reviews.author: Renata M.
reviews.title: The book yes or yes!
reviews.text:
We were lucky enough to choose The Reserve area last minute without really knowing its advantages and it was the best thing that could have happened to us on our couple trip. The difference is abysmal in terms of the privacy you have and the added bonus of having lounge chairs EVERY day in a more private pool that is ever crowded.

There was also the friendly old hotel kitten, Daisy, who everyone loves and we were pleased to see that they take care of very well. 

What I liked the most:
The private pool.
The nespresso cafeteria. I visited her every day and of super quality!
Lemon Fish Restaurant, Salt and The Reserve Pool Restaurant.
The buffet restaurants very rich and complete.
Nice rooms but a little noisy.

What's not so good:
The sea is very rough and can be dangerous.
The pools that are not the reserve are very crowded and look like Spring Break.

Overall, we really liked the more luxurious experience that the category offers, however, the treatment did vary quite a bit between each restaurant. At the one near the pool we were treated slowly and super rudely, and at the Lemon Fish with Jorge and Salt restaurant, we had a super warm and truly wonderful experience.

reviews.author: La C
reviews.title: Happy Birthday!!!
reviews.text: Excellent service, very good quality in food and beverages. Clean facilities, helpful and friendly employees. All top! Armando and Fernando gave us excellent service, congratulations

reviews.author: khughlee
reviews.title: Greqt food and great holiday!!
reviews.text: This resort is perfect for families. Too bad it was closed for renovation this year.  There is a huge pool in which at the end there is a kid's pool.  While swimming to the kid's pool, there is icecream and pizza!  There are also jacuzzis on the way.  Walk down the pool, and there is a beautiful turquoise ocean with no rocks and no seeweed. The ac and fridge didn't work in the two rooms that we were moved to, but I understand the renovation will fix that.  Cielo restaurant is amazing! The food there was the best in any resort I been to.  Hopefully, this resort will open soon!

reviews.author: itn34
reviews.title: My Home Away From Home
reviews.text: I keep coming back year after year and the reason is the staff. Yes the beach is beautiful and hotel has old world charm and warmth,  and stays true to the Mexican culture, but I come back to be taken well care of by the staff. I don't have to worry about much at all. I am immediately greeted by a familiar face of Raul, working so hard in making sure guests arrive and leave safely. Edgar and Rogelio took care of my belongings right away. Galdino was my butler during this stay and he took care of all of my requests and checked in with me daily. Now, if you are lucky enough to stay in The Reserve, you'll have access to the Reserve Pool and you'll be well taken care of by Victor and David. These guys took great care of me as well and helped me get set up every single day and checked on me often. The staff of Sante was so helpful. Most had remembered me from prior stays and even remembered by preferences! Miguel, Cesar, Javier, Yamil, Valeria, and new to me , Jacob, were so helpful. Cielo is by far my favorite restaurant not only at the hotel, but throughout all my travels. Chef David and Moises make me feel special and are always so kind to me. It's always an honor to be able to sit at one of their tables. It really is one of the highlights of my trip that I book dinner there at the start and at the end of trip to savor the food and my experience. Malva is just a great international buffet with high quality and freshly made food, and of course, a wonderful staff. I was lucky enough to have Alberto for most of my meals there, also Ramil and Ivonn were great too when Alberto wasn't around. Armando recognized me from a previous trip, as well as Ferdinanda the hostess. The Nespresso Cafe Bar was a must every morning and Alejandro and Luz handled my caffeine fix deliciously. Head to Capella for some really great Italian food and ask for Jose to take care of you. He's amazing. To wrap up this wonderful trip, I made a new friend named Daisy. She's the resident feline that's made a home for herself at the resort. She is very sweet and likes to make her rounds around the Reserve pool. Hopefully, one of the staff will adopt her before the renovations start next summer. Yes, there is talk of this happening next summer. I am hoping Melia takes care of its staff AND Daisy, and is able to find "homes" for all of them either at their new hotel down the hotel zone (Casa Maya) or Playa del Carmen, and brings all of them back when it's completed. Hoping to return before this!

reviews.author: Erica K. Singleton
reviews.title: Buyer Beware - I’d Never Return
reviews.text:
Just don’t! I traveled here with my husband and son for vacation and  began looking for other resorts to transfer to on my second day of a 5 night vacation. The food was horrible - cold, hair-riddled, with extremely long lines not only buffet, but for restaurant reservations. I a have been home for 1 day and am still experiencing a sour stomach grin the food.  I live in Houston, visit Mexico quite often and had the worst tacos my life from their restaurant that specializes in tacos. On multiple occasions we were sat 45 mins after of reserved time. We’re asking with multiple families waited at the entrance with stay passing by without acknowledgment. 

To be a beach resort, they ran out of towels each day either no options to use anything else. When asked where to find towels, we were told, “go check on the other end. If they don’t have any …sorry. 

Our room was filthy upon check-in. When moved to a service room two days in, there were handfuls of hair stuck to the shower walls.

reviews.author: Kinsley W
reviews.title: Cielo Restaurant
reviews.text: Our favorite restaurant was Cielo and our waiter was Odon. He was great and made  sure that we had everything we needed. 10/10 service!!! Highly recommend the oceanfront rooms with perfect view of the ocean. We came with family, and there was activities to do for all ages.

reviews.author: Kayleigh S
reviews.title: Amazing winter break
reviews.text:
We came to Paradisus to get some winter sun and we were not disappointed. The service was great from start to finish. 

We arrived relatively late and were told that our room with two beds had been given away. This is a disappointing start as we were offered a room with only one bed which didn’t work for us at all. When we went down to complain, Oscar could not have been more helpful and got us moved into a double room the next day. there really isn’t a bad view in the hotel (you get the sunrise and sunset on either side). However, if you’re a reserve guest and an early riser I would recommend the sea view. The maids were great and kept our room very tidy and our mini fridge well stocked. 

We spent a lot of time at the reserve pool and the team there were great! The waiters kept us well watered with drinks all day. The pool team is great too, they always made sure that we had enough towels and that we had an umbrella if we needed it. I did a few of the activities in the day which were well run too - the Mayan blessing was a real highlight. 

The food was generally fantastic! Agua Marina was a real highlight - I ordered the Lobster tail and it was divine! We had some mixed experiences at the buffet - but did not go often enough as we wanted to make use of the restaurants on offer. On Thanksgiving, the hotel hosted a surf and turf night which was so amazing - five courses of amazing food and fantastic ambiance. 

We did the sunset tour on offer as part of the hotel and it was great! We got this for free as part of our package and it was great to see the lagoon. 

A special thanks goes out to Rossana - our concierge during our stay. She was always prompt and so so helpful. She really helped to make the experience. We were told she was the best - and they were right! 

¡Muchas gracias!

reviews.author: Giuditta G
reviews.title: Warning: the hotel is closing for 2+ years so the service is currently TERRIBLE!!!
reviews.text:
I don’t usually leave negative reviews but I actually want to help families and hard working people SAVE their hard earned money! Do NOT book this hotel. We found out the company is renovating and going to CLOSE in May 2025 for renovations. They have let go of staff, their service is absolutely terrible not just ok but TERRIBLE. They tell you to get things yourself. We even upgraded to the adults only side and it was still terrible service. The rooms on the regular side are sub par - our upgrade was much nicer. Also they don’t ask you if you want more food at restaurants, they want you to just leave. You can tell the staff isn’t happy except LUIS the bartender whose always awesome. The staff is trained to give you less. There’s always options of upgrades on the menus to pay for. They have overpriced everything to make a dollar. They no longer care if patrons are happy since they’re closing down and they just want to take as much as they can get before closing down and becoming a new place. It’s literally a joke. The hydro spa was a nice surprise at least. The food was NOT TASTY at all! It’s so suprising because my friend stayed in March at Grand Park Royale cancun it was incredible service, infinity pool, amazing service - and great great food. Very upscale and awesome. The room service was also great but at this hotel it was disgusting. Oh and the nightlife is so disappointing here. No shows. No teams to guide us to other things. It was so random people were so bored at night. It was just super strange all around. Thank God there was good weather and wonderful beach. 

I really feel bad for families that are going to spend a premium to stay here only to experience all of this and just wanted to share to try to help families pick a different place. 

Apparently the reviews previously are good because it WAS spectacular before. But now before they close they really don’t care anymore at all. Save your money. Invest it where you’ll have wonderful food and service.

reviews.author: ng
reviews.title: Cancun trip
reviews.text: First trip to Cancun with family. Enjoyed our stay at the resort. Good service at the restaurant especially Ariliano, Marco and Isiah at Blue Agave. We enjoyed the activities and shows next to the terrace area . Pool was great and beach was beautiful.

reviews.author: Lorena
reviews.title: It was a very amazing experience! Everyone is very friendly and attentive! We would like to thank everyone!
reviews.text: Miguel was very competent and attentive! I liked very much its anticipation, I highly recommend! En Sante was perfect! We stayed for 2 weeks and always ran away well taken care of. There food is one of the best, in Flora we eat aun very well. In Lounge with Júlio we were very well served

reviews.author: Ina W
reviews.title: Top holidays
reviews.text: Good service, very friendly staff. Miguel in particular took good care of us. Food was always delicious. Wide selection of different restaurants. Overall, we had a super great and relaxing holiday and would always come back.

reviews.author: Vardges S
reviews.title: Best service by Jesus at Lemon Fish !!
reviews.text: Best service at Lemon Fish by Jesus!!  Amazing service by him.  Highly recommend. You should definitely try the braised beef!!  Perfectly cooked. And their ramen soup was delicious.  Next time you visit, definitely check this beautiful restaurant out!!

reviews.author: NnekaJuf
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text: Overall great location, food and service. I was even more impressed with the service because we had several events at this location and our coordinator did an amazing job ensuring we got what we needed, a huge thank you to Hernandez Omar for all your hard work, and to the inspire crew, the driver who picked us up and all the folks who helped make our milestone birthday party a success.

reviews.author: NIka
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text:
An amazing time at Paradisus, I was celebrating a milestone birthday without my twin, we reached out to different hotels and couldn’t find the right person to help. We finally got a hold of Hernandez who was our events coordinator. He went above and beyond. He was patient with every demand and ask we made. When we finally met him in person he was even more attentive. He made my sister and I feel special and was crucial
To our even being a success. I would go back here and would 1000 percent recommend not just the hotel but If you are having an event ask for Hernandez Omar. He was amazing. Thank you for your excellent attention to detail.

reviews.author: Margie K
reviews.title: Paradisis Reserve Section Appreciation
reviews.text: A beautiful resort and exceptional service at all resort locations. The team at the Reserve section are incredible hosts: professional and dedicated to offering clients a special experience. We definitely recommend the Reserve section to those travelling without children and looking for a next level customer experience vacation.

reviews.author: Shambhavi S
reviews.title: Amazing food and service at Blueagave - Mexican Restaurant
reviews.text: Amazing food at Blue Agave, Paradisus Cancun. We tried their tacos and mushroom salad. Everything was so fresh and prepared really well. Compliments to chef Isaias. Excellent service by our server Atilano. He is extremely hardworking and  the staff is really friendly. Highly recommend eating here if you are staying at Paradisus. We will definitely visit again.

reviews.author: Rosaly K
reviews.title: Paradisus over thanksgiving weekend
reviews.text: We booked for 6 nights 7 days and we thought the restaurants had pretty great food options. The breakfast and lunch buffet were delicious with lots of choices.  When we dined at flora our waiter was Santos, he was by far the best service we had and so nice and helpful and friendly, he deserves a raise.  Fernando at Capella was pretty great too. The beach was amazing and warm and fun to play in the waves. The pools were refreshing and not that crowded. The rooms were reasonably sized with a balcony and ocean view, but you can definitely see the age of the hotel. The shower leaked like a flood every time we showered, the bathroom door was worn and torn with rotted wood and the mini fridge didn’t work but not enough to complain since we spent most our time outside anyway. Most of the staff were friendly and accommodating but some weren’t so friendly, which was fine. I would say the restaurants and buffet had better food them other all inclusive we’ve stayed at but the hotel rooms could use some updates but all in all we had a very pleasant stay.

reviews.author: Abu T
reviews.title: Amazing Miguel at Lemon Fish restaurant
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at Paradisus Cancun’s Lemon Fish restaurant. It was mainly because of our server, Miguel. I do not recall coming across such a kind and sharp server. He was prompt, understood our needs and contextually very aware. Thanks to Miguel and his supervisor. Best wishes -

reviews.author: Sergio R
reviews.title: Not what it used to be.
reviews.text:
He have been to this resort at least 5 times over the last 9 years. This time around sad to say the quality and attention to detail
Is not the same as our past stays. 

You can tell they are not putting level of attention as they used to to staff, service and rooms. 

With a bit more of investment into the hotel it can hopefully get to where it used to be. 

Staff seem overwhelmed, there are delays everywhere we are at. Food is not was it used to be. The property still has that beautiful feel and the beach is still the same just sad we are leaving this type of review when it’s been our go to vacation destination for so many years. 

When we voiced our concerns you can tell mgmt notified the staff at the restaurant we ate and they were really attentive to us. 

When we ran into a staff member we recognized in years past he too admitted ownership hasn’t been investing the same as before. 

Apparently they will be remodeling the property in 2025. Months Hope it’s all for the better and don’t take away from the nautical beautify the entrance has. 

Wish mgmt would have really taken our concerns and at least comp’d us a night or at least can invite us back when the remodel is done to give this place a better review. 

This could be the last time we stay here :(

reviews.author: karinaV9906SJ
reviews.title: Excellent hotel 100% recommended
reviews.text: 100% family place, luxury facilities, excellent customer service, very warm and respectful people, ideal to rest and enjoy the beautiful sea

reviews.author: Marilu V
reviews.title: Maravillosa
reviews.text:
All the staff attention was wonderful. 
The Mayan ceremony was a new experience for us and something unique that no hotel offers, we loved participating with them. 
Our whole instance was amazing, the variety of restaurants for dining option very good service

reviews.author: Viktor H
reviews.title: Nice beach, beautiful resort, but needs maintenance and better service
reviews.text: The good - nice beautiful lobby, big room, plenty of walking space for the Cancun hotel zone resort. Good Nespresso coffee is a hude plus!!! But service is below average - similar priced resorts have much better service - lack or workers. They are running out of towels several times a day - not appropriate for the hotel priced at $400+/night. Very hard to find beach chair or near the pool. The management trying to sell you a cabana for $250/day instead of providing a free beach/pool chair. The buffet also below average, but restaurants are good! The hotel is outdated, needs maintenance touch in many areas, rooms needs to be updated. Very limited entertainment for teenagers. Not the worst resort, but we will not come back - expected more for the price paid. Thank you for the proffesional live band on Thanksgiving day!

reviews.author: WendyCristina
reviews.title: I LOVE THE HOTEL IS A PARADISE
reviews.text: The facilities I loved for the pyramid structure and greenery, the breathtaking Caribbean sea view, the personalized attention, the food plan has many options, the location is accessible, the cleanliness of the hotel is spotless, the staff attentive to requests , very friendly.

reviews.author: Mar
reviews.title: Good hotel, well located and good intentions
reviews.text:
Good hotel 
Good and comfortable facilities. Located on the beach with many services: several swimming pools, bars and restaurants. 
Regarding the treatment of the staff we generally appreciate a slightly tense atmosphere, not at all a bad treatment, but as I say we perceive some degree of stress improperly managed.
It is possible, from what we saw, that because it is a hotel with a lot of daily movement of arrivals and departures.

RECOMMENDED, OF COURSE YOU DO!!!

reviews.author: Romina G
reviews.title: Low quality but good working staff
reviews.text:
I came back for the 2nd time and the truth is there are several things to improve. It's not bad but I'm down to what it was before. 
In the snacks air the attention of Laura was excellent, super attentive and friendly. Pizzas are delicious and the variety of ice cream is AMAZING. Never seen before in any all inclusive.
The same thing I highlight to Jorge of the restaurant lemon fish. It made us feel incredibly good to indulge in dishes that we thought we wouldn’t find what we liked. Very but very attentive

reviews.author: TAMAYA69
reviews.title: Spectacular hotel!
reviews.text:
Amazing hotel, spectacular...
Reserve a privilege area.
Very happy with Don Miguel, Victor and David who are great!. In Heaven, Jose had such patience. Sal was super special for Stephanie. And now day 2, with this anniversary surprise. Very grateful. We have 3 more nights!.

reviews.author: Martina S
reviews.title: Exceptional
reviews.text:
The stay at this hotel was truly unforgettable. The structure is elegant and equipped with all the necessary amenities. The extraordinary location offers spectacular views of the ocean. 

The real surprise was the exceptional service offered by the staff. 

Special thanks go to Alejandro, the bartender, who made every coffee break unique.

We look forward to returning.
Congratulations, everyone.

reviews.author: olena449
reviews.title: Great Experience.
reviews.text: Excellent staff, especially Renan at Agua Marina. He was absolutely wonderful and came back to visit him multiple times during my stay. Beautiful resort for either friends or families. I will be returning.

reviews.author: Yaneissa R
reviews.title: The best experience.
reviews.text: We were celebrating our anniversary at the hotel and we were fascinated with Ernesto from the restaurant “Lemon fish”. It made our dinner perfect and special. The supervisors and managers of the restaurant made our evening spectacular. Thanks for everything.

reviews.author: Paul V
reviews.title: Great resort with a friendly staff.
reviews.text: We were here for our anniversary and we had the best experience . All the waiters and waitresses are friendly kind and fantastic -  Juan Carlos Gonzalez was our concierge and he was the best, very caring and personable.  I highly recommend this resort.

reviews.author: Wander816590
reviews.title: Reasonable
reviews.text: When we arrived at the resort we went with my boyfriend's parents and put each couple in different pyramids. They had one or another friendly employee but many of them antipathetic at the restaurant Malva often ignored the customer, when he ordered something like a dessert cutter that was never disposable neither in the buffet nor in the tables were still badly disguised for asking as if it were a favor, the food always the same. Limited animation, restaurants and bars closed after 23:00 p.m. The staff of the ginger bar, the snacks from the pool area and the pool bar were very attentive. The shower in the room did not work properly.For a resort of 5 * needed to improve.The lack of loungers in the pool area, was a fortune to catch any because many of them are reserved so to pay off the amount that had already been paid.The Nespresso cafeteria staff very friendly and attentive, very good coffee always filled with cookies to accompany.Good and clean rooms and mini bar always loaded. Very nice resort and good beach.

reviews.author: leo a
reviews.title: I recommend
reviews.text: Excellent place , room and facilities and attention of staff always smiling and attending to the needs when vacationing

reviews.author: AJ C
reviews.title: Pros and cons but more cons
reviews.text:
Beautiful property, beaches and great entertainment for families and adults.

Room had constant maintenance issues and repairs were temporary patches. The food and beverage facilities close way too early and there are no other options available.

reviews.author: Andrea J
reviews.title: Melía the dream team
reviews.text: Melía Paradisus Cancun is the best in breakfast service. Kudos to Valentin, Enrique and Roberto Islas aren the dream team. Excellent service and hospitality. If you are in Meliá Paradisus Cancun ask for Mario the capitán of breakfast service. The best.

reviews.author: Miss p
reviews.title: Old hotel with cold food. Save your money and go elsewhere.
reviews.text:
I am a mom of two kids, the founder of a company, and came with my extended family to this hotel for thanksgiving. I have stayed in multiple all inclusives and interesting thing I have noticed about this hotel is service is terrible. 

I have a feeling the reviews of this hotel are probably fake. Here’s why:

1) We booked family concierge and when we arrived, there were no sheets for the kids beds. In fact, we all had to sleep on one bed because there was no “concierge” available to take our call. 

2) The restaurants, even though half empty, can’t handle the guests. They ran out of chicken in one restaurant and the other restaurant had cold meat. Not sure it was worth paying the all inclusive price. 

3) The hotel is super outdated. The rooms are falling apart. We paid almost $4200 for these rooms. 

I slept terribly. I’m actually scared there are bed bugs. Please save your money and go to Hyatt Ziva. I stayed there last year and had a great time. None of these issues.

I have 6 more days left here… not sure what I’m going to to.

reviews.author: Daniel Y
reviews.title: HIGH PRESSURE sales tactics within the resort
reviews.text:
The service, food and pool are absolutely fantastic but I will be spreading my words to all my colleagues in my airline because there’s something really unfortunate here. This is my third day here, and I am here only for 4 days. The first day when we arrived the moment we step into the hotel, we received a really warm welcome from a so-call concierge person, showing us around the hotel and explaining how everything works around here. We felt great, but things turn south after a while, I kept being pushes to listen to a 40 minutes hotel presentation with exchange of free tour or beach club entries. Even today, I am still getting texts from the concierge asking me to go to the presentation. 

I am really fed up with this situation happening in this resort. I am not sure how are they being treated as an employee but the way he insists on asking me to go to the presentation is telling me this resort is doing some really bad practice. How can you let your guest to stay in a resort that supposed to be relaxing but at the back of the mind keep thinking how to reject the presentation offer. 

Your company should be ashamed of doing practice like this. I am not blaming on the employee but the management. And I will definitely spread my words.

reviews.author: Dennis B
reviews.title: Hot, humid, roof leaked pretty bad in several areas, our concierge was hard to reach, and room had issues with A/C
reviews.text: To start, our check in took way longer than they said it would. Had to change rooms due to the patio door letting hot humid air in so  the A/C didn’t work. Our concierge was hard to reach most of the time, and had to keep on him to get things done! Won’t go again. Spent most of the time hot and sweaty due to no air movement inside the resort. Food was decent, and beach set up was nice! Best part of trip was Dolly the Cat that lived at the resort and would visit you for pets.

reviews.author: Roland V
reviews.title: Great experience at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Let me start with the best waiter of the resort; ‘Jorge’ at Lemonfish.

All the staff are also great with an extra shoutout to the ones at the coffee bar.

We are a family of 4 and booked the family concierge. Our concierge was Limberth and he is the best! He got us various reservations for the restaurants, extra’s for the kids (toys, hats, slippers etc) , cupcakes wine and cookies, reserved the spa, sunset cruise, late check out and the list goes on. Make sure to take good care of him and you’ll receive it back.

Lemonfish is by far the best A la carte

The buffet is very good although we found it better for breakfast and lunch than dinner.

Pool service is also amazing 

I highly recommend this resort and we have been to many so we know our stuff

Go book it

reviews.author: Jamie P
reviews.title: Amazing Experience!
reviews.text: Our trip was absolutely amazing! The service was fantastic. The resort was absolutely beautiful, rooms were great. We went to Celia, Moises and Odon made our experience so great! They made my daughter’s birthday so memorable, and special. I can not recommend this resort enough. It is very clean, beautiful and so much fun. Thank you!

reviews.author: pliniovazquezarce
reviews.title: Enjoy your stay
reviews.text: Very attentive, very complete gastronomy for all tastes elegant spaces very nice facilities

reviews.author: Experience821507
reviews.title: We loved it, we give it 5 stars.
reviews.text:
We love Cancun. This was our second experience in an all-inclusive hotel, and by far the Oil Hotel has been the best.
The hotel staff was very friendly and always attentive to our needs.
The sea view room offers a stunning view. Everything was spotlessly clean. Room service was excellent, with delicious food and a reasonable waiting time. The food of all the restaurants in the hotel is equally delicious, with excellent service from the waiters. (The Blue Restaurant has a buffet. They prepare delicious eggs to your liking. Pilar was very attentive; when she learned that my husband is a vegetarian, she ordered meatless beans for breakfast the next day). Beautiful beach and nice pool.
In the cafeteria, Patricia and Diana indulged us with delicious coffees accompanied by delicious cookies and desserts
Our favorite restaurant was ALMAR; the food is exquisite. The staff was very helpful. Our waiters, Enrique and Roger, were very attentive and friendly, making sure we enjoyed our dinner to the fullest.

reviews.author: Jasmin K
reviews.title: Price/performance very poor
reviews.text:
unfortunately I only have 200 characters rating

Come to us from the Allgäu, couple, 38 years old, no children 

This is absolutely fake, TikTok does not correspond to the truth . You don't feel particularly in reserve. Everything costs extra. Butler only seen once before.  Unclean. In need of renovation.

Lie on the beach and want my money back.

reviews.author: Bruno B
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text:
Celebrating 10 years of marriage, very well served by Ernesto at Lemon Fish!
Wonderful experience in this place! I recommend!
I also remember Flora's resturants because we were very well served by Alex! Both Flora and Lemon Fish, for me, were the best restaurants!

reviews.author: Soledad S
reviews.title: paradisus
reviews.text:
excellent facilities, very friendly all very predisposed to make the guest's stay unforgettable.
the restaurants very good.
while I really liked the hotel and was family friendly, I found it great that there is a pool sector and restaurant for adults.

reviews.author: Joel
reviews.title: Very bad attitude. It's not worth the price.
reviews.text:
We had to request room change for excessive mould smell and the receptionist treated us with a lot of unwillingness. The new room flooded when there was a stronger rain. To make it worse, they were repairing the room above ours and the noise started at 7:30 a.m.
Most of the employees gave a bad service, some with quite rude.
For hotel standard, we expected a better experience.

reviews.author: Gustavo G
reviews.title: Good hotel, but it was better.
reviews.text: After an excellent experience on our last trip in 2021, we realized that the service and service showed a significant deterioration. The excellence observed last time did not repeat itself, even by hiring an additional service of family concierge.

reviews.author: Brittnay F
reviews.title: MEH
reviews.text: Not the best....We didn't have one great meal the entire time we were there. The only "decent" meal was Lemon Fish. We were supposed to have our rooms adjoining (took our teenage kids) and they put us on different floors. Lack of amenities. I would have liked to see fitness classes throughout the AM- they only had early AM classes, which if you're on vacation I would prefer mid AM. The facilities are showing its age for sure- lots of roof leaks, peeling paint, etc. Customer Service was low level. No activities for teens at all aside from pool/beach. Definitely the worst all inclusive we have been to for sure. Will not be coming back.

reviews.author: Papii A
reviews.title: Flavoursome Cielo
reviews.text:
Cielo.. Wow! Wow! Best restaurant in Paradisus Cancun. The aesthetic is very simple but the food was far from that, every single dish that we had from starter to dessert was amazing, flavoursome and just wow!

Moises the gentleman that served us was very kind in explaining the meals and answering any questions we had. 

10/10 Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Carlos A
reviews.title: Excellent service!
reviews.text: Loved it! Excellent seasoning the Mexican Sky restaurant, Chef Emilio has excellent seasoning and our waiter Melvin had excellent service and attention, 100% recommended. Of the best hotels I have ever met in the hotel zone of Cancun.

reviews.author: Sary F
reviews.title: Sky restored
reviews.text: The restaurant heaven of Mexican food has a chef, Emilio, with excellent seasoning and the service of the waiters very attentive and friendly ✨ recommended, make reservation, all their dishes and desserts are good, the amount of food served is a good portion which allows you to try several things

reviews.author: carlosrodriguez2024
reviews.title: Deception
reviews.text: I agree with the issue of environmental protection, but nowhere in the reservation process do they explain that there will be a "environmental tax" charge and when charged they refused to give me receipt of such a charge.

reviews.author: argarcitel
reviews.title: Excellent

reviews.author: Joni

The Mexican restaurant Cielo is good here! Moises was such a good waiter.  Overall our stay was good.  It’s not the best one even
Been in Cancun but overall is nice because the beach you get here is beautiful.  They don’t have a lot of sun Chairs high so it’s something I would recommend for them to get.  We come to bask in the sun so to us that was important.

reviews.author: veronica b
reviews.title: Family holidays
reviews.text: The restaurant Cielo, unforgettable on this trip, the attention to me , which I am celiac spectacular, the chef Emilio came expressly to my table in every dish, the manager Adriana is a person sun and supervised every moment, and the waiters Lucas and jose very attentive in every detail !! Do not miss this Mexican experience!!!

reviews.author: Sonia
reviews.title: Lemon fish service impeccable
reviews.text: Lemon Fish restaurant is one of the best restaurants inside the hotel. The service and the friendly of Jesus and Boris Altamirano were impressive, they let you feel like you are home. Amazing food also has been served. You must try it if you come to Paradisus Cancun

reviews.author: jwhitworth2024
reviews.title: YOU WON'T BE DISAPPOINTED
reviews.text: The service, cleanliness, pool all of it was amazing. The food at Malva was the best for eating. The  beach was beautiful and clean. The cabanas was a bet expensive to rent. The Pool side chairs are free but the get gone early so be sure to get yours before you go get breakfast.  The resort is on a strip were you can catch the bus and go to Coco Bongo or visit the famous CANCUN sign.. I felt very safe going off site. Overall this resort will be my go to when I come back to  Cancun.

reviews.author: Deneb L
reviews.title: Very good service
reviews.text:
All excellent and very good staff 

Blue agave restaurant 
Very good chef and service by Xochitl 

It hosts great service by Victor and Caesar. 

The service is very good and the location excellent too.

Overall great service and looking forward to returning soon.

reviews.author: r55wils0n
reviews.title: Wedding week
reviews.text: Location is great, friendly staff and spa was very nice. Could use some work on their air conditioning system as my room was hot, which caused for poor sleep. Also hotel leaked when it rained.

reviews.author: emmypaul9
reviews.title: AMAZING VACATION
reviews.text: What an amazing experience! We stayed at the reserve and it was such a beautiful environment. Our concierge’s Lalo was absolutely incredible. He gave us individualized special attention every day. We were there to celebrate our anniversary and several days of our trip. We found special treats and a bottle of wine along with a card congratulating us on our anniversary. He also made sure we had reservations for dinner and anything else we needed each day to make our stay perfect! David, the pool concierge was phenomenal and made sure we had a beautiful Bali bed each day. He makes sure everyone is taken care of and feels special. He also checked on us throughout the day to make sure we were doing great! Jorge  at Lemon Fish made our dining experience the very best! We explained that we didn’t like seafood and he ordered us amazing sushi made by the chef with chicken and beef! He made us unique drinks that were delicious! Most of our meal was off menu and specialized to our taste. We cannot wait to go back. This was our 10th visit to Mexico and our first time at Paradisus  Cancun, It was the best vacation we’ve ever had in Mexico.

reviews.author: Jesus V
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: Very good service! Excellent service and super attention, from the bar staffed by Julio to our Waiter Atilano Díaz were very attentive, helped us to further facilitate our experience as well as recommendations to have a more comfortable experience, certainly one of the best experiences for dinner. Highly recommended for everyone to get to know them

reviews.author: Michelle S
reviews.title: Thank you Ernesto!
reviews.text:
We came here on our trip to Cancun and went to Lemon Fish on our last night. Our server Ernesto at Lemon Fish was very  attentive and understanding to our questions about the different cuisines! He made us laugh too! 

As for the food, it  was delicious and fresh. 10/10 would recommend for people to come to Lemon Fish! 

Y gracias Ernesto!

reviews.author: Maria Elena E
reviews.title: Thanks Paradisus Cancun for making my Birthday stay an special one.
reviews.text: I came with my husband for my birthday. The facilities were average (we came to know a hotel overhaul got started and we should have a new experience next time). Hotel views and the beach are fantastic! The beach pool services are other world, specifically would like to mention our pool waitress - Laura Cervantes - she did an amazing job, very attentive and amicable. She even made sure I had a pool birthday cake with all waitresses singing the happy birthday song for me. She is a jewel and knows how to treat a host. I would also like to mention our concierge Jenny, who also made sure we were treated like royals and even sent white wine to our room with a Birthday cake which made our evening special. Aa for the restaurants, we recommend Flora Restaurant, the food was exquisite and services were supreme. We are members of the Melia resort for about 20 years now and have travelled the world and always staying with Melia. We recommend the experience and definitely it is their staff which makes the difference. Thank You Laura, Jenny and Hector too!!!! Thank You! Gracias ! You made my birthday an special one.

reviews.author: Juan
reviews.title: Excellent service in the pool area concierge and hospitality
reviews.text: Really Paradisus Cancun has good facilities according to what is paid; the reason I am putting this rating is for the excellent service of the pool concierge, the extraordinary waiters always very attentive especially Laura our waitress almost personal in the pool area; on the other hand also Hector attended us very very very well, Jenni our assigned concierge very attentive and we support us in everything we ask without exception.... the green areas very well cared for and in general the hospitality services very well; on the other hand we want to also give a very good rating to the restaurant Flora and its staff who helped me to be my accomplices in my wife's birthday

reviews.author: rmckenna1313
reviews.title: Amazing Experience!
reviews.text: Staff was extremely friendly and attentive. Each went above and beyond to create an unforgettable experience

reviews.author: Teresa P
reviews.title: Beautiful experience
reviews.text: The overall hotel is beautiful! Divine beach ! for dinner it is better to make reservations in restaurants because in the buffet at night there is little variety. He stressed the attention of the staff in general is very good! The impeccable facilities .we spent a beautiful family days.

reviews.author: kevin g
reviews.title: Amazing.
reviews.text: The hotel is amazing and immense, it cares a lot about the environment hence there are a few smoking rules. The staff is very attentive and helpful, the activities are fun and has a variety of restaurants to choose from, just book. 100% recommended.

reviews.author: gsswjmc
reviews.title: Lackluster
reviews.text:
I purchased personal concierge service. Not worth it. The room was not worth it. Free round trip transfer was hard to book, so I had to pay for personal service. NONE of the promotional benefits were NEVER offered.

When I travel, I don’t like to bring any of my personal payment. The resort had the credit card on file, but did NOT run that payment. I had to pay when I got there and I didn’t have my physical payment. I wanted to pay by CC tap since my card is on my phone. I was told I couldn’t. I had to then tell my husband on his surprise trip that he has to pay.

Step up bathroom is a NO! The room was too small to be a suite. Will NEVER get this room again for the price.

My goodness. Never is this addition worth it. I forgot a book in my room that I wanted to read by the pool and I asked the concierge (that I paid for service) to go to my room to retrieve a personal item. He told me he was in a meeting and NEVER updated me of his availability. On top of that, when he first introduced himself at check in, he had an obnoxious stain on his shirt. I could have done his job. I told them before hand that it was my husband’s 40th bday and we didn’t get NOTHING special in the room. Even if it was a door sash…NOTHING!

Too many kids and not any adult only. And if it was adult only, we couldn’t access since we didn’t get that package. Very stupid.

Flight wasn’t until 10a and we had to take a shuttle 10 min up the road @4:30a. The hotel was supposed to give the ride for free, but we still had to pay. Way too early and I was NOT happy about having to get up at 3:30a to be at the airport 6 hrs early.

reviews.author: Dan P
reviews.title: Jesus x Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
Me and my partner had a meal in the Lemon Fish restaurant. And had outstanding service by Jesus. 

Highly recommend the Tacu Tacu beef and Pork rib ( if you're not a fish eater - lots of fish on the menu if you are) 

If you're lucky enough to have Jesus as your waiter it'll be an amazing experience

Gracias Amigo

reviews.author: SSDL
reviews.title: Worth the visit!
reviews.text: The staff was courteous,  cheerful,  patient (with me not speaking a lick of Spanish) and incredibly helpful.  We stayed on the adult-only side of the resort and thoroughly enjoyed the calmer poolside environment.  Be sure to make your dining and cabana reservations ahead of time (I didn't know this).  There is a company on-site to book excursions through and we felt safe and had a great time on each of them.

reviews.author: Diane P
reviews.title: Tower Five Adult only was Perfect!
reviews.text:
We went down for a work Conference and then stayed extra time afterwards. We booked the Adults only side, Tower 5, and the service was top notch. Our concierge Lalo went above and beyond to make sure we had the best time while there. Lalo made all of our dinner reservations and spa reservation (he even helped me make sure to get a credit card mix up sorted out). Our room was unreal, exceptionally clean, towels were nice, showers big and bed was very very comfortable. Pillows are not great at all unfortunately. 

Overall I'd stay in Tower 5 again for sure.

reviews.author: Sightsee00864651490
reviews.title: A good experience but, much to improve.
reviews.text:
The hotel is really very cute, huge and varied in its spaces and activities, but you notice the age and lack of maintenance of at least, the rooms. I had to ask for change the first day we arrived. The shower was dirty, the water barely came out the middle of the shower because it was covered. The air conditioning didn't stop sounding like old jar throughout the night and the floor of the room with sand everywhere. 
The arrangement to change us was good, quick and gentle; however, the new room also had the sink covered and it was quite unpleasant having to use it. 
The staff was generally good. Unfortunately, I was left with the feeling that the wages must be quite poor and perhaps that is why there are workers who move ONLY when there is a tip involved. I noticed discontent or annoyance from some people about having to work there, that was strange.

reviews.author: Frances P
reviews.title: Paradisus excellente
reviews.text: From the moment we arrived we were met with great hospitality from all the staff along with our concierge Galvi Chavez. He escorted us to our suite and made sure we had everything we needed! I would highly recommend this hotel but make sure you are ready to walk. It was a beautiful experience for my family and I coming from the USA. Beautiful culture!

reviews.author: Yady George
