reviews.author: Jay K
reviews.title: Staff at Paradisus Cancun made our vacation special
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus Cancun recently, and the experience was absolutely fantastic. What made the place so special, besides the sugar sand beach and the turquoise water, was the fantastic workers who connect with the guest and elevate their vacation experience by providing excellent care.  Kudos to Ivonn and Alberto in Malva Resturant - always welcoming, warm smiles and excellent service.
I noticed that the resort staff put their right hand near their heart when they greeted the guests. I thought it was neat, unique, and sincere for them to do that. We are planning to return soon on our next vacation.

reviews.author: Vadim S
reviews.title: Amazing service
reviews.text: Amazing service at hotel and restaurants. Rooms could use some work especially the bathrooms but otherwise amazing. Jorge and miguel at lemon fish were the highlight with amazing care for us and our baby for dinner. Service around the hotel and the other restaurants was great as well always so accommodating.

reviews.author: Susan W
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
Vacationed at Paradisus by Melia and upgraded to stay at The Reserve which is the only adult section of the resort. 

Pros 
-the hotel is situated on a beautiful beach with spectacular views of the ocean. It’s a beautiful hue of blue 
-the food at each of the restaurant had its fine points which will be individually reviewed below 
-the reserve allows you to book a cabana with Bali beds x2 within your stay so you are guaranteed to be close to the pool. There is continuous service at the pool which allows you to order drinks and food 
-the Reserve rooms are situated close to the Reserve adults only lounge and pool.
-the activities of crafts, yoga, local activities ie guacamole making, incense making are very interactive 
-The Reserve also includes a complimentary spa session, featuring dry and steam saunas, as well as cooling pools.

Cons 
-the rooms at the Reserve needs updating. The rooms had a plumbing issue which resulted a wailing ambulance noise each time we flushed the toilet 
-the cleanliness of the room needs to be looked into. The chairs and walls in the room dinning nook had dried food debris 
-there are ample spots to sit in the Reserve section by the ocean on the beach but the cabanas made of straws are so long that it drapes over and you won’t see the ocean view. There is also no drink or food service 
-the rooms are not sound proof. The wedding music playing outside is heard clearly throughout the night. We have heard other patrons yelling and swearing when loud entertainment is played outside in the evenings in protest
-the room light fixture and tv needed to be fixed. Light and tv were flickering
-there is a mixture of patrons in age. It was nice that most patrons kept to themselves, are quiet and not rude. There were some that were louder and inebriated using mild foul language 
-the evening entertainment were only ok ie the African acrobats and singing were mediocre

Overall, I still recommend the Reserve. It offers all the services mentioned above and includes a concierge to assist with restaurant reservations. Additionally, the Reserve lounge provides snacks, drinks, and coffee throughout the day.

Restaurant Reviews:
-The buffet is mediocre and doesn’t compare well to those at other resorts.
-Sante, available exclusively to Reserve guests, is excellent for a pleasant sit-down breakfast and lunch. However, I wouldn’t recommend the catch of the day, as it’s a pan-fried whole fish with many bones. 
-Cielo  serves Mexican cuisine, which is of higher quality than the other Mexican options at the resort.
-Flora offers a delicious menu featuring prawns, salads, and other great selections with a health focused menu
-Sal Steakhouse provides excellent service, with amazing appetizers and sides. However, the New York steak was disappointing, as it seemed like a lower-quality cut and resembled the look and taste of a pork chop. I expected steaks more comparable to those at The Keg. You can choose to pay extra for USDA cuts.
-Lemon Fish is a nice alternative, offering Japanese and Peruvian fusion such as sushi, ramen and ceviche —a refreshing change from the Caribbean and Mexican dishes typically available.

Each restaurant also has vegetarian options.

The resort staff do not expect tips, but they genuinely appreciate them.

reviews.author: Cathy L
reviews.title: For a 5 Star Resort - The Reserve - You would expect MUCH better!!!
reviews.text:
Arrived Sunday Nov. 3, 2024 - for a work conference.  The check in process was slow - but that was expected with a large group.  Most of the group had paid for the upgrade to be in The Reserve section of the resort - adults only - along with perks outlined on their website.    
Once in The Reserve - pyramid 5 - we were advised that any issues or concerns moving forward would be addressed at the Customer Service Desk within The Reserve.   
We were escorted to the room we paid for - an OceanView Suite - when the door was opened - there was a very strong chemical smell - ignoring the smell for a moment and excited to see our OceanView - I ran to the curtains to open them...just to find a large grass berm - you could "see" the ocean if you looked past the berm to the left or right - but there was definitely no OceanView - to pay additional for - very disappointing.  
...back to the smell - it was so bad our Bell Hop was waiving his hand in front of his nose - and made the comment "you can not stay here".  
I went to the Customer Service Desk - I sat down to discuss our concerns with ALANDRA - I expressed the fact we paid extra to be in the OceanView Suite and along with the smell - we would like to be moved to another room.  She very quickly and rudely said "no" - no care for our situation at all.  I pleaded with her - stating even their Bell Hop said we could not stay in the room - and she very bluntly again said "no - we have no where to move you"    ....again pleading with not only her - but her coworker beside her (I did not get his name) - I asked that either one "please come to the room to smell the odour - and you will see - we are not able to stay in the room" - they then spoke Spanish to each other ...laughed...and the gentleman looked at me and said "I will not be going anywhere with you ma'am" in a VERY sarcastic manner.    I WAS MORTIFIED....this is a 5 star resort - and we paid EXTRA to be within The Reserve section.  And to be treated this way - I couldn't believe it.   
It was at this time - a concierge came over - understanding I was upset at this time.  He spoke to them and it was only then that we were told they would "try" to help us get a different room.   Three hours later we were shown to a room in Pyramid 4 and settled there - being told we could keep our "Reserve" wrist bands so we could still receive the benefits of paying for The Reserve upgrade. 

After speaking with many of our business associates - they also had the same experience with ALANDRA - she was rude - unwilling to help with concerns that were brought to her attention.  On more than 1 occasion (myself included) we were told that even though we paid the upgrade to be in The Reserve section of the resort - since we booked with a group - we were considered "lesser" (Alandra's words) and we would not receive what the website stated were "perks" of paying for the upgrade in The Reserve section.  Shocked to say the least.

On top of Alandra being so unprofessional:
- the food was...at best...a 6/10 - most of the time coming cold to the table.   
- for being an all inclusive - there were many things that you still needed to pay for if you wanted to take part - food on the menu's / seating at the pool / certain alcohol's
- Spa credits - as part of paying for The Reserve were not honoured because we were part of a group
- MiniBar/Snacks were not replenished daily (for our Reserve business associates either)
- Front Desk - Customer Service - if concerns were brought to them - they also would tell us - they could not help because we booked as a group.  

I just want to make this very clear - when we booked with our group - I am very diligent at researching the resort and pricing myself (I just want to know what we are paying with the group vs. booking ourselves) - I went on Expedia - the exact same dates - in The Reserve - for a OceanView Suite - was $1,500.00 cheaper than what we paid for with the group - so to continually be told we were "lesser" somehow because we booked with a group - we paid $1,500.00 more than if we would have booked ourselves AND we would have not had an issue what-so-ever receiving the "perks" of being a Reserve Guest.   Unreal!

The service outside of The Reserve was great - poolside / waiters/waitresses / cafe's / bars - they were all professional and kind. 

The ONLY thing that deserved a 10/10 for this resort ...the Beach - if you are willing to forego everything I just mentioned above - the Beach is beyond gorgeous!  
White Sands - Turquois Water - Gorgeous!

reviews.author: Happiness56450976245
reviews.title: Our Wedding
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus Cancun for our wedding. 

The planning prior to the trip was good and direct, we decided to plan it ourselves, corresponding with the hotel itself. 

Any worries we might have had prior to our arrival were diminished once we met Abigail - our wedding coordinator. She was amazing. She offered great help due to the chance of inclement weather and made sure everything was perfect along the way. 

We, and our 60 plus group guest list had an amazing week and the best wedding experience- ever!

reviews.author: Carrol B
reviews.title: A wonderful time
reviews.text: We truly enjoyed our time here. The place is beautiful and the staff is very accommodating and friendly. The food, especially Lemon Fish, was delicious and our server, Jesus, was the best! Definitely would recommend this place for a relaxing and wonderful time!

reviews.author: Chelsea B
reviews.title: The people ❤️
reviews.text:
I want to take a minute to recognize how amazing the staff is. 
We stayed in the Reserve side so most of our interactions were with the staff who worked on that side. 
      Jose was our concerige and he made sure that everything ran smoothly and was constantly in contact with us and making sure that we got the most out of our experience.
      Oscar was the first face we saw as he checked us in and such a nice guy. You couldn't help but stop by for a chat on the way by.
      Julio was the bartender indoors on the reserve side. Friendliest face to come across with the best smile and always ready to mix you a drink.
      Martin was a waiter in the buffet, who has the most charismatic personality. Gave us all a great history lesson and made thee best cantarito that nobody else could replicate. 
      David and Victor at the cabanas were also two great guys. So friendly, had lot of great conversations with them and they were always checking that we had everything we needed.

I saved the best for last ....

Miguel worked around the reserve pool and Sante resteraunt. His service was top notch. He kept the drinks flowing and the food coming. He took incredibly good care of us and we definitely developed a friendship during our stay. 

The hotel was beautiful and very clean and I was in awe over the whole place but the people is what what made it incredible.

reviews.author: marjane1234
reviews.title: Best Resort in Playa
reviews.text: We have stayed at La Perla and the Reserve for many years now, it never disappoints!!!  Renau and Gabriela at Sante are two of the best servers we have ever had in Mexico.  They truly have become like family to us and we go back because of them.  Jesus our concierge is amazing as well and bent over backwards for us time and time again.  Yoga with Michelle was great and Pilate with Elena was intense,  great women and athletes.  I would highly recommend this resort :)  Look forward to our next trip soon.

reviews.author: Jo W
reviews.title: Good hotel with exceptional views of Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Overall a very good hotel set on the beautiful Caribbean sea. The positives - we enjoyed a gorgeous uninterrupted view of the beautiful Caribbean with breathtsking sunrises and everything we hoped for our Honeymoon destination. The room itself was spacious and well equipped. Service at the hotel could not be faulted.  All staff go above and beyond to attend to your every need. We loved sampling all the various restaurants at the hotel with Flora & Lemon Fish outshining the rest. 

If we came again (which we hope to) - 
Guests have paid alot! so a little frustrating that the many vacant beds cannot be used unless an additional substantial fee is paid. This is advertised as an all inclusive hotel but it feels like it's just the basics that are included with this, everything else is an upgrade which includes sunbeds , the nicest foods on the menu and where you can enjoy the hotel (we were moved on several times).

Also please when guests have waited (myself a whole year) to go on vacation, please let them relax when they arrive. It felt a little high pressured sales pitching to upgrade and pay extra money.

To summarise,  overall the experience was a good one and a great location and hotel to explore beautiful Cancun. Our thanks especially to the extremely hard working staff of Paradisus and we encourage a Xmas bonus which is well deserved.

reviews.author: Gabriel D
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text:
Excellent service of Atilano and Pearl 
And a great reception and great advice on Mexican food in tacos and drinks. Looking forward to having a memorable holiday again and recommending friends, family and close friends not to miss an experience like this

reviews.author: Darren B
reviews.title: Slow Start But Great Finish
reviews.text:
I struggled with a 4 or 5 rating as the week started a little ‘rough’ but quickly improved thus giving a 5. I’ll explain within the review.
Arrival at Cancun- Terminal 4. When we booked our suite through the Melia ap, there was a promotion that included round trip transportation. Emmanuel, the hotel “e” concierge was very helpful in arranging with Otium.  However when we got out to where the transportation area is, no one from Otium was around. The description of where we were to meet was not clear in the paperwork they provided. We also were able to breeze through immigration with only carry on bags so I feel like we got there earlier than expected. After looking everywhere, we found a very nice Taxi rep that told us Otium is usually by the B column.  The rep finally arrived after 15 or so minutes of additional waiting and we were on our way within another 10-15 mins. We were the only people in the van.
This is not a reflection on the Paradisus however if utilizing Otium through any of the Melia properties, we’ll certainly know to clarify the airport meet point in advance.
The Property.
As other reviews have stated, the property is getting tired looking however every day we saw ongoing maintenance happening. It sounds like a refresh may happen next year. That said, I did not find the property to be terrible by any means and found it to be clean for what it was. It did take me a while to comprehend the elevator numbers. IE “0” is the ground floor but that’s me.
The Room.
We were in The Reserve Master Suite -Ocean View #5412. It was wonderful. There were 3 balconies, 2 full bathrooms and a sitting area with second TV. A little dated but clean. The A/C kept us cool and kept the humidity at bay. The maid service was spot on and the beverage/snacks were replenished daily. The light switches took a while to figure out which one went where but otherwise.
Service.
The first 2 days, the “service” was somewhat disappointing. Breakfast at the Reserve lobby coffee/snack place took at least 30 minutes to receive (we sat down and had a waitress) for Avacado toast and poached eggs over beans. Then we proceeded to the reserve pool where it took a while to get our first drink (we tipped generously) to then have the waiter continually walk past us and our empty glasses to serve certain groups. We ended up getting our own drinks from the bar. Important to note, service vastly improved over the week but I mention the poor experience as it was setting a negative tone of which I had not experienced at any of the Melia properties we have stayed. Especially when booking one of the higher room categories at this resort. 
From Tuesday on, I must mention Luis, Cesar, Miguel(and his special drink recommendations) and Javier who took care of us tremendously. 
Thanks Viktor for setting up the Bali beds and making sure we were having a wonderful time. Shout out to David as well-even though he’s a Chicago Bears fan. My only recommendation would be to have food runners during the lunch rush around the Reserve pool. The servers were slammed trying to run food and drinks.
The Food.
Pretty good for an all inclusive so use that for perspective.
Sal’s - the picahna was one of the best steaks I have eaten (including Morton’s / Capitol Grill / Flemming’s). Perfect med rare. My wife’s “sirloin” was not so good (tough fatty and not cooked properly - looked grey - like they pulled it out of a sous vide and stuck it on the plate).
Lemon Fish - 10 out of 10. The sushi was amazing.
Sante, Flora and Capella were both equally delicious and the buffet was good.
Went to Aqua Maria for lunch early in the week. Dirt on the floor at the table we were seated at (dirt - not sand even though they just opened for lunch)
The waiter who first greeted us was straight up rude and my wife’s shrimp tacos were undercooked and inedible.
The Weather. Perfect. We were focused on the forecast leading up to our arrival given a potential tropical storm brewing. The forecast leading up to our arrival changed daily from good to rain to good to rain. Other than a few drops here and there, the only rain that did come, came after dark. 
The Beach. Gorgeous. The water was pretty rough as the tropical depression was in the vicinity yet we were able to get out into it. Do not wear your sunglasses into the ocean. We saw several people lose them when they got knocked over by a wave.
Our concierge Jose. It was obvious he was stressed Monday (there was a big wedding going on) but took care of us with dinner reservations and checked in on us during the week! Shout out to him.
Will I go back to the Paradisus Cancun. Yes as the minor things that occurred early were made up for later in the week. I also think the refresh will do it well however it’s the exceptional staff that make it a place we will want to return to.

reviews.author: Desiree D
reviews.title: Day 2
reviews.text: Service was 10/10 food and experience was exceptional and the view was breathtaking. Definitely recommend the mango mojito and the Hidalgo style beef. For dessert we ordered the Mexican flan which is one of our favorites and it did not disappoint:)

reviews.author: Gil M
reviews.title: One of the best meals
reviews.text: Chef Emilio’s food and the attention of the great Moses in the restaurant Cielo of the Paradisus Cancun hotel is on another level, highly recommended and a delight. Thank you for your attention and dedication to make each meal a unique and different experience

reviews.author: Eduardo V
reviews.title: Restaurant Cielo - Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: During our stay at Melia Paradisus Cancún we met the restaurant Cielo. The service of Moses and the Camarão/Vieiras from chef Emílio made the difference. The taste exceeded all expectations. Excellent!!!! It is worth seeing!

reviews.author: Dolores G
reviews.title: About the warmth of the Caribbean highlights human quality
reviews.text: The main feature of this Caribbean hotel is the friendliness of all the staff. The facilities are very nice and the different restaurants are excellent, each in its style. In short, we had a wonderful week.

reviews.author: KN
reviews.title: Great family trip
reviews.text:
We had a great vacation at Paradisus Cancun. 

Some of the highlights were the beautiful indoor landscaping (made us feel like we were outside), great beach with white sand and minimal seaweed, dining at Flora and Lemonfish, and super friendly staff. 

We would like to thank a few people that made our vacation extra special:

Jonathan at the checkin desk
Fanny at Flora restaurant
Daniel at Lemonfish restaurant
Veronica - yoga instructor 
Daniel - onsite photographer

The downside is rooms are rundown. The first room that was offered to us was not acceptable and we ended up having to pay more to upgrade.  It was worth it. 

All in all it was a great vacation.

reviews.author: Jonathon S
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Jesus with Lemonfish was fantastic. The service was amazing.Great food and atmosphere. My wife and I stayed here for a week. This was a wonderful experience and I recommend for any solo, couple, or family travelers. Oʻoooooooooooooooooo

reviews.author: Andrea R
reviews.title: Excellent!!
reviews.text: It was a great experience especially in two restaurants Lemon Fish and another very rich food that I forgot the name but we got green noodles with delicious meats the best waiters were Abraham of lemon fish and Santos from the other restaurant and the hostess Esthepany the best the truth we enjoyed our whole family of 9 people

reviews.author: psicnelly
reviews.title: It's not all inclusive as they say.
reviews.text:
Not all-inclusive, beds charge in pool and beach area ($250 USD)
The elevators stopped working.

reviews.author: Jose Carlos P
reviews.title: Restaurant lemon fish
reviews.text: The truth wonderful people Jorge and Miguel very good care 100% recommend in this place a great experience , the attention and service and the food 100% recommended! George too special a unique attention and especially with the children! I look for everything they needed 🥰

reviews.author: LB
reviews.title: Great service by Moses at Cielito Restaurant!
reviews.text: We went to Cielito Restaurant to celebrate a birthday and the food and service was great! The service provided by Moses was so attentive and gave great advice on food and also checked on us regularly especially on kids. We look forward to coming back soon!

reviews.author: Chrishan B
reviews.title: Mexican resturant
reviews.text: Ceilo resturant was amazing! Food authentic but the best part of the meal was the service from Moises who was extremely friendly and kind, attentive, helpful and just overall brilliant service. Thank you for making this meal so pleasent..

reviews.author: Sweetgirlbee1994
reviews.title: I loved EVERYTHING about Paradisus!
reviews.text: I travelled here for my 30th birthday and I cannot even begin to put into words how the Paradisus made this birthday one of the best birthdays ever. The resort is beautiful at every turn, the staff is amazing, sweet and helpful. The location of the Paradisus was perfect for the activities I wanted to do and the entertainment I wanted to enjoy. 10/10 definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Mauro Ivan C
reviews.title: EXCELLENT and IMPECCABLE
reviews.text:
The Incredible Hotel. The attention of their staff IMPECCABLE. And the truth is that every morning Mr. Alberto Espinosa made us start our day as kings. Always grateful to the people who made us feel great. THANK YOU SO MUCH. Also the boy Jhonny Jimenez very respectful and attentive.
THANKS TO THE MELIA FAMILY

reviews.author: Aggie
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Wonderful experience! If you are looking for the perfect resort to enjoy ur vacation Paradisus hotel is the place to be.

reviews.author: Mady C
reviews.title: Beautiful dinner
reviews.text: We are staying at the Paradisus and had the most enjoyable dinner at Lemonfish. The food is good, the aesthetic is stunning and the drinks were tasty! Arce provided the perfect service and we will definitely be back! Arce made our dinner even better!

reviews.author: Inspiration246822
reviews.title: Sante
reviews.text:
The best part of Paradisus Cancun in the amazing staff at Sante and the inside atrium of the Reserve.
Oscar, Gabriela, Valeria, Yarmin, Bernardo, Please bring back Moises. We come back because of the people that work there.
There are many good parts of the Resort, restaurant variety, the Spa. Massages are very good, the Hydrotherapy areas all need to be restored and updated. 
They keep the beach cleaned from seaweed.
There seems to be many projects and updates that they are working on, in the past the pool and pool deck areas were much cleaner. 
Overall a ver nice resort for the money.

reviews.author: angelicaguzr
reviews.title: Travel October 2024
reviews.text: The stay I had with my Family was very nice we hope to return soon, the hotel organization in the service is very good in general all the staff is very friendly the restaurant service is excellent as there is always a place available to eat without feeling saturated the spaces.

reviews.author: Mendoza Family
reviews.title: Family Dinner
reviews.text: Very good place. We enjoyed it. Our waiter Alex was great. We tried the olive octopus that had a yummy kalmata sauce and the corn sorbet was sweet and light. We can’t wait to come back next summer. The ambiance of the restaurant was great and we took many photos.

reviews.author: Dream10300758894
reviews.title: If not here, where?
reviews.text:
The hotel is perfect. 
Perfect location, perfect food and perfect service. 
We are very satisfied and look forward to the next few days!!

We especially thank Mr Alonso Sandoval for the super warm, friendly, family and professional approach. He helped make our holiday even more enjoyable! He is a very friendly and polite person, we are very enthusiastic about him!

reviews.author: Cesar Augusto C
reviews.title: Best in Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Very good attention from Jorge and Miguel de lemon fish.. always sought the best attention and that we were a-liking for the service, we were offered several dishes in entrees and main meals, so that we could keep the best..

reviews.author: Bryan G
reviews.title: Definitely coming back
reviews.text: I loved my stay at Paradisus. The food was decent but what made my stay so enjoyable was the staff. I did a tequila tasting with Abraham the bar tender and it was awesome! He genuinely wanted to give us a great experience. Martin at the buffet was so welcoming and made sure we had everything we needed. There were times where I’d be swimming or just sitting and staff would come up to me asking what I’d like to drink or eat. Everything went well, I didn’t go through any hiccups and no one tried to hard sell me on anything unlike other resorts. My family loved it!

reviews.author: kris c
reviews.title: Spectacular dinner!
reviews.text: Had a lovely evening with fanny and alex being the cherry on the top of great customer service that matched a perfect meal, i personally had the meatball main that was incredible with the couscous. Would love to come back! Alex and Fanny were too notch!

reviews.author: Patrice A
reviews.title: Paradise Cancun family concierge 2 weeks dream
reviews.text:
Family concierge is an exceptional experience. 
We had a master suite with magnificent ocean views.
Children have all day activities at the pool at the beach at the mini club and in the evening 
Shows every night.
Restaurants: 
Lemon fish with Mauritius or Sal with Iran and Ignacio 
Thanks to Giovanni 
Our concierge Isis was exceptional 
She organized all our days with plenty of surprises 
Thanks also to Astrid Saria for his warm welcome 
Go ahead without hesitation

reviews.author: Jisoo S
reviews.title: Blue Agave
reviews.text: Service and food at Blue Agave is excellent! Especially Bernice, Paola and Xochiit did an excellent job taking care of us. We didn't know what to order but they gave us the family spread that included little bit of everything.  We couldn't be more happier with our experience.

reviews.author: franciscocarreon2024
reviews.title: Thank you.
reviews.text: excellent, only greater human warmth since at the beginning of the experience were not clear to enjoy it 100%, in a second round without asking everything is clear, but the first impression is never forgotten

reviews.author: Exequiel G
reviews.title: Not All Inclusive
reviews.text: Overall it was a very good experience to go with the family, very friendly people and good facilities. What I don’t like is the concept “all inclusive” when there are so many things that try to sell you as extra. All that is included is accommodation and meal regimen. But some restaurants are not included and even in restaurants that if included there are elements that have to be paid extra.

reviews.author: Bladimir M
reviews.title: Fish lemon
reviews.text: Excellent service from Jorge and Miguel, also from Hostess Yahaita and chef Marcos, the food is delicious, the service from the staff is excellent the service from the entrance was 10 and the service is as food should arrive, a congratulations to all the staff.

reviews.author: Steve R
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise
reviews.text: The shining stars at the Paradisus Cancun are the people that work there.  Yvonne and Alberto at Malva Dinner were exceptional and one of the reasons we keep going back.  Ignacio at Malva breakfast is another fabulous employee.  Always request him at breakfast.  If you are spending time at the main pool, Jose and Balthazar rock it.  What a great time.  The food and amenities are very good but it's the staff that brings it home.

reviews.author: Eunice L
reviews.title: Sweet purple goodbye
reviews.text:
We mainly revisit because of Oscar, Luis(bartender), Gabby, Julio, Luis and everyone at the Reserve section. They were amazing at welcoming us and being family. 
The Reserve was formally the Royal Service.  It’s great but still not quite the same wow factor. The value is not the same. 

Restaurants are good. They brought the good cooks back at Malta! Fanny and Shade at Flora were very sweet. Food was good too! 

Would have like to see the purple towels again and the purple lights at the top of the pyramids. Missed the beach bags in the room too. Lights weren’t working properly in the headboard but, a little birdie told me they are planning on remodeling the resort. Looking forward to seeing a new Paradisus with the  former purple wonders again.

reviews.author: FellowTraveler647010
reviews.title: Top notch service
reviews.text:
The hotel was maintained very well. The room was well appointed and all the facilities we used were very nice. We stayed in the reserve, the adult only section. It more than met our expectations. 
We have been to a variety of places. The staff was very professional and helpful. Juan-the waiter at the Italian restaurant-made sure we felt at ease. Violeta, our concierge at the hotel, made sure we were able to access anything we needed. She was very detailed oriented, making sure we got the best located beach cabana and arranging our pickup times for the return trip. She constantly checked to make sure we were ok, whether we were away from the hotel on an excursion or contacting us on her day off!  Mrs Oglesby, the hostess for the pool and cabana rentals, was very nice and pleasant. 
The waiter at the coffee shop at the reserve was very attentive, always remembering how my wife liked her coffee and pleasantly greeting us. The entire staff made us feel welcomed and at ease throughout our entire trip. 
One person stood out among this very capable staff. Emmanuel Salias was our online concierge, taking the time before we arrived to get to understand our wants and needs. He arranged our beachfront cabana at the Kanna Club, complete with lobster for lunch. We went for my wife’s birthday. Emmanuel arranged for a massage at the spa and reserved our table at Sal Cave. 
My wife realized we left her purse at the hotel. Violeta found it, taking it to security. Emmanuel then went far above what could be considered necessary to make sure the purse was returned. He checked in constantly, in the evenings when home and on his off day. Suffice it to say, it was difficult to schedule the pickup and shipment from Cancun to the US. Emmanuel did everything he could to make it successful, for which I will be forever grateful. 
With employees like Emmanuel and the others I mentioned, Paradisus is in very good hands.

reviews.author: Carly
reviews.title: An old dirty hotel
reviews.text:
We arrived with high hopes (group of 9 adults 3 kids)- Upon arrival a staff member was very dismissive. My sister had 2 rooms (one for her and husband, one for her older children). Staff told her that their family would be separated into two different towers! She had to fight to be in the same tower.

Check in was 3pm. When me and another travel member arrived at our rooms at 4pm the rooms were DIRTY WITH THE PRIOR GUESTS FILTH!. Disgusting. Was told that they haven’t cleaned the rooms yet. Completely unacceptable.

If you are coming with young kids, the hotel is NOT stroller accessible. You have to walk down 2 flights of stairs to get from the pool to beach, no ramp. Also, the towers only connect from one level so if you are trying to get - for example - from the spa (im tower 1) to a restaurant (in tower 2) you have to climb up the stairs then down another flight of stairs. I have never climbed so many stairs in my life. there is zero continuity in the hotel, everything is far away from everything else.

We did not get the upgraded rooms and assumed this meant we would lack certain amenities such as butler service etc. I was wrong. The rooms were disgusting, mold in the shower. ZERO toiletries or amenities in the room. No turn down service (what kind of luxury hotel does not have turn down service??)

 I called for our room to get cleaned because they never serviced it during the daytime, to have my calls be ignored. I had to walk all the way to front desk to request this which was a major inconvenience.

We encountered quite a few rude staff members which I have never experienced on vacation. My family usually goes to Breathless Resort where everything and everyone is pristine and top notch.

I will admit the food was very good and the ice cream bar was phenomenal 

Martín at breakfast buffet was great

The reserve section is in another tower, which we walked by and looked very clean and well
kept

reviews.author: Curious06479886083
reviews.title: Love this resort!
reviews.text:
A girl's trip to Cancun could not have had a better start!
Our first night at Paradisus Cancun was fantastic! Jorge, Dania and Nurby at Ginger 2 took very good care of us. They made us feel so welcome with their excellent customer service. Jorge, the bartender, came to our table, and not only did he share his knowledge of tequila and history of margaritas, he created a special drink for us that was fragrant, flavorful, and delicious! It was unlike anything we had ever tasted. Dania and Nurby epitomize service with a smile. These ladies were so kind and attentive. They made us feel like VIP guests! Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful resort truly because of these beautiful people!

reviews.author: Brisa C
reviews.title: Our ideal anniversary
reviews.text:
I had the opportunity to go with my partner to celebrate our anniversary and we greatly appreciate the attention of all the staff.
Especially to our concierge José May, for all the attention and details he gave us. To bartender Luis de Santé for his recommendation of our favorite drink. To our Ginger waiters, for their warmth and details for the celebration of our anniversary. To Alberto for his excellent Negronis and to Gaby for her beautiful vibe and kindness. To Nicolle our Pool concierge for her kindness to us. The attention of Valeria who was attentive to us in the Balinese and we were able to have breakfast comfortably there.

reviews.author: Liset D
reviews.title: Flora Restaurant
reviews.text:
Excellent food and spectacular treatment from everyone at the Flora restaurant.
We loved everything, super grateful to everyone in general at the hotel, but especially to the team at the new restaurant
Congratulations to Gladis waitress
Tere captain and Rubén and Arturo the chef

reviews.author: mariacamila c
reviews.title: Opinion
reviews.text: Atiliano Fernando and Alfredo are very good waiters, they were always attentive, the food was very good and always good, we hope to return next year and the attention is very incredible, always aware of what we need

reviews.author: KH122Hyo
reviews.title: the excellent family and kids' activities
reviews.text: Our family had a fantastic time at the hotel, thanks to the excellent family and kids' activities. Samantha and the entertainment team were friendly and engaging, offering a variety of fun and safe activities for all ages.

reviews.author: Thiago P
reviews.title: Best atendiment
reviews.text: Flora is a magnificent restaurant. The waiter Ulises was super attentive and provided excellent service. Cozy, family-friendly place with beautiful decor. It was a perfect dinner and experience with my family. :-)

reviews.author: MR_Traveller
reviews.title: 10/10 the place to be in Cancún
reviews.text:
Fantastic Hotel! The hotel is located in the best spot of Cancún. All the staff are super friendly, amazing Service! The rooms are very clean and tidy. The food is also amazing, a big selection for breakfast, lunch and dinner. They have an special area call “The Reserve”, with privat pool, and special services, it worths to book it!
Highly recommend this hotel ,if you want to enjoy your holidays in Cancún. Just an Incredible experience!

reviews.author: monica v
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: The best place to vacation forever! We have been visiting this hotel for 10 years and we always receive luxury attention. Thanks to Atilano, Fernando and Alfredo from the Malva restaurant, their treatment and attention is excellent, they make us feel at home, we will return soon 🫶🏻

reviews.author: Peter M
reviews.title: Does anybody care
reviews.text:
No, just no.
Still 3 days left in this place
Not even a 3 star property.
Room needs a reno , dated, smelly and noisy. 
Food is so so and many “specialty” items on menus are at a “specialty” additional cost.
Stall are efficient but not service oriented.
Meliá should be embarrassed to be presenting this as a luxury resort. Brand is important, yours is tarnished.

reviews.author: KMV
reviews.title: Something different
reviews.text: Everything delicious! Something different Tere, as manager, was very attentive, Anabel took great care of us and Chef Arturo's food was excellent, and they adapted to the family's tastes. We recommend the 3 desserts.

reviews.author: Trushar R
reviews.title: Ginger Bar at Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text: Very special and unique drinks! Ambience is very nice too. We absolutely loved this bar.  Abraham is the best in making a very special drinks each time we visit! Best service ever! We had a very pleasant experience with Tequila Lessons too. We enjoyed every night with music shows and lively atmosphere at Ginger Bar.

reviews.author: Pentagramma M
reviews.title: Rosanna is fantastic
reviews.text: Rosanna assisted us in the best way, helping us to always find the right solution. The resort is nothing short of wonderful and is equipped with everything from the sea to the swimming pool from the spa to the gym and above all the cuisine is delicious!

reviews.author: Betsy C
reviews.title: We are happy to have decided to stay at Paradisus Cancún
reviews.text:
We were staying for our honeymoon, we do not regret having chosen Paradisus Cancún The reserve for our special celebration, we are very satisfied with the hotel service, we want to make special mention of Gilda, Luis, Oscar, Julio and Itzel de la The reserve area, we loved their super professional and friendly treatment, we loved the “snack bar” in the The reserve area. George our concierge was very attentive. There were two other waiters who served us personally but I forget their names, just in general they ALL gave us very good service.

What we liked most:
-The adults-only area, the tranquility and the attention of ALL collaborators.
-The drinks definitely exceeded our expectations.
-The snack bar at The Reserve reception, with its sandwiches, coffee, tea, drinks... was what we loved the most.
-The spa area was sensational, thank you very much!
-The facilities in general and the smell of the hotel.
-The Balinese beds.
-There is no limit on towels is a plus!
Ultimately we return to The Reserve.

Opportunities for improvement:
-The food in general is not the best, I have tried several all-inclusives in the area and the food at Paradisus has been the one I liked the least, most of the desserts were bland.
-The waiting time in restaurants.
-They should include an area or menu for diabetics, or low sugar or sugar free, as well as gluten free... for example: I loved that they do have almond milk but it was with sugar.
-Only the waiters made us feel special because we were honeymooners and because we were mentioning it, but we almost begged the hotel for something special for us…
-They should have more variety of typical snacks in the pool area, such as ceviche, nachos, tacos, hot dogs, etc. (area the reserve)

From then on we left with a very good taste in our mouths, we thank all the staff and we hope to return soon.

reviews.author: Giselle C
reviews.title: Best Resort and Service
reviews.text: We have traveled to Paradisus “Meliá” for over 20 years and this resort never disappoints. It is beautiful from the moment you walk into the hotel all the way to the beach. We always have amazing servers. Baltazar, Didier, Lorena, Erick and Ian at the poolside bar. Alfredo and Joni at Malva are amazing! Cesar at Blue Agave and Jesus at Capella. We had a few people with food allergies and they were always accommodating and ready to help. Pools are clean and comfortable. Lots of room to relax outside with cabanas or chairs. Beach is clean with minimal seaweed and no jellyfish! Water is clear and brilliant blue. We are always sad to leave.

reviews.author: Abraham
reviews.title: Nikte is not what we expected.
reviews.text:
The restaurants are always full and without a reservation option, very high waiting time up to 2 hours.
The benefit of booking as Nikte vs a lower rate was not seen.
Very few beds for the number of guests, we could not find a place on any day when we arrived, our things in the sun and on the floor where a bed was unoccupied.
There was the option of Balinese beds with extra crust (high for my taste).
A lot of pressure to get into their business talks (timeshare).

On the contrary, the KidsDom team was very friendly and kept the children very interested in each activity (except vacations).

reviews.author: Efenzos67
reviews.title: Windtre reward trip
reviews.text: Excellent structure, kind and professional staff especially Keren, Jared and Rosanna, very friendly and ALWAYS helpful guys!! The beach is excellent and the sea is spectacular, cleanliness everywhere, wonderful beach and fantastic sea.

reviews.author: Lisa L
reviews.title: Best on the beach
reviews.text: The paradisus hotel is awesome. Gaudencio, the beach server, will take care of you like he is family. The level of cleanliness is outstanding. The food is good and the drinks are strong. There are several restaurants to choose from and the breakfast buffet will satisfy even the pickiest eater. If you are thinking of an all inclusive, this is it. We have been to several on the hotel zone, and this has been far and away the best. Gracias Gaudencio y la Melia.

reviews.author: Mariama
reviews.title: Great place but need some changes
reviews.text:
We just concluded a 9 days visit to Paradisus Cancun and had a great time! I will write a very transparent review because there  are many pros and cons.

Pros:

•Beach is beautiful! Best in Cancun / playa area in my opinion 
•Hotel is spacious and pool are big and nice 
• Staff are super friendly at the breakfast buffet and all the pool concierge are amazing and attentive. Shout or to Charlie and Ivonne both incredible. 
• Shout out to Jose our amazing Consierge who went above and beyond in making us feel comfortable from the day we stepped foot into the hotel to the minute  we left. He was truly incredible and this hotel is lucky to have such dedicated staff member. He even insured that during his day off, we had his collègue come and check on us , what an excellent service !!
• Plenty of space to walk and hang out 

Cons:

• Food is not the best! Not sure why but nothing tasted great except the Steakhouse which is not part of the all inclusive. All the ingredients are there and fresh but the magic touch to make everything tasty is lacking 
• The facility is beautiful but it is beaten up a lot. You can tell it used to be an incredible hotel but took a beating over the years ( severely scratched furniture , rusty hardware, old toilets , beaten up showed , etc)
• Strong smell  of pesticides almost everywhere making it hard to ignore. 
•  Our room was overlooking the lagune and it was loud every night with all the parties around the hotel. The windows need to be sound proof if this is an ongoing thing. 

It was a great vacation overall and we had a good time!

Thank you Paradisus and Cancun !

reviews.author: Verkauf V
reviews.title: Best Nespresso-bar barista’s
reviews.text:
Carlos and Alejandro are the friendliest and fastest baristas we have ever seen. Every move is precise, and there is always time for good vibes and a smile, even when it's very stressful for them. Excellent employees who have always brightened our mood—thank you very much.

Spanish:
Alejandro y Carlos son los baristas más amigables y rápidos que jamás hayamos visto. Cada movimiento es preciso, y siempre hay tiempo para buenas vibras y una sonrisa, incluso cuando la situación es muy estresante para ellos. Excelentes empleados que siempre han alegrado nuestro ánimo. Muchas gracias."

reviews.author: Sam A
reviews.title: Ask for IAN!!!!
reviews.text:
Ask for IAN at the poolside… excellent customer service. 
Buffet food was decent than most others in an All-inclusive or standard cruise. 
We were here during thanksgiving holiday so it was crowded in general and front desk was difficult to work with.

reviews.author: vilmar u
reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text: Incredible experience ! The hotel is beautiful, clean, and allocated in the perfect area. The staff was great, specifically atilano, candelario, y Fernando Hernandez. They went above and beyond to make our experience wonderful. They were so attentive and provided an amazing customer service. In addition to all the valet/luggage service personnel. Highly recommend this resort !

reviews.author: Krupa and Nitis... S
reviews.title: Amazing hospitality and plenty of delicious vegan options!
reviews.text: We loved Flora so much we went two nights in a row. Anabel Gonzalez and Teresa assisted us. Their hospitality was amazing. The staff is really friendly and the food is world class. If you visit Paradisus, we recommend having dinner at Flora.

reviews.author: Justin R
reviews.title: Beautiful place and amazing service!
reviews.text: What an beautiful place with excellent service. Throughout the stay, staff were super helpful and friendly. Especially Lai and her giving is great recommendations for activities and places to go. As well as Omar and him being very helpful with singing up for the club. Both of them deserve this special shout out and we’re very kind and very funny people that really elevated the experience and took everything to the next level during our stay.

reviews.author: P R
reviews.title: Don’t waste your time or money!
reviews.text:
My husband and I have been to Cancun many times but this was my 11 year old daughter’s first time. We picked Paradisus because of the location and the amount of restaurants that were going to be provided. Before we left, we had heard about how there was music that’s played for hours every night and building three was not the place to be. My husband called ahead of time, a week, and told them that we do not want to be in building three and we wanted a higher level to where we would not be disturbed by the music. When we got to the resort, they put us in building three and on level four right smack in the middle of all the loud music. My husband talked to the front desk and the manager on two separate days but still were given the same excuse that the hotel was sold out and there was no rooms. Yet the front desk was always busy with new coming families. So that told us that the resort was not indeed sold out. Bad service!

Then, if you want to enjoy the pool or the beach and have a lounge chair, you have to get out there by at least 6 o’clock in the morning to get one. As my daughter and I went out in the morning at 8 o’clock everything was already taken, but the thing was there was no people sitting on the loungers. There was just towels covered that people reserved for when they decided to go out. One day I asked the worker if there were any extra chairs anywhere that he could bring out since some of the Palapas did not have chairs underneath them and he basically laughed in my face. My daughter could not believe he did that. My husband did go to the guest services and someone came and brought us some chairs, but one of them was broken. So we had to drag ourselves out of bed at 6 o’clock in the morning so we could put a towel on a chair and then we went back to bed. I think the most frustrating is that some chairs had towels on them for more than half the day before any people arrived. It is not fair for families that want to stay at the resort and enjoy the ocean and the pool while other people reserve their areas with towels, go on excursions, eat lunch and then come to party at the pool or the ocean. I was at this resort for a whole week, and was only given drinks once while at the beach and the pool. I had to always go get my own drinks from the bar. I even put in an order a few times and my stuff never came. Yet other families that unfortunately had lighter skin than me received better service because we watched them getting drinks the whole time. Bad service!

Next, the restaurants only catered to families that had more than four people in them. For example, we were in line 2nd in line for the buffet on Thanksgiving day, and a worker came over and we asked if we could sit outside and he said yes yes the lady behind us said we want to sit outside too, but we have six people. He told the lady and us to follow him which we did. He sat the people of six and then he told us to get in line again and tell the hostess we wanted to sit outside and we had to get really mean with him and tell him that he told us to follow him. Finally he found a table that was for two people and he squeezed in another chair for us so we could sit outside. Bad service again!

Our TV went out on Thanksgiving day, which is a big deal to have a TV because we like to watch American football. My husband called at 8 o’clock and let them know the TV was not working two hours later as we’re still waiting for the TV to be fixed, my husband went down to guest services and was told that the manager was not available because he was off and no one could help but they would send somebody again to look at the TV. My husband called a third time and told them we were still waiting for someone to come and fix the TV. No one came at all that day. My husband and I had to mess around with the TV, trying to find any kind of reset button and we finally got it to work after a whole day. No one still never came to look at the TV we didn’t get an apology. We didn’t get any support from guest services. Bad service again!

If you have kids and want to play pool or foosball good luck because the whole week we stood there for hours waiting and huge families use them over and over and did not let others enjoy but only having one of each was absolutely ridiculous for the large resort. 

One afternoon we decided to go to the restaurant that’s by the pool and we saw other people in there with their swimsuits so my daughter and I walked in with our towels around us. The guy told us we needed to be dry. We told him we were dry but I still went ahead and put my cover on but my daughter had the towel around her like a dress. He then told me that I needed to have a cover for my daughter and I told him why would she need a cover when there is a lady sitting down there in her 20s with a bikini on. He looked at the lady and said oh because she has shorts on which if you looked at her did not even look like she had shorts on. Absolutely ridiculous that you let a young lady with her breast hanging out at lunch and my 11-year-old who’s wearing a one piece that does not show any cleavage but yet we were asked to cover up. If there is a dress code and no swimsuits are allowed, then it needs to be stated with a sign and it needs to be for everyone. Bad service!

The only positives we had was Rodrigo, who is at the taco bar outside by the pool, always had an amazing smile, and made delicious tacos for us every day. Then Moses, who was our waiter in the restaurant Cielo, he made sure we really understood the menu when we asked questions he even made some adjustments so my daughter would have something to enjoy eating and it was delicious food. Finally, I did not get her name Unfortunately she is new to the resort she told us it was her second day she was working at the blueagave restaurant. She was so nice and had a smile on her face and welcomed us to the restaurant. 

This is by no means a 4.5 star hotel. The food is mediocre no changes daily for the buffet. The suites were not suites, they were regular size rooms. I will say the ocean views were stunning, but it’s not the room that makes that it’s the Caribbean Sea.

We made the most of our vacation and we had a great time being together as a family swimming in the ocean, eating together, enjoying the scenery in the hotel but we catered to ourselves. We will definitely go back to Cancun, but we will never stay at the Paradisus or a Melia resort. The only thing that could make this trip the best trip ever is if I were to get my money back.

reviews.author: Fidel S
reviews.title: Unmatched sea, excellent service from Diego Torres and
reviews.text:
The experience at Paradisus Cancún was very good and I would return to the hotel without any problem.

The good:
1) service: we booked a Nikte room which had personal concierge service, in this case Diego Torres provided us with excellent service, always taking care of what we needed, we never felt neglected. Any detail that there was with our room or stay, he resolved it for us.

2) The beach: phenomenal, we didn't get any waves, blue sea, white sand, just as we expected.

3) the drinks: the drinks really exceeded my expectations, a lot of variety and very delicious drinks

What can be improved:

1) beach/snack menu: there were only hamburgers, hot dogs and nachos... it would have been great to include some seafood

2) the waiting time in restaurants, especially in the Peruvian/Japanese ones… we waited 2.5 hours.

3) lounge chairs/towel service: we learned after the 1st of the day that you had to separate your place on the beach and pool with towels before 7 am because if you went down at 8 am there were no towels or place.

4) pool or beach activities for children and adults. There were only a few games but I think they could organize more activities.

reviews.author: Bob G
reviews.title: Excellent Senior (over 65!) Week!
reviews.text: Our 2 bedroom unit was very clean and comfortable during our week long visit.  We are Melia Club members and stayed in Pyramid 1, with an ocean front view.  The consierge and housekeeping staff were very attentive, and every staff member was helpful and anxious to help. Use of pools and ocean beach access is easy, with life guards monitoring the beach activities.  We have been visiting this resort for 20 years, and it is beginning to show its age - but is very well maintained.  We did not take advantage of the "all inclusive plan", so all meals and drinks were separately charged to our room. Meals and entertainment in various areas of the resort were enjoyable and easy to access.  City buses frequently stop on the main street which is a short walk from the lobby, but taxi service is also available.  The AquaWorld facility is immediately across the street from Paradisus, making excursions and other water adventures very convenient. We recommend Paradisus Cancun (Melia).

reviews.author: bhuvanviswan
reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: I spent a lot of money to get to this resort! Resort amenities are good but service is horrible. I upgraded my self from lagoon view to nikte junior suite by paying good extra money but service is terrible. AC water dripping and flooded the floor, did not tidy up the room daily, did not give the towels daily I need to ask multiple times. Last day I asked for 4 towels from morning 6 am I called up to guest services 3 times but they said some one will come someone will come but no one showed up finally we all came back home by not showered the last day! Malva service is sucks. I spent $300 in tops with $1 and $5 usd bills they don’t serve coffee and milk we had to go and take water ourselves many times. Is this what we get for so much we paid and defective room flooded woth water, mini bar not working regularly had to call to fix so many times and tidy up room and bath towels and requesting coffee with tipping bills over bills is it too much to ask? So disappointed. Lili is so passionate and very assertive to help but sadly things fell apart one by one, no one helps without seeing the tips and malva folks don’t help even after taking tips. They don’t even re-fill drinking water

reviews.author: Abhinav m
reviews.title: Ginger bar team work is amazing and the best.. Abraham is my favorite and he is my brother from another brother
reviews.text: Service and bar is top notch.. particularly staff.. karina, sofonia, gaby and best of the best Abraham.. awesome bar tender.. they made our vacation a family time and great cocktails and taste of taquila was fantastic… I am going to visit this place for sure again and again.. thanks for everything.. make sure to visit ginger bar paradisus.. recommend 1000%…

reviews.author: adri60719
reviews.title: Exceptional

reviews.author: Laura R
reviews.title: 3 star resort fun with kids not for foodies
reviews.text:
This is a large sprawling resort that has lots of potential with some money put into it from corporate. You can tell it was once luxurious and well maintained. I’m not sure what happened but it seems they stopped maintenance and have left it to deteriorate (but may be remodeling from one end to the other) There was a strike earlier this year by staff and you can tell it’s 50/50 with them. They seem overworked. The rooms seem like they are robbing Peter to pay Paul with items breaking, non functioning and missing. I would hate to stay here during full capacity. 

The gym and spa were quite nice and staff at the spa was wonderful. My facial was great and my friends massage was as well. Spa is a bit small for such a large resort. 

Our first room was missing outside chairs, fridge was not filled. At 11 pm first night it filled with sewer gas that was so toxic I walked down to the lobby in my robe because front desk didn’t answer my calls. IMO they are too shortstaffed at night. About 2 hours later and a few trips to the desk we were moved to an ADA room same floor ocean view which was beautiful! There were issues there as well but I was thankful we got moved. This was all in pyramid 1 which I highly recommend for kids. It’s quiet. Right in front of the kids area of the pool and rooms have full kitchens. 

Kids club was great! My child wasn’t into it but most kids will be. Great free childcare all day with breaks so you can feed your kids. Tip them well! Get a schedule so you don’t miss anything. 

Drinks and food are the downfall here and it’s really bad. The options are minimal liquor wise unless you visit specific bars and they run out of certain things. The juices are super tart or sugary but I expect that at an all inclusive at this price. The food is so monotonous and flavorless and from what I can tell all comes from the buffet one way or the other. By the 3rd day I didn’t even want to eat because it all tasted the same. They really need to figure out this food situation as lines are crazy at night but they do have buzzers now so you can get a drink or wander around. We ate everywhere but the Italian restaurant and I expect it comes from the pasta bar during lunch service. 

The ice cream parlor outside was my kids favorite she loved it! Beach is beautiful and close. The you have to pay for beds (250) but can negotiate if it’s slow.

reviews.author: Javier C
reviews.title: The best holidays !
reviews.text: My experience at the hotel has been. Wonderful. We met Abraham the mixologist, Gaby, and Karina at the ginger bar. They made of. Our vacation was unforgettable. Thank you for all your attention. I love you guys😘🥰👭👬.

reviews.author: happyguest2015220
reviews.title: Abraham at Ginger
reviews.text: Abraham at The Ginger Bar 2 was outstanding!  He made my daughter and I crafted unique drinks after we told him a few flavors we liked.  He also hand designed the garnish!  Then taught us how to do it!  He was so kind and happy and welcoming.

reviews.author: Kelsi L
reviews.title: Enjoyed the reserve very much!
reviews.text:
We enjoyed a wonderful stay. This is our third time at the hotel, but first in the reserve section. Reserve is the way to go if you’re looking for a quiet and peaceful getaway. The service at Sante was wonderful! Thank you Miguel Quinones for going above and beyond! We enjoyed breakfast and lunch by the pool every day, served by Miguel! He anticipated our every need and provided excellent service!!! We looked forward to seeing him every day! All of the restaurants and waiters at the restaurants were wonderful! The daily charcuterie offerings at the reserve bar were great! 
If I had to offer some constructive criticism for improvement it would be to 
1. GET NEW LOUNGE CHAIRS FOR POOL & BEACH!!!!!!!! There is a lack of chairs and the ones that are there are constantly breaking! I myself got stuck in a broken chair and I saw the same happen to another guest. This is pretty unacceptable especially in the reserve section .
2. Stricter enforcement of no children in the section and a private area on the beach away from children  would also be appreciated for reserve guests. 
3. Upon arrival, direct reserve guests to their private check in so that they are not stuck waiting in the regular check out line only to figure out that reserve guests have a private check out.

reviews.author: Valerie2565
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: Really enjoyed are stay.  The location and food was excellent.  The customer service representatives were very helpful, especially Valeria Cervantes.  If we had a question or issue, she answered or resolved it quickly and with a smile.

reviews.author: ddswong
reviews.title: Always a Great Visit
reviews.text:
I have been going to the Paradisus Cancun for over 20 years( even when this hotel was called the Gran Melia) and our October 2023 trip was my 3rd time this year!!! I am scheduled to returno n February 16, 2024 and I am an extensive traveller with my family. This year alone, I have been on 7 vacations and I plan at least 2 more visits to Paradisus Cancun beyond my Feb trip.
The reason that I always return to this wonderful hotel is not only the great location, the amazing food or the contemporary and traditional decor, but rather the wonderful staff that I have come to know. Every time I return there, we get treated like family. Many of the staff remember us from our frequent visits and the Paradisus Cancun has by far the best staff that I have ever seen of any hotel that I have been to.
A worthy mention to the following amazing people who make our stays memorable :
Poolside- Joel and Moises at the Reserve really go the extra mile to take care of us. We couldnt ask for better service. These two should be taken aside and commended for their outstanding service. As well, Ruben, Oscar, Valeria are absolutely fantastic to us. At the Yha spa, Freddy and Julian are the absolute best to us. Julian always is attentive and so pleasant to us every time we go there. He is wonderful to take care of every single detail and he makes the spa so enjoyable.
At Aqua Marina restaurant, Carlos and Armando are phenomenal. Top class service. As well, Jesus, Christine and Francisco made my wife feel amazing at our dinner at Aqua Marina when we celebrated her birthday.
Sal restauarant is always our favorite. Our last waiter was Juan who was absolutely so warm and welcoming. He made our meal so enjoyable that we went back the following night. Another time, Yostin took care of us and gave us superlative service.
My wife loves the Italian restaurant and Gerardo and Xavier really took care of all her there. First class all the way. And finally, Nury was our last courtesy maid....unbelieble service. She made our room extra special, especially when we celebrated our anniversary there.  Diego as the head of food services always welcomes us with big smiles and amazing service. Best wishes to you, Sir.
Lastly, but definitely not lease- a special thank you to Diego for being our wonderful Resrve Butler. We ALWAYS request him as he takes our vacations over the top. Wouldnt have it any other way.

As you can see, I dont think that you will find anyone who visits the Paradisus Cancun more than my family. We are looking forward to our February 2024 trip. I strongly recommend this hotel to anyone looking for a wonderful vacation with top notch service. Many thanks from the Wong Family from Toronto, Canada.

reviews.author: Brandon
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Ginger bar with Abraham the mixology bartender was really good, took care of guest, amazing also shout out to sophnia and Gaby helped alot, thank you. Also very clean, very fast service, best bar in the resort.

reviews.author: sierrarose4
reviews.title: Vacationers Beware!
reviews.text:
Stayed at Paradisus Cancun at the beginning of November (11/1-11/6). 

Upon arrival, we were greeted with such great service and attentive staff. The lobby was truly awe-inspiring with the greenhouse dome appearance and all of the greenery. In reality, it was all smoke & mirrors. 

We arrive to our "Junior Suite Ocean View" room and immediately knew something was wrong. The room didn't match what was advertised online whatsoever. In fact, there was a connecting door which led to living room that did not belong to our suite. It appeared that we had a bedroom belonging to a 2-Bedroom Master Suite. We went back to check-in to see if it was a mistake. Especially since our parents seemed to have received the correct room (later found out they were "upgraded" to a Master Suite despite their room matching a Junior Suite description.) We overheard two other couples facing similar issues - each were assigned a room that they did not book online. This was an immediate red flag so we asked to speak to a manager. 

Jonathan, Manager of the Front Desk, sits down with us and explains that the resort is fully booked and there is nothing they can do for us. We explain our frustrations. Jonathan's attitude was rude and dismissive - does not have a care in the world cause "there is nothing he or anyone above him can do to help us." His exact words. We left extremely frustrated. I ended up emailing customer service. Sure enough, someone reaches out that they want to help. They explained that the room we booked was not a mistake, they just haven't updated photos online...the most they could do was provide Reserve wristbands so we could indulge in their amenities, but we could not switch our rooms to Reserve since it was closed for renovations. It felt like slapping a bandaid on a much larger issue. The entire resort needs renovations. A lot of water damage throughout the hallways, old elevator systems, outdated room accommodations, etc. This is NOT a 5-star resort. 

Besides the room fiasco, we did truly enjoy the food at each restaurant. Drinks were great. The beach was absolutely beautiful. Most of the staff went above and beyond to create a memorable experience. Entertainment each night was great, especially for Day of the Dead. 

I would recommend this resort for anyone looking for a "deal" on a "5-star" resort but doesn't care much for luxury amenities. Or ocean views since most room's view seems to obstructed with plants - haha. It was truly disappointing because after so much research, I wish we would've splurged on Nizuc, Xcaret, or Excellence. Lesson learned.

reviews.author: Yady George
reviews.title: WONDERFUL BIRTHDAY
reviews.text:
I went to celebrate my birthday, they surprised me more than I expected, since we arrived the bell boys welcomed us in a very friendly and attentive way, one of them was quite friendly and I don't remember his name but he had an Arabic name, I think his name is kerem and angel.
For dinner without a doubt CHEF DAVID, truly a wonderful human being, always super attentive, as well as the waiter Melvin from the Mexican and Arnulfo from the buffet, all of them in general super friendly and always on the lookout, the view and the sea unique, a wonderful creation of nature, without thinking about it we will return again and again

reviews.author: sahned j
reviews.title: Rafael from Lemon fish!
reviews.text: Best sushi I ever tested. Service and food both were great. Our servers Rafael made the experience so good! Definitely recommend it. We tried their deserts and it was very delicious. Lemon fish were your taste buds get euphoria!

reviews.author: Que T
reviews.title: Avoid this place at all costs
reviews.text:
The resort was ok - the food is mediocre and none of the restaurants opened/closed at the time that they advertised on their brochures. I paid extra for upgrading my room to The Reserve section which was advertised as the adult-only section. I'm a light sleeper so I did the room upgrade to be in a section without kids to minimize the noise. Based on the map that I was provided at check-in, the Reserve section is shown to be in Tower 5 but I was placed in Tower 3. As the stay went on, I heard screaming children in the rooms next door so it seems that I was not given the room that I paid extra for - this was the first red flag.

The experience that soured my trip was by the front desk staff and the resort's business practices - I felt like I might have gotten scammed. The front desk staff were terrible. The resort seems very dishonest as well - most hotels would automatically provide guests with their folios at check-outs, but this resort did not do so until it was asked. When checking out, I asked for a copy of my folio. The front desk staff replied "Folio for what?" - it's strange for a front desk agent to ask such a question as he was responsible for guest check-ins and check-outs...When he finally provided me with the folio, I noted that I was overcharged for the stay (this was probably why the resort was reluctant to provide folios to guests). I asked for a refund and the front desk staff refused to help. He dismissed my concern and told me that this is how the folio is supposed to look without any further explanation. Since I had to catch my flight, I did not have time to speak to a supervisor. Once I got home, I even re-checked my original booking multiple times and confirmed that I was indeed overcharged. I tried to contact the property regarding my overpayment and no one replied to my messages. When I first booked my reservation, the resort was very responsive regarding buying upgrades, etc. Now that they got my money, they ignored me. As of today, I still have not heard back from them regarding this issue. It's incredibly disturbing and unprofessional - I will not be returning and will not recommend this resort to anyone else. Stay away at all costs.

reviews.author: Ian
reviews.title: Fabulous Holiday
reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived and were greeted by Raul we felt at home!
Melvin at Cielo was the nicest waiter we have had the pleasure to be served by, and both Abraham and Gaby made cocktails and after dinner drinks something special. 
All the staff were really friendly and courteous and helped make our stay really special. Any complaints we had were dealt with promptly and competently. Hotel is starting to become a little tired, but overall a fabulous holday

reviews.author: Happiness55436509620
reviews.title: Our wedding day at Paradisus Resort Cancun was excellent
reviews.text:

From the initial planning stages to the grand finale, their commitment to providing excellent service was evident at every turn. Only complaint is the check in process is very long and complicated. Rooms needs renovation. The concierge immediately started try to selling me extra service which makes me feel uncomfortable. Otherwise everything else are all excellent. Overall a nice experience and would consider coming back again if those compliants can be addressed

reviews.title: A place to return
reviews.text:
I give it a maximum for the pleasantness of our stay and for the maximum attention of the staff. I don't think I have found people like that, kind and helpful, anywhere. Both in the pool and in the restaurants, the treatment could not have been better. I want to highlight the great work of Alejandro, in his Nespresso corner. We recommend it 100%
