reviews.text: Very good experience, participated in an event and met expectations. It was a little difficult for me to locate myself in the space because of the buildings and the connection between them, but once I went through it I managed to get to the places I needed to go.

reviews.author: majoange
reviews.title: Very happy
reviews.text: I had an incredible time with my family. Food for all tastes. The only thing I would like is a slide area for the little ones, the design of the hotel is undoubtedly one of the best, totally original and unique.

reviews.author: Katelyn V
reviews.title: Yummy food
reviews.text: We went to blue agave and the tacos were delicious . santos was our waiter and was so nice and helpful. There are so many yummy places to eat here def recommend! Its a great place for vacation as a couple and with friends

reviews.author: ldventnor
reviews.title: Beautiful place
reviews.text: Bryant is very nice and help if you need some thing he will be glad to do for you I enjoy doing excercie class they have in the morning and he always there put out matte and towl for you also at the beach for voleyball

reviews.author: Denis J
reviews.title: A true 5 star for the family
reviews.text: Impeccable service. Kind staff. Well maintained site and building. Magnificent room with whirlpool bath on the balcony. Offer limited to the main buffet, but excellent food. I particularly recommend the gourmet Mexican and Peruvian restaurants. Children are particularly well received. Fine sand beach, nice, but which does not, of course, have the charm of certain Caribbean destinations. Sufficient deck chairs. Interesting proximity, accessible on foot, to the city center of Playa del Carmen, its shops and restaurants. A true 5 star. We all have memorable memories of it, grandparents, parents and children together.

reviews.author: Jerry Signs
reviews.title: Awesome Restaurant!
reviews.text: Great Service…Unbelievable Food. Totally Authentic Mexican Cuisine…. 5 Stars… The wait staff guided us through the most Colorful Pallet of Mexican Specialties. They even flooded the table with a wide array of Desert Delicacies.

reviews.author: Flyer65770523664
reviews.title: Horrible Old Resort
reviews.text:
The overall experience was horrible and I’m not sure where to begin, but i guess we can start with the room.. first they put my wife and I and two kids in a room with a single bed, after we made them aware that it’s 4 of us and one bed (they should have seen and known this at the check in) they put us in another room. The 2nd room that we were placed in didn’t have a table or chairs on the balcony. It took 4 calls, 3 front desk visits and 3 full days for them to bring us 2 chairs… we never received a table, so we ate our room service on our beds. One day when it rained , we literally had water dripping in the hotel by the slide door. Several over the lights in the room were burn out and they brought us 2 remote controls before getting us one that worked. The shampoo/body wash holder fell on the first day and it was never replaced. I’m the shower, the hot and cold were opposites so if you wanted hot water you have to turn it to cold. Yes, this is a minor thing but for a 5 star hotel you would expect better. Also, the pain in our room and all around the resort is peeling. The resort is old and in need of major renovations. The food gross and you did not have much of a variety. My wife found a long piece of hair in the potato’s that they had at the Buffett and all the cook did was pulled it out and let people continue to eat. Several days that we were there it rained… the resort does not have much entertainment so if it rains you are SOL. Also, our room was on the lagoon side, if you are a light sleeper or have small children DO NOT stay in a room in the lagoon side. There is an outdoor club across the street that house music blasting until 5AM.. it literally felt like a club in our room. 

We travel a lot and have been to man resorts in Mexico and the Caribbean and this by far is the worst(hotel,food,entertainment ), least accommodating resort we have been to. I highly suggest going to Hyatt Ziva instead.

reviews.author: Hayley L
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text:
I loved the entertainment in Paradisus, Uriel did a great job every day keeping us entertained and laughing. Always appeared really happy and enthusiastic around the pool.

The pool staff were also fantastic, I was never without a drink.   ☺️ .

reviews.author: Jennifer D
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: It is a wonderful hotel, we enjoyed the vacation to the fullest thanks to Fernando Sandoval who organized everything in detail and gave us excellent attention as did our butler Stelian, a very attentive and kind guy. The room was spectacular with a beautiful view, very clean and comfortable. Excellent service from all the staff, mainly from the guys Jony, Atilano and Enrique from the Malva buffet, Carlos from the Nespresso, the guys from the bar in general, everyone who served us was very friendly and provided excellent service. Thank you all. We will return without a doubt

reviews.author: Beassandra
reviews.title: AWESOME EXPERIENCE
reviews.text:
Exceptional service with Cauich our bartender.
He went above an beyond to provide exceptional service. 
Can wait o come back in May. We have been coming to this resort for over 20 years, back then the name was Gran Melisa. They have maintained their great service. I most definitely will recommend it.

reviews.author: Liliana V
reviews.title: Highly recommended, you will have an incredible time. I would 100% return to this hotel.
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful, with a great atmosphere and very friendly service, Ramito and Teresa treat you very well at the buffet, Gaby at night at the bar and in general all the staff have excellent treatment.

reviews.author: Javier H
reviews.title: lemon fish
reviews.text:
Excellent service, top-notch food. Jorge our waiter, very attentive and helpful.
Lis Chef Karen and Mario with details of flavor and presentation of the first-class dishes.
The place like a Zen garden ideal for a souvenir photo. We are already partners of this Meliá system

reviews.author: Bryan H
reviews.title: Great Mixology class at Ginger bar!
reviews.text: Amazing! Abraham and Lia are amazing  and friendly! The mixology class was so much fun. Both the drinks were educational and delicious. I would highly recommend a stay at the Paradisus Cancun and to spend some time at the Ginger bar where there are activities and great music. Try the coco loco!

reviews.author: Keith M
reviews.title: The best hotel in Cancun
reviews.text:
Excellent service from all the hotel staff, excellent food and a beautiful beach. Highly recommended for family travel.
The only thing that should change are the activities, they should have more of them

reviews.author: stevenga0
reviews.title: Okay
reviews.text: Was fun, but room is outdated and lacking a lot of activities. Some restaurants had great food and others had long wait times for food that was mediocre. Staff is friendly and great location for resort

reviews.author: Dulce C
reviews.title: Excellent experience
reviews.text: I loved the experience! Excellent option if you are looking to relax but also have fun. The hotel is beautiful and every detail is very well taken care of. My favorite things were the food and the activities! I love that those in charge of these activities are super enthusiastic people who spread happiness and you can tell that they love what they do. I loved the dance classes, pool activities, karaoke and the mask party. It was certainly an excellent vacation!

reviews.author: Victor R
reviews.title: Beautiful restaurant
reviews.text:
Juan Carlos from the Lemon Fish restaurant, served us very well, he was very attentive and friendly
Laura also gave us an excellent welcome. I recommend it and the food was delicious 😋 the restaurant is beautiful

reviews.author: Marlyn
reviews.title: Beautiful restaurant
reviews.text: We had an excellent service! Laura the hostess and greeted us well and was so nice. Juan Carlos was the waiter/server and explained every dish to us and was very polite and attentive. The shrimp was good, sushi was delicious! And we had coconut ice cream with pineapple as our dessert, loved it!

reviews.author: Teresa H
reviews.title: Beautiful resort with incredible staff
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time at this resort, and so happy we chose to go there.
First, no resort is perfect. That is the fact. This resort is beautiful inside and out. Food at all restaurants is amazing, and even our picky eater always found something good to eat. 

The only downfall that our family found was the activities. It was lacking, and IF they would use the microphone to announce the upcoming activities, WAY more people would participate. A little effort would go a long way! I did speak to the activities staff, but they said that only the DJ had a microphone and wasn’t there yet. Such a shame and missed opportunity.

So many wonderful staff members that took care of us throughout our week. So very attentive and kind: Edier at Nespresso! What an incredible young man! Pool bar-Rodigo, Jesus, Julio, Jorge, and many more that never let us get thirsty or get hungry at lunchtime! (Fish tacos… YUM!) Lifeguards on the beach- Manain, Johnny and Cesar. So grateful for your time and help! Front end customer service- Melissa, Aaron and Jose were truly a blessing and helped relentlessly with an unexpected situation. Lastly, Stelian helped when he didn’t have to and he was whole heartedly happy to! Thank you all!

reviews.author: Joaquin L
reviews.title: Excellent place!
reviews.text:
It is the second year that we come, we love the beach here, with few people.
The entertainment has several proposals and in particular in the culinary area there are excellent proposals of quality and variety.
They could improve the number of lounge chairs so that you don't have to reserve.

reviews.author: Francisco R
reviews.title: I loved
reviews.text:
Good job from the Activities guys
Laila and Ariel from the urban class that made us dance.
Ilse from Karaoke in which she sang a lot.
Excellent service in all restaurants, delicious food and good drinks.

reviews.author: Lucia Arriaga S
reviews.title: Nespresso excellent service from Carlos Vinalay
reviews.text: The attention of the staff was excellent, both maids and waiters, very good, the cleanliness of the room and the safety of leaving valuable objects, there was only soap in the kitchenette, we suggest extending the hours of the pools

reviews.author: rafab00
reviews.title: Ginger Bar Rock Stars
reviews.text: Abraham, Salvador, Karina and Gaby have made our nights the best of our stay. They give a lot of life to the hotel and make the Ginger bar (Lobby) a must-visit! We had a great time, and we hope it won't be the last time we visit!

reviews.author: Anna W
reviews.title: Best vacation spot
reviews.text: Best staff at ginger bar next to the lobby! So friendly, welcoming and amazing staff! Mixologist are the best. They were always willing to have our drinks ready and came back regularly to check in to see how we were doing

reviews.author: Emma K
reviews.title: The best trip, the best staff, the best time🙌🏼
reviews.text: Abraham the mixologist was amazing! I strongly recommend the Ginger Bar! Also the waiters Salvador,  Gabby, Beatriz and Sofonias were beyond amazing! Ask for the margaritas, you won’t be disappointed!!

reviews.author: Natalia V
reviews.title: lemon fish
reviews.text: Everything delicious!! Excellent attention from Jorge and very delicious food from Chefs Mario and Karen!! 100% recommended. The desserts are also good!! One of the best restaurants at the Paradisus Cancun Hotel

reviews.author: Traveler52069563408
reviews.title: lemon fish
reviews.text: Excellent attention from Jorge... very attentive and helpful. The food is exquisite, everything very fresh, excellent presentation of the dishes, you can see the dedication of chefs Mario and Karen! Far from the best nights in Cancun

reviews.author: Gabriel M
reviews.title: Rafael in Lemon Fishing
reviews.text:
Rafael in Lemon Fishing é incrível! Nos atendeu super bem, nos explicou o cardápio recomendou pedir um prato e nos amamos. Sem duvidas o Lemon Fishing é o melhor restaurante do resort.

Rafael in Lemon Fishing is amazing! He served us very well, explained the menu, he recommended ordering a dish and we loved each other. Without a doubt, Lemon Fishing is the best restaurant in the resort.

reviews.author: Renee S
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: This resort was the very best!! At the reserve, the outside bar staff went above and beyond to make us feel special and went above and beyond to anticipate our every wish!! From the skills of Luis and Alex (my very favorite) behind the bar Sante, to Valerie who always had a smile on her face and a peppy step, to Sal an and Joel, to Jamel!! Just wow!!! Thank you thank you thank you!! At night the entertainment and excellence staff at the Ginger bar including Abraham and Valentin.. to Gabia and Dania.. thank you for excellent service and smiles!! I will definitely be back..the staff is so excellent you feel like they are your new friends..the accommodations are simply perfect and the view is outstanding!!

reviews.author: Natalie A
reviews.title: Amazing experience, thanks to our concierge Jose!
reviews.text: We  had an amazing time at Paradisus Cancun! A huge shoutout to our amazing concierge Jose! He made our stay so and was so attentive. Greatly appreciate all the attention to detail he did to make our friends trip special. Everything about this resort is exquisite, the food to the bar and all the activities they have for anyone to do! This was my friends first time coming to Cancun and we will be back soon!

reviews.author: Matheus Soares
reviews.title: Bad check-in experience
reviews.text: Of the entire experience, the most serious thing was that the room was not ready at the scheduled time. I had a wedding at the hotel itself, and I explained to the staff that I needed to get into the room a little earlier to get ready. In addition to not being flexible about this, the room simply wasn't ready on time. I had to shower and get ready in a friend's room. The hotel staff did not solve my problem and did not show importance to something that was foreseen in the reservation. Additionally, some people provided terrible service and flexibility in food options. Honestly, for the price it costs, I expected much more services, attractions and facilities at the hotel. The feeling is that, in addition to having few options, the few that exist are charged individually. Even the sauna has a fee. I don't recommend the experience.

reviews.author: Happiness689851
reviews.title: Amazing vacation as usual !
reviews.text: We loved our time at Paradisus Cancun. We have stayed at the Playa Del Carmen location as well and enjoyed this one very much too! Ginger bar staff is excellent! They remembered our drink request every day and go above and beyond to get you what you want. Abraham the mixology guy is great and Gaby the waitress was amazing!

reviews.author: Guide34188655994
reviews.title: Ginger bar. The best place to have fun🥳😂
reviews.text: I thank all these people for making our vacation spectacular, we had an incredible time. I recommend the ginger bar(lobby). Look for the best mixologist Abraham🥳🎉. And Gaby at the ginger bar. You have a wonderful time with them.😎

reviews.author: Felicia M
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation!
reviews.text: Once again, this resort did not disappoint! We experienced excellent service at the beach, pool and all of the restaurants.  The food was excellent as well, we enjoyed fine dining every evening!  Friendly faces greeted us every morning at the buffet, in the hallways and on the beach.  We have been Club Melia members for a number of years, and look forward to this trip every year.

reviews.author: ezapata2023
reviews.title: excellence
reviews.text: Simply excellent, the service, the food, the pool was great, the staff is especially attentive. I would not hesitate to return and recommend it, the location is great, a dream come true and a unique experience

reviews.author: erassocs
reviews.title: Wedding Trip
reviews.text: While the staff was friendly and the rooms were clean, the hotel shows it age. There is also no air conditioner in the atrium or public restrooms.  Its hard to relax and enjoy the gardens when you are constantly sweating.  The public restrooms have no air flow, so they are hot and smell like urine if you lucky if not straight open sewer smells.

reviews.author: Alex M
reviews.title: I can’t wait to come back! Once the other side is done with construction, that resort is going to be even better!
reviews.text: Overall this trip was awesome! Everyone was so helpful to us. My girlfriend had broke her ankle a month ago or so and everyone went out of their way to make sure she was taken care of, we felt very comfortable with anyone who helped us. I want give extra thanks to Atilano and especially Moses who were both very helpful to My girlfriend, and my family. Also Luis from Sante Bar has great energy and makes great drinks. Blue Agave has some of the best tacos I’ve had. Lemon fish was delicious with very good service as well. Lucas at capella did a very good job serving but the food wasn’t too good. (Unless payed extra, which was delicious) Also one of the ladies that gave us a massage needs more training. I believe her name was Claudia, she continuously needed to be told what to do by her customer and wasn’t relaxing at all. However Anna was very good! Thanks again!

reviews.author: michaelolsa
reviews.title: Fantastic Trip
reviews.text:
We went for a family wedding and had a great time. The rainy weather on the wedding day didn’t make it easy, but the staff adapted the location of the wedding and made it great. 
Every server at every meal was very helpful and attentive. Pascual was our server at breakfast for all 4 mornings we were there and he stood out over all the other great servers. So friendly, funny, and kind. My shy 4 year old even liked him a lot. 
The food at all the restaurants was fantastic!!  I would definitely go back.

reviews.author: joel R
reviews.title: Excellent service 😘😘
reviews.text: Excelente service especially all the bartenders from ginger bar 🍻🍺🍺 I recommend the bartender Abraham the best mixology and Gaby,sofonia and Betty, they are the best team. We fall in love  with them😎👍😘

reviews.author: Carlos G
reviews.title: The best bartender in Cancun
reviews.text: Abraham was the best bartender I have ever ever ever had he needs to be promoted 100% took care of me and my friends every single night til the day we left we absolutely love him and we honestly plan to come back literally just for him we not only gained an amazing experience and a friend here in Cancun Mexico he is an amazing fun time makes everything a 100% better please keep him please ask for him and please tip him we all love him from Carlos, Karina, Natalie, Cinthia, William, and Maria!!!!! We love you Abraham!!!!

reviews.author: psucards2002
reviews.title: Moms 70th Birthday
reviews.text:
Paradisus is an amazing destination all inclusive hotel. We went there for moms 70th birthday and the staff was so lovely and accommodating. Every restaurant made her feel special by bringing a special dessert with sparklers and sang happy bday to her!
These staff members made our trip memorable:
Karen chef at lemon fish 
Miguel server at lemon fish 
Daniel D server at lemon fish 
Moises at the buffet 
Baltazar pool server (the best!)
Edwardo pool server 
Andres personal concierge 
Charlie cabana host 
Fernando guest services 
Leticia hotel lobby bartender 
Gaby server at ginger 
Roberto at Aqua Marina for lunch 
Yolanda pool ice cream lady 
Roger server at Sal 
Bryan activities at the pool (we made a keychain)
David from the spa 
Anna massage therapist 
Lyla & Samantha crafts activities in ginger (I made a dream catcher)
Edelweis & Angelica both at checkout 
My sister in law can only eat shrimp, white rice and pasta with butter and as inconvenient as that can be the staff went above and beyond to accommodate her and for that we’re very thankful! 
All the food was absolutely delicious, the best customer service, the beach was gorgeous with powdered sugar like sand, no sea weed! Thank you Paradisus for making moms 70th so special!!

reviews.author: Carlos Giacometti
reviews.title: Be right back
reviews.text:
We were at Paradisus for my son's wedding...
Few and sincere words to evaluate this hotel...
Unforgettable experience...from arrival to departure, only experiences that enchanted...everything impeccable...restaurants, service, comfort, polite and always ready employees...efficiency in everything...I'll be back soon

reviews.author: Moises G
reviews.title: lemon fish restaurant
reviews.text:
Lemon fish, super delicious in oriental and Peruvian fusion food, in addition to the
Excellent service from our waiter Jorge and the speed of chef Karen and Mario, it is always pleasant to be at the Melia chain Congratulations

reviews.author: Ana Lucila M
reviews.title: Good experience, thing to improve
reviews.text:
Room’s furniture is not the best, but beds are great.  Food is 8/10 and I think there were few waiters for all the people at the hotel.

My favorite amenity is the coffee station, attention was excellent, even with a lot of clients waiting in line. Also coffee ando desserts are great. Hopefully they get an oven for those who prefers warm food.

reviews.author: Quique M
reviews.title: Excellent service, everything very delicious!
reviews.text: Very attentive waiter, delicious food, fresh foods. Overall excellent. I ordered the cochinita pibil, also the esquites and the Aztec cake with rajas poblanas and for dessert the flan and churros with chocolate. I recommend all the dishes

reviews.author: ana r
reviews.title: My experience in Cielito Lindo
reviews.text: Very good service, the food is very good, the waiters are super friendly, good quality food, the atmosphere is very pleasant and the drinks are also very well prepared, I would definitely come again.

reviews.author: Vicente T
reviews.title: The kids club staff is the best
reviews.text: Extraordinary Kids Club, activities and staff, congratulations to the staff Ivana, Itzel, Rubí, Xiomara and Bruno, my 3 daughters never wanted to leave there, they were the best part of the stay, continue like this, thank you very much from Vale, Nati and Arantxa ;)

reviews.author: Claudia B
reviews.title: Excellent.
reviews.text: All hotel staff are friendly and helpful. Congratulations to the team of waiters and hostess of the Malva restaurant. (Ramiro and Ricardo). Thanks to all the hotel staff for the attention and details received. We had a good time throughout our stay.

reviews.author: Patricia B
reviews.title: Excellent service !
reviews.text:
The service we received throughout our stay was excellent!! Food of good quality and variety! I recommend coming!
Thanks to Ramiro and Ricardo for their attention during the breakfast buffet at Malva!

reviews.author: Safari661912
reviews.title: Amazing time at the Paradisus
reviews.text:
There is a reason why we keep coming back to the Melia brand and that has to do with the people who are there to make your vacation special. A group of 7 of us just got back from a week at the Paradisus Cancun and it was an amazing time. We got The Reserve upgrade for a great price when we booked back in the spring and I have to say it is so worth it. Having the option of the adult pool and beach was very nice. 

As for the people, I have to point out a few who really made it so special. Oscar and Valeria who worked The Reserve area and restaurant knew us by name and couldn’t do enough to make sure we had what we needed. At the Malva buffet, Alfonso got you smiling first thing in the morning always remembering what we drank from our iced coffees  and various juices. If you go to the sports bar, be sure to find Gaby (my namesake) - it was funny because the first time I walked in during this trip, she came up to me and said how she remembered me from the last time I was there in 2022 (and remembered my name). And I need to mention Gaudencio who served us on the beach. It was quite a trek to shlep drunks but he had us hydrated each time we visited his area. Never had to ask because he was always there with more!

Can’t wait to return next year!

reviews.author: Mehrad J
reviews.title: Rafael from lemon fish
reviews.text: Rafael’s attention to detail and genuine enthusiasm for his work made our visit truly unforgettable. From the moment we walked in, he made us feel like valued guests. Dining at Lemon Fish Restaurant was a pleasure, thanks to Rafael’s exceptional service. We can’t wait to come back for more! 🌟🍽️😊

reviews.author: Kevin Z
reviews.title: A great experience with great food!
reviews.text: Paradisus is a wonderful hotel! We had a wonderful time with friends despite the rain (which of course is not the hotel’s fault). There were a few activities that were unfortunately canceled due to weather, but there were still plenty of buffets, pool swimming, and fun indoor activities available. Meals were good - Cielo was easily the best experience and our waiter Moises Morales went above and beyond to make sure that we had a wonderful time. I’m also a bit extra and asked for extra appetizers and entrees, and that was a non-issue (I was hungry, what can I say). We were also interested in the fancy top shelf tequila and Moises brought it over to explain it to us. He went above and beyond and it really elevated our dining experience. Overall… Resort: 4/5 - some areas showing their age but still very clean and well kept, Dining: 5/5 - always available, and Cielo is very good, Towels: 3/5, they kept running out probably due to weather, Weather: 2/5 (not their fault), My phone not working: 1/5 (also not their fault). We had a wonderful time!

reviews.author: Ailee
reviews.title: Nice place! Great food! Great Service!
reviews.text: We had a great time when we stayed at this hotel. Especially the restaurant - Lemon fish. We visited there twice and the food was so good and the waiter Juan Carlos is super nice! We had some issues regarding our room at the beginning (the slide door is not working) and our consultant George helped us changed another room immediately so this didn’t make us feel too uncomfortable. Overall, I think the price in this hotel meet its value. Everything was just great!

reviews.author: Kuanting Chen
reviews.title: Amazing seafood and vibe.
reviews.text: Food were so excellent and delicious. Must try mixed sushi and nigiri platter. Vibe was excellent as well. Ask Carlos for your server. He’s the best server we ever met in Mexico. He would introduce you the best food and cocktail. Must to be served by him.

reviews.author: Yenifer S
reviews.title: Thank you!
reviews.text: We ate at the Malva restaurant and it was really delicious! A lot of variety. Special thanks to Ricardo, Arnulfo and Guillermo for the attention and the detail of our friend's birthday gift. Greetings

reviews.author: Fer V
reviews.title: Today is our first day.
reviews.text:
Visit the Lemon Fish restaurant. For dinner, arrive early.
Jorge and the chefs Karen and Mario are great. Excellent atention.
We will still continue getting to know the rest of the hotel. We are happy. ;)

reviews.author: Paulina A
reviews.title: Lemon fish paradisus
reviews.text: Incredible place, an unforgettable and almost unreal experience. Highlighting the lemon fish bar restaurant, Jorge as host and chef Karen and Mario gave us an incredible evening that we will probably never forget. Totally recommended

reviews.author: Bill Webb
reviews.title: The Best Ever !!
reviews.text: Our family and friends of 8 people had an absolutely perfect 7 night stay here.  ALL of the staff were so very pleasant, smiling and truly wanting to see that we enjoyed our stay.  We ate breakfast every day at the buffet, watching the surf roll in.   We had a great time at the beach, body surfing the waves every day. We spent a considerable amount of time at the Sante bar, where Luis made different special drinks for us daily.  He was GREAT. The food and wine at the restaurants was excellent, with most of them offering to make us every appetizer on the menu for us to try. Andrea Diaz at "check-in/out was extremely pleasant and helpful.  At nights, Gabby at the Ginger Sports Bar was always pleased to see us for an after dinner drink.  Again, another employee who was always cheerful and glad to see us.  One highlight was dancing until midnight with earphones on, letting you choose from three different kinds of music to listen and dance to.  Thanks to everyone at Paradisus Cancun for a VERY enjoyable and memorable vacation.

reviews.author: Terri W
reviews.title: Outstanding service at a spectacular resort!
reviews.text:
This is our third time at this resort and it was even better than the first two!  The location is perfect, the food is great, but the service exceeded both!  
We had great weather and the beach was pristine.  The facility was immaculate - clean and well maintained.
The Lemon Fish is a newer sushi style restaurant and was excellent as well as Capellas which is Italian.  We also went to Sal and was worth the extra charge.  
Luis and Alex at the Sante bar took such great care of us, we wanted for nothing!  Luis knew everyone's preferences by the second day.  He went above and beyond, making our drinks look like they came out of a magazine, bringing champagne and sparklers as we toasted an anniversary!!  
Joel, Valerie, Jamil and Oscar took care of us at the Reserve pool and Sante restaurant.  All were extremely attentive.  
Gaby, Dania, Abraham and Valentin at the Ginger Sport Bar were terrific!  They were always so happy to see us, made us feel at home!  
Axel was in charge of activities and made certain to look us up to join whatever was going on.
No matter who we came in contact with, they took care of whatever we needed and seemed truly happy that we were there!  The entire staff made us feel so special!

reviews.author: Joaquin A
reviews.title: Perfect!!
reviews.text: Excellent food, very good service, at the bar and pool service a 10 from Orlando, Luis, Jorge among others and good friend Baltazar. In circle sales we received exceptional treatment from Fernanda who was always aware of us. Also at the ginger bar, Sofo and Luis treated us wonderfully. In the kids dome area they kept my children super entertained and were always attentive to them. The food was generally delicious and with a wide variety of places to eat at ease with different themes.

reviews.author: Genesis R
reviews.title: Rating an employee and his services.
reviews.text: When visiting Paradisus you have many options in restaurants and all provide good service. Dominic from Lime Fish, Jose from Cielo and Jesus from Agua Marina but Alfredo from Malva services and details to attention go beyond a waiters job description. Alfredo has waited family and friends in past trips and I finally was able to meet the famous Alfredo. One of the reason I will return if truly because of him. Thank you Alfredo!

reviews.author: Rocío T
reviews.title: Nice experience
reviews.text: The hotel is very nice and the food is very good, the service is also good, in my case I would have liked there to be more games for small children in addition to the kids zone, and I would like them to give more information about the activities

reviews.author: G H
reviews.title: Wonderful dining experiences. Great staff!
reviews.text:
Malva restaurant offered delicious meal fare for breakfast, lunch & dinner.  Very helpful and attentive serving staff Atilano, Jonni, Armando and Ignacio.
Desk staff were a pleasure to deal with, assisting us in so many thoughtful ways, to ensure our vacation experience met and exceeded our expectations.

reviews.author: Management
reviews.title: Top Pro Service Level

reviews.author: Travellots67
reviews.title: Hits and Misses
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful hotel, but it has its issues. I will an honest and factual review based on our recent trip.

What was great…

1- The Staff. With very few exceptions, the staff are friendly and helpful. Those who went above and beyond included Martin at Malva, Javier on the beach, Abraham at Ginger bar and Edier at the Nespresso bar. Thank you for exemplary service!
2- The Food. Although nothing was exceptional, most of the food was very good and fresh, and the buffet offers something for everyone. Our best meal was at Cielo on our last night.
3- The Location. Of course the beach is beautiful and you can walk for miles! There was no sargassum issue when we were there, but the wind and strong surf caused red flag days the whole time which meant staying very close to shore to avoid the strong currents. 

What was not…

1- Check in. We were originally given room 3125, and when we opened the curtains to see the beautiful view from our “luxury” ocean view junior suite, we were disappointed to see that it was blocked by a giant air conditioning unit! We turned around and went straight back to the lobby to request a change. We then waited another 2 hours for them to clean another room. After arriving at 11:30 am we were finally settled in by 5:00 pm! 
2- Hot Water. When we tried to have a shower the first night, there was no hot water. The next morning we had the same problem and were told someone would be sent to fix it. After many calls and visits to guest services, someone finally came just before dinner. I’m not sure if he adjusted anything, but he told us to let it run longer to access the hot water. We had let it run for 5-6 minutes but I guess that wasn’t long enough. What a terrible waste of fresh water from this “eco-friendly” resort!
3- Eduardo, our “concierge”. He seemed very friendly and promised us a special strawberry “treat” for our room, but when we indicated that we were not interested in their “Circle” program, this never materialized. Not surprised, just disappointed. We also mentioned to him that a random bucket of sparkling wine was left in our room with dirty glasses from a previous guest. He seemed apologetic but it stayed there for the whole week.

For Mexico, this is a 4 star resort, but from an American or Canadian perspective, it’s a solid 3 1/2 due to the issues mentioned.

reviews.author: Spring G
reviews.title: Worth every penny! Paradise for sure.
reviews.text:
I came for a birthday trip and was very happy with my overall experience. The resort was well kept inside and the outside leading to the beach/pool area was even more breathtaking. There were so many food options within the resort and room service was available 24/7. 

We had the pleasure to have Juan Carlos assigned to us as concierge. It made our trip super easy and pleasant. He was a very genuine and personable person which made it a more comfortable experience for us. He was on it! He booked all our reservations on and off resort. I wanted to serve children from the more rural part of Mexico during our stay and he helped us with the language barrier and made sure my birthday was planned the way I wanted. He always went above and beyond with and delivered. I just I’ll definitely come back with my family and hope that he’s still there. 

I’ve stayed at the paradisus in Cabo and this one is far bigger. Both are beautiful with its own and ways but food was good at both resorts. The staff are always so nice and I just love the tropical vibe vs other resorts. It really highlight the reasons I came to Mexico in the first place. Paradisus is definitely my go to favorite resort. It’s not the cheapest resort and neither the most expensive. However, very elegant and you get your money’s worth and more.

reviews.author: GlobeTrotting607353
reviews.title: Paradisus with a personal twist!
reviews.text:
I cannot say enough about this hotel. It’s in the perfect location on the most beautiful stretch of beach for starters you won’t be disappointed. The hotel was extremely clean and well kept and we had met several visitors who had been coming to this  same hotel for over 20 yrs straight. That’s says plenty. 
The room was extremely clean and well stocked with beverages and snacks. The pool is adequately staffed and this staff leaves no stone left unturned. Pool area was extremely clean and well kept. All the restaurants were good. You will not be disappointed with this hotel. 
I have to take time to mention a staff member who went above and beyond for my family. Her name is Ada and she works in the pool/beach area. She was more than a waitress - she is an amazing human and she took care of my family and treated my children like hers. Very personable and very kind and generous. She got to know my family well and knew what we need and when. On a couple of occasions she treated my family to the most amazing food and I am forever grateful to her. For me, number one in customer service. If you get to meet Ada - she’s the one you want for your vacation. Paradisus: you have a gem with her do not lose her. I’m coming back for her!!! Ada thank you so much. Because of you I will return to Paradisus with my family!

reviews.author: Ovi V
reviews.title: Ginger Bar was awesome!!!
reviews.text: One of my favorite places in this resort was the Ginger Bar. Dania and Valentin were awesome!!! Very professional and sweet, they took care of us with the drinks, food and snacks while watching the World Cup games. Good times!!!!

reviews.author: Neeraj A
reviews.title: Poor room quality and service for premium prices
reviews.text: The room had a bad smell, bathroom faucets and toilet door were pretty old. At paradisus “all inclusive” technically just means food and stay, all the services (in room food service, laundry, general medical assistance were all separate charge). When we checked in the front desk didn’t tell us that we needed to make dinner reservations at the restaurant. The restaurant’s didn’t have vegetarian food and buffets didn’t even have proper signs for whether the dish was vegetarian or not. Furthermore, when we asked servers or workers at the restaurant whether something was vegetarian we got wrong answers where initially someone said it was vegetarian and later another person said it was non vegetarian. Most of the staff was only interested in selling services instead of helping provide quality service. The room we stayed in was smelly and old.

reviews.author: Angel S
reviews.title: Second trip.  Still great people!
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus for our anniversary this past October.  It was our second time staying there. 

The positives:
-Our concierge, Freddy, was AMAZING!  He was so sweet and helpful.  When our room was really warm, he arranged for a fan to be brought to us.  He made reservations for us at Rosa Negra (across the road and sooo good) for our anniversary and arranged for an anniversary dessert (which includes a mini-show- haha) for us.  Even on Freddy's day off, he told us to text him for anything we might need, and he took care of everything even on those days.  Freddy was the best!!
-When we had come to Paradisus the first time, we agreed that Martin at Malva breakfast was the best server we'd ever had.  So we made sure to find him on our first morning, and he was, once again, the best.  Martin, Gerardo, and Eddie are seriously the most attentive and hard-working servers that you could ask for.  They remember your drink orders, always greet you with a smile, and treat you like a friend.  I would go back to Paradisus just for them!  We also met Diego, the manager of Malva, and he was so nice!
-Melissa at Ginger Bar was so sweet!!!  She had the biggest smile and made us feel so welcome!
-The Reserve pool servers: Moises, Javier, Miguel, and Oscar were all great!  They worked so hard every day bringing us drinks and food.  They made our days so easy and relaxing!

The negatives:
-Our room in tower 5 was pretty warm.  That was helped by Freddy having a fan brought to us thankfully.
-We went to Ginger Bar on our first night and Pedro and Wendy were working.  They weren't very welcoming and seemed annoyed.  We ordered two drinks that were very good, but were told that they were closing at a certain time for a private party (there was a convention for a company at the resort at the same time), so we had to be gone by then which was a little annoying, but we knew it wasn't their fault!  We finished our drinks and still had 20 minutes until the private party started, so we thought we'd order two more drinks and take them with us to a different bar.  However, when we went to the bar to order two more, Pedro and Wendy looked so annoyed that we were standing there.  Neither one made any acknowledgment of our drink order.  I was so uncomfortable after an awkward amount of time of being ignored that I pulled my husband's hand to just leave without the drinks.  About that time, Pedro reluctantly made our drinks without so much as saying a word to us.  When he sat them on the bar, we thanked him and tipped (again) and still weren't acknowledged.  We avoided Ginger Bar after that until we saw someone new working (Melissa) and gave it another chance.  Maybe they were annoyed about having to work a private party, but whatever the reason, it put a damper on the first night for me.
-The first time we came was over Memorial Day weekend and the resort was packed.  It wasn't as busy this time, so that might be why the Malva dinner buffet didn't seem to have as much variety.  We loved the buffet on our first trip and ate there almost every night because there was so much to choose from.  This time, however, there was much less variety and it got a little boring. 

Overall, the people (with a few exceptions) at Paradisus are amazing and are the reason I would come back!  Thank you so much, Freddy, Martin, Gerardo, Eddie, Diego, Melissa, Moises, Javier, Miguel, and Oscar for helping to make our trip a good one!

reviews.author: Connector310862
reviews.title: Average place for the price you pay.
reviews.text: I will start with good things, , good service overall, view is nice, clean place. on the other hand they were not very accommodating, first day they told we cannot make reservation for dinner at any restaurent, the Concierge Service they provided was new and next day he was off with no backup the manage Fernando said we will provide you a new concierge but he never did which was very disappointed some room did not had bathroom doors, the view is not good from room for ocean view its blocked due to design and they have the chairs low and wall blocking view. over all it was ok, do not recommend to use their circle promotion it is waste of time and do not provide any coupon etc for your time.

reviews.author: Kevin S
reviews.title: Thanksgiving weekend trip 5 days 4 nights.
reviews.text: Great place to spend a few days or a week. Everyone was really helpful, Leví our Concierge was awesome and made all our reservations and took care of all the details. The rooms, beach pool and facilities are well maintained and clean. All the restaurants were amazing but Lemon Fish and Miguel along with Jorge were great waiters with excellent knowledge of the menu. Joel and Caesar at Santi by the beach were spot on for every meal and the food was delicious every time. Kevin and Lana

reviews.author: micheledN254OR
reviews.title: Great Resort Excellent Staff
reviews.text:
Amazing, Awesome,Friendly, Clean are just a few words to start this review.
Let me start with Astrid of Guest Services and Alejandra in the Club concierge section.  They are both quick to reply & fix any issues that may come up during the stay. Excellent contacts & they do their job with a smile.Very pleasant & helpful.

The room was great. The beds were so comfortable everyone in our group slept like babies. It was quiet, clean, fully stocked and AC was perfect after a hot day at the pool. Cleaning staff are excellent. 

Malva restaurant is outstanding. The assortment of food, beverages,  desserts and meal stations available here is no way you leave hungry. The staff is constantly refilling the trays if they run low on food. They will take your plates and bring to your table if your hands are full. 

Suriday the hostess is very sweet & she is always moving & making sure you are seated quickly.

Gaudencio, Joni, Manuel, Antonio, Ramiro & Raul to name a few are outstanding. They remembered what we preferred to drink, refilled our cups throughout our meals & made sure we were refilled in our mugs to go before we left. Very Attentive. If something is not on the table and you ask they will deliver it in seconds. Not only was the staff absolutely on top of their job duties they are very personable. All always were smiling and friendly.

We only did the beach 1 day and Luz was our angel of a hostess/waitress. She was on the go from the second her feet hit the sand until we left. She was pleasant, friendly, funny & remembered all of our orders with no issues. Luz is a hustler and a great member of the Melia staff.

Cristina at the main pool was there every morning sweeping the excessive water away from under the chairs with a smile. 

They clean the pool daily & efficiently. They have someone in the pool every morning cleaning the pool floor, adding supplies such as chlorine and pumping in/out what was needed. Pool was amazing & refreshing.

Elliot & Yvonne at the pool are fantastic. They helped us get the huts and Bali beds every day.
We actually had the pleasure of meeting Elliot in 2019 when he was working the beach & we were very happy to see him still at the Melia. They work very well together and fulfilled all of our requests. Without the huts no way we would have enjoyed the day. The huts were a must for us.

Balta, Sergio & all of the bartenders and staff at the main pool are sensational, amazing, fun, caring, very personable and I can't say one bad thing about any of them. They all work very hard every shift. They remember what one prefers to eat for lunch or if we had a special drink preference.

Balta went above & beyond when one of my girls wasn't feeling well & helped get some soup and rice to eat. To have him go above and beyond to help make her feel better we will forever be thankful for his kindness.

Giovany and Roberto at the Ginger Bar we became friends from the minute we met. They make a delicious drink, make you feel very comfortable during your time at the bar. Both are diligent, happy, bright & very welcoming to their area.

The silent disco on Sat night was my favorite part & wished they had it more than once a week.

I have been to several resorts in Mexica, DR. & Aruba and this was my best vacation ever. The staff made the vacation we all wanted & needed perfect. !00% outstanding staff.

Only thing I would like to see adjusted or changed is to be able to make dinner reservations at check in or on line before arriving. Having to leave your activity to wait in line to only be able to book 2 nights at a time is inconvenient. 

Also the area where the shows were performed would get crowded. Maybe moving some of those activities to a conference room with a stage would allow staff more room to perform and the guests more room to sit & enjoy the performances.

Can't wait to come back again. Hoping to see everyone again in February 2023.

reviews.author: Courtney B
reviews.title: Worst stay ever
reviews.text:
Worst stay at an all inclusive resort ever. One thing after another led to a terrible experience. We were traveling as a family including grandparents and our 10 month old baby and stayed for a week. 

Our first night we went to the buffet and there were cockroaches running over our feet and climbing up the bench seats. We literally ran out of there because one of them tried to crawl in the diaper bag! So gross. Also the food was not labeled and I ate the biggest scoop of the spiciest salsa of my life! My mouth was on fire for a good 30 minutes, which was both hilarious and infuriating at the same time. 

We were assigned a concierge on the second day of our stay. We told him we were flexible for dinner reservations and that he could book them between 6-7pm at any restaurant for the week and that we would like to try them all. He said this would help him to make the reservations because we didn’t demand specific restaurants or times. We still had 2 out of 4 reservations that were not booked correctly. Really poor communication. We were booked for Sal’s after an excursion day and we even had to cut our excursion a little short so we could get back in time for our reservation. When we showed up to Sal’s the hosts rushed over and were very abrasive and rude and said no they can’t seat us because there are no babies allowed. That would have been nice to know before we were standing in front of them. Especially when we rushed our excursion to Chichen-itza for nothing. So we were forced to eat at the roach buffet again and again there were cockroaches running all over the floor. The following night we were booked for the Italian restaurant and when we showed up for our reservation the host said he didn’t have a table for us. He said they were double booked and tried to seat us in the entryway! Like the waiting area! All 7 of us plus the baby! Meanwhile there was a table set for 10 and they never showed up; so we had to beg for that table instead. 

We made poolside Cabana reservations several days ahead of time for 3 of the days during our stay. The first day was no problem. The next day we were standing waiting for Elliot for 20 minutes until finally another staff member told us our cabanas were given away. Neither Jose (our concierge) nor Elliot ever communicated to us that we needed to “check in by 11” the first time we made a reservation, but that was their excuse for not having cabanas for us that day.  

The waiters at the pool got our orders wrong every time we ordered food or drinks. Sometimes we never got what we ordered. The elevators were broken and we had to lug the stroller up and down all the flights of stairs everywhere we went. 

We have never had to complain before because we usually have good experiences with club Melia but this was on another level. We could have overlooked some things but it was just one inconvenience after another and left a really poor taste in our mouth about the whole vacation. We did not have the pleasant experience that we expected to have.

reviews.author: Annie F
reviews.title: The Vacation of a Lifetime with Geovani, Sofonias, Emilio, Roberto, Nurbi, and Emmanuel 😇
reviews.text: This vacation at Club Melia was amazing due to the amazing staff in the Ginger Bar  including Geovani (mi amor) , Sofonias, Emilio, Roberto, Nurbi, and Emmanuel💗 these amazing people made my vacation a vacation of a lifetime! So thankful for meeting them and for their kindness to us during our vacation.😇 please give them all the kind words they deserve and you are so incredible to have these workers work for you all! Everyone make sure to visit the Ginger lounge for the best DJ ( ERIC) and for the best companions you will find in Mexico!! Also huge praise for Jean Carlo (JC) and Cesar at Lemonfish, we LOVE him. I cannot say enough about these people. Also to include Sergio, Elliot, and Balta at the pool, so kind and always so sweet to us. Thank you so much for making this vacation so memorable.

reviews.author: Ken P
reviews.title: Amazing resort and experience

All in all, would recommend this resort to anyone and we will definitely be returning.

Love,

reviews.author: Sergey N
reviews.title: Not a 5 Star Hotel
reviews.text:
Would like to start my review with positive things . The hotel stuff is nice and very helpful , especially Christian and Albert at the reception. The views, the ocean, the nature are amazing and taking your breath away, it’s like in the movies . 
But that the end of good things.

reviews.author: Leanne P
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with lovely staff!
reviews.text:
It’s difficult to find bad things to say about this hotel. This was our first trip together to Mexico and we couldn’t have picked a better hotel. Overall the interior was beautiful and the beaches amazingly kept, the most stunning sea I have ever seen. This hotel offers lots of meal options in the buffet as well as a wide range of a la carte restaurants to choose from which are all easy to book. The staff around the bar, beach areas and all restaurants made our short trip relaxing and not far off perfect. 

We were offered fresh drinks upon arrival (which was very much needed after a 10.5 hour flight) whilst we checked in. This was a lovely touch real 5* service. 

The rooms were lovely and clean with plenty of places to put clothing and shoes. The only things we struggled with here was the sockets not being strong enough to hold any plugs, the lights where in odd places within the room and there were no lights in the shower making it very dark. Other than that the bed was comfortable and fridge was always re-filled. 

The restaurants were easy to book and the only one we had to book a slightly later time that we would have wanted was Lemon Fish, sushi restaurant. This was our favourite and we visited two nights in a row! Our waiter for the first visit Manuel who was lovely and welcoming making us want to return. Our second visit our waiter was Caesar and he helped answer all our questions despite being rushed off his feet.  Very good service here, couldn’t fault the food either,
some of the nicest sushi dishes I have had.

The only other things we struggled with in general were the QR code menus, I understand this in due to COVID however I find it very unsociable and sometimes hard to read. 
Finally the lack of entertainment. The entertainment staff were all lovely when we saw them around however there wasn’t a bored around the hotel so we did not know what to look forward to around the pool. It would have been nice to have some of the classic aqua aerobics and water volleyball to have taken part in, I feel if we were at this hotel for longer we may have gotten bored. 

Other than the very small things there very few ways to complain. We found so many positives and have the most amazing first holiday together! Thank you to all the staff for making it so special, if we had the money we will be returning.

reviews.author: Alex R
reviews.title: Perfect service
reviews.text: Jorge gmanuel was are server he had perfect service checked in very frequently very good manners on our trip to Mexico. Leaving us with some great memories. Would definitely come back to this restaurant.

reviews.author: GoPlaces31488468502
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Great service from Emanuel and Jorge. Amazing servers and great food. Ate at lemon fish. Will definitely be coming back in the future for more meals. The pineapple desert was my favorite if you wanted any suggestions.

reviews.author: Iris
reviews.title: GETS BETTER EVERY TIME
reviews.text:
I had the pleasure of being able to stay at the Paradisus Cancun last month. I miss it already, and I am currently at a different resort!
The staff, hands down, is top notch! They are the reason why I go back once or twice a year. They are so attentive, work so hard, and so appreciative of everyone that stays with them. They bend over backwards for me. They anticipate all of my requests. I do not have to lift a finger there, and when I try to, they deny me right away! There's a warmness and genuineness about them. The resort still hangs onto the Mexican culture, but yet are able to accommodate so many guests from across the globe. Why go to Mexico if you are not going to try to partake in the culture??
Among the staff that I had went above and beyond for me as follows, in no particular order:
1) Ruth Aliba - Reserve Concierge. So sweet and so helpful. I had the honor of having her assistance last stay as well. I was so happy to see her again. She took care of all of my requests and handled things for me promptly. She is the best!
2) Jennifer S. and Nicole - Reserve Pool Concierge - What a great duo! So wonderful to be greeted every morning with a big smile and warm welcome. They took great care of me every day, checked on me constantly, and had the time to make some conversation during my solo travels. 
3) Raul - bellhop and greeter. I have been here multiple times and he always remembers me and so happy to see. He always start my stay with a big smile and welcome which always reassures me I came at the right time and I'm definitely at the right place
3.5) Cielo - Moises and Chef David. These two gentleman are one of the main reasons why I keep coming back. They are so welcoming and they go completely out of their way to make my dining experience unforgettable. The food that is served there is my favorite in the world. I make it a point to dine with them twice during my stay. Chef David introduced me to saltamontes!!! Only he could get me to eat them! Moises, I can call my friend who I enjoy seeing and catching up with every time I stay at Paradisus.
4) Reception - Orlando and Manuel helped me make some room changes at my request, including an upgrade
5) Malva - Antonio, Orlando, Armando, Edier, Alberto, Atilano, Martin - made me feel like I was the most important guest around. They even sent me off with a chalk drawing on my last day. 
6) Reserve Pool Wait Staff - Javier, Joel, Ruben, Valeria, Yamil, Miguel- anticipated all of my needs and had my bucket of ice, Coca Cola lite, and aqua ready for me at the start of the day, even before I had to ask! Drinks and food arrived promptly. They work so hard for the guests
7) Lemon Fish - Miguel- Made such great drink recommendations and prompt service!
8) Sal - Leo- Such amazing service!
9) Capella- Fernando- Great service and conversation 
10) The Lunch Box - Jose - Such wonderful service and he helped me navigate some of the Melia points program with suggestions
Thank you to all of you and your staff for such a relaxing stay. Thank you for being patient with me when I try to practice my "Espanol." Hope to see everyone again in the spring! Thank you, thank you, thank you.

reviews.author: Humberto O
reviews.title: Service with excellence - Alfredo Alvaro
reviews.text: Alfredo Alvaro, Eddie and Teresa's team provide excellent service at breakfast and lunch!  very attentive and ready to serve! always attentive to help you with breakfast or lunch! Thank you very much for the service to me and my family!  A tip for visitors: if you want great service, look for Alfredo!

reviews.author: Nathalie
reviews.title: Malva breakfast and lunch
reviews.text: Had breakfast and lunch at Malva during our stay. Food was great and service was fantastic. Servers Atilano and Manuel catered to our large group with a smile and nothing was too much to ask. They even gave my son a plate of raisins because they saw him picking them off my dish and eating them. Very attentive!

reviews.author: Dharti T
reviews.title: An A+ resort experience!!
reviews.text:
This resort is one of the best we have ever been to. So clean and smells so good when you enter. Staff is friendly everywhere.  
Special mention: Cielo
We are vegetarian and upon consulting the manager Adriana was kind enough to accommodate us. A great thanks to Chef David, he specially made all veggie mexican menu for us. It was delicious 😋. The hostess Karen and our waiter Victor were incredible.  Overall a very memorable experience and a fun trip!

reviews.author: Reese R
reviews.title: Lives up to the name
reviews.text:
The experience at Paradisus was simply incredible. One of the key things to look out for with all inclusive resorts is the difference between a basic and premium package and Paradisus has the best balance. We were here with a basic all inclusive package and never felt like it was an obstacle for our vacation. Premium things are just premium, with basic you can still do all the things you need; it's just 1 restaurant, 1 pool, and some conveniences like reserving lounge beds on the beach that are premium only. Basic includes a personal concierge which is a huge bonus, our concierge Atzi got our whole dinner schedule from us right at check in and set up all the restaurant reservations for our whole trip and kept us updated by text. She was incredibly helpful with any questions by text as well.

Activities were a great deal too, Paradisus works with a marina just across the street. Through Paradisus with them, we found activities, like day cruises to Isla Mujeres or jet skis, much cheaper than was possible with even the cheapest independent companies.

Lastly, the food. We found that lunches were ok at any of the restaurants but breakfast and dinner were excellent, and also the most important if you're out all day anyway. The breakfast is a buffet but good quality and a lot of options; really anything you can think of is available. For dinner, Cielo the Mexican restaurant was the best in the resort, and one of the best Mexican restaurants I've been to, do not skip this one. A special thanks to Moises and the chef David who were so kind with us. The seafood restaurant is another one you shouldn't miss for dinner. The ceviche and sushi restaurant in the center is one of the most popular but might not be worth the effort of getting a reservation, the ceviche is fantastic but the sushi is just ok, it's mostly about the location and scenery.

All together, if you aren't one to spring for premium packages at all inclusive resorts, Paradisus is a great choice and you'll barely notice that anything is held back from you. If you like activities, their partnership with a local marina will save you a lot on watersports and some great dinner options will round out your days. Getting such an attentive concierge in a basic package is unique and really makes the visit smooth so you spend your effort enjoying vacation.

reviews.author: Brittany M
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
Rafael was an amazing host. He was so kind and very helpful with the menu. 
I wish we would have had an another opportunity to come and dine with him. 
The food was incredible and the ambiance unbeatable. 
Thank you Lemon Fish, Rafael, and the bartender (best martinis on the resort!) for an incredible experience

reviews.author: aiden P
reviews.title: Paradis Lemon fish
reviews.text: Paradisus Lemon Fish was very good. The waiter (Daniel) was very kind to us and this place is very high-quality that deserves a 5 star rating. The food also tastes very good and I hope me and my family will come again soon.

reviews.author: kerolos i
reviews.title: The best spot for kids
reviews.text: The whole place is amazing, food was very good, pool and water is very good the best idea of the whole place is if you have kids. They have a kids club only dedicated for kids all ages. You have lots of activities on a schedule on a daily basis for the kids. They have their own room with tv, movies and games. Also painting and dancing and water activities. Definitely coming back. My kids loved it. Special thanks to Gustavo, Ivon, Maribel, Ruby and Brenda from the kids club.

reviews.author: amy m
reviews.title: best servers on the beach
reviews.text: Yesenya & Gaby we’re the best servers that we had while we spent our days at the beach. They knew what we wanted and would always bring doubles of what we were drinking. We were a big group here for a destination wedding and they made our experience 10x better, remembering our names and everything!

reviews.author: Ryan F
reviews.title: Has gotten poor
reviews.text:
I’ve stayed at this resort a few times over the past 5 years. They have went down hill. My room a/c didn’t work and to fix the situation they tried to downgrade me rooms. However I’m arrival it took an hour to checkin as they were trying to upgrade everyone rooms. They have gotten really greedy. Ask I could hear from midnight to 3am was loud pounding of music from the night club. Anytime staying in tower 4 would hear this. This wasn’t disclosed. They stopped supplying Simple things like maps to guests unless you are in the reserve or medallion class. It’s like they are pushing the staff to just upswell everything instead of taking care of the guests for what they advertised. They also have a cockroach issue s as I saw them on the buffet and on in our bathroom. Thankfully it was in our bathroom the last day or I would have freaked.

Overall I would no longer recommend this resort. I brought 3 other couples here this trip and it let me down.

reviews.author: tskelly2016
reviews.title: If you are looking for relaxation book the Reserve here!
reviews.text: Love this resort! This is our 3rd time at this resort, the last was just before Covid. We upgrade to the reserve so we can have the pampering experience on the adult side of the resort. The service is fantastic, better than most resorts I have stayed at including the US and other islands. The Sante restaurant exclusive to reserve guests, is excellent for breakfast and lunch! The servers are amazing and rotate through through restaurant and the pool area. Shout out to Joel, Oscar, Valeria, and Cesar who made sure we were taken care of with food and drinks all day! They remembered us from previous trips. Violetta was our concierge and checked in daily making (and changing) dinner reservations and keeping our room stocked with extras that we requested! Nicole and Jennifer at the pool hut ensured we got a cabana and towels daily. Josue worked the coffee bar in the lobby of our building and made my coffee in the mornings ( he also remembered us from previous trips).  These folks are one of the reasons we love it here in addition to the beautiful property and the views from the rooms, pool cabanas/Bali beds as well as proximity to the beach! Do take advantage of the rest of the resort, restaurants, ginger bar with entertainment nightly and 24 hour espresso bar with treats. We ate at a few of the restaurants for dinner and the buffet for lunch one day (great for salad) The food is typical of an all inclusive, good not stellar but you can narrow your choices and even ask for things not on the menu. Aquafina and Lunch Box were outstanding IMO. Raul at the Lunch Box was great as well! Spa is fantastic, definitely use the hydrotherapy.

reviews.author: 580brodyg
reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort!! Definitely recommend the Reserve upgrade which includes a personal concierge to help with almost anything you would need including dinner reservations-Rafael was our concierge and he checked in every day and made sure we had everything we needed. Reserve upgrade also included the private, adult only pool with comfortable cabanas and amazing poolside service- Miguel & Julio never let us go thirsty! Nicole and Jennifer, the wonderful pool concierges, always made sure we were taken care of. No complaints whatsoever about the food, it was all delicious and our servers were exceptional- Shout out to:
Ian at Cielo 
Rafael and chef Antonio at Lemon Fish
Jesus at Cappella
Leo at Sal Steak Cave

reviews.author: Emily M
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
The service at the pool was amazing, muy bueno! Didier, Sergio, Irena and Gabriela took such good care of our family poolside. They brought buckets of ice cold water and beer each day. They took our lunch orders and delivered the large order quickly every day. They all were very friendly! They also delivered towels! 

Most of the restaurants were good. Our favorite was Agua Marina. Each restaurant (besides Sal) is super kid friendly. 

I recommend getting the reserve level service to enhance your experience. Kids club is available from 10am-11pm, but it closes from 6pm-7pm so time your dinner reservations accordingly. We weren't told this when we arrived so we weren't able to use the kids club at all during dinner, unfortunately. Our dinner reservations couldn't be changed to accommodate using the kids club. That is probably my biggest disappointment.

reviews.author: Andrew M
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Didier made our experience during our stay for our family  at the pool excellent. He went above an above for all the service and did everything we needed each and every day !!  We were very thankful!!!!

reviews.author: Pioneer55973354728
reviews.title: Best experience in Cancun
reviews.text:
Restaurant Malva.
We had waiters Anilano, Manuel and iGnacia and they were absolutely amazing. They would constantly coming to our table helping us with all our needs. I will definitely be back and will request this team if I can.

reviews.author: Kim B
reviews.title: Best all inclusive in Cancun!
reviews.text:
Where to begin… everything from the moment we checked in was AMAZING! While standing at the front desk I had a headache from traveling and my boyfriend said “let’s find you a drink,” and I kid you not 10 seconds later someone came up behind us to offer me a drink LOL.

We stayed in the premium lagoon view room which actually turned out to be more of an ocean/tower next to us view, but we loved the jacuzzi on the patio and the bed was so comfy. The kitchenette was a nice feature but we never used it aside from the mini fridge.

During the days we went to the big pool with the swim up bar or the beach. The water is breathtaking and both were fun and lively. We also did a 3-pack of excursions with Aquaworld (jungle tour, parasailing and isla mujeres tour) which was so worth it and an easy walk just directly across the resort. 

The night life at the resort was pretty good. We enjoyed walking around the little market set up by the second pool and the silent disco one night was surprisingly SO much fun. On our last night we even took a bus to Coco Bongo. 

On the first night we had a reservation at the Mexican dinner restaurant and we had to wait an extra 30 min and the food was good but probably my least favorite out of all that we tried. We loved Agua Marina so much that we went back twice in a row. Blue Agave had great tacos and an easy lunch to do during a pool day if you didn’t want to order poolside food. 

We read in another review that Malva breakfast buffet was hot and overwhelming, but we enjoyed it each morning we went. The staff there were the most friendly and lively we interacted with out of any restaurant! A special shoutout to Gerardo, Pascaul, and Edie who made our last breakfast so fun that we almost forgot how sad we were to be leaving for the airport right after!!

10/10 recommend for anyone looking for a fun and relaxing paradise!

reviews.author: msmbp
reviews.title: Cielo
reviews.text: We ate dinner at Cielo. It was delicious. Our waiter, Moises was friendly and attentive. The chef, David came around after dinner with homemade candies. We are going back for dinner again this evening. The entire staff was wonderful. Enjoy your vacation in Cancun. It is amazing!!

reviews.author: Tretrejo
reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: We enjoyed the hotel very much: the beautiful natural landscape, the color of the sea, the weather, the infrastructure of the Hotel and, above all, the warmth and efficiency of the staff, so friendly and willing to make our stay excellent.

reviews.author: Danny G
reviews.title: Great family resort and service.
reviews.text: Great resort. Can't say enought on the great service Angel Barrera and Ian Zamudio gave in the Cielo restaurant. Very informative on food selection and always onto of making sure my family felt welcome and comfortable attended during the dinner.

reviews.author: Tricia M
reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Moises was incredible! The food was very good! Especially the bone marrow sopes and the ceviche. But mostly the attention we received from Moises. Delicious cuisine and the drinks were amazing! He anticipated our wants and needs! 5 stars!

reviews.author: Kelly R
reviews.title: Great staff and resort experience
reviews.text: Huge shoutout to the wonderful staff who made our stay top notch!! Frida (Conceirge) Nicole and Jennifer (cabana staff) Axcel (activities) Oscar and Alejandro (wait staff) went above and beyond for us

reviews.author: Raylene F
reviews.title: 3 Generation Family Vacation
reviews.text:
Spent 8 nights in this resort! Positives are the POOL was great! So many pools in Mexico are too cold. This one we could actually enjoy!!! The rooms were nice and the resort itself was very pretty. The staff was lots of fun. Every night we always knew we would have fun @ The Ginger Bar thanks to Argenis AKA Randy, Sofonio and Luis!!! Randy made the absolute Best drinks!!

Although I can't say any of us was a fan of the food as it was defiantly lacking the crew was always ready to take good care of us and get us anything we needed. Marvin and he's crew Codie, Geraldo & Teresa always greeted us with smiles in the Buffet at Breakfast! Another shout out to Emanuel I believe was his name. He is the manager of Lemon Fish. We had a little mix up with our resersvation but he was quick to fix it so we could enjoy the Sushi!!

It was a great get away for our 3 generation vacation!!!

reviews.author: Dennis G
reviews.title: Lemon Fish restaurant
reviews.text: Great place to at. My wife and I had a great experience. Thank you to Rafael our server who was amazing from start to finish. The whole team was great including management and chef of the kitchen. Definitely recommend this spot. 🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviews.author: Jaminemisa
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Miguel was our server! Super kind person and he recommended great dishes to try and what is the most popular on the menu! He was also teaching us how to properly pronounce the food in the menu!! Highly recommend this place! Would definitely come back here!

reviews.author: Brian S
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Rafael was an excellent and very boisterous waiter. Paid a great detail to the comfort of myself and significant other, going above and beyond to ensure our every need was met! Made our dining experience at lemon fish that much more pleasurable.

reviews.author: brittney
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Rafael was an amazing waiter! We came to lemon fish for a late dinner and he helped explain the menu, and recommended a wine for me. He had me taste it first to be sure I liked it. The sushi was great quality, and my boyfriend who doesn’t eat fish even found something he liked.

reviews.author: Allyson B
reviews.title: Amazing first time in Mexico!
reviews.text: This was our first time to Mexico and as a family of 5 with little babies it did not disappoint! The resort is stunning, the service was outstanding, and the Kidsclub was super clutch for our sun time limited 6yo. From our initial check in we got upgraded to an ocean view room (thank you, Jonathan!) which was such a nice touch to our stay. Frida, our concierge, helped us by making reservations for dinner at the many restaurants they had at the resort, all with their own specialties. She also was quick to answer any questions we had which was so helpful! The servers at the buffet, especially during breakfast when our kids were super hangry, were so attentive and it was so appreciated. We never felt like we were annoying anyone and didn’t feel like we had to apologize for our kids toddler behavior (read: random screaming, minor tantrums). Thank you, Antonio, Roberto, Raul to name just a few! We loved our daily cabana visit by the kids pool where the servers again were so attentive, always checking in and asking us if we needed anything. Irina is seriously the best! And then the Kidsclub… what praising words can I say about the Kidsclub?! Everything? They’re amazing?? Awesome?? The best with kids?? My oldest (6yo) had an absolute blast and every day asked what time it was so he could go back to the “kids room.” Gustavo, maribel, ivon, itzel, Brenda were so fantastic with the kids and the activities they did every day were mind blowing. I only wish my younger two didn’t cry when we dropped them off so they could enjoy the activities as well! I loved that every day there were activities and events so if you felt like “doing something” but didn’t want to leave the resort, you had lots of options. Can’t wait to come back! Highly recommend this resort, especially if you have a family. And if you don’t want to bring the fam or want to enjoy a trip without kids, they have a clear separated adults only section!

reviews.author: steve h
reviews.title: Tacos at Cielo
reviews.text:
Great tacos!!! (Chorizo)
Filiberto is the man!!!
If you get a chance go see Filiberto he will treat you like you are a star. He was attentive and entertaining. I had a great time and great food. .
Viva Cancun!

reviews.author: Luz R
reviews.title: Girls Trip!!
reviews.text: Returned to this hotel after being here with my daughter in June, but now returned for a girls trip! We had so much fun, the room was amazing the pool and ocean where great!!! And Jesus from entertainment was so awesome! His energy was great!! made sure we where always having fun!! In love with this hotel will be returning soon!!!

reviews.author: cali415
reviews.title: Awesome service! Family-oriented service
reviews.text:
It was my family’s first time visiting Cancun, and we traveled with our 2 kids. We stayed at Paradisus. The service we got from Arturo, Armando, Orlando and Raul at Malva made the trip memorable. They are very attentive and their service were amazing! We also want to mention Rod who our kids grown fond of.  The hotel offered all inclusive but our kids wanted Malva because of these amazing people.

Thank you! And we will definitely be back sooner…

reviews.author: Clinton R
reviews.title: Fantastic November Veterans getaway
reviews.text: Definitely a 5 all the way.  Did the all inclusive and the food and service was great.  Spent an evening to pamper myself in the Steakhouse (Sal), which was an extra charge, but worth the money.  The evening bazaar’s brought some interesting items right to the lobby, just make sure you count your pesos and dollars correctly.  Never a line to get drinks and plenty of open chairs around the pool, with several cabana rental options.  Will be back.

reviews.author: Juan R
reviews.title: Lemon fish
reviews.text: Excellent experience we will never forget this night we were treated to a memorable experience the waiter help us by recommending a variety of dishes my family and I enjoyed the best Japanese dishes we’ve had in a long time thanks so much Rafiel we will be back

reviews.author: Marcelo A
reviews.title: Retiro de Trabajo
reviews.text: El staff de Malva hizo mi experiencia inolvidable. Frecuente la área de Liliana y Arnulfo para mis cenas. Siempre muy atentos y con una sonrisa que me hacían sentir como que estaba en familia. What can i say about the great staff at Malva. They made my trip so much better. The whole staff was great but we decided to stay in Liliana and Arnulfo’s area for dinner. They always had a smile on their face that made me feel welcomed. My final night here they had a special touch that will always be remembered by my family and kids. Thank you Guillermo and staff specially Liliana y Arnulfo.

reviews.author: Aimee T
reviews.title: A definite must!
reviews.text:
My family and I visited the Paradisus Cancun in mid-October and we had a truly amazing time.  This was my aunt's first time in Cancun, and now it's the only place she wants to vacation!

We stayed at The Reserve and had #Rafael as our concierge.
