He made our dinner reservations (and made sure my mom had a super birthday surprise in our room), checked on us every day, made sure our fridge was stocked with extra water, and always made sure we knew he was available in case we needed him.
Rafael's manager, #Fernando, was also an absolute angel!  He helped us so much with the problems we had (mentioned below).  He was so calm and explained things in such a way that I never realized I ever upset!
We at breakfast and lunch at the Malva / Lunch Box (buffet), and we sat in the back at the same table so we could have the same staff - these people are truly wonderful!  By the end of the week, we all felt like family.  They always had our juices ready for us, and always met us with a smile.  A huge shout out to #Manuel and his team: #Alberto, #Fernando, #Janeth, #Arturo, #Alex, #Raul, #Alejandro, and #Atilano.
The food at Cielo was delicious, authentic Mexican...while I'm not a fan of bone marrow, my mom found it quite delicious LOL  #Team Cielo and #Melvin were terrific!
Sal Restaurant is a steakhouse, and I cannot say enough about this place!  The steak tar tar and the picana was so darn delicious, I talked about for 2 days...
And the spa, oh my goodness!!  I got the Aromatic Balinese massage with #Anna and I wanted to smuggle her in my suitcase and take her home!  She was amazing!  As was the ginormous hot tub pool that I was in prior to my massage, outstanding!
I also can't forget #Jennifer by the pool - we reserved our cabana every day and she was a delight to see every day.  So welcoming and friendly, and always helpful with whatever we needed.

Now for the not so good - at Sal Restaurant, the Manager (I thought his name was Cory), when we asked if he could have the dj either turn off the thumping music or turn it down, he said absolutely not.  He said Melia has a contract with the dj and I was the only one to ever complain.  I advised him that it was a restaurant and not a club, and I shouldn't feel the music in my chest.  Again, he said no.  Then he said all he can do is turn the volumn down.  If you have a "didn't she ask that" face, yes, yes I did...  So, after arguing with me and turning down the volumn like I asked, he proceeded to check on every table except ours...

I also had a horrible encounter with two managers on the Paradisus side, as well as on the Receptionists.  I was trying to help a couple we met who I felt had been overcharged.  Long story short, I bought a timeshare with Melia so I know more than most about what's included, what "should" be paid for, what are the amenities, and what amenities you can get with your friends who are also staying at the hotel.
I tried discussing this with the manager (Gabriella), and she basically ignored me and what I had to say, when she did listen, she was extremely rude, called me "chiquita" to someone on the phone (I don't speak Spanish but that word I thought I understood).  I went over to reception to find out what it actually means, and the receptionist Alberto just smirked at me.  I asked him to please get Gabriella's manager and he refused.  He just kept smirking, and chuckling.
Eventually, Garbriella did get her manager (Marisol).  She was basically just as rude, and told me "chiquita" was nothing to worry about.  Gabriella was using it with her friend on the phone and not towards me.  I don't buy it...

I didn't let any of the minor bad interaction ruin our vacation - the hotel/resort is absolutely breathtaking!  The rooms, beds, pillows, so comfortable!  All the staff, every guest we met; just made our vacation that much better!

reviews.author: Amber K
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Excellent service, excellent beach service, will definitely be back. Didier and Sergio are absolutely amazing on the beach servers so kind to our son and us. Love that they were so accommodating and kind everyday. Didier definitely made us feel welcomed.

reviews.author: Kevin S
reviews.title: Carlos from Blue Agave
reviews.text: Carlos truly made our experience at both Blue Agave and Paradisus as a whole such a pleasure. He was such a kind, wonderful server and made us feel special and welcome. I will certainly be coming back and asking for him. Thanks for everything Carlos!

reviews.author: Juan F
reviews.title: Paradise in Paradisus
reviews.text: My time at Paradisus was nothing short of relaxing and fun. I stayed there with a group of friends, and we all had such a wonderul time! The property is stunning and unlike any other resort l have stayed at before, especially with the beautiful Mayan motifs throughout. The staff showed a strong commitment to providing us with the highest quality experience and service. Big shout out to our host, Frida! She kept us on schedule with friendly reminders about our planned set of activites and dinner reservations. Speaking of dinner, the food at every restaurant was very delicious and offered something for everyone. The entertainment each day was such a treat and such a great exposition of local artistic talent.

reviews.author: michael s
reviews.title: The best service at any pool bar
reviews.text: Employees at the pool bar are exceptional… They are very alert and attentive they learn your name and treat you like a special guest every day… Alex Tio yaSenia Walmart Hector LECIo Alejandro Sergio y Flor… Are the best in the biz ….. this was a last-minute reservation for us and it did not disappoint.. everything was very clean organized and I was especially impressed by how much goes on to keep this place looking correct behind the scenes ….I am going to recommend this place to my friends and family.. Around the third day my children made friends with some of the other kids and they had a blast for the rest of the vacation

reviews.author: Nakia T
reviews.title: Excellent service!!!
reviews.text: Everyone was great!! They all provided excellent service. The breakfast staff at Malva Food Bazar, Martin, Eddie, Gerardo, Alex and Diego, were so welcoming, and provided top service beyond expectations. I felt welcomed from the time I walked in the door until my last day staying with them.They are the reason we will be returning

reviews.author: kristine p
reviews.title: Best dinner for a party of 11. Thank you Rafael!!!
reviews.text: Rafael is the best server you will ever have. He is the king of servers. This whole trip was made because Rafael brought the best server game to Lemon Fish. If you go there ask for Rafael. He knows top notch service, how to make everyone join in & provide great drinks.

reviews.author: Samantha R
reviews.title: Lemon Fish Rafael is the best
reviews.text: Had dinner at lemon fish during our stay and Rafael was the best server. He attended to all of our needs and had the best energy. The food was amazing but the service was excellent. Thank you Rafael!!

reviews.author: Bernee L
reviews.title: Best dinner ever!
reviews.text: I had the most amazing meal at Cielo. Chief David Corrales prepared a delicious meal of Lamb, it was & full of flavor.  And our waiter Noe Mendez was polite, funny and so personal.  I highly recommend Cielo   Don’t miss the best dinner experience.

reviews.author: Oceansister
reviews.title: Beautiful place, amazing personnel !
reviews.text:
We usually go to Cancun for Fall Break. This year, the hotel of our choice was under construction, so we had to experiment. After some research , we picked Paradisus Cancun. Here is a very honest review. The hotel is gorgeous, the rooms are outdated, really need good maintenance. BUT...do all the other resorts in the area. They all are built 30-40 years ago, so the rooms appearance is identical across the beach (we talked to some other people , and all agree).

However, what makes Paradisus Cancun amazing, is the people that work there. I mean, customer service is on another level. We had a pleasure of working with Veronica, who was an Angel with a magic wand making all our wishes to come true :-) She made all our dinner reservations, helped with activities, simply was always available if we needed anything. Veronica genuinely cared, which was very nice and made our vacation very pleasant. Her kindness and professionalism, her lovely personality and care about us truly made our vacation special.

The restaurants and bars are pretty nice at the resort. While dinners required reservations (which were taken care of by Veronica), lunch and breakfast was "come and go" as you please. We mostly hanged out at the first floor breakfast area, and made great connections with the staff. Alberto, Janeth, Fernando, Rafael, Rest, Malva- you guys are amazingly awesome! To put up with so many guests on everyday basis, yet remain so professional, kind , wonderful and accommodating. Amazing crew at that restaurant! 

Can't help but mention a very special friend we made while at Paradisus. Her name is Daisy, she is the sweetest cat who wonders around the swimming pool (by the cabanas and ice cream stand). She is so friendly and cuddly! A very special treat to meet such a lovely cat :-) If you see her - please pet and feed her (we gave her some ham and bacon from the buffet ;-) 

Overall, we will be back because of the wonderful people that work at Paradisus and Daisy. Really hoping the management would consider to upgrade the rooms.

reviews.author: Eleanor and Aaron
reviews.title: Paradisus is the the place to stay!
reviews.text: My wife an I came here on our anniversary and our server Samuel Sosa was amazing! He somehow knew we were celebrating something special, and he guessed right (but before I go on, I have to say the variety and food were fantastic)! He surprised my wife with dessert and co-workers singing and celebrating. She had tears in her eyes and couldn’t wipe the smile off her face. Thank you also Alex Resandis and the manager Memo! You all made our dinner at Malva Buffet the most memorable on our trip! Thank you and see you again soon!

reviews.author: Jose M
reviews.title: Italian paradise
reviews.text: Jesus gave the best service. He was attentive and provided great suggestions. Jesus ensured  we never ran out of any items. He came  back within short periods and made sure our glasses were never empty

reviews.author: Jade
reviews.title: Dinner at Cielo
reviews.text: The service from Ian was amazing. He took such great care of us and was very kind. Would recommend the bone marrow and the red mole sea bass. The dessert was also great. Thank you for a great experience, Ian!

reviews.author: Ed g
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
Our wait staff at Lemon fish restaurant, Emanuel and Rafael were absolutely amazing! We celebrated our 29 year anniversary at Paradisus Resort and the treatment there is outstanding.
Thank you! Thank you!

reviews.author: laddr4
reviews.title: LEMON FISH — ask for Cesar y Manuel
reviews.text: Went to lemon fish. Definitely the way to go and prob one of the best restaurants at the Paradisus — HIGHLY RECOMMEND. Plus, Cesar is THE BEST server ever — try to request him (aka demand him) if you go! He alone is worth going there for! Also, Manuel is a great jefe and espresso martini maker 👌🏼

reviews.author: Steve R
reviews.title: Paradisus Paradise
reviews.text: This place was amazing.  From the beauty of the resort, the impeccable service, the food choices and all the little extras that go beyond what most resorts provide.  Wow.  I've stayed in plenty of 4 and 5 star resorts and this one is right up there.

reviews.author: Jessica V
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: My husband and I are guests at the Paradisus Cancun. This hotel is not only insanely beautiful but houses beautiful restaurants including the Lemon Fish. The ambiance is beautiful and also our waiter rafael was very accommodating and quick. The chef mario really outdid himself. You can tell that the manager Emanuel has really put together a great team. We will definitely eat here more often. The ceviche and the sushi were delicious! Keep it up!

reviews.author: Amy R
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text: A beautiful resort but the service is above and beyond. Definitely visit or sit with a table where Miguel and Jorge will be your servers at Lemon Fish. Their attention and recommendations are so on point. They go out of their way to make you feel special and have a wonderful experience.

reviews.author: Cole O
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text: The resort was phenomenal. Had a massage at the Yhi Spa and it was the best massages I have ever had. Anna and Frida were the best masseuses for me and my wife. The service was always great, everyone was very friendly. Wendy at the hotel bar was specifically extremely nice and professional. Overall, great experience.

reviews.author: Kenna A
reviews.title: Lemon Fish
reviews.text:
We came to paradisis Cancun for our honeymoon and had such an amazing experience. The best restaurant we went to was lemon fish, the service was exceptional
our waiter was Rafael, and he was the absolute best and gave us a little cake to celebrate our honeymoon. The chef Mario made great food that was an experience we will always remember, and the manager Emanuel was so nice. 10/10 would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Stephanie B
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text:
Antonio and Ramiro were amazing for breakfast! We asked for them every morning and received the best service. They were always so attentive, hard working and very fun. 
Gabby and Yasenia by the pool outside the lunch box were amazing as well! They always made sure we had full drinks and brought the kids (ages 2&4) fun kid friendly drinks as well. 
Aaron our concierge went above and beyond for us during our whole trip, from prebooking dinners to make sure we had a spot each evening at a restaurant to making sure our kids were having fun too with cute shirts and buckets for the beach. 
Room service did a great job everyday with cleaning our room and making sure we had everything we needed in our fridge. 
The customer service here was above and beyond!! 5 stars ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
One thing I’d offer for improvement would be more high chairs for dinner time, we had two babies with us and dinner service was difficult at times because there wasn’t enough high chairs each night. I would also add a little more kid friendly area ( maybe a splash pad or bigger kids zone).

reviews.author: ShaanS74
reviews.title: You're better off staying on the street - never again.
reviews.text:
Hands down the worst resort I have ever stayed in.  We had been working with the resort for 4 months prior to our stay, as it was a large family reunion of almost 30 people.  Thinking that we had blocked rooms and working on a group rate, we would all be together.  But nothing of the sort.  Every reservation had us scattered across 9 different floors, but if that was not bad enough, rooms for the SAME reservation made by a person were not on the same floor, let alone next to each other (I had two rooms, one on the 3rd floor, the other on the 8th).  Every single reservation made by family was like this.  It took us over 2 hours to check in for each group in the family because they were so disorganized. On top of that: NO bell service to help with luggage.  We were told that we had to take our own luggage and we were in the Reserve building of the resort, where we were supposed to have our own concierge. Speaking of the Reserve: if you come in after 6PM, the Reserve office is closed and you have to check in from Building 5, which is an open-air spot in the middle of the floor.  Made no sense to me when the Reserve is in Building 3.  And I could not understand why the Reserve office was not open 24/7, when the non-Reserve check-in area was.  Why not do check-in from there?  Made no sense at all.  

Speaking of the concierge - total nonsense.  She was completely useless.  She would not respond to messages, sometimes had a day off (and we were on the resort for a week), or wouldn't start until midday.  No back up person for us to work with.  Any dining reservations, I would have to go up and down 8 floors to sort out at the restaurant desk on the ground floor (this was EVERYDAY for every family meal).  It was ridiculous.  The pools would run out of towels on a daily basis and it was like toilet paper during the pandemic when they would bring the cart of clean ones out (and you didn't know when that was - people were hovering like vultures).  I have never had to fend for myself as much as I did on this vacation.  I would NEVER come back here and I do not recommend this place to anyone.

reviews.author: Anne N
reviews.title: Staff Steals Your Money! Don’t Book Here!!!
reviews.text: I accidentally left my wallet here in their lobby/entrance area 11/3/22 as I was exploring. I realized I left it in it there after 10 mins of leaving it behind. Security "found" it and claimed I left it on the street lol. They took $300+ USD cash from my wallet and returned the wallet back to me with out the cash. Thanks for nothing crooked Paradisus. Security and staff are crooked. To management, if your security tells you a different story, they are lying! They are thieves. From the secuirty who checks in guests at the entrance to the security on the beach side. Thanks for stealing my cash and returning my wallet! I do not recommend anyone booking here. They are untruthful crooked thieves.

reviews.author: Richard D
reviews.title: Ginger Bar-Sports Bar
reviews.text: Watched the World Series here. Excellent service from Gaby, Geovany & Melisy (Melisa). They found the network carrying it the first night and made sure it was on for the remaining games. The friendly tone they set made us go back all other times!

reviews.author: Lobat O
reviews.title: Most Fun We Have Had in Cancun!
reviews.text:
When we first arrived, we went to the main lobby but apparently, we had to go to the Registration area in Tower 1 since we were 'Members'.  So someone took us there and we got our wristbands etc. Not much info was given so we had to ask the Agent.  He was nice but should have initially covered everything with us like how to get into the room etc. How checkout works, etc.  Our room was nice and clean however, there wasn't a coffee maker in the room which would have made it a lot easier on room service and us.  The AC didn't reach the bedroom well so that could be improved.  Room service was ok.  We ordered Continental the first day and it came before the time they said, was good.  Next day we got eggs etc., and it was all cold. So we just got coffee the other days.  Thankfully the Nespresso bar was great with all great staff.  Then from Monday--Saturday, there were men working in the room next door from 9 am on, so that was not great as they were loud banging around.  The daily maid service and fridge fill up was great although one day our fridge was not filled.  We were in contact with our Concierge Margarite throughout our stay as needed.  She made all of our dinner reservations and answered our questions.   All the restaurants are nice and clean.  We enjoyed the Buffet and Celio the best as the menu had more items that we preferred.  The daily pool activities and nightly Circle bar activities were fun!  Especially the steps to learn how to dance salsa etc. by the pool.  The swim up bar was great and Juan was THE BEST.  All the bartenders, staff, everywhere were very nice and helpful - except for the main lobby when we went to exchange money - we went 3 times and all unsuccessful as they didn't either have it or they told us they needed our passport.  When we went back with our passport, they said they didn't have any!!  That was only an hour before - so that was frustrating plus we didn't find the staff in the main lobby registration area as helpful/accomodating.  The bell boys were great also. Hemik I think was the name of the fella we had when we checked out. Very nice and helpful!  We loved the Ginger Bar & had so much fun there dancing, listening to music, relaxing, playing pool and foosball.  The bartenders with their unique drinks, Geovany, & Cassiel with his famous creation of Tequila, Hibiscus and Orange, was my favorite drink at Paradisus.  The waitresses, especially GABY was awesome, so was Melisa.  Very friendly, great service, and always remembered us when we went in.  The service was spot-in & they all made us feel like family! Love Love! Last but not least, it was very thoughtful & appreciated to receive a follow up call from the Management team when there was a little incident in the ocean due to a  RipTide and the lifeguard came to get me, and then another couple after me.  Very much appreciated!  Overall it was a great trip and we enjoyed ourselves very much!  
 Would definitely like to return!

reviews.author: Maria K
reviews.title: We love Carina at Kanna Bar
reviews.text: Great vacation, Awesome service, Excellent employees in the Lunch Box Restaurant, 24 Hr Espresso Bar, Luz’s service at the beach, fabulous destination for all 12 of us.  Besides all these the highlight of our trip was Kanna Beach Club where we went every night before dinner, get served by Carina bar tender different drinks one better than the other one.  Carina was very sweet, nice and knows her drinks and how to create a great atmosphere for the guests.

reviews.author: Kaveh P
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun vacation
reviews.text: One of our best trips to Cancun. Everything was great, specially the KIDSDOM. Very friendly and caring staff. Thank you Gustavo, Itzel, Ivon, Maribel, Rubi, Keren and Brenda. You guys are the best. We will definitely come back to Paradisus again and we will recommend kidsdom to everyone.  Our kids didn't want to leave at the end of any night because of how much fun they were having.

reviews.author: maria_wheatley4
reviews.title: Ginger Bar
reviews.text: Ginger Bar was our favorite place at the resort! Gaby, Melissa, Pedro & Cassiel we’re attentive, welcoming & ensured we were having a great time! Thanks, friends for taking such great care of us…. We raise a Sol & Tecate Light to you all! 🍻🍻🍻🍻🍻

reviews.author: Alpaslan T
reviews.title: “Lemon Fish” once in a life time experience…
reviews.text: Best Japanese restaurant  in Cancun. Great atmosphere,  perfect service, tasty food and great experience. Special thanks to Emanuel and Jorge who made our night.  And a very special thanks to Dennise who has been our guardian angel and became a close friend. Really happy to be a part of this experience.

reviews.author: Ylianna G
reviews.title: Cielo restaurant was amazing!!
reviews.text:
The food at Cielo was to dieeee for! 
We got a little bit of everything and tried the different plates amongst my family and we kept asking for more! Ismael and Ian were such amazing waiters and treated us with so much care and kindness. This experience will truly be one of the things we remember from our trip! A must try!

reviews.author: GoPlaces714537
reviews.title: Argenis and his team.
reviews.text: The bartenders at the downstairs main bar, I believe it was called Ginger, were awesome!  I especially liked Argenis.  He went above and beyond for me, finding a special drink.  I told him the kind of drink that I like and he went to get Splenda and mixed my drink with raspberry and even put it in a cool-looking cocktail glass for me!  He just made the even more fun than it was!

reviews.author: eveangel883
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Our stay at the hotel was great! The service was exceptional especially Martin and his team including Eddie, Gerardo and Pascoal at the buffet area. Our room service was great too. We attended a wedding here and it turned out prefect. The only thing we did not like was within the hotel there was very little AC. It felt so humid after walking out of our rooms. Other than that the service and beach area was exceptional!

reviews.author: Tina W
reviews.title: I didn't want to leave.  So much fun.
reviews.text:
My sister and I have been to Paradisus Cancun a few times now and i have to say the changes they have made have made the stay better.  

I want to shout out Alejandro Camelo at Lemon Fish.  He was an amazing waiter and knowledgeable on the menu.    

Luis at Ginger Bar is the sweetest guy and great waiter.  

Last but not least the waiters and waitress at Sante and Bali beds are always amazing.  Miguel even remembered my sister and I from previous trips.  It feels like coming home when going there.

reviews.author: Kedra W
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort...Excellent Service
reviews.text:
We decided to come to Cancun for a long weekend. I've stayed at the sister property in the Dominican Republic and it was really nice so decided to give the resort in Cancun a chance. The moment we walked in the resort we knew it was going to be a great stay.

We were greeted at the door and taken to a separate check-in for the Reserve area.  After checking in our concierge Levi took us to our room and gave us a tour of the resort. Levi was so kind, attentive and helpful with our requests. He was able to make our dinner reservations as well as reserving a cabana for us and answering any questions we had. He even contacted us on his day off to make sure we were ok. Excellent service from Levi!

We ate breakfast every morning at Malva and dinner at Capella and Sal. The food and staff at all three were excellent! As well as the food in the pool area. 

We also did the Escape Room at the resort...we escaped just as time ran out. So much fun!

Overall we enjoyed our stay here. All the staff we encountered were very friendly. We will be back for a longer stay in the future.

reviews.author: Mike P
reviews.title: Dinner at Capella - Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Food was phenomenal. We got a variety of appetizers, dishes and desserts and each was delicious. My kids loved all of it, which is a hard task! Our waiter Cumplido was not only a very hard worker, but he was kind and caring. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: likesvacations412
reviews.title: A great vacation!!
reviews.text: We just spent 8 days there and had a great time! As Club Melia owners, we have been here many times and are never disappointed. Alfredo and Eddie at Malva were awesome servers!  Also a shout out to Jose our Concierge and Luz, our server on the beach.  We loved Lemon Fish and Agua Marina, great food and service.

reviews.author: Passport67913335627
reviews.title: The man behind the Cananas Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
I want to recognize Luis who is in charge of renting the Palapa Cabanas .  He was always ready to set up one’s cabana with fresh towels and provide very good information about the hotel and Cancun.  He is very well educated and a very hard worker.  He loves his job and is a great ambassador of the Paradisus Cancun.  He is fun to converse with and such a nice person. 
The employees at the Paradisus get only one day off per week and work a 10–12 hour day.  Their HR dept has the back of hiring people that truly should be in the service industry.  All impart a desire to work hard and represent the property well.

reviews.author: Hjremlinger
reviews.title: Awesome dinner experience at Cielo in the Paradisus Cancun Resort.
reviews.text: We have been coming to Parradisus Cancun for over 11 years, and look forward to our next return.  Today we had a remarkable experience at the restaurant Cielo.  Our host Karen Ruiz was extremely friendly while our waiter Jose Acuenteco, who spoke perfect English went over and above to take care of us.  With gluten issues in our family the chef David Corrales prepared a perfect gluten-free meal which my wife could enjoy.  Thank you to all of you for making this an exceptional experience.

reviews.author: Alex C
reviews.title: Team pool is excellent
reviews.text: The team at the pool bar was excellent. Victor, Balta, Didiel, Sergio, Qilando, Leo, and Euaristo (Team Pool), greeted us everyday at the resort and made us feel welcomed. They were constantly on the move taking care of us and all of the other guests around the pool area. Our experience at this resort was extra special because of their hospitality.

reviews.author: Samantha M
reviews.title: Pool bar
reviews.text: We were so lucky to have come across Victor and his pool bar team our first day on the trip. Every day they would greet us and make sure we were taken care of with delicious vacation cocktails or snacks. They made our trip extra special! If you plan to visit the Paradisus, make sure to stop by the pool bar! Thank you again to the amazing pool bar crew (Victor,  Balta, Didiel, Sergio, Orlando, Leo, Evaristo)

reviews.author: Cole B
reviews.title: Excellent resort!!!!
reviews.text:
*written by girlfriend* 

We are finishing up our trip at Paradisus Cancun but wanted to take a moment to thank the incredible staff here. 

We had the reserve package and had the pleasure of working with Diego. He was very attentive and answered all of our questions quickly. He helped us schedule dinners at times that worked for us, and provided a special birthday gift for my boyfriend which was balloons and cake for our room. Thank you Diego!! 

The main restaurants we went to on the resort were Malva (buffet for breakfast), Sante for lunch and Lemon Fish for dinner. 

Malva has options for everyone. Omelette stations, American style breakfast, fresh fruit, lots of
Pastries, yogurt parfaits, fresh juices and delicious cocktails. At the end of the day, it’s a buffet folks. The quality of food was always great and the variety kept it interesting for us everyday. 

At the Malva restaurant I’d like to thank the team of Atilono, Arturo, Ricardo and Martin - they were great!! We would specifically make a point of sitting in their section every morning. 

At Sante, we loved Cesar!! He was our waiter a few times and he was extremely attentive. He is also the guy who was able to get us the best spicy ceasars (Canadians who can’t stand bloody Mary’s here)

At Lemon Fish, I would sincerely like to thank Alejandro Camelo. He provided lots of suggestions for food (boyfriend is a picky eater) and made sure everything was safe for me considering I have a severe cilantro allergy. One shrimp appetizer I thought sounded amazing but the sauce had cilantro in it. So Alejandro worked with the kitchen staff to create a beautiful passion fruit sauce instead so I could still enjoy my food. It was amazing!!!

Lastly, I’d like to thank my boyfriend’s buddy here Jose! He was our favourite bartender and we made a point of always finding him to chat and get our drinks from him. I apologize I do not have Jose’s last name but on Monday Oct 31 he was working at Kanna bar, Nov 2 he was working the reserve bar and today he’s at Malva!! 

Thank you staff here. Overall, the beach is beautiful, you have lots of options of things to do here and the team is great. 

P.s if you’re adults I would 100% recommend upgrading to the reserve package if you’re able to!!!

reviews.author: daniel m
reviews.title: Restaurant Malua at paradisus had incredible service staff
reviews.text: Atilano, Arturo, and Aldaltir at the restaurant Malua were three incredible servers. They were very attentive quickly noticed when our drinks were running low and refilled. They always made sure they were easily accessible in case we needed anything. I really recommend this restaurant because of the amazing servers and the good was good too:)

reviews.author: Amy
reviews.title: The most incredible trip!
reviews.text:
I can't even begin to describe how amazing this resort was. I have been to Cancun multiple times and have stayed at various resorts and nothing compares to staying here at Paradisus. My husband and I came here for our honeymoon and were blown away by the beauty, the food and especially the service. From the moment we entered the resort we were immediately relaxed. I have never seen a resort like this, the interior is just so stunning. Booking with The Reserve upgrade was worth every extra penny. From the separate check-in to our own concierge, the separate pool and our own lobby with bar.... all exquisite. 

Our room was absolutely gorgeous, spacious, and always perfectly clean. Freddy was assigned as our concierge, and he was so accommodating & kind - we wanted to make last minute dinner reservation switches and he made it happen for us. Not having to worry about reservations and bookings yourself was an absolute dream & Freddy made it so wonderful.  Nicole & Jennifer at the pool were always so sweet and welcoming, such a great way to start the morning getting a poolside cabana! Speaking of cabanas - the servers at the cabanas and restaurant in The Reserve section were all INCREDIBLE! We had Valeria, Julio, Joel, Ruben, & Miguel throughout our week and they made us feel like VIP every single day. All so personable, so attentive, so kind, never left us waiting or wanting for anything. Even if we didn't have them as a server that day, they would all come say hello and chitchat with us - like we were lifelong friends. We originally had thought it was odd that there was no swim up bar in the adults only pool, but with the exceptional service you receive you don't even miss it or think about it. 

Our lobby bartender Cesar was the best, mixing up tasty cocktails for us any time we passed by and always with a smile and good conversation. We ended every night with him before going up to our room... and sometimes even coming back down in PJs for one more night cap! I had a massage in the YHI Spa and it is an absolute MUST! Isabella gave me such a wonderful massage after spending over an hour in the spa amenities. And I have to mention David who circulated the pool areas offering information about the spa - I already had an appointment booked but every day he would still make a point to stop by and chat with us for a while! I'm telling you... the service is like no other, you feel like family here. 

Now the food.... Wow. Wow, wow, wow. I've stayed at larger resorts where you lose out on the quality of food because they are cooking for the masses and that could not be farther from the truth here. Every dish was so fresh, so flavorful, and perfect portions. And what a variety of restaurants! We hit them all except for the Italian restaurant (which we will absolutely get to next time). It's been two weeks and we are still talking about and raving about our different meals, they were that memorable. Make a point to go to Blue Agave for tacos, they are of course delicious & Roberto took such excellent care of us. Lemon Fish was such a different & beautiful dining experience, and our server Cesar made it feel so personalized. My husband doesn't love sushi and Cesar made excellent recommendations for him to still leave with a happy, full belly. We also went to the Sal steak house; I will say it was very good but will probably pass next time we go. Nothing was wrong with it; we just know we can get that at home, and we'd rather have more food that is unique to the trip. Although, the wine there was not included even with The Reserve upgrade. 

The quality of the entire experience cannot be beat. We are already planning for our next trip there and are hoping to bring friends next time. If you are looking for any type of trip to Cancun this is where you want to stay! And please be sure to tip these very wonderful, very hard-working staff - they deserve it!

reviews.author: Alvaro G
reviews.title: Amazing hotel in a superb location with super friendly staff
reviews.text:
Everything is perfect in the whole resort. Staff are very friendly and really committed to their tasks. The building is amazing from the architectural point of view and the interior design is gorgeous with most of spaces up to date. 
Ruth Avila as a personal concierge at The Reserve is the best, super friendly, attentive and efficient. The girls at the pool also super nice; Nicole and Jennifer. 
A point to improve: more healthy options for food (grilled fish and meat) should be available at the buffet and in "a la carte" restaurants.

reviews.author: Porshia L
reviews.title: What An Amazing Experience
reviews.text: The Sal Restaurant experience was nothing short of AMAZING. We really hope Leo serves you, knowledgeable,  kind and very attentive.  Thanks Katia for being so warm and accommodating.  Tasty food, wonderful staff and great atmosphere! Sal @ Paradisus Cancun

reviews.author: Britney C
reviews.title: Service at ParaDisus Cancun
reviews.text: Amazing staff, the whole time three gentlemen by the name of Gaudenaio, Joni and Manuel merged our every food and beverage needs. There was never a time my glass was empty. Treated us with respect and kept checking in on us.

reviews.author: ayumiyam1
reviews.title: Great place, great people
reviews.text: This hotel is beautiful and huge! All inclusive is the way to go with a big group. I happened to meet my high school friends after 26 years! We wanted to eat, drink, relax and of course catch up. The site facilities were clean and well kept. I enjoyed the pool, the cabanas by the pool and the beach. They have a variety of delicious restaurants, my favorite would be Capella, Italian food, it was sooo good! The staff were very accommodating, respectful and helpful. A big thank you to Djordje, our concierge, we were very happy with his service. Also, I would like to mention the staff at Sante, specially Moises and Miguel who treated us excellent! Overall, I had a good experience at this hotel and I totally recommend it!

reviews.author: Ruaa A
reviews.title: Celebrate son birthday
reviews.text: Great  hotel and the staff so nice and friendly. We came to celebrate my son 10 birthday, first time in Cancun. Definitely I will be back. Juan who works at the beach very nice and great photographer. .

reviews.author: Francisco Brito
reviews.title: Paradisus is a nice property but avoid Sal Steakhouse.
reviews.text:
I am writing this review on my last night at Paradisus because I am fuming mad at my experience at Sal’s steakhouse.  

To give a little context I have been visiting paradisus  for many years and while the rooms are a bit dated everything around the property is well-maintained. One of my biggest disappointments is the poor quality of the food. Outside of breakfast all of the specialty restaurants we’re not very good.  I stayed on the Reserve side and the lunch at Sante was decent.  We would try to fill up during the day at Sante because the specialty restaurants for dinner we’re both difficult to reserve and the food quality was poor.  

One night we were hungry after an excursion and wanted a good meal. I decided to Spring for dinner at Sal.  We had a couple steaks & a couple drinks and my bill came out to $260 US.  I don’t spend that kind of money for the real deal at Fogo de Chão or Del Frisco’s.  But I was tipsy and feeling good and blew it off.

Fast forward to tonight my final night in Cancun, we’re sitting at Cipolla Italian restaurant and the food was just terrible my wife didn’t even eat anything. It was our last night and I wanted to end things on a good note so I bit the bullet and visited Sal but this time sober I paid close attention to my bill. My wife and I ordered the Australian ribeye which was $960 Pesos each. No appetizers or cocktails and was handed a bill for 200 bucks that did not match up with the price they had on the menus. When I disputed the bill they explained that what I ordered from the menu was not available so they gave me a different cut of Australian ribeye that was a double the price. I explained that was some thing that should’ve been stated when I first placed the order.  I feel like I got ripped off and it made me question why my bill was so high a couple nights before.  It really left a bad taste in my mouth and that’s unfortunate because the service was one of the shining points everyone works so hard to provide fantastic service and the dishonesty at Sal Is what I will remember most.

To add insult to injury while I’m sitting there enjoying my over priced steak a big roach just strolls through the dining area. I brought it to the managers attention and at first he seemed annoyed but later came back and profusely apologized (picture of roach attached).

I actually remember when Paradisus  had a really good Brazilian style steakhouse included with the all-inclusive package. I understand that Covid has affected businesses in  all sorts of ways but the food has really fallen off.  Im really kicking myself For being lazy because there is a Portofirios and Rosa Negra Right down the street with beautiful patio sunset views and ambience for less than what I paid at Sal. 

One last thing that disappointing me was the fact that I never saw my concierge for my entire stay.  That was one of the reasons I upgraded to reserve in the first place.  It was a pain in the butt to reserve dinner every night everything was booked and just getting information about Covid testing etc. that was supposed to be provided by your concierge we just had to figure it out on our own.  What was the point of offering a service that you don’t actually have in place?

Despite those two unfortunate experiences it truly is a beautiful place and the staff was very gracious.
Moral of the story stay clear of Sal steakhouse and don’t expect to see a concierge anytime soon and you’ll have a fantastic time.

Francisco

reviews.author: Anthony S
reviews.title: Our stay at the Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We had an amazing stay at the Paradisus Cancun. Everything was so clean and they really went above and beyond to make us feel safe. We spent most of our time by the pool in chairs overlooking the beach. The Paradisus does have an amazing pool server . Her name is Asuncion. She really went above and beyond to made sure we felt so spoiled and special. She always anticipated our needs and was always nearby whenever we needed something and she was always so friendly. I would recommend staying at the Paradisus based on her service alone.

reviews.author: Rojas
reviews.title: Relaxing Vacation
reviews.text: We enjoyed our vacation at Paradisus- Cancun, beautiful sunset views with a great ocean & pool view from our room tower 2, it was a challenge to find our room since all 5 towers look the same.🥰 The pool was a great size and good service.  The waiters & bartenders made a huge difference, it was a 5 ⭐️service to us they were Alfredo Alvaro, Alexis Osuna, Martin Arzeta. Our concierge Jose & Alexandra were very helpful and took care of our dinner reservations & got in thankfully. Italian restaurant Capella & the buffet at Malva were the best! Daily Activities and tours were fun! 🥰

reviews.author: Joe M
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation!
reviews.text:
Stayed at the Paradisus Nov 14-22nd and had a great time! We booked 3 rooms in the "Reserve" section (pyramid 5). I would absolutely reccomend this section. It is the "adults only" section. We had 3 children with us, which is fine for them to stay there, they just can't go in the adults only pool or eat at the adults only restaurant by the pool. This was totally fine as there is a pool right next to it that kids are allowed, so we split time between the 2. The "Reserve" section also comes with a "butler" to help with reservations and daily activities which comes in handy.  If I had to be more specific I would probably give the resort  4.8 stars. Definitely closer to 5 stars then 4. First I'll start off with the reasons I would give 4.8 and not 5.

-The entire middle section of the main building (3) is under construction. I stayed here back in 2019 and they had a great restaurant in the middle here and this time it wasn't available. Totally understand a resorts need to update things so definitely not upset about it, just would've been nice. They have pictures of what it is going to look like and it looks awesome.

-Two times we went to dinner with a reservation from our "butler" and they didn't have our reservation. Which after a brief wait and talking to Alex (from guest services) it was taken care of. Again, nothing to get super upset about as these things happen.

Now onto what makes this a great resort!

-First and foremost I have to start with the people and service. They could not be nicer and more willing to go above and beyond to make sure your stay is amazing. I have to go through a list of people to not only show our appreciation but so visitors can look for them when they go. 

Lucas and Max- These are your guys for cabanas and chairs by the reserve pool. Both of them were amazing in helping get us set up each day. 2 super nice guys!

The servers and bartenders at Sante' (bar/restaurant by reserve pool) - I have to name all the ones we had since we had many different ones over 8 days. Ruben, Valeria, Luis, Javier, Joel, Oscar, Cesar and Juanito. A little extra special shout out to Moses. He was so funny and the level of energy and care for his job is next level. We were there for my Mom's bday and even when he wasn't our server he always checked in on us to make sure Mom was ok and enjoying herself. Great guy!

Alex (Check-in /Guest Services)- Another amazing guy! When we had an issue with our reservation, Alex was there to fix it. When my sister wanted to move her room to a higher floor, Alex was there to make it happen. He went out of his way to make this vacation great for us. So thank you Alex, from my whole family.

There were many other workers who's names I do not remember but just know, every restaurant or bar we went to the service was great and they were all extremely friendly.

-The resort itself is beautiful. Yeah they could use a little updating, which by the looks of things they are doing. The inside is very clean and has real flowers, trees and waterfalls all over. The pools are all nice and plenty big. The beach and ocean right there was great. Clean, water was warm, and barely any seaweed. Our rooms were all nice. I saw some complaints about A/C but none of our rooms had any problems with ours. We all had ocean view rooms in pyramid 5. Great views and this building has a little bar/snacks area on 1st floor of building. Great for in-between meals or a drink before heading out.

-Covid test was simple. Just make sure you get it set up day or day after you get there as appointments fill up fast. Once set up they email you day and time of your test. We waited maybe 5-10 mins when we showed up for the test. Quick and easy and results were emailed to us within an hour or 2. Make sure you go to guest services to have them printed out as they don't have a business center.

Now the last thing I will say. We were there for 8 days and I can count on maybe 2 fingers the times I saw any guests tip the employees. I understand this is an all-inclusive but c'mon people. Those tips can go a long way for a lot of these workers. There wasn't a person that helped us that we didn't tip, including the housekeepers. Bring down lots of singles and fives and take care of the people taking care of you. That is all!

reviews.author: joaniezn
reviews.title: Not worth it
reviews.text: Too much loud noise at night. Construction in main building creating a lot of dust. Not recommend for family trip. Checkin process is super slow. Restaurant reserve rations not easy to book. Slow service at restaurants.

reviews.author: Marissa C
reviews.title: Amazing stay !!
reviews.text: Just came back from the most wonderful trip ever. We were a huge girls group so  we knew it was going to be kind of tricky. But all the staff  did everything to make us have a great time. We had the best trip ever. Our concierges Violeta and Aaron, were all the time available to our needs. If you plan to go it´s worth every penny to pay a little more and have thee Reserve Service. Since the check in they mede us feel special. The room had an amazing view. Good and free internet quality for the ones who have keep up with work.  The food was really good! And the attention unbeatable. My favorite was Sante, next to the pool were we enjoyed lovely breakfasts with a sea view at the Terrace. Diego, the manager was so kind, and his staff was very professional and made us had a great time. María, Ruben, Miguel, Yamil, César, Eligio, Oscar, Jonny, Josué, Julio, Valeria, Luis, Moisés, Javier and Joel fulfilled all our expectations and more.  The pool concierges Lucas and Maximiliano got us Bali Beds and the the best service with fresh towels, snacks and drinks. We spent some days at the Kana Club, a private beach in the hotel were spoiled by Rene and his staff, Manuel, Juan Balta and Luis were awesome. We had champagne at the Bali Beds and lobster by the sea. Totally worth it!   Definitely I'm coming back soon! Thank you for

reviews.author: melanienweaver88
reviews.title: Family vaca
reviews.text: Needs more food variety. When you get there make your dinner reservation.  Dont eat at sal.  Super expensive for what its is.  Go across the street to rosa negra. Way cheaper and more variety and great atmosphere.

reviews.author: Maripi74
reviews.title: Amazing  25 years school reunion!!
reviews.text:
We just finished a stay with my school friends after a 25 year reunion. We enjoyed the drinks and nibbles in this area specially the chocolate covered strawberries. Cynthia Blanco was the groups manager and she was helpful making sure it was all in place and checking on us a few times during our stay. She was very easy to contact and her speedy responses to all my questions make this stay smoothly and enjoyable. Aaron and Violeta was our concierge, they contact us throughout or stay making sure our bookings were dealt with . They helped us when needed and checked on us every day to ask if we needed anything. We also enjoyed a few days in Kanna Beach club. Rene was so helpful organising this for us- he was kind and attentive and always made us feel special even though he was mega busy with a full club on that day. His staff, Manuel, Juan, Balta, Luis are some of the most fun and enjoyable workers I have met. The food made by the chef in Kanna beach club was exceptional specially tacos of cochinita Pibil!!!. Thank you guys!. . Diego in Sante! He was just amazing, he made sure we had the best attention, and tables ready not matter how may or what time for our massive group. He was so accommodating, friendly and professional. He speaks highly of his staff Maria (Hostess) , Ruben
,, Valeria, Luis, Moises, Javier, Joel, Miguel, Alex (chef),Cesar, Eligio, Jhonny,Josue,Julio, Yamil & Oscar ( spoiled us so much), Maxilmiliano and Lucas you got us the best Bali bed and such a pleasure to meet you! Diego you rock!! And every meal in Sante was special! Thank you all so
Much!

reviews.author: Ana Beatriz B. Fernandes
reviews.title: AMAZING!!!!! You should visit this place!!!!!
reviews.text:
AMAZING PLACE AND FRIENDLY STAFF!!!!
We came to spend the day and it was perfect, we felt so welcome from the first minute till when we left. Juan and Victor are so kind, i am glad that we had the opportunity to meet them !!! The food was amazing and the drinks was so different and good! 
We will came back for sure and hope to see everybody again!!! 
Grade: A+++++++
Best regards from Brazil!!!!  🇧🇷

reviews.author: CNC1980
reviews.title: HUGE Beautiful RESORT on the best beach of hotel zone!
reviews.text:
This is my fifth time to Cancun Mexico but first time to Paradisus Cancun (Nov 12-17, 2021) and it was a HUGE Beautiful RESORT on the best beach area of the hotel zone!  (This beach has waves; which I boogie boarded). 

What we loved was......the food, ocean views, large pools, staff, big balcony
and layout of resort. What we wished they had.....more bathrooms outside, more dancing shows, better way to reserve restaurants and map of resort.

I had a ocean view balcony in pyramid 3...room 3562. Great A/C, HUGE marble floor balcony and very clean.  Inside Pyramid 3, they are finishing up construction on a restaurant area in the center of pyramid but I already knew that so it didn't bother me. It will be stunning when that area is completed. 

We loved eating at Malva buffet; always something different and delicious. Ate at pool area hamburger, chips salsa guacamole; all so good!  Then ate at another Mexican food but don't remember it's name Rio or Agave; either way best margaritas there.

Shows were on the 1st floor at Ginger Bar, neat setup but kinda small performing area but felt personal and I liked that.  They even had silks lesson and pole fitness class on particular days. Got to try the Coco ice cream (Coconut) so good; ate it everyday.

The resort is large which I like, which never felt like I saw many people even in the dining areas.   Large huge pools. Now I went in Nov so it was a bit stormy here and there and most of the pools a bit chilly but the adult pool was somewhat heated and felt great!

The beach is amazing but alot of the beaches in hotel zone have eroded so there is less space of beach but Paradisus still has great beach space unlike some neighboring resorts.  

I didn't do THE RESERVE but could see that they had very nice areas, another pool and maybe even better food/drinks. Would do THE RESERVE next time as it would be a nice addition but I was perfectly fine without it too. 

The staff is very professional and friendly and I appreciate their hard work.All in all, Its a beautiful big resort and I would return! A+++++

reviews.author: WoJo
reviews.title: Overall a good experience
reviews.text: I stayed at Paradisus 8 years ago. I thought the hotel was nice it lacked maintenance. I enjoyed my stay at that time; there were numerous options for food and beverage and I enjoyed Royal Service option. This time Royal service was not available and they on the offer Reserve - it seems like options are fewer and the rooms, even though renovated, don't feel and pristine condition to justify $360 a night. The staff was extremely helpful and pleasant.

reviews.author: lawrence g
reviews.title: Fake Booze Rip Off
reviews.text: Fake booze. If you have no interest in drinking, this is your place. If you intend to drink anything….don’t come here. None of the alcohol is real….with the exception of beer. The fact that they think nobody can tell the alcohol is flavored color water is insulting…

reviews.author: jkakumanu
reviews.title: Anniversary trip to Cancun
reviews.text:
Family vacation to Cancun. Perfect weather and nice stay at Paradisus made trip memorable.
 
After heard reviews from my colleague we chose to stay at Paradisus Cancun. 

Not a good experience is transportation from Airport. We reached Cancun at 4:30 PM due to immigration delay transportation company Otium left without communication. After multiple call got the transportation at 9:30 PM.

reviews.author: antoniopadilla85
reviews.title: Paradisus Experience
reviews.text: Chef David from Cielo Restaurant gave us an exceptional experience. He was attentive, thoughtful and very considerate of our experience. Compliments to him and his entire staff!! I would recommend his service to anyone that travels to Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: F. Smith
reviews.title: Excellent Place
reviews.text:
My husband and I went for our 3rd anniversary and were completely blown aaway from the service we received.

We booked the Reserve Package which came with all the top tier services along with a photo shoot. From our personal conceirge to our ocean front room, we were beyonf pleased.

Also, because of our celebration, I decided to suprise him with a balloon filled room with a love theme along with a beach front dinner on our last night. Therefore, I reached out to gwendolyn at Premium Moments (located within the resort) and she went above and wayyyy beyond my expectations. She worked with me the whole way throught and gave nothng but a superior level of customer service. She and her staff FULLY decorated our room and surprised him;which isn't easy to do. They then had us set up for a beach front dinner but because the rain decided to show up they moved it inside to the Oriental Garden. This place was even better than I thought. It had a secluded location filled with romantic lighting, water flowing behind us, soft jazz playing on the speaker and a personal waiter(Josua?) who took excellent care  of our needs for the dinner. After dinner was over, he boxed up our food that we didn't finish and  brought it to our room along with a bottle of Moet.  

I STRONGLY recommend the team at Pardisus and Premium Moments. They are absolute ROCK STARS!!!

THANK YOU SO MUCH Gwendolyn, Juan, Josa and all the wonderful staff at Paradisus. You defintely created a life long memory for us.

reviews.author: Ihar Simanovich
reviews.title: Great times celebrating 10yr wedding anniversary
reviews.text: Booked all inclusive Reserve and it didn’t disappoint. Let me  start by saying that we booked this trip with our anniversary falling down on the first day of the trip. Maximiliano at the Reserve pool made sure that we have gazebos reserved for the right days for the best experience as well as he was making sure that we were set on the waitlists for the days we didn’t have reservations. Top notch service from Max elevated our experience at Paradisus Cancun. Also, it happened that I was short on time to come up with something special for our anniversary and Sol steakhouse was already booked, since we just arrived and our butler Juan didn’t have time to get us reservation. I was trying to get flower petals in room decoration at least, but it was not possible due to Covid restrictions in place. So, Juan got me in touch with Guendolin from premium moments and oh boy it didn’t disappoint. Guendolin was able to put everything together in the matter of few hours, she made sure chef agreed to prepare dinner and also her suggestions on timing and options were absolutely spot on. My wife was caught by surprise and she totally loved everything. It was definitely a premium moment and will recommend to anyone for an experience to remember for the rest of the lives. One more thing, Guendolin followed with us to make sure everything went well and not only that, she brought up Yhi spa’s special for blackfriday which had a good deal on the couple’s massage. Overall, our experiences at Paradisus exceeded our expectations and definitely appreciate people who made it extra special.

reviews.author: Jody TD
reviews.title: Our Wedding in Paradise
reviews.text: We were supposed to have our wedding in November 2020, but of course that had to be postponed until early Nov 2021. Everyone at the resort was extremely understanding and accommodating throughout our entire wedding planning and trip. All of the staff are very friendly and attentive. Our wedding coordinator after the wedding was postponed was Ana, and she was friendly, accommodating, and went out of her way to make sure we were happy. Sometimes we didn’t get an email response for awhile, but a few weeks out from our wedding she was much more responsive through text. We had 65 guests and Ana made sure that our ceremony and cocktail hour was perfect. Unfortunately, it started raining right before our outdoor reception, but she quickly arranged to move our reception into the ballroom. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and were very happy on our wedding day and throughout the trip! The resort is absolutely beautiful.

reviews.author: rachelels2n
reviews.title: Family vacation 2021
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Mexico and Paradisus Cancun didn’t disappoint. From the time we walked through the front doors  to the time we left, everyone went out of their way to make sure we had an incredible stay . We stayed in the Reserve and are so happy we did as it totally elevated our overall experience. Ruth, our concierge, was so kind and accommodating. She took care of all of our reservations and checked in every day to make sure we had everything we needed. Max and Lucas at the Reserve pool were amazing and had our cabanas waiting for us every morning and even brought us warm towels when stormy weather set in. Ruben, Ceasar, Oscar, you all took such good care of us. A special thank you to Moises who repeatedly went above and beyond to make us feel right at home. He has such an amazing spirit and his kindness won’t be forgotten. The resort is stunning, but it is the staff that truly makes this place exceptional. Thank you to everyone who made our vacation so memorable. We absolutely can’t wait for our next visit!

reviews.author: owainhoefle
reviews.title: Paradisus was amazing
reviews.text: The hotel Was great! The pool was great and Juan was incredibly helpful at the Kanna Beach Club. The food at the restaurants were all great. I was surprised how good the food  was. The beach was really beautiful! We’re coming back

reviews.author: Jon R
reviews.title: A Cancun must stay
reviews.text:
I’ve  been a customer of this hotel chain over 8 years. I enjoy Paradisus Cancun very much. Importantly they continue to make improvements to this large resort. If your an adult, I highly recommend you stay on the Reserve side of the resort ( Formally known as Royal Service) 
Private pool and luxury benefits for reserve guests are nice touches . The staff is attentive to your needs. 

        The Reserve pool side staff and servers were all outstanding and worked extremely hard. I’d like to especially recognize Ruth our concierge who Provided  outstanding service for a stay at Paradisus Cancun. She made my family feel like royalty. I hope to see this level of service continue.

       Now with that said this resort is not five stars but, they continue to improve with each visit. Also a storm came in last month and washed away the exclusive reserve side beachfront. hopefully that will be restored on my next visit. Beach front is still available but it’s on the main portion of the resort. Bottom line,  it’s a good resort and you should give it a try.

reviews.author: Marc M
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
This was our fourth time staying in Cancún but the first time at this hotel and it was by far our best experience. The hotel is extremely clean, the food in every restaurant is delicious and the staff is exceptionally friendly. A special thank you to Florinda who was part of the room cleaning team, Luis at the coffee bar and Antonio at the Malva restaurant for their exceptional kind service. 

There is some construction at the main centre building during the day, they do not start to early or work too late but during the day the noise can be heard from the rooms. No noise is heard however from the pool or the beach. 

They also have a very nice and clean beach and pool area. 

We definitely would recommend this hotel !!

Thank you

reviews.author: sergioojeda01
reviews.title: HORRENDOUS EXPERIENCE!
reviews.text: Receptionist experience was AWFUL not accommodating AT ALL, out of all the restaurants the only decent one was Enso, rooms are outdated our room got flooded because of the rain, no compensation for the flooding which caused us to move rooms and took time away from our vacation causing to repack everything in new outdated room and unpack again!! The buffet is not good and the staff aren’t friendly at the buffet. Do yourself a favor and stay at Iberostar Cancun way better resort and better quality! OCEAN FRONT VIEW ARE COVERED BY PLANTS SO IN ORDER TO ENJOY THE OCEAN YOU MUST STAND IN YOUR BALCONY!!!

reviews.author: sydney
reviews.title: Excellent customer service
reviews.text: Everyone at the resort is so helpful! We were having an IMPOSSIBLE time getting dinner reservations, Wenn from the front (service desk I believe) came to our rescue!! We almost were not going to be able to make reservations anywhere because we couldn’t get through. All waiters & waitress from Ginger Bar were fabulous!

reviews.author: Christine H
reviews.title: Blown Away! Will Be Back!
reviews.text:
My husband, daughter and I traveled to the Paradisus Cancun for one week and had an amazing time. Everything was exceptional from the service, to the food, to the hotel grounds. We have stayed at multiple other all inclusive hotels in the Dominican Republic, Mexico, and Aruba and this is by far the best one yet. 

Service - There are so many workers!! You never feel like you have to ask for something twice or look for someone to help you. There is always someone available and very eager to help. Everyone was very pleasant and you feel like they genuinely enjoy their jobs. They went above and beyond to make our experience as easy and carefree as possible. We ate at Malva for breakfast daily and a few lunches and Alfredo Alvaro and Alexis Ozuna were the best. They greeted us every day with a big smile (that I can even see through their masks) and we’re very attentive with drinks/clean up. They were very pleasant and remembered us when we came in each morning. Thank you for your incredible service!! It’s really great to see that the workers seemed happy. No one was huffing and puffing or was irritated at any of our requests. 

The food -  WOW! The food was such great quality, flavor, and variety. From our previous experiences, one of these is typically lacking at an all inclusive but Paradisus had all three. The buffet to our surprise was excellent! They had a large variety and they did not cheapen out on quality. We had dinner at all of the restaurants and again they were all amazing. The menu had such a large selection to choose from and everything was delicious. Our favorite was the Peruvian and Japanese (went to both twice) but the Mexican and Italian were excellent as well. Overall, the food and drinks exceeded our expectations. 

Hotel Grounds - absolutely stunning! Everything is designed so beautifully and is so picturesque. We really loved the layout and landscape of the hotel. 

Activities - if I am going to critique one thing it would be the activities. We were here for 7 nights and they only had activities by the pool for one day. We wish they had more going on, like pool games or competitions. We also felt like there weren’t many activities for children. The night shows were great but there were so many kids at the hotel and some sort of kid entertainment during the day/night would’ve been nice! 

The only other thing we wish the hotel had was a hot tub! This may seem insignificant but we love hot tubs on vacation! There is so much space at the hotel for them to build a hot tub and would be a really nice addition! 

Overall we had a great experience and will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Todd H
reviews.title: Best service
reviews.text: Excellent service!!! We love Paradisus Cancun! We plan on returning here fir our third trip next March. The staff has been very friendly and cannot do enough to make sure you are satisfied. This is a highly recommended resort

reviews.author: Oliver R
reviews.title: Great hotel and staff who went out of their way to help. Very average food.
reviews.text: Great hotel with a narrow but nice beach. The staff were exceptionally friendly (shout out to Richier who served us coffee every morning - he was amazing!). Buffet and taco restos were awesome. The reservation restos we’re at best average but mostly poor.

reviews.author: Lynn V
reviews.title: Best hotel and staff
reviews.text: I had a little glitch in the beginning with the concierge in the beginning but it was changed to Raphael Juarez who was absolutely wonderful and couldn't help us enough.  He checked in with us all the time.  In the reserve pool we had two gentlemen Lucas and Maximilian who told us more that was going on our first few days  when   our concierge did not. Also by the pool was Jennifer in activities she was great.  Carlos the waiter at Cielo restaurant was wonderful. Last was Gabby at the ginger Bar we could not believe that on the second night there she remembered what we were drinking she was friendly  and very efficient.  All the staff should be given congratulations by the hotel, we will be back next year because of this staff. This is the third Paradisus I have been to  and cant wait to go back.

reviews.author: amoureuse1976
reviews.title: Malva restaurant - Paradisus Cancun review
reviews.text: Joni, Gaudencio and Atilano in Malva restaurant were great. Their service was exceptional. Very friendly. Buffet style service with different choices. But friendly people are the best about the hotel.   They are attentive and remember the small details that make a difference.

reviews.author: llabrada
reviews.title: Second time
reviews.text: This was our second time on Paradisus, had a great time as before. To me, is the people there the ones that make your vacations shine. Julio at the pool bar was great to us with his service, advices on what to do and where to go. Check in takes a long time, I'd suggest more terminals and employees as needed. There's construction going on during the day, but on those ours we were out on the pool or the beach. Reservation to some restaurants is hard to get, but for a couple or 4 person group, walk to the restaurants and talk to the people there, we were a much larger group and got in the lunch box and in enzo. Took the small boat and snorkeling tour just across the street and enjoyed it too.

reviews.author: foru2nv86
reviews.title: Bad Services and no accommodations when complaints
reviews.text: The service was not what I expected it to be there was certain restaurants that was ok but the food was poor quality and cold. Also, there was no accommodations once complained about roaches in the restaurant.

reviews.author: Victoria H
reviews.title: Paradisus November 2021
reviews.text:
We chose to go on vacation very last minute so we paid about 3800 for our Junior ocean view/7night stay at Paradisus. 

Over all we would come back but maybe if there was no Renovations and we knew the weather would be better. 

The Positive: we really enjoyed our Bartender Juan-Manuel at the Kanna Beach club. He was very friendly and we spent most afternoons at his bar. We enjoyed his drinks and even sat in the rain cuz we didn’t want to leave. 
I really enjoyed the Buffet and we went there often, our last server there, Joni, was very attentive and kind. The breakfast service was always the best but that’s probably because we woke up at 7-8, before crowds. 
The beach here is clean and beautiful even in the rain, we swam in the ocean and it was a lot of fun, although watch out for where there may be some exposed rocks near shore. 
There is a warmer and a cooler pool so it’s nice to have options. 
We watched a decent amount of the cable  TV because of the poor weather but there were some good movies to it wasn’t bad. 

The negative: The resort was under renovations (i knew ahead of time that there would be Just one restaurant unavailable because of this). However, being that our stay was pretty rainy and windy with minimal sun (no tan lines) we did spend some time inside the same building as the Renovations. The construction left a heavy layer of dust on all the plants in the sanctuary- the plants being a huge focus of the appeal of this resort- and the loud noises (later that 6pm) and smell of paint spray really makes the building unpleasant to be in. So I didn’t take any pictures of the plants since it looked so dirty. 

Another thing about the resort that Was not so great was the minimal activities to do. Only having been to one other resort ever, I thought it was normal to have things like lawn games out and stuff to do by the pool, but the activity schedule here seemed limited to weather dependent activities like outdoor yoga in the morning and volleyball on the pool. Can’t really do anything is it’s pouring rain. Other indoor activities probably would have been in the main 3rd pyramid/lobby, but again with the Reno’s it would be nauseating. 

We would have gotten a Bali bed but the weather was too unpredictable. Instead we did go Snorkeling but it was a bit of a bust, not much for cute fish. 

You have to make reservations for almost everything besides the Buffet +lunch, even need to book for the Gym which I didn’t go to because of the inconvenience. To make a reservation they originally tell you at check in to download this “Melia” APP but it doesn’t work-the reviews are so low on the APP. Instead you have to go each day to the guest services to book the reservation for the following night. Would be a lot easier to book everything for 7 days all at once. 
Also we were told we could Pay for our PCR test by Credit Card when we checked in but the nurse who did our swab insisted cash so thankfully I had cash on hand but it was meant for something else so that sucked.

reviews.author: Alberto G
reviews.title: Ginger Bar 2
reviews.text:
Mi más sincera felicitación para Wendy Morales del Ginger Bar 2 (siempre pensé se llamaría Sports Bar o algo similar) si bien todos al momento de brindar el servicio que les corresponda Wendy se destaca sobre todos por su amabilidad, vocación de servicio y platica amena.
My sincere congratulations to Wendy Morales from Ginger Bar 2 (I always thought it would be called Sports Bar or something similar) although everyone at the time of providing the service that corresponds to them Wendy stands out above all for her kindness, service vocation and pleasant conversation.

reviews.author: Tim F
reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to Mexico, having previously opted for Punta Cana, Bahamas and southern Florida.  We stayed 11 nights and overall it was a wonderful vacation.

The staff in general were very nice and accommodating.  Kudos to Fabiola in Guest Services - she was especially helpful and resolved our issues quickly and with a smile.    For servers, Lorena, Moises and Jimmy were exceptional.  

The room and bed were very nice, and overall cleanliness was never a concern.  Housekeeping performed their service well, although we had to track down the guy to get the mini/fridge refilled.  Bathroom lighting was poor.  Both the pool and beach areas are very nice - most days we opted for the beach.  There are many chairs available, but you need to go early if you want a shade hut.

The buffet was average, with food temperature being our biggest complaint.  Most items were served Luke-warm, and were room temperature by the time we got back to our table.  The Blue Agave Taco Restaurant was fantastic.  The female singer there was also very good.  Reservations at the all inclusive restaurants were very hard to get on the app.  We finally got assistance in making one through guest services.  We ate at Cappella, which was a very good experience.

There was significant daytime construction in the main building, which is where our room was.  It didn’t cause us any problems, but could be an issue for someone else.

I wouldn’t hesitate to return a Paradisus, Cancun.  The water was warm and a beautiful shade of turquoise.  The beach was delightful with soft fine sand.  The excursions were well organized, memorable and fun.  I look forward to next time.

reviews.author: Thom M
reviews.title: SIXTH TIME AT THIS AWESOME RESORT!!!
reviews.text: This was our 6th trip to Pardisus Cancun and as always we had an awesome time!! Many changes and upgrades have been made since our last trip in 2020. We found many new items on restaurant menus which were very delicious. The food was very fresh and prepared in a 5 star format. We did recognize many of the same staff that we had seen over the last 6 years and it made our stay feel more intimate. This trip we traveled with another family and kids so we spent much of our time at the pool. This was a blast due to the daily activities, music programing as well as the pool side bar. The property has undergone many interior and design changes, all of which look great. A previous night club has been renovated and opened up making it lighter and more inviting. Kudos for all of the TV's in this new bar as watching international futbol was a nice touch. This was just one of many new surprises at the property. We are already talking about our next trip and can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Rds81
reviews.title: Ok but not again.
reviews.text:
We have been to Cancun 10-12 times over the past 10 years. My wife and I generally go once a year although we have had a few years where we have managed to go more. This is our second trip to Paradisus. The first time was a number of years back prior to Meliá purchasing.  

Our first stay was an incredible value for what we got. We stayed in what was then called Royal Service.  The service was great, the food was pretty good and the stay was all in all better. Not amazing but we felt we got an incredible value. 

This time was not as memorable. The resort is big and does show its age in many ways, however they do a pretty good job keeping it clean.  We stayed in a one bedroom ocean front suite in the “reserve”. Check in was fairly easy but our room was not ready when we got there at 1:30pm.  No big deal we also had friends there so we just hung out with them at the pool.  At this time we met our concierge which was probably the biggest let. down for the trip.  It is not that our concierge was rude, it was that he was basically non existent.  His name is Raffael. I would suggest another option if he is provided. 

When we checked he asked for our number and told me to download the Whats app app which is did.  He told us that he would let us know when the room was ready. After a few hours with no communication we had our friends contact him. He confirmed the room was ready.  Ok no big deal.  We met him in the hotel and he took us to the room. He never explained anything the resort had to offer, didn’t provide any type of notification of activities. He did not initially provide menus when asked he said my friend had them. (He did provide the next day when my wife contacted him. We had to get his number from our friends and use the app to find him even though he said he would contact us.)

Room was great. Always clean great bedding, great shower, stocked mini bar with snacks beer and sodas etc. Never an issue with the room.  Great job guys. 

Ok so dining. Food was ok everywhere. We weren’t overly impressed with anything.  However given the price point of this hotel I feel you need to have some sort of expectations based in reality. If you are a foodie and that will make or break your trip then I would go elsewhere. My wife and I are vegetarian however the couple we were with were not. The feeling was mutual. If you are vegetarian this hotel was probably the least accommodating we have been to. You can get something everywhere you go but many times it will be a special request of some sort of combination of items throughout the menu. There just were not many options with some restaurants only having a dessert item as an option. I believe two of the restaurants we went to had nothing.  In short you will be able to eat most anywhere but you will not have a comprehensive list of options. Especially if you like to eat somewhat healthy. It’s a shame as you know they have all the vegetarian options available just not thoughtful in that regard.   

The meat options looked ok. Don’t expect tomahawk ribeyes, fancy duck options or crab legs, at least not included in the price. They did have a few upsell menu items and a pay restaurant and upgraded beach service area if you want a more special experience. Having not paid for any of this as being vegetarian I can not speak to them. I did look at the steakhouse menu and you can expect to pay a few hundred bucks for a nice dinner with drinks etc.  I was told (not by our concierge) that the upgraded beach area was 220 usd per day. This included all you can drink champagne, lobster etc. it was very small but also some of the only beach area available.
