Ok about the beach. Non existent. If you love the beach this is not the hotel for you. I believe much of their beach was recently washed out. We are not beach people so this was not an issue. 

Pools were ok. We staid in the reserve pool area which is much quieter. The pool was good. Pretty warm and clean.  The other pools were overrun by kids and much louder. Great probably for families and those that want to do shots at the swim up bar. Plenty of pool areas. Not sure about seating outside of the reserve but imagine it goes the same as many places. Get up early to reserve your chairs. Without much beach area this will be exaggerated here.   With the reserve upgrade we got only 2 days out of five where you can get a cabana. Little seating out at the pools so you have to get up early or hope someone doesn’t show their cabana. We were able to do this a few days so it all worked out. However we did see plenty of pissed off people because of this. If you don’t want to wake up by 8-8:30 am to get your seat you will likely encounter limited options in the reserve area. 

With respect to the reserve I would say it is not worth much additional fee. First you will be the furthest away from restaurant. It is a hike. They have a nice area with small plates and a bar. It was nice but most of the options you could find throughout minus a few exceptions. The alcohol was ok. They had grey good, Hendricks and Bombay, jack Daniels, some decent rum, and Don Julio, 1800 etc. it was ok. Beer was basic fare. Heineken , Dos Equis, tecate etc. 

The only real advantage we saw was the more relaxed pool.  Again the concierge was essentially worthless which is ok. Many hotels do not have them but I would not put any value in this.   Feeling like more of a broken promise I would have said our stay would have been better without having one. Our dinner reservations always seemed to be an issue.  Luckily our friends did most of that part of communication with him. They asked for 6:30is timeframe for dinner which was only granted once. Our times were most often 8 or after. On the last night we didn’t get our table in the Italian place until 950. Our reservation was at 9:30.  Multiple requests to move the reservation were not replied to.  Our concierge never once checked on us and only would respond if we asked him a question. I think we only reached out 3 times our entire stay so not needy. Once to get menus which you would think would be provided. Twice to see if a reservation was needed for an activity.  Again he did not alert us to the activities nor provide any direction where to find out about these activities. He also did not let us know about the COVID testing. We knew about it luckily so we’re able to find out the ins and outs on our own.

Entertainment is also not a strongpoint if this hotel. It seems like this is becoming less and less of an option vs 10 years ago.  They don’t have a great areas to house this first of all. You have to crowd into the main bar.  Again nothing outstanding so don’t expect to be wowed here. The best was probably the silent party however it will not appeal to all. 

Hotel was clean with exception of where construction was occurring.  Pretty loud during the day but this should not be held against the hotel. They are building another restaurant which should help and is desperately needed.  Given the size of the hotel, reservations are a problem.  Only expect to be able to get into any of the high demand restaurants once during a stay. They have limited seating. Like 12 tables. And this resort is huge. You can always eat somewhere, but probably not where you want nor when you want. Reservations were the most frustrating part of the trip. We would have hoped our concierge could have helped with that but it was the bare minimum. He was actually the running joke of our stay. 

The gym looked nice. Good size. Tons of equipment. We did attempt to use the hydrotherapy during the stay. Huge disappointment. A little run down. Steam room not operational in men’s room. The jacuzzi in the area was not warm, actually cold. Actually there was not a hot tub anywhere in the resort. Major let down. 

In short this hotel was ok. Probably a great value for families wanting to take kids. I think they stay free.  No beach and limited seating by pool.  Food and drinks were ok. Service overall was good. You will have to get up and go get things and you may be told no in some situations, however again this is not an expensive stay. So don’t compare with something like Le Blanc.  We would not pick this resort for another stay. Even with the prices being lower we would be willing to pay more for better service, more open reservations and improved eating options. 

Two specific call out were Jose at “lunch box”. He was very welcoming and was quick to accommodate our vegetarian diet. There was not an option but he proactively offered. He was very funny and made everyone enjoy dinner. We wish we could have had him every time. 

Also Raoul at the door who took our bags upon arrivals and who met us at departure. He was great very welcoming and funny. He is an asset to the hotel.

reviews.author: Maricela63
reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: We had the best service, drinks and food at the Paradisus Cancun during our entire stay! The service was the BEST we’ve ever had! From Joni at the Malva for breakfast (a few times) to our cabana serviceman, Max to our cabana server Julio. They were ALL excellent! We even had the pleasure of chatting with their supervisor, Diego who was also very attentive. Best stay EVER!!

reviews.author: Franciscooliveir2021
reviews.title: Vacations in Paradisus
reviews.text: One of the best hotels i've stayed in. Location (proximity to center, to waterworld, excellent beach, music, animation high quality, etc..), staff sympathy, disponibility and efficiency, that doesn't let you worry about anything in order to provide you, with everything you could ever want in a vacation. Stupendous Beach, pool, environmental concerns. I advise it 100 %

reviews.author: Bumjoo K
reviews.title: Great Service, but construction annoying
reviews.text:
Good : The service was good. 
Especially, Marva's Christian and Jorge helped us have a great time. 
The bartender of Enzo made a very delicious cocktail. 
Mexican food was especially delicious.

Bad : The lobby construction was quite noisy and there was a lot of dust.
There weren't many facilities or programs for young children to play in.
I wasn't satisfied with the facilities of the free golf course.

reviews.author: Vacaylove
reviews.title: The staff is quite special
reviews.text: We had a really lovely vacation at Paradisus- primarily because of the staff! There were 2 people that truly made our stay AMAZING!!! When you eat breakfast, sit outside and request ALFREDO ALVARO. What a perfect way to start your day. He is so happy, has an incredible memory and does his job while singing through the day. He was the best!!! We also had the sweetest and most attentive server at the main pool- ASUNCION. She made our days by the pool so amazing. The activities team is also so fun- check the schedules so you don’t miss out -Thank you for a great trip!!!

reviews.author: Jade1234
reviews.title: Do not stay here
reviews.text: If you’re looking for a budget stay and do not consider yourself a “foodie,” I would say this is a good deal, as the views, pool, and beach are enjoyable. However, I probably stay at about 10 hotels a year and this is by far one of the worst experiences I’ve had. The food was hardly edible, the liquor was truly unrecognizable in flavor, and the rooms were a far cry from 5 star. Outside of motels, there are two hotel stays that stick in my mind as some of the worst experiences, and both include Melia Caribe resorts. It actually seems fraudulent to call this a 5 star hotel, but good spot if you’re looking for something budget and enjoyable.

reviews.author: Belmarie Palen
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: Lazara was an amazing assistant! All is food recommendations were amazing. The best dinner I had at my stay in Paradisus. The coconut cream dessert is absolutely delicious. The appetizers and guacamole were also delicious.

reviews.author: Robin
reviews.title: Great service!
reviews.text:
My husband and I visited Paradisus the last week of October.  After reading reviews before we left, I decided to upgrade to the Reserve service at check in.  It was worth every dollar!!!  We have never received the quality of service given to us by all staff!!  
Violeta was our butler and she took care of everything we needed. She made dinner reservations for us, made request to housekeeping and the person that stocks mini fridge in room.  She even checked in on us during her days off!  
The Reserve upgrade allows access to adult only pool area with beautiful Cabanas and the Sante restaurant.  The staff at Sante restaurant were more than exceptional!!  These are also the waiters that took care of service at the Cabanas.  They were all very attentive to our needs.  Never had an empty drink very long and they would even bring your lunch right to the Cabana!  Wanted to give a shout out to Julio, Cesar, Oscar, Eligio, Miguel, Moises and their exceptional leader Diego.  I also need to mention Maximiliano who helped me every morning to get the best of the Cabanas! These gentlemen were super friendly and felt like family by the end of the week!  
We would definitely return to Paradisus Cancun again!

reviews.author: abehache
reviews.title: Not a 5 stars at all
reviews.text: Hi everyone. Would like to start to say that hotel facility is clean but not a 5 stars resort as is promoted. Let’s keep in mind that the beginning of a vacation is crucial. We had 4 rooms and it took us more than 3 hours to get our rooms and that was we went back to from desk staff and complained our the issue. We ended up taken any room available and not what we had. As well information provided was very limited nor any literature at the rooms about hotel facilities and activities. 70% of the staff were friendly. Not refills in the rooms. Restaurants hard to get a reservation and once you there the first thing they promote the food and drinks that cost you extra. At the pool the cabanas was an extra charge of $250.00 as well the beach. They need to improve at large the entertainment. By midnight everything closes. Bars at the pool and beach close at 6:00pm. Enzo restaurant food was awful. We tried several dishes keep in mind that we have a group of ten. Italian was ok and Cielos the Mexican is the best option. Oscar, Atilano, David, Rafael, Pascual, Roque were great

reviews.author: Britany V
reviews.title:
Staff was good … food was not! 
Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
First off, I want to recognize Moises at the Reserve pool, Carlos at Cielo and Rafael Reserve concierge they all went above and beyond with their amazing customer service. Each of them did everything that they could to make our stay as special as possible. 

The initial reaction to the resort was beautiful. The live plants that lined the lobby were amazing. When we arrived we were escorted to the Reserve check in where we were walked partially through the resort and they pointed us the rest of the way to find the check in desk on our own. During the check in process the gentleman helping us was fairly new and unable to answer questions regarding some of the amenities. We did receive welcome cocktails which was a nice touch.

Our room was a deluxe ocean view suite, and the room hit all the buckets. Beautiful view, clean, very spacious, rain shower,   Comfortable King bed and a well stocked mini bar. 

In the Reserve area you are assigned a concierge/ butler to the room. Our initial concierge we met in our room, spoke to once and did not see again for 3 days. We requested a change and got to meet Rafael who came to meet us and once he found out we were celebrating our Honeymoon, he personally delivered balloons sparkling wine and chocolate dipped strawberries. It was a real treat. Rafael continued to be in contact with us the remainder of the trip to book our dinner reservations and attended to any other needs we had.

As a perk to our Reservation we were allowed use of the Bali beds. Moises was our server at the Reserve pool area, and he was so helpful. He has an awesome attitude and excellent customer service. You can really understand after speaking with him that he truly loves the work he does. He always recognized us wherever we were and asked how he could help us. We were also able to get to know him a bit on a personal level and it was so nice that he was comfortable opening up to us. He went above and beyond with everything he did for us. One day he even saw us by the main pool and said why aren’t you sitting with him? ( There hadn’t been any seats available) 15 minutes later he had loungers set up with water and our favorite drinks and came to tell us to come sit in his area. Amazing!

The biggest reason for our average review was because of the food. When you go to an all inclusive resort like this and you spend a decent amount of money, you expect a certain level of service and food selection. We felt as if we ate the same thing for 8 days…. Not ideal. The food was mediocre at best. There are many times throughout the day where the only option is Malva (buffet). The food at the buffet was terrible, mostly lukewarm mishmash of ingredients left little to be desired. The specialty restaurants seemed to have a bit more quality affair, however a reservation is required. Without a reservation you are left to room service or buffet which all come from the same kitchen. McDonald’s is luckily across the street if you need something to tie you over.

I highly recommend not booking this resort until the construction is over. The constant noise of grinding metal and dust in the air well into the evening make for a “relaxing” trip.

I wish I  could have come away with a better story to tell from our Honeymoon but this resort lack attention to detail, even when you pay for the extra perks.

Although we met a few great staff members we will likely not be returning to this resort.

Special Thank you to

Moises, Ruben, Oscar in the Reserve pool

reviews.author: Ann N
reviews.title: Orlando, Guadencio
reviews.text: These were our best servers by FAR!!!!!  They were very attentive to our needs for our food We had tons of laughs and drinks were flowing for us t breakfast. We couldn’t ask for a better second day of vacation!!!!!

reviews.author: dmenis
reviews.title: Cappella restaurant
reviews.text: Aurelio is the best! Good recommendations, amazing service.  Gem to the melia company! He was well informed and didn't upsell us.. Honest and true, the food was fresh and tasty. We will definitely be back, the best !!

reviews.author: Doremon H
reviews.title: Above and Beyond!
reviews.text: We are from Canada and it was our first time in Cancun at Malva... Service top notch and the food was first class. Our servers went above and beyond and made a cricket for our cutie! Gracias Eddie and Armando!

reviews.author: Leslie P
reviews.title: Capella in Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We were very impressed with the food at Capella. We ate their twice during our stay and the food was constant. The artichoke dip was delicious!!  Their pasta rivals my favorite in my hometown. The service was excellent. This is a must if you stay in Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: AylinNazaryan
reviews.title: Construction I conviniance.
reviews.text: Property is very nice. But was under construction.  The middle part of the hotel was under construction and was not covered.  There was a coffee and ice cream desk under and next to the construction dust. The sofas and tables were covered in construction dust.  The Italian restaurant had no air conditioning.  Check in was very long. Only 3 people working and long line.

reviews.author: ash_breezy
reviews.title: Worst to best!
reviews.text:
Check in was a terrible experience. We arrived after 12 hours of travel and they had given away the room we paid for in advance. We had specifically booked a suite where we could watch the sunset. The front desk agents were not telling us what was going on and we had to wait almost two hours standing with all our luggage in the lobby while they had a replacement room cleaned. By this time we had missed the sunset and when we arrived to our room, the keys were not functional. This happened two more times and each time, we went back down to the front desk two more times, each time dragging all of our luggage, exhausted and hungry. The sun had set completely by this time. We asked about food and we’re told they would see if they could fit us in and would call us when they found something. We finally made it to our non-suite room on the third try and didnt receive a call about dinner until almost 10 pm. Defeated, we decided to just give up and go to bed.

BUT! The next day everything turned around! We met some amazing staff at the Kanna Bar Juan concierge, Manuel (bartender) and Alex were so friendly and kind.  They really turned our stay around. So lucky to have such great people working at the resort, they really saved our vacation!

reviews.author: nora
reviews.title: Good service
reviews.text:
Orlando Bello for the best coffee!
Martin at lunch box excellent service. 

The food is great. The staff very friendly.
Rooms need some renovating. 
Nightly shows. Nice sized pool and clean. 
Construction currently ongoing in lobby so lots of noise and dust during the day.

reviews.author: Joli A
reviews.title: Amazing Staff + Vacation Overall!!
reviews.text:
My mom took a 5-day vacation here this past week and had a wonderful experience. From the food options, to the beach, and activities offered for the guests, we couldn't have had a more fun time - especially for the price! 

We did not feel the need to sign up for any excursions outside of the hotel as there were plenty of activities provided for people of all ages. The activities staff, particularly Luis, Axcel, Saul, and Agustin really made sure that my family was taken care of that and we had everything we needed. The staff really took the time to know their guests, understand their names, and make everyone feel included (who wanted to be). 

I definitely will be recommending this resort to friends + family that are thinking of a trip over, and cannot wait to return!

reviews.author: Emmy A
reviews.title: Excellent Getaway
reviews.text:
What a wonderful, relaxing time. I want to prelude by saying we did the reserve upgrade which most likely removed some of the complaints others had. This experience is based on a family trip
 
Room: air conditioned, cleaned 2x/ day, comfortable, everything we requested, looked great!! 

Food: very good, please know I’m comparing it to other all inclusives NOT a Gourmet restaurant. There and many different options. 

Beach/ Pool: amazing, amazing! We chose Cancun based on its beaches. When we went, no seaweed; that we saw. Pool area can use some updating, however it did not take away from the expereince. They have separate Pool areas: adults only, general (all),
Children & adults (not sure if this was only for reserve- we were there most of the time as it was more serene.) The cabana style beds are a must. 

Facilities: room was great, halls great, there was staff always painting or updating something. YES there is construction happening in side and they are making a new restaurant, personally for us it did not take away from the experience. Resort was clean. 

Staff: Excellent, humble, they seem to be a little short staffed as they are increasing the amount of guests they are allowing. Be patient, give tips. 

Entertainment/ activities: we really were
There to relax. I can not speak much to entertainment though they seem to have things going on. We took advantage of the photographer and captured beautiful family memories. 3 photos free, the rest you can purchase. 

I say book it, and enjoy! (Go reserve)

reviews.author: mscherryfan
reviews.title: Theft and poor service.  Stay away!!
reviews.text: When you offer a personal concierge you should be able to deliver on the expectation listed on your website.  When I spoke to other guest they didn’t have a concierge appointed either.  Maybe hire maids that don’t steal would be a start.  My AirPods went missing from my room and there was no help by the staff to get them back even though there is a gps tracker on them yelling me their exact location.  My coffee and water were never refilled after asking everyday.  I don’t drink so that was my only request for the room.  The royal service is a shame, there was theft of my belongings, no help from security or guest services, poor food quality, and no request was fulfilled regarding my daughter birthday.  As a long time Meliá guest this experience has made me switch to Dreams resorts as my number one.

reviews.author: Qixing T
reviews.title: Be Aware! Don’t choose this toxic hotel it will ruin your vacation!!!!
reviews.text:
11/7 
I’ve been Cancun like four times, and this hotel is my worst experience ever. I booked 4 nights for my family trip and today is only the second day, we all already wanna go home. First of all, the front desk was super slowly and not welcoming at all. The check-in process spent more than 40 minutes. Why? Because the front desk were using 5 minutes to looking for a scissor to cut our bracelet and chatting with her coworkers by the way. She didn’t trying to explain anything except promoting us to book a SPA service. After we went to the rooms, the rooms were old and didn’t look like a luxury hotel room. And then, they spent around one hour to delivery our luggage even we did talked to them twice and told them it’s emergency because our baby need to eat his food. 
For the baby, it also was a big joke. This is a family hotel but it doesn’t welcome little kids at all. They put our room close to a bar, the noise continued until 12am, my baby just COULD NOT SLEEP. omg it’s really a nightmare. Why you put a family to this kind of room? I really don’t understand. And before we went to the hotel, we called them to ask if they can do baby food and they answered yes. Upon we are here we found they don’t know how to make baby food, they even don’t understand what you are saying. We repeated told them no salt no sugar please, and they repeated sent the food super salty.  “No Salt.” Is the two words really hard to understand?
I wish I never come to this hotel, I don’t even know how I spend the rest two days with noise and baby’s crying. 
I will never come back to this hotel and I recommend everyone be away from this hotel. Don’t let this hotel ruin your vacation it’s not worth. 

11/8 UPDATE 
The hotel manager just changed our rooms today and the patio’s chair was broken my father was falling from the chair. The two rooms key broken four times and we just exhausted to go to front desk for asking assist. The most employees don’t speak English, they just talks with us in Spain and don’t care if we understand or not.  It’s just funny we feel suffering in this hotel and wanna come back to home ASAP.  We don’t even want to come to Cancun because of this hotel. It’s not a hotel, it’s a nightmare, it’s a scam, it doesn’t worth 5 stars, Motel 8 is better than this place.

reviews.author: haykbn
reviews.title: What a great experience! Feels like you are home!
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun from November 5-8th. What an amazing experience. The stuff here treats you like you are their family. I want to highlight the experience we had at the beach. We reserved cabana every day and were treated like royalties!! Victor, Juan, Balta and Luise went above and beyond to make our time special. This is type of service I call “Amazing”. Thank you guys!! I am looking forward to be back soon!!

reviews.author: Frequenttraveler3229
reviews.title: Only go here is you want to spend your trip with severe food poisoning
reviews.text: STAY AWAY AT ALL COSTS!!! We chose to spend the extra money to stay here because I've been tp the Playa Del Carmen resort a few years back and had a great experience. My experience in Cancun was FAR from great. I got SEVERE food poisoning from the buffet on the first day of my trip and spent the rest of the trip unable to get out of bed. It was absolutely horrible. The rooms had an odd smell and were dated. The staff was rude. The food was horrible and unsafe to eat. Stay away for your own good!!!

reviews.author: Isabella M
reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: Most of the reviews I read stated that check in took awhile, I found that to be true but everyone who worked with us was super friendly so it didn’t seem like such a big deal. We arrived around 12 and the got our room ready in about 30 minutes, we ate in the mean time. Throughout our whole stay I noticed that the staff was exceptionally friendly, helpful, and hardworking. We had a security guard help us get water at 1:30 in the morning, not something that seems to be his job but he was very happy to help. A shout out to Saul, Myra and Axcel, the staff who are in charge of activities, they were so great and friendly and we had so much fun playing the different sports with them and doing the activities and just getting to know them and hanging out with them. Another shout-out to Wendy one of the waitresses working at the inside portion of ginger bar. We enjoyed our stay and didn’t really have any complaints. They are doing construction in the middle of the main building currently but we were right by it on the 6th floor and it did not cause any interruptions as you could barely hear it from your room. Overall a really great stay.

reviews.author: Fred K
reviews.title: Bait and switch in damaged room with faulty appliances
reviews.text: RCI exchange for king size bed and full kitchen. It was neither. Management was going to contact me to correct. Never heard from them. Microwave and mini fridge didn't work. Room flooded in the middle of the night. Called and no one came to do anything about it. Cleaning lady mopped it up the next day.  You could see it was an ongoing problem. Even soaked the bed. To be fair, Pool, cleaning and dining service people were very good.

reviews.author: mackenzie k
reviews.title: paradisus is amazing
reviews.text: european, and these are the most amazing people. Juan from kanna, luis and Alejandro ❤️love all the amazing people. such an amazing place to be. Can’t wait to come back and enjoy my time with everyone again!!!!!

reviews.author: jruiz1174
reviews.title: Needs work
reviews.text:
The construction is a bit loud and dusty. The rooms need updating. My room specifically had a moldy smell and the ac unit did not work well. The air conditioning in the halls and lobby either does not work or was not put on. The staff in the restaurants were very friendly, but the food was just ok. 
Overall we had a good time, but just feel for the money spent was not up to standards.

reviews.author: M J H
reviews.title: Fantastic staff
reviews.text:
My wife and I have been to this resort 6 times this year already. We had stayed at another resort in June and at another several years and Paradisus Cancun is head and shoulders above the others.
While we aren’t happy that construction is happening inside the hotel we know it’s necessary in order to keep the hotel current and nice.

We would like to especially acknowledge several of the Paradisus Cancun employees . While all are outstanding there have been several who are exceptionally attentive to the guests needs . Raul who is the manager of the restaurants has always been helpful to us when there were some mistakes that needed to be fixed . He would actually take the time to track us down no matter the time of day in order to make a situation right . One time he even offered to come in on his time off . A very outstanding manager and we were much appreciate of how he helped .

Most of the time we stayed at the Bali beds along the beach 
One employee in particular Rene was beyond OUTSTANDING. He made sure our stomachs and drinks stayed full each and every time we have stayed . The guy is always moving and is always giving the guest his undivided attention. He made sure I never had to leave the beach area for anything. 

One more employee we would like to acknowledge is Hugo Hernandez. He is one of the leads inside the Italian restaurant. We first met him when Raul assigned him to our table . Thanks again Raul for the excellent choice of servers. Again, excellent attention to detail and his dedication to his staff and guest are obvious . Btw - he’s got great taste in music. 

Anyway as I close in my comments, I don’t possibly have time to thank all the employees as everyone is extremely attentive and helpful . As I told the employees I can pick anywhere in Cancun to stay , yet my wife and I have continually chosen Paradisus Cancun . As previously stated 6 times this year already .  Also this is the first review I have ever written regarding a vacation or a stay somewhere.

Respectfully,
Mark and Julie

reviews.author: Steve14487
reviews.title: WOW!!
reviews.text:
Not sure who exactly is responsible for the staff, and customer service but BRAVO!! Ive been to over 25 resorts in the last 15 years, and I can say, without a doubt, Paradisus, Cancun has the top of the top staff!! Never have I felt more welcome, and taken care of! Besides being a breathtakingly beautiful resort, its employees are exceptional! Room service is the best, food delivered within 25 minutes, and food is hot! Elevators were fast, no long wait, never ran into housecleaning and had to wait for the room to be done, The bartenders and waitresses were prompt and always refilling our glasses. Restaurant food was delicious, and pool snack shacks were great! Our room was beautiful and had a great view, room 4066!! 
My only complaints, the room has no coffee pot, Buffett needs more options and the shows have to supply more seating for guests.
Tips...order room service breakfast to avoid crowds...tip well, its so worth it....book your restaurants ahead of time....bring a pool float(the pool is very deep), bring your own cup and ENJOY!! We had  a great time!!! Paradisus give your employees a great big raise, this is what makes you Exceptional!!!

reviews.author: Patrick A
reviews.title: Yesenia, Orlando, Thank you for making our trip so special.
reviews.text: The staff there is amazing, out of this world, especially YESENIA who works around the pool and the bartender ORLANDO. I will miss this place and I have tears in my eyes to leave. Good job to everybody who runs this resort. Please keep the quality this high.

reviews.author: sanraj2021
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Best place to spend time with family by enjoying the beauty of nature , trying different cuisines and have fun. Free from stress, cooking,cleaning  and work. Best vacation ever. Weather was also beautiful.

reviews.author: luislanza
reviews.title: Excellent overall!!! Best vacation ever!!
reviews.text:
We absolutely love this hotel.
Since we stepped in everything was amazing.
The food, the installation, the views from everywhere of the hotel.  However, what we were most impressed was the service and hospitality.
Since the front desk personnel, the bartenders, the waitreses and waiters, the cleaning staff. Everyone was always very helpful, very friendly.
Specially the bartenders, waitreses, and waiters from Bar Ginger.
Argenis, Antonio, Sofonio, Wendy, Ana and all the others that I forgot their names..
Everyone from this bar were excepcional!!!
Also the personnel from Malva Desayuno
Ignacio, Alex, Rafael, Arturo, etc.. Everyone was fabulous!!! 
I would must definitely recomend Hotel Paradisus Cancun. 
Specially for their staff, their friendlines, their hospitality. Excepcional!!!
We love Hotel Paradisus Cancun!
We love México!!!

reviews.author: MrsMallory21
reviews.title: Amazing time at Paradisus
reviews.text:
We had our mini honeymoon here and it was paradise! With a few minor changes this resort would be spectacular! Our trip was made lovely and relaxing by the hardworking and attentive staff. 100% recommend the reserve upgrade if travelling as a couple and wanting to relax! Victor was the most amazing concierge. Julio and Jose were the most attentive staff waiting on us at the pool. Having our daily Bali bed reserved and set up with towels daily was a total luxury. 
Gio and Wendy at the sports bar were amazing and we had the best post dinner martinis here. The yhi spa was gorgeous and relaxing. Overall impressed with the restaurants and food selection. House wine selection needs improvement in variety. Capella was our favourite especially with the electric violinist.
We would definitely come back :)

reviews.author: Pmrlo5
reviews.title: Very nice resort
reviews.text:
Seventh time to Cancun first time at Paradisus.   Some tips.

The reserve rooms are a must.  You get access to the best pool and beach restaurant. Bali beds next to the pool are free with drink and food service.  Ruben is the best! You get you own top shelf bar in the lobby and food.   Our butler/ concierge was very nice but we had to reserve a majority of our dinner and pool reservations. He wasn’t reliable unfortunately.  The staff is incredibly friendly. 

The beach on the resort is amazing.   We ordered the Bali beds on the beach “Kanna club” and had lobster and champagne twice.  Is was amazing!  It’s an additional $220 US dollars to do that each time. 

The spa is a disappointment unfortunately.  None of the hydrotherapy pool jets worked and the sauna and steam room were broken. Such a bummer.  Massages were good.  

Gym was ok.  It was functional, but out of all the resorts we’ve stayed at this was my least favorite.  

Food.   

Buffet wasn’t good. 
The steak restaurant was amazing but it’s cost extra. For a couple of two we paid about $250 US dollars.  
Italian was ok
Mexican restaurant was good 
Peruvian was good
The outside reserve beach restaurant has the best breakfast and lunch.   
We waited 30min at the Blue Agave to be served. Ended up waking out.  

Entertainment 

They had entertainment every night.  
The ginger sports bar was relaxing 

I’d give this place a 5 star if the food was better, the concierge service was better, and the spa was functional.  You really can’t beat the facilities though. Really beautiful and clean.  

I would come back.   Hope this helps!

reviews.author: Priya Kang
reviews.title: Going back for sure!
reviews.text: I had an amazing trip here! Everyone is extremely friendly and more then willing to go above and beyond to make everyone happy and satisfied. The hotel itself was extremely clean and the overall aesthetic was stunning. Atilano, one of our servers was so sweet and truly went above and beyond with my sister and I. The boys at the swim-up bar, I don't know their names other than Victor, were so kind and made us feel extremely comfortable and helped us out with anything when asked. Augustin (I believe that is his name) who organized/helped with events also made sure my sister and I were enjoying our time, making sure to introduce us fun activities for the duration of our time there any chance he got. Overall, this was an extremely great, kind and genuine staff as well as beautiful hotel.

reviews.author: Cynthia G
reviews.title: The staff here at Paradisus Cancun are amazing!
reviews.text:
Besides being in paradise with a beautiful beach and amazing ocean colors , The Reserve at Paradisus Cancun is the way to go. To be honest, it’s the staff that made our stay here so memorable. 

Aaron our concierge was great and booked all of our dinners, and made sure we always had the right information for our stay. 

Oscar was the best! He really knows how to take care of his guests. Whether it was at the cabana side or at the breakfast spot (Sante) in the Reserve pool area, he made sure our drink were never empty, or brought us extra food without us asking such as toast & extra sauces to top off our omelette with. Oscar was amazing! 

Diego, also made sure we were taken care of and asked if there was anything else he could do to make our stay better. 

Ruben & Moises was also one of our others servers during our Cabana days at the Reserve side pool, they also went out of his way to get things for us & also made sure our drinks were full. 

Martin was probably one of the sweetest guys, he worked at the buffet and as soon as he found out my husband and I were on our honeymoon, he went out of his way to make us special mimosas to celebrate. 

Another shout out is to a server that worked at the Cielo restaurant, I forgot his name but he served us the night of Sunday 10/31 & another guy we can’t remember that works at the Italian restaurant took care of us as well! He served us the night of Monday 11/1, he brought us champagne to celebrate our honeymoon. 

Again, if it wasn’t for the staff here at Paradisus, we wouldn’t have had the same experience. These guys work their butt off & a little extra love from their guests (tips $) wouldn’t hurt!

reviews.author: Marc D
reviews.title:
Amber Gaspard
Room 3347
reviews.text: Sergio was excellent, and he made sure our pool experience was great each day. The food at the snack bar was decent, and the food at the buffet always seemed to be fresh. We at dinner at Sal on our last night and had Ignacio as a waiter. His service was very good as well.

reviews.author: Peter I
reviews.title: very good service in the "Royal Service" or "Reserved" zone
reviews.text: sehr guter Service in der "Royal Service" oder "Reservierten" Zone im Restaurant La Palapa, am Pool und an den Liegen "Bali Beds". They speak good English and fulfill every wish. The best breakfast and lunch until 5 pm. And the best and most attentive staff.

reviews.author: Gloria
reviews.title: I want to go back!
reviews.text:
This hotel is off the bat mesmerizing, I for one really enjoyed the clean architecture and the sophisticated yet "natural" interior design theme of the resort. We stayed 10 nights on The Reserve (formally known as Royal Service) Deluxe Ocean View Sweet ;) and we got exactly what the pictures  on the Melia website showed when I booked it. We got the room on the first floor and the view from there was still a spectacular one. The biggest incentive this room had was I could jump out of the balcony and go reserve a Bali bed with Max in less than a minute. Ese Argentino was very helpful! 

With the Reserve add on you get your own personal concierge who tries to go the extra mile for you and really makes this vacation experience a lot more relaxing. Ours was Rafael and he was attentive and helpful. The Reserve is it's own Pyramid, and when you step outside of your room you can go to it's main lobby area and grab a quick bite, a cappuccino or any alcoholic / non alcoholic beverage your heart desires. 

The food here was good for the most part, but the one dish I couldn't get enough of was the catch of the day; an entire fried fish plus a side of Greek salad with avocado and a side of habanero sauce from the Sante restaurant. This restaurant has the most attentive staff that really give it 100% to make you feel VIP at the Reserve Adults Only Pool. Julio really pampered us, and we looked forward to having him as our server, but then we met Joel, Cesar and Ruben at this place and they delivered to the standard that Julio had already placed forth.  

Another part of the resort my boyfriend and I enjoyed was the bar by the main lobby where they hold shows and have a live DJ every night. Gaby always made sure our drinks were always full and that we were having fun.

On our last day we booked a couples massage at YHI and the experience was the cherry on top. 

The takeaway here is The Reserve is completely worth it, the staff is phenomenal, the cabanas by the pool and beach were cozy and aesthetic, and the beach views are panoramic. We had a wonderful stay and we wish to go back very soon.

reviews.author: jalisaj23
reviews.title: Good for the money.
reviews.text: Had a nice time. The hotel is beautiful. Staff is very attentive except for when I asked for more towels it took over an hour to get them. The food is okay but this is typical of all inclusive resorts. Overall we had a lovely time and I would definitely come back again. The concierge and staff and very kind and helpful.

reviews.author: Crystal V
reviews.title: Fuego food & service
reviews.text: Edie and Edier were our servers and definitely went above and beyond for us. This is by far the Best restaurant (and we tried many) in this hotel in our opinion. The Food was great great and the service was great 10/10

reviews.author: Rachel
reviews.title: 10 year wedding anniversary
reviews.text:
We booked the Reserve as we were there without the kiddos to celebrate our 10 year wedding anniversary. We didn't ask much of our concierge other than to make dinner reservations and help us with gym times...and he didn't do anything more than that. We were a little surprised he didn't make a notation with any of our reservations about our anniversary to the staff to at least have them say something upon check in. Shout out to the staff at Enso, when we told them they brought us a bottle of bubbly to the table. Vento was our least favorite, appetizers were good but the main dishes were subpar. They put us in Malva seating with very bright lights, we asked if we could wait for a table in the more intimate main area and it seemed like we personally offended our waiter. I wasn't impressed and would recommend just about any other restaurant for dinner. Best lunch award went to Fuego (market grill on their website...I'll get to that). Overall, other than our Vento experience we really enjoyed the food.
The Excellent: Daniel the manager(?) for the Reserve area. La Palapa was closed 2 out of 4 days for hurricane repair. He was gracious, kind, checked in on us multiple times throughout the day and definitely runs a tight ship. Aaron at the Reserve pool was just as wonderful. He made sure we had the same Bali bed daily, stored floats for us. These two individuals alone made our stay. The room was great, being in a more quiet area was perfect for us.
The Good: We probably should have been more forceful in our request for top shelf. We took the opportunity to try things new or different. There is NO drink menu to speak of. I asked if there were specialty drinks at each location. Passion fruit margarita and tamarind margarita stood out as some of our favorites. No timeshare pressure at all, was prepared for a polite no but never needed it.
The Covid: Gym is limited to about 4 or 5 people, I'm a workout nut,  I don't miss a day the gym closed early in my opinion and it was difficult to get a good workout time. I booked Reserve to have spa access for the hydrotherapy area...no hydrotherapy due to covid restrictions (understandable). Maybe our concierge would have left us a dessert in our room if not for covid restrictions...
The Bad: The app is horrible. It is awful. DO NOT expect it to work correctly. It had wrong times for restaurants (closed when open, open for al a cart when not open at all), wrong menus (2 lunch menus at 1 location), not clear how to get food descriptions (tap on the item you will get a description, it doesn't look clickable). The most frustrating thing about the app was actually our room service. I ordered coffee to have while getting ready, 1st day it showed accepted, coffee was late, I called they said their was an issue, they brought it immediately, day 2 worked fine. Day 3 they claimed they never received the order. Just call, save yourself the frustration. I wouldn't trust it to  make my dinner reservations if you are not reserve. La Palapa was closed for repairs for 2 days. They set up a little breakfast and lunch area in tower 5 but it wasn't made to order and wasn't near the quality of what we did have at la Palapa. I would have opened another space for al a cart for Reserve guests personally. The really bad though was when our concierge said he set up our bellman service on our last day. We waited as late as we could to still make our shuttle and no bellman arrived. A guest services rep came to ask about our stay as we were walking out the door with our luggage in hand. She seemed apologetic is the most I could say about that experience she carried one bag, while my husband and I carried the rest. We were livid, it was our last impression and I don't think we will try a Melia brand again.
#rayraythegatherer

reviews.author: Nyctraveler3737
reviews.title: Viva Mexico
reviews.text: I had the pleasure of staying here for the thanksgiving weekend. The property is beautiful and kept very clean. Our butler Violet, did an amazing job of attending to us and making sure we received what we needed. I highly recommend staying here and look forward to returning.

reviews.author: Kdiane30
reviews.title: Paradisus was unbelievably fabulous. It set the bar high for any other resorts,
reviews.text:
I could go on and on about every aspect of this resort from the smooth and inviting check-in procedure, to the exquisite décor and room, to the delicious restaurants, and to the amazing views.  However, I want to take the time to tell you about the wonderful restaurant Fuego and the amazing staff at this restaurant.  Guillermo is Fuego's restaurant supervisor.  He is a beautiful human being who runs a fabulous service staff.  He is professional, yet kind and warm-hearted. He truly made our evening meals perfecto!  Along with Guillermo is an incredible waiter, Joel.  He was attentive, professional, and totally "on-point,"  Fuego is lucky to have such a professional waiter.  The rest of Fuego's wait staff was amazing as well.  I can say that Guillermo, Joel and the staff at Fuego made a life long impression with myself and my husband, John.  When we return, one of the first things we will do is look for these amazing men.  Now for Fuego's food.  OMG..... Everything we ate (regardless if it was lunch or dinner) was OUTSTANDING.  If you love seafood, this is the restaurant for you.  Besides Fuego (our absolute favorite), Mole was delicious and Paradisus has the most exceptional breakfast and lunch buffet my husband  and I have every experienced.  We normally cruise a few times a year and enjoy fine dining on the cruises.  I have to say that Paradisus will not disappoint.  
         The resort was very clean and following all of the CDC guidelines.  Every employee  (inside and outside) was in a mask and there was hand sanitizer everywhere for use.  They did a great job keeping the guests socially distant, yet still made you feel like everything was "normal."
         The pools and grounds were beautiful.  The entire resort really created a sensory overload. While we are not big drinkers, the drinks were fabulous and all made with top shelf liquors.  
        If you want a 5-star all-inclusive resort with a value for your money, Paradisus Cancun is my recommendation.  I would rebook tomorrow if I had the money.

reviews.author: Ann
reviews.title: True Paradise!!
reviews.text: I had never stayed at one of the Melia hotels before but chose this hotel based on the amenities and reviews.  I read about The Reserve packages, and since we had not been able to travel this year, we decided to splurge and spend the extra on the room.  First......the good things.  You absolutely are treated like royalty.  We had 10 people in our party with 5 different rooms.  We had one butler, Rode, assigned to us during our stay.  There was NOTHING that Rode would or could not do for us.  The staff all knew our names and were constantly checking to see if we needed anything.  If you stay in The Reserve section of the hotel, you have a different, private pool, your own "Bali beds", your own bartender and waiter and a separate restaurant out by the pool and beach.  However, you still have access to every restaurant and amenity in the hotel.  Buckets of water, beer and cold drinks are left at your Bali bed.  You have a bartender constantly coming by to get your drink order and another waiter bringing you all the food you can consume.....right at the pool.  They made reservations for us each night at the different restaurants and each one was a different type of food but so outstanding.  You will never get better service.  The hotel is beautiful.  The beach is gorgeous.  The pools are beautiful.  Absolutely 6 STAR all the way!!!  I do have a few complaints / or suggestions for other travelers.  This hotel is not very ADA friendly.  We had one guest with us that had to use a cane to walk and couldn't handle stairs well.  The elevators are not very convenient and they do not stop at every level.....to get to all of the restaurants and bars.  Also.....this hotel is MASSIVE.  You do a lot of walking.  But, it was well worth it to be able to see the entire property and enjoy every restaurant.  I would recommend staying in The Reserve section, for the service you receive.  However, that part of the hotel is a little more secluded so if you want to enjoy every amenity in the hotel, you will have to do some walking.  Or, if you just want to be secluded, The Reserve has everything you need right in that section.  This hotel is just far enough out of town to enjoy the peace and beauty of the beach.  But, the staff suggested that we take the bus into town to shop and it was super easy.  Just hop on the bus for $1.00 and they will tell you where to get off.  I would HIGHLY recommend this resort again and already planning my next stay.  If you stay in The Reserve, ask for Rode as your butler.  He was part of our family before we left!!!  Truly the best!!!

reviews.author: Alexandria S
reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: Orlando and all of the staff were amazing! They made us feel so welcomed and I would definitely come back to visit again! Very nice place and clean. They helped my boyfriend who got hurt every step along the way to ensure the best stay.

reviews.author: Nalinitaa
reviews.title: Beautiful memories to be cherished
reviews.text:
This resort was amazing.The staff, the people around were all so friendly. We did the ocean front view reserve suite, and let me tell you that the view is breathtaking. Special thanks to Rode, our butler, who went above and beyond to make sure our stay was perfect. He took care of our dinner reservations, helped us book our activities and even got some toys for our sons who just loved them.
We were very impressed with how very well the hotel was organised during Covid. The buffet had someone serving you at each station, so that nobody touches the spoons and laddles, we had to wear masks while lining up and maintain 6 feet apart. They thought of everything. Buffet food was delicious.We will be going back there for sure. Absolutely recommend this resort. You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: Steven N
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Had an excellent week at the Paradisus. The beach was beautiful and the service was amazing. We especially enjoyed our morning breakfast due to the excellent service provided by our waiter Victor Cavich.

reviews.author: juliessan
reviews.title: The reviews are real
reviews.text:
This is an old hotel. It does not even have USB port on the rooms, absolutely neccesary to charge your phone on vacations. The employees are not as attentive compare to other hotels, probably because they are overworked. Seeing an overworked employee during your vacations makes it difficult for your self to relax, you dont receive a good treatment and can feel the stress of the employee. 
The food is not good at all, plus you have to make reservations at the restaurants because if not you wont have anything to eat, there is no a 24hrs restaurant open and everything closes at 10pm.
The price, compare to others in the area is not as cheap and the others hotels looked way better.
They also try to charge me a room service I did not asked for. It made me get worry because I did not knew if it was the hotel trying to charge more or someone was actually at my room at certain point given the room next door was forced during my staying. 
The only good factor is they follow lots of regulations related to Covid-19 but that was all over Cancún, not exclusively from the hotel.
I did saw some “not good reviews” before booking; the same as the one im providing here but I tought “this is just people who like to complain, Meliá’s hotel has always had good reputation”. After this experience, realized all the reviews were true and I dont think I will pick a Meliá anymore.

reviews.author: Jenessa Rodriguez
reviews.title: Ok
reviews.text: Check in was very slow, and unorganized. No clear direction on facility, restaurants, and available services. I don’t think the team was attentive, pool closed early, jacuzzi was cold. Restaurant was ok but food was poor quality.

reviews.author: Mari SB
reviews.title: Fabulous stay at the Paradisus!
reviews.text:
Just returned from a week long stay at the Paradisus Reserve to celebrate our anniversary and we had a fantastic time at the resort!

We got paired with Rodolfo as our butler and he went above and beyond to make sure that our anniversary was special.  From booking our dinners at the different restaurants, making sure our needs were always met, and coordinating special treats and celebrations Rodolfo made it happen.  He was always responsive, professional and friendly and when we return next year, we will definitely be requesting him again!!

By the pool, a big shout out to Aaron, Miguel, Cesar, Valeria and especially Josue who made sure we were always taken care of and kept the party going every day.

All the restaurants are very good, but our favorite, hands down, is Fuego!  Delicious food and special thanks to Chef Angel, Guillermo and Joel who surprised us with a very special dinner on our last evening.  Truly unforgettable!

As far as Covid-19 measures go, the hotel is extremely clean, has hand and shoe sanitation stations at every entrance.  Your room is disinfected and secured before you arrive and you have to give permission for any staff member to enter during your stay.  The buffet is still in operation however you cannot serve yourself, there are servers present at every station to serve your plate for you.  Also, all silverware is disinfected and sealed for every meal and there are no more paper menus, all menus are now accessed through a QR Code using your smartphone.

The beach is a bit eroded due to a couple of hurricanes that hit in October, however it seems to be coming back now that things are calming down.  Also as a result of the hurricanes, there were several repairs being done in the Reserve pool area during the last couple of days of our stay.

All in all, a wonderful and memorable experience and cannot wait to return!!!

reviews.author: Vi Ngo
reviews.title: An Amazing Experience!
reviews.text: We had our wedding at Paradisus Cancun in 6/2019 and the accommodations we got were far beyond expectation. Our room was upgraded to the Royal Service (now called the Reserve) with no charge. Our butler Hector followed through with every single request we had, even for our wedding guests, and made us feel cared for despite the busiest time of the year at the resort. Our wedding coordinator Marlene also followed through with every details we discussed and stayed with the wedding the entire time to make sure everything goes as planned. Words cannot express how much I appreciated the top-notch service and how much I'm impressed with this resort. After the wedding, we were gifted a 2-night stay certificate and we were 100% certain we will come back. Due to Covid-19, the resort gracefully extended our certificate to the end of 2020 and we made it back in 11/2020! It felt incredible to be back to where we got married, the resort was still just as beautiful as we remember and the employees were just as friendly and welcoming despite the tough year everyone went through. We decided to upgrade our room because we know it is worth it. The Royal Service is now called the Reserve but it is the same quality and awesomeness. One thing that I continue to be impressed with the resort is how good the food is. Every restaurant I tried, the food is just so good. I don't know how I could ever go to a different resort when I come back to Cancun, because Paradisus Cancun is the definition of perfection.

reviews.author: Ro B.
reviews.title: Birthday weekend
reviews.text: I had a great birthday weekend at Paradisus Cancun. I stayed in the reserve luxury junior ocean front suite with butler and concierge service. Rode', our Butler, was fantastic. He planned all of our reservations for dinner and helped with any issues we may have had. In reference to the hotel, it is beautiful. Is was very clean and I appreciated their policy and hard work in relation to Covid-19 safety. In reference to the food Definitely, the best restaurant to us, hands down, in relation to options and flavor, was Malva Restaurant. Definitely looking forward to returning late July or August 2021.

reviews.author: Zuleima T
reviews.title: Mole restaurant
reviews.text: Coming from family of cooks, food is always critisized, must say hands down Mole was one of the best experiences my palate has ever had. Our server was outstanding, Javier Salazar was perfectly splendid and was able to direct us to what dishes would be very delicious. Let me start of with the “Sopes .. which were not your tipical sopes, but the flavors melted in your mouth, And dont get me started with the Tixtihuil Shrimp, they were perfection and the mixture of flavors paired with them made every bite to look forward too, just wanted more, and just top it off with that churro desert, its a must have dont care how full you are!!” My hats of to Chef Yohari and thank you Javier for the great experience you gave us at Mole it was memorable there should be more waiters like you out there!!

reviews.author: BLAworldTraveler
reviews.title: A must visit resort!
reviews.text:
DO.NOT.SLEEP.ON.THIS.RESORT!
I came here last week to celebrate my 30th birthday. I came with my boyfriend and we had visited their location in Punta Cana DR last year for my birthday. We stay AMAZED by the staff who constantly, throughout the day, maintain the beauty that is this resort. The view is STUNNING! The staff is so sweet, so fun and very attentive. We reserved the adults only side of the hotel (The Reserve) which gains you access to adults only restaurants and pools along side your adults only hotel room levels. The restaurant "La Palapa" has a gorgeous view and open air grill for a hot and delicious breakfast and lunch. The servers are incredible (shout out to Miguel & Cesar!), and if you appreciate spice their habanero hot sauce is a must (tread lightly, you've been warned!). Our butler, Galindo, was one of a kind! Always checking in with us, making our dinner reservations, recommending a spot for lunch, making sure we had a bottle of champagne in our mini bar and securing a sweet birthday surprise at my birthday dinner! 10/10! Vento is a gorgeous "river side" Italian spot that we visited twice. Can't go wrong with anything on the menu! Enso and Sal steak house weren't open while we were visiting (#COVID 2020). We also drooled over the tacos at Blue Agave, don't skip the pastor tacos (worth every bite)! We attended Mole for my birthday and it was such a pretty set up by the pool, the food was incredible and definitely eat the churros (so yummy)! Fuego was a great spot for night entertainment and a show, pool side dinner spot (food was decent). Malva for breakfast is a must, everything was so good and they have a huge selection for everyone! Bana is their Asian inspired sushi spot and it was honestly our least favorite, only because everything else was sooooo good! We love sushi, but it felt like an after thought. Try everything else first! The staff was sweet, the grounds keepers worked their butt off all day, the entertainment was so fun, the food was amazing, the service incredible (unmatched! our favorite resort by Melia thus far) and the rooms were clean and felt super COVID safe. Enjoy your stay!

reviews.author: Kimberly W
reviews.title: 5 Days in Paradise???
reviews.text:
THE GOOD:

COVID safety measures: made us feel comfy in our stay. Mask worn by all. Temperature checks when entering the resort and every morning at breakfast. 
Lots and lots of cleaning. Hand sanitizing stations everywhere. 

STAFF: Friendly and helpful!  Special thanks to Christen for making breakfast one of our favorite experiences during our stay! Atilano, Raul (consierge), Sergio & Laura (poolside) took great care of us. 

BREAKFAST & LUNCH: omelette and pasta dishes made fresh! Green juice and buffet options were plenty!

BEACH & POOL: Beautiful, clean, and not crowded. Hardly any seaweed. Vendors were not aggressive. Spent most of our time at the beach.

ENTERTAINMENT: Great! We really enjoyed the Latin girl band at poolside. Music by the beach daily (on one side). 

THE BAD:

DINNER: left much to be desired. We found the best menu at the Asian fusion restaurant but on the last night, they served me cold food. 
Then I ordered room service because I was still hungry and that meal was ALSO cold.  No bueno.

LEAKS: minor leaks throughly the building. Mostly in the hallway to our room and covered by towels. This was minor for us but worth mentioning. 

BEDDING: the bed is decent but the pillows stink. They are very comfortable but who wants a pillow that smells like burp? Everytime you adjust your head, it unearths that awful smell again. Ugh. I’m  not sure if it’s because of what’s inside of the pillows, but I hope they consider changing this. 

THE UGLY:

The GIANT centipede (the length of my middle finger) that crawled onto my face as I slept in bed the night before departure. It was the parting gift that I never wanted. Lol. Needless to say, we didn’t get much sleep after that. I told the guy at checkout and he didn’t seem to care at all. 

CONCLUSION: This is our second stay at Paradisus. While we loved our first experience at the Playa location via Royal experience, we most certainly won’t be returning to this location.

reviews.author: Juan G
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun - Increible Experience
reviews.text:
My family and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun for the first time. I was booked in a non ocean view room and Julian at front desk to care of us. He was able to switch our room to a ocean view for my little ones and wife to enjoy an amazing vacation.

The staff was amazing everywhere we went. Special thanks to Julian (front desk), Ignacio (Fuego Restaurant), Orlando (Fuego Restaurant), Francisco (Pool side) and many others that I dont recall their name.

In addition Paradisus Cancun had a great safety protocol to keep their guest free of Covid.

Look forward to visiting again!

reviews.author: steveg12xTurqoise
reviews.title: Parisus Cancun - Reserve, Nov 2020
reviews.text:
nice property,  The Reserve was very good as was the Butler service
could not get king size bed despite advance request
was not given credit for 2 nights my girlfriend left early due to work despite reservations saying it would be handled at Reception/check out

reviews.author: Tom H
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun reigns supreme with exceptional service
reviews.text:
Recently completed our 5th stay at the beautiful Paradisus Cancun. Pampered ourselves in the Reserve (formerly Royal Service) to enjoy a private pool and seaside restaurant (La Palapa), Bali bed use, and personal butler (Rossana). From the moment we arrived at the resort, we were greeted with perfect service. We came to this resort because of the offering of a tennis court, and were disappointed to learn upon arriving that the court was damaged by the hurricane. However, the manager of the Reserve - Sandra - went above and beyond to ensure the court was like new in just 2 days. Sandra was our guardian angel, ensuring that maintenance staff worked into the darkness to lay concrete for posts, install new posts and chain-link fencing around the court, and fix the net. Sandra was so amazing that we felt compelled to post this review. 

Sandra and Rossana worked together to see that we had special treats stocked in our mini-bar every night, and Sandra presented us with local Mexican presents on our final day. During our last meal at Vento restaurant (the 3-cheese pizza is delicious), we were presented with complimentary champagne and strawberries dipped in chocolate! We enjoyed all the restaurants, with our favourites being Vento (Italian)and Fuego (South American). Bana (sushi) was also good, and Mole (Mexican) was okay. The nightly entertainment was good, and Aaron was very attentive by the pool.

Staff worked hard to have us feeling very safe during the pandemic, always wearing masks and providing ample hand sanitizer.

We highly recommend Paradisus Cancun if you want a quiet, relaxing, seaside getaway, with top drawer service!

reviews.author: Domingo Pisana
reviews.title: Best Resort In Cancun!
reviews.text: I highly recommend Rodolfo for butler service! Everything we needed, he exceeded expectations! We stayed a total of eight days all inclusive and I recommend Bana restaurant in the hotel. The alcohol is not watered down and you get what you pay for!

reviews.author: Yaya
reviews.title: The best vacation
reviews.text:
I had an amazing time!! 
Saul and Noe were great host! Make sure you do an activity while you are in Cancun they will show you a great time! I will definitely be back! 
Great hotel, great staff, great beach!

reviews.author: Joanna
reviews.title: Girls Trip
reviews.text: I just want to say that we had an Awesome time at the Paradisus Cancun. Everyone was very nice, Especially Cesar and Rode they made sure that we were having a time. They went above and beyond, superior customer service!!! I also want to add that the nice men that work at the Nepresso counter were great as well, always added extra happiness to my cup of coffee. I can't express enough how great this experience was.

reviews.author: Dalibor P
reviews.title: Had an awesome time (once again) with Reserve Service
reviews.text:
We are a family of 6 and had once again a great experience at Paradisus Cancun. This is the only resort we decided to come back to, and even in these challenging times, it did not disappoint. Pool is one of the best out there and ocean water has the color you’d expect in a paradise. Food is amazing at the buffet and specialized restaurants within the resort. Buffet is no longer self serve but they have plenty of personnel around to help you make your selections easy. You would not want everyone touching the same pair of tongs during these times anyways. They have managed the transition to Covid restrictions extremely well.

On a final note, I wanted to make sure Hector and his Reserve team are well recognized for what they do. Whenever and whatever we needed, Hector made sure we get, whether it’s a question we needed answered, fridge filled, reservation made, you name it. I have absolute confidence that this level of attentiveness would satisfy the most demanding of customers out there.

I will return again when the opportunity knocks.

reviews.author: Letisha G
reviews.title: Girls Weekend
reviews.text: Had an amazing weekend and the best send off with the great service provided my Rode and Cesar. Rodé was an amazing host and made sure we were well taken care of. Cesar was a great server and made sure the drinks kept on coming ;) Thank you again!

reviews.author: SunTrip
reviews.title: We Keep Going Back!
reviews.text:
We've had amazing experiences at Paradisus! The most recent trip was this month (November), and it was beautiful! We always stay in the adults only section, so I can only speak to that, but I've absolutely loved every visit to Paradisus Cancun. We were apprehensive with the pandemic, but all of us really needed a mental break and we wanted to go somewhere that would allow us to be outside for a majority of the time. 

There have been changes since Covid to the resort. There are definitely less staff members, no more open buffets, and they are rotating which restaurants are open each night. I'd recommend eating at the restaurants and not ordering room service or pool service - the restaurant food is FAR better during the pandemic (i would assume due to smaller staff). All of the restaurants were great, but Fuego was our favorite. The fish was SO fresh and everything we ordered there was amazing. 

Our Butler, Galdino, was incredible. He was so kind and helpful. We never had to book our own reservation, he checked in on us daily, made sure we had Bali beds, and genuinely seemed interested in making sure we had the best visit possible. 

The adults only pool is great, we stayed outside all day long between the pool and the beach. Only down side is that there's no swim up bar in the adult pool, but the staff is so attentive and brings your drink to you while you swim or sunbathe. The beach in Cancun is honestly unbeatable. The water is insanely beautiful and you really can't believe your eyes. 

The rooms are very nice as well! The bathrooms in the adults only end are decadent, there's a sitting area, and we did an ocean front room so we had beautiful views from our balcony. Only caveat is the mattress - if you don't sleep well on a more firm mattress, then you may be in pain. My boyfriend cannot sleep on firm mattresses, and he was very uncomfortable by the end, but I was completely fine. 

Overall we had an amazing stay and we were so happy to spend time safely outdoors. If you're looking for a place to get away from the craziness and spend some time outside - this is it! If you visited during Covid as your first visit, I HIGHLY recommend returning to the resort for another visit once everything is back up and running. It's truly is a beautiful place to stay, and it's even better when they're able to operate at full capacity again. 

My only request to to the resort - PLEASE enforce mask wearing more! You're told to wear masks while indoors, not inside your rooms, and not while actively eating, but in every other circumstance a mask should be worn. You're informed of this policy at check-in, and through signage within the resort. However, there were many times where I saw groups of people indoors, standing around, and not wearing a mask. I never saw a staff member ask people to put on masks, and that was very disappointing. This pandemic is really serious, and I understand everyone needs an outlet for a mental break at this point. However, it needs to be done safely and the only way to contain this virus until we have a vaccine is by wearing a mask. Please, please, please ask staff to enforce this rule more. Want everyone, guests and staff, to stay safe!

reviews.author: Betty I
reviews.title: Mrs
reviews.text: excellent service, activities program for children in which the staff is really careful with them, the activities for teenagers are fun and the staff in charge are very friendly and attentive, with a staff always ready to help you, excellent food and drinks.  We felt safe everything was clean and sanitized.

reviews.author: KIM
reviews.title: Okay but not great
reviews.text: This resort is beautiful hands down. That's pretty much where it ends. The food is average at best. Breakfast is the same everyday. You will wait 15 minutes after getting your food for condiments to arrive to your table. By then your food is cold. The mixes they have for drinks are way to sweet and they have no natural fruit to make daiquiris with. It's all nasty concentrated overly sweet juice. There are no straws at the resort. We went to the Mole restaurant and there was no one in there but were told we needed to have made a reservation 3 hours prior. Meanwhile the staff was standing around talking to each other. Enso is absolutely horrible food and staff. I find the people with good reviews have paid extra to stay in the Reserve but you shouldn't have to upgrade and pay more when you arrive to have decent service and food. Also, the music by the pool is terrible except for when the dj plays only a couple times a week. If he's not there it's the same boring beat day in and day out. I wanted to love this resort. It was on my bucket list. It missed the mark.

reviews.author: carpediem
reviews.title: Amazing getaway
reviews.text:
The attention to detail, the friendliness and cleanliness were top notch. They are taking every precaution due to Covid from labels on the floor to mats, to remote controls covered in plastic. The attention we received from Cesar and Rode from the VIP section were unmatched. They went over and beyond to make sure feel at home. The 5th pyramid had a premium liquor station and bar where they had food and a coffee stand. Would love to have that back soon. Orlando our waiter was amazing, friendly and always happy to help. 

Overall our say was amazing and would recommend it. We were being taken care of beyond what we expected.

reviews.author: David A
reviews.title: Great get away
reviews.text: We had an amazing time at Paradisus Cancun last week. It is a beautiful resort. They are taking every precaution In respect to COVID. Our butler Violeta was amazing!!! She took care of us Beyond our expectations. This was our first time at this resort. We will definitely be going back. All the staff members around the Reserve pool area are great Aaron got us the same Bali bed daily as the pool was not crowded. Can’t wait to go again.

reviews.author: Cooki
reviews.title: Home Away From Home
reviews.text: I've been a guest at Paradisus Cancun more than a dozen times, so obviously I continue to be satisfied after each visit. The staff, atmosphere, food and drinks all combined are why I'm a repeat customer. My last visit was early Nov 2020 during the week hurricane Eta was slowly churning off the coast. During my four day stay I only got MAYBE 30 minutes of sunbathing in, so I did what most travelers in Cancun would do during inclement weather, eat and drink! I stuffed myself with tacos at Blue Agave and they make THE BEST passion fruit margarita! By the way, Royal Service is now called The Reserve, but the same great service is provided and it is well worth the upgrade. The poolside restaurant La Palapa, which is exclusive to Reserve guests, has a delicious shrimp tempura on the menu. This resort's vibe is generally on the lowkey and laid back side, so if you're looking for a rowdy atmosphere you might consider other resorts that provide more of a party scene or you can create your own party at Paradisus. I've tried a few other resorts in between my stays at Paradisus and although Paradisus still remains my favorite I do have a couple suggestions I think would make the experience even better. Including hibachi in Bana the Asian restaurant would add an exciting option for dinner. Also, a sports bar with many TVs showing sports from around the world, especially NFL, would be a nice way to catch a game or two without having to retreat to your room and still have that vacation feel. These are the only amenities I see lacking from this resort that many other resorts in Cancun and Riviera Maya already provide. Paradisus is a great resort; these additions would make it top notch. I will be returning to Paradisus Cancun regardless. See you soon!

reviews.author: mehjgmty
reviews.title: Not able to provide adequate service
reviews.text:
The location is beautiful and the architecture is impressive, and the buffet is tasty. However, in the wake of the pandemic, they are understaffed and disorganized, unprepared to handle sometimes basic elements of hospitality under current circumstances. We had a series of problems, and despite reporting them and talking with customer service, they apologized but didn't do much to fix, much less compensate for, the many inadequacies and inconveniences. We did not get what we paid for, and would not go back.

Specifically:
We were given no information when we arrived, not even the wifi. Our room wasn't ready, although we arrived at 4:30 pm. The person who received us couldn't find us on the list at first, so we spent time waiting in line in the wrong reception area until that got worked out (because we kept asking until the staff got it right). 

There were two of us registered for the room, and they gave us just one room key card. The door was jammed the first time we tried to enter; the bellboy had to work hard to open it. We went later to get a second key card, and when we got to the room, it didn't work; we had to go back again to get another one.

There was no information in the room; we had to call reception to find out why (a pandemic safety measure). The app turned out to be the best source for info. However,
the code to activate the hotel's official app didn't work until hours after we arrived because they hadn't finished checking us in properly. I had to call the reception twice to get out activated.

The television was hung crooked, was is a picture on the wall (tilted in the opposite direction). The semi-transparent curtains were not entirely well hung (some of the hooks were off the rails.) The sofa felt saggy and didn't have any cushions for the lower back. The television was not properly adjusted; watching CNN on cable, the image was squashed up. We had to go into the TV settings and fix the proportions so we could watch TV properly. The first morning, there was a cockroach in our room.

The room service doesn't automatically replace the water bottles for free; we had to ask for bottles from the bar, and they are tiny. We were told by reception over the phone that we’d be charged for room service if we ordered water, although the app says it’s free.

The application and enforcement of health protocols was been inconsistent; often, the mats for disinfecting shoes were totally dry, there was almost never encouragement (much less a demand) to use hand sanitizer upon entering different areas of the hotel, and in the assisted buffet area only a few of the attendants enforced social distancing between people and distance of guests from the buffet (as indicated by the markings on the floor).

At breakfast in the buffet, the first day we had to ask the waiter for butter and maple syrup; it took easily 15 minutes to get, and my food was cold by the time it arrived.

On Friday we made a reservation using the Melià app at the Enso restaurant. As there was no map as to where the restaurants are, at the time of our reservation we had to go to another restaurant (Fuego) and ask where it is located; the employee told us, and we headed over. When we arrived, it was closed, with a sign saying “closed: private event.” We went back to Fuego and the person who received us didn’t know why Enso was closed. We tried to make a new reservation at Fuego for four people for 7:30pm (it was almost 7PM and the restaurant was almost totally empty) but he told us he couldn’t do that, and he couldn’t give us a table for four immediately unless all four of us were there, because it was all booked up (he didn’t check). We eventually convinced him to let us have a table for four although only two of us were there; our friends arrived about 10 minutes later (and the restaurant never filled up while we were there, so there would not have been any problem). While there, we found out through a chat with customer service that Enso had been moved to a different space due to the weather. We had a reservation, and were never informed, and the staff at the other restaurant didn’t know either.
