On Saturday, we went down to the beach. We wanted to use one of the square “camastros”; the available ones didn’t have the curtains up, but we were told they’d hang the curtains if we rented one. A few minutes later, we did rent one, and then they told us there weren’t any more curtains. The bed was wet and dirty with sand; we were told the staff would clean it off for us. They never did. We ended up asking for more beach towels and hanging them ourselves, instead of curtains, and covering the mattress with them. (Since the mattress is covered with a removable cloth, the right thing to do would have been for the staff to simply change the covering.) There were no cushions. We ordered food, and it took 30-45 minutes for the food to arrive, which is way too long for something as simple as chicken wings or grilled vegetables.

In the evening, we went to the Enso restaurant (which was open and in its place this time). The waiter wasn’t familiar with the menu, and made a series of mistakes in taking our order and in delivering the food to the right person. I ordered ramen soup (the only soup on the menu) and what I got was soup with a totally different kind of noodle (flat and thin) in a very small amount, with lots of pork. Ramen soup should have ramen noodles, and lots of them; the pork and other ingredients accompany the ramen, but the noodles are the main ingredient (hence the name, “ramen soup”). I got the impression that they didn’t want to say they didn’t have ramen, and the cook improvised. The customer service we'd talked to after our problems the previous day, and who made our new dinner reservation, had told us they'd send us a treat at dinner to make up for the trouble; they didn't.

At no time did we get the feeling that the employees were slacking off, rude, careless, etc.; on the contrary, they were clearly doing their best, and they were friendly and attentive to the extent they could be. However, more than one of them told us that there was simply nothing more they could do. We could see that the hotel is currently understaffed, and the workers in some cases have been clearly feeling frustrated and impotent in the face of the situation.

reviews.author: Christian
reviews.title: Best resort experience ever!
reviews.text: This was my first time at a resort and Paradisus Cancun did not disappoint! From the clear blue beaches, fine restaurants inside to the atmosphere the resort gave off, I was immediately taken back. To top it all off, our butler, Rode had welcomed us with open arms and treated us as if we were one of his own. His top notch expertise in telling us what the resort offered helped my partner and I decide what we wanted to do and he would reserve whatever it was we wanted to do that day/night. If I were to come back to Cancun, I would definitely choose Paradisus over any other resort! PARADISUS FOR THE WIN WOOT WOOT!!

reviews.author: Kaden K
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text:
Stayed here for a week on a company trip. There were some stand out employees! Salvador is the best bar tender ever, he was crazy busy but made you feel important and was creative with drinks and remembered you each time you would come up. His team was very helpful as well of Karina and Sofonia were making sure the drinks were passed out and collected so the area remained clean. 

Also my wife and I had a couples massage and Anna had as our masseuse. She gave the best massage I’ve ever had, I would highly recommend getting a massage by her to anyone who stays here.

reviews.author: Mary
reviews.title: Amazing experience as Reserve guests. 100% Recommend!
reviews.text:
My partner and I stayed here for four nights (11/08-11/12) and had the best experience. As Reserve guests we had extra perks such as access to a private pool with Bali beds, beach area, and having a butler. Our butler was Rode and he was amazing with helping us and giving us restaurant recommendations for our stay. He ensured our reservations were always ready and that we had everything we needed. Thank you so much Rode!! As a native New Yorker I’ve had the real deal when it comes to Peruvian, Japanese, Thai, and Italian and I can say with confidence that the food here at their speciality restaurants as well as the buffet is amazing!! The property itself is absolutely spotless and so stunning. Service is impeccable. I’ve stayed at most major resort chains (RIU, Iberostar, Dreams, Barceló) and in terms of service Paradisus definitely ranks number one. The staff is so kind, so attentive, and so eager to make sure you’re having a good time and feel taken care of. 
Special shout-out to Elijio who was one of our waiters by the pool. I wish I had made a note of more names to mention because so many people really went above and beyond for us. 

In terms of COVID protocols they take your temperature and info before entering every restaurant and at the buffet servers serve you as opposed to you serving yourself. All staff is wearing masks 24/7 and they are doing a good job at being safe. As a guest you are to wear your mask if you are not at the pool, beach, or eating/drinking. 

With regards to the type of guests staying here, we saw couples, families, young friend groups- so I think you’ll have a good time regardless of age. Note that the Reserve areas are for adults only. 

Bottom line- don’t hesitate in spending the extra money for Reserve (well worth it) and consider this property for your next stay in Cancun!

reviews.author: Claudia J
reviews.title: Best Time of 2020
reviews.text:
The food,atmosphere,the staff and location was simply perfect. We stayed at the Reserve and the experience was superb. Dining a la carte service was fast. Shout out to Miguel our waiter at lapalapa, Salvador he had us couple  nights at Avenue Bar. Everyone was super attentive HUGE HUGE thanks to Rode our butler he was EXCELLENT!! We arrived late than anticipated/starving and he personally booked us at last minute for lunch waited for us to be fed to continue with our check in,very attentive, He helped us plan a day trip to playa Norte everything was magical I’ve visited Cancun  this was by far my best experience.
THANK you all we will be back soon.

reviews.author: Ron Agudelo
reviews.title: Best vacation
reviews.text: My friends and I stayed for four days and we had our best vacation the hotel is beautiful and the attention was excellent especially from our butler Rodek he helped us en every request that we had and every single employee treat us very well definitely we will back again and hopefully soon

reviews.author: Gabecastaneda
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We arrived Thursday 11/5 just in time for for a tropical storm. Started off as a bad experience but Julio Ortega in reception took care of us and saved our trip. We had an excellent time overall and cant wait to return. Gracias Julio

reviews.author: Gato Felix
reviews.title: FAMILY vacation
reviews.text:
My wife, and kid and I had a great great experience stay  at this Hotel we just got back today 11/10/2020 and was there for 5 days , everyone was nice , the staffs member, the food was super great the snacks bar was on point , You Have to try their Fish Tacos the snack bar by the pool,  I want to give a HUGE shoutout to Rode for going above and beyond. I really meant it HE made us feel like The ROYAL family of England, very attentive Person  and educated , He definitely hooked us up as well as Sandra his manager she did her parts to make it even better . The guys at the pool BAR they  Rock, I had so many good drinks , so many different types of cocktails, real liquor not not water downMan go there you guys will enjoy it , the beach was super great and  the water was warm, the pool was Fantastic. I will recommend this hotel to many of my friends.  I have been in mexico about 7th times and this one was of the Bestttt !!!’ Thanks Rode and Sandra . You guys are the best . 

Thanks to “Colombia” and his partner at the pool bar “El gordito” those guys Rocks !!!! See you guys soon with the whole family 🙏🏽

reviews.author: Estefania
reviews.title: Loved it
reviews.text:
Just got back from our short stay. The resort was amazing and I felt safe with their covid19 protocols! The customer service at this place was superb and stood out the most! To me this is the most important when things go wrong. The staff was extremely friendly and attentive. Staff member Rode assisted us from check in to check out! He was truly the best and made our stay that much better.  Big thanks to him!

The only negative I can say is that our room was not ready at 3pm & when we did get our room the AC was malfunctioning and the bathroom door did not close. We also needed 2 beds instead of 1. However, Rode was efficient and assisted us with an upgraded room due to the inconvenience. He also assisted with dinner reservations, a late check out and cabanas by the pool. He was really there for us everyday with any questions or concerns.

The food was great with a versatile selection. We tried 3 a la carte restaurants. Fuego was my favorite.  The covid19 protocols make it extremely safe to eat at the buffet.  They enforce use of mask in common areas, temp checks and staff is also serving the food at the buffet instead of self serve option. Utensils are handed in a plastic bag, which is also used to store your mask away while eating.

Overall, I would definitely recommend and will be returning! It was an amazing stay.

reviews.author: Andres
reviews.title: Very good resort BUT...
reviews.text:
Just ending a 7 day stay in this beautiful resort. It’s your classic all-inclusive place where you definitely can and will have a very good time. We chose to stay at the adults only section (The Reserve) which is very well maintained. Some minor maintenance issues with our room which were promptly taken care of when reported. 

Food is all about hits and misses. Two outstanding restaurants (Mole and Vento), with the other ones being just ok. Nothing to write home about.

What really stands out in this resort is the above-and-beyond service attitude of the staff. They really make you feel welcome everywhere you go. A big thank you to all the staff at The Reserve pool and La Palapa. 

Covid protocols in place make you feel safe.

The “BUT” in my review is about the hotel not honoring the benefits of the MeliáRewards status (gold) which allows late checkout until 2 PM. They wanted me to pay $80 for something that I’m entitled to. Not a very good way to finish a very pleasant stay. 

Will I be back? Definitely yes. Hopefully next time food quality will be constant throughout all the restaurants, and management decides to read a little about what their loyal customers are offered.

reviews.author: Ana
reviews.title: My visit
reviews.text: The hotel is big and beautiful there were a fewer inconveniences but the pool concierge Aaron is wonderful! He is always willing to please! The Palapa restaurant was amazing! Over all a beautiful experience. Thank you Paradisus Cancún

reviews.author: Niko B
reviews.title: Don’t book wedding here
reviews.text:
Don’t book your wedding here! 
Since booking our wedding October 2019, the wedding department Adriana and Diana were a nightmare to work with. Just asking to sign a contract took forever for them to respond. Only communication with Diana the wedding planner was through email, which her responses would take a week to three weeks! I would ask Diana questions and not receive a response for a month to which she would reply she’s busy! I get you are busy but I am a paying bride! I work in customer service and never let my clients wait for answers to their needs. For a bride trying to plan a wedding in another country this is very frustrating! Diana has no idea how to work in customer service.
 Then comes the pandemic- which I had to pretty much beg them to let me reschedule my wedding due safety measures for my guests. Then the hotel closed due to covid, and no one from the hotel or my wedding planners told me! I had to find out when I called the hotel to ask a question. Receiving a refund from
The hotel for a trip I booked in March to plan took 7 months to receive and many emails and phone calls.
The hotel was closed from March and set to open July 1st. Found out on Facebook they extended the closing till October 1st! 
 The hotel opened October 15th then closed again a week later due to a hurricane and once again I found out on Facebook. Not my wedding planners. 
I emailed Diana to find out when they would reopen because my wedding was set for November 1st. She never responded. I found again yet again via Facebook the hotel would be closed for my wedding. Once I called the hotel and demanded to speak to a manager did I finally receive an email notice from Adriana the supposed wedding manager. A week before my wedding date the paradisus Cancun moved me to their sister hotel in playa del Carmen. Ridiculous! What a nightmare this hotel was to work with. If I could go back in time I wouldn’t have booked with them. Don’t get blinded by the beauty of the hotel. I’m still also waiting for my complimentary three night stay there that they promised me to soften the blow of them moving me and my guests last minute. I won’t hold my breath!!

reviews.author: Tamila A
reviews.title: After 10 years of visiting so disappointed now!
reviews.text: I totally understand Covid19 changed so many things for all of us but I never expected to write this review. We came here for beach and we always coming back to Cancun because my family loves waves, I have no idea what request lifeguards received from the management but this is absolutely unacceptable for not letting people to pour their legs into water.. Why we came here??? Buffet is not operational like before, food is cold and it's seems left overs from the previous day. Fridge is not restocked anymore, I have to chase all over resort to find water.. Where is our special crew??? Where is special service? No towels on the beach.. No swimming, no food.. I recommended this resort for years and I couldn't wait to come back and help my Mexican friends as I know the main industry is a tourism.. But wait.. I am working so hard to have 4 days of vacation and look at the sea??? Unbelievable.. Please change something or you lost my family as your longterm client and so many..

reviews.author: Matthew J
reviews.title: Excellent service, beautiful resort!
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus Cancun November 1-7, and had a great time, despite the weather from Hurricane Eta! Every interaction we had with staff was pleasant, and everyone there was so helpful and accommodating. Our butler, Rodolfo, was excellent, and easy to contact. The resort is beautiful, and pictures just can't do it justice. The food in every restaurant was high quality. We stayed in another resort for 1 day prior to our stay at Paradisus, in the same price range, and it was nowhere near as nice of a stay, which made us appreciate our stay that much more. Also, the staff at Coco's Beach bar did an excellent job of keeping us upbeat during bad weather. We will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Paul Velol
reviews.title: Had a great time !!
reviews.text:
We love Cancun always a great and relaxing time. 
First time we stayed here and was great!!
Beautiful hotel and grounds. 
We will stay here again!!
Food and drinks are great nothing to complain...
Staff is very friendly everyone is always saying hi and smiling. 
Waiters and bartenders the best !! 

Charlie from Club was very friendly and nice. 

Playing to go back next year for summer time and definitely will stay here again!!

Viva Mexico...

reviews.author: Alexandra Castro
reviews.title: Best Customer Service!
reviews.text:
I wanted to express my gratitude and appreciation for the service and care I received at the Paradisus Cancun, even despite having to evacuate 4 days earlier due to the hurricane. 

I wanted to shout out a few of your employees for their outstanding service– Cecilia Castro (The Reserve Check-In Agent), Victor (Beach Waiter), David (Spa Coordinator), Daniela (Masseuse), Valeria (Poolside Waitress), Daniel (F&B Manager), Guillermo (F&B Manager) and my absolute favorite, Rodolfo. 

Upon arrival, we were paired with Rodolfo as our Butler. Right away, he was professional, attentive, kind and super informative. He arranged every meal, activity and personally walked us around the property. I was completely blown away by his hospitality. I cannot express how much Rodolfo’s care and support meant to me! For that reason alone, I will be back to visit your hotel. 

Also, I have to make a quick note about your Operations Manager, Miguel Diaz and your Sales Team Members, Claudia Arbarca and Rebecca Bolio. In the midst of all the chaos, these three also every effort to check-in with me throughout my stay. I truly felt the love from your team. 

Your staff constantly went above and beyond to make sure I had a pleasant experience! I have to be honest and say this was definitely one of the best hotels I have ever experienced. From check-in to check-out, I truly felt like a valued, special guest.

P.S. PAY FOR AN UPGRADE! It is completely worth it. The Reserve is such a plus to experience.

reviews.author: Aleksandra S
reviews.title: Our wedding
reviews.text:
We had our wedding at Paradisus Cancun and were working the wedding planner Diana, the best wedding planner!!!!!
The whole planning process was smooth and stress free as we knew we had Diana to count on over in Mexico. The communication was always quick and very detailed. We were provided with precise answers to our countless questions, got amazing suggestions, and support. 

Upon arrival, we felt welcome and knew that everything was under control. Diana knew exactly what we wanted and our first meeting went smooth and we felt ready for our day.

Our welcome cocktail party was absolutely gorgeous and the perfect event for all of our friends and family to gather together on the first day in Mexico. 

The wedding day was absolutely amazing. Diana has been there for us for anything we needed, for all of our stressed and worried phone calls in the hours coming up to our wedding and always made sure that we have everything we needed as we prepared for the big moment. We truly appreciate that SO MUCH.

Everything at the ceremony and reception went smoothly and we had the best time and so did our guests! 

We cannot imagine how much work was put in on Diana’s part AND the romance team at the resort to make us feel so comfortable and special on our wedding day.

 

Thank you for this unforgettable experience that we will cherish for the rest of our lives!

 

Please let us know where is the best place to leave a review for you and our wedding with Paradisus Romance team.

We would 100% recommend having your wedding at Paradisus, Cancún!!!!

The resort and its beach and entertainment were amazing as well and made our week there unforgettable!

reviews.author: Alicia H
reviews.title: Wonderful trip!
reviews.text: I came with my friend, neither of us had done an all-inclusive before, but we will definitely do one again after this! We are already planning our next trip to Paradisus and plan to do Royal Service again!

reviews.author: llj23
reviews.title: First time here and wow.... we loved it!! Royal service is a must do.
reviews.text: The Royal service was worth the upgrade! Cyndi our butler did a superb job booking us reservations for dinner and getting our garments cleaned and ironed. Having Cyndi made us feel special and took care of us so we could recharge and relax! Cyndi was thoughtful and professional!!!

reviews.author: Nachelle
reviews.title: Fantastic find!
reviews.text: We stayed during a botched trip to Peru, that ended up with my husband, our 1 year old and myself in Cancun for a few days. Luckily the resort was awesome!! Our concierges Rodolfo and Gloria were fabulous. Rodolfo really connected with us and our daughter during our time there. They helped us with reservations, feeling at ease leaving our daughter for a couple of dinners in the Baby’s club and when I was sick he spoke to the kitchen staff to get me some certain foods made. Truly above and beyond service! Rodolfo even made sure we had a cabana that we could relax in each day we went to the pool so that it was more confortable getting out of the room while not feeing very well. The food was great, and it was very nice to have snacks and beverages available in the family concierge lounge throughout the day. Beach access area was beautiful and not crowded so we were able to let our little one roam about and explore on her own some. Nightly entertainment that our concierges made sure we knew about was really a special surprise we hadn't expected and changed nightly. We will definitely be returning and hope to bring out other family there with us!

reviews.author: Andrew E
reviews.title: Left feeling cheated.
reviews.text:
I visited Paradisus for the first time in May on a family trip. I thoroughly enjoyed my time the first time around. Big buffet, service was great, couldn't ask for anymore. Only six months later, my significant other and I decided to go to Mexico, and of course, I recommended Paradisus. 

Check-in went great, we headed to our room, it was clean and orderly. We went to the beach for a couple of hours, then back to the room to get ready for dinner. We decided to go to the buffet which left me speechless when we walked in to see the vast buffet I saw just months before, brought down to just 9-10 options. My S/O being vegetarian had even fewer options. We were very disappointed. After a night's sleep, we were greeted construction noise right in front of the pool. They had closed the buffet with no warning and starting tearing the place up. As you can imagine this was a bit of a headache. But we were still open and we're hoping the buffet would be open once more for dinner. To our surprise it was closed, and they were serving chicken burgers and hamburgers outside. My S/O asked if they had any vege-burgers, they didn't. With hour-long lineups at the other restaurants to get any food, we had to order room service, which came with a fee out of our pocket. 

We had a fantastic time at the Spa. Silvestre, the male spa assistant, who was there when I went earlier this year was fantastic. I was very pleasantly surprised when he was there the second time around. We went to the spa three times this time and Silvestre was great each time. Bringing a cold towel and water to the wet sauna. Guiding me through each of the pre-spa steps. Great service, better person.

reviews.author: Jules Y
reviews.title: Superb hotel
reviews.text:
An incredible five-star hotel! An impressive hotel --comfortable, luxurious, magnificent architecture. It really does make you feel at home. 
The ROOMS are beautiful and comfortable, and although some could be bigger others are enormous! The mattresses, though, are a bit too soft, which might be uncomfortable for some people like me. I couldn't wait to get back home to feel my thick hard mattress. The bathrooms are also very comfortable. The bigger ones had two sinks. Careful! There's not shampoo provided. 
The FOOD is de.li.cious! I highly recommend the tacos/quesadilla place downstairs: not spicy at all and very tasty. It was THE BEST PLACE for dinner, and I discovered it the last night :( For those fussy eaters like me o those who like eating more traditional meals, I'd recommend Enso, it has all international dishes, though it might get repetitive. Lapalapa is a good option for fish lovers, though there's a (cow) meat option for those who don't fancy seafood --like me, as well. HOWEVER, desserts leave a looooooot to be desired. There are almost no regular desserts in ANY of the restaurants. >>and the same happens during the afternoon: for those used to snacking at 5/6pm do get some food from breakfast and save it, cuz there's little you can do. 
Now the free NESPRESSO s are the BEST THING of the hotel. As a coffee lover myself, I was delighted when I saw the Nespresso guy downstairs. It's free but it's only open 7-10 and 15-17hs. 
The BEACH is just spectacular!! Warm, crystal water worth going for a swim --priceless! They give towels and each room has a sort of hay umbrella, YET the lounge chairs (reposeras) are way too uncomfortable, I mean, they have only 2 positions and no soft surface. They should offer at least another option, like other kind of chairs. 
The POOLS are fabulous!! Don't only got to the beach, the pools are worth giving a try, they are gigantic and they don't get easily crowded. Excellent spots inside the pool to sunbathe ;) 
The STAFF is incredibly kind and loyal, always ready to make your holidays the best and to assist you in anything you need. I really appreciated it. 
The LOCATION is excellent, as well! You can take the R2 bus and go the nearby malls, like La Isla or the supermarket Chedraui, where you'll get incredible prices (do no, by any means, go to one called Luxury, there's nothing to see, it's literally empty).
So basically there's no doubt Paradisus is one of the best places to stay in. Even though some things could be improved, they are just tiny compared to the experience.

reviews.author: KimsJSE
reviews.title: Much better last year :(
reviews.text:
Our 2nd stay (Nov 15-21, 2019). It was great to see that all of our favourite staff members were still there, starting with our amazing butler, Hector. Unfortunately the resort was undergoing renovations that limited our dining options during the week. It would have been nice for the resort to inform us of the renovation prior to our booking. 

For us, upgrading to Royal Service was a no brainer. Having access to an exclusive swimming pool, Bali beds and the fantastic La Palapa restaurant made all the difference in our trip. We can’t say enough about how amazing Degner, the pool concierge, was. The resort was near full capacity during our stay, but Degner was always so warm and friendly, helping us with anything we needed around the pool. 

Dinner at Mole was our worst meal during our trip. The meat was rubbery and not up to par for a 5 star resort. La Palapa was by far the best restaurant in the resort. The restaurant and pool staff, Daniel, Victor, Josue, Oscar, Moises, Orlando, Valeria, Eddie, Ramon and Julio were all amazing.

I hope that the owners of the resort take heed of this and some other reviews. If it were not for the amazing staff members, the appeal of Paradisus Cancun would be diminishing. The unannounced renovation and lower food quality are a bit disrespectful to your valued customers. The more that we reflect back on our trip, and as amazing as the staff members were, we will seriously have to weigh our options in the future when choosing our next Cancun resort.

reviews.author: Fredrickarm
reviews.title: Wonderful holiday ruined by Melia vacation sales people
reviews.text: We enjoyed the resort very much, I managed to go the full two weeks without a sales presentation then on the very last day was cornered by the Melia salesman into what he said would be a 90 minute presentation to show us the Melia vacation package. After being handed off to not less than 5 different sales people in the last 4 hours of our vacation keeping us almost to the point of missing our flight I finally gave in and purchased a 7 night stay in a place I have no desire to go to, in a country I don't even feel safe going to. I will try to cancel but I feel as though the rescission requirements may make it almost impossible.

reviews.author: Nupur M
reviews.title: You can do much better with your money!!
reviews.text:
What a terrible experience this has been. We come to Cancun a lot, always had good experiences. But this place:
Terrible CUSTOMER SERVICE
TERRIBLE FOOD OPTIONS. 
CHARGE A ROOM SERVICE FEE (??) never experienced that before. Save your money and do your research go somewhere else! So many options here.

reviews.author: Mitch S
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: As always,the amazing staff was fantastic! Royal service experience is the way to go! Our butler, Rode, was so helpful and attentive. If we needed anything he was alwsys available to help! Very special place that never disappoints.

reviews.author: Riya K
reviews.title: Not a 5 diamond resort!
reviews.text: This was our 3rd vacation in Cancun. This couldn’t be more disappointing. We had 4 rooms in total and we called a month ahead to request king beds for 3 rooms and double for 1 and possibly same floor and we had double beds for majority of the rooms. And different floors. It was more than half and hour to check us in and no one offered us welcome drinks. When I went to my room, there was water everywhere. I went to change my room, they made me feel like I was inconvenient for them. Room sink and bathtub were yellowish and kept clogging(disgusting) It was beginning of our vacation so I did not want to ruin my mood and head to the pool. Few restaurants were under construction and wasn’t updated on their website. Food quality was really bad. Raw and dairy products in the buffet were kept without ice underneath and barely any seafoods options. Very poorly managed property. We had to dine in the same restaurant over and over again since options were limited. Also resort charges you fees to deliver in room dining food. We paid $10 for  two glasses milk for our 5 years old. Very limited pool side entertainment and no activities involving the guests beside volleyball and soccer. Few highlights of our vacation were pool server Auscion and buffet night server Victor. Amazing personalities and very accommodating but we do not recommend this resort and specifically with kids.

reviews.author: Sean C
reviews.title: Amazing vacation & Royal Service
reviews.text: We did this trip with another couple and had a wonderful time.  The level of service and amenities were top notch.  We stayed in the adults only section (Royal Service)...best decision/upgrade ever!  From the most conference welcoming check-in process to daily attention to relaxing environment and more; we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves.  The Spa and Gym kept us on our routine even while on vacay!  When you think of excellent service, Disney Vacation Clubs and Ritz Carltons come to mind.  Well the Royal Service at Paradisus is right up there as well.  Our personal concierge, Rode Abruto, truly made this experience memorable.  Beyond being professional and attentive, he seemed to genuinely care that we had a great vacation.  The diversity and inclusiveness of this resorts level of service has kept it on our list of resorts to visit again.

reviews.author: Becca
reviews.title: Nice staff but loud amplified music at night
reviews.text:
At first we thought the hotel would be great for our trip; however, a couple of nights in loud amplified music was being performed in the hotel central area. It was VERY loud in our room and this wasn’t something the hotel staff had warned us about. This was really obnoxious when we wanted to get enough rest before getting an early start. When we called the front desk to inquire about turning the volume down, they said the music was scheduled to go until 11PM (on a Monday night!) and that we could move rooms. Not sure why that was the best option - to inconvenience paying guests who had already unpacked to move and settled in the room to move? 

Besides the loud music, the hotel was okay but not great, especially considering the expense. The pool and beach are really nice, but be aware that the nice looking Bali beds in the advertising are an extra charge. 

Additionally, the food is hit or miss. La Palapa was quite nice and the grilled food by the pool was great. We liked the sushi restaurant in the middle of the hotel. The burger place by the pool was mediocre at best. The food at Mole and Blue Agave missed the mark. 

Drinks throughout the resort were good and again the staff was very nice. The swim up bar was great! 

Our room was very clean and well kept. Linens and towels were okay quality, but not great. The pillows were also kind of odd. The furniture and decor were pretty outdated. We didn’t have a bad experience, but I wouldn’t recommend this place or come back to it. I think there are probably better resorts in the area for comparable prices.

reviews.author: cathellecarrillo
reviews.title: Treated like Royalty
reviews.text: WOW I cannot tell enough people how happy we are with our experience. We chose Royal Service to for my bday trip. Norma our butler took every single thing we were concerned with and made all our arrangements. She was attentive and overall extraordinary! All of the staff was amazing. Bana was our FAV restaurant,  we tried almost everything ln the menu and it was sooo tasty! Took advantage of the cabana beds included with royal service and the treatment was stellar thanks to Oscar and Orlando! The spa was nice as well, Lulu was super pleasant but the water therapy pools need updating and cleaning. Loved the sauna and mist room. The royal service lobby area was a must stop everytime we passed by. From premium liquor, to iced coffee, meat and cheese platters and desserts i dont know what I loved more. I already miss being there! Cant wait to be back

reviews.author: Emily F
reviews.title: Very disappointed - would not recommend to anyone to waste their money here. I urge you.
reviews.text: I read tons of reviews on hotels in Cancun before carefully selecting Paradisus and was the upmost disappointed. At one point my boyfriend and I were looking at other hotels we could go to for the remainder of our days in Cancun to get away from this lousy hotel. We are NOT picky, but basic things like having pool towels available on a beach vacation and having pool chairs available on a beach vacations are things that cannot go unnoticed in my opinion. It was unacceptable to lay on a towel in the sand when I’m paying for an all-inclusive resort.

reviews.author: twarf
reviews.title: great vacation place
reviews.text: Rooms, amenities and service was great.  Loved Augastine and Allen, the activities workers.  Augastine was very friendly and added to the great experience. They got us in the pool for water exercise and water volleyball.  They also informed us of special activities like wine tasting, painting and gave our group an impromptu salsa dance lesson

reviews.author: BearKr8
reviews.title: Family Concierge Was Way To Go!
reviews.text: We had a family concierge updated ocean view room in the main tower.  We were very close to most restaurants and amenities.  Our butlers Tansy and Fernando were great!  The kids loved the surprises!  We also loved the Bali beds and the information and reservations that they provided.  My kids loved the Kids Club (ages 7 and 5) and this allowed us to enjoy Royal Services and lunch at La Palypa which was the best lunch!  Some restaurants were closed during our stay but breakfast was great at all locations and Blue Agave was our favorite.  The room service food left something to be desired and should be improved.  The drinks were great (we didn't think they were watered down).  The service through the resort was great.  My only complaint was the pressure of the sales team.  They seemed to be waiting every time we passed  through the main tower.  One time it was way too much when my husband and I were enjoying a kid free drink at Royal Services prior to dinner and saying no wasn't being accepted.  The resort was pretty clean and great for families.

reviews.author: rusAleksG
reviews.title: Simply amazing!
reviews.text:
Hello! It could be a lot of letters, but just bear with me. I solemnly swear that everything I say is truth and nothing but the truth, and everything is based on my personal experience.
I’ve been traveling all over the places, but I’ve never seen anything like this. Starting with exterior, the hotel looks like ancient pyramids, which you could recognize from above when you flying in the plane. The interior is mind boggling. This is probably how the hanging gardens of Babylon looked like. There is a garden INSIDE the hotel with fountains, live fishes, and those skylight rooftops. And the scope of it all - simply amazing!
But, the reason that I keep coming back here year after year is people. I encountered a lot of friendly staff everywhere else, but these people are of the scale. They always make me feel like home. 
Last year 2 bartenders by the names Edgar and Jorge Argentis ( a.k.a. Randy) made me an excursion to the land of tequila. I tried about 20 different types of it (don’t drink Mezcal Union if you want to live :)). So, if you like it - these are the guys to go to. This year, along with these guys, I met Giovani. They would say he is the best bartender, plus chief of mixology ( which means you think of any drink and he’ll make it). I’m not an alcoholic, but the cocktails he makes want you to get some more. Don’t forget to tip them. Amazing guys!
And, if you want to get a truly professional massage, ask for Anna. She is my girl, and I cannot say enough about her. She has magic hands and Hollywood smile. And she is very affable (here is new word for you). Please, treat  her with respect. 
Remember, everyone has a different taste and preferences, so I just told you about my personal ones. I’m definitely coming back!
I would post a lot of pictures, but I don’t want to spoil it for you. Besides, you can always google it. Uff, I should start writing the books...:)

reviews.author: WAYNE K
reviews.title: A Bit of a Disappointment
reviews.text:
This was my third stay at Paradisus Cancun in the Royal Service area.  As usual the staff was fantastic and go out of their way to pamper you.  That being said, I think the hotel is undergoing major cost cutting.  Three restaurants were closed during my week (13/11 - 20/11/2019).  This included the always popular Brazilian Steak House, the Market Grill.  None of these closings was mentioned on the web site, and, one of the restaurants, Fuego, was located in the old Enzo one night and then surprisingly appeared at The Palapa on our final night.  One evening Bana and the Blue Agave were the only places open not requiring a reservation.  This resulted in long waits to be seated and understandably flustered staff.  The atrium bar / restaurant in Pyramid 5 disappeared one morning as it was moved to Pyramide 4  
to alloow for renovation.  None of this was announced and our "butlers" were left scratching their heads.  I feel that the staff was generally short-handed and operating at a severe disadvantage.
The airport transportation, provided thru Otium, has been downgraded to "shared" rides, eliminating any flexibility on the return to the airport....we did not use it on the return.
So, bottom line, great property, great staff, great Royal Service...poor communication and cost-cutting obvious.

reviews.author: Wendy Jameson
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: We have stayed at the Paradisus many times and we love it! The level of service we receive from Rode on the Royal Service side of the hotel is exceptional!  We ask for him by name each time we stay there and he is always wonderful.  Thank you Rode!

reviews.author: Montaruli
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: We stayed in Royal Service pyramid 5 on the 4th floor. Our room was beautiful. We had a butter named Rode who was excellent and took care of our every need. We were a large group of 8 with another couple who are owners and not in Royal service. Our Rode went above and beyond to make sure our entire experience was perfect. We were a needy group. He was very professional. The entire Royal service area was amazing. Some of the restaurants were closed for renovations and we were upset but the Royal service group made up for this. We felt we were missing nothing! Daniel is the man! He made sure were treated royally. Julio, Aaron inside royal pyramid, Oscar at la palapa, Manuel one of The Royal service bartender, Josue at the pool or in Royal pyramid, Julio at la palapa, Aron pool concierge ,Valeria at the pool and in Royal service, Moses at the pool or royal service or at la palapa,Christian and Victor at Enzo. I am sure I am forgetting names. These people made the trip special! Moses was one of my very favorites. It is amazing to watch this man work. He knows his stuff!! Because of these people I would definitely come back! The beach was beautiful! The color of the water amazing. We were very happy!

reviews.author: Seth
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: Family Concierge service was excellent. Our butlers, Violetta and Alexa were caring and went beyond their way to show hospitality. Our servers Francisco at the kids pool and Fernanda at Alfredo Arcos were the best servers.

reviews.author: autozone801
reviews.title: Amazing place and amazing staff!
reviews.text: Everyone is so friendly and have great personalities amazing with being able to remember you and your group with the hundreds of people they deal with in a day best trip ever will definitely be coming back to this resort!

reviews.author: Katie W
reviews.title: Couples Trip
reviews.text: Excellent resort! Excellent service and food! We always ask for Rodolfo! Beautiful beach location and weather was perfect in November. Rooms are clean and we always stay in family concierge or royal service. Our favorite restaurant is La Palapa and Bana.

reviews.author: World Traveler
reviews.title: Not worth the money...better value options elsewhere in Cancun
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed there last week, and were quite disappointed with our room. It showed a lot of wear and tear, and was in need of an update/maintenance.
We had an all inclusive package, and were also disappointed with the lunch and dinner options. The breakfast was fine, but the quality of the lunch and dinner options were not competitive with the other resorts we have stayed in before in the Cancun area. (this was our 5th trip to Cancun)

reviews.author: NYQT320
reviews.title: Cancun take two
reviews.text: Came here in March of 2019,loved it so much we became Meliá Club members and couldn’t wait to come back. Jamie Castro was there to set up whatever we needed from Bali beds to spa and dinner reservations. Asunción was our server on the beach. She was amazing and our drinks were never empty. Their are so many others who were so helpful and friendly from room service to getting towels. Danille gave an amazing massage as well. This resort is so well run I look forward to going back again and again!

reviews.author: amyrbrock
reviews.title: Drew and Lindsey’s wedding
reviews.text: First time in Cancun....it was awesome  and the wedding was magical! We had a few issues with the shower but otherwise things were really good. We enjoyed the food, the pool and the beach plus the bars and entertainment

reviews.author: J S
reviews.title: Not Up to Par
reviews.text:
Just completed my 3rd visit to the Paradisus Cancun. 

The restaurants are not what they used to be. The buffet was very limited compared to past visits. Mole and Enso were less than ok. Overall, the food selections were pretty poor. 

Stayed in the Royal Service section. Our butler, Galdi was excellent and always checking to see if everything was ok. The resort needs more Bali beds. For what we were paying, we should have been able to have a Bali bed without any problem. The only service issue that we had was the rude pool attendant who could have cared less that he couldn’t accommodate us. Our one bedroom suite was nice and had an awesome view. 

The pool food and beverage servers were awesome. 

We do love Cancun. The beach and the water were beautiful! Just might try a different resort next time which offers better restaurants and better poolside amenities.

reviews.author: desiree k
reviews.title: Remodeling, & being there in the in between was not so good.
reviews.text: This was our 3 and last trip to Paradisus.  Love the views and most of the staff, however we paid for a Butler that we saw only on day ONE! Never saw him again.  Javiar did have an intern with him, she was delightful, however we barely heard from her as well.  Check in was a hot mess, we paid extra for the Royal Service as usually it's very accommodating.  Disappointed with the food options - Mole was mediocre at best,  We chose to eat at the buffet  twice - blah.  For the price paid and the lack of service and the watered down drinks by the pool.... I'm fairly confident we could have stayed somewhere better for less.

reviews.author: sg325is
reviews.title: Amazing week for the family!
reviews.text:
Will definitely go back.  Staff was exceptional and friendly.  Kids and baby club amazing.  Amyrani, Atilano, Alberto, Arturo, Espinosa and Martin were amazing in Enso Restaurant.  Abraham in Blue Agave and Mole was a true professional.  I'd stay away from Bana (the sushi restaurant).  Quite possibly the worst sushi experience I've ever had.  But it didn't kill the week as we only went that 1 time.  
The staff in the kids club were the highlight, though.  Fernanda and Saul.... They were amesome with the kids.  My daughter woke up everyday wanting to go back there.  
Amazing!

reviews.author: Gustavo Castillo
reviews.title: Top Notch Service!!
reviews.text:
Had a really amazing time at this Paradisus ( have also stayed at Paradisus In punta Cana). Service is top notch! You must try the food at the blue agave. Nice assortment of Mexican food..The service from the staff at the blue agave is very accommodating. Gaudencio, Pablo, Dania, Fernanda went above and beyond  to make our stay even better.

We look forward to coming back..

reviews.author: edaniela1981
reviews.title: Relaxing vacation
reviews.text: This is our 4th time coming here at this resort. Why? Suite rooms are amazing and lots of privacy, ocean front rooms. Service was excellent. Beach was amazing and staff best we ever had. The butler Gloria and Rodofo were super super nice and friendly and exceeded our expectations. Some cons were some restaurants were closed and wished we had better weather.

reviews.author: Emiro F
reviews.title: Beautiful Family vacations.
reviews.text:
Beautiful property, with a lot of amenities. Great service!
Their Staff is the best.
Special Thanks to: David, for helping us with the group check in and make it very easy.
In the Restaurants, Adriana, Alfredo,Rafael, Armando, Pascual and at the pool, Victor. Their service was their service was above and beyond!

reviews.author: kpaquette10
reviews.title: Beautiful Family Vacation
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort. Our family had a great time enjoying the property all last week. Only downside was it rained almost every day. 

A huge plus that we didn't know about was there is a kids club (5-12) and a baby club (1-4) you can stay and play with them or drop them off! My 2 yr old LOVED the baby club and getting to play with all the toys, finger painting (lots of activities) and the jungle gym. She made us go at least once a day. May was excellent and made us feel very safe. 

The wait staff was very helpful. We had excellent service a few times and I'd like to single out Laura from the club melia beach area for being so amazing with us and our kids. Also Abraham from the Blue Agave was amazing with our family and how crazy it can be at dinner with kids. Blue Agave turned out to be our favorite place for a meal. The tacos and quesadillas were delicious. Enso was a favorite for breakfast. Dinner at Enso was delicious as well but you will need reservations. Bana has a beautiful ambience but, it takes a long time for your food and the portions are very small, so make sure you order more than you think you would need. One sushi roll is only four small pieces. The manager Christian again was amazing with us and helping to get my kids milk, from the cow haha.

If you have time, I highly recommend visiting the spa. David gave an excellent massage. Make sure to bring your bathing suit with you. It's a full-service spa with a hydropool, saunas, and cold baths. When you book you have access for the full day. Someone came around at the pool and book me a spot, also giving me a discount. 

If staying with club Melia, book the Bali beds!! They were definitely worth the small cost. We did one day on the beach and one day by the pool. Would have done it every day if it didn't rain so much. Elliot was great at helping us to arrange this once we came down every morning. 

The only thing we found confusing, since the resort is so big, was where we were supposed to go for help. There's club Melia, concierge, then RCI concierge and it's in 2 different buildings and the "lobby" is the main building is huge with a front desk but also desks near the elevators. Halfway through the trip we were able to start figuring it all out . I'm sure of we haven't checked in at midnight there would have been a better run down of the property with us. We saw lots of hotel staff walking people around explaining everything. They have workers for everything!

Can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: Madison S
reviews.title: family vacation
reviews.text: there was a show every night and every night was fun at the avenue bar. kids loved every show and during the day there was water aerobics and other fun activities. the workers were fun to be with and the restaurants were great.

reviews.author: Hugo S
reviews.title: Great!!!
reviews.text:
Business meeting with  partners of US /MX /CAN very nice hotel with a lot of garden. Clean beach!!! Excellent food. Comfortable alocations. Several pools. Very nice environtment. Friendly guys.
Reccomended!!

reviews.author: JP Gizhoski
reviews.title: Geta way
reviews.text: Would recommend to anyone! People were excellent great service and great atmosphere. Everyone treated you like a king and queen. Hotel is beautiful very clean with great entertainment and many different options for food. Blue Agava was our favorite the home style tacos were excellent. The Avenue bar was great as well extremely positive vibes. Our waiter Francisco made us feel right at home, did a wonderful job taking care of us each night. Would recommend this place to anyone and if you visit Avenue bar, you must ask for Francisco. He won’t disappoint you!

reviews.author: Irene Tian
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancún - Family concierge
reviews.text: Had a great trip! Beautiful hotel and incredible service! Our butlers, Gloria and Fernando, are super nice and supportive which made our stay with two little kids easier. Strongly recommend family concierge for anyone traveling with little kids. And don’t miss the opportunity of working with Outdoors photo-shooting team to capture the breathtaking Paradisus Cancun landscape! Our photographer is Adrian Gonzalez, gentle and professional, took perfect pics for us within very short period of time. Can’t be happier as we have super active little kids who don’t understand the concept of “being cooperative” lol!

reviews.author: Britney V
reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: Overall, the hotel experience was nothing special. The hotels views were very pretty & the workers were professional (not too friendly but definitely professional) and that was pretty much it for the list of positives that I have for this experience. I’ve done my fair share of traveling and was the most disappointed by this all inclusive resort than I ever have been by other all inclusives. The food was absolutely mediocre at best and I did not mind that at first but when you spend a lot of money for a seven day trip, you do expect to have at least one good meal during your  stay. The drinks were COMPLETELY watered down. There was absolutely zero liquor in the pool bars. My group and a bunch of the other groups at the resort were very frustrated considering that we pay so much money for this experience and the hotel was just simply giving us sugar with ice and telling us that it was alcoholic beverages. To top it off, the representative from Orbitz sold us on a package deal to Isla Mujeres and when the day of the excursion came, our transportation that we booked with this representative never showed up to pick us up. After calling the Orbitz representative, there was no response and he decided to text us. He said that the transportation did come but we knew that was a lie. We demanded our money back and he talked us into purchasing a cab to take us to the destination. We booked with Orbitz so that we could feel a sense of safety being in a whole new country. My fiancé and I felt extremely unsafe jumping into a random cab from the middle of the street in Mexico. Overall, this experience was very unpleasant and I would not come back.

reviews.author: anna0124
reviews.title: Perfect Beyond Words
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is perfection beyond your wildest dreams. After booking, we were worried about recent negative reviews about restaurants being closed and need for updates. However, we’re so glad we overlooked the negativity and stayed here! Paradisus Cancun has quickly become my favorite hotel.

Royal Service:
Upon arrival, we upgraded to Royal Service and were swiftly met by our butler, Alex who brought us to the Royal Service lounge where we were greeted by cold waters and tequila shots. Check in was smooth and quick. I couldn’t recommend Royal Service enough. As if it’s not wonderful enough to be in an adults only section with its own restaurant and pool, the added benefit of butler service is really the perfect cherry on top of a wonderful cake. Alex was phenomenal. He checked in on us several times daily, made our restaurant and cabana reservations, and catered to all of our needs and questions. He was off on our last day and arranged for Aaron to take care of us in his absence. Both had fantastic attention to detail, nothing was missed.

The snacks in the Royal Service lounge were amazing and available from 7am to 10pm, and changed throughout the day. The lounge bar was stocked with premium liquors.

We didn’t pay extra for an ocean facing room. Our view was of the lagoon, and was just fine as we hardly spent any time in the room. Housekeeping was wonderful. It’s worth upgrading to ocean view if you’re on a romantic getaway, otherwise, I wouldn’t bother spending the extra money.

We had a wonderful surprise of wine delivered to the room one day, such a nice touch as we were celebrating a graduation.

The pool and grounds are wonderful and the hotel itself is absolutely gorgeous. The hanging vines are so unique and the pyramid shape of the hotel leads to wonderful photos.

If you’re looking for a resort where you’ll be pampered, look no further. 

Food:
Holy crap! Absolutely amazing.

La Palapa – exclusive to Royal Service for breakfast and lunch, but open to all (with reservation) for dinner. My absolute favorite. You HAVE to try the chicken anticucho and frying pan sirloin. These two dishes hit it out of the park.

Mole – wonderful. Lots of unusual and contemporary tastes, so we stayed with safer options. The goat and mixed meats plate were wonderful! MUST try the passion fruit margarita!

Bana – if you have to skip a restaurant, I’d skip this one. Although the food was ok, it was just that. The noodles were quite salty and I don’t have an affinity for raw fish. However, if you like sushi, I hear it’s fantastic here.

Enso – ate breakfast here one day, but much prefer La Palapa. If you are Royal Service, the breakfast at La Palapa and even in the Royal Service lounge is much better. There were many options, but nothing out of this world. 

Vento was closed for the duration of our stay and we didn’t try the buffet (Market Grill) as we preferred the a la cartes.

Spa:
Booked a wonderful 80 minute massage and at one point was so relaxed I snored which woke me up. Absolutely wonderful. Booking in Royal Service allows you to use spa facilities (jacuzzi and hydrotherapy circuit daily). To me, this wasn’t necessarily worth it, it didn’t add anything to our stay.

Gym:
Only visited to look at it, never worked out. A couple machines, and some free weights. Very small space compared to the rest of the resort, but would get the job done.

Pool/Beach:
If you’re looking for a resort with an amazing beach, look no further. Paradisus has the most beautiful white sand beach with the bluest ocean water. No issues with seaweed during our stay. We mostly spent our time in our cabana, which was wonderful. The snack menu was fantastic and the service was superb. Huge shout out to Orlando who ran through the rain to keep our drinks flowing all day!

Entertainment:
For the first time at an all-inclusive, we decided to join some resort activities. One whole day was rainy and made it impossible to do anything outdoors. Instead, we participated in trivia and a mixology class. Wonderful activities by the hotel. Impressed with their ability to change/add activities based on the terrible weather! Loved the 8:30pm shows at Avenue Bar as well. 

Special shout out to our two favorite bartenders at Toji Bar, Edgar and Gio. The absolute best service and drinks at the resort! You name a flavor and these two guys can make it.

reviews.author: J K
reviews.title: Worse than expectation.
reviews.text: Too noisy. Scent of room is terrible. Food in Japanese restaurant is worse than local cheap one. The alarming light on your head is blinking all the time in bed. Kids zone is the only satisfactory part in this hotel.

reviews.author: Alyssa E
reviews.title: Discriminated Against During Check-In
reviews.text: We had a disappointing experience during our stay last week. We arrived at 11am and were told to wait until 3pm to check-in - upon our return we were told that we would be in a double room even though I had requested a king bed when we first arrived. The person at the front desk specifically informed us that because we were two ladies, they had to "prioritize families' requests". As an engaged lesbian couple, this felt incredibly invalidating and discriminatory - that our room would not be accommodated because of the gender of our partner. Unbelievable. Tired of arguing, we agreed to switch out rooms the next day. They had the audacity to ask us to check out at 11 and check back in at 3 - seriously?! We are already being discriminated against and have the inconvenience of having to switch rooms - you want us to have to pack up and not have a place to go all day?! They eventually conceded on this point. When we were finally able to check in to our king room the following day we were placed in a lagoon side room even though we had paid for an ocean view room. Additionally this room was smack in the middle of current construction noise - the bed was wildly uncomfortable and no upgrades or perks were offered. We will not be returning.

reviews.author: Allie M
reviews.title: The staff is amazing!
reviews.text: Very clean and beautiful resort. The staff in every part of the resort is amazing. Josè at the Market and Hugo at the pools were extra fantastic! Super sweet, attentive, and fun! The beach is incredible, sand is so soft and the water is unbelievable.

reviews.author: Matthew M
reviews.title: My experience with Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: The only"issue" I would say was that we came while a lot of renovations were being conducted, but nevertheless it was still a memorable experience! Very welcoming and friendly staff. Definitely returning in the near future!

reviews.author: Adventure20409644608
reviews.title: Great experience... Definately coming back.
reviews.text:
We celebrated our 20th wedding anniversary and overall had a great experience. The staff was great and very attentive and friendly. The Tempo restaurant was amazing (not included in the all-inclusive, but definitely worth the experience), and the Coco Beach Cabanas was the best part of the experience. I really think they "under-sold" the Cabanas. Wow, the lunches provided were a seafood lover's dream; Crab, Lobster, Shrimp, Calamari, etc...

The only drawback (minor), was the room had an elevated floor in the bathroom. My wife wore sandals and the room was dark when we walked in and stubbed her toes when she walked in the bathroom. A few drinks at Coco Bar fixed that issue...

reviews.author: M.Potter
reviews.title: Great experience with a Melia resort
reviews.text:
Everything was fantastic. The place, although a little bit dated, has such a hospitable staff. That's what you'd expect when you're in an all inclusive resort and they delivered. Every staff introduced to me remembered my name and they'd greet me with such warm smiles whenever they see me. Outside you'll see the exterior of the hotel modeled to look like Chichen Itza, the calendar/temple of the Mayans. As you enter you'll see vines hanging from each balcony surrounding the pyramid-like interior. It is as if you have entered the heart of the jungle. With the comforts of modern technology, shops and restaurants. Exit through the back and you'll be greeted with an amazing view of the blue waters from the Caribbean. 
Blue Agave, the restaurant visited for lunch had good Mexican food. They're menu only consists of three items: 2 types of soup, tacos and quesadillas. I went for lunch and they only served the tacos. Enso, the restaurant I tried for dinner had a buffet and a la Carte menu. Enso is an asian buffet restaurant while the a la carte came from the Market Grill menu(it is closed at night due to renovations,2019) a brazilian fusion restaurant. The buffet at night changes nightly. The a la carte was awesome. My friends were obsessed with the octopus. I was liking the steak cooked to my preference. You can order from the a la carte menu as much as your heart's desire. We went back to Enso both for breakfast and lunch at different days and I can say it was not bad. We also went to the Market grill during lunch time and they offered some good selection of pork, beef, poultry and fish. I'm a meat lover not so much a vegetable eater so I cannot say much about they're vegetable selections. The fish and chicken I like, the beef a little tough and the pork a bit bland for my taste. Mole, a traditional mexican restaurant that offers dinner had awesome plating for a casual dining. They got the concept right. They served food like it was a tasting menu. Appetizers, soups and salads performed well but the mains not so much. We ordered octopus, duck and a meat platter but only the duck had some promise. The octupus was better at Enso. This comes from a person who did not appreciate the strong gamey flavor that was the lamb from the meat platter. Bana, a japanese restaurant that can be missed. If you think this place is good, you've never been to Japan or tasted authentic japanese cuisine. I thought it was edible at the least, my friends did not like the strong fishy flavor and smell that came from their sushi. In other words, the fish wasn't fresh. This is the biggest reason why my rating isn't perfect. We weren't able to try the other restaurants they offered due to time constraints but I wish we did. Tempo is their fine dining experience we missed, and las palapas was another one, overlooking the ocean, was missed because we didnt make the reservation. The drinks at any of the places that offered it was ok though not consistent. Sometimes you'll get the right amount of alcohol sometimes too little, sometimes too strong. I guess being in an all inclusive resort means the bartenders don't need to measure. Finally, the spa. Disclaimer, I didn't expect much about the spa because I've been to other spa and they were awesome at a fraction of a price. Also, I went there just after a water activity which was nauseating. With that said, Yhi spa is spectacular. They have a huge jacuzzi, rainfall shower rooms, sauna and steam room, a spacious lounge with a small snack bar by the jacuzzi, towels and slippers for your comfort, nicely dimmed waiting room while waiting for your massage room to be ready and the massage room itself that has it's own tub and shower room. I haven't even started the massage but I already felt pampered. Then I get to the massage. My masseuse did something and I can't remember anything but me snoring. Kidding. I fell asleep for sure but before I fell asleep from the most relaxing massage. Overall the service from yhi spa is superb if you can afford it. It will knock you back by 85-145usd without the tax. Overall, paradisus cancun is only one of the many hotel resorts offered by Melia but one that should be visited nonetheless for an experience that should be remembered for a long time.

reviews.author: vikrisgab
reviews.title: Blue agave satff are amazing !!!
reviews.text: We stay first week of November,was wonderful !!!We love so much restaurant Blueagave,the hostess Fernanda and waitress Dania Toscano Gaudencio,Pablo,Vincente were amazing,they know what they doing !!! But they took there time while checking us in the hotel. They had a very nice greeting when we first got there !! Hostess Yvonne at Iban restaurant was very rude and mean !!!

reviews.author: Frank1565
reviews.title: A Wonderful Vacation at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
My wife & I just returned from this stunning resort. We are Vacation Club Members and have been to many resorts in the past but this has the beauty, service, hospitality, beach, pools, staff, food & restaurants that can't be beat. Our beautiful room faced a winding pool & sea with spectacular sunrises. The center lobby is breathtaking with vines cascading down from the perimeter of the 8 floors. The ground level of the lobby has an outstanding Asian restaurant with multiple levels of tables surrounded by foliage.

I would like to mention some staff members that I came in contact with that make this resort so special:

Luz Elena Quiroz - a Manager who is always available to meet with anyone that has an issue or concern. She immediately makes you feel like you are a family member & always provides a satisfactory solution.

Jose - a Vacation Club Butler that goes above and beyond any expectation you may have. He will coordinate any special occasion to perfection or surprise you by delivering a bottle of your favorite wine to your room.

Flor - a Vacation Concierge will coordinate restaurant reservations, transportation transfers or assist with any special requests or celebrations you may want to have while at the resort.

Atilano - a Buffet Waiter will always greet you with a smile at breakfast or lunch and will provide service that is beyond your expectation.

Elliot - a Pool Area Associate provides towels, bali beds or lounges and any other request you may have at pool side. His smile and humor are infectious.

Yerry - another Pool Area Associate, Elliot's partner, also provides towels, prepares bali beds or  lounges. He is extremely creative in preparing a swan or heart design with towels on the bali bed each day.

I must also complement every server of all restaurants, they were all exceptional and the food was also prepared to perfection with special sauces where appropriate.
Our favorite restaurant was Mole, a Mexican restaurant with an extensive menu to suite any palate. The ambiance was also amazing.

The cleaning staff kept our room immaculate and fully stocked with all of our needs.

The resort is centrally located to all attractions with bus or taxi service right out front of the hotel.

These are some of the reasons why we love this fabulous resort. We are looking forward to returning for 2 weeks in 3 months.

reviews.author: Paul M
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Review
reviews.text:
Vacation October 26th-November 2nd at Paradisus, Cancun.
Pros
- pool staff very attentive. Laura and Flor excellent service at poolside. Kept area clean and guest happy.
- Rooms on fifth floor, main building were newly remodeled and very nice. Booked this hotel six months in advance and requested to be on the same floor as travel companions. We had to tip the person at check in to get us in the same building. This should not occur and is not very professional or accommodating. 
- Bartender (Edgar) outstanding!
- Bellmen very attentive and helpful on checkin and checkout. Professional and efficient. 
- Beach area was very nice and well maintained. 

Cons-
- Hotel showing it's age and in need of general maintainance. Peeling paint in many areas. Paster coming off the ceiling and walls in many areas and tiles missing in pool area. Staff was working on several updates during our stay but many more needed. 
- Restaurants - three closed for remodel, food was the worst of any all-inclusive we have ever stayed. Buffet sub par with very limited options. We would not return to this hotel based on food alone. 
- Checkin  - not informative or very helpful. Did not guide us to our room or give us towel cards for the pool area. 
- Checkout - same as ckeckin, just took our room keys. 

Summary 
- there are many better hotel options in Cancun hotel district. I would not recommend and will not return in future visits. I would rate this hotel avaerage at best.

reviews.author: Heather
reviews.title: Review on customer service
reviews.text: Alan did a great job great making my experience fun and eventful! He was very determined to make sure our stay was great. He got us involved in lots of activities and informed us of all of the fun events that would occur!

reviews.author: rmorri622268
reviews.title: Cancun October 2019
reviews.text: Royal Service at Paradisus was amazing.  Our butler George was very attentive and provided great service during our stay.  The Spa and beach were just what we needed to create a perfect vacation and break before the holiday madness begins!

reviews.author: Audrey Bell
reviews.title: Wonderful honeymoon destination
reviews.text: Must do the Royal Service. Our Butler was Daniel, who was outstanding. He made reservations, checked in as needed and quickly felt like a friend. He even went above and beyond to make us feel celebrated on our honeymoon. Everyone at the resort works hard to ensure you have a positive experience and makes you feel welcomed. The Bali Bed was a huge highlight and was included in the all inclusive. Although we never asked, I would have liked more information on events/activities taking place around the resort. It wasn't until the second to last day we were informed (from other guest) about the Melia app. which provides guest with events/itinerary. Access to a jacuzzi would have been nice too, I don't believe the resort had one. I also wished it had a Hibachi restaurant where they cook in front of you. Last thing, to end on a positive, I recommend the spa, I had the BEST message from a lady named Veronica.

reviews.author: Babybike2001
reviews.title: Best anniversary ever!
reviews.text: This week I was celebrating my anniversary at El Paradissus Cancun and my experience was at another level.  The service was of the highest quality, they made me feel the most beloved guest for everyone and most importantly, they made my wife feel like the queen she is to me.  Since we arrived at the Luis hotel at the front desk he was very helpful and attentive.  In the restaurant area I want to recognize Dania and gaudencio and abraham at the Mole restaurant, Roberto in Palapa, Gemma and David in the Spa area, and last but not least Jorge and Hugo from the pool area.  These people made me spend the best vacations of my life, at all times they acted as owner employees.  I want to congratulate management because when people work in such a passionate place, it is because they are inspired to give the same treatment they receive from their managers.  I will definitely return to your hotel.

reviews.author: Ed T
reviews.title: Good time in Cancun
reviews.text: I like the hotel's overall look  and feel. The lobby was amazing, though it got hot mid day. The room was clean and the AC worked good. The beautiful  Caribbean with the amazing colors. The beach was really nice and well kept, NO SEA WEED. The  entertainment was REALLY good. if you notice I left the food till the end of my review, as these I rated average. Typical all inclusive, and limited food choices. Some restaurant not part of the all-inclusive, others you had to make reservation.

reviews.author: richtamz
reviews.title: Royal Service is great value for money
reviews.text: Our experience was nothing short of spectacular.  We were very impressed with the service from everyone throughout the resort, not just in the Royal Service area. The room was beautiful as was the view. They helped my boyfriend create a special birthday surprise for me which was icing on the cake. Loved it

reviews.author: sgladman07
reviews.title: Beautiful resort and great for honeymooners!
reviews.text: We went through a travel agent to make sure we were getting an all-inclusive trip. This place is so beautiful! The beaches were super clean and weither your on the beach or near the pool the waiters always asked if you needed anything. We would definitely come back!

reviews.author: RonnM
reviews.title: Beach was beautiful though...
reviews.text:
Our 3rd time in Mexico but first time in Cancun and we picked Paradisus expecting to get 5 star service. Me and my family were a bit disappointed as we have stayed in better resorts. Our trip was for my girlfriend's birthday and in our purchased online ticket it specifically said it's for her celebration. On her birthday, I was expecting they'd do something in the room to make her feel special, (mind you, other resorts in the past have done this for us). No cute decorations, no "happy birthdays". We had to call them to ask them for something and waste one hour just talking to the manager on the phone. So finally my girl just asked if we can at least have a cabana for free, which they did but only for a day ($100/daily).

We upgraded to oceanview luxury suite on the 7th floor in pyramid 3 and we kinda regret it. Yes the ocean view was amazing but not worth the extra $350. The 'suite' was small and AC was loud. Also, our door card stopped working and we had to wait and go back to the reception for someone to come up and "replace the battery". We are a bit concerned because these cards are the same cards you will have to use on the safety box. We had to make sure everything is working fine and our room and box isn't compromised. 

There aren't many buffet and ala cartes to choose from. Enzo was ok but it was dark during dinner time. They need to add more lighting, it's hard to eat when you can't see the food. Entertainment was ok, not great.

Overall we didn't like the hotel because as a 5 star, they didn't deliver. Having said that, the staff was amazing! Their service was top notch especially Alfredo and Gaudencio in the Blue Agave buffet. Every time we come to eat they treated us like family and we really appreciate their effort. Thanks Amigos! Also, Manuel in the pool area who treated us like royalty while relaxing. The bartender in the swim up bar, I'm sorry I forgot your name buddy but you serve the best mix of drinks! (Mexican holy water) And the lifeguard Moses for going out there to try and retrieve my drone. I appreciate it, brother!

reviews.author: Jen
reviews.title: Going for our third visit!
reviews.text: Excellent staff and service no matter where  you are in the resort. We upgraded to Royal Service last time and again for our third trip. 100% worth it! Much quieter and better/yummier food in the RS areas. Unlike other resorts, they don't harass you to visit their timeshare locations. Alex, our butler, was attentive and followed thru with our requests; butler service definitely comes in handy for making dinner reservations. For our third trip, I need to write down names for the hardworking AMAZING staff on the RS beach! We caught a package this time around, so we're looking forward to experiencing the airport transfer and dining voucher at Tempo. Melia Cancun, see you soon!

reviews.author: AshPriest
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort & amazing service. Carlos at Enzo went above & beyond to make our time here special!
Our first night we had Carlos for dinner. He was so wonderful, we asked for him again & again. One night he surprised us with a romantic dinner. We could not had been more impressed! Thank you Carlos!

reviews.author: Miguel
reviews.title: Amazing wedding thanks to Paradisus
reviews.text: We had our destination wedding here with 60 (yes 60!) guests. For some it was their first time abroad, while others were avid travellers. Either way, nobody could stop talking about how great their experience was. The weather was great, the food was fantastic, and the level of attentiveness from the staff was, I'd say, the best part. I loved how the staff seemed to be having a good time and were always ready to help out or go that "Extra" mile for you. For example, when we had someone's birthday come up. We asked them if we could get a candle and maybe a dessert. Instantly someone overheard and looked all over (this was at around midnight) to find a sweet with a candle. It made the moment that much more special. Definitely will be recommending this place to everyone I know

reviews.author: Sarah Y
reviews.title: Very Humid, Disappointing Food, Not Worth It
reviews.text:
When we checked in, we did not get a room with two beds as per our initial booking - which was fine but then we asked for a room with a better view to make up for this, which they also did not provide. When we were getting our tour of the facility, it was very clear that the hotel was undergoing construction... the tour guide even mentioned "I hope you were made aware of the fact that we are undergoing construction ahead of time" - we were not. The construction was noisy and the elevators did not work. We were on the third floor which is not so bad but I would hate to know what someone who is elderly or disabled would have done.

The staff was very nice and the bed was comfortable but the hotel was SUPER hot and humid... to the point that we were sweating while we were walking through and even while we were sitting at the restaurants. 

Unfortunately the food at the pool/beach (which was the same restaurant they used for room service) was NOT good... it seemed like everything was frozen. Food always came cold... at the pool/beach and in the room.

The food at the Japanese restaurant inside the hotel was also not good... the sushi did not taste fresh and the rice was hard. The ceviche had a strange consistency.

On a positive note, the traditional Mexican restaurant (Mole) was very good so at least we had one positive food experience.

Overall, I would not recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Aryene A
reviews.title: Wallet stolen from room, no towel card received at check in
reviews.text: At check in we did not receive our towel cards and when we asked for it, not even 1 hr after check in we were treated like criminals. My husbands wallet was taken from our room on our  last day at the resort, when we weren’t expecting any room service due to the fact that we would be leaving at 3am the next day, but be a robe magically appeared in that room (why give that to a customer on their last day?) and his wallet was gone.

reviews.title: Overall very satisfied and recommend this place
reviews.text: Very attentive and friendly staff. Gorgeous hotel and beach area. Very satisfied with cleanliness which was really important for us. The only problem was that the quality of food at two restaurants (Feugo and Mole) was low. Other than the food quality, they were better than any resort we have been.

reviews.author: MARTEx
reviews.title: Was there for a wedding ...
reviews.text: The hotel  grounds is really nice . The rooms at least ours needs a little updating .
