Everything was very clean .. food was tasty at the different restaurants, just wish the specialty restaurants weren’t all booked up .. very hard to get in .. that was disappointing... loved the nespresso bar and the gelato bar ...

reviews.author: Shaya S
reviews.title: not 5 star
reviews.text:
I stayed here for a week in September. I was pleased with how clean the hotel was and how nice and courteous the staff, especially servers at all restaurants, were. But this is by no means a luxury hotel! Buffet restaurant's food was low quality and offered limited options. They had theme nights, except for Mexican nights that were amazing, this place was easy to pass. Blue agave offered great breakfast and was open pretty much all day, they offer really good tacos but because menu was very limited you couldn't keep going back to this place. Mole' was meh, Japanese was 5/10, portions at the market grill were extremely small! All other restaurants were closed for construction at the time we were there. 
Another thing I'd like to mention is that this is not a particularly lively place. pool bar closed at 6...which is super early. Maybe 20% of guests were English speaking, the rest were Spanish or Portuguese speaking. (which was pretty cool). A lot of people come into the pool with clothes on which I wasn't fond of. If you are looking to meet people, I recommend you choose a different resort. 
Water is rather rough by this side of the strip so keep that in mind if you're looking to swim in the ocean everyday/ have kids. We took the bus which was only $1 to the public beach area a couple of times, water was much calmer and nicer!
A tip if you're going to Isla Mujeres. We opted to take the ferry there and rented a gold cart in the island and explored the island for hours , went to couple of different beaches, went snorkelling at Garrifon de Castillo  for like $5 if I remember correctly, did some shopping etc. This was a great experience, you get the local experience, spend less money and more time on this beautiful island. I'd recommend exploring Isla mujeres on your own vs going on a tour!
all in all, I probably wouldn't stay here again. Pool was old, quality of food was low which is pretty important if you're staying at a place for an entire week, just didn't live up to a 5 start hotel standards. I'd give it a 3.5. Oh and also, we din't get the "Royal" service! there was a weird divide in the middle of one of the 2 pools and you can't go past a certain line because its for loyal service. 
We were really worried about the weather going there is September, it was hot,humid  and rained maybe once for like 15 minutes the entire time we were there. travelled sep 12-19. Perfect weather!

reviews.author: Peter S
reviews.title: Nice All Inclusive for a Business Conference
reviews.text: Stayed at the Paradisus for 3 nights for a business conference in the Summer. Good food and facilities. Did not get too much time to relax but all in all, it was a nice hotel. Pools were okay unless you got access to the private location which I'm sure you pay more for. Restaurants on site were decent and good entertainment.

reviews.author: Paula R
reviews.title: Meets the highest standards for a luxury vacation!
reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Cancun Melia was our second.  We stayed the second week in September, 2019.  We love this place!  The hotel itself is a grand, beautifully designed place, with an experience niche for every type of guest.  It is huge, but almost has a small town feel, with a variety of streets and corridors to explore and restaurants to try.  

We are Melia members and enjoyed the upgrade to Royal Service.  This provided us a larger room (with a soaking tub), a “butler”, access to the adults-only pool and beach, and our favorite restaurant, the La Palapa, which is beachside. Hector was our “butler” and was the most refined and gracious gentleman one could hope to meet.  He took care of everything we needed, and went way out of his way to make my birthday very special.  By the time we left, we felt very much that Hector was our friend!

All the staff are amazing.  The beach and poolside servers and those at La Palapa were not only beautifully trained professionals, but personable as well, and most have been there at least since our first visit two years ago.  Moises, Julio, Oscar, Joshue, and Carmelita? are among the staff we looked forward to seeing every day.

Our stay was a wonderful experience; nothing was lacking; the perfect indulgence!

reviews.author: Ashley G
reviews.title: Amazing vacation ... Alan is the absolute BEST!
reviews.text: We had the time of our life visiting Paradisus for our second time in 2 years.  We travel with our two boys 12 & 14.  Our 14 yr old is autistic and the staff, particularly Alan, who included him in all of the activities was amazing.  Alan sought him out to make sure he didn’t miss anything.  Just amazing and so knowledgeable and helpful.  A dream come true for us as parents & watching our son have the time of his life! And a shout out to Rodrigo, who is the head of the entertainment team

reviews.author: Wildia M
reviews.title: Celebrating Our Aniversary
reviews.text: The best Vacation Ever !! This hotel is not only beautiful but what make this hotel special is the employees that works here at the Paradisus Cancun. You guys made our stay here special , unique and  amazing . I need to mentions name because everyone of you did amazing job with your genuine attentions.  Abraham at Mole , who teach us make the best passion fruit Margarita. Dania, Gaudencio at Mole Restaurant during our breakfast time . I told Gaudencio That I have diabetes and he went back and brought me special papaya fruit juice just for me without sugar. Roberto from La Palapa Restaurant he was so sweet and attentive. We went to the spa and David and Gemma did the couple massage. Jorge and Hugo at pool area , amazing guys . Luis from front desk very helpful l, and Judith very sweet with us. The guy from the pool area ( aerobics ) forgot his name , Very nice also .  We definitely would like to bring our kids and come back. Thank you 😊 again . Hope administration recognizes this amazing employees. Always smiling and always professional. I have nothing bad to say about this hotel I recommend you this place 100% . Worth every dollar.

reviews.author: Addie N
reviews.title: Exceptional Service and the best vacation!
reviews.text:
Amazing stay at Paradisus and sad to leave! Royal Service is 100% worth it and is a must! The best part of the resort though is definitely the service - truly exceptional! I listed below the people who made our experience amazing! Also, i have Celiac Disease and eat gluten free strictly and had no issues. Every menu is marked for GF and every staff was very knowledgeable and accommodating. A bit more difficult to eat GF at Bana (which is typical for sushi), so keep that in mind if you are celiac/gluten intolerant. 

Below are a few of the people who made this the best vacation: 

Our butlers: Javier and Cindy - went above and beyond for us! It was my birthday and they got my pool cabana & room all decorated! Also Cindy got me GF cake which was so sweet! So so thankful!! 

- Hector (Blue Agave) - he’s the BEST!!!!! 
- Gaudencio (Blue Agave) 
- Marvin (Mole) 
- Aaron (Royal Service)
- Orlando (Royal Service)
- Eddie (Royal Service)
- Oscar (Royal Service) 
- Roberto (La Palapa) 
- Sarahi (La Palapa hostess) 
- Alejandro (La Palapa) 
- Andres (Blue Agave) 
- Vicente (Blue Agave)
- Dana (Blue Agave) 

- Housekeeping - don’t know their names but our room was cleaned more than once a day and they did a great job! 
- Royal service reception - great check in/check out process! 

There really are so many more people that I didn’t get their names so you can’t go wrong! These are just the people i noted who truly stuck out and went above and beyond.

Thank you to everyone at Paradisus!! - Addie & Alex

reviews.author: Mferris321
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Mexico
reviews.text: The Resort was Beautiful, rooms were very nice and Beach front was Awesome the only thing i would suggest was the wall on balcony should be glass so when sitting you can see the water it is concrete so when sitting you see the wall. I loved leaving door open when in bed you could hear the waves with no problem. The staff was Great very friendly and eager to assist with anything you needed. Don't believe the weather reports it said Thunder storms the entire week we were there but the weather was perfect it would rain maybe 5-10 min during day and the storms would come at night when sleeping it was not too hot i suggest dont pack jackets you wont need them loose clothing since it is humid I would go back today if i could!!! Highly suggest we were there Oct 26th to Nov 2nd hope this helps :)

reviews.author: Emjohns7
reviews.title: An amazing holiday full of kind and wonderful people
reviews.text:
Sadly our holiday comes to an end tomorrow and I am not ready to go home. We have had the most wonderful time at Paradius and in Cancun. Everyone at the hotel has been fantastic and has gone above and beyond to make this a truly special holiday but I would also like to give a few special mentions to Alexa and Violeta who have made our whole experience amazing from beginning to end. They thought of everything from restaurant bookings both in and out the hotel to keeping us updated on the day’s entertainment to arranging a lovely surprise for my daughters. I can’t thank them enough. Also Alan and Rodrigo by the pool who bought loads of fun and energy to all the games and activities they arranged everyday. They worked really hard to get everyone involved and bought loads of fun to every day. Also to all the breakfast staff in Enso who got to know our love for English Breakfast Tea and hunted down teabags for us. They gave us a lovely warm welcome every morning and started our day perfectly. 
We have loved this holiday and it is with a heavy heart we have to leave. We will look forward to visiting again

reviews.author: McAwesomeMarkM
reviews.title: Great resort, AMAZING service
reviews.text: We have been to several all-inclusive resorts in Mexico, Jamaica and Punta Cana. This resort by far has the best service we've experienced. What the resort may lack in some other aspects the staff and their hospitality make up for any other short comings. We've stayed at this resort twice since visiting the Paradisus resort in Riviera Maya. Besides the staff, what we really like about the resort is the beautiful beach and ocean view from the other areas of the resort particularly the pool area and some of the eating areas. My main gripe on our last visit would be is that they were doing renovations, so two of our eating options were taking away from the first time we visited, and one of them was the main buffet. The only other two complaints I had besides lack of eating options was the limited areas with air-conditioning. Last time we went was in December and I don't remember it being that hot in all of the areas inside the hotel. The other was the lunch buffets didn't replenish the food fast enough, and with limited options you would like to see the food replenish. We've been in early Oct and Mid December. In Mid December the pool water was to cold (it isn't heated). During our October trip the pool was perfect. Other differences is Market grill was open for breakfast, lunch in dinner last time. The Market Grill before was a Brazilian BBQ and now it's a steak house.  Other change is you now need a towel card to get a beach/pool towel.  The wait staff around the pool Hector, Leticia and Jesus were all amazing. They would regularly check in on us to make sure we were taking care off. They are really hard workers and amazing people. Best pool service I've experienced. Usually you have to wave someone down at other places or they will come by every half hour or so. Not them, they remembered our drinks and would stop by every time they walked by. The gym is nice so I enjoyed lifting weights and my wife enjoyed doing the boot camp classes in the morning with Rodrigo, Alan, Julian. Alan also did an amazing job walking around during the day to let us know the activities for the day and my father and I enjoyed doing a tequila tasting and my kids and wife did a water painting class. The wait staff at our meals were equally hard working and amazing. Breakfast/lunch—Atilano at Enso breakfast buffet, and Aaron/Alfredo/Alejandro at Blue Agave breakfast buffet. Dinner—Juan and Aaron at Mole, and Alejandro at Feugo (at La Palapa).  Atilano and Alredo actually remembered us from our visit the year before and they made us feel extra special on our trip. Best Meals was La Palapa and I really like the Blue Agave for street tacos.  The bar staff in the Avenue bar area were all nice as well.  There were typically 2 – 3 shows a night.  There was usually at least a family show and then either a singer/band later. Only negative this time was they didn't have the Michael Jackson show this time.  We've been here twice and will surely stay here again for the amazing quality service, cleanliness, amenities and beautiful location.

reviews.author: Katie
reviews.title: Will not book my wedding here
reviews.text:
My fiancé and I came here to potentially book our wedding. I’ll start off by saying I filled out several requests to speak with a wedding coordinator before the visit and received no response. 

Pros:
1. Most of the staff was amazing. Martin at the buffet was great and generally all the wait staff was fast and accommodating. 
2. Beach and location. It’s close to the airport and the beach and water is fantastic. 
3. Coffee shop was cute and staff there were nice 
 
Cons:

1. Hotel is under construction and 3 of the restaurants are closed. The employees don’t know that apparently because twice I asked where 2 different restaurants were, they gave me directions and sent me to a closed place. 
2. Check in was long and they try to sell you a timeshare
3. Rooms are dated, lighting is terrible and outlets are hard to come by
4. Pool is outdated and it’s impossible to find a chair if you are not there at 8am. The hotel wasn’t even that busy, so I cant imagine what it’s like when it is.
5. You need a towel card for the pool. I figured for the level hotel they advertise, you wouldn’t need something like that. It’s a pain to go get your towels and when you do they relentlessly try to sell you an adventure like jet skiing or parasailing. It was soooo annoying that it was the main reason I didnt want to host a wedding there. No one needs a high pressure sales environment when they’re trying to relax at the pool. 
6. The timeshare pitch doesn’t stop at check in, they call you and let you know someone has a gift for you at the front desk and just ask for Carlos to pick it up. Sure be right there.....
7. You need reservations at most of the restaurants 

Overall great location and if you pay for the royal service I’m sure it is better. Was surprised at how high the rating was for this location. Didn’t waste my time meeting with the coordinator because I knew it wasn’t the place for me. Was decent for a quick getaway but definitely not my favorite.

reviews.author: cassandra357
reviews.title: Not the funnest place
reviews.text: This place isn’t bad if all you want to do is relax. Other than that, there is no entertainment, the food isn’t great and most of all, you will face VERY pushy staff trying to sell you things daily. It’s clear they are told to be this pushy from corporate because they are all this way. At one point we were confronted and the lady said she “insisted” we attend the timeshare presentation! (We fully paid for our trip and were not under any obligation to go to a presentation.) There are other fun places to stay with way better food and fun staff. 7 days felt like a long time at this resort and I’ve never felt that way on a vacation.

reviews.author: 🤴 king
reviews.title: Paradisus great job👏👏👏👏👏
reviews.text: The check in family concierge was fast and they explained very thing about the hotel to very small detail. The food is amazing. I loved the shrimps in the restaurant la palapa. All the staff is very helpful and the smile all the time saying HOLA. I felt like was home and not in a resort. I recommend this hotel to all my friends.

reviews.author: Meera V
reviews.title: Orlando Bello is the best !!
reviews.text: Make sure you stop by the coffee bar and have Orlando make you a coffee ! He’s is such an amazing person ! He also serves breakfast at Naos. He is very attentive and always gets the order right. An ever smiling face : )

reviews.author: Alexandra M
reviews.title: Paradise in Cancun
reviews.text: This has been the most amazing vacation ever!! Everything from the beach, the food, the room, the kids club to the service is top notch, perfect. Gloria and Fernando with the family concierge are a must. They go out of their way to make you feel so special and they are there for anything you need! Soül, Paula, Fer, Mage, Nicole, Rodrigo, Tanya, Adriana (I hope that's everyone from the kids club), you guys are amazing! Best Kids club ever. My son loves you all so much and never wanted to leave ♥️ I think Soül is his new best friend lol! Thank you Sofonia for the awesome service by the pool, always a smile and our drinks were always full! To all the waiters (Martin at Enso, Alejandro and Naila at la Palapa) and any staff I missed, thank you. We don't want to leave but we will be back!!

reviews.author: AustinHall0508
reviews.title: Lack of personalization and maintenance
reviews.text: It was our engagement trip, we felt like 2 sheep in a hotel of 2000. Our host ditched us as soon as she read off the hotel info and restaurants and never saw her again although she promised us engagement surprises and told us one of them would be champagne to our room which never came, the room had many flaws; small, granite falling off walls, everything was very “used”. Lighting for my fiancé’s make up was a joke. The outlets only worked half the time. Pool was falling apart. Beach and Bali beds were nice. The spa was obnoxiously loud due to the layout of the YHI spa, you’re getting a message that was expensive feet from where people are in the pool screaming and yelling and getting a message in that environment was a disgrace, this is a short list, prepare to be forgot about. We booked this trip last minute and decided on this hotel because we had stayed at Melia Playa before and in hopes it was close to the same. They complete opposites.

reviews.author: Tracy B
reviews.title: Happy in Cancun
reviews.text: Just loved Victor and Orlando!!!!  Galdino made our stay so easy.  They all were so nice and accommodating trip wouldn’t have been the same without them. Great guys!! Loved the pool area and the restaurant and bar right there.

reviews.author: compvlsions
reviews.title: Great hotel, little dated
reviews.text: The hotel staff were amazing. The hotel itself is beautiful - our only disappointment was paying for an upgraded oceanview suite. The view was amazing, but the room looked nothing like the pictures and we found the room to be quite Dated. Otherwise, a great hotel.

reviews.author: Kim Z
reviews.title: AMAZING TIME
reviews.text:
I had an extremely amazing time at this resort. Everyone is so friendly, rooms were VERY clean. Food was good. Beach was BEAUTIFUL. Highly recommend.

I booked on sunwing and it was extremely organized. Would visit again 100%

reviews.author: Krasnogor
reviews.title: Very nice vacation experience
reviews.text: Room was standard. Balcony and garden veiw were great. Loved all toiletries. Couch looked a bit dated. Didn't love wall art, not happy looking for vacation atmosphere. Very enjoyable experience otherwise. Great friendly stuff. Outside movies were a big hit for kids. It was nice to have activities right on the beach such as volleyball, kids soccer, parasailing.

reviews.author: Blair
reviews.title: My first cancun was awful
reviews.text: I can’t believe this hotel is a five star resort but it pretend. I felt like the employee was looking down on me because i’ve already paid. Concierge is too slow and in absence. Why didn’t anybody answer?

reviews.author: SurMar
reviews.title: Great Resort - Few Minor things to Make it 5 Start
reviews.text:
Stay at the Resort Thanksgiving Weekend with my Wife!! Anniversary Getaway!

The Good- The Resort is very nice. About 15 minutes from the Airport. You can take a taxi or use USA Transfer( I do highly recommend). I was in building 3 where they have all the restaurants. The Food I will give 7.5 out of 10. The Buffet was pretty good as well. Not Great but there is variety and don't think you will find much better at an all inclusive in Mexico. The BEACH was very clean. Clear waters, white sand and enough Huts for everyone. The bars are great and serve decent top shelve liquors. Don't expect High End. But again you won't get that at too many all inclusive. The service for the most part was good. There is always waiters at the beach to bring you drinks. I don't think it's necessary to do Royal Service at all. Unless you want absolute peace and quietness. Other that that. No big difference. Book a massage if you can afford it. It's Awesome. Also, the photographer takes great pictures if you will like to book a shoot. 

The not so good. - We had an ocean view room. The rooms can use some updating. However, I do heard that some rooms are newly renovated. I am assuming they are working their way down the floors. Upon check we were told something will be sent to up to our room for our Anniversary. Never happened. The timeshare people can be a bit annoying at check in. The charge $5 for room service which I think is ridiculous for an all inclusive. I do tip the delivery person at least $5 for bringing the food up. But why charge me for Burgers at an all inclusive when it's just something you grab from the buffet and bring to the room. Def not 5 star

I do think it's a great Hotel and will Stay again if I was to visit Cancun.

reviews.author: joanna2144
reviews.title: Paradise For Two
reviews.text:
We had a very enjoyable six night stay at this hotel.  From the moment we stepped foot on the property we were treated with excellent service.  The resort has a very Zen feel to it. Greenery everywhere and scent of tea tree oil lingers around the main building.  Our trip started with an easy check-in, and introduction to the hotel.  We were also influenced to sign up the next day for an introduction to Club Melia, which is a 90 minute presentation, that included breakfast, a short tour, and of course their sales pitch. We decided to do the tour, knowing we weren't interested in Club Melia, but they offered a really good discount at the spa for enduring the presentation.  It really was only 90 minutes of our time (including the breakfast).  

Our ocean view room was fantastic!  Clean, spacious and comfortable.  The ocean view rooms offer amazing views of the sun rising every morning.  At night, we could also watch some of the entertainment right from our balcony.  The tv only offered a few English speaking channels (CNN, BBC and TNT).  I wish they would have had a few more English options available.  

The beach area was easy to access and well kept with crystal blue water and soft clean white sand.  Plenty of palapas and chairs were available for us.  Of course November is the off season, so I'm sure it would have been different if the resort was busier.  The drink service at the beach was excellent.  Our server checked on us making sure our drinks were kept full.  The ocean water is absolutely beautiful!  There was a little seaweed in the water, but not nearly enough that it would interfere with swimming and playing around in the ocean.  

The pools are awesome, and big!  We mostly stayed in the main pool that has the pool bar, which is were all the action is. Every day they provided some sort of entertainment around the pool area.  We had a lot of fun socializing in the pool area.  

We did a couples massage at the spa, and that was also a great experience.  We got a really good deal on the massage since we did the Club Melia presentation.  We were able to come early and use the steam room and hydro pool in the spa before our massage.  The massage was top notch, and we both really enjoyed our experience.  

This resort has several restaurants.  Two of them were closed for remodeling while we were there.  I have to be honest, I didn't think the food at the the resort was anything to brag about.  It was good, just not great.  Our favorite restaurant was the Market Grill. You can eat at this restaurant and watch the evening entertainment.  This restaurant is similar to Fogo de Chao.  Prime cuts of beef sliced to order at your table. The buffet restaurant Naos, had plenty of variety, but again I thought the food was okay.  I heard Cancun has a lot of nice restaurants, and I wish we would have ventured out and tried a few.  

The nightly entertainment was also fabulous!  Every night they had music and dancing, and all the show were very engaging. 

This is my second time staying at a Melia property, and both of my experiences have been impressive.  We would definitely stay at this resort again if we return to Cancun.

reviews.author: Slinger
reviews.title: Family Concierge butler service is amazing
reviews.text: Alexander and Rodolfo were fantastic and made our stay so stress free.  Very helpful butlers.  The resort is just incredible.  The beach is perfect, the pool staff is superb, and the food is excellent.  Very impressed with this place and will 100% return.

reviews.author: SauminShah
reviews.title: Bad reservation system and rude phone customer service
reviews.text: This review is not for the resort itself but for its reservation booking and customer service to make reservations. I booked my stay from Dec 18 to Dec 24 for Cancun Paradisus online using their Melia Rewards programme. However, my 2000 points did not apply to the reservation. I made a non refundable booking which Is what I intended to do. But When I called customer service if they could apply the points so that I would get the discount which was worth $100 at the time of booking, they very rudely told me that they cant do anything with it. I asked them if I could escalate it or reach out to someone who can help apply those points. They said they cannot do anything about it. They were vey rude on the phone. $100 is a lot of money to loose. I am already not looking forward to staying at this hotel. We booked a family concierge ocean view room but I have very low expectations now and cant cancel it now. Also i had emailed resort itself wanting to know what kind of baby food they serve as i am travelling with a 7 month baby. I also wanted to know if they provide mirowave and high chair in room but they hav not got back to me. Real disappointment since i need to think about packing

reviews.author: BeWishful
reviews.title: A Wonderful Honeymoon in Royal Services
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to Mexico and our first time experiencing an all-inclusive resort. If we’re being honest, we were a little sceptical about all-inclusive. We weren’t sure what to expect and we thought it might feel a bit uncomfortable to have someone wait on us all day long. 

All these thoughts aside, we still wanted to try out this beautiful resort for our honeymoon and looking back, we are glad we made this decision. 

The resort was beyond beautiful and the staff members were ever so kind to us. They were patient with us as we learned how all-inclusive worked and what was available to us in Royal Service. 

As a side note, one of the big takeaways was the fact that staff members did not have their hands out asking for a tip whenever they served us or assisted us. We heard from a couple who we met that this is one of the big reasons why they love Paradisus Cancún. They’ve had bad experiences at other resorts where staff members expected a tip for every act of service. With that being said, if tips were given to staff members, they were very appreciative and respectful. 

The work ethic of every staff member baffled us as we watched them go from cabana to cabana in the burning heat, assisting guests who were relaxing in the shade by the poolside. When you passed a staff member in the hallway or around the resort, it was not uncommon to receive a smile and a friendly hola, buenos días or buena noches. 

In addition to our comments on staff members, a few names come to mind which we hold in high regard. Everyone was very kind to us and accommodating; therefore, we will mention a few names here and reiterate our appreciation to the staff of Paradisus Cancún. 

Hector: A very kind server who transformed a simple breakfast at NAOS into a wonderful memory of Paradisus Cancún. 

Aurturo: Our butler who was always there if we needed him, even when his shift was ended. 

Oscar: Our kind poolside Concierge  with a sense of humour. 

Martin: Our server who was energetic, kind and fun. 

Valeria: Another very kind server and poolside concierge, with an amazing work ethic. 

In regard to the food, we had our favourite restaurants and ones which were a little lower on our list based upon our personal preference. The restaurants which we went to during our stay are as follows: Fuego, NAOS, Mole, Bana, The Market Grill, Vento and Enso. Our favourite was, to our surprise, Mole. The delicious food, fun atmosphere and authentic Mexican experience was so exciting and memorable. 

A few of the nice perks included with Royal Service is the priority in making reservations for restaurants, not having to bring your wallet to restaurants, receiving exceptional treatment and having a butler to assist you. 

The majority of Paradisus staff spoke really good English. However, there was one housekeeper that did not speak English at all, but we were able to get by with simple hand gestures, smiles and head nods. 

Final remarks regarding our stay in Royal Service at the Paradisus Cancún. We would like return to this resort and stay in Royal Service again as soon as possible. When we return, we can’t wait to be reacquainted with the staff who made our stay 10x more enjoyable.

reviews.author: Pinkey P
reviews.title: Family Concierge Stay with Amazing Staff & Service
reviews.text:
We stayed here for 4 nights and LOVED every moment!  We stayed in a Family Concierge one bedroom suite. 

We used Whatsapp on our phones to chat with our Concierge staff to get anything and everything we needed.  Mostly it was to accommodate our daughter's needs.    

Each day we would message for steamed veggies and a smoothie around 5pm.  We would feed her before we went to dinner as she gets distracted very easily so it made our dinners very calm.  

We would request for a cabana, and based on availability we usually were accommodated.  

On our second day we forgot our daughter's swim hat and life jacket at the pool (our fault).  We remembered the next day and was just saddened that no one returned it and it could not be found.   We asked the staff to keep a look out, it was never found but the next day that loaned us a fun flotation device.  Our daughter loved it!

Before our arrival I sent the concierge service the list of restaurants we wanted to go to and the timing.  They made sure we made it to each and every one!   They could make it only 24 hours in advance but it all worked out.   All restaurants were AMAZING!

Some of the items that could use updates are the room bathroom.  Since it is a family concierge room, i would have liked a double sink and more space.  
Also  - since it is a family friend place it would have been nice to have some small pool slides or activities in the pool for kids.   The pool was nice and shallow but not much activities for infant/toddlers.  

Shout out to Fernanda and Violeta!  You made our stay PERFECT!  Hope to be back soon!

reviews.author: Debbie M
reviews.title: Simply Amazing
reviews.text: Loved this resort. Besides being beautiful they offered nightly entertainment, great food selections and excellent service. Poolside find Miguel and sit in his section, he will keep you hydrated! In the buffet we absolutely loved Gaudencio. He will remember you from day one. I can't wait to go back....soon!

reviews.author: Lynn K
reviews.title: Amazing place and people!!
reviews.text: We went to Paradisus the week of Thanksgiving. There were 10 of us, 3 children and 7 adults. It was beautiful! They were constantly making sure things were clean and we were taken care of. I don't think it would have been the same without Sandra and Gloria taking care of every detail for us. We spent the day relaxing by the pool, which Michael took great care of us there. The kids loved the kid zone. In fact, they didn't want to leave on a couple days!  We will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Aidanryland
reviews.title: First time at Paradisus
reviews.text: This was our first trip to Paradisus Cancun, we got a pretty good price booking through Meliá so we decided to give it a try.  We have stayed at high end resorts and lower end and I would have to say Paradisus is at the high end of the scale. From the moment you walk in the greenery, plants and flowers are all over and very well manicured.  I actually saw workers cleaning all the leaves of the plants with rags. The hotel was spotless, the pools and grounds cleaned every day.  We actually enjoyed the hotel so much that we booked another trip on Black Friday when they were running another special.  All the workers were extremely polite and always happy to help in any way.  We enjoyed all the restaurants for dinner and the buffet for breakfast.  For lunch we usually ate at the grill by the pools. Miguel and the two girls he worked with were working so hard every day there.  There was always a line and they were keeping up very well which looked extremely hard to do considering all the people lined up day after day. By the way the wings were amazing there. I have to say from day 1 all the way through day 8 we encountered one person that really made our trip.  Gaudencio who worked in the buffet for breakfast and lunch from our first meal to the last he approached us with a smile and a hand shake, or a fist bump for my son.  He was always there to great us and have a table ready for my whole family.  He was just one of those employees who I truly look forward to coming back to see again. He is a very special and hard working man and deserves the praise for it.  I will definitely be back to see him and this beautiful resort again soon.

reviews.author: CanadianSuzyQ
reviews.title: VERY DISAPPOINTING
reviews.text:
1)     This hotel has a "Club" (time share), and you are directed to them when you check in.  Too aggressive for my liking. 
2)      No one seemed to know what the entertainment was and where it was and even what time it started.  This is the first all inclusive hotel I have ever stayed at that didn't have nightly entertainment - at a set time and in a set place.
3)      Food was OK.  Staff was great.  
4)      Spa - massage was amazing but the experience before (1 hour before was boring and the water was cool to cold in the pool area and the shower
5)       One day they put up a blow up slide by the pool for the kids, but that was it.  No one doing water aerobics, playing volley ball or anything else to keep the guests entertained.

reviews.author: Alanna O
reviews.title: Relaxing Stay at Paradisus
reviews.text:
The hotel is gorgeous and the grounds are wonderfully kept. Upon arrival you are offered a drink while checking in. Check in was a bit slow, but the staff was very friendly and helpful. 

All the rooms are up to date and we were pleasantly surprised to find that they all have huge private balconies. We thought about upgrading to an ocean view but decided not to and it was the right choice, the front side of the hotel offers a view of the golf course and lagoon, which was just as beautiful.  

We stayed in the main building, which can get a little noisy at night due to the entertainment and music from the club, however we were so tired we didn't hear it once we fell asleep. 

While you are at the pool/beach, people from the spa and photography booth will come around to book you appointments if you are interested. We spent an evening at the spa and it was very relaxing and worth every penny. I participated in a photo shoot as well but the prices were very high, so I did not purchase any photos although they were great. 

The food at the hotel is decent, however I wish there were more authentic Mexican meals served. The hotel offers 1 Mexican restaurant, which was not authentic. I was hoping to have some delicious tacos, but sadly I did not. The food is catered towards tourists, which I understand, but I did not travel to eat the same food. 

The service we received during our stay was outstanding, everyone was very friendly. I would like to give a special shoutout to Miguel for his wonderful service at the beach and pool, he was fun and kept the drinks flowing. I would also like to thank Antonio for his wonderful service at Naos, he made sure we had everything we needed at each meal. Thank you to all the other staff members who helped us as well, I wish I got all your names. 

Overall the Paradissus is a great hotel and I would definitely visit again. 

P.S. We also went to the clubs one night, some have very expensive admission prices and some are reasonable. We felt safe on the bus and catching a cab.

reviews.author: Rcasares
reviews.title: Revisit after 8 years
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun used to be a Melia 8 years ago. We were here Christmas 2010. This time was more amazing. Thanksgiving holiday to remember. To mention the awesome employees: Orlando from Nespresso, Claudio from Ilbana, Nayeli from Concierge, Victor from Bell and Margarita most helpful. Food, service and accommodation were Great. Wellness Center/Gym is 24 hours, awesome. Beach is pristine white sand

reviews.author: Shaman
reviews.title: Starting to show its age
reviews.text: We really liked our experience at the restaurants here, but the hotel it self is really starting to show its age. The pools were not adequately heated during our time there, but the staff and service were really kind and amazing. We paid extra for the Royal Service but I would not do so in the future, we barely saw our "butler" and he was no where to be found after maybe one or two days. The best part about Royal Service was the royal service only restaurant, which had an amazing view. We have been to four the the Paradisus brand resorts and this one by far had the best food.

reviews.author: CPTraveler17
reviews.title: Nice All Inclusive
reviews.text:
Spent five days in November and while the resort was clean, had some great architectural features, and service was very good, we would consider this a nice but not great all-inclusive resort.

Check-in and check-out was great. Room was nice with a great ocean view. Pool and beach area was very nice. Overall the service was good.

Dining options were average, although Tempo was absolutely outstanding. The included restaurants featured a good selection although quality of service varied greatly between restaurants. The additional cost Tempo was exceptional, both the menu and service was well worth the additional cost. 

The bars and lounges fell short of expectation. The hours of operation seemed limited and most closed around midnight.

The biggest negative is that the Resort is also a time-share property resulting in being asked numerous times if we would be interested in a presentation and tour - the sales approach was annoying.

Overall, this property was nice; however probably wouldn't be on the top of our list the next time we visit Cancun.

reviews.author: Zhana K
reviews.title: Stay away
reviews.text:
We had the worst experience in Paradisus and I would never stay here again. Our usual hotel is under construction and based on the reviews we booked this hotel for 2 days. Stayed on November 18 to 20. We arrived early and the check-in wait was about 45 minute.The room wasnt ready which was expected since it was 9 am. I used the hospitality suite to change and noticed a small cockroach. I undertand it's a big hotel and hard to control what comes inside. I didnt pay it no mind.  We went to the pool and did our own thing. At around 130 PM our room was ready and looked clean. In the evening when we came back, there were small roaches all over the table. I wish I can post a video of this nightmare. They were everywhere. I lifted my purse. And a huge roach ran out. We called downstairs right away. The lady asked us "do you want us to spray the room??what ???spray the room?no, I want new CLEAN room. After we went downstairs, the manager was not on site. About 5 minutes of screaming, he reincarnated and was able to move us to a different room. For such a large hotel, they could get the place fumigated.
The food was horrible,except at the royal service restaurant.  And the beach is nice. But the place is horrible and the workers weren't very friendly. 
Anyway,if you wish to bring some new friends home, stay away from here. I ended up washing and spraying all my bags prior to entering my home.

reviews.author: M7594JQjessicae
reviews.title: NICE FAMILY VACATION
reviews.text: It was a nice, clean and cozy place to take your family on vacation. I was celebrating my husband's birthday and he really enjoyed himself. The beach and pool was fabulous. The weather was perfect and it made our vacation well worth it.

reviews.author: Bodee J
reviews.title: Thanksgiving
reviews.text: Service was great!  We enjoyed every restaurant except Bana. The sushi we had was not good at all. We ended up visiting Blue Agave for the 2nd time (excellent taco joint.) Our kids, 11 & 12 spent most of their time in the ocean. The poolside Sunset Grill had really good made to order pizzas, wraps, and grilled foods as well as buffet with burgers, fries, and hotdogs. The wife and I really enjoyed Mole and Blue Agave.  During the evenings we spent most of our time at Cocos Beach Club Bar.  Carina and Samuel were excellent bartenders and wait staff.

reviews.author: Pev1982
reviews.title: Thank you Rodolfo & Alexander
reviews.text:
If you do decide to stay here, make sure you opt for the concierge service, request for Rodolfo & Alexander to be your butlers as they are brilliant. 

Food wasn’t that great, we had dominos 4 times and went out of the resort for dinner most nights. 

Thank you Rodolfo & Alexander for making our stay so lovely. 

Lots of love 

Patel family - room 1601

reviews.author: Pathfinder234683
reviews.title: Relaxation
reviews.text: N Joy our stay somewhat, was better when we stayed there before and was not as expensive on the other side. It has its pros and cons, should be able to use other Cabanas when others are in use on adult side.

reviews.author: Tomas W
reviews.title: An Ok ....huge Resort
reviews.text: I give this resort 3.5 starsI would consider it a 4 stars if the food was better.The staff is really attentive and ready to help.The Royal Service adults only was a good option for us, great quality premium beverages and the size of this section is a bit cozier than the rest of the ptoperty.The resort is HUGE and difficult to see it all in a 4 days stay, the Disco is awesome for after dinner fun...without children running around.Our only bad experience was outside Vento while having dinner...we saw roaches crawling from a lobby fish pond...to underneath our table....our appetite was gone for the remainder of the trip.

reviews.author: Juila W
reviews.title: Highly Recommend this hotel!!!!
reviews.text: This hotel was awesome staff was wonderful and respectful!  Clean food was good and lots choices! We will definitely love to return with our children next time. I can't recommend this resort enough. BTW pool bar is a plus and the waiters are on their game!

reviews.author: Cpetra
reviews.title: Melia Paradisus Cancun 7-day vacation for couples is perfecto!!
reviews.text: We enjoyed 7 restful & relaxing days at Paradisus Cancun exactly what we needed! Victor our pool side cabana pool bar waiter was awesome where we enjoyed a private cabana every day with beautiful views. Victor bartended at the indoor bar on Friday. He is a class act & his customer service is superior. Armando Balam & Guadencio were our breakfast/lunch waiters in Naos Restaurant were like having the "A" Team -Amazing! They could not do enough for us. Geni who makes the omelette is a pro. She was our best friend each morning. Petra did yoga & Pilates classes. She is very knowledgeable Pilates/yoga fitness person & delightful! Classes always full so recommend beach yoga to accommodate larger numbers. I missed yoga one day no more room even arrived early.  Only comment is food kept under warming lights was never hot enough. Older hotel compared to some of newer on Cancun but clean & well kept. Overall would have given 5 stars -the Melia employees are all CLASS ACTS who pride themselves on customer service.

reviews.author: Trail60434407186
reviews.title: Iryna Sytnikova
reviews.text: Stayed at Royal Service Paradisus Cancun - Excellent. The Hotel is very clean, loved the garden area in the middle with food bar. There's a variety of restaurants/food - all inclusive. The only one not included - TEMPO, expensive, but definitely worth the experience! Our butler Maria (Russian lady) was amazing! She has provided excellent service, was very attentive and responded to all of our needs in a timely manner. She made our stay very comfortable!

reviews.author: wsz1910
reviews.title: Best vacation ever
reviews.text: I had a fantastic time in Paradisus and I had best pool bar service ever Thank you Eden, perla, eduardo VILLAFANA, tomas.  I love Hotel and service. Food was great as well. Perfect weather and a lot of attraction make his place that for sure I will come back next year. :)

reviews.author: Tourist46534803668
reviews.title: Paradises Cancun
reviews.text:
Hello all!

This was my very first time staying at the Paradisus resort and I was for the most part pleased.

My critiques would be the wait for seating at a restaurant if you were to arrive anytime later then 7pm the wait could exceed an hour. Also, not a wide variety of food, restaurants very small in comparison to the size of the hotel. Fuego was good, we enjoyed the sirloin and seafood dishes. The largest buffet on site was closed for reservations until our last day. The outside grill was satisfactory, definitely could have been better. 

Our room was SUPER small, we had a junior suite ocean view which is the typical room we book elsewhere, but this was exceptionally small compared to other resorts. Bathroom & room decor was dated. Long walks to restaurant areas.

The bar sizes are super small. THERE IS NOT ONE BAR WITH A TV, sports lovers beware! We were forced to leave the resort to watch a football game. Unlike other resorts aside from the pool bar there were only two more bars, one in the center which could only fit 6 people and then a large entertainment area that in my opinion was a waste of space, only opened late at night. 

The cabanas on beach look dirty.

Now to the good stuff!...

My boyfriend and I were celebrating our anniversary so when we arrived there were rose petals on floor, also champagne was delivered that night. 

Cabana service (at the pool) was worth the money, we had a blast. Our servers David and Didier were AMAZING!! I can not compliment them enough, very personable, great attitudes, attentive to all of your needs. The lobster and champagne served were great. 

The pool bar was nice, the bartenders were good and again attentive. (Closes at 6pm, which was the worst part). 

We did a fishing excursion through Aqua world and it was amazing. We caught in total 17 HUGE fish, the staff was great and super helpful. Conveniently Aqua world is located directly across the street from the resort.

The center bar was good (with the exception of size) but bartender Jamie made it that much better, he was great, again super personable, pleasant! 

Clean resort. 
Food mediocre.
Great service - Jamie (center bar), David and Didier (cabana & pool service)

reviews.author: Po Fu C
reviews.title: Family Concierge Not Worth It
reviews.text:
Booked a family concierge junior suite for 4; me, my wife, and 2 kids ages 4 and 8.  Booking was made over 8 months ago, and the reason I opted for the upgrade to family concierge is advance dinner reservation by the assigned butler.  As any parent can attest, it is hard to keep the kids occupied if you had to wait an hour in line for a table.

During check-in today, I was advised that the advance dinner reservation service has been discontinued, and I must wait in line for a table even with family concierge.  I was not informed of this change in advance or offered an opportunity to cancel my reservation (which I would), nor was I offered any upgrade or price adjustment to reflect the diminished level of service.  I was assured that the wait for a table at any restaurant would not exceed 20 minutes, lo-and-behold every restaurant has a 45 to 60 minute wait around our normal dinner time of 7:30 p.m.  In short, I paid for premium but received just regular level of service, which made the extra charge for Family Concierge a complete waste of money.

It is a shame that the management at Paradisus Cancun would just arbitrarily alter its service agreement without concern for its guests’ interest.  The employees are friendly and the resort is actually quite nice, but this is definitely not a property I would come back or recommend to anyone.

reviews.author: Josh M
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: This is my first time to Punta Cana and will not be my last! Paradisus is an amazing hotel with amazing staff. In particular, my OSCAR POLANCO, FIUMER JAVIER, EDWARD CAMINERO, ANTHONY ASTACIO, DEYANIRA MOTA and YARITZA BURGOS!! THE BEST STAFF EVER!

reviews.author: Journey59531
reviews.title: Confused by all the positive reviews
reviews.text:
- There is only one restaurant that accepts dinner reservations (the most expensive one); aside from that, it is a 1.5 HOUR wait for dinner each night. I have no idea why people are saying that their butler got them dinner reservations -- ours told us that dinner reservations are not possible and that we either need to show up at 6 pm to hope to get in within 10-15 minutes.... otherwise, it's easily a 1-1.5 hr wait for dinner. And you are not allowed to leave the area, because if they call your name and you are not there, you lose your reservation, so you literally need to stand outside of the restaurant for an hour just to get in!   

- Assuming you can get in to one of the nice restaurants, they are only open for dinner...

-... therefore, the rest of the day, you're stuck mostly with buffet food: soggy fries, over-cooked hot-dogs, room-temperature ceviche...leather-tough waffles at breakfast.  Yes, the omelettes at breakfast are lovely... too bad there is a 30-minute long line to get them!!!!

What is the point of going to an "all you can eat" place if the waits are so long, you can't actually eat anything?  (and the stuff that IS available at the buffet is unappetizing?)

And the free alcohol -- sure, it's "free", as in "might as well we alcohol free" -- we ended up ordering beer and wine in the hopes of getting alcohol in the drinks; otherwise, they were very weak. 

Enjoy your relaxing time by the pool.... as the tour operators try to sell you on a tour package for the umpteenth time, or relax on the beach as hawkers walk by, trying to get you to buy their stuff  / get your hair braided. 

My lesson has been learned -- if this is what all "all-inclusive" resort is (it was my first time staying in one), then I will never do it again.  There are so many tricks for them to save money (cheap buffet food; lines so long at the restaurants that you can't eat at them; watered down cocktails...), that it is not even close to being worth the cost. 

Oh! My favorite part!  The "all-inclusive" latte / capuccino service... that was only open for like 2 hours per day!   I was SO excited when our butler told us that the Nespresso latte / capuccino / espresso bar was included in the all you can eat.... well the joke was on me, because the place was never open.  Even better, they don't even post a list of times that it will be open!  Ditto for the free gelato place next to it. Free gelato, wow!  Except... except it was almost never open? 

From now on, I'd rather spend twice as much money but go to a hotel where I can get what I want, when I want it. 

Sorry if this is harsh but the fact that there are SO many 5-star reviews here had given me sky-high expectations... expectations that were not met by the sad buffet food, the room service with only a handful of options, and the 'six pm or nothing' option for the nice dinner restaurants.  I only get a little bit of vacation each year, and I want to relax and Id rather pay for my latte, but at least get one when I want one.

reviews.author: Clifford L
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: We travel around 4x a year with the family to different warm places for their pools and beaches in the world. We generally limit our stay at the Ritz Carlton, JW Marriott or W/Westin.Last year, we took a gamble picking Paradisus Playa del Carmen (PDC) instead of a well known international brand. Just last week, we came back from a  wonderful 7 night stay at the Paradisus Cancun. We couldn't help but compare which resort is nicer. They couldn't be any more different in terms of the resort layout, look and feel. We were initially missing Paradisus Playa del Carmen's more vast resort layout, but after a few days of Paradisus Cancun's service, we felt totally at home and comfortable with our choice of picking Paradisus Cancun. The two resorts were common with their top notch service, level of food service (for the price). I just wish they had the nespresso/illy coffee bars open more hours in a day. They were literally just open 4 or 5 hrs in a day. Food service is phenomenal at both sites - maybe the time period we visited (early November) is their slow period.. so we had servers always available to help.. whether we were pool side or at any of their restaurants. One difference I found was the Cancun food staff was a notch friendlier than the PDC Paradisus staff. Overall, an amazing experience and have recommended to our friends.

reviews.author: melissaruminot
reviews.title: Great resort & location for families
reviews.text:
Booked this last minute for a quick, 3 day getaway right before Thanksgiving. Got extremely lucky to see a Family Concierge Oceanview Suite become available and the price was perfect. Check in was a breeze in the Concierge lounge and we were in our bathing suits enjoying very quickly. The room size was perfect. As a family of 5, I highly recommend  the suite. We easily fit an extra bed with the sofa beds and the two terraces were amazing.  Our butlers, Sandra and Gloria, were fantastic and made sure we knew the activities for the day and took very good care of us. My kids loved the kids club, but did wish for more activities and later hours for the club. Foam party was fun! 

We did snorkeling thru Aquaworld and did the 11am departure. They told us it was 2 hrs- it wasn’t, it was 4.5 which was way too long. We were ready to leave after 2-2.5 hours and waiting the extra time was not great. Overall the value was good just way too long. 

Back to Paradisus— overall, it was good. Food was decent, location was fantastic. Staff was great. Special shout out to Saul - he made my son’s night during the shows and became his “best bud” - we appreciate that so much!   The night time entertainment could be improved and I didn’t like that they don’t do reservations for dinner so wait times can be long which is annoying. For the value, this was perfect for our quick trip.

reviews.author: Samantha H
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort. Clean and amazing food. The Spa was even better than expected. Only negative was the fact that unless you got to dinner at 6, you’d have an hour wait and the restaurant was near empty. They save the seats for the Royalty service rooms and make the others wait. 

Super kid friendly. If you go to get away from kids, this may not be the place to go. We may consider an adult only resort for this reason specifically.

reviews.author: tammy v
reviews.title: Excellent every time!!!
reviews.text: I love Paradisus is my 3rd time staying there and will always come back everytime I’ll go to Cancun. Everyone is amazing from Nacho in breakfast, Asunción in the pool to every single person in the hotel.

reviews.author: zbass11
reviews.title: Fantastic stay!
reviews.text: I have been reading reviews for this hotel for a couple of months before visiting. I was worried that it might not be great as we had a terrible stay at crown paradise club the year before. This hotel is fantastic!! I do not really post a lot of reviews but I wanted to let potential visitors know that there is nothing to be worried about. The hotel is very clean! The lobby is beautiful! The staff is fantastic and friendly! The food is good and NO MORE reservations for restaurants! Obviously the restaurants are not Michelin starred as it’s mass produced. The Markit grill is really good and so is Blue Agave. The rest of the restaurants are good. There is definitely quality control of food i.e. correct care for different foods unlike crown paradise where my wife got sick for a day from the buffet. The pools are fantastic and huge! It spans the length of the hotel. The hotel landscape is beautiful as it has a golf course around with palm trees, tropical plants, and green grass. Unless you are super picky and like to complain about petty things, I think you will like this hotel!

reviews.author: Cristoteca02
reviews.title: Is avarage .. but is good
reviews.text: I like this hotel the is avarage .. the drink are good .. you need reservation for restaurant .. pool are .. royale service is good if you want to relax adult only .. they hotel is very clean .. it has a nice night club too!

reviews.author: Kris C
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation!
reviews.text: My wife and I recently completed a 8 day stay at Paradisus Cancun and we have nothing but wonderful things to say about the resort. The hotel itself is absolutely beautiful and well kept. The junior suite is plenty big for 2 people and was very clean. The best part of the room was the jacuzzi tub on the balcony! The restaurants we're all pretty good and had excellent service. The staff of the hotel was very friendly and helpful. Our favorite part of the resort was of course the pool and swim up pool bar. Jamie, the bartender at the swim up bar was soooo awesome! He truly made our time at the pool memorable as he made us so many good shots/drinks that we had never had before and he was just so personable and truly wanted the guests to have a great time, so go visit him! This was our first time in Cancun and we were blown away by how beautiful it was and how many outside activities there are to do. We will definitely be going back very soon!

reviews.author: Mark L
reviews.title: Best service
reviews.text: If you are going here you need to stay in Royal Service.. Get Rode as your Butler he is the best. Always there to get you what you need. The rooms are bright and airy. The 1 bedroom ocean view is the best, you have 2 bathrooms.

reviews.author: Miguel S
reviews.title: Pyramid 4
reviews.text: Very beautiful hotel. Will definitely book for future trips. The food was amazing. The ocean in front was just beautiful. The amenities offered are great. The staff is very friendly. Definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Dawn M
reviews.title: Another great trip!
reviews.text: We stayed in royal service the beginning of November. This was our third time here and everything was great. We came with a large group so we had two butlers Rode and Daniel. They were both great ...they took care of all our needs.Rode was our butler the last time we stayed too so we requested him again because we were so Pleased with him the last time. The rooms are very nice and the weather was perfect! The only disappointment was a couple of the restaurants were closed for renovation and they no longer take reservations at any of the restaurants which was kind of a hassle. Other than that it was a great trip and hated to leave! Thanks Rode, Daniel and the rest of the staff for all your hard work!  Hope to see you all again soon!

reviews.author: lmur649 .
reviews.title: Nice family trip.
reviews.text: I enjoyed this resort very much.  The best parts were the following1.  Restaurants provided high end quality food like sushi and California rolls at the Ibana as well as steak and salmon at the Fuego.  All done to perfection.  All the restaurants were excellent.2.  Staff are great.  They really are!  They are friendly and considerate and do their jobs attentively.  3.  Foam party for the kids was awesome.  Kids also enjoyed the arts and crafts like the bracelets. 4.  Large floating game for the adults and kids was so much fun and entertaining.5.  Pool bar - drinks were done well and staff was attentive Some downsides 1.  Two main pools are 5'2" and the pool floor is uneven so you can go under a little also, not expecting it... If you are 5'3", you better know how to swim OR you need to bring your own floating devices such as noodles or floats for adults and floaties for kids.  The hotel does provide ANY of these..I would recommend the hotel provide some floating beach mats or noodles at least.2.  The daily entertainment needs a bit more punch.  We decided to try the aerobics one morning so we went to the pool at the start time and could not find it.  We found the organizer and he was doing something else but he decided to do it after we asked.  We  didn't bother to do it again as it looked like we were inconveniencing him, nor did we see the aerobics or any of the other activities on the schedule like yoga.3.  The steel bars from the pull out sofas are super red and rusty!  They need to be replaced, yikes!  I didn't even want my kids near them.  That's a safety issue and really should be addressed.  We did not use them at all.

reviews.author: amylynn1010
reviews.title: Good, not great
reviews.text:
The week did not start out well. At check in we were not told that two of the restaurants were closed for remodeling, including the main buffet. Also, we are used to getting a list of activities or at least an explanation of how to find the list, but that didn't happen.

My friend and I were denied for dinner our first night at two of the resort casual restaurants because we had halter top bathing suits on under our clothes. We were not wet at all but were still turned away. A manager finally let us in the substitute buffet.

The restaurants didnt have much variety. The breakfast buffets were pretty much the same. The Market Grill was good the first time, but the second time the beef was all very rare, the bacon on the bacon wrapped turkey was rubbery and the chicken wings weren't cooked.

Mole had fantastic sea bass. The tapas were hit and miss at Tempo. The shrimp with risotto was the best one. 

At all the restaurants if you have a large group I recommend family style. You get a good variety of everything on the menu.

It also seemed odd that there was a restaurant in the main courtyard instead of a bar or area to have shows. The shows were not always in the same place. Sometimes in the Avenue Bar and sometimes at the pool outside Market Grill.The two shows we did watch were fantastic- Michael Jackson and a traditional Mayan show.

There was also a weird vomit smell near one corner of pyramid 3 on every floor.

The convenient store had everything you needed reasonably priced. 

The safe only used the room key, no code. We didnt have anything stolen, but we thought it was weird.

Sofonio was an amazing server at the pool next to the adults only section.  Jamie at the pool bar was great too.  In general, the staff was nice.

We have stayed at multiple resorts in Cancun/Playa. The Royal in Playa is our favorite.

reviews.author: Deshayc
reviews.title: Worst stay of my Life
reviews.text:
This was the WORST hotel I have ever stayed in! Do no I REPEAT DO NOT STAY HERE. For an all inclusive hotel at $440 per night + tax It was terrible. Where do I begin: 

Check in: they could not find our reservation and you CAN NOT book at the front desk so I had to go Via Expedia (God Bless them) and book another room. It took us 3 hours to check in. The entire process was SLOW!

Food: I tried all the restaurants including room service and NONE of it was good. I mean barly etable! The eggs where pink and the pasta tasted it came out of a can. The pizza was bad I mean how do you mess up pizza. The cookies where even bad. I could go on but o don’t have enough time. 

Checkout: trying to leave the hotel in a timely fashion we waiting in line for 40 min to check out and you have to stand in the line because you need a check out card in order to leave the hotel. They literally would not let us leave because I needed to swipe my card they already had on file for the equivalent of $20USD. 

Positives: The staff - they are SUPER friendly and helpful and the service other than check in and check out is pretty swift. 

Unfortunately, I would never stay here again which is a shame because I am due back to Cancun 3 more times in the next year.

reviews.author: EZ_Pickins
reviews.title: Big Changes, Big Disapouintment
reviews.text:
Resort: We were here at Paradisus in February and noticed a big change. We checked in at the Family Concierge lounge which was quick and efficient. We were introduced to our butler who gave us a brief  description of the hotel and the benefits of the Family Concierge level. We were not given any informational pamphlets of the resort as we had on our first visit. We had to go back to the lounge and ask for the information about restaurants and entertainment at which time they printed out a single sheet with that information. The grounds are still beautiful, and well maintained. We spent our days at the beach. The music at the main pool was too loud for our taste. 

Accommodations: We had booked a Family Concierge Junior Suite Ocean View. Our room was in building three on the first floor. The room was overlooking the pool but still had a good view of the ocean.. The room was a good size, clean and the bed was comfortable. There was the same problem with wash cloths this trip. The bathroom was stocked with four face cloths when we arrived but were not replaced when used. Bath towels were replaced. We called our butler the second day to get additional wash cloths and he did deliver them promptly. Housekeeping stopped by the room in the evening for turn down service and we would ask for more then. Sometimes they had them, more often not. When we arrived we found that the circuit breaker for the bathroom outlet was tripped and had to call for maintenance. The shower drained very slowly to the point that it overflowed into the bathroom. A call to maintenance did little to help the problem.

Food: Disappointing. The Fuego and Naos restaurants were closed. We ate breakfast and lunch at the Enzo buffet, Bana and Market Place. Dinner twice at Market Place where one night was good and the second was not. (Salad was lettuce and dressing, nothing else)  Dinner buffet at Enzo was just ok. There was not the selection or quality of food at any of the restaurants that we had experienced at Naos.

Staff: The staff is exceptionally nice and helpful. You are greeted by every staff person you meet in the resort with a smile and a happy greeting The service was great at the restaurants and the beach. A special thank you to Ignacio Vazqez at the Market Grill restaurant. He remembered us from our visit there in February and as before provided exceptional service.

The Paradisus Cancun resort is a beautiful resort only minutes from the airport. The staff is friendly and attentive but due to the problems with the room and the disappointing dining we will not be coming back to this resort

reviews.author: Departure29560658558
reviews.title: Paradisus=Paradise
reviews.text: What a beautiful hotel. One of the largest hotels I've stayed at in Cancun. What I loved best was the butler experience. I've never had someone making all of our reservations to restaurants, cabana's and even driving my husband across the street to the pharmacia for a antibiotic for a tooth ache. We always had someone looking out for our happiness. That's customer service!*****Thanks again Alex!*****

reviews.author: ervinmehmet
reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text: Everything about this resort is amazing.We were escorted to the family concierge upon arrival which is open until 10 pm and serves snacks ,coffee and of course drinks .Our butlers Rodolfo and Alexander were very helpful and made sure to answer all our questions and follow up in every need we had. The room was amazing with ocean view.All the restaurant had amazing food and drinks were very good too. This was our third time in Cancun and this was the BEST experience ever.Looking forward to be back.

reviews.author: Maricela E
reviews.title: Great experience... a few glitches
reviews.text:
The hotel is beautiful and the staff is incredible! We had excellent service our entire stay. Staff is super professional, very helpful, and fun. The hotel is beautiful, the views are unbeatable, the food was great, the beach was a-ma-zing, the pools were refreshing, and the entertainment was wonderful.

The few glitches that we encountered were the following: we had teeny, tiny, little ants in our room, the power went out in our room once when I was using the blow dyer, the battery pack on our door feel out of its place twice and we have to call to get it fixed, a juice from the minibar in our room made me extremely ill on my trip back home due to a past due expiration date that I didnt notice before I drank it.

reviews.author: Raj
reviews.title: 2nd honeymoon
reviews.text:
My wife and I stayed at the Paradisus. First time in some 20 odd years without the kids. It was a great time. The place is huge and lot of dining options. Aquaworld is just across the street and we took three excursions with them. The Jungle trip in speedboats is awesome.
Kudos to Christian at the Naos and Alfredo at the Bans. They went out of their way to make us feel special and pampered.
We did have a fireline leak just at the entrance of our room and that caused water running down our bathroom walls. I called it in, in the middle of the night and they had it fixed by next day even tough it was a Sunday.

reviews.author: jdccurtis
reviews.title: Beach paradise, almost perfect
reviews.text: Check in easy with a waiter bringing and cocktail, juice, soda that you could ask for.  The resort is clean with fresh flowers and beautiful decor anywhere you turn.  The views to the ocean look like a postcard and once your on the beach you will never want to leave. The sand is soft, and water is clear and blue.  Service on the beach for drinks was amazing as you never were without a drink of choice.  This was also more impressive as we were with a group of 12.  The rooms are clean and modern and fit the tropical island feel.  We had one major issue as our doors electronic key reader went dead.  We had to spend 2 hours waiting for the staff to figure out how to get us in our room. They eventually used a crow bar to get the door open so we could take showers. We continued to have issues with new door and keys and had to make 7+ trips to the front desk to get in our room.  We were not mad as we know things happen, but we were offered nothing for the inconvenience. We thought maybe they would throw in a bottle of wine not included in the all inclusive, but nothing was offered.   The other part of the trip that could have been a little better was the food was average for the most part.   Nothing really impressed any one of our 12 travelers.  It wasn’t that is wasn’t good, it just wasn’t great for how fancy everything was.  Overall I would go back as the positives far outweighed any negatives.

reviews.author: Ahna P
reviews.title: An amazing trip to Paradisus Cancun/Royal Service
reviews.text: We had a great time at Paradisus Cancun while staying in the Royal Service.  The ocean was beautiful, the food amazing and the service was like nothing else’s I’ve ever had before.  Victor and Caesar in the La Palapa and pool area took great care of us, along with the rest of the staff.  We cannot wait to return.

reviews.author: Passenger46208570579
reviews.title: Excellent trip, definitely will visit again!
reviews.text: Location couldn't be any more perfect!  This trip was perfect for what we wanted, just a relaxing family vacation.  We will definitely be booking again in the future.  Staff was all super friendly.  We did have only one issue while there, even on the 7th floor we still managed to have tiny ants trying to find the goodies they kept leaving us in the room.  But we called and reported it and within minutes it was taken care of and they were even quick to offer us a room change which we declined as we didn't feel it necessary.  Overall everything was perfect and we wish we didn't have to leave!

reviews.author: Carol Brooks
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel and Staff
reviews.text: My Husband and I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun from October 28th - November 2nd. We were treated like royalty our entire stay. The hotel is beautiful and the grounds are well maintained. The beach is clean and beautiful.  Our Suite was located in the 3rd Pyramid which was located close to restaurants and disco. The staff was wonderful and very friendly. The food was very good!  We plan to return next year with our family and friends. The customer service exceeded our expectation!

reviews.author: Rafik G
reviews.title: Cancun Vacation
reviews.text: Not good value for money, pools need maintenance and upgrades, so loud too. Few restaurants were closed for renovations, air condition is loud in the rooms. Tenjo and Vento are the best restaurants, and night shows are really nice.

reviews.author: Angela223377
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort, Perfect Location
reviews.text: The service is excellent and the hotel decor is beautiful. The resort plans fun events and entertaining shows. The lobby is beautiful and there is plenty of shopping on site. The pool bars are very entertaining. The all inclusive food could be better but compares to most all inclusive resorts. The specialty restaurants are a great choice for dinner versus the buffets. The coffee bars are wonderful!! It’s a great location, 10 min bus ride from La Isla Shopping Mall.

reviews.author: Paul S
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel with very helpful staff
reviews.text: The location is great (oceanfront and across the street from Aquaworld). The Hotel is beautiful and so are the rooms. The staff were excellent and responded to every request we made. We had a great time. This place is so nice that some guests expect gourmet food. We loved the food but you have to go at the right times to find the best, freshest selection.

reviews.author: gidrah
reviews.title: Birthday vacation!
reviews.text: The hotel was beautiful, beach was clean, service was as expected, good. The staff very hard working and most are very accommodating, just had an issue with hostess at “mole”, was rude, which is not tipical. The regular rooms do need upgrading, expected better decor, but were clean. We upgraded to “royal service” for $200 each for five nights. Worth it, did not get a butler but got ocean view on second night of stay, The royal service area was beautiful and had nice snacks all day, wish they closed later(10;00 pm) This is second time visiting Cancun this year. Food at Mole was not good, Blue Agave ok, Sushi was ok, the tuna tartar was great! Next time will go to another hotel, just to try a different experience. Had a great time with my friends, long lasting memories!

reviews.author: PlainfieldTrish5683
reviews.title: Fabulous
reviews.text: Second time here. Even Better now that we know a few things. If you have a day that you plan on staying the entire day at the resort spend the money on the Bali bed in David’s section. Give him a nice tip and your cup will never be empty. He wears compression stockings because he need them he hustles ALL day! If the Bali bed is not in your budget get up early and secure a chair in his section - he does not provide any lesser service to the pool chairs but the Bali bed is yours from 10-6 providing comfort shade and a saved spot.  Service from different pool hostesses was not great. Food can be delicious and amazing but you need to know what to eat and what to stay away from. We are from Chicago- stay away from the pizza burgers and hot dogs- save yourself for Portillo and Giordanos at home. Enjoy everything and anything chicken at the buffet. All the fresh fruit is delicious. Any potato side dish except fries was great. Get an omelette made for Breakfast.  Market grill for dinner is good. Be patient for them to bring all the skewers around they come out gradually. Blue Agave is awesome for lunch quesadillas and tacos. Great chips salsa pico and guacamole. No rice or beans though.

reviews.author: KarenandRick1984
reviews.title: family wedding holidays
reviews.text: We just got back from a week stay at the Paradisus Cancun.  Overall we enjoyed our stay at this resort.  We had an ocean view room on the the fourth floor of pyramid 4 and our view was outstanding - our room was very spacious and clean and our mini fridge was stocked daily.  They were doing some renovations to the resort during our stay, and in particular the Naos Buffet was being renovated.  They had several other buffets open in the resort, but we found that they were a lot smaller and did not have as many food options as we have experienced in other resorts in the past.  We would like to come back again when Naos is open as we feel it would have been more in the line of what we are  use to.  Check in was fast and efficient.  We arrived at the resort in the  morning so we were offered a hospitality room and use of all the facilities until we were able to get our room in the afternoon.  We did find that in some areas, the pools were very deep so if you are a non-swimmer or have young children, it did limit the areas you could use for pool time.  We never had a problem getting a lounger in the shade - whether it be at the pool or the beach.  Our son's wedding was amazing - the service was outstanding and they did a wonderful job of making the wedding and the reception amazing.  We also had no problem getting into any restaurant that we wanted to dine in.  We would have liked it if the coffee shop located in the third tower would have longer hours - in particular would have been nice  to be able to get a special coffee early in the morning.  Overall I would recommend this resort but would like to come again when the renovations are complete.

reviews.author: Mario B
reviews.title: Grandma´s  80th in Cancun
reviews.text:
My family and I were at the Melia Paradisus for six days to celebrate my mother-in-law’s 80th birthday. From the moment we arrived we were treated splendidly. The entire personnel made us feel at home, as there were ten of us and they knew each of our names. Each one of the six days they had a different celebration and a different gift in each of our rooms.
