We stayed in the Family Concierge area, and Sandra and Gloria took care of us - letting us know of daily activities, food options, and accommodating any specific requests we had for the day. 

Michel, Manuel, Jesus, and David took care of us at the main pool, not only with the best service we could have asked for, but also as great company and conversation to answer any of our questions about the area.

We visited the Enzo restaurant the most, where chef Eduardo Mukul cooked a special meal for us based on what we craved each night. Antonio, Martin, and Edwin welcomed us with a set table every day and made us feel very special. Jose, the restaurant’s manager, made sure we received the best service possible.

Finally, we had access to the Spa, and it was wonderful. Silvestre always welcomed us with a smile! Behind him there was a full staff and personnel dedicated to care for guests and provide a great ambiance for relaxation.

Overall, our experience in Cancun was full with the company of great people who genuinely love what they do. Without a doubt, I’d recommend it, as it is now our home for any future visits.

reviews.author: Cindy M
reviews.title: First Time Definitely Won’t Be The Last!
reviews.text: Stayed at Paradisus November 3 through November 10th.  Royal Service is a must.  You could not ask for anything better.  Octavio I. royal service building 5, was the best coffee barista on the resort.  Always happy and smiling.  La Palapa for royal service has wonderful staff.  Victor, Daniel, Orlando, Jose are always there to get your drinks and food with a smile.  Really enjoyed the breakfast and lunch.  Naos buffet was okay - Antonio was a great waiter.  Market Grill was our favorite.  Martin knew our names when we would eat there.  Coco’s Beach Bar was the best place to get a drink- Salvadore and Karina make the best chocolate martinis.  We will definitely be back to this resort.  The grounds are beautiful and the staff is the best!  If you have a butler, Rosanna is the one to ask for!!!

reviews.author: chalex
reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: Great all inclusive hotel, location is good, not far from the airport or nightlife. The service in the hotel is excellent, almost everyone is on a ver positive attitude and giving the best so you have a pleasant stay. Food is great, way better than my previous all inclusive stays, good variety of rstaurants and high quality, varied menu. Swimming pool for adults only, for kids or for all. Ammenities for the kids are varied, including a kids club available all day. Great hotel

reviews.author: SkillCan
reviews.title: Disappointing Experience!
reviews.text:
Been going to Mexico all inclusive resorts annually for the last 10 years.
Hotel - is a nice looking hotel.
Rooms - basic and smaller than other resorts. No liquor in room. Basic fridge drinks and beer.

Food - 3 restaurants closed....as a result, there were bottlenecks and lineups. Why would you close 3 restaurants at the same time? Waits were at least an hour. And this was low season. They give you a time but still wait was longer than that.
Food quality was poor except the Royal Service restaurant. Food is important and I have to say the worst of all the other all inclusive experiences we have had. Pic of fish and chips attached - pretty sad!

Ice cream and coffee place - open few hours in the afternoon, and closed during  mornings and evenings. We found this bizarre as the resorts we have been to were open all day long till late night.

Royal Service - don't get it if you have kids. Kids are not allowed in Royal Service restaurant and pool.
Service was inefficient, long and by the time you received the beer / drinks, they were warm. Staff not attentive and hygiene wasn't great either. 

Definitely won't be back and same for our friends.

reviews.author: LaJuan L
reviews.title: Beautiful Escape
reviews.text: My husband and I have been coming here for over 20 years and have watched the transformation from the Melia to Paradisus. The beauty of the hotel never disappoints nor does the food, beach and pool area. The spa is awesome. If you want a great massage ask for Lilliana Marquez. She is awesome. Things to work on include the new check-in process. The space is pretty but too small to accommodate large groups. It was too hot and over crowded. Also, the property needs regular cleaning especially sweeping the floors. I highly recommend the hotel.

reviews.author: Gabriel M
reviews.title: Paradisus experience
reviews.text: Best hotel ever.I Will comeback as soon as possível, I had a wonderful week with my family .I think seriouly, knows more about Club melia and become a partner of paradisus , this os the best place i stayed in years.Thank you so much ... and wait for promotions. Gabriel M faria.

reviews.author: Trail08680136095
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text:
What a place!! Stunning hotel in a unreal location, everything you could want and ask for..
We were in the Royal service area where the staff couldn't be anymore helpful/ attentive, you are assigned your own butler who help with anything you might need or require we were lucky enough to get 'Alex' and we couldn't of asked for anyone better!!

The hotel was super clean, the facilities were amazing, all of the staff you come across from cleaners, butlers, waiters, receptionists everyone you meet were unbelievably polite and helpful!!

We really couldn't recommend the hotel enough such so that we will be back next year..

reviews.author: rbaskin5
reviews.title: Overall Good
reviews.text: Royal Service area was nice. Hotel is beautiful and staff is helpful and friendly.  Butler service is a good idea but we got a bad one.  Food is average.  Note:  in November 2018 there were 3 or 4 of the restaurants closed for construction/renovation. Made it a little difficult.

reviews.author: Cbraegger328
reviews.title: Rather disappointing...
reviews.text: First off, the people were great.  Everyone we came in contact with at the resort was pleasent ( minus the pushy time share guy) . The rooms were nice, updated great amenities. There were 3 restaurants closed the entire time we were there. The food was sub par, nothing great at all and the selection minimal. Most everything was buffet style, not to mention i askes for more guacamole from one server and qtches him bring me some from an empty table that someone hsd just got done with.  The pool closes at 7 pm every night and there is very minimal activity to do at night at the resort. I would not book here again.

reviews.author: M.G
reviews.title: Expensive for nothing
reviews.text:
I don’t recommend it at all, it’s not worth it to go this resort, you can go another one and pay less and enjoy more, the pool there is disgusting, I had a white swimsuit turned up to green, we found food people threw it in the pool , food is same every day NO SEAFOOD at all repeatedly items every day, location is very good close to shopping centre and this s the only thing we enjoyed it
Beach is amazing but all the resorts on the same line have amazing beach, so it’s better to choose another place in ZONA HOTELERA , you will get good location and great beach, but don’t pay at this resort

reviews.author: eb0nyg0d
reviews.title: Nice trip
reviews.text: There was a few of us that came together, we took up 5 Ocean view rooms, we called up prior to us arriving and requested the rooms be on the same floor. We were given the rooms as requested. On arrival the Concierge told us to check in and that he would be along shortly to assist us with our suitcases. After check in, he and his colleagues were nowhere to be found. So we lugged our suitcases upstairs. 2 of the rooms had initial problems with their showers and maintenance was called, unfortunately the issue was resolved with us tinkering about with the controls and maintenance still had not shown up. The rooms were adequate sized, with private balcony. The balconies themselves could do with a deep clean but they were nice to use. The rooms were nice and cosy but could do with a fair amount of maintenance, cleaning of the rooms was sporadic and to ensure that they were done, it is an idea to call housekeeping as you are going out. Room service was quick but unfortunately the food kept arriving lukewarm, even after I specifically told them this and requested hot food. In the restaurant for breakfast, Gaudcino took care of us and he was different types of amazing, we were there for my daughters birthday and he made it extremely special for her. I would like to say a special thank you to him. The beach area for us commoners quickly filled up, and the service was definitely of the quality that made the Royal service section very enviable. I can understand there being a 2 tier service but some decent service for the ordinary guests would have been good.The beach however was well maintained and the dead seaweed cleared away from the the hotels section of the beach was nice to relax.  I have to confess I have previously stayed in Cancun at the Ritz Carlton and the difference in service is pretty obvious. The hotel needs refurbishing and a tightening of their services, the staff are amazing and do what they can, but to be classed as a 4 * hotel, I do not think they are there yet. For instance, I was informed that the gym was 24/7 but on going down there early one day I was told that it did not open until 6AM, All in all a brilliant stay, the staff made it so that I would stay again, but certainly not before a full hotel refurbishment.

reviews.author: CFM
reviews.title: 6 Day Family Reunion
reviews.text:
Here is an honest on-balance review of the Paradisus by Melia – Cancun, from soup to nuts. 

 I planned the trip as family reunion, with olks flying in from NY, CA and GA. 
Shuttle from airport to hotel (SuperShuttle) - went very smoothly in both directions -- although I did contact Expedia a day or two before arrival in Cancun requesting that they contact the carrier in Cancun to confirm and verify the reservation.  I Did this based on the mixed reviews I saw on-line.  Expedia happily obliged, and the supervisor of the shuttle service contacted me by e-mail from Cancun to confirm.  Suggest you do the same -- to avoid any of the horror stories you read about from some previous customers of the service.  Service was on-time, courteous, direct to hotel, polite driver - both ways, and affordable.

Hotel:  This place is massive.  Has 5 separate blgs. (all connected).  Has a golf course (was planning to play a round – but it was too hot.  Also expect to pay $25.00 each for a few clubs, and 12 dollars for three hotel inscribed balls.  Course is 9 hole – real short – almost like pitch and put.  Get out by 8 AM or you’ll fry!!  We went in October.  Based on course size, condition, price and weather conditions, we didn’t feel it was worth it.  There was no one playing anytime we looked!!  We did the all-inclusive pckg. For everyone, and arrived a day earlier than others to iron out any kinks.  Room (gulf facing) was nice – but small (it was deluxe ocean view Jr. ).  Mini-bar poorly stocked – no liquor, beer soda, water and a few candy bars.  A/C was good.  Rain shower a plus.  View excellent.

Went to pool and got a real surprise.  Pretty crowded and LOUD.  Better get there early or you won’t find two chaises together, despite size of pool. A lot of loud activity in pool – especially around the swim up bar.  20-30 somethings (yo) very loud, boisterous and drinking heavily.  Music being played around the pool was at top volume, and most of it was hip-hop/rap.  No matter where you went along the pool you couldn’t escape it.  At 3PM – three entertainers (female) scantily dressed located themselves atop a knoll overlooking the pool, and continued the hip-hop live – the volume was so loud that I saw people fleeing the area.  I won’t comment critically on their ability because I’m not a fan of that music.

We thought about the several days we would be there, the situation we encountered, and decided to upgrade everyone in our party to what they call “Royal Service” .  Had to change rooms – different section of hotel – lost the gulf view – but had an “adults only” area to enjoy and a variety of other upgrades – which we paid handsomely to get.  The quieter atmosphere itself was worth it.  You are given a private valet/butler who will make reservations, run interference as needed, and pay some special attention to you.  The fellow we had was “off” 2 of the 5 days we were in “Royal Service” – but he was helpful and nice when around, and when we needed him.  You get his cell # to call for anything, and he touches base with you a few times a day.  .  Name was Alex – spoke excellent English which helped us. (This place is a real Int’l destination with people from all over the world represented).  Royal service upgrade quite expensive.  Allows you to use a restaurant by their pool which serves breakfast and lunch – and it was a joy to get away from the craziness and crowds at the buffet. 
 
Don’t plan on losing anything while there (eg – in my case a pair of glasses, and sandals).  The lost and found is a joke.  When the hotel rep in charge of (L&F) essentially told me I thought she was lying because I expressed surprise that only 1 pair of pink glasses and a pair of flip-flops were all that was in the lost and found (as far as items I was looking for), I felt offended.  She was a female named Neyeea.  I checked back with her later in the rip – same attitude!!  The sandals (a real good pair) were left under the cabana bed reserved for our private use for the time we were there – I’m sure no occupant picked them up.  The glasses were lost on the beach – so that I guess would have been tougher.  

The Restaurants were generally pretty good – BUT you need reservations TWO days in advance to get into anything other than the buffet.  So be prepared to make Reservations on arrival.  Despite this, there were usually plenty of open seats at the specialty restaurants we got reservations for.  Our private butler was helpful on this.  The food at the buffet was below-par.  The specialty restaurants (6) were fine.
The evening shows were pitiful!!  I’ve been to many resorts over the years – Cancun amd otherwise, and these were the weakest shows I’ve ever encountered.  They usually started around 8 and went 90 min.  I won’t even bother to describe them --- just take my word!!  Seemed like most people stayed away.

No American TV at all – no sports – all news was Int’l or local.  Very few Eng speaking channels.  Wanted to watch a particular college football game on Sat, and had to leave the grounds and go to a neighboring hotel that had a sports bar.  If you need TV coverage, plan ahead.

Ocean was beautiful – Beach well maintained.  Royal service pool was well maintained – can’t say the same of the other pool.  I’ll just leave it at that.

The main bldgs of the resorts (5) were huge wide open spaces with atrium's – and these are where the different restaurants are located.  Either they interiors were too exposed to the elements or they weren’t  Air Conditioned – because it was Really Hot anywhere in them – which made eating unpleasurable at times.  Fans were blowing hot humid air around in many of the restaurants.  Walking around in the shops was also uncomfortable.  May have been that the place is just too big to keep cool.  

All in all, I would rate our vacation a 5 out of 10.  I am generally not a complainer at all – and I don’t consider this to be a bad review – just an average one.  Nothing special.  I would have expected Royal Service would have been more special than it was.

The ladies enjoyed the spa services – they got some discounted treatments being on the Royal Service tier. 

Probably wouldn’t return.

reviews.author: tyler_garrett
reviews.title: Royal Service is Royally Awesome!
reviews.text: This was my wife's and I first trip to Mexico and a stay at a all inclusive resort.  We are extremely satisfied with out stay.  The level of service was impeccable.  Alturo, our butler was the man!  He was very tentative to our needs and very personable.  I will request his services if we return.  Great time!

reviews.author: Esther M
reviews.title: Vacation 2018
reviews.text: best pool party buthe new werr the party was at the pool bar with Us, Saul was the best of the staff to party eith us he new our crew was the party crew 2018 Dr Blanca Murillo DDS best bossEver , Coming back soon

reviews.author: Denise R
reviews.title: Super Friendly and Attentive Staff
reviews.text: Thank you for an awesome experience at Paradisus! This is my 3rd time in Cancun and by far the best hotel experience. Edwin (at Enso) and Pascual (Market Grill and Blue Agave) gave great hospitality to our dining experience. Thanks guys! We were a total of 9 and they had the patience and friendliness you need to actually enjoy a meal.

reviews.author: Fahad Q
reviews.title: Good stay!
reviews.text: great workers, not enough seafood, only some restaurants had it for dinner, don't worry about 'royal service', not worth it, the hotel review is skewed bcuz of royal service.  resort is stunning!  No point getting a room if it doesn't have an ocean view, ask for the updated rooms in the main building.

reviews.author: Graciela Ivonne C
reviews.title: Magnifique estructure en pirámide maya
reviews.text:
Love this beautiful 5 pirámide hotel 🏨 Nice gentle staff, beautiful Beach and Blue color Sea : good food and TEMPO restaurant so spécial and unique : 
Beautiful piscines and the Royal only adults pirámide magnifique 💕💕

reviews.author: Sam H
reviews.title: Excellent destination
reviews.text: After a short stay at a hotel in Tulum, we relocated to Paradisus, hoping to find 5 star service - and we certainly found it here. We stayed at Paradisus for 10 nights in August 2018 and there was enough to do to stay on site for the duration. Top quality service and hospitality. We would stay here again

reviews.author: beckyrim
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Beautiful suite that has a balcony and steps right I to the pool. Private lounge chairs and wonderful service. Delicious food, loved all the restaurants. Beach is sandy not clear, but that can’t be helped. Very worthwhile trip

reviews.author: Viciousvixen1
reviews.title: Paradise
reviews.text:
Absolutely beautiful resort with all the amenities you could imagine. The food was great and the all-inclusive rules were very easy to follow and simple - nothing shady, no tricks or hidden fees or anything like that. Top shelf alcohol is included! Everything here is very clean and exceptionally well maintained. The hotel is right on the beach and they have multiple pools too. They even have complimentary coffee &/ or dessert carts. The pistachio muffin is incredible. 
The entire staff here (except one weird rude creepy employee at the pool) was incredibly nice. Please tip them well- because believe me, you have a lot more than they do. Raul the bellhop was sooo sweet and very helpful, and so was another guy who was among the front desk with the glasses (he was greeting the guests and stuff)... I forget his name but he was my favorite  :(
All in all, beautiful resort, would definitely go back!

reviews.author: Rafael Cortes
reviews.title: Much above all expectations!!!!
reviews.text:
We stayed 15 days at Paradisus. We have a 5-month baby and a 5-year girl. Our room was FAMILY CONCIERGER SUITE. that menas we had an exclusive VIP service of a concierge focused on the family. Mrs. Gloria and Sandra were one of the best parts of the trip. I don´t want to make any other trip without this kind of service, and everyone deserves to have this service one day.
After second day, we took our 5-year-old daughter to the Kids Zone. Well, what we thought could be just a relaxing moment to the parents, became one of the best moments for our kid. They have many different activities all day, and different each day of the week. Our kid met other kids from all over the world, and even though she did not speak english or spanish, she made friends with all of them.
A special recommendation for the monitors that work there. Their kind attention made these moments very special. So my personal thanks to mrs. Ivonne, Sarahi, Paula, Adriana and Arantza, who took care of our girl all these days.
In conclusion, on the last day our daughter said: “when I grow up, I want to work as a lady of the Kids Zone. Well, a mermaid also, but working at Kids Zone”.
Paradisus is not only a perfect hotel, but is also the best experience ever for a family trip

reviews.author: Hoda S
reviews.title: Very nice vacation
reviews.text: It’s a very nice resort and the staff there are amazing. Every time I ordered room service for my LO they were so fast in coming up with the things I order. We had a great time. Thanks to all the people who work there

reviews.author: hawk_gosman
reviews.title: Amazing trip!
reviews.text: Fantastic resort with amazing people! Special shout out to the pool bar staff and Jaime!!! They took care of us all trip! Rest of the hotel staff over the top accommodating. Food was great, just need to know when to go. always room by the pool and on the beach. On site night club has great music and is busy on the usual nights. Bus stop is at resort entrance to go into Cancun and ride is 10 min max!

reviews.author: Angela Peoples
reviews.title: Nice hotel but needs an upgrade
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradiusus in Cancun for 4 nights/5 days in October. Our arrival experience was excellent, very efficient and complimentary drinks offered at check in. However we did not appreciate the ‘hard sell’ on activities from the ladies who greeted us, we found it difficult to stop them and go to our room. Food isn’t great, in fact we only had one nice meal in the Mexican restaurant. Be careful as everything is not included in the all inclusive. The location and pool area are beautiful and the entertainment during the day was great, we thoroughly enjoyed everything the staff put on. Our last night stay was marred by the very noisy nightclub below us. The music was soo loud we didn’t get much sleep until around 2am when it closed. One afternoon we were sat on our balancing and a steel ‘girder’ dropped from a height above us. We reported to staff who came and removed it but no apology was received, nor at check out when we again reported it. I have attached a photograph of this.

reviews.author: Fyodor K
reviews.title: Was a really great resort, but degrading during the last two years
reviews.text:
We were coming to Paradisus Cancun five years in a row and were really happy during our visits. The resort was really the best we've seen in Cancun and we were looking around for different resorts and every time were convinced that Paradisus is the best. Few great points are for: fantastic interior that looks like a tropical garden under the roof, great location right in the middle of hotel zone, and great quality food with nice selection of fresh juices, smoked salmon and french cheese for breakfast; few sorts of fish and seafood for dinner and nice la-carte restaurants when you want to try something new.
The amenities are OK with special kudos to the Kids Club stuff that is organizing nice activities for the kids.
Speaking other words we were super happy and would continue to come back. Things started to degrade a year ago (2017) when the fresh juice disappeared and seafood dinner with lobsters and crabs started to happen only once a week. But this year (2018) things became really bad - the quality of food severely degraded: no more french and swiss cheeses (only local cheese), no more smoked salmon, barely one kind of grilled fish every other day. I wasn't able to find even grilled veggies for dinner... They closed three restaurants for renovation and looks like they are unable to keep up the good service and good variety of food. So, essentially, you are getting less for your money (price remained approximately the same).
With all this combined, unfortunately, Paradisus has likely lost us as customers and this is quite sad, because the interior and the location are great.

reviews.author: dianachaloner
reviews.title: Stunning hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is incredible with very friendly staff and all the amenities you could want. It caters for couples with a separate section on the beach and by the pool, and has a special part dedicated to families.

reviews.author: NawHan
reviews.title: Good vacation at Paradisus. Need more effort to improve.
reviews.text:
We spent a good vacation at Paradisus for a week in August. Gorgeous Ocean View was not good this time due to Seaweed that affected the Ocean badly. I believe the resort management did not do much to resolve the issue or minimize the effect. They definitely could do better.

Royal Service Manager and most of the employees worked hard to make our stay enjoyable but they still need to do extra effort to be a 5 star resort. we rate the resort this time as a 4 star resort especially with the sea weed issue and the buffet restaurant bad quality of food.

Royal Service makes a huge difference, so use it . It is worth the extra money.

Positive points:

The restaurant fuego was excellent Paola Chavez did a great job on the checking and the waiter Jorge Perez Segura was outstanding in attending our needs.

Palapa restaurant: the manager Daniel did an excellent job, Cesar is an outstanding, very efficient waiter. Eddy, Valeria were very attentive and focused waiters. Joel was very helpful.
Market grill restaurant: the manager Pablo Kara did a great job, Ruben the waiter too.

The manager of all the restaurants chef of all the chefs Eduardo did an excellent outstanding job! He prepared a dinner from us from the appetizer, main dish and dessert with lots of very fine and sophisticated ingredients. The attention and service was royal, he treated us like VIP. Chef Eduardo should get credit for all the dedication and passion he has for cooking. He should serve in a 5 stars restaurant! Bravo chef Eduardo if we come back, it will be for you.

Negative points:
Daphne at the checking aggressed us from the first day to listen to a long Melia club, promising that it will last only 2 hours when it took the whole morning. She also promised that if I attended I would get a free spa, which never happened. They give you a certificate of 2 nights which is a trap, since it includes tons of conditions and doesn’t include all inclusive service and is the lowest category of room. The bottom line, do not waste your time with club Melia.

The Buffet restaurant is very bad, we could not eat there for one time during our whole stay. Worst Buffet restaurant at all resorts we visited.

reviews.author: Glowee
reviews.title: The Paradisus Cancun was just okay
reviews.text:
Went to Paradisus with my girlfriends for a long getaway weekend.  The food wasn't good, the best meal we received was when we rented the Bali bed for the day.  The drinks were good with top shelf alcohol.  The hotel itself is beautiful and for the most part clean.  Wish there were more activities during the day but the nightclub was definitely the place to be at night for drinking and dancing.  

We encounter some great staff at the hotel, Didie and Rene in the Bali bed area, Julio with entertainment, Atilano in Fuego, and Jorge in the Market Grill.  These staff members made our stay at the Paradisus unforgettable, if the food was good I would've given the hotel five starts.

reviews.author: Randy F
reviews.title: The Leazer Group
reviews.text: Our trip was an all expense paid business rewards trip through The Leazer Group. Food, accommodations, amenities, all interactions with staff and employees were excellent. We would certainly revisit Paridisus again.

reviews.author: Bill
reviews.title: Changed from our usual hotel, this one is better
reviews.text: Huge hotel.  We were in the quiet pyramid at the end.  Great location.  Little more walking, but well worth it.   Really good staff, everyone is very friendly.  Cost was a bit higher than what we had been paying, but well worth it.  They said that they were 96% full, but if true, it really seemed to be uncrowded.  Very little wait for anything.  Enjoyed the food, better evening entertainment that any others that we have seen.  Nice grounds with 9 hole golf course on site.

reviews.author: Coastal22430461009
reviews.title: Gorgeous Ocean View
reviews.text: The ocean view was stunning.  White sandy beaches.  Lovely pools too.  The atrium was very pretty and our room was great.  The staff was wonderful.   The only reason I'm giving a 4 star was due to the restaurants as they were either extremely hard to get into (reservations) or closed for remodel.  The restaurants that we were able to make a reservation offered bad food and difficult to read menu's.   But the buffet was very good.

reviews.author: jdesimini
reviews.title: Best vacation we’ve ever taken!
reviews.text: Royal Service is the way to go.  Our butler Daniel was attentive and made sure all necessary arrangements were made to ensure a relaxing vacation.  Victor took great care of us poolside and the food and nightlife were outstanding.  We will definitely be returning!

reviews.author: Tracy T
reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text: We arrived 10/30 with hopes of getting an ocean view family suit instead of the lagoon view. When we purchased our hotel deal, the lagoon and ocean view were the same price, but the ocean view rooms were all sold out so we had to book a lagoon view instead. Our travel agent had spoke to Melia reps multi times, up until the day we checked it to see if we could get an icean view room. Of course when we checked in, there was an ocean view room available for $100 extra a night. After talking to the check in people who then spoke to the manager Leslie Galindo, it was down to $80 a night, then $60 a night. What a rip off!!! After waiting an hour of my vacation trying to plead with these people, I gave up. Our travel agent also spoke with Leslie Galindo and was given the same BS about paying $60 extra a night. I’m so surprised a hotel would not upgrade people to ensure there stay is amazing!!!! This is our second time staying at a Melia owned restore and it will def be our last!!!

reviews.author: Melissa Williams
reviews.title: Cancun
reviews.text: Loved our stay and had a wonderful time. Alcohol was served to my friends kids a few times so sip the kids drinks before they drink it. Pool bar seemed to water down the drinks when a group of guys were getting out of control. But my over all experience was amazing! The Bailly beds were wonderful and super relaxing.

reviews.author: Meander640686
reviews.title: Royal Service - heaven
reviews.text: our trip last week was amazing - truly enjoyed the attention and service of Galdino, our butler. The adult section is peaceful and relaxing -- just reserve a Bali bed and relax for the day with an adult beverage with some wonderful pool snacks.  Great facility -- beautiful beach, large winding pools --- perfect!

reviews.author: Culture00822422829
reviews.title: It was a fantastic resort and vacation
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun was absolutely one of the nicest hotel experiences I have ever had. I would recommend one day or forever at the resort. Everything you could want or need was at your fingertips. The staff was so very attentive and the resort was a wonderful place to relax.

reviews.author: eliaf297
reviews.title: Great Property, Beautiful Hotel....except the food
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay in Paradisus Cancun over Thanksgiving.  It has many pluses and one major minus.  First, the good: 
1. The property is clean and beautiful.  It is very well maintained although they were doing a lot of construction when we were there, I assume in advance of the Christmas season.  My understanding is that they are updating royal service, but it is not loud and really does not detract from the overall appearance and cleanliness of the property.  And it smells great everywhere.
2.  The staff is wonderful.  Truly wonderful - friendly, warm and they try very hard.  Stand outs -- Fernanda in Family Concierge.  The BEST!  She made our stay.  Same with Moises and Denni in La Palapa at Royal Service and Gabriel at the beach service.  These guys went above and beyond to make our stay wonderful.  
3.  The beach - AMAZING!!  Blue and beautiful.
4.  The Gym - one of the biggest and most modern that I have seen in an all-inclusive.  And Martin offered great cross-fit classes.  Very, very hard but so so good.

The only thing keeping me from a glowing review was the food.  Overall, the food was not good and at times barely edible.  Mole and La Palapa were the exceptions where the food was good.  The rest of the restaurants were not, with Naos, the buffet, being the worst of it.  We should have known when on the first night of our stay, the seafood buffet ran out of lobster within one hour and they were not even serving the full lobster tail like other properties -- they were just serving cubes of lobster!  The food was particularly disappointing considering how luxurious everything else is at this property.

reviews.author: Lauren H
reviews.title: Best place in town!
reviews.text: I've been to more than one hotel in Cancun and this is by far the best. There was a personal touch to everything done. Every server seemed happy, everyone was more than happy to help us get anything we needed for our stay. I highly recommend the Royal Service if you are not traveling with children.  You get bottles in your room for you to make your own cocktails, plus a lounge where someone is waiting to make them for you if you don't like what you have in your room. The lounge also featured snacks until 11pm which were tasty. I would also make sure you let your butler- yes your butler know you want a cabana, because they are nice and you just need to claim them by 11am.  EAT AT TEMPO- I know it's extra, but it was one of the best meal I've ever had. Mole was fantastic as well. Naos is a basic normal buffet, it tends to get busy so we only went once. The water was perfect and it was easily accessible for swimming.  I will be going back.

reviews.author: Deanna H
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: We were given a suite on the 8th floor of pyramid 3.  There are 5 pyramids, with number 5 being the Royal Paradisus. Our suite was comfortable with a king size bed, a sofa and table and chairs.  We found our terrace to be sunny and overlooking the ocean.  The mini bar was filled daily, and housekeeping kept us in fresh towels and cleaned up daily. Most of the resort's entertainment and many restaurants are on the bottom 2 floors of pyramid 3, so having a room there is very convenient. However, because the the building's center is an atrium, it can be noisy until about 10 pm nightly. We were able to work around this easily though. The whole resort was very nice, and the staff was outstanding. The entertainers were professional, and we liked their nightly shows.  With the buffet and the many specialty restaurants, we had good food and excellent service in all of them. Our favorite was Bana, where we really liked the sushi.

reviews.author: Adabelle B
reviews.title: Truly Paradise
reviews.text: We had our wedding at paradisus palma real in punta cana so we were very familiar with the brand. we had nothing but high expectations of our visit and were truly satisfied. my husband and I just got back from our five day trip in cancun. we booked the luxury junior suite that had an ocean view at royal service. the rooms were beautiful and updated. they were going under construction and re working the royal service lounge area so they had a smaller area set up in the hallway. the royal service feature is definitely worth it. you get a butler and updated rooms as well as your own private adults only area. that last point was the true seller for us. we wanted to relax and be away from kids and the royal service area provided that. they also had an exclusive restaurant called la palapa and it was delicious. all other restaurants were delicious as well. we also really liked the bali beds. Moses is the best server at the pool! He's always so happy and with a positive attitude, we will miss him! He made sure our drinks were always full! i do wish they had more availability at their restaurants because we only seemed to get late reservations at 9:00 or 9:30pm. other than that everything was fantastic! I wrote a review on my blog as well, the daily belle.

reviews.author: VIET L
reviews.title: cancun
reviews.text: excellent place to stay...we had a great time and enjoyed ever aspect of the hotel from the service to the food to the beautiful views of the property....we love the paradisus cancun and can't wait to come back

reviews.author: paulagc2017
reviews.title: Great All Inclusive Resort
reviews.text: Great Resort! Our second time staying here and would defiantly book my stay here again.  The all-inclusive is defiantly worth it! About 10+ great tasting restaurants, Pool bar area was great! Great in-house events. My husband and I purchase a spa for couple and loved the total experience. Came out so relax and ready to enjoy the rest of the Caribbean.  All staff members were very attentive. Great experience overall. I have recommended this resort to a few friends already!

reviews.author: Taiwo Kay
reviews.title: Nice stay
reviews.text: Enjoyed or stay, especially Bana restaurant. Our waitress, Veronica Mendoza was excellent. The beach was nice and the evening shows were very good. The location in the hotel zone was very strategic. We spent six nights in the hotel.

reviews.author: IowaPeggy
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text: Our family of 11 stayed here for 5 days.  We had 7 adults and 4 children, ages 8 to 15.  This resort was perfect for this age group.  The beach was beautiful and very swim able and the pools were of nice temperature.  We bought floaties and boogie boards at Aqua World (they are cheaper there than at the resort).  The restaurants that need reservations are hard to get into.  We did eat at Enos and Vento.  Everyone was very friendly and had good service.  We did tip, a $1 goes a long ways.  Felt very safe here.  Several parasailed and rented waverunners.   The Buffet was very good and had lots of choices.  Great icecream place.  Make sure you scout out the resort so you know where things are.  Sunset Grill has a great lunch......Coco Beach Bar is a great place for drinks.  The swim up bar is wonderful!    We saw four shows at night and they were are fantastic.  We had ocean front rooms.  Used room service several times and it worked great!  Rose pedals and champagne/fruit greeted us when we got to our room.  We were offered a timeshare presentation with a full day of activities, but turned it down.  They never bothered us again.  We ordered a platter of lobster and shrimp one day and it was so good.....it was $50, but worth every penny.  There are a lot of steps, but that way we wore off all we ate and drank!    I would definitely go back here and recommend for a family.  It was not crowded.   We did not use the Royal Service, nor would I if I went back....it simply isn't necessary.    We also had our picture taken with the resort photographer and they captured the moment!   We used Vacation Fixation through Facebook....Jenny did an amazing job putting this trip together for us.

reviews.author: Helen
reviews.title: Excellente!
reviews.text: Melia was by far, the best all-inclusive resort we have experienced on the Caribbean. The staff were courteous and professional. They seemed to be enjoying their work. I like the uniforms too. Very pretty! Thank you so much for being kind and letting us enjoy our Thanksgiving Holiday. The food was superb. The cocktails were top-shelf. The beach is clean. They're not strict with towel service so we help by returning used towels as much as we can encounter. However, the pool is 5 feet 4 inches deep on average. Too deep for me to lounge in. I didn't see a jacuzzi (hot tub) either. The beds in family concierge room could be bigger, like two queen sized instead of two full-sized. Still thankful though!

reviews.author: BobbyG143
reviews.title: Nice but showing it’s age.
reviews.text: Housekeeping never got it right, our room flooded after a storm and we received 4 bottles of liquor I’m sure we paid for but never touched. Food was hit or miss, lacking consistency from one restaurant to the next. We were seated at the bus station or just outside the rest rooms more often than not. Royal Service was over priced not worth the price.

reviews.author: Mgcollazo
reviews.title: Great Service
reviews.text:
Beautiful resort, delicious restaurants, rooms are gorgeous and bed mattress was a perfect. 
We’re Club Melia members and love the perks that come with it. 

Fully stocked mini bar, complementary balibed. Free room service, Pool service. Friendly staff. I love this place.

reviews.author: youssefamroche
reviews.title: Thank you
reviews.text: My wife and I want to thank the Service Manager and all the hotel team who gave us such exceptional service on our last day here. Thank you also to the staff at Enso who gave us a fantastic dinner on our last night. We are already thinking of staying here when we come back to Cancun in March next year!

reviews.author: David G
reviews.title: Nice Hotel with an Amazing beach
reviews.text:
I recently stayed at this property.

I honestly do not have much experience in all inclusive hotels, however I know of those properties that stand out in these services.

I have to admit that I liked the personalized attention they gave me prior to entering this Resort, the Reservations Staff was in a very cordial way accommodated to the requirements. . They gave me assistance in a very effective way with some CC changes due to an inconvenience during my trip, I have to highlight the incredible work of Elena Cruz in this department, she was extremely effective, professional and with a very good touch for the handling of information, very grateful for your good work.

The food was good, the services and the drinks in general were good.

In relation to the rooms I think that this property has been operating for several years which is remarkable due to its concept and decoration. so it's not your strong point on my opinion.

The beach area was my favorite, definitely you have a great beach. The pool area was pretty good, however they tend to take a bit longer to provide service. (being aware that there are usually many people)

In general it is a well maintained property, with a lot of enthusiastic staff in what they do every day and an incredible beach.

Thank you very much.

reviews.author: Dan S
reviews.title: Nice family vacation despite poor resort management
reviews.text:
We spent 6 nights at Paradisus.  Although we found the resort to be poorly managed, if we overlooked the related frustrations, it was a nice place for a family vacation.

Our frustrations started prior to arrival (which perhaps should have been a clue).  We emailed the hotel twice with various questions and the hotel never responded.

Check-In Difficulties
We arrived at 7am on a Monday morning after taking a red-eye.  We had booked two rooms, one with a king bed and one with two double beds, we had requested roll-away beds in both rooms, and we had requested adjoining rooms.  (We are a family of 6, and we wanted maximum flexibility as to sleeping arrangements.)  Our reservation was confirmed at check-in, but they told us no connecting rooms were available.  Instead, they offered us two rooms with one room in-between.  We realize the connecting room was not guaranteed, and this was a good option (and certainly we appreciated it).  We were put on a priority list for room cleaning, and we were told to check back in a couple of hours.

At 11am our rooms were still not available.  Not a big deal because check-out was at noon.  We were told rooms would be available at 1pm.  We checked back at 1pm and rooms still not available.  We were told to check back at 3pm.  At 3pm, the official check-in time, rooms were still not available.  We were told they were doing final cleaning, and one room would be available in 30 minutes and the other room would be available at 4pm.  We came back a little after 4:00pm, got our room keys and found that we had 2 rooms with king beds (instead of 1 king bed room and 1 room with double beds) and no roll-away beds.  I went back to the front desk, and I was told that the only double bed room was on a different floor, although there was a room with double beds on the same floor that would free up tomorrow (so we put a hold on that room).  They said they would have the roll-away beds set up.  

At 6:30pm, we still did not have roll-away beds.  We called the front desk and we were told no roll-away beds were available.  I complained and they said they would work on it.  I then went down to the front desk and asked for a manager.  I complained to the manager about no roll-away beds, not getting 1 king and 1 double bed room, and not having rooms available at the official 3pm check-in time.  His response was that room type was guaranteed only if we booked directly through the hotel (we booked through expedia), and that they could not guarantee room types sold through any other party!  He also said there was nothing he could do if all of the roll-away beds were being used.  He ignored my complaint about not getting rooms at 3pm.

In the end, the rooms worked out fine.  They found one roll-away bed which we used.  We ended up not taking the double-bed room that we had placed a hold on.  It was incredibly frustrating that they did not tell us about the rooms at check-in (that we would not be getting a room with two double beds) or that no roll-aways were available.  At check-in, they confirmed our room types and they confirmed we would get roll-aways in both rooms, and then they could not deliver.

Room Overview
The rooms were large, with 1 king bed and 1 fold-out couch (full).  One sink in the bathroom, with shower over tub.  Although the rooms were basically identically, one room did not have a clock, the other room had only one bedside lamp (instead of two), and one room had just a folding chair on the balcony whereas the other room had two folding chairs and a table.  So, a bit of inconsistency whereas we would have expected the two rooms to be identical.  We requested a second lamp for the room with only one bedside lamp, and housekeeping brought one up.  Note that the "master" switch turns off many outlets.  So, if you turn off the master switch to turn off all lights before going to bed, don't expect your phone to charge over night!   

Housekeeping
Housekeeping was pretty spotty.  One of the two rooms had a sticky, orange substance on the floor that we found when we first entered the room.  One day it was obvious that the shower/bathtub had not been cleaned.  We ended up putting four kids in one room (and it was very obvious that 4 people were sleeping there), and some days housekeeping left 2 towels in that room, and some days 3 towels, but never 4 towels (even though we called every day and requested extra towels and asked that they make a note that we would like 4 towels).  In general, when we called to request items be delivered (towels, etc.), the items were promptly delivered.

Room Location
We were on the 2nd floor of building 3.  Building 3 contains most of restaurants and bars, with restaurants on floor 1 and bars/nightclubs on floor 2.  Noise was fine/no issue, although it was a bit loud on Saturday night with music from one of the nightclubs (but not so loud that it kept us or our kids awake).  Biggest issue is that the stairwells smelled like sewage and you had smells from restaurants in hallways outside the room.  No bad smells in the rooms or restaurants though, so we just tried to ignore this.  Clearly the hotel is aware of this as they try to cover the smell with musky perfumed air on the first floor in the staircase areas.  This worked on the first floor, but as you moved up to the second and third floors, the smell got pretty bad.

Activities
Typical resort activities - Zumba, volleyball, etc., all of which were fine.  However, at least 4 times during our visit an activity did not occur.  For example, on the day we arrived we were given a schedule of activities.  Volleyball was supposed to happen at 11am.  Our kids went to look for volleyball, but it turns out volleyball had been replaced by soccer (with no notice).  Another day, there was supposed to be poolside games in the afternoon.  We saw the "entertainment guy" at the designated time, and he was leaving the pool.  We asked him about the games, and he said we was coming back.  20 minutes later, he still had not returned.  Another day, morning Zumba started 30 minutes late due to an issue with hooking up music.

Concierge/Butler
We had just basic level of service (not royal service or family concierge).  At check-in, a concierge was assigned to us.  He told us we would be working very closely with him the first couple of days as we learned the resort, he would make dinner reservations, etc.  He gave an overview of the resort, which finished with him asking if we were interested in the time-share presentation.  We said no, and he spent a few moments trying to convince us that we did want more information.  We held firm.  At that point, he basically wrote us off.  He passed us off to someone else to take us to the hospitality suite to change (as our room was not available and we wanted to change into bathing suits).  After changing, we went back to the desk and asked him to help us get dinner reservations.  He told us that he was not able to help us and pointed me to a phone so that I could call myself.

Dinner Reservations
The restaurants that require reservations book up very quickly.  You can only book two days in advance.  We wanted a 6:30pm reservation at Fuego or Mole the first night, but, when we tried to get a reservation the morning of our arrival, we were told nothing was available at any time.  I asked what dinner spots were open at any restaurant that night, and they said the only reservation was a 7:00pm at Bana (which we took).  At the same time we tried to make a reservation for Fuego or Mole for the next night, and we were told the restaurants also were booked the next day and the only reservation was a 9:00pm at Mole.  We pleaded (it was my wife's birthday the next day), and they found a 6:30pm slot at Fuego.  For the rest of the vacation, as soon as I would wake up, I would call and make a dinner reservation for the next night, so we had to plan things out two days in advance.  With that said, as we walked around the property at night, and as we ate dinner (usually at either 6:30pm or 7:00pm), most restaurants had numerous free tables, so we do not know why it is so hard to get a reservation (is there just not enough staff to support a full restaurant?).

Food Quality
Dinners, in general, were very good.  Mole and Bana were excellent, and Enso was solid (although no steamed rice available at a Chinese/Thai/Indian restaurant?).  Fuego can be easily skipped - the food was fine (nothing special), and, because the restaurant essentially is right next to Naos (the buffet restaurant), with an opening into Naos, you get a lot of extra noise and traffic - depending on where you sit, you feel like you are in an extension of Naos as compared to being in a nicer restaurant.  We did not try the Market Grill (Brazilian) or the Mediterranean restaurant.   

The buffet breakfast (at Naos) was fine but was below average compared to what we have had at numerous other resorts (for example, the way they cook made to order omelets results in the eggs always becoming very brown/burnt; none of the pastries were "worth the calories"; etc.).  The buffet lunch also was fine but was below average.  However, after two breakfasts and two lunches, we had had enough of Naos (which is not a good thing given no other breakfast option and another 4 days of vacation).

Sunset grill, by the pool, is basically unappetizing, bad kid food - pre-cooked hamburger, hot dogs, chicken patties/nuggets, and fries, sitting under warmers, nachos, a few things you could order, plus kid-quality pizzas.  Most of it was pretty unappetizing, although the guacamole, which was available 4 of our 6 lunches, was very good. 

Blue Agave, which was open starting at 11am and then all day each day of our stay is the street taco restaurant.  That quickly become our lunch venue of choice.  Nice atmosphere, and good tacos.  For some reason, the restaurant information we were provided at check-in indicated that Blue Agave opened at 4pm, although we found that it opened at 11am every day (another example of poor management oversight resulting in us getting bad information).

For dinners, we had some excellent waiters and some ok waiters.  Service in restaurants and at the pool and beach was uniformly good - no bad experiences.

Beach/Pool
Only two (very large) pools, and no hot tubs.  (We did not check out the spa or the gym.)  Both the pool area and beach area were very nice with lots of chairs, umbrellas, etc.  Plenty of staff around the pool and on the beach - asking us regularly if we wanted drinks or bringing us water.  On the beach you had the typical "locals" selling trinkets/cigars/braiding/etc.  In general they did not bother us, but we were surprised that they would walk to within a couple of feet of where we were sitting.  At other resorts, we have seen a rope line in the sand and they have to stay on the ocean side of that line.
    
Nightly Entertainment
There was one show each night, and we went to the show each night while we were there.  One (Michael Jackson) was entertaining and equivalent to what we have seen at other resorts.  The rest of the shows were all below average, and at least half of our group of 6 people left each of the other shows early out of boredom (except the circus show, although that also was below average - we kept hoping the next act would be better but the show never improved).

It's easy to leave a review with lots of complaints.  Bottom line though is, even with the frustrations, we still had a nice family vacation.  With that said, due to overall lack of management oversight at the property, I cannot rate the Paradisus very good, and therefore am giving 3 out of 5 stars.  It is a shame - with stronger/better management, and specifically more management oversight and a bit better training (housekeeping and front desk), this could easily be an excellent resort property.

reviews.author: Vh36
reviews.title: Does a lot, but none of it well
reviews.text:
We stayed for a week at the Paradisus Cancun as a family of 4 that travels frequently across the world.  This was our first time at an all inclusive resort, so maybe my expectations were too high but we found this hotel at best mediocre.

The hotel itself is very pretty with beautiful landscaping and a stunning beach.  But there is a lot to be desired in the details.  The rooms show a lot of wear with terrible beds (the “queen bed” is full size at most), broken latches in the bathrooms, finish pieces that randomly detach, etc.  Sometimes housekeeping will give you clean towels, sometimes not, sometimes you get 4 towels, sometimes 1.  They will knock on your door for turndown service at 10 pm, call you at 8 am, but if you need an umbrella at the pool, it’s basically impossible to get one. Staff are nice and seem to be trying but are overstretched.

The food is wildly inconsistent.  Some things (blue agave tacos) are delicious and sometimes you will get a plate of fried rice with absolutely no salt or seasoning.  We didn’t have a single meal where the wait staff didn’t forget part of our order.  We ended up eating off property for some dinners because the food was so bad.

The hotel felt very crowded and incessantly noisy.  There was pumping dance music at all hours of the day, and well into the night, at the pool, at the beach, and in the central area.  Since the door to your room is not even remotely soundproof, that means you will have to listen to the music (like techno violins) day and night.

We still enjoyed our vacation, but it felt like it was in spite of the hotel.  They would do a lot better to tighten up the focus and do less but more consistently.

reviews.author: iraodessa
reviews.title: Beautiful beach
reviews.text:
This is our fourth trip with P
 Couple of things to mention 
 The  maine buffet it’s very crowded with lots of children not a ton of choices for food.
 We stayed at Royal service it was much better quieter and the pool was extremely warm ( I personally really like that )
 The main pool was full of children it was during Thanksgiving week.
 The beach was rough the first three days not a big deal for us some people might not like that .
  Royal service is definitely the way to go with this place if you go without children .
 Food was  good but not the best 
 Service was excellent people really go out of their way to serve you which is always nice Mexico
  The hotel is generally quiet,  this trip it was mostly people with kids or older couple.
 If you’re part of Royal service you will be able to  reserve your Bali  bed ,  if you just staying in the regular part of the hotel it will cost you $40 per day to rent one the pool gets pretty crowded so you have to get space early in the morning.

reviews.author: tenzi123
reviews.title: Celebrating friend's 50th !
reviews.text: My friend and I went to Paradisus Cancun mid November for 5 days.   We had the best time ever!!!   We were greeted with warm smiles as soon as we arrived.  Check in was a breeze.   The restaurants where we needed to reserve were all amazing which is not always the case on a resort.  We went to Bana- thanks Luis for making our first meal there memorable. We also went to Market Grill- so delicious . A big shout out to Alberto and his team for   making us feel so welcome...these guys work so hard to feed us...I am eternally grateful!  Our waiter was also friendly at Vento..I'm so sorry I forgot his name but he was helping out Alberto at the Market grill one night.  Johnny at Fuego was so attentive and gracious and even made the time to celebrate and sing Happy Bday to my friend eventhough he was so busy.  Richer from Naos buffet was fantastic as well.  We had a great room with an ocean view and they made my friend's bday so special with the ballons and cake on arrival and champagne and chocolate covered strawberries! The beach had white sand and the water was a beautiful turquoise and we had a lovely waiter who served us tantalizing mamboleles!  The spa staff made us feel relaxed and at home....loved the jets and cascading falls!  A big shout out to my Argentinian hottie at the gym who gave me workout tips! A big thank you to Gloria and Maria who also were so helpful and attentive to our needs.  Overall we found the people so warm and they were happy to take a pause and chitchat with us.  They made us feel genuinely welcome.  We would go back in a new york minute!!  Thank you everyone at Paradisus for making this a vacation to remember!

reviews.author: AgelessMedSpa
reviews.title: Very beautiful hotel
reviews.text: Absolutely loved it!! They do not build hotels like that any more . Staff was very good and locations is perfect for a quick get away or longer stay. the only con were drinks way to sugary for our taste.

reviews.author: nviniar
reviews.title: Aside from our pool attendant, the hotel was So-So
reviews.text:
First let me start with the positives- Sergio at the pool was amazing- he was attentive, friendly, helpful and always ready and willing to bring us drinks, water and even left a bucket of ice with water bottles for our group consistently. He was truly great!
Our reservation was for a King Size bed in our room, our room for the children was perfect with 2 full beds. When we arrived at check in at 3 pm we were told that our room was not ready as they needed to get the King size bed ready.  After an hour we went to our room, and guess what- No King size bed. We called down to the front desk and were told that they would be right up to fix it. 7 days later, and still no King size bed. Our rooms were on the side of the hotel with the Night club. The music was blasting until 2AM. We were on the 3rd floor so we were very close to the music, and did not get to sleep until 2AM on any given night- so much for relaxing and resting. When we spoke to the front desk they promised to call the following day with a room change-but that never happened. No one ever called. There are quite a few choices for dinner which was nice but you had to make the reservation the day before, early in the AM, otherwise everything was booked.  The pools were just gorgeous, as well as the beach. The grounds are really spectacular.

reviews.author: Hiral P
reviews.title: Amazing views awesome service
reviews.text: Loved this resort. Good place to take kids and have family time. A place thanks to Gaudencio. Made the stay very pleasent. Food was very good the only bad part about the trip was it was hard to get reversations to certain restaurants. The all inclusive part was good and they let you order any drinks you wanted.

reviews.author: Char F
reviews.title: Frustrating!
reviews.text:
I am writing this review as we are still here at Paradisus Cancun - we have been here one week, and have 3 days left.

The welcome on arrival was wonderful, really great staff and had a full explanation of how the hotel works, facilities etc. Again great concierge who took us to our room and explained things further. Room is ok. We have a junior suite with lagoon view. It has two beds which are pretty small, not a lot of space for two adults! Room decor is ok, a bit dated, but the room is clean.

Now the frustrations!

1. Despite signs saying you can't reserve sun loungers for more than 30 minutes, you basically have to get up before 7 to hold them. No one enforces the rule. The first day we went to the pool, I got two loungers next to one of the cabanas that you have to pay for to be told that 3 loungers are per cabana - and most of them not used! If you aren't down there to mark your territory at 7am you have to wait for someone to vacate one during the day.

2. Restaurant reservations. These supposedly can only be made between 7-7 for the following night. One morning I called at 7.15 and was told the only times they had were 6.30 or 8, nothing in between. I asked how that was possible when it was only 15 minutes since reservations had opened and was told some people book early! Today I called at 1015 and the restaurant I wanted was full though was given a time if 9.30pm which will be fun with a 4 and 5 year old...

Not a totally relaxing holiday - I didn't expect to have to be up so early every day. So much for a lie in.

reviews.author: Ana Paula O
reviews.title: Drinks!
reviews.text:
Francisco and Nestor were amazing and made great drinks at Toji (the bar at Bana). I would greatly recommend coming to this bar if you are staying at Paradisus Cancun. 

The hotel overall had very welcoming service. Everyone that works here is friendly and ready to help. We absolutely loved our trip. The service was no doubt the best part!

reviews.author: holly w
reviews.title: Decent, not the best of the chain
reviews.text:
My family and I just got back from a week at the Paradisus Cancun (small kids, ages 6 and 2) and we enjoyed our holiday overall.  We are club members, but did not use the club for this stay and were assigned the main building (3) for a junior suite; READ: regular hotel room with double beds and zero space. Check in was a disaster, we waited to be greeted, then checked in, only to be told to come back in another hour as a room was ready. We arrived back in an hour and the expectation was to wait in the same line for another 30+ minutes to get a room key.  Did I mention 2 small kids and a day of travel? 
We are fans of the Melia brand, and there's many things that they consistently get right.  The grounds of the hotel were great, the large pools, clean beaches and the staff never disappoints.  We took advantage of the kids club (for the 6 yr old), and he absolutely loved it, so much so that we found ourselves bargaining with him to spend time with us rather his new friends.  The staff was great with the kids, lots of activities, including beach and pool time.  The baby club, which is unique to this property, is in theory awesome; however understaffed.  We were not comfortable leaving our toddler in the room with 10+ other kids and just 1 adult. The room was also not as clean feeling with dingy stuffed animals that were in need of a wash, and a large soft surface mat for kids to watch movies on...I don't consider myself a germaphobe, but something about it just made itchy and fear that we'd end up w/a sick kid for the rest of the holiday week. 
Overall, for an all inclusive the food was good.  We had more formal dinners at Mole and Enso, and really enjoyed the taquiera of Blue Agave.  Room service is a decent option for avoiding the buffet crowds in the morning. But I do warn, if you're a coffee fan, you'll be hard pressed to find some through out the day.  The espresso bar operates in odd hours, and was down for 2 days we were there (and by bar, Its an Nespresso machine with an attendant) and there's sometimes brewed coffee available outside of Naos and sometimes not. There's certainly enough food choices, bars,entertainment and relaxing opportunities that you wont feel the need to leave the resort.
Room tip: if you've got young kids, request a building outside of tower 3. The evening entertainment is loud and can keep your kids up.

reviews.author: Edna B
reviews.title: Not a big deal
reviews.text:
The hotel is very beautiful and has very good accommodations. 

We went there in our honey moon and initially it was not a very good experience since we had to sleep the first night in a room with two single beds. 

The staff is very kind, specially the waiters in the restaurants who make their best to provide an exceptional service. 

In general, is a good all inclusive hotel, but the expectation was higher. It seems all the good things are for the royal service. For example, some days there weren’t chairs available in the pool and in the beach, however they were renting places for abusive prices (tents rent by 170usd at the beach with food included).

reviews.author: Irena
reviews.title: 7 days in November
reviews.text:
about 15 minutes from Cancun airport, 
check- in & out was  very quick and easy 
oceanfront room allowed to keep balcony open to hear waves,
all necessary amenities were provided, everything was working.
beach is great for walking along the ocean or relaxing, 
you can not swim in Cancun due to currents and big waves.
You can swim in swimming pools from 7 AM till 7 PM.
Enjoyable live music at 7 PM in the atrium of the main building. 
Would like to mention some people, who made the vacation joyful.
Evey day,  during the whole day, different classes to choose -  Andrea, from activity unit, always cheerful and uplifting helped with translation of some of the classes.
Ivan gave very educational workshop about hand made cigars.
Very inspirational and dynamic classes of yoga by Petra still stays with me.
My butler George -Jorge J Salinas was incredibly helpful and considerate.
Had a wonderful experience at Paradisus.

reviews.author: Brandy B
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text:
Royal service is the only way to go if you are a couple.  Our butler Daniel was AMAZING!!  He had our room prepared with roses every night and aromatherapy pillows.  We would tell him where we would like to have dinner and he made it happen, so that we didn't have to worry about booking the reservation on our own. 

La Palapa - WOW amazing people and food!!  We ate here most the time.  Daniel, Jorge, Valeria, Octavio, Victor so so personable and great!! Thank you for making our trip great.  

Carlos at the adults only pool - Amazing human, so kind and willing to go that extra mile for you. 

Hector - my buddy at the Royal Service Lounge - Wonderful guy, so happy to chat and always wants to make sure you are looked after.  

Beautiful beaches and beautiful people.  Miss them so much.

reviews.author: Guillermo M
reviews.title: Great option and location
reviews.text: This was my fourth visit to Paradisus Cancún and as usually I can say that everything went by the book. The hotel (although it starts to look tired) still has great facilities and overall service is top notch. Things I like: the atriums of every pyramid, the restaurants and people. Things I don’t like: overcrowded with people unlawfully reserving sun beds with all sorts of items (and staff doing nothing about it) and children seem to be all over the place (and the adult area has an extra cost). That being said it is still a pretty decent option to stay.

reviews.author: Majid M
reviews.title: Another Paradisus experience
reviews.text:
I've been in Paradisus Punta cana and you can find my review over here and the Paradisus Cancun adds up the good experience that I had with this chain.Despite some bad impression when you get in Sunday afternoon the service was excellent.
There are top notch restaurants for different taste from Asian to Mexican which you can pick and enjoy.My favorite restaurant was VENTO which had great Tapas-es and nice desserts.Just be careful not to book restaurants via themselves which you would have problem with reservation later on.On the contrary of Paradisus Punta cana which is a big resort,Paradisus Cancun dosent have that land and space, therefore they built hotels and they used the height which you can see in the photos I post here.
One drawback is the night shows are at 8:30 pm which is early for some people. Because Cancun is party city and lots of  people (young) prefer to go out and use night clubs outside.It is better you go there and experience yourself and leave more information for you to catch.

reviews.author: sams
reviews.title: Incredible Stay
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I had a 10-night stay here with Royal Service. We were celebrating our anniversary, a birthday, career change, and much needed vacation. Because of the quality of service and the beauty of the resort we had such a lovely time. The resort is absolutely gorgeous. Each pyramid has it's only plant garden, with vines dangling down from each floor which adds to charm of this luxurious and peaceful resort. The staff here made everything so wonderful for us.

First and foremost, I have to thank Eduardo for helping make our stay so memorable and special, we will definitely see if we can request him if we stay at the Paradisus Cancun again. He was our butler and took care of everything we needed and followed-up constantly to make sure we were pleased. He was personable and genuinely caring, a very rare quality to find, and we are so grateful. At the pool Jose was kind and always checking up on us to make sure we had what we needed. At the lounge, Hector was always smiling and friendly, asking us if we wanted anything, we appreciated the conversation he'd provide too.

One of our top two favorite restaurants at the resort was Mole, Christian is such an amazing waiter, his food suggestions, knowledge, and general demeanor made the evening enjoyable. The other restaurant we loved is Bana for sushi and more, the dining area is in the main lobby surrounded by plants, giving it a very natural and romantic vibe. Vento is this nice small plates restaurant with a little water garden and koi fish, again, beautiful vibe. La Paloma, is exclusive to Royal Service guests, we would HIGHLY recommend getting the mango or coconut ice cream, it's a lovely presentation for ice cream and so delicious. For asian fusion there is Enzo, the food is good and enjoyable, but not great, so it was a little disappointing, especially because we expected more considering the type of resort this was. If you enjoy tacos, Blue Agave is yummy. Fuego was nice as well. The buffet, Naos, is alright, basically what you'd expect from a buffet.

Book a Royal Service room to make the stay worth it. I will say, the only reason that this came up on vacation search results within our budged is because they had lowered the price during our stay due to renovations (which was not audible and absolutely amazing!). Based on tips from other guests we spoke to during our stay, we would suggest booking a regular room and try to upgrade to Royal Service when you get to the hotel for the best price and quality of your stay if possible. Royal Service was definitely worth it (at least at the price we paid and our budget). Also, this allows free access to "hydro therapy" at the spa, which is basically, the steam room, sauna, and jacuzzi area that focuses on different areas of the body in the pool.

Overall if we can afford it and decide to come back to Cancun, we would definitely choose Paradisus again.

reviews.author: Elizabeth K
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: After staying at LaPearla this was quite a let down. We requested two rooms close together and were put on two different floors; this really makes a family girls trip feel fragmented. Royal service was not quite as royal on this trip.

reviews.author: David L
reviews.title: paradisus is a great experience
reviews.text:
The resort was very beautiful. The lobby and main entrance was amazing. The various restaurants were sprinkled throughout the main common area. There were some other restaurants in other areas. The best food was from Mole, Fuego and Market Grill. We also loved La Palapa. The Asian themed restaurants were not as good, some dishes were better than others. They also have a café and a gelato stand. The poolside food in Royal Service was very good! 

Our room was upgraded to family concierge which was bigger and more spacious but the décor was a little dated. It was clean and tidy but somewhat dated. There is a mini bar with drinks, and snacks.

Service was good. Everyone was kind, nice and tried to be helpful. The Service was not as good as it should be in that our servers kept forgetting dishes, entrees, sides, drinks, etc. It happened everywhere from the buffet, to La Palapa to the various restaurants.  Its an odd thing but if servers and management took their time to double check orders and what we are supposed to be given the service would be impeccable. They do very much try and are very kind. 

Our room was upgraded to family concierge but our bracelet/service level was upgraded to Royal Service. Because it was an upgrade we did not get a butler service. Royal service is very nice as you have your own pool, own restaurant area (La Palapa), use of the lounge with snacks and premium drinks and can use the spa facilities. I think it is about a 90 upgrade a night. Is it worth it? If you also pay for it, you get butler service with first priority to bali beds and restaurants. They also unpack and pack for you! We would definitely get that service if we were to come back.

reviews.author: Arnob K
reviews.title: Amazing Experience
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun is a wonderful resort that has plenty of restaurants, amenities, pools, and an adults only place. My Fiance and I stayed for 7 days we didn't have a chance to check out all the restaurants. I want to specifically call out Jose Garrido at the pool concierge in the adults only pool for making us feel special every single day. His personality and polite demeanor really made out trip special. We would also like to call out Josue Leon  and Orlando from La Palapa, as they were very helpful in helping us select the best items of the menu. Service at this resort in general was amazing!!

reviews.author: kgr1789
reviews.title: It was ok
reviews.text: The pool and beach were very nice. The dinners were nothing special. The lobby was very nice but hot (No AC). If you are looking for any night life even with low key, music and bar there is not much ever going on. I would not run back to this hotel. I stay in Royal service part of hotel service was nothing special.

reviews.author: Flightattendantk
reviews.title: You can find a better place for the same price
reviews.text: There's 5 parts in this resort. We were staying in the first one, it was about 7 minutes of walking to get to the main pyramid where all the restaurants are. The room was okay, nothing fancy. The balcony is small but we had a hot tub on it. Housekeeping was usually good except the last days they forgot to put new towels..we called and they delivered it within 10 minutes or so. The restaurants are not the best, service is not consistent and food is great at Market Grill. For the rest it's not exceptional for Mexico, I had better food in other resorts in Cancun. You feel the gap between Royal Service and regular guests. You have to book your a la carte restaurants a day in advance and not all the restaurants were open. They ask for your room number and then tell you if they have availability for you. We had a few waiters who did not speak english at all and freaked out because we didn't speak spanish very well so they didn't serve us until we called the manager, then they came back and screwed up the order even if I showed them the menu to make sure they really understood what we wanted. On a better note the beach is clean but there is a big step to get to the ocean due to the strong waves so be careful. Service on the beach is great if you tip well, around the pool you better go to the bar yourself it will be quicker. Ask for brand alcohol, if not they will use the cheap stuff. Towel service doesn't required a card which is great. The hotel is close to the bus stop if you want to go downtown or to la Isla Shopping.  I wouldn't recommend going to this hotel unless you take the Royal Service.

reviews.author: Amanda r
reviews.title: Wonderful Vacation Getaway
reviews.text: We’ve had a wonderful experience-on day 9!  Laura, who’s served us at the pool is AMAZING! She is beyond attentive and takes wonderful care of us! Orlando, in breakfast, is so personable and provides the best service as well!! We will be back due to their service.

reviews.author: Sergey S
reviews.title: Great place for family vacation
reviews.text:
Beach 5*
Service 5*
Rooms 4.5*
Food 4.5*
Entertainment 3.5*
Alcohol 4.5*

Entertainment is the only part lacking, this hotel does not have a theater, or any reasonably large space for the shows, and it does not have its own animation team on par with Iberostar, Sandos or RIU. Overall great vacation spot.

reviews.author: Michael G
reviews.title: Best workers! (Gerardo)
reviews.text: We stayed it paradises for a week and I️ was astonished by how nice and friendly the workers are. Mainly the activity workers. (Gerardo) and his crew where very fun to be with. The guys do a great job at entertaining people. 🔅🔅🔅🔅🔅

reviews.author: Mobile334353
reviews.title: Best service Alfredo-Jaime-Manuel
reviews.text: The best place and the best service , the people are so kind and all the time there for you , at Gril Market restaurant Alfredo - Jaime - Manuel they have done  everything for having with my family  a beautiful night . My friends when you go ask for them and give them a hi from Ioanna .

reviews.author: O1773QEluiso
reviews.title: very nice property, excellent beach but rooms very mediocre
reviews.text: feel we got value for our money but i don't feel the upgrades i paid for were worth it. Beds were very uncomfortable and rooms were very small. the property itself was very nice comparable to the nicest hotels in the area.
