Also need to be careful with the charges as they try and double bill.

reviews.author: Francisco P
reviews.title: Nice looking hotel, great Beach, not an all Inclusive
reviews.text:
Just stayed there last week because of a Congress. The hotel is beautiful with great scenery and landscapes, beach is outstanding! However to be sold as an "All Inclusive" when you have to pay extra to get a bed by the beach or by the pool, then is not really an all Inclusive. We had to pay from $105-$150+ to get a bed by the beach (and of course, you get a bottle of champagne and food delivered), but the mere fact that you have to pay extra to get the better things of the hotel is definitively a bad thing. I have stayed at many other All Inclusive type of hotel, and when you say All Inclusive, is really all. Don't advertise like it if you are not ready to deliver... 

The other bad thing that was although my room was very nice, my mattress had an inclination on the head side. I didn't realize that for a couple of days, and as result, i had gastritis and reflux. When i noticed what created the problem, i tucked in the cushions from the living room under the head side of the mattress and problem solved. Good sleep (actually the mattres could have been better), but the best of it, gastritis and reflux were gone. 

Bad place to stay if you are an smoker. I don't really care that much about that, but certainly having to walk outside of the hotel to smoke or just having one single area for smoking by the beach is not a good thing if you want to relax and enjoy a cigar.

reviews.author: cjdrxjohnson
reviews.title: awesome resort- awesome staff!
reviews.text:
This was an awesome resort and worth every dollar- I wouldn't stay anywhere else in Cancun.  The restaurants are delicious - the staff is courteous- the rooms are clean the bars are fabulous and the bar tender at the Toji Bar Samuel and Edgar are the best EVER!!!!
Awesome Spa as well!

reviews.author: denisYUL
reviews.title: Royal Service
reviews.text: We just returned from a 7 nights stay at the Paradisus Cancun. We opted for the Royal Service upgrade and thanks to our butler Suzanna we were treated like King and Queen. Our Ocean view room was immaculate, modern functional furniture impeccable, amenities such as Nespresso coffee machine, well appointed mini-bar,bathroom super clean and large balcony.The staff was very friendly, beach clean, numerous beach chairs and ''huts'' and also we had the option to use the ''Bali Beds''. Service on the beach is always available during daytime and again the waiters were friendly and efficient. The Hotel in general is very well kept, pool area always clean and functional. Great service at La Palapa restaurant thanks to Julio and Ricardo.

reviews.author: SMETIN
reviews.title: Nice hotel but staff are not so kind!
reviews.text: Hotel call its rooms suite but these are normal standard rooms .service are all inclusive it looks good but if you have guest from outside of hotel they want to charge you 120 usd for entering fee for hotel even your guest want to drink coffee with you !it means it is not convenient for any kind of business stay in this hotel .we were there for conference which makes us uncomfortable ..they have some restaurants for dinner such as japanese food service(it is good) and far east restaurant (taste meals are not good),fusion latin restaurant (i can not advice for my friend) and open buffet ( every day foods are same which is not convenient also. Generally it is good sea side hotel

reviews.author: Atti S
reviews.title: Big hotel in CAncun
reviews.text: This is an ' all inclusive ' hotel but that is a bit misleading because not everything is included. Good beach and pool and average food. Rooms are good especially the ones facing the ocean but the registration, checking in/out is a disaster, be prepared for long waits.

reviews.author: Jorge T
reviews.title: A very good option
reviews.text: Nice hotel, excellent value for the cost, with great options for a family with children and very good food. Área to improve ls pool temperature specially if the day is not too sunny, it could be very cold, specially for children.

reviews.author: Linh V
reviews.title: Worst travel experience so far
reviews.text:
When we arrived, it took us a total of 1 hour to be checked in. We were told repeatedly that the hotel was fully booked and did not get the rooms that we previously requested through Expedia. Both my husband and I were tired of explaining so we took the rooms that were given. Our room was literally flooded after the rain during the first night. My parents’ room was wet but we were told that was normal after the rain even with the Ritz Carlton down the strip. We then asked to switch our room only (because after checking it out even the concierge agreed that it was bad in our room) and we mentioned for the second time that since we travel with a toddler we’d like to be on a higher floor away from the noise. Amazingly enough, we were put in a different room right on top of the hotel’s night club. Obviously we did not notice this until the evening. I am currently writing this review at 1:30 am and the music is blasting away. My husband did complained with the hotel management at around 11 but since my daughter is already sleeping we cannot/don’t want to switch to yet another room. We have been trying to turn the AC down so that the noise from the AC might help with the loud music. I am very disappointed at the way Paradisus treats its guests as the staff are nice but things seem to be broken somewhere. We talked/raised our concerns with hotel staff but there appears to be limitations on what they can do to help. 

I am totally aware that this review won’t affect Paradisus’ business as Cancun is a very popular destination and the resort is conveniently located. During this stay, both my husband and I think that due to these factors, Paradisus doesn’t really have to please its customers. We try to enjoy ourselves here and I have to be fair saying that the wait staff are very nice and attentive; however, it’s safe to say that we will NEVER go back here or choose another hotel run by Melia. 

For people who will be traveling with kid(s), maybe try the Family Concierge option. I initially did not book it as on Expedia it says that the option for ocean view is limited to 2 twin beds which doesn’t work for us. Try to get a room away/several floors higher from the night club and allow yourselves at least half an hour for checking in.

reviews.author: Elona T
reviews.title: My first time leaving a review.
reviews.text: Before booking a trip, I always do extensive research and read up on many reviews but don't find the time to leave any myself. So this is my first time. We had stayed for 9 nights at Paradisus in October. When planning a trip make sure to read up the reviews of the same season you are planning on going that makes a difference. We had stayed a 3 different dreams resorts and one sunset princess. This one has been the best one. I am very picky especially about food. I was pleasantly surprised about the food. It was very good.I was hoping the sweets wouldn't be good so I wouldn't gain as much weight but I was wrong they were delicious. The only minus for me was the lack of fresh fruits. I like to eat a lot of fruits and I guess because it was fall there wasn't so much. We don't buy any of the royal club and VIP stuff for us its a waste of money. Our room was on the 8th floor bay view main building and it was great, away from the downstairs noise. The staff was the best we have had. very curious, friendly and helpfull. We whent through a timeshare breakfast with of the Malia representatives I think his name was Andre and he was very very good, would commend him if its something you would want to do. And Karla Sanchez Aneda booked the session for us and got us great discounts for excursions and two massages. She got me what I wanted. During our trip we usually spend about $200 in tips even though its an all inclusive but we feel like the people deserve it and everything is top notch when we do. The biggest Con about the resort is the lack of activities. Nothing at the beach, the evening shows are kind of boring and we went because there was nothing else to do. After the show about 9 there is nothing to do. I was was a club at the red lounge at 11 but its a joke not a club. So between 9 and up prepare to go to bed. I would definitely go again but just probably to a different Malia resort due to the lack of entertainment and activities. Oh we went with two kids 10 and 6 the liked the kids club the girls in there are very nice.If we take our kids again we will make sure to find something with a calm beach because this one was a bit rough for them especially with a very heavy current. But again maybe its the time of the year. Other than those factors we enjoyed our stay.

reviews.author: pixie83822
reviews.title: Absolutely amazing
reviews.text: This was our first time in Cancun and will definitely not be the last.  The staff at Paradisus made us feel special and were very attentive to our needs.  Miroslava was exceptional!  She always made sure that we had dinner reservations and if we didn't, she'd proceed to make the reservation herself.  Te extrañamos, Miroslava!  Everyone was great and there aren't enough words to express how good everyone made us feel during our stay.  Muchas gracias y nos veremos pronto!

reviews.author: Cristina S
reviews.title: "An awesome vacation at a wonderful resort"
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort with another couple and have to say that this is hands down the best all-inclusive resort that we have stayed at. The service is first class. We had the Royal Service package and from the moment we arrived we were treated like VIP's. The room, the pool, the restaurants and the beach were great. Our private balcony was incredible with beautiful views over the ocean and beach. We would like to extend a special thanks to our wonderful butler Daniel who dedicated his time to make sure that our trip was unforgettable. A big thanks to Ramon who looked after us on the beach and to Victor who took care of us by the pool. These guys worked so hard and provided us with exceptional service.  Thanks to Jorge and Julio who served us at La Palapa. There were many others who also provided excellent service throughout our stay. We highly recommend this resort and look forward to returning next year!

reviews.author: NicholasVenice_CA
reviews.title: Exceptional quality, location, and amenities
reviews.text:
I just returned from Paradisus, Cancun last week, where I stayed with my wife for 3 nights and four days.  This was my first visit to this resort.  I am an avid traveler, and consider my standards to be high.  I would rate this property as exceptional for the following reasons:

1. Food:  The food was excellent.  I read many other reviews before I went and was concerned about whether I would be able to eat.  The food is excellent.  All of the fine dining restaurants included in the All-Inclusive arrangement were exceptional.  Mole is one of the best of its type, if not the BEST, I have ever had.  Bana, the Japanese restaurant, was exceptional, easily 5 stars with great food and ambience.  The third dining option we tried for dinner--an Asian-fusion Thai house--was also great.  Not simply good but exceptional.  The buffet is also exceptional in terms of buffets (I am not a big fan of them, but this was good).  You can get steak freshly made, octopus, tuna, scallops, shrimp...etc. etc. all fresh and cooked to order.  The selection and quality of food is exceptional.
2. Service: The service is simply fantastic.  All of the staff is clearly hand-picked in terms of etiquette, friendliness, and professionalism.  I did not tip anyone, and I received excellent service.
3. Building/structure: The reviews I read before going concerned me greatly in that they portrayed an old, dilapidated building that sounded like the maze from Hunger Games.  Nothing could be further from the truth.  The structure is both grand and beautiful, in excellent condition.  It was almost extremely clean, and appeared to be as if new.  The room was clean, extremely comfortable and spacious.  Note that I did not select the royal upgrade.  That is entirely unnecessary.  The place is beautiful and the service is great everywhere.  No need to waste your money.
4. Coffee-I am a coffee addict.  This place offers its own coffee house during the day where you can get what you need, and it is all included.  The Cappuccinos and espressos were excellent, and I had at least 5 a day.  Why not? They are included and made fresh to order.  The ice cream looked great but I did not have any.  Fresh donuts were also excellent.  
5. Beach--beautiful, clean with excellent service.  I was regularly asked if I wanted or needed anything.  I did not have to go looking for a drink.  Service came to me.
6. Ambience--relaxed elegance, did not feel crowded at all even though it was 'sold out' during the period we were there.  This place is like "My One and Only" just a lot cheaper. While you are there, it is yours. 
7. Work out facility--excellent, and we made use of it.  Great equipment, beautiful location to work out.

A couple of other notes to share:
1. Spa--The spa looked great but we did not use it.  I only get massages when I go to Puerto Vallarta because I can get an hour for $30 at my favorite spa near the marina.  I am not used to paying a lot for a massage.  However, if you are ok with that, I am sure the spa is 5 star as well.  It reminded me of any spa in a 5 star hotel in the US.
2. Beauty salon looked nice, but I did not use it.
3. Kids facilities are available if you need them.  They seemed open and visible, but this should not be confused with a resort that sports its own family water park.  Kids and families are welcome, and made me smile.  However, to me it seemed more oriented towards adults--not in an exclusive or unfriendly way, but just naturally so.  If you took your family, I am sure they would enjoy, but the adults are more likely to appreciate the amenities.

I hope this review helps.

reviews.author: AustinArmacost
reviews.title: Luxury Paradise
reviews.text:
Every expectation was beaten on this, my first time to Mexico. We went with the Royal Service and were blown away. A separate, private, chocolate covered strawberry, champagne reception awaits Royal members. Meet your butler and given a breakdown of all services. The Butler was there to make dinner reservations, changes to the room, iron clothing, pack and unpack... all included in the price of Royal Service. I would DEFINITELY recommend paying a bit more for Royal Service. Bed was extremely comfortable and a super KING. The privacy offered by the Royal Pool was amazing. Reserving a Bali Bed was the way to go. Bana Japanese restaurant was the best if you’re a sushi lover. By ask what wine is included as we spent around $100USD on a bottle. The staff couldn’t have been more attentive and the ground couldn’t have been any cleaner. The 3 tone blue ocean was a stunning site to wake up to and have breakfast at Lapalapa with the waves crashing just meters away. Our butler Galdino was wonderful & Hector was also a big help! The gym was also a great size with plenty of equipment! The spa was remarkable. Lovely place to go to get out of the sun for a bit and have some quiet time. Highly recommend a couples massage or reflexology. Beginning to end was remarkable !!!
5 STAR *****

reviews.author: diannad391
reviews.title: Excellent Service
reviews.text: The service definitely MADE our experience. We stayed in the adults-only section of the hotel (royal service) which I highly recommend. The pool was warm, the beach was beautiful, and our experience at the pool side restaurant was EXCELLENT. We had breakfast and lunch there every day of our stay and not only was the food great but all of the servers were incredibly attentive and friendly. As someone who works in the hospitality industry, I know how important it is and I appreciate it even more when I'm well taken care of. Absolutely impeccable service!

reviews.author: mlomrantz
reviews.title: A TRIUMPHANT RETURN TO PARADISE!
reviews.text:
Having just gotten back from our second time to Paradisus Cancun I had to sit down and say again it was fantastic.  Can’t imagine it was better than our visit last year but it was!  The staff is so attentive and constantly pampering our family - my husband, daughter and son in law, and my two grandchildren.  Special thanks to Mayte, Chief Concierge for going above and beyond for all of us and to Pascual in Naos – two outstanding staff who make this resort happen! My grandchildren were well cared for with their peanut butter and jelly, noodles and chocolate milk.  Pascual would greet them everyday by name and he became part of our family.  All the staff were so accommodating and making it all happen each day.  
 
From the moment we arrived, Jose the bellmen set the tone with his friendliness.  We were able to get an early check in and start enjoying the resort immediately.  It is so nice that there is not the constant Time Share pressure that Mexico is known for.  Just sit back and enjoy all the facilities and amenities.  
 
My grandchildren participated is some the KIDS CLUB activities and enjoyed them very much.  The highlight for them was a Disney Show that was so enjoyable.  The only improvement is that they need to publicize these events more so you know what is happening around the resort. 

One day we opted for a BALI Bed on the beach and enjoyed all the pampering, excellent service and a delicious Lobster and shrimp lunch.  
 
The food was great and our favorites were Market Grill, Vento, Blue Agave and of course NAOS.  My husband and I had the opportunity to dine at TEMPO and to say it was incredible is an understatement.  Treat yourself and enjoy one of the finest dining experiences ever. All in all, the food was delicious, fresh and well prepared everywhere!

Another thing to note is how immaculate and clean the resort is.  Someone is always cleaning, wiping down  rails and windows and the rooms were cleaned and refreshed twice a day.
 
We are already talking about when we will be going back next year.  I would not hesitate to recommend this resort to anyone looking for a total vacation experience.  The 8 days went by so quickly but the memories will be with us forever.
 
Thank you Paradisus Cancun – you are just amazing!

reviews.author: timmyvaloy
reviews.title: Great vaca
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun I want to thank for the great experiences, the staff was great to us they treated us with so much attention.. Naos restaurant breakfast was great with lots of varieties; ignancio is excellent along with Pablo, Guillermo, arelis, vazquez, Antonio they make you feel like you at home. They made sure that our group of 24 were always sitting together, the moment we got to the restaurant they already knew who we were and our spot was already reserved. 

The pool area was great as well the only problem is the pool are a lil to deep but Ausuncion she’s great, her services are excellent she made sure we were good in all terms food, drinks, even with our kids made sure they always had milk. 

Room services great as well, my room was begin clean twice a day housekeeping does a great job making sure you have enough towels and clean sheets I was staying in room 3430 and the guy did a great job cleaning. Front desk very polite.

It’s my second time staying at paradisus and I would definitely go back again. Thanks guys

reviews.author: Caldeira Bertoli
reviews.title: Very good if you are on vacation mode and mood
reviews.text:
My stay was pleasant and you cannot complain about the all-inclusive fare. The food is quite reasonable, the drinks are server non-stop and the people nearby the pools are pleased to serve.

The inconveniences I found were on the instructions for the use of the  safety box - do not match with what you have to do to use it - and the not pleasant smell inside the drawers which prevented me from putting my clothes inside.

The pool and the beach are very pleasant to stay and I found it weird that the guest has to pay for the use of the bungalows by the pool.

If you are in a vacation mode and mood you will enjoy it.

reviews.author: Rim A
reviews.title: Paradisus cancun
reviews.text: Very relaxing environment. Royal service is really worth it. Our concierge Sergio was very helpful. We enjoyed very much the pool area and Palapa. Daniel, Ricardo, Orlando, Julio, Eddy and Valeria were very sweet and caring with us. We look forward to visiting again this place. Saludos desde Marruecos

reviews.author: Melissa S
reviews.title: Amazing Resort and vacation destination
reviews.text:
My 10yr old son and I went there and had the absolute best time. We were so well looked after and were kindly given an upgrade to have the absolute best pool/beach/sea view. I had not paid for this but was given this and I have to say, the view was absolutely incredible and would be well worth paying to additional price. We stayed in the tower next to the main one as we didn't want to deal with the nightclub noise, whilst we were just on the edge of the main tower, we didn't hear a thing. 
The room was brilliant, very clean, spacious and private. The whole resort is breathtakingly beautiful, we loved the tropical smell in the main tower and the vines everywhere. It is kept really clean and tidy. 
The food was incredible, our favourite restaurants were Bana (we went there twice it was that great), Vento and we ate breakfast & lunch at Naos each day. There was plenty of variety at Naos so you didn't get bored of the same food. Enzo restaurant was ok, probably the least preferred but still good. 
The cocktails were amazing, they definitely didn't water down the drinks at all, in fact they were pretty strong.
The pools are amazing and the service at the pool bar in great. 
The only recommendation I would have is to have the barista cafe open in the morning, it opened later in the afternoon so all you have was cheap drip coffee (which I personally do not like or drink.

reviews.author: Caroline F
reviews.title: This is the most I have EVER been pampered.  The staff is extremely attentive and is genuinely happy to help.
reviews.text: I have never been so pampered ANYWHERE!  I thought cruising meant being pampered.  The staff, rooms, and amenities are the best I have ever experienced in my life.  The staff cleaned, not just straightened up, our room every day.  This was our first all inclusive resort experience.  After the first night, I booked for next year.  The food was always excellent, except at the Sunset Grill.  The Market Grill was our favorite at night; it is a Brazilian Steakhouse!  Another favorite was Ilbana, gourmet sushi.  They also have nightly shows that are very entertaining and professionally operated.  We even requested a late check out time on our last day and they gave it to us, no questions asked and no extra charge.  You never have to move from the pool area to get your own food or drinks as the waiters are always asking what you need and will .bring you anything.  As far as travel to and from the airport, use Cancun Shuttle.  They are very professional and courteous.  Use the public bus system for traveling around the area as it is less than $1 USD per trip.  I would rate this experience Excellent PLUS.  Just one word of advise at the airport, when arriving, don't get trapped by the other resorts' salespersons.

reviews.author: Angela L
reviews.title: Great family resort - loved it!! Just a few things...
reviews.text:
Paradisus has so many positives and we had such a great family vacation - 5 stars from us because it was awesome!  We have also been to 4 other family resorts and there are just a few odd things I️ feel are important to mention, just to make your resort even better, but these things didn’t affect our vacation much because we are grateful for the opportunity to be there! 
So, overall our favorite place that we’ve taken the kids so far! 

Pros: 
CHECK-IN: In Family Concierge it was fast, special, one on one, we got to sit down, lots of snacks, desserts and drinks for kids to choose from upon arrival. Favorite bottle of alcohol for your room too, wow! 

NO TIMESHARE BS: This is the first hotel where we have ever been harassed and asked to visit their timeshare meeting. I️ loved it and for the first time never bothered on vacation from annoying timeshare people!! Yes!! 

SERVICE - our butlers in family concierge Maria and Gloria were wonderful!! They tended to all our questions, booked all our dinner reservations for us (that’s a first at any hotel we’ve been to!), cabanas, questions we had, and special fun things in the room for the kids. Wait staff were all excellent! 

POOLSIDE WAITSTAFF - Jamie and Javier and all others were awesome near the Kids pool! Thank you! 

DOCTOR ON STAFF/SITE: My daughter got fever and cough/cold and we got to see him on a Sunday morning. Also, my husband had painful earwax removed that he regularly does in the states, and they removed it perfectly and it did not ruin his vacation...So thankful! 

KIDZONE: Used the kids babysitting Service/Kidzone 4 times and kids loved it. At all the other resorts the kids never really wanted to go back, but they did fun engaging activities and lots of energy. Kids begged to go back and we got to eat twice by ourselves which was nice. They have a great playplace and fun games/movies for kids. 

BEACH/POOLS: Pools were heated and/or nice and beach was amazing. Always plenty of chairs, towels and cabanas to rent no matter the time of day. Loved the cabana!! Best pools we’ve seen, they seem well taken care of clean and not dated! 

SHOPS: I️ like the shops inside the hotel, it was neat for something different to browse though. 

GYM: We liked the gym and it was everything we wanted/needed. 

Cons: 
COFFEE: 
Not having a Coffee/Espresso bar open in the morning? Never understood the hours and it would be open at weird times like 4 pm ?? We like strong Coffee, much more than what the Buffet served. 

FOOD: Buffet area is too small and it was like a food fight in the mornings. I️ would be constantly bumping into other people, waiting forever for fresh eggs or an omelette, even waiting behind people talking because their tables are right in the way of the buffet area. After a few days we got over it and wish we had done room service more like we did the final day. 

We also heard that there was a seafood Buffett on Wednesdays? We wish we had known about that...

The Chinese/Asian restaurants were not as good. Enso was not good and felt like the food was packaged and heated in a microwave honestly, but had an awesome waiter making it so wonderful and they brought my husband a special birthday dessert. They should turn Enso space into another morning Buffett area, to clear space out from the other one. Best food overall was Buffett, Market Grill, Blue Agave and Fuego. But we enjoyed the variety of restaurants and didn’t even get to eat them all. 

FACILITY CONSTRUCTION - Visiting Cancun 14 Times, I’ve seen nice/brand new and not as nice, on a scale the ground and facilities were a 6. There was lots of finishes done poorly and the hotel is somewhat dated. Lots of splattered wall texture/paint poorly done and looked like quick remodeling. But the atrium and overall concept we thought was amazing. 

ROOM - room and bathrooms needs to be bigger and updated. there is not enough drawers to put clothes. We had 4 of us and there was only 3 small drawers and 7 hangers. Definitely need more space to take your clothes out of suitcases. Take out the beday/2nd toilet and put a dresser or shelves for clothes. 

MUSIC VOLUME: Because we’ve seen it so much, same shows at the other resorts, it’s not really our thing, but when we did watch the speakers and music were SO LOUD in the evenings. I️ was actually scared of other little kids being that close to the speakers sometimes. And the area that it is in is too small, I️ would find a better place than the avenue bar. Seems like there were always lots of people standing and trying to fit in the couches/beds. And because the crowd is so close I’d definitely turn the volume down. 

Otherwise awesome trip and we loved Cancun once again!!

reviews.author: kendra4099
reviews.title: Truly a beautiful resort for family, friends or just as a couple
reviews.text:
Paradisus Resort offers everything you need in a vacation stay. Stunning rooms. Nice, clean beach. An overwhelming amount of restaurant choices that all offer delicious, quality cuisine. Game room and activity center for the kids. Plenty of bars and a club for adults.

There are several pools on the property; kids pool, family pools and adult only pool. You will not have any problems finding lounge chairs! 

The hotel staff are all so friendly and accommodating! 

I would recommend this resort to anyone!!

reviews.author: Chad R
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun (beautiful place bad service)
reviews.text: Paradisus Cancun is a beautiful resort once you leave your room. Everything outside our room was great but the room service sucked. We stayed all inclusive but had to call everyday to get our fridge refilled and the snacks refilled for our kids. We even had to call to get new towels for the bathroom because they never left clean ones. We even had to call 3 times one evening to get our snacks for the kids refilled and by the time they actually brought them our kids had fallen asleep because it took 2 hours. Ridiculous. We even are Club Melia members which they are supposed to go over and beyond for you as a member. We will never stay in Cancun again. The Plya del Carmen Paradisus is way better.

reviews.author: Blerina V
reviews.title: Destination wedding/ family vacation
reviews.text: It was so fun, we will definitely visit again.... the service was great, clean, friendly, very beautiful. we had  the family concierge service,and it was awesome ❤️especially  when you have kids... Gloria and Maria were the girls that were taking care of our family,and they were the best ❤️ thank you again for everything girls❤️ it was a vacation we will never forget ❤️

reviews.author: Jesse M
reviews.title: First all Inclusive with Royal Service 10/27-11-3
reviews.text: I followed weeks of reviews while making this decision to try the Royal Service plan. I was sold by all of the wonderful reviews regarding staff and resort amenities, especially the Butler service. The first night there we agreed we would definetly be returning to this resort. My only problem was the main reason I booked was the least enjoyable of our stay, the Butler service Maria. We hardly saw her and out of the 3 things we asked for dinner reservations we got, daily newspaper not until check out and where we could find cheetos, which we found while checking out never recieved a response to. Now on with the good Juan Carlos from the royal service team, manager i believe was awesome. All of the guys from the Lapalapa staff, Daniel, Orlando, Joel and sorry for the guys I am forgetting. They went above and beyond every time they saw us. Doing/asking whatever they could to accomadate us. The team overseeing the Bali beds made sure we had our days and great locations. The market grill is a must try for sure. The Naos was probably the place we ate most meals. The Vento, Enso and some of the others where abit too complicated for our palates we were unable to appreciate them. We will definetly return and give this resort another try.

reviews.author: naughty2000
reviews.title: All Inclusive in Cancún
reviews.text:
Just returned from Cancun where I attended the Alacero 58 Congress.

The large hotel complex has already seen it’s best days. The style and lay out (pyramid style) is outdated. Especially the lobby and the center of the pyramid are too dark and hot. The room (pyramid 4) was behind expectations. Bathroom boring, the room in white, average furnitures. However, the TV set was modern. 
What was really good is the beach aerea including two large pools. The beach very nice and clean.

It was my first time staying all inclusive but cannot understand the advantage of such concept. The lobby service was more or less missing. Especially during the day many outlets were not open but idle. Sometimes no chance to order an espresso or somehing else. Most staff had problems speaking English and/or were not motivated at all. Nevertheless tip exspectations were always evident.
May be for the many US tourists no problem but for many others.

The all inclusive concept together with many other things were not according to my taste and therefore do not plan to check again into this hotel or other hotels having the same concept. In my opinion all inclusive hotels should be excluded from common star ratings as it easily could be misguiding.

reviews.author: Gabriella H
reviews.title: Royal Service Is The Way To Go
reviews.text:
Our second time at Paradisus Cancun Royal Service, which is all inclusive with top self beverages.  Even though construction is going on in building #5 we were located in building #4 which is close by.  The usual Royal Service section of building #5 is temporarely now in the basement of building #4.  We were informed the construction completion should be around December 15, 2017.
Had a wonderful time again even though there were minor set backs.  Would like to thank our butler Galdino who again did a terrific job for us.  In addition would like to thank Carlos, Jorge, Eddie, Valaria, Manager Daniel, Josue and all the workers who make this the best place to stay. Royal Service is top notch and would not be the same without the dedicated staff that runs the place. Thank you, we will be back soon.

reviews.author: Kathleen N
reviews.title: Girls Getaway
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for a weekend girl's getaway. We upgraded to the Royal Service building when we arrived at 10am, but did not receive our room until 6pm! (We were told when we checked in and paid the additional fee for the upgrade, our room would be available at 2pm.) The only thing that saved the day was the service we received from our Royal Service Pool Concierge, Jose. His professional attention and stellar service made our weekend the vacation we were looking forward to. We will definitely return to this property, our number one reason...the service from the Royal Service Pool Concierge, Jose and Carlos. Thank you for taking such great care of us. We miss you!

reviews.author: PitaRG
reviews.title: Great for a business conference
reviews.text:
Was there for 1 night as part of a business conference.  Since I arrived I was checked in at a special concierge then taken to my room.  Jr. Suite was clean and with enough space.
Service was good and friendly staff.  Had good lunch at the Palapa and breakfast at Naos, which is ok. 
Dinner at Tempo (not included in all-inclusive plan) was a great surprise!!
Even though I was there for a business conference, I saw a lot of families and couples.  The hotel is quite big so there is plenty of space for everyone.
Hotel and rooms in general are quite old but are decently maintained.  Not a luxury hotel but worth the price and type of business conference.
Would recommend and would return for a business conference.

reviews.author: rebeccacX7252XQ
reviews.title: Amazing time at Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: If you're looking at Paradisus Cancun, just book it. We had the best vacation of our lives here. The resort is beautiful, the attention to detail is impressive. We got the all-inclusive package and the restaurant selections were excellent. The staff is attentive, helpful, and friendly, and our Royal Service butler Hector was excellent, taking care of everything we asked for and more. We only left the resort once during our stay, it was just too easy to relax on the beautiful beach and by the perfectly maintained pools. Would recommend to anyone and hopefully we'll be back soon!

reviews.author: Ferhenning
reviews.title: Excellent resort
reviews.text:
Nice food, restaurant, room service and attendants. The hotel is so beautiful, nature everywhere. Big pools, the bluest ocean and amazing view to the beach. 
If I could tell something to improve, it would be the pool animation: when we where there 12 to 18 pm, there were no animation or activities in the pool. 
The japanese restaurant is very good, as well as blue agave, a true mexican food experience, you just need to schedule in advance. 
 Good wines and beverages in the all inclusive option, which also included room service for free.
We had some trouble with the rental car company, and the hotel receptionist was very lovely, helping us with the issue.

reviews.author: 674ayeshak
reviews.title: Superb!!!!
reviews.text: I️ have too many great things to say about my experience from the beginning to the end of my stay at Paradisus. Every staff encounter was more than professional to name a few: Autoro, the outside waiter at Naos restaurant; Alejandro H. the indoor waiter at Naos resturant; and Alejandro along with the other waiters at the poolside. There was many outstanding activities that the resort offers. I’ll definitely come back to this resort and highly recommend it to others!!!!!!

reviews.author: James S
reviews.title: Incredible Vacation at Paradisus Cancun that always delivers again and again!!!
reviews.text: If you want to have an amazing experience in Cancun with excellent food, delicious drinks, white sandy beaches, and superior service, then Paradisus Cancun is the destination for your next vacation.  This is our 3rd trip here in the last 3 years and we cant wait to go back again. The resort is not too big, and not too small, it is simply just right. Last year I brought my now fiancé here to ask her to marry me and they made it extraordinary by upgrading us to the Family Concierge Service. Gabriel and Rodolfo were our contacts in Family concierge and they, especially Gabriel, made every detail perfect and the engagement unforgettable. (See prior review if you want more details.) This year I again contacted Gabriel and as I wanted to upgrade in order to experience the Family Concierge level of service. This upgrade was worth every penny as it gives you all the benefits and access to all the Royal Service areas. Furthermore it allows for the opportunity to have Gabriel work with you to make your vacation one to remember. Leading up to our vacation Gabriel was in constant contact with me, helping me make arrangements for the flowers I wanted in the room for my fiancé, our room selection, the beverages we were requesting for our 1 year engage-a-versary celebration, and he did some of this while he himself was on vacation emailing from home. Every aspect of the trip was perfect. We walked into the room to find it decorated with rose petals and champagne. I don't think there was anything they could have done to make the experience more special. What we love about this place above and beyond the beauty of the hotel with its indoor hanging gardens and soothing water fountains and streams, the fantastic food, the premium drinks, the gorgeous beach and relaxing pools, are the people and the unmatched service they provide. When we arrived we were greeted with warm smiles and some of the staff remembered us from last year. It felt like we were seeing our family again. Gabriel met us at the door as our airport shuttle arrived, they took our luggage, got us checked in, and we went down to our favorite morning and lunch restaurant La Palapa. So many of the staff were amazing and genuine at the restaurants, by the beach, by the pools, in the spa, and all throughout the resort. At La Palapa Victor, Moises, Jorge, Eddie, Valeria, Cesar, Daniel, Julio, and Ignacio made every meal a perfect occasion. They also were our servers down by the beach and at no time were we thirsty for drinks or a bucket of water, as they regularly came around to see if we needed anything else. We didn't even have to ask for the beach menu options because after we had been down there for a little while Victor, Moises, Jorge, or Eddie would ask if we were hungry, allowing us to keep soaking up the sun. We have never felt so special. By the Royal Service Pool which you have access to with Family Concierge, Jose and Dedgar were so helpful with cabana reservations and towels as well as just making sure we were enjoying our time at Paradisus. At both the Market Grill and Vento Angel our waiter provided a level of service that was truly amazing, and since he changes from restaurant to restaurant, we were lucky to have him 3 nights in a row. With Family Concierge you are provided a butler throughout the day. During the day our butler was Gabriel and in the evening was Fernanda. Both were available to help with any questions or requests and periodically checked in to make sure our stay was going well. There are sincerely no words to explain how special this trip was. We have made so many friends both who work at the resort and were vacationing there as well. If you choose to go to Paradisus Cancun you will not be disappointed and you will make some wonderful memories along the way.

reviews.author: knittingshop
reviews.title: I expected just a tad more, that's all
reviews.text: We were really looking forward to the Paradisus Melia vacation because we loved the Paradisus Playa del Carmen. We cannot say the Paradisus Cancun was a total loss and bad (actually it wasn't, it is a very nice resort) there were a few things that we would like to call to the hotel's attention. Maybe it was an exception, but our check in took forever because the lady at the counter was on the telephone for a very long time.  We understand she was taking care of customers, but after such a long wait, she could have said to the people "I have customers waiting here I will call you right back". We were tired and had to stand there listening to the conversation which kept going in circles. We ate at Enso and Bana during our stay. These restaurants serve Asian food but the main dish of ANY Asian restaurant and home was totally missing: RICE! They don't have rice unless it is fried rice. Plain steam rice is for Asian food like a tortilla is for Mexican food. We ordered the sukiyaki at Bana (don't do it) and we kept waiting for our bowl of rice, the server said it doesn't come with rice(!), so the he had to literally steal a scoop of rice for each of us from the sushi bar, so that we could eat it with the sukiyaki.  When I ordered the seafood curry at Enso, thinking, how much damage can they do to curry. I was served a bowl of curry, with no rice, so I just ate a little bit and left the rest because curry NEEDS rice.So if you could transmit this to the chefs of these two restaurants: Chinese, Japanese, Vietnamese, Korean, Cambodian, Thai and Indian, ALL need a side dish of rice. You will be taking a great step to improve their food just by doing this simple thing. The buffet food and the other restaurants were good, we liked Mole, Blue Agave and Fuego. The service and the people very nice. All in all, it wasn't that crowded this time of the year and we enjoyed our stay there. Normally we don't rant about things like rice, but it was weird eating Chinese and Japanese food at a restaurant that serves no rice.

reviews.author: Johnzags
reviews.title: Fantastic stay with Royal Service
reviews.text:
Spent 2 days at Paradisus Royal Service before heading to Akumal for a week in September.  Had we of known what a great time Paradisus was going to be we definitely would have stayed longer!

Hector our butler in Royal Service went out of his way to make sure the time we spent at Paradisus was memorable.  He added several small touches to make sure that we were happy and we will definitely request him when we return. Josue was our waiter at the cabana during the day and at the Royal Service breakfast and was definitely on his A game. Josue also went out of his way to make sure we had drinks and food at all times and we really enjoyed his service.  Thanks Hector and Josue!

We are returning to cancun again over the holidays and the Paradisus is definitely on our list!

reviews.author: wilfredos466
reviews.title: Paradisus
reviews.text: A beautiful place... would definitely visit again. The service was excellent. the rooms are amazing. the food was so good. I recommend the la palpa. top shelf drinks. it's the perfect place to get away and relax.

reviews.author: RICHARD A B
reviews.title: Good 3 star resort
reviews.text: We have stayed at several Melia resorts and this was similiar to most of them.  Pool lacked slides and other self play activities for kids.    Uffets was ok and some of the restaurant meals were very good.  They are in process of remodeling building 5 which caused no problems.  Pool area is not the easiest area to access with no rooms (or few) having access.   Work out area better then most.

reviews.author: JulieM
reviews.title: Great vacation with excellent activities such as Zumba, Salsa dance lesson and Aquarobics
reviews.text:
We love our vacation at Paradisus and believe it is a lot more fun and healthy with activities such as daily Zumba dance, Salsa dance and Aquarobics.  
We especially love Vasti who gave great Salsa lesson and aquarobics exercise and Andrea for her Zumba and Aquarobics lessons.  Vasti and Andrea were great and will be remembered as we remember our nice vacation at Paradisus.
Restaurant food is very good however the buffet food needs to add more variety as we were bored with the selection after a couple of days.

reviews.author: Zita
reviews.title: Great Hotel, Great Location, Great Food, Great Service
reviews.text:
Recommended to us by our friends who go there to the same hotel almost every year. Impressive Cenote-like atrium, great price for all-inclusive, great facilities. Good selection of restaurants which we tried from their Mexican (Mole), to Mediterranean (Vento), to Churascarria (Market Grill) to their Japanese (Bana). They also have their buffets which we go to for breakfast and lunch. Also tried their room service where they have desserts and they refresh the mini bar. Checked in @5:30am since we had a red eye flight, and our room was ready at 10am (even if the actual official check-in is at 3pm). To our surprise, when we got to our room, there were rose petals shaped like a big heart on our bed (since we mentioned that we are celebrating our anniversary). Then a few hours later, we got complimentaty champagne. 

Some "small" cons (or rooms for improvement)::
Common areas not air conditioned and with the indoor plants, a bit humid. Make sure to wear mosquito repellent even inside the hotel as we got some (unpleasant mosquito bites for souvenirs). Pool on the deep side not good for kids. Not a big venue for nightly shows. 

But overall, Excellent hotel stay and service.

reviews.author: Amanda T
reviews.title: Wasn’t really impressed
reviews.text:
We stayed here for an anniversary trip.   Check in was very nice, and we were upgraded to Royal Service. I commented to my husband about how amazing it smelled in the check in/lobby area.  

We arrived way sooner than check in time, but were given our bracelets and told to check back in a couple hours for our room.

Right after check in we were approached by a man that wanted to invite us to a welcome breakfast and gave us a list of all these upgrades and discounts we were getting just to attend.  Obviously it was their Club Melia presentation.  My husband said he had read they didn’t pressure to buy and that the incentives were worth it.   We agreed to attend the next morning.  

We then decided to get some drinks and eat lunch and then come back and check on our room.  We decided to dine at La Palapa, for Royal Service guests.  It is open air, overlooking the ocean.  We got great service here and great food and strong drinks.  Loved it here!!

Our rooms were not ready at this point so we decided to check out the resort.  It was at this point that it appeared the resort wasn’t really up to standards one might have expected.   In different areas of the different pyramids, I would smell a strong musty, moldy smell.   This persisted throughout the stay.  The hallways and common areas are also very dark!

I told my husband I didn’t really feel comfortable traveling the dark hallways alone. 

When we got our room, we had two double beds but had booked a King.   We didn’t care either way, honestly.    The balcony is very spacious but they need pub height chairs and a table out there because the beautiful ocean view is obscured by greenery growing there.

Our room also smelled very musty and a terrible odor came from the drains at times.

There was a smoke detector right above the bed with BRIGHT flashing green lights.   It was disturbing!  Once during some “adult” activities at night  the green lights came on and stayed on which freaked me out a whole lot.  Not sure what the deal is with that!!

Dinner reservations were always a hassle!  The first night the only restaurant we could get into was ENSO, which is kind of like Chinese.    I got chicken tandoori and my husband got duck.  Both ours were dry and overcooked.

The second night was our anniversary.   We called for reservations right after our “Club Melia” presentation and again they said the only thing available was ENSO! We just decided to go off property that night for our anniversary dinner.

DO NOT DO THE CLUB MELIA PRESENTATION!  The “free” vacation they promise comes with a 50.00 fee and according to the fine print, you have to attend another presentation.   We were also a discounted spa service we never received and Two free excursions that took pretty much demanding to get them to honor.   Plus it was very high pressure to pay 43,000 for a 50 year timeshare.  

We did get reservations at BANA the next night and it was just ok.  The sushi didn’t seem fresh.   We are sushi fanatics so they had a lot to live up to.

We spent a lot of time at the beach area in the Royal Service area.  It and La Palapa were our favorite places during the day, then a drink at Coco’s Beach club at night.

Our last night we decided to eat at Blue Agave.   No reservations required, and this is pretty much just tacos and quesadillas.  It was very good but my husband and I felt sick the rest of the night.  

Overall it wasn’t a terrible time, but it wasn’t the best either.   I enjoyed being in Cancun and their beach, drinks and pool area was good.   The food needs some attention and inside needs some updates, cleaning, etc.

reviews.author: Natalie C
reviews.title: Perfect Vacation with the Family
reviews.text:
This hotel was PERFECT for the family.  We stayed 5 nights over Thanksgiving, and met with extended family (total of 9 of us).  The vacation was not without some hiccups, but overall- it was absolutely wonderful and well priced with children.  We have stayed in Cancun several times, and I would come back here with the kids.

Pros
1- Gorgeous grounds.  The vegetation and architecture inside and out made it such a pleasure to walk around!  They also make it very easy to get around to the pools, restaurants, and the beach.  It's always clean and safe, people are touching up the area at all times.
2- Beach.  The beach is well kept, and although this has nothing to do with the actual resort, the water was a perfect warm temperature in late November! The sea was a little rough at times, but our 12-yr old was in the water from morning until sun down.  Very little seaweed, and the sand was fun to play in/very fine/not rocky (this is not the case at all Cancun resorts).  The service and places to sit - on the beach and in the shade- were wonderful. Nice showers to rinse sand off before hitting the pool/room.
3- Pool.  We rented a cabana (about $100USD) each day.  With 9 of us total, it was a great way to have a shady spot to keep all our stuff all day.  We felt cabana #107 was the perfect location to the pool and beach. In late November, it was a little cool at first, but very clean and refreshing, the kids were in there all day.  The entire area we stayed at was 5' deep, so bring a float for the little ones if they need it. There is a kids area where it's more shallow as well.  The swim-up bar was teeming with kids, so if you want an adults-only trip, this might not be the place.  Nurbi, Roberto, and Jesus did a great job of always taking care of the adults and little ones.  Lots of areas to sit.  It's typical that people put towels to mark their spots, but they will bring out more chairs as needed.  Even on Thanksgiving, it never felt to crowded.
4- Drinks.  What can I say? All-inclusive makes the drinks taste better.  Besides being 'free' and plentiful, they were tasty and strong, and the staff kept them coming all day. I suggest the Grand Marnier Margarita.  For the kids, the mango/strawberry/lemon smoothies were a huge hit. 
5- Room.  The room will be in the pros and cons. We stayed ocean front, and our view was gorgeous.  We were on the 5th floor, not near the center (where it can get loud).  The beds are nice, the room is clean, and the balcony is wonderful.
6- Food.  The food is admittedly barely a 'pro'.  It is what I have learned to expect at an all-inclusive.  It does not wow, and at times is even underwhelming, but the buffet that was always open had plenty of choices (great for little ones), the bar by the pool was great for wings/hot dogs/fries, and the Market Grille (Brazilian Steakhouse) was really tasty, the best food I had at the resort!  If you are by the pool, ask your waiter for the shrimp skewers.  They are not on the menu, and take 40min to get, but are worth it!  Booking a restaurant (other than the buffer or Blue Agave) has to be done very early in the morning.
7- Value.  They say kids (0-12yrs old) are 'free', and I have found at other places it's not really true (they increase the price in other ways).  But here, they really are FREE.  My parents (2 adults) paid the same amount we paid for 2 adults + 2 kids. There was no better deal to be had.  I can't tell if kids are always free at Melia resorts or if this was a limited time offer, but I can see the deal is still going on now.  I do suggest bringing tip money.  It's nice to tip for good service, and it goes a long way with the staff.

Cons
1. Room.  Even though we were far from the center, and on the 5th floor, I could still hear commotion later into the night.  That said, I went to bed early (9pm), so might not be an issue with those with older kids/night owls.  We also heard sounds all night- just structural shifting sounds, so I didn't sleep well.  The air con is really loud, but that was actually nice background noise.  I felt the rooms were the smallest of any resort I have been in Cancun. That said, they are still a decent size (we had a family of 4 in one room).
2- Smell.  The resort is very clean, but they have a very strong air freshener, and it was over-powering in the room, in the halls, on the sheets, etc.  That said, I admit to have a sensitive nose.  I will say, I didn't smell another bad smells (mildew, uncleanliness, sewer, etc).
3- Towels in Room.  No matter what we did, we never got 4 bath towels, and rarely had wash clothes.  You have to call for more towels, but because of the sheer size of the place, everything takes a good amount of time to happen.  
4- Check-out.  Check-out was lengthy and fraught with issues.  They don't let you check-out the night before, so make sure you have a 20-30min cushion for this process.  Also make sure you get a confirmation paper that you checked out.  My parents checked out, but they didn't give them the paper, but you cannot leave the property without it, so we had to yet again go back to the front desk for this paper.  

Overall, it was a very wonderful, relaxing, fun, gorgeous vacation.  We are thoroughly happy considered we paid for 2 people out of 4.  We will definitely return to Paridisus for a family vacation.

reviews.author: c-florian
reviews.title: Good familly hotel
reviews.text:
Interesting architecture,good location, manicured gardens and a lot of vegetation inside of the pyramids give a unique feeling to the resort.
Decent food and a lot of options for dinner reservations are just one phone call away.
The lounge area is nice but small for the shows performed every night . I'm sure the resort can find a better solution (maybe the beach tent ?)
Nice designer toiletries but no bathrobe or slippers, good size bathrooms with rain shower, separate toilet and European bidet  . The rooms are reasonable size ,air conditioning ,fridge with beer ,sodas and snacks and a large terrace with two chaise-lounges and a small table. The view is great on both sides : towards the sea or the lagoon. 
Approximately 10 minutes bus ride to "la Isla "shopping mall, bus station at the end of the walkway. The pools are good size ,wet bar ,also a hookah bar . All bars feature good quality liquor. The beach is wide ,too bad that almost one third is taken by an unused tent filled with tables and chairs. Part of the beach is reserved for higher status members so the area available is kind of small. Some Chaise-loungers are in need of repair but there are enough palapas  and the resort doesn't skimp on towels.
The staff is helpful and hard working and one name stands out :Gaudencio -he went the extra mile and he was very professional . With more attention to details and some refurbishing the resort can be one of the top preferred resorts to many discerning guests.

reviews.author: Me T
reviews.title: Amazing zen and classy hotel
reviews.text:
We stayed at Paradisus Cancun and loved the nice look of this hotel.  We got great service from Family Concierge, especially Gabriel
Our favourite meal was the Tapas at the Vento and we got extraordinary service for our waiter, Carlos. 
The beach is awesome. 
Rooms are OK

reviews.author: Cocobpete
reviews.title: Perfection In Paradise
reviews.text:
Every time I come to Cancun I always end up here. The place is just beautiful the food amazing the accommodations and views are superb but the best part the staff will bend over backwards to make your stay as enjoyable as possible. 

You will never be disappointed here. 

Regards

reviews.author: Shelley T
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun,  a nice vacation But needs some work.
reviews.text:
My Husband and I and a group of friends traveled to Paradisus the 1st week of Nov.
When we arrived it was Dark out. Walked into the Hotel, the smell was overwhelming(too much essential oils and the incense have to go!) Check in was fast,but then we sat down with this lady telling us about the hotel, which was great. Then it happened, she offered us a deal on an excursion if we would have a special breakfast with her in the morning, RED FLAG!  My husband and I said no, and after that we were treated very cold. She wanted us to waste our beautiful morning listening to her try selling us a timeshare with Melia. I was really turned off by our 1st half hour or so of our arrival. So we make our way to our room,the resort is very dark and I wasn't impressed with that, Kinda dangerous I think. Our room was very spacious and clean also had a very nice plate of fruit and a Mayan mask as a welcome gift, along with balloons on the bed as I was celebrating my retirement. Thank you!!

The service from the staff at the Buffet,Ala Carts and Bars was very good. I preferred eating at the Ala carts rather than the Buffet.Which is weird because it's usually the other way around when we travel. Believe me, I'm not a picky eater, the buffet was not that Great!
THE CHICKEN WINGS AT THE POOL WERE AWESOME!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!
One of our friends that we were traveling with needed wheel chair access. This resort needs more of that. We wanted to go sit in the Red light lounge,I think that's what it was called, we couldn't  because of the stairs. Couldn't sit at outside lounge, No wheel chair access.Very frustrating for him!
Also I think this resort needs a Theater you have to stand and watch the show in the Lounge, Really!! And get rid of those darn bed loungers in the Lounge.What a waste of space and kinda dirty! 
We've been to many resorts and there's always places to sit in the lobby to visit and have a few drinks where its quiet,this resort has nothing like that. Oh sure there's place to sit as walking down the hall way etc. But there is no type of beverage service if you were to do that.                              MORE WHEEL CHAIR ACCESS!!

The pool area and beach was wonderful. Always a place to sit and plenty of towels. I love the fact that there's no towel cards. Always had friendly service around the pool area. The staff was always cleaning and keeping the guests happy.

We always had a good night sleep. The beds were very comfortable and our area was very quiet. We were in room 3211 with a gorgeous Lagoon view. Our maid was wonderful and the turn down service was awesome too! Fridge was always stocked daily with lots of water,pop and goodies.

Would we return here? No (there are way too many better resorts out there that I would return to.)
Would I recommend it to my friends? Maybe,but they would know about all the issues we all had as a group.

Aside from all the things I felt needs to be looked at by administration, we did have a very fun and relaxing vacation at the Paradisus Cancun.  Thank you!

reviews.author: Beth B
reviews.title: Loved this place!
reviews.text: Staff was amazing, service was fast, food was good.  The beach and pool are beautiful.  Some suggestions - make dinner reservations a day early as they fill up fast.  Grab your chairs on the beach or by the pool EARLY, they are all gone by about 9am.  I'd suggest booking your excursions ahead of time as the prices are slightly higher if you do it at the hotel.  The weather was great when we went (Thanksgiving week), a little chilly at night and a little windy but overall fabulous.  We rented a cabana twice and thought it was worth the extra money.  You get personalized service all day - whatever food or drinks you want.  I would definitely suggest tipping well, the staff will remember you and go the extra mile to make sure you're happy.  Plus they deserve it, they work hard!! The nightly shows were really fun but again get there at least an hour early to make sure you get a good seat.  Overall a great place and we would definitely return.  It was by far the nicest hotel in the general area.

reviews.author: Golnar L
reviews.title: Would Not Plan Wedding Here!
reviews.text:
Anyone thinking about having their wedding at Paradisus Cancun.

We just came back a couple days ago from having our wedding at Paradisus Cancun Resort and I felt as if I needed to share our experience for anyone who is planning on doing the same.  The experience and service is not what I expected compared to other destination weddings that we have attended. It was clear from the moment we checked into the resort that none of the staff cared to make the time memorable for you.  The wedding and resort were great. The pre and post behavior by hotel staff ruined the experience. We brought 100 people to resort and spent close to $30k for this event. 

-No one greeted or congratulated us in the 10 days we stayed at this property.
-When we asked for an upgrade on our room to have more space for wedding preparation, we were told there are no other rooms available. Yet, two of our guests were upgraded to suites hours after because their rooms were not ready when they arrived at the hotel for a couple hours. Which made no sense. 
-After paying for our entire wedding during the first meeting with our wedding coordinator Donavan. We were told that the hotel could not find our initial $4300 deposit that we paid to their Miami office in May. We supplied them with credit card statements clearly stating the charges and were told that wasn’t good enough. That they wanted the confirmation code that was given to us over the phone by their office when we made the payment.  They insisted that I pay this amount again or supply them with their confirmation code, or they couldn’t move forward with the wedding. I was shocked that they would tell me this 2 days before the wedding and once my 100 guests arrived to the hotel. If they were missing anything, they should have contacted me while I was home and not at resort.  I spent over 10 hours on the phone with my credit card company tracing the account the payment was sent to. This is something that their accounting team should have taken care of, and not me. The next day while on an excursion with my family and friends the other wedding coordinator Melina called me 6 times in 4 hours to discuss the issue. Mind you I told her that were were not on the property and that I would contact her when we returned.  At this point I was completely agitated and requested to speak to the hotel manager. This never happened. Instead I received a bottle of champagne and 3 strawberries. They treated us like we were trying to rip them off the entire time. 
- Our wedding coordinator Donavan made a dinner reservation with the food and beverage manager at Naos for 30 people. When we arrived, we were told that this wasn’t guaranteed and that there wasn’t space for us. We basically argued for 15 minutes, before one of the other servers came and told us that it was clear they just dropped the ball and forgot about our party. 
- There was no cocktail hour set up even though it was included in our package. We were told it was because they were expecting rain and couldn’t set up outside. There were no alternate plans. Our guests ended up going to pool bar for drinks after ceremony. Why were we charged for something we never received? If weather is a factor then they should have a back up plan like every other hotel.
-Our flowers were delivered 2.5 hours late by the hotel vendor Alquimia. This delayed our photos and time with photographer.
- After I checked out of hotel, this is 6 days after the wedding. I was stopped/ basically confronted by one of the front desk workers in front of one of my guests stating that I had not paid for my wedding and that I still owed money. Naturally I got upset asked to speak to hotel manager. A few minutes later the front desk person came back said oh sorry our mistake. I immediately called the wedding coordinator group and spoke to Melina. She stated that she would have her manager Pilar call me back. This never happened. 

This is the short version, 1/3 of the things that happened during our 10 day stay and wedding at Paradisus Cancun. I think that Donavan our coordinator really tried hard to help me have a good wedding. However, I would have expected that either the hotel or wedding department manager Pilar would have taken 1 minute to call or meet with me considering that I requested to speak to them several times, and the repeated failures on their side. You really can’t expect your team to care about guests and experience if you don’t. 

A little less than a year ago, my cousin got married at a Barcelo property and spent half the amount of money we did. The staff made one little mistake and the hotel manager immediately contacted her and apologized in person on their behalf.  Given the number of people we brought to the Paradisus and money spent, I would have expected a call or at least an email from a manager acknowledging we were at the property.

It’s a lovely hotel for guests or a holiday stay, but I wouldn’t plan my wedding or event here if you’re expecting good service. Our guests that had the royal service were treated better than the bride and groom who brought all the guests there. 

Again, I think it's lovely hotel if we were on vacation, but they failed and continued failing throughout our event planning and stay.

reviews.author: Islandgirl517
reviews.title: Amazing Cancun Vacation
reviews.text:
Thank you Paradisus Cancun for an amazing first trip to Cancun, Mexico! 

If you are looking for a well maintained, friendly staffed, attentive resort to stay at in Cancun then Paradisus should be your choice! 

I was here with three of my girl friends for a girls trip and we had an amazing time! We weren't sure at first if it was going to be the right place for us as it seemed like a very family oriented resort and not much for drinking, but we soon discovered that was not the case. There was the perfect balance of families areas and adult areas. 

A huge GRACIAS to the following staff that made my stay at Paradisus absolutely amazing:

Coco's Beach Bar - Alan, Katarina and Jason

Royal Service Beach - Edwardo (Eddie) and Moises

Entertainment/Activities - Rodrigo 

You are all incredible at your job! Thanks for making our stay an amazing experience and making us all feel so taken care of. 

I will be back again for sure and will recommend this place to anyone looking for a well balanced resort with relaxing and partying. 

Thanks again!

reviews.author: tinarS8292DI
reviews.title: Had a great time!
reviews.text:
Pros: This is a large resort with many restaurant options. There were always chairs available either by the pool or by the beach. We went very early down to the pool to get a preferred spot (says not to but we did, I know rebellious). The pool was a little chilly and deep (around 5'8" in most places) but felt great if you just got done laying in the sun of playing volleyball! We laid by pool most days and Miguel brought us drinks constantly (even before we were done or asked for another one). He was great! The bartenders knew how to make everything! Had a free tennis lesson also!
Cons: We booked 6 months in advance and asked for a king bed and not on first floor. Of course, room was on the first floor and we could only see a palm tree. We used $100 credit in booklet they gave us to upgrade but still cost an extra $300 for the week! You need to make reservations to most restaurants but can do so 48 hours in advance and we never had an issue eating where we wanted. We did had problems with the restaurants saying we didn't have reservations after we made them but they were always able to accomodate us thankfully! We only speak a small amount of Spanish and the staff's English wasn't that great which led to some misunderstandings (maybe getting reservations wrong). Also we got a call at 4 AM the day we were supposed to leave saying out transportation had arrived. We were supposed to leave at 10:05 AM. Not the resort's fault but still inconvenient as Amstar had us on an American airlines flight with the same number as our United flight! 
Overall we had a great/relaxing time. We had friends get the royal service and they were satisfied with their special area but that pyramid is under construction so not the greatest indoor atmosphere.

reviews.author: Steve K
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text:
Recently visited over Thanksgiving for a family celebration. 
Really, really impressed by this facility. The staff was incredibly courteous and constantly sought to accommodate.  The hotel is clean and our ocean front rooms were spacious.

The food was consistently excellent and we tried Enzios, Fuego (our favorite), The MarketPlace and...another that escapes me.

I would return.

reviews.author: lostpenguine1011
reviews.title: First morning here...not impressed so far
reviews.text:
This is my husbands and my 5 year wedding anniversary and we frequent all inclusive hotels. Let's start with check in... the bell hop was super friendly and our first thought was "this is going to be amazing" then check in happened... the couple in front of us got offered drinks but we didn't, we waited in line for what seemed like ever and then we're rushed through getting our room. We were not asked if we wanted an upgrade or offered an upgrade like every other person who has reviewed this hotel and we were not given our resort credit so i had to go down later and ask how it worked... its not resort credit, its coupons where you have to spend more money to use them.Nothing about the hotel was explained (it's rather large). 

When we got to our room there were rose petals on our bed which was so sweet. We changed and freshened up (the bathroom has a small step up to it which I have stubbed my toe on, fell and my husband has also miss stepped and fallen from this sneaky step). When we got downstairs everything was closed, there were no towels and not one person asked to help us or get a drink. We were brought a bottle of champagne in the evening but it was late and we were tired and had no idea it was coming so we were both had to throw cloths on quickly as the gentlemen kept knocking at the door. I would have rather it just been waiting in our room upon arrival as we didn't open it because we were so tired. Then about 40 min later the maid service started knocking to see if we needed towels and we just wanted to rest.

We went into the blue agave restaurant for some food and waited 40 min for our tacos... not sure why when everyone around us was getting their food.

This morning I have been by the pool for an hour and not one person has asked if we would like a drink... I have never been to a resort that is this hard to find someone to get you a drink. The coupon book...or umm resort credit as it is advertised (wish they would have just said it was coupons and not a resort credit. The Palace resorts have real credit and they are amazing). Anyway the coupon book is  joke. You probably won't use any of them as I was just told the bali are 160 a day and you can only use 1 coupon of 20.00 off. I was so looking forward to the Bali beds, they are my favorite at most resorts.

So here I am, morning 1 of a vacation and I feel lied to, misinformed, and well, like the hotel doesn't care about my buisness. Ohh and apparently there are supposed to be beach bags in the rooms you can use during your stay... our room doesn't have one.

In short, if your not in the royal section don't stay at this hotel. The palace resort is just down the way and you will be treated like royalty no matter how you booked or what room your in. 

I'm still hopeful this trip gets better though, at least I'm on a beach in the sun.

reviews.author: monica3116
reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: Amazing food,amazing staff and an amazing experience! This is our 2nd time at this resort ans were able to take our 10 month old and it still remained as an awesome experience as the first! This certainly will not be the last either!

reviews.author: Ricardo G
reviews.title: Awesome experience~ Stongly recommend
reviews.text: The resort is in a great location, cleaniness inside and out was great. Service second to none. My wife and I were at The Perla and must give kudos to our butler Napoleon for his attentiveness to our every needs.Very professional and can see being promoted in the near future. Our housekeeper Fatima was amazing. Left our room impeccable every day. At the Red Lounge Bartender Israel Conde is a pro.who knows how to prepare drinks.Very good personality too. Every one at the resort made us feel special. Will hopefully return in the future

reviews.author: ralmel519
reviews.title: What a dump of a property, and atrocious front-desk service
reviews.text:
The hotel stinks... I mean literally ... there is a food smell everywhere. But that is not the worst part. The customer service is absolutely atrocious.... I have never been treated worse anywhere in the world. And I travel a lot. These guys need to really shape up. 
Their website also stinks...This time figuratively. of course. Extremely poor English website, very misleading in terms of the offers suggested, and the front desk staff do not honor what is stated clearly as offered on their website. Will not be using any of Melia's hotels ever.
The only positive about this hotel is that the food is actually not bad.

reviews.author: Dollyd321
reviews.title: Stairs everywhere! Dimly lit. Very dangerous! Constant pumping of insence everywhere and no washrooms easily found!
reviews.text: Pools are too deep for children.  Not family friendly.  Too many stairs to beach. Two full flights! Biggest problem is lighting. So dark. Very scary. There will surely be accidents from anyone falling!  Beds in lounges rather than chairs. Again not comfortable! Do you want to lie down with strangers? That's the bottom line.

reviews.author: harrieturgo
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
Our fourth trip here.  Service is excellent.  Beautiful pools and amazing beach with bar service all
day.  We found the restaurants very good and even had room service.  The maid service was
excellent and hotel is very clean.  Love the new  nespresso bar.

reviews.author: hdank05
reviews.title: Review
reviews.text: Only issue we had was our room wasn't ready til about an hour after it was supposed to be... and some of the other guests were rude to our children for splashing. All of the waiters and bartenders were amazing. Especially ernesto, Jesus (pool bar) Andres (pool bar) and Miguel (outside of the pool bar)

reviews.author: algreenz7007
reviews.title: Paradisus = Great experience!
reviews.text: Room was clean and well stocked of food & bottled water. Location was great, short bus ride to markets. Eating options at Paradisus were fantastic. Jacuzzi was a nice amenity, we spent some time in there every night!

reviews.author: jtwireless1188
reviews.title: Overall great experience
reviews.text: Great place to vacation. Tons of activities and of Coz will spend ton of money. Dont try the 1.5 hour welcome cession. Waste of time and it's a rip off deal. Was promised to have half price massage by spending 1.5 hours for them to sell us the time share package. End up we didn't buy and massage was of Coz "full booking" and we can't get it.

reviews.author: Joey J
reviews.title: Unforgettable and Amazing
reviews.text: We came here for our honeymoon and I would recommend this resort to everyone I know. The staff was amazing, and one staff member in particular, his name was Christian Lovera, he works at nao's, it's a buffet for  breakfast, lunch, and dinner. He was amazing, and a huge help. If I could give him 10 stars I would. The resort was beautiful, the food was delicious. Me and my wife did a couples massage that was out of this world. And the pool was amazing, there is no other word to describe this place. With 9 different restaurants, the bars, the staff, you guys made us feel welcome, thank you Paradisus Cancun for a wonderful week.

reviews.author: I5633UNfrankb
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel with a friendly helpful staff. The restaurants are clearly all 5 star. The daily activities and entertainment by the pool was wonderful. After a week there we felt completely refreshed. I would recommend this hotel to everyone.

reviews.author: wtravelinggirl
reviews.title: Amazing time in Royal Service!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for 2 nts - Nov 9th and 10th in Royal Service, if you ever want to get pampered, made to feel special, and enjoy fine dining, friendly staff and a nice clean All Inclusive high end experience, this is where you should go!! Don't hesitate for anything, this resort is great for couples, families and their Family Concierge is the best I have seen in 12 yrs of owning my own Travel Agency!  Our Butler Antonio was great and anything we wanted he made it happen, with a smile! I highly recommend asking for him! There is a wonderful restaurant for all Foodies, called Tempo, it is an extra charge, but it is a total dining experience with 11 courses and tastings with Wine Pairing - think of a Special occasion to celebrate there!
