The Bali Beds by the Adult only pool section of the Royal Service I could get used to! Very comfortable, the pool was a great size and never was crazy with noise or heavy partying - which I truly appreciated! And the restaurant for Royal Service guests La Palapa was exclusive to this area for breakfast and lunch, right on the water, couldn't have asked for better - ask for the Kobe Beef Burger if you are really hungry, it's Huge! But most of all, the Royal Service is well worth it, and the beach is nicely kept up and great waves! Enjoy! We did!

reviews.author: VacationAllStars
reviews.title: Great stay!  Would go back!
reviews.text: Trip away with the wife and friends and Paradisus did not disappoint.  Peace and quiet or lively music and fun, Paradisus offered it all.  Service was fantastic and never had a bad meal.  Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Gina L
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus!
reviews.text:
We had a fantastic time last week at Paradisus. The food was great, the service was impeccable and the rooms were cozy. Our view of the ocean in building 1 on the 4th floor was amazing!
We wanted to thank especially from our buffet visits Pascual, Pablo and Alberto. They remembered us and remembered my son Michael and called him by name! Michael couldn't wait to get to the buffet to see them! Everyone who waited on us, from lounging at the pool to the beach, to each restaurant we visited, were so kind and friendly. Thank you to the staff at Paradisus for everything! We hope to get the chance to come back again sometime soon!!! :)

reviews.author: AventuraBird
reviews.title: Unforgettable wekend!!! Extremely recommended!
reviews.text: We went to that wonderful hotel for a friend´s wedding and we had the time of our lives! The service was excellent, you can feel the kindness and good vibe from all the employees. My husband left his iPad pen on the room, we called from Miami to let them know that. The housekeeper already reported it and one of our friends brought the pen back home. The room, the bed, and the bathroom were always clean and comfortable. The room´s view: breathtaking! The weather was so good! The best liquors in all bars. The food: Oh my God!!!!!!! You don´t have to go out to eat like a king. We loved all the restaurants, but "Blue Agave" and "Mole" are top of the line!!! We will come back soon.

reviews.author: Rachel H
reviews.title: Amazing Wedding/Honeymoon Experence
reviews.text: This a beautiful property with great restaurants and  friendly staff. The rooms were spotless and great service. Food was delicious and the drinks were strong and never watered down. Great for family, singles and couples.

reviews.author: lesso1963
reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Fantastic hotel, wonderful staff,amazing choice of food,made for a great 2 weeks. Special mention for Sergio our beach waiter and now amigo, the mud slides and banana dachary maestro and nothing was too much trouble.

reviews.author: Jennifer Q
reviews.title: ERNESTO and crew rocks!!!
reviews.text: This all inclusive resort was everything I thought it would be. Great food, drink and lots of things to do for our family of 15. We were lucky to have Ernesto (especially!) Susie, Freddy, Andrea, and Hugo to provide fun things for us to do at all times. They were very professional while at the same time treated us like we were good friends. An awesome bunch. They definitely were the icing on the cake!!

reviews.author: Oleg P
reviews.title: NAOS restaurant service
reviews.text: It was a family vacation with our two small daughters - one is 2 y.o. and another almost 4 y.o. The NAOS restaurant was an obvious choice since we could not go to other fancier places on the premises where an advance reservation was required. Our younger daughter decided it was her own vacation and hence she was quite demanding :) That's how we got to know Antonio Cubrera who was super-friendly and actually saved us at least one evening when my wife and I were on the edge :) Antonio really entertained our daughters and they converted from cranky to little angels and we fully enjoyed that night. On our subsequent visits to NAOS restaurant Antonio took very good care of us and we truly appreciated that! The restaurant has a variety of food and options changing daily.

reviews.author: Tom M
reviews.title: Great first vacation to mexico
reviews.text: Great food, friendly staff plenty of activities or just lay around the pool and enjoy the views. This was our first trip to mexico and we are already planning our return trip next year. Our only regret? That we didn't stay for nine days!!

reviews.author: amoureuse1976
reviews.title: Excellent choice, service is great
reviews.text: Stayed there this past week 11/15-19/2016.  This is my fourth time in Mexico and this hotel surpassed the expectation. Check in was a breeze. The staff is attentive from the moment you are on the premises.  This is an all inclusive hotel - the food is great. The premises are clean. The staff is nice, never a complaint in Mexico for me. The room was nice and clean. The beach is clean. The ocean was 'rough" but beautiful - if you are a strong swimmer than you should not have a problem.  They do not say no. They make sure your stay is enjoyable. Definitely recommend and would go back. No complaints.  Restaurants on the hotel grounds were all fantastic from Enso where Benito and Ernesto were great to David and Jaime at the Grill.  Go and enjoy!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.author: Kacee L
reviews.title: Paradise -Us
reviews.text: Great resort and very accommodating. The resort sits right in Cancun proper on a beautiful beach with the best wait service, on the beach, we have ever had. Special thanks to Sofrino (and can't remember the other ladies name, but they worked together during the week), for brining mimosas, buckets of beers, and mixed drinks all day long, we just look down and there they were. Tipping your wait staff will ensure your taken care of to the fullest. We stayed in 3406, king bed, junior ocean view suite and it was perfect, main building. Room service was great, entertainment was great, and I liked that all you did was call zero from your room to make your reservations. I can't thank the staff enough for such a memorable birthday stay. We would go back to this resort. They have everything you need!!!

reviews.author: sjmckinn10
reviews.title: Best Vaca Ever
reviews.text: We are on our last full day of our vacation at Paradisus Cancun and we have absolutely loved every single thing about this resort. First of all, if you are considering upgrading to Royal Service, absolutely do it! The attention to detail is amazing and you will feel like kings and queens. Our butler, Erik, has been so awesome for our entire trip. He greets us on the beach each morning and makes sure that we have been well cared for. He even brought us local tamales, which we love!! We have zero complaints about this resort and can't wait to come back!! We will most certainly be requesting Erik as our butler in confidence that he will handle every detail of making this vacation unforgettable!! We can't wait until our next trip back!!

reviews.author: Dawn M
reviews.title: Awesome stay😎
reviews.text: Had a wonderful 8 days in paradise! This was our second stay at the Paradisus and it was great again .The weather ocean beach and pools were perfect. The food was very good though we still wish they had an Italian restaurant. Our room was so nice with a spectacular view. All the workers are so friendly and helpful. Our butler Rode was absolutely excellent. He took care of all our needs and requests. Daniel at the towel hut was so nice and always made a point to stop and talk to us throughout the day.Cesar Eddie And Victor kept our drinks full all day long and worked so hard by the pool and on the beach. Special thanks to Lazaro for taking care of us and making sure we were happy throughout our vacation. We're really hoping to return again next year!! Thanks Paradisus for another fabulous trip!

reviews.author: Cori D
reviews.title: amazing vacation
reviews.text: I would tell anyone and everyone to vacation at this resort.  We can't wait to go back.  Location from airport was great.  The staff truly made our week long stay amazing.  They went above and beyond in every single sense of the word.  The grounds were gorgeous.  The food was incredible. Each meal we had was better then the other.  The pool areas was wonderful and the pool bar incredible.  The music at the pool everyday got people up and dancing.... there were activities for the kids and adults....... the beach was simply gorgeous................ truly a fabulous place to stay!

reviews.author: camillajacques
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: I came back 2 days ago..114 of us in a group stayed at Paradisus. .the staff were amazing. ..food was excellent. .hotel fantastic.. .we enjoyed emensley. .I would definitely recommend. .and would go back to same hotel

reviews.author: livelarge2016
reviews.title: Poor Royal/Butler Service
reviews.text: This was my second trip to the Paradisus. The first time I would give it five stars.  This past trip in November was not so enjoyable. The butler service was not up to par from the first visit.  The wife and I were very upset and disappointed. Although the hotel and staff and grounds were great and beautiful. The Royal/Butler service was just not there.

reviews.author: Tim M
reviews.title: Book royal service
reviews.text: Ask for gerardo as your Butler he is top notch.  LA palapa is a great breakfast and lunch choice.  The beach was pristine just watch out for the peddlers on the beach selling items they will offer u narcotics every day which is annoying

reviews.author: Mike J
reviews.title: Amazing Beautiful Resort!
reviews.text: Must of said beautiful a thousand times when I was there!  From the front lobby to the beach, everything was immaculate.  Room was spacious and clean.  We stayed in the Royal Lagoon View.  View was not good.  We were put on the bottom level and our view was mostly blocked by the garage.  Didn't spend a lot of time in the room though.  La Palapa was our favorite place for breakfast and lunch.  Right at the Royal pool and great view overlooking the ocean.  Service at both the pool and beach was fantastic.  Never had to wait for a drink.  Beach and water was clean and amazing turquoise blue.  Atmosphere is Building 3 was relaxing and romantic.  Loved hanging out at Coco's Beach bar after dinner enjoying the warm ocean breeze.

reviews.author: mmherrera21
reviews.title: Great Resort to Stay with Family & Kids
reviews.text:
Our family of 4 stayed here for 1 week in July for my brother's wedding. As soon as we arrived at the hotel we were greeted with great service. Unfortunately, the room we paid for in advanced was not the room they gave us. We had paid for the Family Concierge- One bedroom Suite. We were given a normal guestroom. However, they took action right away in trying to accommodate us. In the end they did give us the room we requested minus the high floor (which was fine). We stayed in tower 3. It was  a quiet room no noise at all. We were on the first floor. 

We were traveling with our 5 and 9 yr. old and this room was perfect! We had our own King bed that connected to the kids pull out couch and rollaway bed. The Rollaway bed was really comfortable. It was pretty spacious for my 9 yr. old. They also had their own private bathroom. They greeted us with champagne and chocolate covered strawberries and the kids with a special backpacks that came with all kinds of goodies (toothpaste and brush, a comb & bush set, baseball caps, etc). Every night the kids had cookies and milk delivered to our room as well as a special toy from Mexico. The loved that. They also had their own robes and slippers.

Our concierge was great! He made all the restaurant reservations we needed. Our fridge was always filled with drinks and snacks. 

One tip: if you plan to go in the summer please make sure you wear your flip flops around the pool. The floor is extremely hot!! Even if you get out of the pool your feet will burn! Especially if you have kids. My kids had to wear their flip flops all the time. 
Also, the main pool is really deep. So If you have kids who cannot swim definitely bring a float. I brought mine at the dollar store and just left it there because my kids got tired of swimming. The 2nd pool wasn't as deep. 

The food was good. If you want an omelet get ready to wait online forever! Its always a long line. Lunch at the buffet was ok. It wasn't anything fancy but it was decent. They change it everyday so you have variety. There is a lot they can offer for kids. Even at the restaurants at night at the hotel you can request "chicken fingers and fries" for the kids. 

Overall, the hotel and staff did a fantastic job in providing us with a great vacation. There is a lot to do with kids. Our kids were comfortable and enjoyed the beach & pool every day. Remember if you want the space when you travel with kids try to upgrade to the Family Concierge 1 bedroom suite! Worth every penny!!

reviews.author: 633elinap
reviews.title: Paradisus Hotel
reviews.text: First time at Paradisus on our family trip to Cancun and we had the best time. Beautiful hotel with friendly staff and great food. Loved all the pools and entertainment this hotel offers. Great variety of restaurants and amazing detail everywhere.

reviews.author: DM444
reviews.title: I'm in LOVE with this place!
reviews.text:
BEAUTIFUL just Beautiful. 
The room they gave us was right outside a small breakfast area and adjoined to the storage compartment - woken up every morning at 4am.  I found the upside of that tho, I got a few extra hours of sun and surf!! 
The wait staff & restaurants are fantastic!

I do have to say - having kids in the "swim up bar" pool was a turn off.  There should be Adult Space!!! Have a kid pool!

reviews.author: debh032015
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text: This was my first time staying at this hotel.  I've been to a few others, all nice.  This has been my favorite to date.  This all-inclusive hotel is lovely.  Friendly and efficient staff.  Excellent follow up on all requests we made. We upgraded to an ocean view, over-looking one of the pools.  Our room was comfortable, quiet, and roomy.  Beautiful beach and pools with plenty of lounge chairs.  Great food and wonderful selection of restaurants (though make your reservations early!)  The spa is lovely.  I had two services my first full day there.  Veronica gave me a wonderful 80 minute massage followed by a 30 minute reflexology!  Our favorite activity was relaxing by the pool.  Such good service, which includes the drinks and food from the grill, plus fun live entertainment in the afternoon.  On our second to last day there, we paid extra for a reserved thatch-covered pool cabana bed, which included pool-side food service from Coco Club, drink service, and a bottle of champagne (there were other choices on the bottle of liquor, but we chose champagne).  Since we were celebrating a birthday that day, we also requested a cake.  On our schedule and not theirs, they brought out the cake and champagne at just the right moment.  David and Jaimie were our servers the entire day, and we indeed spent the entire day there.  We kept them busy with our requests and they really spoiled us.   We asked to speak to their manager, Tabita, to let her know how pleased we were. It was such a wonderful experience that our friends signed up for the pool bed the next day, which was also our last day there.  I would highly recommend Paradisus Cancun.  It's a very large property, but we never felt like we were anything but special guests.

reviews.author: Monika D
reviews.title: This is Paradise!
reviews.text: I absolutely loved this hotel and can't wait to go back!  What a beautiful hotel, the staff are so amazing!  The entire hotel team are so friendly and smiling, so happy to assist you to make sure you have a great vacation.  I loved all the greenery of this hotel, very Zen like.  We enjoyed a couples massage.  Erik from the Bana Restaurant was so sweet and accommodating, after our Sushi dinner he had the Chef make us a very special flaming chocolate ball with fruits inside for our anniversary; so beautiful and delicious .  The beach was perfect and the gentlemen serving drinks were very efficient and so gracious.  We also loved the nightly shows at the Red Lounge.  The Avenue Bar played great music for those of us who love to dance.  The restaurants were many; such a nice variety.  The Market Grill was one of our favourites the serving concept of the food and sitting outdoors was exactly what we loved.  What a beautiful hotel with purple orchids everywhere.  This is my favourite hotel in Cancun by far and we are definitely going back next year.  We only have high praises and there is nothing lacking here, the cleaning staff are great too, as is room service. Thank you for making our week perfect we wish we were still there in beautiful Cancun.

reviews.author: mlomrantz
reviews.title: FANTASTIC FAMILY VACATION
reviews.text:
We just returned from an absolutely glorious 8 days, 7 night stay at the Paradisus Cancun. It was beyond all our expectations and we have the wonderful staff, food and service to thank for a great experience.  All the staff are  happy and enjoy working there.  Special shout outs to NAOS waiters Pascual, Martin and Julio, Efrain in Market Grill and Tabitha at the swim up bar who my grandchildren just adored. It was our 40th wedding anniversary and my grandaughters 6th birthday and they made us feel extra special.  We had regular accomodations (Pyramid 3 ocean view!) and service and we felt constantly being catered to.   
The place was spotless - always being cleaned, wiped down and not a piece of trash anywhere.  The drinks and food were plentiful and we are already talking about returning next year,  Only drawback is that we wished that there were more of a served menu for lunch instead of buffet or fast foods - but if that is our biggest complaint that's okay. We loved VENTO and MARKET GRILL so much we went twice to each.  Room service accomodated my grandchildren's hunger at 5pm so we could enjoy a later dinner,  
This hotel is a "well oiled machine' and special thanks again to Mr. Ricardo Reyna, GM for running such a tight ship.  
Kudos to all of you for making this trip a memory for our family.  We have been to many other places in Mexico but this by far is our favorite,

reviews.author: Craig C
reviews.title: A gem of a vacation find.
reviews.text:
We wanted to try an all inclusive resort and chose a great one. The staff were above and beyond accommodating, always friendly, smiling and helpful. ALL the restaurants were excellent with beautiful presentation as well as quality - food was delicious. the indoors of the resort have gorgeous plants, fountains and koi ponds throughout; it also smells great, too. The pool (adults only) was big and beautiful. The bali beds around the pool are big and comfortable and the service is excellent; we also loved the beach. We booked the lagoon side with a king size bed. The rooms have great, mostly private balconies. However, they didn't have a king bed available and the next day upgraded us to the ocean side with a king bed. Everything is the room worked well,the air conditioner especially.   Either side of the resort is fine; a view of the lagoon side is equally as nice. 
We suggest getting the Royal Service. It's absolutely worth the extra money, check into it. Our butler, Susana was always there with information and with taking care of all our needs. We love this area of Cancun because it's away from the bars and clubs, but a short bus or cab ride when you want it. If you want to be pampered your entire stay, this is the place. This was an anniversary vacation, but it's perfect for honeymooners.  We can't wait to go back.

reviews.author: D c B
reviews.title: AMAZING VIEW AND SERVICE IDEAL VENUE FOR A WEDDING TOO
reviews.text:
This hotel was fantastic, absolutely spotless and the staff are amazing too. We were there for a wedding which didn't quite go according to plan but was still the best I've seen.
Sergio one of the beach waiters was very friendly and made sure you were ok at all times, along with Andres who runs the coffee shop.
You must get the ocean view its unreal, only thing i would say is to put chairs on the balcony so guests can sit outside too.

reviews.author: Paola G
reviews.title: Great Experience!!
reviews.text: Overall the service was great. But some employees really stand out and we want to say thank you for your excellent service. Our butler Jorge Salinas was the best. Always there when we needed him, super honest and ready to solve any issues we could possible have. Our two favorite restaurants by far "Fuego" and "Blue Agave". Daniel and Gabriel from Fuego, were just extraordinary. And Leo from Blue Agave, was also very professional and super friendly. To all of them, thank you for making us fell welcome and for making our experience wonderful.

reviews.author: BethMorrison6
reviews.title: You should stay here!
reviews.text: Everything so well coordinated.  Oscar will have a cocktail ready at check in and the front desk is super helpful.  Thanks Bennui!  The rooms are clean and comfy.  The common areas are stunning! Many onsite restaurants make this a good option however they are only open at night.  Daytime dining is limited to Mexican food or buffets.  That's the only thing that needs improvement.

reviews.author: grygry
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text:
We were a little scared to take our kids ages 6 and 12 to Mexico but we decided to go for the experience and we are so happy we did . The bedroom was not the best and the sofa bed my kids had to sleep on was horrible, old and very uncomfortable, I requested a different room but it wasn't available so the boys had to sleep 7 nights on that ,but they were so tired from all the activities at the kids zone , the ladies that took care of the kids and all the activities just made up for the room ... my boys loved all the sports played at the beach, arts and crafts,baking cookies,making smoothies, yoga , movie night.... and so much more !!! I give a A+++ for the girls at kids zone (Fernanda,Pam,Suzi and the other girls) were very loving, energetic and passionate!!! My kids miss them so much... The food was good and definitely eat at Mole the food took me to another dimension ( sopes and the octopus ) it was delicious, amazing, saboroso!!!!
The gym was awesome, clean,spacious and good machines etc .We loved it!!!
The spa was amazing!!! (Thank you Lupe !! You are the best!!!!)We loved it!!!
The staff was amazing! Loving, willing to help and very courteous!
The local bus right in front of the hotel is cheap, safe and fun !! Takes you anywhere and 95% of the people riding on those buses are tourists having fun just like us we met wonderful families too!!! The boys loved it!!!!
Pools and the beach amazing!!! Don't be scared of the red flags !!! Life guards are there all the time and we swam and felt very safe ... nice waves super clean and nice temperature water!!!! We loved it!!!
Cancun is a nice, safe,clean, amazing place for vacation with so much to explore all the historical sites and nature sites to visit it's a complete package with good prices and awesome family experience. ( not taking the boys to Florida anymore after the Cancun experience) 
We will go back for more fun next year!

reviews.author: KristalM007
reviews.title: Fantastic vacation
reviews.text: Staying at this hotel was truly a great decision. The staff is extremely friendly and very helpful. The hotel is very clean, the room was clean and spacious, the partial sea view and the lagoon views i got from my room were absolutely breathtaking. The food was good as well.

reviews.author: 247barb2016
reviews.title: The excursion vendors are rip offs!!!
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful and amazing! The staff is great and very tentative of your needs. Watch out for the excursion vendors specifically Expedia and the guys with the Red and Blue shirts. They offered private transportation we paid a little more which is no problem if you actually get the private transportation. We were a group of 12 including kids and now we were stuck on a bus with 60+ people and didn't even get a partial refund. We then went to Isla de Mujeres boat the tickets at the hotel to.find out we had to pay more where we had to take the boat because they gave us the wrong prices and they ended up charging us all different prices and we.missed the boat. When we back to the hotel to speak to the vendors they said that that was not their problem. Final mishap trying to get the on-site Expedia representative to set my transportation to get back to the hotel was like talking to my 3 year old. There was a confusion on Expedia end and the rep told me that's not his problem I had to call expedia myself to solve it because that's not his job. So what is he getting paid for!!! Bottom line stay away from the vendors there!!!

reviews.author: dicksayad
reviews.title: Perfect trip
reviews.text: There's nothing bad I can say about this trip, the weather the food the hotel the service everything was up to par and beyond. This is the place that you want to come back again to enjoy because it has so much to offer. If you have not come to this hotel, you must cone in your life you'll really enjoy.

reviews.author: l0littah
reviews.title: EXCELLENT
reviews.text: The resort is amazing and the staff excellent! I would definitely stay there again. Hector along with other servers on the beach were efficient, friendly and made our beach days very comfortable. The ambiance is beyond beautiful. The nightly shows were great and very entertaining. Also, the restaurants and quality/taste of food is superb.

reviews.author: O1360FNjoseg
reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: I will visit again love the place my family love it also my wife cousins told us about it... the food,drinks,peoples,service was great room service excellent.. I give it a 10 the swim up bar was excellent the pool is huge

reviews.author: Gabriela V
reviews.title: Paradisus = True Paradise! <3
reviews.text:
WOW! WOW! WOW! WOW! 
A surprised trip turned into a trip filled with more surprises, we were upgraded to Royal Service, PHENOMENAL staff who took excellent care of my mother and I for all 5 days. Every restaurant and beach club we attended the staff had remembered us by name and were extremely attentive. The resort deserves all the stars, it is beautiful, but the staff is what makes this resort a must go to place. The hospitality, the attention to detail, the kind heart young staff who wanted to practice their English and demonstrate true Mexican hospitality was beyond compare.

Special shout-outs to some exceptional staff members:
1. Mario Daniel Cardenas: Ready to help for any situation possible, even made dinner reservations for us while we were on the beach, caring about our experience and checking up on us... I study the culture in Mexico, and he took the time to explain to me the economy, the people, the culture, I am forever thankful. I made a friend which I will stay in touch for a very long time.

2. Alan Tec: BEST BARTENDER in the resort.... from day 1 to day 5 as we sat at Coco's Beach Club we asked him to make us a special cocktail, with the biggest smile on his face, he did, we loved his cocktails so much that every day while in Cancun we made sure to visit him at each bar he was working on. We even attended his Mixology class to find he had named a cocktail after me, Gabriela! A must try!!!! I have never encountered such a kind-heart bartender filled with passion to create such special drinks. His hookahs were perfect as well. Thank you so much Alan, I wish you the best of luck!

3. Luis Mendez - Bartender during Mixology class, perfect to detail, always smiling and making you feel welcomed.

4. Adrian Enrique Gonzalez: Best waiter we have had the entire stay at BlueAgave. From start of day 1 to day 5 dinner, he truly took care of us from serving me the BEST tacos in the resort, to cocktails, tequila shots, Mexican flag cocktails and requesting Mariachi to sing for my mom and I. He deserves all recognition.

5. Karina from Coco Beach club: allowed me to teach her how to make Fruit Bowl hookahs and was ALWAYS attentive, shared stories about Mexico, about her passion of working. Beautiful woman!

The housekeeping and room service, Vanilly, and whoever came to take care of our room 3 times a day made us feel very satisfied, taken care of, clean and sincerely happy.

reviews.author: rkd1966
reviews.title: What a great place!!!
reviews.text: First, anyone who gives this place a bad review must never be happy anywhere. We stayed in the Royal Service side, our butler was Antonio. He is the best, very good at what he does, we wanted for nothing and he was always around looking to see if we needed anything more. The servers couldnt be any nicer weather it was at the pool, beach or restaurants they all made you feel at home. One night we went to the buffet and it was theamed towards things I really didnt like, I ask one of the managers if there was anything else I could get and they brought me out a steak dinner from one of the other reasauants, thats service! We ate at all the restaurants except Tempo and they were all great. Breakfast at La Palpa every morning overlooking the beach was great, what a way to vacation. We cant wait to plan our next vacation there, again a big thank you to Antonio our butler, Daniel down at the pool area, Juan and Ramone you all made our trip great.

reviews.author: JohnHyeNJ
reviews.title: Awesome time!
reviews.text:
Hey everybody we came and visited for this past week. The hotel and grounds were very nice given the use they get. As nice as the hotel and grounds were the staff made it all worth it. We especially loved Marco our server in the Naos Restaurant. And the staff at the Kids Zone and Baby Club were the absolutely astounding. Our 5 year old had a blast with them all! It was great trip for the entire family. 

Here is a photo of our 5 year old watching a magic show by the pool!

reviews.author: Jose D
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: as a member of the Melia Vacation club I go to Cancun often...and the Paradisus Cancun exceeds my expectations. Being there 7 times and hotel is a charm, beach is the best and all the restaurant options available at the hotel won't disappoint you.

reviews.author: equoit
reviews.title: Great Family Resort
reviews.text: The staff were the greatest aspect of the resort, I would highly recommend this hotel. The food was not the greatest, but there are plenty of options. Great location on the beach and very close to down town shopping venues.

reviews.author: Natalia B
reviews.title: It is truly Paradise!
reviews.text: I defintely recommend this hotel for couples, and families, I stayed here with my cousin, we're both in our 20s, and well we don't recommend it if you're looking for a party vibe, As for the service, everyone is there to assist you, it is the best service I have received. The buffet is good, but the restaurants are amazing! definitely make your reservations throughout your stay, my favorite was Vento (tapas restaurant). I have to give a shout out to the guys at the Toji bar who i cannot remember their names right now, i think one of the was Hector, he definitely made me and my cousin's night with all the variety of drink he made us. The other's name was Reymundo if I'm not mistaking, these guys were a pleasure to meet. As for tipping, everyone here deserves it, the service is extraordinary! Room service was quick. Overall a great vacation. I have no complaints about my stay. Thank you Paradisus!

reviews.author: Bill L
reviews.title: Our visit
reviews.text: Just got done staying at the resort. I can't say enough about it every single person we met there were extremely nice. Carlos and Salazar were our bartenders and were two of the nicest guys ever the room was great with an ocean view. My only complaint and it's a small one was the food it was cold  every day and since were not foodies we didn't really care the desserts were great the bread was good oh well we will definitely be back to this resort

reviews.author: Joy N
reviews.title: Beautiful Vacation
reviews.text:
My best friend and I spent 5 days here at the end of October to celebrate her 40th birthday. The resort is absolutely beautiful. Our room was great. Very clean. The balcony facing the lagoon gave us a great view. The beds were very comfortable, mini bar always stocked. Because we were celebrating a big birthday, we had a fun photo shoot planned. The hotel staff went above and beyond to help us with some things we needed, like ordering a cake and filling balloons with helium.
The pool and beach were beautiful. There is always someone close by ready to take your drink order. 
The food was great! Market Grill was our favorite restaurant - we ate there twice! One night we booked at a restaurant (Vento) and when we sat down we realized there was very little on the menu that we liked. The server was extremely accommodating and had the chef make us the best steak I've ever had. The buffet had a large variety of food available all day and night. We are very picky eaters but there was always something for us. 
There are shows every night that were entertaining.

There were a few cons but nothing that would stop me from returning:

1. Stairs!!! The hotel has stairs EVERYWHERE! There are elevators to get from floor to floor but there are many many stairs throughout. To go from the pool to the beach and back there are many stairs. For someone that has trouble getting around, this could be troublesome. 
Aquaworld is conveniently located right across the street and there are many activities/excursions there. The 60 steps down from the hotel aren't so bad, but walking back up - that was tough!! I would recommend the hotel offer a golf cart or something to help guests go back and forth. 

2. U.S. Dollars. The hotel does not have US dollars available. We had larger bills and forgot to bring ones for tipping. The concierge or anyone else there was unable to provide change. 

3. Daytime activities - we felt they were lacking in daytime activities. We realized on our last day that there are activities, they just aren't advertised very well. If you are interested is doing something other than lounging by the pool/beach, just ask the concierge what is going on while you are there. 

4. There is a great little coffee bar big it doesn't open til 10am. Just found that odd. 

Overall I highly recommend Paradisus.

reviews.author: MYaghi
reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Despite being charged more for a child and the mediocre room for all 5 of us. It was a great all inclusive resort. Every employee of any kind was extremely friendly.  Anyone of them would do anything and everything for guests. They truly went above and beyond. Food was excellent everywhere we ate.

reviews.author: Megan B
reviews.title: Great first visit to Cancun - will be back soon
reviews.text: One of my close friends recommended Paradisus since it was my first time to Cancun and I couldn't have had a better time. The service is great on the beach - the waiters come around about every 20 minutes and are very pleasant and quick. Hotel is perfect, clean and well kept. Restaurants are amazing. If you love sushi - you need to go to Bana (maybe more than once). Our waiter there was named Darwin and he was perfect - funny, helpful and all in all a very nice person. He will not steer you wrong if you don't know what to eat. He is more than happy to help. The other dining options were just as great, but Bana and Darwin's service blew me away. I can't wait to go back!!

reviews.author: Teelf
reviews.title: Great holiday
reviews.text:
We stayed for sixteen nights which included Halloween and day of the dead .This was our first family holiday to Mexico and didn't really know what to expect .We are from the u.k.
Check in was straight forward ,and in our room within ten minutes.
The room was a great size and the kids found the sofa bed comfortable.The dressing gown a slippers were cosy and homely.The balcony and ocean view was fantastic .The bathroom was dated but served its purpose. Minibar well stocked but could have stocked some different beers .Television and wifi great.Could have done with clothes rail for balcony to dry swimming costume .
Market grill and Ventofantastic ,fuego good Enzo was ok.The main buffet was good or excellent most days bout noticed when there was a wedding on the food quality dropped.Entertainment fantastic.
People could not have been nicer.Ernesto and Hugo were great entertainers.We will be back.Thank you for a wonderful holiday X

reviews.author: Chris T
reviews.title: 20th Wedding Anniversary
reviews.text: We recently stayed at the Paradisus for a couples trip.  We had booked an Jr Suite which included Royal Service which came with a butler, we were honored to have Rode as our butler who took excellent care of us.  We had a private pool with bar/grill, bali beds and plenty of chairs with shade on the beach.  Rode made our trip extra special, each morning Rode would see us and make sure we were well taken care of.  I just want to add that the entire staff was also awesome, they really made us feel special.

reviews.author: cce5016
reviews.title: Relaxing and enjoyable stay!
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus Cancun for five nights and six days.  We upgraded to the Royal Service and I am so glad we did.  The level of service in the Royal Service section is outstanding!  Additionally, because you have a different bracelet than others, you get preferential treatment in areas outside the Royal Service section.  I read so many reviews, most of them thanking the employees of the Paradisus.  I now know why: there were so many people there who wanted to make our trip enjoyable, which you don't see everywhere.

The Resort: the resort is made up of 5 pyramids.  Pyramid 3 is where all the restaurants, shows, and stores are.  Pyramid 5 is the Royal Service pyramid.  There isn't any air conditioning in the hallways and common areas (the bars and restaurants have either fans or AC).  We went in August so it was hotter than usual.  To combat that, we walked outside to get from Pyramid 5 to 3.  

The room: like I mentioned, we did the Royal service.  We stayed on the 7th floor (top floor). The room was nice, well taken care of and clean.  It was very spacious, had ample storage for clothes and hanging garments.  The bathroom was nice as well.  The wifi worked really wellin the room, but got spotty outside the beach, pool, and when we went to other Pyramids.  One thing I will say is that because the buildings are pyramids and there isn't AC in the common areas, it did get hot in hallways.  The elevator was a little finicky so a couple times we had to walk either up or down.  The heat really rises to the top so I would recommend a room on the third or fourth floor. 

Royal Service Lobby: on the ground floor of Pyramid 5 is the Royal Service lounge.  Here they have light music playing, snacks, and a full bar set up.  While the food is serve yourself, they will make you whatever type of drink you want!  They also have bottles of water chilled for you at anytime.  My boyfriend and I would often stop here before going to our room for bottles of water, drinks, and snacks.  It was great having that there!

Pool and beach service: the pool and beach area are wonderful!  With the Royal Service, there is a separate pool and beach area just for Royal Service guest.  You're able to reserve Bali beds by the pool or beach two times during your stay (comes complimentary with RS).  There are only five that overlook the beach, so they're a little hard to get.  I would recommend reserving the Bali beds as soon as you get there because they fill up quickly.  You have to be at your Bali bed by 11am or they give it away.  This worked out for us because we were able to get a Bali bed 5 out of the 6 days we were there.  The drink and food service by the beach and pool are excellent!  We never had to wait for food or drinks. I would especially like to thank Victor and Octavio as they always made sure we had everything we needed!  Outside of the Royal Service pool are two additional pools, closer to Pyramids 3 and 4.  The pool near Pyramid 3 has a bar.  We tried it out for a little but it can get a little rowdy and they don't have the top shelf liquor like they do at the Royal Service pool. 

Restaurants:
La Palapa: this restaurant is exclusive to Royal Service guests.  It is open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner (you do need a reservation for dinner though).  This was by far our favorite restaurant.  The food was fresh, had many options, and cooked very well.  For breakfast, we really enjoyed the eggs Benedict and pancakes.  For lunch, we enjoyed the grilled prawns, burger (it's HUGE), and gnocchi with scallops and shrimp.  For dinner, we had the picaña which is a type of steak.  It was outstanding! The mashed potato and asparagus sides were also delicious!  The service at this restaurant is top notch, they keep your drinks coming, are very attentive, and very accommodating to additions or substitutions if you want to change something.  I cannot say enough about the food and service here!

Enzo: this is a Japanese, Thai, Indian fusion restaurant.  The location is nice, it's close to Pyramid 2, outside by the pool so you overlook the beach.  The food unfortunately is a major miss.  I tried to go with some traditional Japanese foods (spring rolls, shumai, gyoza, chicken teriyaki) but all either lacked flavor or tasted off.  Halfway through the meal I think they realized we were staying in the Royal Service section so they made this lobster and shrimp dish (not on the menu) that was pretty good, but I don't think they do that normally.  Also, they only have a white and a red wine.  If you want to get something different, you have to buy a bottle.  The prices were extreme, $145 for a decent red wine.  This was typical at all the restaurants and was the only thing that I'll say was slightly disappointing as we are wine drinkers.

Market Grill: this is a Brazilian steakhouse type restaurant.  They have many different cuts of meats and bring around a couple choices of sides.  This restaurant was good.  I read reviews about the meat being tough, but didn't experience that at all.  It was slightly fatty, but nothing I couldn't cut around.  They have chicken, pork, and sausage too.  All had good flavor.  

Vento: this is a Mediterranean tapas place.  Our appetizers were good, however, when we ordered our main tapas, they tasted funny.  I stopped eating but my boyfriend continued on.  Unfortunately, he ended up getting food poisoning and was down for the count the entire next day.  Over the next couple of days there, I actually talked to two different families who had someone in their party get sick after eating dinner at Vento.  Luckily the worst of it only lasted 24 hours for my boyfriend, but I still felt so bad to have food poisoning on vacation. 

Bana: this was another one of our favorite restaurants.  This is a sushi restaurant located in Pyramid 3.  Only negative side to this restaurant is it's not enclosed like the other restaurants, and therefore can get very hot (especially in August when we went).  They have fans though that they're more than happy to put on for you.  We had someone training with our butler, Erik, who also works at Bana.  He was our waiter and put together a special treat for us.  He decorated our table with rose petals and prepared a menu of miso soup (the best I've ever had!), edamame, and a sushi plate with various rolls and sashimi.  Everything was so delicious and fresh!  Chef Marcos also prepared a special dessert for us which was a chocolate ball that he opened by pouring some type of liquor that was on fire on top.  It was really a spectacular evening!!

Bars: we went to two bars in Pyramid 3.  The first was Toji which is a part of Bana, the sushi restaurant.  It is also not far from where they have the shows so if there was music playing, it was away from the crowd but you could still hear everything.  Geraldo was one of the bartenders who made the best drinks and shots!  He had excellent recommendations based on what we like and was fun to talk to.  The other bar we went to after dinners was Avenue Bar.  This is where they have all the shows.  It has a lounge type decor.  One of the bartenders, Francisco, was there every time we were.  He, like Geraldo, made awesome drinks and gave excellent recommendations!

Tips/Suggestions: as soon as you get there, make your reservations!  Everyone in Royal service gets a butler.  Ours was Rode and he was very helpful in making dinner reservations.  As soon as we got to the room, I wrote down every restaurant I wanted for each night of our stay.  He also arranged a Bali beds for us. 

Bring lots of $1 bills.  We found this especially beneficial outside of Royal service.  We would tip $1 after each drink and they kept the drinks coming.  

Explore the place and get to know where things are.  It took us a while to get down the locations of everything.  Also we found it easier to walk outside when going between our room and Pyramid 3.

Lastly, if you are a couple going here, I highly suggest the Royal Service area. While I love kids, it was so nice being in the adult-only section and the level of service is incredible!

reviews.author: Monique B
reviews.title: This place is literally...PARADISE
reviews.text: This resort sits at a very good location and its HUGE! I went with a friend and she made reservations for the Royal Service side of the hotel - very mature, romantic, and no kids. I thought this was excellent that it was split that way. We had access to some great amenities and restaurants and we were just a few steps away from the beat. Rooms were clean and well attended to. The restaurants offered a variety of foods for different tastes but much of it was not seasoned or it was not served hot. We ordered room service several times and although they said 40 minutes it came a little faster than that. The food was okay the first couple of nights but the last night everything tasted OLD. Everything was cold and was NOT good at all.

reviews.author: Itzel N
reviews.title: One of the best vacations I've ever had
reviews.text:
When we decided to take this trip we expected to have a great time, but this surpassed all our expectations (and I'm very demanding).
The place is great, the staff - ALL OF THEM - are wonderful, the food is amazing, and we got every single thing that was promised to us and more.
A special than you to Guillermo and specially Marco from the Naos restaurant. They treated us like royalty.
We'll be back soon !

reviews.author: Luciana O
reviews.title: Honeymoon
reviews.text: The hotel was good but not what I expected coming from Paradisus La perla and having stayed at Me Cancun. It's nice, comfortable, service is good and restaurants are good. But when I go back to Cancun I prefer Me Cancun or Paradisus La perla in Playa Del Carmen if you want to stick with Melia hotels. But overall a good experience.

reviews.author: SilverTalk
reviews.title: Sunny Beach
reviews.text: We loved the beach and the massage and the Mayan pedicure as I refer to it. The water was such a beautiful blue color and the sand so white. Beach side service made for a restful afternoon. Umbrella and lounge furniture available to rent. Free parking if furniture is rented.

reviews.author: koralart
reviews.title: I loved it !
reviews.text:
I enjoyed every minute of my stay in this hotel. Amstar transportation was reliable and reasonable.The room was cold enough to feel comfortable and not to be affected by humidity. Not intrusive cleaning personnel. My minibar was refilled every day without hustle. Food was EXCELLENT!!!  NAOS buffet never bored me with selection and varieties of meals. The staff really took pride in serving guests needs. Gaudencio and Pablo greeted me every day with a willingness to make my dining experience nothing less than superb! I would rate the food as healthy and nutritional. All restaurants offered great experience and quality of food and service, but I would mention "VENTO" (Gerardo guided me through an unfamiliar menu like an A grade skipper)."ILBANA"(The art of sharing) was elegant and memorable , especially with help of a waiter Claudio. I loved all bars and promptness with which drinks were served. Pool bar became my favorite. 
Entertainment was also good. Great and enthusiastic dancers and singers. M. Jackson was the best.
Marco and Blanca were always ready to help and guide. All in all, I had a great experience and strongly recommend this hotel. Definitely will be back!

reviews.author: Wade D
reviews.title: Service Excellence/ Nice Hotel
reviews.text:
We just returned from staying 14 amazing days at the Paradisus. October 22 to November 5th. 

I planned a surprise 2nd 29th birthday for my wife with 10 other friends and family. 

The majority of our group stayed in the Royal Service section and for those that did not they regretted it :( ! The only way to stay is with the Royal Service option in my opinion. 

The staff was Amazing!!! 

Suzanna our butler was a true professional and a pleasure to deal with from making sure we had all requests, reservations, comforts, and even some extra surprises through out our stay taken care of and always with a smile. She also helped me coordinate a private birthday dinner that turned out amazing and the food was spectacular! So much so the wife had to have the soup again! If you can request her to be your butler you will not be disappointed! 

Victor, Cesar, and Valeria, at the Royal Service Restaurant " The Palapa" where fantastic and always made a point of making sure we were fed or had a drink in our hands and that all our needs were taken care of with the most positive and pleasant of demeanors! 

These are just a few of the amazing people that made our stay amazing, every staff member is there to make sure you experience nothing less than pure comfort during your stay, need something? ask, it will not be long before your request is met! The staff truly made the Trip for us and our group! The only staff that put us off was the photography group, it was fine to be asked if we wanted pictures but it got annoying when it would happen 2 to 3 times a day even after making an appointment and being asked time and time again by the same staff members not being able to remember or keep track of who's they already asked or booked. It just brought to the surface it was purely a money grab and not about the experience. 

The food overall is great, The Palapa was our favorite place for breakfast and lunch as it is menu based with higher end dishes daily but each restaurant has some truly tasty dishes. One opportunity for us on our visit was the lack of chicken options in all the restaurants except Blue Agave and Enso.

The Hotel itself is going through renovations in the true Royal Service pyramid (5) and sometimes the noice did make its way to the pool but nothing that I would say took away from the ability to relax and enjoy the day. The Royal Service Bali beds and the beach are amazing at the resort, many days enjoyed in theses locations on the trip! The rooms are nice and the cleaning staff does a good job, for us this could have been nicer and cleaner on a day to day basis but overall acceptable. 

The Royal Service Bar is a nice touch for premium drinks and snacks and a great place to chill if you get an ugly weather day and yet again the service is amazing there as well! 

We would easily stay here again but there is always room for improvement as such the last opportunities we noted versus other resorts we have enjoyed that I would leave as a comment to the hotel and future travelers 1- No lobby bar 2- no stage for shows (shows take place mainly in a bar that really only allows small amount of people to watch in comfort or with proper visibility ) 3- the golf course and how it's is run needs updating and attention. Rental clubs are way out dated and overpriced for what is available. More guest would use the course if better priced and attention was focused on getting guest involved which would in turn add to the overall experience of staying at this resort. 

Great stay, Amazing people, Very good food, and overall an awesome resort!

reviews.author: Deonesea
reviews.title: Amazing Entertainment!
reviews.text: Not only was the hotel gorgeous with wonderful restaurants and gracious staff, but the nightly entertainment was superb!  As a dancer myself, I had a great time enjoying and connecting with the entertainers.  I was impressed with their creativity, their choreographies and their costuming...they had their audiences enthralled.  And it was great fun dancing Salsa and Bachata with them by the pool during dance lessons.  Thank you Rodrigo, Chacho, Hugo, Fernando, Freddy and the ladies for a truly fun time!!

reviews.author: Katie H
reviews.title: Royal service with Cesar
reviews.text:
My husband and I recently visited Paradisus Cancun from October 27th to November 3rd for our anniversary and my husbands birthday. We had a great trip overall. With any resort there is always ups and downs but overall we had a great time. Any problems that we came across our amazing Butler Cesar and his manager Lazaro were always willing to help in any way possible! From booking a night out at Coco Bongo to all dinner reservations and transportation needs. They decorated our room with balloons and streamers for my husbands birthday along with a small cake and candles and rose petals for our anniversary. We stayed in Royal Service but pyramid 5 is currently being remodeled so we stayed in a one bedroom ocean view suite in pyramid 4 which was beautiful. Check in and check out was very simple. Blue Agave was our favorite place to eat, the tacos were to die for! Also in regards to the food, I have food allergies and I was given an allergy card to place on our table when ever we ate and every single restaurant accommodated me in any way they could which was so thoughtful! The royal serivce team also made sure that any spevial treats left in our room were free of the foods that i am allergic too so that I could enjoy them along with my husband. The royal service pool is very nice and peaceful. We did have a Bali bed every day of our stay which was set up by Daniel our pool concierge. We had very relaxing couples massage at YHI. Their locker rooms along with showers, steam room, sauna, and hydrotherapy pool were amazing. Probably one of the best I have ever been too! Also we were there during Dia de Los Muertos and Johnathan (a doorman) told us about different places to visit and about some great local food. He was so sweet and always greeted us with a warm smile and super friendly hello when ever we came in the front door!
There is only 3 things I was a little unhappy with. The first was a contracted company (Outdoor Photo Cancun) they have on property that offers photo sessions. We have used this company in the past at other resorts when we have visited Cancun but the employees we dealt with this time were extremely rude and called us thefts in the lobby in front of other guests! We immediately went to Royal Service and they took care of the problem but it was still very upsetting. Second, for the most part the room was clean but there were 2 days that a maid just folded dirty towels and hung them back up. Lastly, the wait staff at the Royal Service pool was just okay, at some points it took 30+ minutes to get a drink or bottle of water and it wasn't even very busy.
But like I said before overall it was a great experience and we have already talked about returning. I can't wait to see what they did while remodeling and to see Lazaro, Cesar, and Johnathan again!

reviews.author: Annie T
reviews.title: Only resort I'll book!
reviews.text:
We had an amazing time. First we love Gaude cio in restaurant Naos. It's the buffet. It was so nice to see him again!  
We didn't schedule any dinners. We enjoy the buffet for breakfast and dinner. Lunch we go to the taco place. Or eat by the pool.
I honestly don't have anything bad to say about the general services. 
We always had drinks in our hands. What ever we asked for, it was there!

Before I get into the not so good experience . I want to say... I love this hotel, and the services at the buffet, pool side and beach side, snack services are all amazing. The staff who cleans our rooms are awesome.
I would only book this hotel when I go to Cancun.

Also, if you are looking for an all adult please look else where. There were some adults there doing adults stuff that's not appropriate for family. 
Or at least wait till kids are not around to act the way you act on an all adult vacation. Everyone is there to have a great time. But there's no need for thongs and self playing music that is foul to little ones ears. The world doesn't revolve around you.  If that's the kind of fun you are looking for . Please look for an all adult resort.

Last time we got spoiled. When we arrived our rooms were ready .
This time we had to wait till 3pm which was fine. We hung out by the pool. Only thing was the concierge told us to return at 1230pm to check. Which were all fine . It's just the lines to wait to check... and 3pm there were another line to get our rooms.
If the concierge just told us 3pm , go change, and gave us a "room" number to get our towels. It would have been a more Pleasant checking in experience.  

The hotel has given us coupons to use at the store. ( I had left them in the room)
I asked the store , what coupon it was and I made it known to her I left my coupons upstairs. She said 10$ off 100$. So I picked out a few things. As I was trying to pay.
I was getting different answers from different workers.  
Some items weren't included. Some were.
Then one person said as long as you spend 100$ .  So I said ok I got 106$ can you take the 10$ off. She then asked me for a coupon... I said I don't have it with me. Long story short . The coupons itself said 20$ off 200$
 And I end up buying 60$ worth of what I really wanted. And they never gave me the 10$ off of the 100$ and I didn't want to buy more than 200$ . 

The spas were really pricey. So we didn't do any of those!
I wish they would lower the price a little. Make it a littler more affordable .

Also other than their time share. I wish they offer another loyalty program. 

All in all, I love this hotel . I can deal with the check in process. 
Thanks for reading!

reviews.author: mjbernatz
reviews.title: Not quite up to standard
reviews.text:
Okay, here is the good, the bad and the ugly...

First, the good. We chose the Family Concierge package and really liked it. Our concierge, Gloria, was amazing. When we were brought to our ocean view room from which the ocean could barely be seen, she immediately located another room us. Gloria made our restaurant reservations and each evening had a surprise snack waiting for us (wine, cheese, etc). The pool area was very nice, and I didn't see any difference between the main pool and the Royal Service pool area. All of the restaurants were very nice, and our room was cleaned and fridge restocked daily. Having the bus stop in front of the hotel was convenient for shopping trips into the city. The Yhi Spa was nice, really enjoyed the massage provided by Jenny. Finally, the fitness center had plenty of equipment and wasn't crowded. 

The bad. The buffet, Naos, was a disappointment. Some of the food was at room temperature and food quality and presentation reminded us of the buffet on National Lampoons Vegas Vacation. The nightly entertainment, held in the Avenue Bar, had inadequate seating and viewing so patrons were stepping in front of each other to get a glimpse of the shows. 

The ugly. When we arrived we immediately noticed a huge tent erected on the beach with dozens of tables and more than 200 chairs. This structure (see photo) took up more than 100 feet of the beach in front of the hotel, and remained there, unused, for the entire week. Many guests were complaining about it. It is inexcusable that hotel management would permit such an eyesore to remain on this wonderful stretch of beach. Shame on them. 

While we had a good time, we will not return.  If we vacation in Mexico again we will return to the Barcelo Maya Palace Deluxe where we visited last year.

reviews.author: garyrC2925VQ
reviews.title: Clean
reviews.text: Rooms are so clean you could sleep on the floor. Beds were so comfortable. Staff was awesome. The pool and bar side area are very clean and the staff outdoors are very attentive to our needs and desires.

reviews.author: 235shanitaj
reviews.title: 18th Birthday Family Trip
reviews.text:
This was our first stay at the hotel and it did not disappoint. I read a lot of reviews; some good and some not so good. Let me tell you: I was impressed! The service was phenomenal. The check in process was a breeze. We arrived around 9am. Check in time wasn't until 4pm but both of our rooms were ready upon arrival so we were able to comfortably get our vacation started right away. 

When you walk into the lobby, you are greeted by an awesome aroma. There were plenty of plants and it was very nicely decorated. I could also appreciate the fact that all of the restaurants are located in the same area so you always know where to find food.

When we reached our room, we were pleased. But, the outlets were a little quirky in that you must have the light on in order for the outlets to work, which meant that traveling with several phones and devices, you may end up sleeping with the lights on if you want a full charge for the morning. The beds were comfy enough and the bathroom was nice. I especially liked the raindrop showerhead. The temperature controls in the room worked well and we had a nice balcony of good size.

We stayed in tower 3.  The night club and lobby can get pretty loud in the evenings but we're noisy people so it didn't bother us too much. However, this may have been a concern if we were traveling with a baby or needed to get up early.

Room service was courteous, prompt, and included in our package. The food selection was pretty good. We've stayed a several resorts and I think the food here was best. There was always a wide selection and something to eat for everyone. The waitstaff was pleasant and always willing to go the extra mile. I was never more than 20 feet away from a shot of tequila so that made up for the mini bar in the room which consisted of beer, soda, water, and light snacks. 

There wasn't very much to do in the area of hotel but it was conveniently located about 20 minutes from the airport. We traveled for my daughter's 18th birthday.  This place was not too wild and we even felt comfortable allowing her to walk around the resort on her own. This is a very calm laid-back atmosphere. If you are looking to party, you could probably have a nice time at the club but might do better taking a trip to Coco Bongo for the night. 

Oh, the best part was the kids club! My 11 y/o son and 9 and 7 y/o neice and nephew never wanted to leave! And you must eat at the Market Grill!! We'll be back!

reviews.author: ROSA I R
reviews.title: Vacations in Cancun
reviews.text:
The service is excellent, the beach is clean the pool and facilities are very nice, excellent place for families, easy access to comercial area and excursions. 
Beds are excellent and clean. 
The restaurants are very good, Tempo is the best. 
The nights shows are excellent and the price is good in comparison with Cozumel

reviews.author: Discover677601
reviews.title: Vento restaurant
reviews.text: Having been to Cancun several times in the past few years, I have something to compare to. With that being said the hotel was mediocre. The rooms are very small and old. The mattresses were extremely dirty. However, the service was amazing. Everyone is super nice and friendly. But I have to say the best service and the best food was at Vento. The food could not have tasted better. So many flavors. Our waiter was Carlos. He was very prompt and very attentive. Great service by Carlos!! Wish we knew the food was this good would have visited more often.

reviews.author: Kris Klinsmann
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel, amazing beach!
reviews.text:
My misses and I spent 10 nights at this property celebrating our 1st wedding anniversary.
The hotel is very impressive and well maintained.
They have really good restaurants, perfect buffet with lot of options to choose from. We had a amazing room with a spot on ocean view! 
The only down side is that some of staff are rude don't seem to help a lot without tipping them, I am not a stingy person at all and was tipping when people really deserved. Also if you need to print boarding passes you have to pay at the convenience store don't expect reception to do it for you and pay $5 dollars deposit to have adaptor plug which should be redounded on departure wasn't!

Had a really good time whilst staying, but, nothing is perfect. Won't be staying again, I would definitely recommend it to a friend this resort!!! 
Thank you for the good time.

reviews.author: Jennifer R
reviews.title: Amazing place
reviews.text: Amazing.  No complaints.  Everyone works very hard at this resort. Royal service was great.  Loved the Royal service pool very relaxing.  Great service everywhere.  Great food.  No need to leave the resort.  Lovely room and view from ocean view room.  Great weather, too windy to swim in ocean but enjoyed laying on beach.  Plenty of chairs and umbrellas on beach.  Met many great people.  I would love to go back someday.

reviews.author: Murphy B
reviews.title: Excellent visit and Butler Service
reviews.text:
Thanking the hotel for a wonderful stay at this hotel. It was absolutely fabulous.
Thanking 
Susana for providing an extremely wonderful service, support and help.

The hotel is 15-20 mins from Cancun airport. The hotel has lots of entertainment and is close shopping centres, with a variety of food places to eat. Downtown centre is around 20 mins from the hotel, you can get their by bus or taxi.
By the way, the bus service is really good!!
Looking forward to returning.

reviews.author: Sandersonbree
reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: The resort is beautiful and with plenty do and eat. My best friend and I went there for her 50th bday and she couldn't stop smiling. The staff are wonderful and very accommodating. Now since more of our friends seen our pictures now they want to go with us to the Paradsius in Punta Cana.  Best Resort in Cancun great for girls trip, family and couples. Love, love it and the rooms are big, clean and fabulous!!

reviews.author: Juan F
reviews.title: Awsome entertainment!!!
reviews.text: We visited Paradisus Cancun on 11/6/15 -11/13/15. All I can say we had a blast. The vibe of the hotel is great. The music at the club was superb Artel the Dj at the club on some of the nights we were there is the reason why we had an amaizing time. The selection of music he chooses to play is great he creates a very upbeat vibe, and at the same time plays diverse music. I just cant wait to go back and hit the club.

reviews.author: 190michaelap
reviews.title: Paradisus is best service, a little city in itself
reviews.text: Take Royal Service if you can - they really treat you like a king/queen but with respect to themselves too - they are all in white and you feel like you are part of a little community. They all make you feel like they really appreciate you staying there. Just make sure you are as respectfull to them as they are to you, otherwise it will feel like you are abusing their generosity.

reviews.author: Steve L
reviews.title: Awesome Experience!
reviews.text: We just returned from the Paradisus Resort.  We stayed in the Royal Service section and were thrilled with our experience.  The service was awesome and the resort was more than we expected.  The resort is clean, the pools were sparkling everyday and the wait staff was the best we have ever had.  If you go to the Royal Service pool make sure you look up Moises Ochoa.  He will treat you like family and give you excellent service throughout your stay. We loved the cabanas at the royal service pool for lounging.   The food in all the restaurants was very good and the selection was varied.  Everything about this resort is 5 star!  We will be returning next year for another remarkable stay!   Also, look up Daniel at the pool.  He reserves the Cabanas and makes sure your pool needs are taken care of.

reviews.author: Joanne D
reviews.title: Royal service treated like queens!
reviews.text:
We loved our stay in this resort! The staff was amazing : thank you to Gerardo, Cesar, Rodrigo, Javier, Alejandro, Valeria, Guillermo,Octavio and all the pool and restaurant staff. They made our stay unforgettable with their professionalism and kindness. The restaurants were really good 
The whole place is clean and inviting. 
We strongly recommend you stay here, you'll have the time of your life!
All in all, great place, great staff, amazing food and unforgettable vacation!
We would go back anytime! 
Jocy and Joanna

reviews.author: TXAmanda
reviews.title: Great relaxing vacation, disappointed in Kids Club
reviews.text:
My husband,  4 year old son,  and myself stayed here for 5 nights Thanksgiving week.  We have previously stayed at Paradisus in Punta Cana and were looking to try a new location.  
We also like to visit Paradisus because of the great service we had at the kids club in Punta Cana.

Well, the kids club here is a joke!  They have a "baby club" for infants to four years old.   It was a room full of cribs and baby toys.  On the first day,  and subsequent days after,  there was no more than one kid in the baby room.  There were no scheduled activities for this room.   My son is very active, attends preschool and I found it an insult that he be in a room for babies. We questioned the staff and they seemed annoyed with our questions.  One male staff member was sitting on a bench reading a book. While this room had nothing going on,  all the action was in the room next door.   Our son saw that and wanted to go play in the kids club room. I voiced my concern for this and asked if he could go to the room next door, the kids club,  and was given the run-around from the staff.   "I have to ask my supervisor..."  Eventually I checked back and was told my son could attend the kids club if I was with him.  Ok, no problem,  at least he can do some activities and play with some kids.  On Wednesday of our trip, I escorted him to the kids club for wax art.  The supervisor told me that he is not allowed even if I was with him!   I was livid,  I went off!   I questioned her to what activities he is able to do??  She quickly escorted my son and I to the baby club and they let him make a visor.
The next day while at the pool the kids club staff walked through the kids pool area displaying a play doh scence he could make and telling us that it would be at 4:00 in the kids club.   We walked there and once again were turned away because he is 4.  Well, wth did you invite him????? 
Also, when we would walk by the kids club, the kids-especially boys, were running around,  throwing a ball against a wall, kids getting hurt (saw it with my own eyes when I escorted son), staff members not really leading any games.
I would rate the kids club as terrible!

Pool:
Very good service, rented a Bali bed,($50 a day) which is nice.  On our last day, there was a piece of feces floating in the kids pool, which is connected to the adult pool.  We told the staff and they said they "would take care of it"  We didn't see anything done.  And I know that whenever there is feces in the pool, it has to be shut down for 24 hours.  Kids and adults were still playing in the pool as we were leaving.
Pool rating is average bc of the feces situation.

Restaurants:
Breakfast buffet is average.
Bana is delicious.
Vento is delicious.
Mole is delicious.
Blue Agave is nasty.
Market Grill is delicious.
Service was great in all restaurants!
Restaurant rating is above average.

Family Concierge:
Loved the private check in and games, toys, and snacks available.  There were more activities here for our son than at the kids club.
Staff was very friendly and accommodating.
Our Butler was ok.  The service in Punta Cana was excellent and she did not live up to our expectations.

Room:
Ocean view was gorgeous!
We had the junior suite.  
Room was very clean and appointed.

We all enjoyed the Michael Jackson show!

We would choose Punta Cana any day over this resort.

reviews.author: Dragos S
reviews.title: beautiful
reviews.text: stayed here from 31st october to 7th november and had a really great time. the hotel is lovely, as well as the restaurants and all the staff. the food was great, plenty to choose from, as well as the drinks. the beach and the pools are superb with plenty of activities to keep you entertained. i would like to take this opportunity to thank reymundo, argenis and gerardo from the main pool bar, and the pool dj, and all other staff for their brilliant service. looking forward to see you guys again next year!

reviews.author: travelnut2009
reviews.title: Spring break hotel for grown ups.
reviews.text:
Baffled by all the glowing reviews as what is really a 2-3 star hotel.  
Pros:
Very nice staff
Good drink service at pools
Enjoyed pool Bali beds
Beach is pretty 
Cons
Hotel is obscenely huge.  Takes forever to get around.  Upon arrival they didn't have any beach or pool towels.  Ultimately told to get some from the room.
The breakfast buffet is packed with mediocre food and long lines for things like omelette service ( cheers to Samantha who always had a smile on her face but looked overwhelmed)
The entire hotel smells like perfume and is very dark and often slippery.
Sheets on two occasions were dirty.
The family concierge is a complete waste.  You need to make dinner reservations a day ahead. They don't do much for you.
Mole was the only restaurant we actually liked.
Rest food sub par.
Everyone had a least one post meal stomach problem.
Pool atmosphere is like spring break.  Drunken adults who are very loud and not age appropriate for things like playing football on the patio after tequila shots.
If you like blaring music and annoying poolside games shouted on a microphone then enjoy that.
Not for us and not something you'd typically see at a high end resort.
Weather pattern may have been problem but ocean was so rough we could only get in twice and we are used to Long Island beaches.
The pool is very cold  and very deep.
There are constant renovations under way.  Paint fell out of the sky at dinner one night and landed on my daughters head.
We have travelled to a lot of the great  resorts in Anguilla, st barths, Barbados, Antigua etc and this doesn't even compare
So if big resorts with rowdy atmosphere and nightclub blaring all night long are your thing you might enjoy ( bring earplugs)
Would in no way recommend this property.  Went to the beloved in playa mujeres last year .  Blew this place out of the water

reviews.author: me612015
reviews.title: Paradisus Hotel (Gran Melia)
reviews.text: Stayed here every year and was nervous when Gran Melia became Paradisus Cancun. It actually improved what was already a wonderful vacation spot. Very well managed.Restaurant  selection is excellent. Enjoyed Naos (buffet) & being seated by Pablo Puertus with a smile. Everything fresh & delicious. Staff exceptional too. Rooms Comfortable. Staff was polite and helpful. We received outstanding service from Ricardo, Daniel and Cezar in the pool area (Royal Service ). They never stopped moving, making sure everyone comfort was met. Some of their co-workers were lazy. We especially enjoy seeing Raul Lozano @ Pontero (check-in) everytime we arrive. He went way beyond to help us (years ago) in a pinch. A real asset to keeping customers coming back for approx. 20 years.They also have a large variety of entertainment, also great activities and area for children. My Grandchildren love it here. Atmosphere is family driven, and refreshing. Comfortable and Relaxed.

reviews.author: Dawn M
reviews.title: Loved it!!
reviews.text: Let me start off by saying I can not understand how anyone could give this resort a bad review?! We stayed (4 couples )the beginning of November and really loved it . We stayed in Royal service ocean view room and it was great with an amazing view! Pools were perfect and beach was so nice and yes there was some seaweed but we didn't let it bother us. Service all over the resort was spot on. Anything we wanted or needed was taken care of with a smile. Food was very good just wish they had an Italian restaurant. The only negative thing I would say is that the restaurants and soo hot that it's hard to enjoy your meals...really wish they could do something about that but the would be my only complaint. All 8 of us loved this resort and hope to return next year! Thanks to everyone at the Paradisus Resort for making our trip so wonderful! Also bring lots of dollar bills to tip... Believe me the staff work so hard and really deserve it!

reviews.author: Dennis G
reviews.title: vacation
reviews.text: Hotel was beautiful. Suprised us with rose petals on the bed and champagne on ice with fruit when we got there. Hotel room was immaculate. Beds and room was clean every afternoon and sheets were turned down at night with chocolates on our pillows. Employees always working,cleaning, and waiting on you hand and foot. I will come back to this hotel every time.  Food at every restaurant was 5 star cuisine with 5 + star service.  Vento was great and service staff (Leobardo, katia, and jose) was amazing and professional. We dined at Bana for the sushi and service(Darwin) 3 Times. Bar service was outstanding everywhere and my cup was never empty. An outside pool server even remember me and my mango margaritas The next two days and just brought it to me without asking. Such a great touch and it really says something about these employees. The most fun I've had in Cancun. Cannot wait to go back and stay with the fine folks at Paradisus Cancun

reviews.author: ColoHiwayBuilder
reviews.title: Another Awesome Stay at the Paradisus Cancun!!!!
reviews.text:
We have had another great week in the Royal Service section of the Paradisus. Although the resort is starting to show her age, in many areas, the amazing staff go above and beyond to make your stay enjoyable. Our butler was Cesar, who did a great job of making our dinner reservations and keeping everything in order for our family while we were here for a Thanksgiving get away. This is the second time that we had Cesar as a butler and he was fabulous both times that we have visited.

If you want to have AMAZING service at the Royal Service pool, find Moises, as he goes out of his way to make sure you are taken care of. The pool concierges Javier and Daniel are also awesome, and made sure we always had a great Bali Bed for our lazy days by the pool.

We ate at most of the restaurants during our stay, but he overwhelming favorite of our group was the Market Grill, which is the Brazilian rodizio type grill. We did not really care for Mole, as the quality of the food was not "up to par" with the other restaurants. Vento and Bana were both very good restaurants as well, and the quality of the sushi at Bana was very good.
