I would not hesitate to recommend the Royal Service section of the Paradisus, as we have throughly enjoyed our stay here both times that we have stayed here.

reviews.author: slgsm
reviews.title: Horrible!!
reviews.text:
We are currently staying at the Paradisus Cancun and from the moment we got here it's been a horrible experience! Our first room had a horrible toxic smell that would not dissipate even with opening the patio doors. Not until the THIRD time we went to the front desk did they move us to another room. Our first room was very nice, a true suite with a bedroom, separate living room and two bathrooms. It also included robes and other nice amenities. We paid for a Jr. Suite with a king bed so we thought this was the suite. Knowing we could not sleep in a room with such a toxic smell, we didn't question the room we were moved to. We were so tired and just wanted to sleep. Upon arriving in the new room it was a definite down grade! It was a single standard room with two very small  double beds that were actually like an oversized twin bed. It was also near the main lobby and extremely noisy! Even with the air running I had to put in ear plugs to minimize the noise in order to sleep. I was also freezing because I had to keep the air on to help minimize the noise coming from the hallway. And of course there was no extra blanket in the room. Nor did it have the robes or other extras that the other room had or as nice of furnishings. The next day we spoke to a supervisor and they once again moved us to another room. This room is still a standard room in the club melia part of the resort. Again, extremely disappointing!! Oh, they did upgrade us from a lagoon view to an ocean view, which we appreciate, but still not nearly as spacious and as nice as the first room which apparently isn't the Jr suite, but a one bedroom suite. We only got that because it was a fluke upgrade due to availability. The standard hotel room they call a Jr suite which isn't a suite at all! Just an extremely basic room with a tiny bathroom. If the room we are in now is the standard club melia room I'm glad we're not members as it sucks!! Old and tired room! Nothing nice about it at all except for the ocean view.And to top it off when I went to take a shower the water was cold and wouldn't get hot! Also, we can't get internet access in our room! We have to sit on the balcony to connect to the Wifi. 
The other huge negative is you have to make reservations to eat dinner at most of the hotel restaurants. We arrived yesterday at 6:30ish pm. The were all booked for the evening. And when we tried to book a reservation for tonight, again, they were all booked!! So, what, you have to wake up at 7:00 am the day before to make reservations for the next night?!?! And people like us who arrive in the evening are then screwed for two nights of dinner in a restaurant other than the buffet. Horrible, horrible way to run a hotel!!! The other issue we encountered was not enough pool chairs, all were full when we arrived at the pool. And NO pool towels!! Then the two we did get were full of nasty stains including obvious blood stains. YUCK!!! I really didn't know if they had even been washed or just refolded from earlier that day! We've stayed in other cancun all inclusives and never encountered an issue like this! Needless to say, we find this hotel extremely disappointing and would never come here again and wouldn't recommend it to anyone else!

reviews.author: janej85
reviews.title: Stay here!!
reviews.text: We loved it here.  The location was perfect, just a short bus or taxi ride away from the busy areas in Cancun.  Beautiful lagoon and sea views.  The staff were extraordinary - so friendly and helpful, especially Cesare in Naos restaurant, Guadalupe, the reception manager, Sergio the royal service butler.  Plenty of excellent restaurants to eat in with a very high standard of food.  Lots of different bar areas to drink in too and live entertainment every evening (singers and dancers).  The hotel was not at full capacity when we were there, so I don't know how it would operate under greater pressure.  We organised a couple of excursions with Victor from Amstar who was based in the hotel.  He is a great guy and was really patient with us whilst we decided what we wanted to do.  The only thing I would be careful of is when you arrive at the airport.  We had pre-arranged our hotel transfer but as we walked out of arrivals, there was a virtual army of beige-uniformed staff within the airport.  They actually told us it was their job to help us find our transfer team.  This was not true and they were like time share people.  When we realised and made to leave their area, their sales tactics became quite aggressive - avoid them at all costs.  It's also worth mentioning that the bus, which stops right by the hotel, is extremely cheap and safe.

reviews.author: IFirenze
reviews.title: Couple's Dream Vacation
reviews.text: This was the most amazing vacation my boyfriend and I have ever been on. The Paradisus Cancun was recommended by my niece and we couldn't have picked a better place to stay. The entire staff from the front desk, waiters, maintenance to our Butler Guillermo were outstanding in every way. We stayed in the "Royal Service" all-inclusive pyramid and I highly recommend it if you want an adult only experience. Private pool and beach area without kids was nice since that's why we got away in the first place. The handful of restaurants were amazing and the entertainment in all areas of the resort were an unexpected treat. We had our own lounge right outside our room where there was service of drinks and food all day long. You will not go hungry for sure, but your clothes may be a little tight on the way home. Our favorite restaurant was "Market Grill" with the staff of Karla, Efrain, Manuel, Uriel and Alejanadro giving exceptional service. At poolside everyday we had our Bali Bed where the staff of "La Palapa" tripped over each other to see who could help us first. Our favorites were Victor, Jorge, Gustavo, Josue, Oscar and Raphael. They all were just amazing!! Can't name them all, wish I could there's just not enough space to write every name. We will definitely be vacationing there again! There's no way we would pick another place to stay. And we would ask to have our Butler Guillermo again if possible. He went out of his way to make sure we were happy everyday to just checking in with us at poolside to making our dinner reservations every night. If I could give this resort 10 stars I would, don't go anywhere else. ~ I. Firenze

reviews.author: giuseppe
reviews.title: great
reviews.text:
Few months ego we stayed at the ME-CANCUN, last week we tried the PARADISUS-CANCUN,  two great experiences. Both places look great, the staff is wonderfull, very polite and attentive, on the food, We mostly used the buffet, with a little kid is more praticle.
We can wait for next time to try Paradisus in Playa del Carmen.
thank You :)

reviews.author: Stela T
reviews.title: Amazing place. I highly recommend it.
reviews.text:
Amazing place. I highly recommend it.
The place is very clean and the service is great .I found this resort very comfort for my family. Staff is friendly and helpful everywhere and anytime.
Definitively will go there again.

reviews.author: J9871OZdanielw
reviews.title: Best Hotel Ever
reviews.text: I cannot give this hotel more praises. The "royal" staff, entertainment and "continental" breakfast were beyond our expectations. The staff was just amazing, never expecting a tip, but appreciative always. Constantly waiting people on the beach, which I considered quite a walk for a drink, to which a waiter said to me, "I love my job!" The "continental" breakfast was above and beyond, with so many different fruits and changes in egg style and potatoes or plantains just to name a few. The breakfast waiters were always happy to bring you fresh mimosas or coffee or whatever you can possibly need! The same went for all of the staff in the Royal section at all times of the night that they were open. Our butler, Gerardo, left us surprises when he was on at night, made reservations for dinner for us every night and was extremely accommodating! At one point I had a ring stuck on my finger very late at night and I had 4 staff members in my room trying to help me remove it. That is the the amount of effort they put into their guests. It was the perfect vacation and I would recommend it to everyone, we were sad to leave. Oh not to mention the Royal only entertainment and cigar rolling were also above and beyond. Our last day had live violin performance was amazing, as were the nights before. Everything smells wonderful and friendliness is out of this world!

reviews.author: Sand man
reviews.title: Great holiday
reviews.text:
The Paradisus is a great hotel to take a holiday.
The beach is amazing with on hand staff caring to all your needs .
My favourite was Laura she was great fun and very friendly she went way beyond helpful ! My little friend she called me .
Big hi to Laura if the Paradisus read this !
Also the food was very good and we had a waiter named Kauil in the Naos restaurant he looked after us throughout our stay .
Again please pass on our thanks to a very special man he made us feel very looked after also a it was a fun time being around him !
All of the bar staff went above and beyond helpful Reymundo was just so good !
My son made a life friend with Hugo Sosa another favourite with our family stay .   
The pool swim up bar was great fun with a great pool side entertainment team.
A small grumble ! The evening entertainment in the Avenue bar !
Entertainment was good but the bar is badly laid out so that unless you stand in the walkway outside you just cant watch any shows . 
We had two rooms 3340/3341 that were kept immaculately clean .again please thank your staff .
We did give tips to the staff that we met on a regular basis but felt there was never any need or that they expected anything .
We only ventured out for one day over our two week break, we took a day snorkelling with Ocean Tours amazing day out worth every penny.
Overall very happy we chose the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Brooke V
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: This hotel is extremely beautiful with great views from literally every room! Erik at Ibana restaurant within the resort was very helpful! We attended some other restaurants as well, but none of the staff were anywhere near as helpful as Erik!

reviews.author: Bruce N
reviews.title: How much can you drink
reviews.text: First all inclusive trip. Loved the Royal Service at pool and beach, especially the Bali Beds. Our Lagoon view room was a few of the main road and McDonalds. There was water somewhere behind that. We wanted to have a quiet vacation and booked last minute. The Royal Service and no kids actually was perfect. All Inclusive was not a good value for us. How much can you drink?  Also if staying more than four nights you may tire of the restaurants in the hotel. Most of the food included in the inclusive had limited selections and wasn't great. We ended up going off property for dinner last three nights. Finally if you are traveling w dollars make sure you bring small bills, we had trouble getting change for $20s. Gratuities are appreciated by the staff

reviews.author: Jana D
reviews.title: I'll Be Back!
reviews.text:
Two friends and I visited Paradisus Cancun from November 19 to 23, 2015, for a 40th birthday getaway. I've stayed at two other all-inclusive resorts in the area (from Cancun to Riviera Maya), and Paradisus Cancun was by far the best. 

When you enter for check-in, you notice a wonderful scent in the air. It smells like a spa, or just fresh air, and it's lovely. I'm sensitive to strong scents and this was nothing close to offensive. From the moment we arrived until the moment we left, the service was top notch. My experience has been that the folks working these resorts have fantastic customer service skills and are very friendly, but somehow the service here was just a step above. 

Our favorite staff person was Asuncion, a waitress at the beach bar. She has worked there for 23 years and was so hard working and very, very sweet and kind. She brought buckets of cold water (refilling with ice as needed) throughout the day, and we could hardly finish one drink before she was offering us our next. We did tip her two days ($10-15 each day because she was so lovely). The last day was the birthday for my friend, and Asuncion brought her a cake. We asked her to widen our drink repertoire, she asked if we like sweet or sour, asked if we like vodka, and brought us delicious special drink after special drink. Then the shots started coming. The drinks are the strongest I've experienced at an all-inclusive resort. They were very good, and I got buzzed but never sick. We stayed on the beach each day, and at least during our stay, Asuncion worked the section of beach on the north end of the resort, down the stairs outside the circle shaped restaurant next to the beach grill, to the right of the beach volleyball ball net as you look toward the Gulf.

We loved the nachos and chicken wings at the beach side snack place. That salsa was the best I've ever tasted. All the food was top notch. Service was great. No complaints with the food. Making reservations was simple.  A number to call each morning to make reservations for the following day's dinner is provided at check-in. Our first day there, we made dinner reservations for that night and the next; one for 7:00 and one for 7:30. There was a mixup the second night. We arrived to dinner at 7:35 and were told our reservation had been for 7:00 and we missed that, but after a 20 minute wait at a bar around the corner, we were seated for dinner. There was a bit of a language barrier but our hostess under promised and over delivered regarding our wait time. All was well. I had the seared vegetable skewers at the Mexican restaurant, and they were amazing, and the rice served with them was the best white rice I've ever had. The breakfast buffet is the largest I've seen, and everything is delicious. We only ate the lunch buffet one day since we enjoyed the snacks at the grill by the pool for nachos, guacamole, hot dogs, burgers, wings, etc. each day after a filling breakfast.

Our room was clean. We did have to ask for additional washcloths each day. They seemed to run low on those. There weren't many visible outlets in the room, so two of us charged our phones at night in the bathroom. The balconies are of generous size. Ours overlooked the lagoon. Beachside would have been better but we had a budget and opted for lagoon. At least we had water to see. There was a highway in view before the lagoon started. Still, no complaints.

We used the Expedia travel agent to book parasailing. He was very friendly, kind, and accommodating. I'd book all excursions through him since he knows which are safest. We didn't get to parasail because we planned to do so on our last day, we'd heard from what ended up being an unreliable source that 3:00 was the best time to go, and by then there was a storm coming so they couldn't take us up. Getting a refund from the travel agent was simple. If you parasail, don't wait until late afternoon on your last day, just to be safe!

The beach is deep (from shore to concrete at the resort) and beautiful with soft white sand, big waves, and gorgeous aqua green water. There were plenty cabana beds and lounge chairs under palapas at the beach and the huge, lovely pool. The pool water temperature was perfect. Our first afternoon, a father and his adult daughter drifted a bit too far in the Gulf, and out of nowhere a lifeguard showed up at the shore line, keeping a close eye on the situation, whistling to let them know that they needed to move inland and they were in danger. Once the daughter signaled that they needed help, the lifeguard swam to them with a life preserver, and three more lifeguards appeared on wave runners, as well as one more on the shore. The father was safely and heroically rescued. It was a team effort and I was glad to know they had an eye on the situation. I didn't drift too far out after that. I just let the waves his me when it was about waist deep. They father and daughter were trying to get back to shore but just couldn't make any headway with the current and waves.

This resort was the least "open air" that I've stayed in Mexico, but it's my favorite. Inside, philodendron plants vine down from each floor creating a wall of green leaves. There are glass walls in the restaurants at the perimeter so you can be in air conditioning with breathtaking views. The center of the pyramid (the most inner part of the first floor) includes fountains, fish, wooden walkways, gorgeous restaurants, many seating areas, and green plants that reminded me of a scaled down Opryland Hotel. Gorgeous! 

We booked this vacation in late August and needed a resort near the airport to maximize our beach time, that wasn't couples only but also not geared heavily to kids. It may have been the time of year, but we lucked out. There were families and couples and kids, all whom were kept entertained, but it was quiet and no obnoxious loud music at the pool. There was music but it didn't overpower everything out of that vicinity. There were nightclubs in the resort that looked fun but we didn't check them out.

Once we settled on Paradisus Cancun for our destination accommodations, we booked airfare and resort via Travelocity. We then added the airport transfer. We used Super Shuttle and we're pleased. Note, however, that Paradisus is pronounced Para Dee Sis (not Para Die Sis), as our initial pronunciation caused much confusion with two transfer services.

We were asked at check-in if we wanted a room on a low floor or high. We chose high and were very pleased with the views a high room offered. Elevators were convenient and quick. There are eight floors of rooms, and we were on the 7th.

There are a lot of concrete stairs around the pool and beach so this may not be the best place for someone to visit if they have some trouble with stairs. They do have ramps but the stairs are more convenient.

I was shocked to learn that the resort is 25 years old, because it's been very well renovated and kept clean and beautiful. The price is right for a place so nice. I can't wait to return!

reviews.author: Alexandra & Oscar Suarez
reviews.title: Great Customer Service
reviews.text:
We had an amazing family reunion vacation at Paradisus.  The property and setting were absolutely beautiful but the staff definitely made the experience complete and over the top. 
We are looking forward to returning next year and making this our spot for our family reunion!

reviews.author: bbecton30
reviews.title: BEST TIME EVER!
reviews.text: This property is AMAZING! My reservations were for the Royal Service area of the resort and I must say the staff there treated us like royalty. Ricardo from the Palapa restaurant is the BEST! I loved it

reviews.author: MsAshley92
reviews.title: Amazing everything!
reviews.text: Beautiful resort with amazing amenities. The service is the best! I love coming here. The food is very good also. My two favorite people during our stay in February were Tabatha who managed the Bali Beds and William at the pool bar. the rooms are beautiful also and there are three levels you can choose from, each with its own perks. With eight restaurants and a night club you can't go wrong. I love this resort!

reviews.author: Robyn819
reviews.title: Grand Pyramid
reviews.text: This place is huge and could easily do my 10,000 steps each day! All-inclusive is my kind of vacation, no cooking and enjoying new tastes and flavours .... Specialty restaurants did not disappoint. Hotel premises are exceptionally clean and service 1st class. I appreciated the poolside staff asking guests to keep food and drink out of the pool. Lots of activities throughout day to work off the dining experiences and plenty of entertainment options in the evening .... The violinist from Cuba was the best!

reviews.author: frank r
reviews.title: Unfulfilled expectations
reviews.text: The food although better, staples lack authentic taste. Often overbooked main restaurant which has problems seating people and host has no clue to handle large crowds. Other restaurants require prior reservation which leaves you lacking choices. Daniel the host was rude when asked if I could take a table.

reviews.author: Krystal D
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text: Beautiful hotel, we had an ocean front view. All the employees there were extremely nice and fun. The restaurants in the resort had great food, our personal favorite was Fuego. We really had no reason to leave the resort, there was a live show every night at the one of bars/clubs.

reviews.author: Patti S
reviews.title: Catherines President Club
reviews.text: I wanted to take a moment to compliment the amazing service that Ernesto and Oscar provided.  They both worked at the Royal Service Pool bar.  They certainly went above and beyond for all of their guests and always had a smile on their face when doing so.  Both of them could work for me - love the 'can do' attitude and exceptional service.

reviews.author: John M
reviews.title: 2nd time around even better!!!
reviews.text:
What a wonderful resort, love the hospitality and responsiveness of the staff.  Had two issues with the room, could not get TV to work, maintenance was there in 15 minutes and resolved the issue, coffee pot went out that was resolved while we were on the beach, but room service showed up and provided us with a complimentary pot of coffee before we left the room.

This is a great place to stay, second time I have taken the family, six of us, to this resort, the addition of the Bana restaurant (Sushi) was a real treat.  This was under construction during our last visit.

Pool and beach staff go out of there way to take care of you, our beach waitress, Asuncion, did an excellent job of making sure we were properly hydrated.  After day two she knew exactly what we liked to drink and when she saw we were in our spot at the beach, would not even come and take our order, just rushed our drinks down to us, that was a very cool surprise and was much appreciated.

We travel to Cabo almost every year, and use the Cancun trip to just sit back and relax, not as busy as Cabo, not the big party atmosphere as Cabo, just an awesome place to sit back, relax and enjoy all its beauty.

Good job Paradisus, we will see you again in a couple of years!!!!

reviews.author: Debbie G
reviews.title: Recent stay at Paradisus
reviews.text:
This hotel was very nice but it is showing its age.  There were a lot leakage problems, water pouring through the ceiling in buffet seating area.  Towels always on the floors in the hallways to the rooms.  The hallways were VERY dark so it was hard to see the water on the floors.  The smell of the incense burning to hide the smell from all of the plants was very overwhelming and actually sickening.  

The wait staff is extraordinary.  Extra thanks goes out to Antonio in the buffet.  We asked for him every day for breakfast and sometimes lunch.  He went above and beyond to meets our needs before we even asked.  Also, kudos to Gerardo at the swim up bar.  He was lots of fun and knew how to make lots of fun, different and good drinks.

reviews.author: kmas724rx
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort with Excellent Service
reviews.text:
Spend the extra money for Royal Service. You will not be disappointed! We arrived and were given champaign, cold water, and cool towels to cool off and were whisked away to the Royal Service area (pyramid 5). Check in was quick and our personal butler, Fernando escorted us to our rooms and our bags arrived within minutes. 

All the restaurants were delicious and seemed to have options for everyone. We went to a different one each night. We opted out of Tempo because we decided not to pay for a meal when the others were included. Bana (sushi/Japanese) was delicious, and Vento (Mediterranean tapas) were our favorites. We also loved Blue Agava, the one restaurant other than the buffet that didn't require reservations. 

Being Royal Service, included you get two days of Bali beds at the pool, but we ended up getting a Bali bed for four days... And it is worth it. A server is almost always within arms reach the entire day, bringing you drinks and food from the pool bar and grill. We enjoyed our servers Eddie, Ricardo, and Guadalupe.

The beach is beautiful and very large. There are many recliner chairs at the beach and cabanas as well. If you decide to not get Royal service, the pool chairs seem to fill up quick at the other pool for non Royal service guests... But that is where the swim up bar is and all the activities (also a fun, lively area!)

The lobby's are like huge green houses so it does stay humid, especially at night... But the air conditioners in our room were great and kept us cool.

Overall, I would recommend this resort to anyone! It was great and my boyfriend and I enjoyed ourselves.

reviews.author: diane p
reviews.title: Great Place in Cancun - not much entertainment
reviews.text: I enjoyed my stay here, but compared to other Paradisus resorts, there wasn't much entertainment.  Each night there is a dance show, but that is about it.  There are a few other things to do entertainment wise, but not a whole lot if you like to keep busy with that sort of thing.

reviews.author: Emma J
reviews.title: Best holiday yet ignore all bad reviews
reviews.text:
Please IGNORE all bad reviews. We travelled back today after 11 nights at this resort and we cannot fault a thing. I went with my partner to celebrate my 30th birthday, as soon as we arrived we were stunned, the entrance is beautiful with vines hanging and the most amazing scent coming from diffusers as you walk in. Yes the reception is dark as pointed out in another review but it is certainly not to dark to see paper work, its a very relaxed feel.  As soon as we arrived we were given an upgrade to an ocean view room, balloons, streamers and a cake were in the room for me which was a lovely touch. View was breath taking, the sun rose right in front of our balcony. We had balcony furniture, a couple we met did not so some rooms do appear not to have furniture for the balcony. The room was modern and spacious and beds are very comfortable, maids visited everyday. We did notice a couple of towels on the floor but this is not enough to leave a bad review, its a towel at the end of the day! I have literally no idea why anyone would complain about the food, its amazing and soooo much to choose from. We visited the buffet every morning for breakfast where you have choice of fresh fruit, yoghurts, waffles, pancakes, omelettes which are made fresh in front of you, you name it they have it. We also visited this for dinner a couple of times which was also great. The best restaurant is The Market Grill, we ate there 4 times, this is a must to visit. The Mexican tapas restaurant is also brilliant. All the staff are amazing, so friendly and cant do enough for you. The grill round the pool is great for chips, chicken, and nachos whixh were delicious.
Pool is great, really big and the pool bar has really friendly staff, the entertainment round the pool is also for all ages and great to watch. 
The beach is gorgeous and as the hotel is quite long this means the beach is a good size, you do get people walking past selling stuff but they don't badger you, if you say no or ignore them they walk on by. 
The entertainment in the evening is really good and takes place in the bar on the 1st floor. 
I cannot stress enough that if you are interested in this hotel then please please ignore the bad reviews.

reviews.author: Sarah A
reviews.title: Avoid, No Customer Service
reviews.text:
Our honeymoon started out great - our flight got in early, we had a VIP taxi service waiting with beverages, the rain had just passed - and that all came to an abrupt end as soon as we tried to check in an the Paradisus. We had booked and paid in full through BookIt.com (who, by the way, Paradisus is STILL advertising their rooms through) back in February and I had confirmation of this along with an email BookIt.com sent me the day before we left for our trip. Paradisus was obviously expecting us - had all of our information, a room for us, and for the correct dates. However, they then informed us that they never received payment from BookIt and it would be OUR responsibility to then contact them after arriving in a foreign country, This was the first we were hearing of any of this, why they had not tried to contact us at least the day before is beyond me. What is even more ridiculous is that they forced us, they're guests, to contact one of THEIR vendors to receive payment. After two very stressful hours (and a lot of tears) somehow the payment magically went through. We received NO APOLOGY and nothing to compensate us for our troubles. From this experience alone, I would never return nor would I recommend anyone else waste their time at this mediocre hotel. The customer service is nonexistent.

The rest of our week here was just okay. The lunch options are poor and the food at dinner is so buttery and salty and overall inconsistent. Everything is falling apart, especially the furniture. The bars are randomly closed during the day or have an early last call at night. The pool is pretty much one depth - 5 ft. Not ideal for hanging out and relaxing in all day. The atrium (where all the bars and restaurants are) is large and beautiful, but so unbelievably hot even at night. I can only imagine what it's like in the summer months. 

The best part about the hotel was the staff working at the bars and by the pool. They truly want you to have a good time and it seems like they have fun doing it. We tipped  everywhere we went to show our appreciation, but I have seen them give great service regardless. 

This was my fourth all inclusive I've been to around Cancun/Riviera Maya and I would definitely recommend you don't waste your time or money at Paradisus.

reviews.author: South_ATL_Sunlovers
reviews.title: Great place, but issues with front desk service and condensation everywhere!
reviews.text:
I don't want to be too negative about a great time, so let me start by saying we just got back, had a great time, and the positives outweigh the negatives by a lot. Beach: great. Pools: gorgeous. Food: Very good. Spa: great. Would we go back? You bet. But two caveats.

 First, the check-in experience. It's so dark in the check-in area that you can't read what they're asking you to sign. And you might want to read it, because their form says you consent to getting eternal spam from them and any associated company. There are two tiny little boxes to check opting out of this, but you can't see any of this unless your eyes are a lot better than our aging peepers.

That's not the only problem we had with check-in. We were promised resort credits, but had to go back and ask for them. Our room wasn't ready when promised. And the room we were given was just shockingly bad. The resort website featured a beautiful photo of the "junior ocean view suite," inviting us to "take in the all the luxury and elegance that is waiting for you" including a lovely seating area, art on the walls, posh furnishings, and a planter with lush shrubbery on the balcony. When we arrived in "Suite" 1501, however, we found that all the seating area furniture was missing, as was all the art -- there wasn't even a mirror on the wall. Much of the furniture was broken and shabby -- we were apparently assigned the suite they'd cannibalized to keep all the other suites up. Oh, and the balcony planter feature foot-high grass and weeds, one live shrub and two dead ones. Our first "suite" had all the "luxury and elegance" of an interstate roadside motel.

The darkness of the check-in area made a great place to compare the website photo (on my laptop) with the photos we took in the room (on my phone). Result: we got the room we should have gotten the first time. But there's really no excuse for them giving anyone that first room (Room 1501) except maybe some passing monk who's taken vows of poverty.

Second caveat -- the condensation. The building contains lush vegetation throughout, meaning that the lobby and corridors are kept warm and humid. Result: we saw no place anywhere in the building where there weren't towels on the floor to collect the drips. In corridors. In our room. In the restaurants. Everywhere. 

Again, most aspects of our visit were very good, and we hated to leave. The grounds were beautiful, the staff very pleasant, and once our room was corrected we felt good about the deal we got. Just be aware of these issues if you go.

reviews.author: PuertoVallarta-1
reviews.title: Saved our vacation!
reviews.text: My wife and I had booked a trip to Puerto Vallarta  to celebrate our sons 40th birthday.  We were to leave on Oct.23, the day hurricane Patricia hit the west coast of Mexico, ( my wife's name is Patricia).  After many hours on the phone, we were able to get a reservation at Paradisus in Cancun.  We lost 2 days of our vacation, but we still got to spend 13 days  at the Paradisus.  What a stroke of luck for us, far and away the best stay we have ever had in Mexico.  I cannot say enough good things about this place, the food, staff, service, and grounds were simply GREAT!  The buffet food exceeds many resturants.    Always a very good selection of everything.  Two nights there was a seafood buffet, prawns, scallops, lobster, and octopus.  Our waiter had them grill lobster for us how we liked it.  Every night was so good.  Our room was spacious, clean and nice.  If we needed anything it was brought to our room promptly with a smile.  The hotel has the fragrance of a spa at all times.  All staff were helpful and courteous always.  The pool is large and the waiters and bartenders went above and beyond to keep us happy.  The beach is big, clean, with lots of palapas and beds, we never had a problem getting a place.  Our last day it started to rain about 10:30 in the morning, by the time we got to Avenue Bar, all of the pool staff were there serving drinks.  Then they started to play games and totally entertained us all day.  A BIG THANK YOU to everyone!  We will be back next summer.  The free wifi was a nice plus.

reviews.author: Kristyw96
reviews.title: Outstanding service and stay
reviews.text: This was our first time visiting cancun and our stay at paradisus resort was amazing! We got the royal service package,very beautiful hotel and relaxing environment! I want to give extra recognition to our butler sergio for outstanding service and making sure we were comfortable and had everything we needed! Also edier, at the royal service pool who always had a smile and very friendly attitude,he always promptly brought out our drinks and food and came by to check on us very often! All staff we encountered or just even passing said hello and were very friendly. We had a wonderful vacation and will defitnetly stay with paradisus on our next trip back to cancun!

reviews.author: Deidra J
reviews.title: Short But Sweet
reviews.text: Great service at this resort. Whenever an issue arised it was tended to by staff immediately. Huge property. I stayed in the junior suite which included a hot tub on the balcony along with two lounge chairs. Several restaurants to choose from. Please make sure you make reservations for dinner. I recommend Market Grill for Lunch & the steakhouse dinner.  Market Grill has an amazing view of the beach & pool.

reviews.author: Myro M
reviews.title: Generosity at the beach
reviews.text:
A place where friendliness and generosity abound - this applies to the staff and the food. There is even a complimentary mini bar in the room for all inclusive,  which includes snacks and offers 24 hour room service .
The facility is very clean and has several large swimming pools .

reviews.author: Grace M
reviews.title: Wind Tunnel
reviews.text:
Overall stay was very pleasant, our only disappointment was our room was very noisy with the wind coming through the sliding doors, it seemed as the seal on the door was missing.
The noise was very loud and made it uncomfortable.

reviews.author: Julia Y
reviews.title: Short but great trip!
reviews.text:
We actually traveled to their sister property in Riviera Maya but were offered to stay at this hotel for few days and we gladly accepted because the beach at the Riviera Maya - well - it is basically non-existent.  So we knew we were getting an older hotel but we were hoping to enjoy the beach.  

So this review is comparing the two hotels, Paradisus Cancun and Paradisus Riviera Maya.  

Pros:  Food, Daily Activities, Entertainment
Cons: Rooms

The food at the buffet for breakfast and lunch was just great.  A LOT of variety.  The buffet is huge.  During one of the breakfasts, they ran out of tater tots, so I asked someone to bring it, one person came out and told me they ran out and the chef who happened to be out of the kitchen overheard, came up to me and told me he will try to get a little more.  Turns out they didn't have enough to fill the container to put it out but he gave me a plate-full :)  Great service!  Food is also very delicious.  During lunch, the variety and amount of seafood is incredible.  We have traveled to all-inclusive a lot and this was the best food we had.  
My favorite restaurant was Mole but we only tried - Mole, Vento and Bana. 

Room service was also quick.  We had an issue with the mold in our rooms and then a safe, both times, someone was at the door within minutes.  

Yes, rooms are old and moldy.  They are outdated but still spacious.  The balconies are big but no jacuzzi there.  But there are workers constantly working to restore the hotel.  Riviera Maya hotel is newer with more spacious and modern rooms.

Entertainment during the day and shows were fun.  There is always music by the activity pool.  Announcements made when activities start gathering people and there is an activity schedule board (this was lacking in Riviera Maya).  

Beach:  The beach was definitely better than in the Riviera Maya.  Clean water, no seaweed, no rocks.  But those waves made it hard to swim.  A lot of palapas by the beach so no need to run out and reserve.  Service by the beach and the pool is great with drinks but No straws rule in effect.  

Overall, this hotel is great but I doubt we will be back to it as a family.  Given that it is in Cancun, I got the vibe that it was more for adults.  I didn't see many kids there, there was a Kids' Club so perhaps they were all hanging out there.  Also, we are beach bums so I am still searching for place with a great beach.

reviews.author: lisarx2
reviews.title: Awesome service!!
reviews.text:
Our 12 day stay at Paradisus was great. Service is awesome!! Here are some staff members that went the extra mile:

Kauil at the buffet Naos
Rodrigo royal service pool concierge
Moises royal service pool server
Eddie royal service pool server
Javier Salazar server at Mole
Ricardo royal service pool server
Victor royal service pool server
Edier royal service pool server

Thank you all!!

reviews.author: Melanie U
reviews.title: BEST all inclusive and by far the BEST service ever experienced
reviews.text:
My fiance and I have visited this all inclusive resort twice and we absolutely love it. The resort is beautiful, the beach is amazing, and the pool/swim up bar is so much fun. The service is amazing. You can't beat the service here. I cannot say it enough. This resort is perfect for everyone. The food is amazing, plenty of restaurant options, and all of the drinks are top shelf. My best friend had her wedding here last year and we enjoyed it so much we came back again this year. Next to the Ritz it is by far the nicest resort in Cancun, not to mention much more cost efficient. 

There are three employees at this resort that I have to mention because they go above and beyond in order to make the guests happy. Kauil and Marcos who work at the restaurant Naos are by far the most hard working and fun guys you will ever meet. We had breakfast at Naos every morning and they made it an amazing experience. 
The third employee I have to mention is Rode. He works in the Royal Service and he is AWESOME! He works his tail off for every single person and is a wonderful friend. Rode will help you with anything you could ever need. If you book a Royal Service room, ask for Rode.  

Book this place. You will be so happy you did. We will be back next year!

reviews.author: 56anitaa
reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Overall it was a good experience with friendly people.  We enjoyed the food and the staff was always there to help.  The drinks were always there a but not very strong.  I guess they don't want drunk people.  the bar tender Chris in the Avenue Lounge was awesome.

reviews.author: 536ba
reviews.title: Magical Week at Paradisus!
reviews.text:
We had our wedding at Paradisus Cancun with 24 guests. Planning with the Romance team went smoothly and the wedding was perfect.  We had our ceremony at the wedding gazebo right in front of the beach and the reception in the pool area. It ended up pouring rain during the last hour, but everyone was a good sport and partied in the rain anyways. The staff even brought us warm towels to dry off with.

About the resort, I was blown away the second I walked in. It smells nice everywhere you go. We've been to many all-inclusive resorts and this one was by far the best. We tried most of the a la carte restaurants and they were all excellent. You can only book one day in advance, so when we couldn't get reservations, we ate at the buffet, but even the food at the buffet was delicious. There was a great selection of food and desserts (which I never got to try but I hear were amazing). We had the opportunity to dine at Tempo. Our waiter Florencio was excellent and very attentive. I ordered the fish and it melted in my mouth - so good! The overall experience was nice & very high class. We were served Moet as we entered and the men were handed a rose to give to their ladies at the end of the meal. When we wanted some late night food, the Blue Agave is open from midnight until 7am or something like that. They've only got hot dogs, nachos and burgers at that hour, but it's good "drunk food". The dress code is actually pretty relaxed as long as men don't show up for dinner at the buffet or a la carte restaurants in a tank top, it's all good. Woman can wear pretty much anything but a bathing suit.

A few other things I enjoyed about the resort:
-Top shelf liquor at all the bars, not just for Royal Service guests!
-Nespresso Bar - excellent coffee and the barista Andres was really friendly!
-24 Hour Room Service - food wasn't spectacular but doable if you're too lazy to leave your room.
-Avenue Bar - nice place to chill and drink with large parties
-Thierry Mugler bath amenities
-Lots of goodies in fridge stocked daily
-When you ask for water, they give you bottled water
-Beach was clean, water was nice and warm. Seaweed problem not as bad as expected.
-Servers going around the pool and beach area taking drink orders
-Bus stop right outside the resort, easy ride to get downtown.
-Decent Wi-Fi connection all throughout the resort and pool area - It made it easy to communicate with our large group. The connection tends to cut off close to the beach.
-Friendly staff everywhere!
-Turn down service - had no idea what this was before I came here, but apparently, someone comes and closes your drapes, removes the throw pillows and puts chocolates on your bed. Nice touch :)

A few minor cons: Building 3 is pretty loud at night because of the live bands playing on the main floor and the night club bumping until 2am. Didn't bother me, but it might bother light sleepers and people with children. I preferred to stay in building 3 because it is where all the restaurants, shops, and spa are located. Also the AC throughout the resort is not very good, but good enough in the bedroom. They run out of towels fast at the pool so grab them while you can or wait 20 minutes while they restock.

I read many reviews prior to our trip about the Club Melia timeshare people. Actually, they weren't as aggressive as some reviews made them out to be. A few of our wedding guests did attend some of the timeshare presentations (1.5-2 hrs long) in exchange for spa certificates and discounts on excursions.

It was a memorable week and all of our guests raved about the resort and the food. In a way, Paradisus ruined all-inclusives for us because now, we can't go back - it's 5 star or nothing! Highly highly recommended; we can't wait to go back!

reviews.author: salliep7
reviews.title: All-inclusive is best value
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I came with another couple and stayed for 5 days and 4 nights. We had an incredible time. After booking an all-inclusive vacation, we were a little weary of what we would get but we couldn't be happier. The hotel is very well kept and beautiful and the service was incredible. We ate at Mole our second night and had Javier as a waiter---he was the BEST. He was incredibly attentive, professional, warm and provided great service.

Make sure you get to the pool early if you want to get lounge chairs, as they are reserved quickly. You can also rent a Bali bed for $50 a day--we had a coupon so it was well worth it. 

There is also a Nespresso bar where Andres works nearly every day. He is also another outstanding staff member. He always has a smile on his face and makes delicious coffee.

Make sure to leave tips if you had great service, the staff works off of tips. 

We stayed in a room facing the lagoon which I read negative reviews about because it faces the parking lot. We were on the 7th floor and still had beautiful views. It was a little noisy at night since we were in the main building so if noise bothers you, I would recommend staying in another part of the hotel. Otherwise, being in the main building was very convenient for everything.

Overall, our group agreed that we highly recommend Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: bryanlut
reviews.title: Another great visit to paradises properties
reviews.text:
This was the third time I've stayed at a paradisus property but first in cancun. Compared to LA Perla I would have to say the food wasn't nearly  as good.  The service was great. Tips make sure you know what the butler can do and ask. If you don't they didn't volunteer  anything. Make sure to make reservations  at pool for the cabanas. Service was night and day different in cabana. I did give a 10 dollar tip to start which I'm sure helped.   We had our best meal in the cabana over looking the beach. Resort was full but fairly quiet which was fine. The rooms in LA Perla are much nicer. We were upgraded to a one bedroom suite due to birthday upgrade being a Melia loyalty  (free) member. Had friends in a normal room and was you basic room. No jacuzzi tubs in room or on balcony. The hotel did put balloons in rooms and a piece of cake as it was my birthday week before.

All and all I would come again. Everyone was very friendly  and special thanks to jorge,valeria, and Ivan for taking wonderful  care of us and making out trip special.

reviews.author: henry n
reviews.title: BEST ALL INCLUSIVE I'VE EVER STAYED AT
reviews.text: Blown away is all i can say/ this resort is so beautiful the inside is super nice and elegant. I was here for a wedding and it was grand. I ve been to alot of all inclusive and this resort had the best food i ve had so far. Even the buffet was good one night they even had lobster WHATTTTT. The resort was pricey i payed about 1750 but i seen my friends payed a bit more coming from Canada, but worth it and i am super cheap too. I ate at the Michelin star restaurant called TEMPO and to me it was only ok and our bill was $260cnd so that was a bit high but the experience was cool to try out. All the ala cart resturanat was so delish, my favorite had to been either the Brazilian food market grill so much good food and lots of meat come hungry or feugo the Argentinian food and that was upscale and excellent food as well. BE sure to make those reservations they will do one day in advance.  Now my best friends got married and the prices were a bit high from what they told me but i guess that where they get you. The wedding did go smoothly and no hicupps and thing got a bit rowdy as people got tossed in the pool after the wedding (GROOM). The staff was laughing and they even gave us towel to dry off after the groom and groomsmen got tossed in the pool. the service is excellent the food even better all in all BEST TRIP EVER.

reviews.author: RichardZee
reviews.title: Staff is amazing BUT.....
reviews.text:
As the title says...The staff is amazing.  The staff are 5 stars. There are some issues in terms of policy and maintenance.  Furthermore  if you are from an area like New York, like I am from, certain of their food options are underwhelming.

We stayed in Royal Service and they really treat you Royally.  Sandra, Rode, and Lazaro helped us through a rough time that occurred while there.  I am truly appreciative and they really take great care of their guests. That being said this is an honest review.

The Royal Service Pool:  Once again dominated by great service.  The bar and wait staff were superb.  Edier (Eddy), Rafael, Rodrigo, Javier, and Cesar all made us feel like kings and our cups were never dry.  The Royal Service offers a true top shelf alcohol experience and I watched them open brand new bottles of Grey Goose and whatnot. THERE IS NO SWIM UP BAR IN ROYAL SERVICE. However, the poolside dining menu was lacking both in the diversity of the menu and the taste of the food.  The food was just not well executed. 

 Furthermore, this pool offered absolutely no music.  I would understand that if it was a super relaxing atmosphere but it wasn't.  While I managed to procure a Bali Bed everyday, which was amazingly comfy, the lounge chairs (pic attached) are NOT cushioned and are difficult to manipulate.  They require inserting this ratty looking appendix under the chair into another part of the chair to change the setting.  Lastly, the pool deck is in a state of disrepair with missing and damaged tiles everywhere.  Pic attached.  

Other Pools: All pretty much standard, same chairs. The swim up bar was fun and could get a little rowdy, they play mostly dance music at this pool.  HOWEVER, this pool is shared with children as it is not in the Royal Service Area.

OUR ROOM:  Due to an event we were celebrating, possibly combined with our Expedia Gold status, Sandra was extremely gracious in upgrading us to a Lagoon facing one bedroom with two balconies, the hotel was not at capacity.  The room was decorated beautifully and extremely clean.  The bathroom was spacious and just a quick note to the ladies with long hair:  they only have those little sunbeam hotel hair dryers.  Rode, our butler, went into town to buy us a normal one. Like I said, great service.

Another note about the room:  Our room had a spectacularly comfortable bed. The AC worked very well and it was generally very quiet.  One complaint:  There was a smoke detector directly overhead, the lights blinked all night long, seemingly much brighter than they probably were. (pic attached)

Common Areas:  Beautifully decorated, zen vibe.  Koi fish ponds.  Aroma therapy.  Lush green plants. Candles.  Great subtle lighting.  Soothing Music.  The restaurants are mostly located in the main building around the outside of the common area, they are all inter-connected.  The Air Conditioning is a bit lacking in the common areas probably due to the tremendous open atrium.

If you booked Royal Service to have an adult only get away please remember that the restaurants and common areas are all shared by Royal Service and Family Concierge guests.  The only kid free areas are building 5, Royal Service building which includes a beautifully decorated common area, some buffet dining, a bar/coffee bar and your royal service checkin/concierge, RS pool and a section of the beach.

Breakfast:  Again service was great, food was ok.  THE ONLY OPTION FOR BREAKFAST IS BUFFET> (Room Service breakfast menu did not include eggs!)  
I will attach a pic of the line to be seated.  The entire hotel must eat breakfast here, they were overwhelmed at times. There was a huge variety of decent food to eat with the major shortcoming being only having access to two omelette stations.

Lunch:  Buffet, Market Grill or Poolside.  Buffet is self explanatory, decent food.  Poolside I already described and Market Grill was the best option.  The menu was diverse and well executed.  Several salads to choose from.  Several different proteins and a mix and match Pasta/sauce section.

Dinner:  We made reservations at the a la carte restaurants every night. 
     Best: Vento.  Mediterranean tapas. Great service. Yummy breaded little rack of lamb over a truffled creamy potato, shrimp over risotto, seared scallops, caprese salad.  Stay away from the hummus and baba ghanoush which I believe they made with sesame oil instead of tahina.  GREAT DESSERT OPTIONS.
     Mole:  Baby chicken in Mole sauce=awesome.  Menu was fun and adventurous, very well executed, great service.
     Bana: Asian. Decent but underwhelming, sushi rice way too mushy.  It is on the floor of the main common area in building three.  The shows take place here in one of the venues on the second floor so its loud at times.

     Market Grill (for dinner) is a churrascaria.  We didn't eat there but heard good things.

     Blue Agave:  Casual Mexican, tacos, quesadillas and the like.  Excellent, Authentic food.  Only restaurant open at 4pm. Roberto was an excellent waiter.

The lounges and bars were all nice and decorated beautifully, depending on what you were looking for.  

Coco's outdoor beachfront bar.  We went here twice for after dinner drinks.  The first time I was really enjoying my drink and the music.  I asked the bartender to make the music louder,specifically saying I was enjoying the chill house music, he did.  Then not even a minute later changed the music to a strange unknown hip-hop, we left.  We returned another night and again were feeling the music, I asked  "Hey, how long before you change this, I really like it."  He responded fifteen minutes and changed it in two minutes, and I left again disappointed.

There are a lot of weddings here.  Doesn't leave you any place to have quiet night time beach space.

Overall had a great time.  The staff makes this place as good as it is.

reviews.author: passion4travel4ever
reviews.title: Excellent Service and stay
reviews.text: My friend and I visited Cancun in the beginning of November. We stayed at Paradisus Cancun. The weather was great and there was almost no seaweed (that was my main concern). Customer service at this hotel was outstanding. We booked Royal Service and it does make you feel royal. We had a cell phone to call our butler for any need we had. You have a server on the beach so you do not have to do anything. I would like to say special thank you to our server Octavio. He was amazing. I did not like anything from the pool bar menu and he would go to the kitchen and ask them to prepare a dish I was in the mood for. Also I would like to say special thank you to the pool concierge Daniel. He went above and beyond for us (bali bed requests). Overall it was a very nice property, the lobby is very different from traditional hotels. In the evening they have live music and then shows after that. Lots of food choices. It is completely safe on the property. I spent the last day by myself and not once I felt unsafe. I would love to visit this resort again.

reviews.author: Rajarshi C
reviews.title: 5 day in Paradisus Cancun, May 2015
reviews.text:
It was more of a Business w/ Leisure Trip. Winning "The Global Circle of Excellence Award" I went to attend this event hosted by my organization which was hosted in Paradisus Cancun. It was a 3 day event by due to flight schedules we checked in on Sunday (May 17) around 1:30 am and checked out on Thursday (May 21) around 10:30 pm.
Coming to the resort/hotel... Amazing is an understatement. The resort blocks replicates the structure of a pyramid. We were checked in to on of the rooms in the Royal Service segment and they lived up to the name "Royal Service". Got great Hospitality from the friendly staff. Great rooms specially the ones in Level 0 (we were in Pyramid Block 5).. Room # 5009 to be precise. Spacious studio unit. 24x7 butler service. Keep in mind its an All Inclusive segment, so you pay an All Inclusive fee (Mandatory) and you do not need to pay any dues while checking out (except - Spa facilities, laundry services, certain water activities). 24x7 room service for F&B, Minibar refilled at regular intervals, separate Royal Service Swimming pool, complementary butler service by the pool. 
Great ambience, great service, even you stay back at the resort you wouldn't be bored. You can book you own "Palapa" by the royal service pool. A DJ playing House Music adds on to the mood.
They have a tennis court, and beach is accessible (onsite). There are quite a few in-house clubs and restaurants. I strongly recommend Ibana and Mole restaurants.
Beautiful property to boast of.
Visit Market 28 (not on Sundays, mostly closed). There are lot of things to do around - Rio Secreto Caves Exploration, Tulum & XelHa, Chichen Itza, Catamaran Sail, Dolphinaries, Salvatica Zip Line and not to forget be sure to have advance table reserved in Coco Bongo (the most happening club which is approx. 7 mins drive from Paradisus Resort, Cancun).
For travel to and fro airport and and travel within I strongly recommed "Amster" services or you can even hire any car rental services from the airport like - Hertz, Avis, etc.
To conclude, a resort with amazing service and ambience, you would just love staying here and would long for more. None the less amazing place for couples and you can make excuses to be here to celebrate end number of Honeymoons ;)

Bon Voyage--
Regards,
Rajarshi (Rishi)

reviews.author: George B.
reviews.title: Excellent service for kids
reviews.text:
I stayed solo for 1 week in November 2015 with 2 kids (3 and 7 y.o.) in tow. My review is solely from the family perspective (not couples, weddings, etc).

- Transportation. After making the booking (directly with hotel), I got a link to book free airport transfers. It was just a request form, and then I was contacted by 3d party provider to arrange the details. It went fine both ways (they sent us a picture of how their rep would be dressed, and we found him in the crowd of transport service providers outside of airport exit). Subsequently I talked to their rep on local mobile to confirm the return, and the van appeared at the appointed time. 

- Family Concierge service was well worth the money for me, The value comes from 
a) Lounge. Play area, coffee and snacks, sweets, Xbox / playstation. Great  place to spend time especially if having longer conversation about adventure booking. I'd leave kids there for a few mins to go change for dinner.
b) Activity booking recommendations and direct booking with the provider (they are a service, not middlemen). I took kids to Selvatica jungle zip line (yes appropriate for 3 y.o.) and meet the dolphins at local aquarium
c) Little gifts to your room--Mexican toys, water guns, fish food etc. Also milk and cookies for kids.
d) Local mobile phone (besides talking to concierges, used to contact the transport company)
e) Actual butler assigned to you. They were all very nice (ours was Ramon). I found it easier to call him for small quick matters (like dinner reservations or where something can be found) and go to the lounge (letting kids loose there) for complex matters that would take time. At the lounge Artyom was very helpful, as well as Josue and Alvaro. I found it very funny that one time a female concierge (Keyra) brought the milk and cookies over while I was just exiting the shower and we had a lovely unhurried conversation while I was draped in my towel.  

At the same time, I loved the service because I was one parent with 2 kids. if there are 2 parents and one older child, maybe you can spend the money on upgraded room, give the kid an iPad and book things yourselves, 

- Room. The jr suite was very nice with highlight being an excellent bathroom. However, there was plenty of space for 2 Queen beds--they only had 2 doubles. I had ocean view, but I think with smaller kids it may not be worth it. there's significant noise from the pool (and there could be wedding parties in the evening), and if the little ones nap (mine did not) it could be bothersome, and lagoon view could be calmer. I got to use the minibar, but for kids drinks, not alcoholic. 

- For booking a week's stay I got a "$1500" worth of coupons, but used $0. The best use would be Bali bed reservations, but again, it's more of a valid option for 2 parents, or for peak times. I just used regular sunbeds and was in/around pool most of the time anyway. I was disappointed a bit that while the spa offered a kid's barber service, I could not use the coupons on it. So no hair cut. 

- Kids activities are plenty: we partook in all 3 weekly kids discos (before main show), which tend to follow the same pattern: professional dance; Kids Zone staff intros, kids dance (like Macarena) and kids contest (some luck and some skill).  Did about 5 activities for older kid in kids zone (pottery, pizza-making, treasure hunt, etc). Younger kid in Baby Club at the time. Fun drum concert by the pool. A bare-bones playground, but still we went there on occasion. Never did anything in kids Palapa by the pool, but there were some (like decorating pirate flag).  

I would suggest (for US travelers) to bring plenty of US cash (booking activities typically requires a cash deposit). I had been scared of various stories about where everything was to be transacted in pesos, an brought few USD, and used the ATM at hotel. At least at Paradisus it was nonsense--dollars were just fine. 

- Food. I found the buffet to be very good. We liked to get a la carte for lunch at Market Grill for a difference. The little spot by the pool (Sunset Grill) was more for a hot dog in case of late dinner (days of kids disco) than for an actual meal. It's very basic for a reason. I have no problem with their food, but they SHOULD have basic drinks (i.e. you should not need to go to the bar to get Sprite or Fresca for kids). Sometimes they had a bucket and sometimes they did not.  

For dinner we always ate at the a la carte restaurants who all offer to bring you chicken nuggets or hot dog or pasta for the kids. However, I chose to order for them from the menu for principle and variety's sake. My conclusion (with my kids' tastes) is that with the exception of Bana (Sushi) the food, while very good, is not very suitable for kids (Mole - a fine take on Mexican food - was a prime example). Some restaurants are adults only, and so were not tried. 

- Overall experience. We mostly spent time going to the beach and the kids pool. The weather was excellent save for the wind that made the ocean unswimmable most days. The hotel was not full for most of the stay and that certainly made a difference in enjoyment. The concierge rightly pressed us to reserve things in advance. Last couple of days, venturing out to kids pool in the afternoon, with no Bali bed reserved, had trouble finding sun beds or towels. in fact, there are still signs for towel cards, but the resort went away from that policy. Clearly, some people do hoard towels, but I would imagine that guests in peak times could be unhappy. In any case, the friendliness and the service of the staff really made it an excellent experience.

reviews.author: Laurie H
reviews.title: Almost paradise...
reviews.text:
Stayed here as a Royal Service guest as my company is hosting 300+ employees for our annual company meeting in January.  The service is amazing!  I can't say enough good words about the staff.  Here's what makes it less than paradise...the food.  It's not that good, in fact, it's barely average.  Little to no flavor, big disappointment.  And I tried almost all the restaurants on the property.

Now let's talk spa...specifically the Yhi Spa on site.  While the prices are definitely American (meaning pricey), the overall spa experience is lacking.  There's a separate changing room for both men and women and outside the changing rooms is the shared hydrotherapy pool area.  Before my spa treatment, I had a chance to visit the steam room and sauna.  Since this area is before you enter the shared hydrotherapy pool area, I decided to skip the bathing suit, as it was a female only area (the spa did provide a robe for when you were walking around).  Before my massage, I wanted to rinse off in the "experience shower".  I hung my towel outside and stepped in.  When I finished, I opened the door to get my towel, and the doors to the shared pool area were WIDE open and some (lucky) guy was standing there and got to see me in all my glory.  The best part was the door was left open by a female attendant, who was exiting the area as I stepped out of the shower.  Not what I expected from a place that claims to be a Four Diamond Award Winner.

reviews.author: fr0mchicag0
reviews.title: Gateway weekend
reviews.text:
We spend 4 days in Paradisus Cancun. The hotel is old but the people are extremely nice. Restaurants are really nice and very good food. The waiters are very quick and helpful. The grounds are very clean.
The royal service is a must option. Better service, butler, private section on the beach and pool. Without that is just ok.
We stayed all the time at the Coco's beach club. You have to pay extra for cabanas but it's really worth it. You get Moet champagne and delicious food. Drinks are also much better. But most of all we loved the Dj Artel. He played great music and made the atmosphere so special. Also the manager Tabata is really nice and trying to get you the best price and best service. Great vacation overall!!!

reviews.author: Kwasi D
reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text:
We weren't blown away by the food choices in the all-inclusive package but we give very high marks for everything else. Service in particular was excellent. Our room was clean and when we couldn't access WIFI, they sent a guy to setup an extra router the room.
When we forgot to book a poolside cabana, they sent someone to the pool area(saving us the walk back to the inside) to set us up and eventually gave it to us for free as half the day was one. 
Guest services was really helpful- in particular Claudia Maria who helped us plan all our activities. When we needed to go to the ER, she recommended the Galena which turned out great for us. 
Room service was excellent and we found ourselves ordering at very odd hours since its 24-hours. We loved the omelets(made to our specs) and the oatmeal.

reviews.author: Neener415
reviews.title: Truly Paradise- Excellent in Every Way
reviews.text:
What can I say about this resort that would do it justice? My cousin and I just came back from a 5 night 6 day stay at the Paradisus Cancun and we couldn't be more pleased with the hotel, the staff, the food and thee overall experience. I have stayed at a number of all inclusive resorts in the past and consider myself to be very picky when it comes to service, cleanliness and food quality. This resort had it all and then some. I highly recommend booking the royal service as it does make a difference in your stay. There is complimentary access to the spa, an assigned butler, premium drinks in the royal only lounge, an exclusive adults only pool and many other added perks. 

I want to send a HUGE shout out and THANKS to Rosanna our butler (only female butler) who was the kindness, sweetest and most pleasant person I have come in contact with during my travels. She did everything to make sure our stay was comfortable and enjoyable. She really went above and beyond and deserves all the praise for her hard work. Ask for her if you decide to get the royal service! 

In terms of food, we mainly ate at the restaurants for dinner and they were all fantastic. Excellent service, great food quality, lots of choices for vegetarian dishes and an extremely accommodating staff. The buffet had a lot of options but mainly greasy oily buffet food which i am not really into so if that's your thing there are tons of options. 

From the check in process to the constant greetings of the staff, to the pool concierge, the waiters, the food quality and the room comfort. Everything was top notch! Throughout the trip we were treated and felt like royalty. 
Sandra at the royal concierge was extremely pleasant, helpful and attentive. Daniel our pool concierge checked in on us several times throughout the day to make sure we were enjoying our cabana time. He even came by with fruit kabobs popsicles AND brought back my cousin's missing hat from the lost and found. Special mention to the manager Daniel and our waiter Gamaliel at Fuego who were extremely customer service oriented and were very much about making sure our dining experience was top notch! 

Here are a few other bullet points to consider in case you go

1. the hotel is dimly lit with mood lighting in the evenings so do not be thrown off by that
2. the elevators need a bit of sprucing up but they are working on it
3. the Nespresso bar in thee main pyramid is an added bonus
4. the royal pool concierge has banana boat sun block and tanning lotions in case you forget yours
5. If you want something special for your room just ask. They will try to make it happen
6. Room service food was excellent but you have to wait at least 30- 45 min for it to arrive
7. Spa is small but the hydrotherapy was great to end the day with.

Feel free to hit me up if you have any further questions.

reviews.author: SW20Foodie
reviews.title: Surprisingly excellent!
reviews.text: Not my type of place these big USA style hotels! But I loved it. Amazing food, great rooms, tidy beaches and simply fantastic service. I'll be back to sample the fantastic hospitality, margaritas and huge scrummie seafood platters.

reviews.author: r0bertstamper2013
reviews.title: Great food and beverage services
reviews.text: I was born and raised in Las Vegas and the food and beverage here is  exceptional, I was a butler at the MGM hotel. The service and quality here is equal to home. The market Grille was great  Melvin,Karla and Alejandro gave us excellent service. I had a chance to talk with the executive chef and was impressed  with his passion for what he does with food. I'm really truly amazed. Even the room service was great, hot toast,cold milk. As they say in the business hot food hot cold food cold. Thank you for a nice visit

reviews.author: thuytt1
reviews.title: Our stay at Paradisus
reviews.text: We went with a group of 16.  Everyone enjoyed their time there.  We were not able to try all the restaurant but the ones we did try were excellent.  We did the Brazilian Steak house, the Sushi, and Frego.   My favorite was the Sushi, which I wasn't expecting it to be good.  The buffet was the only thing I didn't care for and the taco place was good.  Make it a point to make reservations for the restaurants, you won't regret it.  The staff was amazing.  Please bring singles and fives so you can tip.  You won't regret it.  Victor by the pool, Luis by the buffet, and Gerardo in Red Lounge gave us amazing services.  We stood in the third pyramid, on the fifth floor.  You were able to hear the music from downstairs but we didn't mind.  We were close to everything.   Great hotel and we would go back for sure.   We didn't do royal service but no regrets.

reviews.author: Sel48
reviews.title: Perfection
reviews.text:
Everything about this hotel is absolutely wonderful. The beach is fab, the service is superb and the restaurants are beautiful! We didn't get Royal Service as we had already paid so much for the holiday and didn't feel it was essential for us personally as we love the animation by the pool and being involved with everyone- not so much excluded into a separate part of hotel. 

Location- 10-15 mins into town by bus. Close proximity to night life and local malls. R-1 and R-2 go straight to both.$1 each way.

Beach- yes there is a tiny bit of seaweed- but that's nature and it's stunning!!!! 

Pyramid 3- is the main pyramid and my partner and I are not fussed by being able to hear entertainment downstairs. That all finishes by 11ish anyway, but if you want complete silence you might be better off paying the extra (a LOT extra) for royal service and getting quietness/more privacy. 

Pool- animation team are great and get everyone involved as much as they can. Beds do go early, especially ones with umbrellas. So get there early! Paradisus, more umbrellas would be fantastic. 😄

Food- Bana was our favourite place to eat! Superb service from waiter (especially Josè) who was very accommodating and has excellent customer service skills. If you like cerviche, then you will
Love Fuego as the food here is fantastic! 
Buffet at Naos- breakfast great but we weren't a fan of lunch and dinner. We would have LOVED to see some Mexican food being made on the grills one night, or perhaps 'theme nights' the food was quite bland for dinner so i definitely recommend making reservations in advance for the restaurants. 

Blue Agave- nice Tacos and good service but more variety for vegetarians would be great 😀

Rooms- all you need, although did find stains on the pillow one night but we had so many pillows that we just didn't use that one. Need a little more attention to detail from house keeping. 

Gym- fantastic and has everything you need! Cardio Machines, squat rack, weight machines and free weights with a separate  studio. 

Pesos and USD accepted everywhere but I found you are better off paying in pesos as your change is always in Pesos anyway. 

Tipping is a standards requirement everywhere so ensure you always have change.
All in all will we come back? We're already planning our next trip to Paradisus :)

reviews.author: MaureenB2013
reviews.title: Royal Service is not worth it!
reviews.text:
I have stayed at other Melia resorts and found the Royal Service to be superb.
That was not the case recently.  Our butler Rode was not attentive at all and there were many things not in order:  beds not made, air conditioning not working, no turn down service, refridgerator not stocked, etc. etc.
The resort is beautiful, but the level of Royal Service needs to be upgrade.  It is not worth the premium price.
Also, there needs to be more entertainment available at various venues within the hotel.

reviews.author: anthony g
reviews.title: Perfect
reviews.text: I have just spent 8 wonderful days at this resort,everything was perfect the room,food,service and the fantastic beach also the bus service from outside the hotel to go down the strip is fantastic took a hire for the day to see Tulum well worth the drive and xehe for snorkeling,i did a lot of research to find the right place and it paid off.

reviews.author: Juan T
reviews.title: Service was great and the resort was very nice.
reviews.text: I had great service.  Bartenders Simon and Juan took really good care of me and my girlfriend.  The food was great.  The hotel itself has a great set up.  I would recommend this place and come back again.

reviews.author: MINDY415
reviews.title: GREAT FAMILY RESORT
reviews.text: Hotel is very large.  The buffet is excellent with many choices. There were many families with young children at this hotel. Hotel is not handicapped friendly or for older people, unless they are in excellent health, as they have to walk 40 steps without railings down to the beach.  I asked the employees what they do about handicapped people or people in wheelchairs and I was told they carry them.  Hallways going to your room at night were dark and not well lit.  Beach is good.

reviews.author: Martin N
reviews.title: There is lots of good here but some things need work.
reviews.text: Just got back from the Paradisus Cancun after a week in paradise. This resort is in a great location. The staff was awesome, very friendly and attentive. The resort is clean and the food was pretty consistent quality but limited in selection. Tapas resturant is well done with some good food. Blue Agave was a favorite of mine, love some authentic tacos. The drinks are good not watered down at all. They make a good magarita. They do need a better selection of wine. Our room was small but did the job with a nice view of the ocean. What I did not like was how dark this property is. I would prefer less plants and trees with more light getting into property. It reminds my wife of being on a Cruise. .. the decor is just to heavy. Also there is no bar open during the day in the actual building. You have to go poolside with I'm my opinion has too many people drinking all day. One other issue was how they allow people to put towels on chairs near pool and beach even though they are not there. They should police that better. We did like our vacation just not sure we would return to this property.

reviews.author: Angel C
reviews.title: great hotel staff
reviews.text: the resort was beautiful.  there were several restaurants to choose from, but we didn't really enjoy the food that much.  but the staff at all the restaurants were so gracious,  friendly and helpful.  Fabricio and Gaudencio at the Naos restaurant were great.  we can't think of the name of the maitre'd but he was great as well.  in the Blue Agave restaurant Augustin was so friendly and wonderful.  we didn't enjoy this resort as much as other resorts in cancun that we have visited in the past, but the staff made up for it. also, we can't forget to mention that the room service ladies were excellent.....our room was cleaned very well and they kept the amenities stocked....we stayed in room 3448....the ladies in the spa were also wonderful...just can't say enough about the staff at the resort...so i hope that the resort acknowledges these wonderful employees

reviews.author: Mark H
reviews.title: Beautiful hotel with a beautiful staff
reviews.text:
My girlfriend and I booked this hotel for her birthday weekend getaway and it turned into an engagement weekend, as I proposed during our "romantic dinner" organized by Lorena and her staff. Overall, the hotel and lobby are incredibly beautiful. You walk in and your breath is taken away. We were part of the "Royal Service" experience and it was truly royal. Our waiters Josue and Ivan at La Palapa made our romantic dinner that much more special by being gracious and humorous, even helping to take some of my nervousness away by being supportive during my marriage proposal. One thing to add was the ceviche class with Erika and her staff. 

Life is short - it's the experiences in life that you can't take away - this place offers that- make sure you've had all the amazing experiences that Paradisus Cancun and it's staff have to offer - truly magical - I highly recommend it!

reviews.author: tgob
reviews.title: Girls weekend
reviews.text:
We visited Paradisus recently for a girls getaway. The resort was exceeded all of my expectations. The service was superb. Food was awesome.  Buffet  at Naos was awesome.
