The staff at Naos awesome and great energy. The bartenders at 2nd Avenue bar made great drinks. Gabriel the Waiter  at Fuego was awesome and made sure we had everything we needed. The lobby of the resort was breathtaking day and night also  romantic at night. 
The rooms was always clean so is property. Minor thing when room would get clean  towels removed were not replaced.  But an easy fix as the staff responded promptly. 
Had a such a pleasant  stay planning to return to next year.

reviews.author: Blue F
reviews.title: Experience with my Blue Lagoons
reviews.text:
The resort is very nice.  Perfectly laid out, with the pool and beach within a short distance.  The food was amazing, as an all inclusive this surprised me.

Now for some cons:
-You need to make a reservation at the restaurants a day in advance.  If you land on Thursday, chances are you won't be having a good meal on Thursday night (due to the fact you never made a reservation) They will let you know the buffet is available, but I felt this was unacceptable.  You will notice even when you do not have a reservation, that half the time the places are empty.  We spoke to the manager about how ridiculous it was, but he insisted that they account for the amount of food, not the amount of people.  I could understand if they were so busy that they were overwhelmed, but this was never the case. 

-The towel situation.  They NEVER had enough towels, or clean towels ready mid day.  The cabana where the towels were, the workers continuously said 20 minutes, when I went back in 20 minutes it turned into an hour, and than an hour turned into 2 hours.  At one point I was so frustrated, cold from the sun going down, I insisted they find any type of towel, in which they finally gave me a large clean bath towel. (So ridiculous the towel ordeal)

-The rooms were OK.  I think the bathroom needs some updating, as the ceiling had cut outs in it  (probably from leaks).

You pay for an all inclusive, but the little things you have to fight for, which makes it ridiculous.  The reservation aspect, due to not enough food, and the beach/pool towel situation drove me nuts.   

Room service takes forever.  At least an hour and a half for simple foods, like omelets, and coffee. 

I would go back to the Paradisus pending they restructure the dining experience, and towel situation.

reviews.author: oliver o
reviews.title: Service and Hospitality
reviews.text: First off i have to start by saying you will feel like a king and or queen when at this resort.  The resort workers go out of their way to make you feel like your at home. Amazing quick service.  Every time you pass by someone they say hi! Pool is great ocean is even better and the drinks are the best. Buffet was out of this world.  But I have to say that i have the best servers. Their names were Marcos and Kauil and the restaurant NAOS.  Every time i went to that restaurant to eat i only sat at their table.  From carrying my food to making sure my drinks never empty they were awesome.  They made us laugh and have a great time all throughout our meals. Thank you guys.

reviews.author: sgamble113
reviews.title: Service
reviews.text: Pretty good all inclusive. If you don't want the buffet you have to make a restaurant reservation two days in advance:/. But one of the best parts was Sergio, the bar waiter. We found him the first day on the beach. He worked his butt off for us. We followed him when his station was at the pool. He found us chairs with umbrellas when there were none to be found. He was a very nice gentleman and I will look for him again next year.

reviews.author: 528jeniferc
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.text: The atrium of this hotel is breathtaking! We ate at Bana (sushi) and Market Grill (Brazilian Steakhouse) and loved the food! Service was great, not too pushy. Most people speak english. The only complaint we had was that the shower did not drain and the sink counter was broken. Housekeeping was not consistent, one day we would be missing towels, the next day we would be missing washcloths, but they were always quick to apologize and provide the items upon request. We went during a less crowded time and had no problems getting spots at the pool or chairs on beach. Bus stop is right outside hotel, McDonalds and Papa johns are just a minute away. Mall is about a mile down the road - within walking distance. Great hotel. Would recommend.

reviews.author: Larry Q
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun
reviews.text:
We were there last week, 10/31- 11/7, and had a great time!  The entire staff were ready to assist us and so friendly!  One day we had a tour and the bus would not come up driveway. One of the door staff grabbed a golf cart and took us down hill.
While we were there Mexico celebrated the Day of the Dead. There is a picture of  setup in restraunt ! The Market Grille at night becomes a Argentian Stye restraunt ! We ate here there times because the food and service was excellent ! Nanos is a buffet style restraunt and had everything you could imagine! Everyday I had a great omelet any way !
The pool had a swim up bar and music was playing. There was the sunset grille where food was available and eat poolside! At the far end of the pool there is an area for children. Along the sides of the pool are also cutouts so children and adults will be afraid the water is too deep. Many parents were taking the children all over the pool!
WiFi is not great and told they are working to improve!

reviews.author: RLesak
reviews.title: This is the BEST place I have been
reviews.text: I have traveled all over the world, cruises, trains, hotel, and several all-inclusives.  The Paradisus is an all-inclusive in Cancun. I have been in several of these in Mexico but, this one tops the bill. It is not cheap but,  is worth it.   Its big, beautiful and the food is OUTSTANDING.  The service is terrific.  If you can  afford this place, go.  Forget about their Royal business it isnt worth it.  I cant tell you how much better this place is than all the others i have been at.  If you need assistance while here see Jared Garduno, in the business office, he will take care of you.

reviews.author: James S
reviews.title: Best trip of my life
reviews.text: I stayed here for a week with my girlfriend the end of september into october. There is not one thing I would complain about the service was incredible, the room was perfect, and the staff was so helpful and friendly. Victor the pool waiter went over and above to make sure everyone around us was taken care of and enjoying their trip. We absolutely will return. I want to be clear that I dont always write reviews, but because of our experience I had to do it because I want others to be able to enjoy the amazing resort.

reviews.author: Janet R
reviews.title: Great vacation!
reviews.text:
Many issues including:

...false advertising....the web site for Tempo (restaurant) says under the description that "Additional charges may apply". That is very misleading because you pay for what you consume. It is no included at all. It is very upscale and worth the money though.

...difficulty making reservations for dinner. The place was packed for a convention. All of the restaurants were booked. I called the day before we left and they would not let me make reservations ahead. We did not arrive late, but at 2pm. Assertiveness and persistence paid off and we ate at Vento which was wonderful and Mole which was also great.

...it took a day to get 3 rooms close enough together.

...there are no only two outlets in the room so bring an extension cord.

...the bathtub didn't drain. 

...the room leaked at the patio doors when it rained.

...there are not enough shady areas or chairs for the beach and pool.

...the roof leaks in a lot of areas during the rain and with the beautiful slick floors there is a risk of slipping.

Now the good stuff:

...even the lagoon facing rooms have a beautiful view.

...the rooms are well appointed and comfortable.

...the service is fantastic! 

...the hotel is beautiful.

...the food is delicious.

I would come back! 

p.s. bring a starbucks insulated cup with straw. They will fill them for you with your drink!

reviews.author: Lynda C
reviews.title: Oustanding
reviews.text: This resort was above and beyond all my expectations.  The room was perfect with an ideal balcony with a full ocean view.  The staff was exceptional from check in to check out and everything in between.  The food was very good. The entire experience was amazing.  The atmosphere and serenity throughout the resort was perfect.  Especially enjoyed the evening shows at the Avenue Lounge.  The bartenders, Christian, Maritn and Andrez were a cut above with friendly conversation and great for suggesting new, different, tropical cocktails.  Everyone at this resort could not have been more helpful, friendly and cordial.  Can't wait to plan my next trip.

reviews.author: Pittvaca
reviews.title: Our Favorite All Inclusive
reviews.text: This trip was our third to the Paradisus, Cancun. We love this resort! We had the privilege to stay in the Royal Service this trip! It was definitely worth it. Some features of Royal Service are a buffet exclusive for Royal Service guests that is stocked from 7am-10pm, access to Bali beds for free, unlimited access to water therapy at the spa, and priority reservations at all the restaurants. Access to the Royal Service tower is by card access only. It is adults only in the tower and at the pool and beach area. The rooms were well maintained, and even though we had a lagoon view, it was still beautiful! It was nice to have a butler for reservations, but we didn't find it was necessary to have him do much else (we are pretty independent people). Royal Service guarantees you 2 Bali beds per stay. We recommend one of the five that overlook the ocean; they were amazing. At the pool Alex, Omar, and Daniel are awesome guys willing to make the stay as enjoyable as possible. Raphael, Eddie and Victor from La Palapa took great care of us while pool and beach side! You can also order lunch right from there which is a nice feature.  We also built a great relationship with Gustavo in Royal Service who was awesome; he even brought us our favorite meals of crab legs and octopus right to the Bali bed. They added more umbrellas and chairs on the beach since our last visit, and it was never crowded. Never did we have to hold our chairs early in the morning; there were always some open during the entire day. As for food our favorite restaurants are Bana which serves Asian cuisine (Yuan was our waiter, and he was great) and Mole (Luis was our waiter, and he was great) which serves authentic Mexican food, but to be honest we liked all of the restaurants with the exception of the Steakhouse, it was ok. We also really enjoyed the smoothies and omelets at the buffet.  The complimentary water therapy at the spa was a nice relaxing touch to take advantage of each evening.  Our best advice is that $1-$5 goes a long way. The staff is super friendly and accommodating, and try their best to make the stay exactly what you want.

reviews.author: Hannahb350
reviews.title: First Class
reviews.text: Beyond all expectations of the country and all-inclusive resort. The upgrade to the Royal Service was well worth the extra money and Hector our personal butler couldn't have done anymore to make our holiday more special

reviews.author: Kevin G
reviews.title: Beautiful,good location,friendly staff,good food
reviews.text:
Located in the middle of the strip, across from aquaworld. Easy access to local bus for $1US(no change given), cheaper if using local currency.
The staff is great! very accommodating. The food was good, all restaurants were great and main dining area Naos had a good selection.The main and pool bars had good selection of top shelf liquor.
The hotel is beautifully decorated.The room was comfortable with jacuzzi on balcony

reviews.author: KWS53
reviews.title: Very nice stay for a wedding - but a bit underwhelmed with "Royal Service"
reviews.text: Stayed at the Paridisus Cancun for a wedding at the end of October/early Novemember and had a wonderful time.  The hotel is huge - almost overwhelming - but we stayed in the "Royal Service" part of it so had the feeling of a smaller hotel.  Our room - a one bedroom suite - was huge and had great views of the ocean with over 40 feet of deck space.  Rooms were clean, and beds were comfortable.  Service overall was very good, though a bit disappointed with our butler service as he did not seem nearly as attentive as other's butlers were - perhaps it was a language problem.  An example - one night when I wanted a drink in my room (from a well stocked inclusive bar) I wanted some ice.  I called my butlers cell phone and no answer; called the Royal Service desk and waited 45 minutes still with no ice; then called room service and waited.  I finally walked out and was on my way to get it (almost 90 minutes after my initial request) and a very responsive room service person - where I asked where the ice machine was - said he would get it.  Pool service was overall very good, and food was overall good and plentiful.   All in all for the price a nice vacation, but would suggest researching and requesting a butler who people rave about.

reviews.author: Cocobpete
reviews.title: Great Time Great  Hotel
reviews.text: Wow What a resort. My girlfriend and I recently spent a week there and let me tell you we were pampered beyond our wildest dreams. We were in Royal Service (adults only) and the attention to detail and to make sure that you are comfortable and well fed and they always wanted  to see you with a drink in your hand and they make amazing drinks. Ask for Cesar. He took amazing care of us. There is also a wide selection of restaurants and bar lounges if you just want to hang out. The views from the rooms are spectacular and the whole staff is very friendly and accommodating. If you are going to Cancun stay at this Hotel you will not regret it.

reviews.author: Jasmin N
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Oct 28-Nov 2
reviews.text:
Throughout the 5 days we stayed here we received nothing but excellent service from the staff. We had the Royal Service package and everyone who worked at the royal service pool was very attentive, always asking if we wanted any drinks or food. Staff would alway check up on us to make sure we have everything we need. The food here is the BEST food I had for an all inclusive resort, Fuego is my favourite. Tempo is a MUST try, it is for an extra charge, but the food you'll be receiving is more than worth what you are paying for. 

The only thing I was not too satisfied with is the actual building. It is an older resort and some of the faucet had some kind of green mold on it. It bothered me a little, but not enough for me to waste time changing rooms. Some of the furniture could be updated a little more, but overall the hotel is very nice.

We only had 5 days in Cancun and 3 out of those 5 days we had some sort of excursion to go to, so we really didn't have much free time. But when we did try to watch the nightly entertainment, the area was full. If you want to watch it, you must arrive early to ensure a seat. 

Lastly, I would like to give a special mention to our butler Juan! He is AMAZING! We miss him already. He was so polite and attentive. He was able to answer all the questions we had and he got us everything we needed, from pillows to certain drinks for our mini bar. He made all our reservations to fit around our schedule (excursions). One day we were at the market buying souvenirs and it was an hour before our dinner reservation, we called him to get it pushed back an hour and it was done just like that, with no hassle. He would surprise us with bubble baths, rose petals scattered on the bed, special notes, desserts, and bottles of champagne (he knew that was the only thing I would drink). He knew our schedule and what time is our dinner reservations, so before dinner he would always ask if we needed our clothes ironed or shoe shined. I always decline because I don't like the feeling of getting someone else to iron my clothes when I can do it myself, but I am very happy that he asked if we wanted it done. On the last day there, he would call to ask if we needed anything done, such as packing our clothes or getting our luggage brought downstairs. Overall Juan exceeded our expectation and made our experience at Paradisus one to remember.

I cant wait to travel to the other Paradisus in Mexico!

reviews.author: Eric M
reviews.title: First Time at an All-Inclusive
reviews.text: The Paradisus Cancun really helped to put my skepticism at ease regarding all-inclusive resorts. We had never done before and were a little hesitant. Concerned that it was just going to be a Carnival Cruise and overly cheesy. But the desire for this particular vacation was complete laziness and little to no decision making. The Paradisus delivered on all fronts. We had great weather and the hotel was only at about 50% capacity. That certainly helped the experience as well. No fight for chairs or palapas. Very speedy service from the bar and the pool servers. No trouble making reservations at the restaurants. We stayed for a week and only left for a day excursion to Chicen Itza. I'm not a huge fan of buffets but the breakfast is pretty decadent. A great variety of cuisine and restaurants. Fuego, the Latin fusion restaurant, was particularly nice. The only restaurant not included is Tempo by Martin Berasategui. DO NOT MISS THIS. It's Spanish molecular gastronomy for a very small financial investment. So, so fun and delicious. Try to avoid the time share spiel. It's the same spiel that you've heard before. We did get $100 free at the spa but the salespeople for the time share are very aggressive (as is usually the case). The spa was great. Very cool and unique hydrotherapy component that was a great experience. Deep tissue message that left me feeling like a noodle. Highly recommend this hotel especially during October which is low season.

reviews.author: Locarte
reviews.title: Review: Royal Services Staff
reviews.text:
If you're looking for upgraded and premium amenities, the "Royal Services" pyramid is for you. This smaller section of the hotel is more  private and quiet than the general public area. It has a completely different feel than the rest of the hotel. (The rest of the hotel is great, but this section is REALLY great.) We especially enjoyed the special nightly entertainment and hospitality bar as a way to begin our evenings.

Our personal butler was ROSANA. She was on hand throughout the day to make our reservations, answer questions and take care of every detail/errand we needed. The purpose of the butler is to keep the guest care free.This was certainly accomplished by Rosana.  We were given a special phone to reach her during the day. Each night after dinner, when we returned to the room, we would find a beautiful display of fruit, mini desserts and a hand written note arranged for us by her. It was a very nice touch. We found Rosana to be excellent at her job.

There are other members of the Royal Service staff that stood out during our stay. DANIEL in the pool area, was very helpful in making arrangements for a daily Bali Bed. (Bali Beds are not guaranteed - you must have a reservation and the location can change each day.) Most impressive to me, though was the way I witnessed him handle a VERY difficult guest who was reserved next to me. Also, Daniel was training a new employee who was very attentive and friendly to our group. I regret that I did not get his name. He was one of the people who constantly checked on us, answered our questions and tracked down the busy gentlemen food/drink servers for us.

Also by the pool with exceptional food/drink service on our very first full day was GUADALUPE. She took good care of us when I know the heat and the large crowd didn't make it easy. We were never thirsty or hungry though, with Guadalupe.  During our stay, she also worked inside the Royal Services breakfast/snack area. Again, top notch service with a friendly smile. 

I also visited the spa for a 50 min relaxation massage with YURI, who gets 5 stars for technique. She worked out the kinks without causing residual soreness. DONT MISS THIS.

Housekeeping was spotty. Sometimes they restocked the mini refrigerator and sometimes they didn't.  We had to request bottled water one day because we didn't have any. (This is a big deal in a climate that is hot and humid.). Washcloths were another problem; on three occasions we had just one. These are minor things that were cleared up, but they should have been non-existent to begin with. HOWEVER: I accidentally left my wedding ring on the dresser and went to the pool where 4 hours later I realized I didn't have it.  When I raced to our freshly cleaned room, there it was, just as I had left it.  For this, housekeeping gets. 5 stars.

SUMMARY: I was constantly greeted by friendly staff who were willing to help me any way they could.  The people I have named were just the ones that I had the best interaction with, but you can expect to have contact with 10-15 helpful staff members per day.

THE PROPERTY: The property is beautiful and a bit dated in areas however it is constantly being cleaned and maintained. I saw workers in the gardens, painting, dusting, sweeping etc... The public bathroom areas were pristine. 

The view/: 5 stars excellent
The service: 5 stars excellent
The property: 3 stars good

reviews.author: Mark D
reviews.title: excellent staff and service....food excellent
reviews.text: When we travel to Cancun we will always stay in the Paradisus Cancun...the service is outstanding, this is our third time at this hotel and we have stayed at others in Cancun...from now on always stay here. They are the friendliest and attentive staff we have enjoyed in many vacations. The food and beverages were upbeat and fresh and replenished as needed.

reviews.author: Rashita L
reviews.title: Absolutely lovely
reviews.text:
My husband decided at the last minute to take me away for my birthday for 5 days 4 nights. After I looked and looked, I decided on Paradisus Cancun. Mainly for the live plant architecture. I have read reviews prior to going and they gave me a 60/40 chance that I would be completely happy with my stay. Suffice it to say, my husband and I were completely happy! Our guest concierge, Claudia, was amazing! Anything we needed she made it happen. Our trip was mainly for relaxing so we didn't do too much outside of the resort except go to the Market 28 in the local neighbor pass hotel row. We caught the bus right outside of the resort road the R2 bus for 15 mintutes walked 3/4 of a mile and we were there. By-the-way. It is totally safe. Just be prepared to haggle. Back at the resort the employees and guest are all friendly. We ate at three reservation type restaurants and our best was Mole, Mexican cuisine. Vento was ok and we didn't like Fuego. However, this dosent effect the stars we gave the resort. The buffet is by far the most amazing place to Dibble and dabble in different mexican cuisine. The swim-up pool was great. We rented the Bali bed for the last two days. FYI ( rent the Bali bed on the beach size next to the bar. Those two are the only ones with a socket, this way you can plugged your gadgets in). We had a pool  concierge, two of them who by far were all great. But Ingrind, was the best. At the bar Jeison was the most fun bartender. At the beach bar Coco, we can not remember the bartenders name but we discussed alot about YouTube and he played plenty of music that I asked of him without a problem and he always made sure to have Glenlivet waiting for my hubby. I can go on and on about this resort, but I am sure everyone gets the point. We will be going to paradisus in another destination with the children this time. 

I only gave it four stars because although they fixed the several problems I had expediently, I still had to go through them and they were tiresome for me to have to do them on my vacation. But we would go back

reviews.author: JJD98
reviews.title: Impressive Hotel with lots of options
reviews.text:
The hotel is very impressive with a lot of options on where to eat and what to do. The hotel is all inclusive and the range of different restaurants is amazing. 

However, to get the most out of this hotel you need to stay in it constantly. So you start to feel like you are on a cruise ship that happens to be on land. And many people will love it for that reason.

Personally, although the hotel was great, the all inclusive approach wasn't for me and I would rather go for the "standard" hotel approach and explore a bit more. But I could imagine folks who just want to de-stress and laze around the pool will love it.

reviews.author: MiamiBeach2002
reviews.title: Complete disaster
reviews.text:
I just returned from Paradisus Cancun.   I had the worst experience of my life.   The food was awful, my whole family was sick from it most of the time.   I found the facility to be filthy, and the staff to be rude and incompetent.  
I found the hotel to be completely inflexible when it came to any accommodation or requests we had.  
Please do not spend a penny in this establishment, you will regret it.   There are 100 better places to stay in Cancun.

reviews.author: Ragd3
reviews.title: Beatiful All-Inclusive High Quaility Hotel
reviews.text:
We were looking for Cancun resorts for our summer vacations and, right just when we were about to go with another hotel, we found a really good deal for this one.

The GOOD:

This place is beautiful! The hotel is very elegant and well distributed and it smells like paradise. We had a Junior Suite Ocean View that had enough room for two couples (we had to independent bathrooms). It was like having our own apartment near the beach. The place was clean, up-to-date and comfortable.

The beach is beautiful and clean (except for the seaweed issue which is happening everywhere in Cancun) plus you get beach service (don't need to stop relaxing to go get drinks). Beach bathroom is big and clean. It even has an AC! The pool is big and well distributed too with a few integrated "Jacuzzis". It was warm all day!

Restaurant are great. You have so many options to choose from and they all are worth it. The best thing, you don't have a limit of restaurants you can go during your stay so, as long as you have enough time to visit them all, you're good to go (as we did). The food is just delicious! You get quality seafood plus local and international flavors. You MUST try the welcome drinks of all the restaurants as they were actually good. Every single bite was worth the calories! I can talk about the food for hours here...

Service is also very good. Everybody was nice! You don't feel harassed nor neglected. We can't complain at all. We called for extra water bottles and we got them right away. Room was cleaned flawlessly all the time. Reception is also very diligent. Restaurant service was also very quick, professional but friendly as well.

However, you don't always find someone that works in a hotel that you really wish you could take home with you but, this time we found that person and, we would like to thank our special bartender Christian "El Gato" who made our vacations extra special. Not only he prepares the best cocktails we tried in the hotel but, he's super fun and friendly! Since the first moment we met in the pool bar, we would chase him to which ever bar he would be working. Honestly, we felt that he really loves doing what he does and he strives to make you feel welcome. And you know what? We only tipped him on his last day before our departure so, he wasn't just pleasing us for money. ¡Bravo, amigo!

Finally, did I mentioned FREE Wifi? 

On the BAD side, we only have two observations:

1) Cooking smell at night time in the main building: As I mentioned, this hotel has an ambient scenting system that makes it smell like a SPA during the day but, at night, the smell of all the cooking going on is really strong in the main floor so, as soon as you leave your room you can taste the burning oil. I would suggest improving the ventilation system so the whole place doesn't smell like a huge kitchen.

2) No room for night shows: The hotel is lacking a dedicated theater or stage area so, the night shows take place in a living area on the main floor. This is actually where the AVENUE BAR is located which is not so small for a hangout area to sit down, relax, have drinks, etc. but, when the shows are going on, you have no option to stand up around the action trying to get a view. It only takes a few people to overflow the room space and then you have people standing up gathered around trying to see the show from the corridor, the stairs, etc. We could only watch the shows each night for about 5 minutes because it gets too unbearable. Honestly, they need to find a better place or way to accommodate people or, simple, don't do any night shows at all!

reviews.author: MimiDemty
reviews.title: Best in Town
reviews.text: The hotel is simply beautiful... With a beautiful view of the lagoon right in front of the lobby,the beauty of the facilities is above any other place in Cancun. The staff is very professional and friendly.I loved the Royal Service... It really enhanced the whole experience  to another level. The beach is just amazing as well. If it's for work or pleasure, you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Jojoeles
reviews.title: Not loving it!!!!
reviews.text: Currently staying at the Paradisus in Cancun and are really disappointed! We arrived on Saturday and today is Monday and had to go to the front desk both days to request that our room be cleaned( at 4pm) . Since it was late in the day we also did not receive towels. While trying to view Mail on my iPad noticed a swarm of little gnat type bugs sashaying across the glass table .  After staying at 4 other Paradisus resorts this is a big disappointment. Hope the remainder of the week gets better!

reviews.author: Victoria F
reviews.title: Honeymoon of my dreams! !!!!
reviews.text: The hotel is absolutely beautiful, the staff is so accommodating. Everything was amazing from the pool to the ocean, the beaches are clean, staff is very helpful. Everyone always greets you to make sure you have the most amazing time. If you didn't opportunity to rent a bali bed do so its worth it.

reviews.author: Simplyidi
reviews.title: Not what i expected!
reviews.text: Pics look way better than reality. Was not welcomed at the door with a beverage or cool towel as i read in reviews. Check in was a mess.took 30 min. Could not find my name. Then said no room available. Not even offered a drink in the mean time. And i was doing royal service. Did not feel royal at all. Food at buffet was the same everyday. Activities at the avenue bar were somewhat boring. Was called to my room to ask me if i was with another family.. (Which i wasnt) they were so confused.. Royal service pool menu was bland. Requested a bali bed with ovean view and it was given to another couple because nonone ever told us we had to be down the pool by 11am. Nonone ever informed us. We arrived at 11:30 and it was given to another couple already. Walked in to the hotel few times after comming in from outside activitys no one at the door.. Anyone could just walk in. Cleaning lady threw out my personal soap i took. Did not replenish facial towels i had to ask for them daily. At check out they could not find my paper work. Then asked if i had switched rooms which i didnt.! Total mess again. Sorry. But would not return.

reviews.author: Jocelyn F
reviews.title: All inclusive holiday
reviews.text:
The service level at this Melia hotel  was the best!  
Alfredo at the reservations desk went above and beyond in his efforts to help me when we had some water leakage during a huge storm.
The team in the Vento restaurant (Katia, Jose and Rueben) superior service.
The team in The Market Grill ( Alejandro, Jose, Karla and Melvin) more superior service.
I will miss seeing the smile from the breakfast buffet hostess "Cristina" and Christian the waiter there.
The hotel has the best service level of any we have stayed at.
The food was excellent in every venue.  We even did the seven star Michelin chef at Tempo; an experience that I will never forget.
The only downside to this hotel would be the scent that they pump into the air ALL THE TIME.  A lot TOO MUCH if you are even a little scent sensitive.
The main pyramid can be way too noisy in the evening until 2 a.m.  First there is evening entertainment and then the disco starts after 8 p.m.  In the rooms surrounding and above; don't hope to get a wink of sleep unless you are stone deaf.

reviews.author: Debra P
reviews.title: Son's Wedding
reviews.text: Went for our son's Wedding. Couldn't have been more romantic! Everyone enjoyed their stay. The buffet had the freshest food you could imagine. The fish was the frestest I ever had. I enjoyed  Bana (Japanese) restaurant. We are all sushi lovers and it was outstanding.

reviews.author: Cherif G
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort , wonderful staff!
reviews.text:
We love Cancun VERY MUCH and we we’ve been vacationing in Cancun 3 times a year for the past 15 years, we are well travelled and always to 5 star resorts in Cancun , the Caribbean, Europe and around the world.
We can assure you PARADISUS is one of the best!!!
This October 3rd, 2015 was a special occasion. We were celebrating my husband's birthday and we booked the Deluxe Junior Suite Ocean View Royal Service. We stayed for 7 days.
The room was beautiful and the View amazing. The Royal service staff were friendly and courteous, It is worth booking royal Service.
The beach was super clean and all the beach waiters were wonderful, they continuously came by to ask if we needed drinks and they suggested all kinds of delicious drinks and lots of water in ice bucket, they kept coming back and forth asking if we needed more drinks, they were very friendly specially Moises, he went out of his way to make us happy We even asked him for non alcoholic beer and he brought it specially for us SOL Cero, delicious Mexican beer, nicely chilled in an ice bucket. wow!!! that's service!! 
The restaurants are all great , and the quality of the food  is excellent and choices and quantity is abundant , the buffet restaurant NAOS for breakfast and lunch is excellent , there is nothing you cannot find, the waiters are super nice, but one special waiter who made a difference is  Kauil at the Buffet Restaurant Naos & Market Grill, this guy Kauil is a wonderful person, so attentive to all your needs and always smiling and going out of his way to please you and he takes care of everyone sitting in his section. Whatever you ask him he will make sure to get it for you as fast as possible and always with a smile on his face. HE WORKS SO HARD and he's happy when people are happy. It really feels like he loves his job and puts great effort to customer service
Thank you Kauil for making our vacation special.
We also loved Tempo Restaurant. You have to reserve dinner in advance and they have a Renowned French Chef, you can either chose the Chef's special menu or a la carte. We chose the Chef's special 7 course meal , our meal was prepared by their Spanish Chef I. Medina , and I cannot describe how delicious it was. With every course
they serve a special wine. we reserved for dinner on the date of my husband's birthday and the Head Sommelier Carlos served our wines and he would explain the different types of wines that goes with each dish. so we started with Champagne then 7 different wines, The dinner was absolutely fabulous! and the service was excellent. Our waiter Miguel was great.
It was a memorable evening, everyone should try Tempo at least  once during their stay. You cannot miss that.
Another excellent restaurant in this resort that you must try is the Mexican restaurant Mole !
all the waiters are extremely nice and friendly and the atmosphere is fun , they have Mariachi band who play Mexican music and they can play and sing the song of your choice. Once again the food was excellent , we loved it and we had lots of fun in this restaurant, our waiter Angel was extremely nice and efficient and his assistant waiter was very funny and unfortunately I forgot his name , I call him excellentes because he kept coming and checking if everything was excellent, Thank you Senor Excellentes you made our trip memorable. Another wonderful gentleman is the assistant sommelier , his name is Iran and he was there to recommend the wine and was wonderful. Iran you’re a true gentleman, we really enjoyed meeting you ; your wine recommendations were excellent.

We tried the Sushi Bana, it was very good but noisy because of the show. Fuego Restaurant was excellent, the food was great as well as the service we highly recommend it. Our waiter was very nice.
 
Paradisus is a real paradise ,from the waiters to the staff in general they were all excellent. but the one and only most special person who made a difference and made our vacation memorable was Mr. Abraham Franco, He really cares about all the guests in the hotel, and makes sure people are happy and that all their needs are met, and if there is a problem he takes care of it immediately, and very efficiently and makes you forget it ever happened, we can't wait to go back to Paradisus and we made sure to recommend this resort to all our friends and business associates. Thank you Mr. Franco !!!! we look forward to see you again real soon.
Without hesitation Paradisus is the best hotel in Cancun .

Another special lady also who should be thanked is Sandra at Royal service,
she took good care of us too. Thank you Sandra!! 

Also special thanks to our butler Geraldo who was very nice and attentive and specially decorated the room with balloons and cake and a bucket of champagne for my husband’s birthday, thank you Geraldo. 
Once again management should take care of Kauil the best waiter ever !!! thank you Kauil, you are wonderful!  And thank you to all the staff, Can’t wait to go back to Paradisus!

reviews.author: Ronald S
reviews.title: Great Stay Great Service
reviews.text:
Very tropical main atrium. If your looking for an environment for ROMANCE & RELAXATION this is definitely the place.Staff is very friendly and accommodating (if you are looking for "over the top" service that include hand shakes, name recognition, extra fast response times, then simply TIP your hard working bar tenders, hosts, beach servers and restaurant servers). The crew we run with appreciates the art "getting what you pay for". We tip generously and we end up with all the attention we need while others who don't, sit around waiting for average attention. 
Very simple advice folks!
KAUIL (Ka-Will) is the BEST SERVER in the buffet. Greets you every morning with a hand shake, smile and first name. At lunch time he will see you coming from across the pool and gesture with hand signals requesting how many will be coming so he can set up our tables accordingly.
SAMUEL in the beach beds area provides first class attention.
JESUS on the beach is very courteous, friendly and will also greet you on a first name basis as well as everyone in your group.

reviews.author: Mary P
reviews.title: AMAZING! WONDERFUL EXPERIENCE!!!!
reviews.text:
I just can't begin to tell you,about the WONDERFUL time my wife and I had at this resort.

We have NEVER been treated with such respect, and have NEVER been so spoiled in our entire lives.The service , the food, the beaches EVERYTHING was perfect.The choices of restaurants and the beauty of the surroundings were breathtaking!!!

We can't go back soon enough!!!

reviews.author: Dave C
reviews.title: Great beach, very clean, excellent service. Good Food
reviews.text:
My wife and I have been twice and are planning a third trip to this Cancun resort. Food is good and if you don't see somthing  on jthe menu just ask for it and it will be brought to you. Always hard leaving. Beaches are spectacular  but hey this is Cancun and is expected. Nice clean pools with poolside and beachside service. Kids are welcome but are far and few between. I believe this is rated at 4.5 stars and that is accurate. I recommend the beach front view rooms if you can swing it. Would I pay full price no but there are always deals to be had if you watch out for them. Staff is friendly grounds are clean and we'll maintained as well as the interior. Plenty of restaurants  and good buffet.
Has a very nice exercise facility  with modern equipment. Nice machines, some free weights and cardio equipment. Not one of those afterthought fitness rooms. It does the job if you need to get a good workout in. WiFi service has been upgraded and has decent coverage. Free use of safes, bar fridge is stocked daily and rooms are well maintained  and clean thoroughly daily.

reviews.author: ebriganti
reviews.title: food was very bland, very little activities, no nite life what so ever.
reviews.text: the hotel was beautiful and very clean, not impressed with the food or activities, had a situation in the ocean called for help multiple times no lifeguard came to help! Also checking in took forever!

reviews.author: Patriciap47
reviews.title: Embarrassed
reviews.text: We took our entire family of 11 to this hotel for a Thanksgiving holiday week. We have vacationed together 5 times and sorry to say this was the worst. Ages range from Grandpa and Grandma late 60's to our married kids in their 40's and grand kids all boys, 11, 16, 16, 18. I will try to be brief and direct. The 2 Stars were for the waiters Luis, Luis, Jesus and cleanliness of the facility. First check in was a nightmare with no air conditioning anywhere but our rooms. It took 3 hours to check in and that was after reaching the desk. A long flight, sweat and tired we finally reached our rooms. Nice enough. Beds hard and old mattresses. 2 pools, one hot like a sauna, the other where the bar was along with hot tub were freezing. No hot tub there. Jets but freezing cold water. Bali beds at the beach cost a bottle of rum. $125.00. We are good tippers so we received great service. Ocean was beautiful. Very rough. Ages in this resort were young couples with lots of kids. No teenagers. They had a kids club but that was it. Nothing for our boys. Thank god we brought a football to toss around. No activities at all. They had classes at the cold pool but no one would go into water.....cold. Lots of stairs with no railings for us older people. So many restaurants. No reservations so had to wait 1-2 hours for table of 11. I'll make it simple. Food was horrible. Every restaurant tasted like the one before. We are not snobs by any means but we could not find anything that tasted good. These other reviewers...I have no idea where they ate. Vento was the only one I thought was acceptable. Everyone went to Walmart to get processed food. The fruit was good but you can't eat that every minute. We had 4 rooms. And they were only cleaned 3 of our 7 days. The refrigerator was supposed to be stocked every day. Nope not even close. Had to call down and still had problems. Never replaced coffee, soap, shampoo. We tipped too. Really. Entertainment was in a small room that you could never get near. You could hear but never see. So that's about it. We have had wonderful times in Disney, Cancun at Dreams, Moon Palace in Punta Cana. This hotel was chosen by my travel agent. Really? Even the hot dogs and hamburgers were not edible.....this is an open hotel so the blast of hot humid air is everywhere except your room. We asked for a cot in one of the rooms. 3 adults in a room with 2 double beds. The cot was ordered when I booked the trip in August. After calling non stop, we finally received the cots on the 3 rd night. My biggest thing is this was probably our last trip together related to health issues and I just wish the reviews had reflected the truth. Beware of this hotel.

reviews.author: Chad L
reviews.title: Top Notch "All Inclusive" with "Royal Service"
reviews.text: First "all inclusive" for my wife and I. Also first trip to Cancun. No doubt would go back to the Paradisus again. There are two Paradisus people that made our trip. Galdino was our butler and saw to our needs. He wanted to know if we were in Cancun for a special occasion. We said just a "get-a-way, but my birthday was a few days after our stay. The day after our arrival a birthday cake and a bottle of champagne showed up in our room. Also on the last night a bottle of top notch tequila showed up in our room. Thank you Galdino. Our "Royal Service" pool waiter Francisco Terrazas was entertaining and went above and beyond keeping us in food and drinks. We asked if we could order other food that was not on the La Palapa (pool bar and grill) menu. He said no problem and made it happen. Thank you Francisco. The only critique would be the weather. It was very windy over Thanksgiving weekend. The temperature was nice considering it was below 0 Fahrenheit at home in South Dakota USA.

reviews.author: Cab0c00k
reviews.title: My first trip to Cancun and I won't stay here again
reviews.text:
Our rating of this hotel was actually less than a 1 star.  Here is our review:

We scheduled a timeshare stay at the Paradisus after reviewing hotels online.   My husband and I have traveled many places but it was our first time in Cancun and we were really looking forward to it.  Arrived and was immediately escorted to a building at the far end of the hotel (Pyramid 1) to check in and was immediately scheduled the next morning for a timeshare review.  This check in and scheduling for the following morning was polite but  took over an hour and 1/2 and I was tired from the trip.  We checked into the hotel room assigned in Pyramid 2 (It was Hurricane Season and the hotel wasn't full) and was in a room looking at the Pyramid 1 tower.  "Why did we get this room?" I asked since the hotel was not fully booked.  Complained to management and finally moved into another room facing the ocean for $100 more a day into Pyramid 2.  

A typhoon was coming over the Yucatan peninsula and our new room flooded.  We called Housekeeping to request towels or something to help the water, but the hotel didn't bring in towels so we used the ones in the bathroom so we didn't slip on the wet floor.  The book about what the hotel offers as its service and luxury spa on site that was in our hotel room, stated we were supposed to have turn down service every night.  Nothing for the first 3 days.  The hotel book says that guests receive a free gift upon arrival. Us?  Nothing.  The sheets on the bed didn't fit and it was like being short-sheeted.

Out of the 7 restaurants, only 4 were open and of those 4 only 2 were open for breakfast and lunch.  The other 2 were only open at dinner time and the one only service tacos.   The food at the Buffet line was tepid warm. No steam tables at this place to keep the food warm.  When we complained about the food to the management, the Hotel Room Manager said, "I eat there every day" and acted indignant as if I offended her.  She eats there for free, I'm on vacation and had paid for an All-Inclusive package.  The Hotel site doesn't say anything about the restaurants being closed or specifically what food is not included.   The room service refused to deliver ANY alcohol to the room to eat with a meal even though we paid for the All-inclusive package.  The only snacks in the room were a bag of chips and a 6 pack of oreo's.  No crackers, no fresh fruit    (mangos, local fruit), no local Mayan Chocolate, nothing! 

Our trip was during off-season, not a full hotel and the Cabana's on the beach were still were being offered to us for $100 a day...that's even during a typhoon?   I paid over a $1,000 dollars per person for an all inclusive package.  We mainly ate at the buffet since the other restaurants were closed.  Finally for the last night I ordered a lobster tail for dinner.  It was fantastic but this was not offered in our All-Inclusive package.  I couldn't eat or drink enough of what they offered to make up the cost for what I thought I was paying for.  I talked to other people staying in other parts of the hotel, and they were given primo service, balloons for celebrations, drinks delivered, etc, etc.  My husband and I truly felt we were the LOWLY GUEST TIMESHARE PEOPLE (Pyramid 2). Not even placed into Pyramid 1 where the Guests of Paradisus Timeshare stay or allowed to stay with coffee, drinks, food offered or in the Adult Only part of the hotel (Pyramid 3 &4) and I offered to pay for the upgrade when we checked in but were told no.  

The ONLY saving grace was the humbleness and kindness of most everyone that worked at the Paradisus.  

We may return to Cancun but will definitely not stay at this hotel.  If you stay here, I hope your stay will be better than the one we had.  I doubt the hotel will read this and I truly doubt that the hotel will make any effort to comp us for anything.  About the ratings:  Service at the restaurants were great but he Hotel Management service was terrible..  The Location of the hotel was great!

reviews.author: jesscicar
reviews.title: Lovely place to stay!
reviews.text: My mother and I visited on a weekend trip and it was amazing. We enjoyed the pool, the sand, the room, and the cocktails were amazing. The food was delicious. Everything about the place was amazing. The staff was helpful and had great recommendations. Worth every penny!

reviews.author: rzolt
reviews.title: Always a Great Stay!
reviews.text:
We just returned from our 4th stay at Paradisus and have a reservation for our 5th stay in February.  Simply put, Paradisus is a wonderful place to stay.  The staff are friendly and very helpful while the beaches are just beautiful.  

While I can't say that we never had a minor problem or two I can say that the staff has always worked hard to rectify it.  Paradisus is the kind of place that if you just want to relax and enjoy the beach you'll have no problem doing it there.

reviews.author: Caleb W
reviews.title: High expectations and they were surpassed
reviews.text:
Where to begin on this hotel....I can start with explaining what is important to my family when we travel.  Top notch service, cleanliness, above average rooms, and value.  This place blew away our expectations on all levels.  We booked our trip through Book-It and flew American.  

The Room - We booked what is referred to as a "Family Concierge Luxury Deluxe Suite - Lagoon View".  I am not sure if an A-La-Cart in an option, but we were All-Inclusive.  This room was perfect for a family of 4.  It had ample storage for all our belongings, a comfortable place for a pack-and-play, a roll-away bed, and didn't require that the dining room table for 4, or the couch be removed from the room.  All of this, and there is king sized bed and balcony with a whirlpool tub were separated from the rest of suite by a sliding door.  When the kids were asleep at 8 pm, my wife and I were still able watch breaking bad via Netflix on our Ipad without bothering the kids.  The resort-wide FREE wifi worked wonderfully and was quality enough to allow us to stream movies without any buffering or drops.  

The Service - We booked the Suite because we needed the extra space, The Family Concierge was a bonus and we didn't really understand what this service provided.  Upon arrival the Family Concierge has a private 2,000 SF room off the lobby dedicated to these guests.  100% of all your interaction related to your stay can occur in this facility - check in, check out, issues with a room, etc.  The facility has a self serve bar with top shelf liquor including Belvedere Vodka, Johnny walker Black and Red, Glenlivet, white wine and beer.  The room also has snacks set out for adults and kids as well a full kids facility inclusive of kid sized pool table, TV with X-box and Playstation (in case it rains) and facility for really little ones.  We didn't use the service, but it would appear they had a fully day care for infants.  We stopped in for various things during our 7 day stay, and never once did we have to wait for service.  That said we traveled during the week of thanksgivings so I would venture to guess the hotel was not 100% full, however it was likely close.

Family Concierge guests are assigned a direct contact, who for us was Nancy.  Maybe all the staff is as amazing as Nancy, but I would find that to be an impossibility.  Anything we needed was taken care of promptly and with a smile.  If you want one, the hotel will give you a cell phone that you can use to call your direct contact anytime you need something.  you can be sitting by the pool and realize that you left your kids floaties in the room - use the cell to call and in no time your floating are delivered poolside.  Last comment is the special things the Family Concierge does as part of the package:  Milk and cookies each night in the room, a drawn bubble bath on the balcony with balloons, a backpack filled with toys, slippers and a hat all of which you get to keep, kids robes and slippers in each room as well Colgate kids toothpaste, and a full suite of Johnston and Johnston products for the kids.  I could go on and on.

Other kids services included daily activities such as decorating cupcakes or make your own pizza.  Also there is a very large indoor kids zone that is essentially an indoor playground for in-climate weather or a change of pace.

Cleanliness - No matter where you looked staff was working on keeping the grounds and facility clean and in good repair.

The Pools - These were endless.  A dedicated pool to adults (this was not part of our package), a pool with the swim up bar (at normal pool temperature), a third pool close to the lobby that was kept at a very warm temperature for people like me that hate cold pools, and an over sized kids pool that was no deeper than 3 to 4 feet.  The pools spanned the entire property.  Lounge chairs were in abundance as well private cabanas (for a charge).  The pools were littered with staff ready to bring you an endless supply of drinks and food.  Sergio deserves a call out for going above and beyond.  Family Concierge guests also had a poolside hut with 6 types of sunscreens full of charge.  There also was a pottery painting hut that my daughter visited everyday (extra charge).  It was a break in the swimming and she loved the crafts.  The same quality extended to the beach, which is direct access from the hotel in many locations.  I would be remiss to forget to mention the shade.  I am not a direct sun guy for a any long period of time unless I am in water.  There were private huts with lounge chairs throughout the resort and we never had any difficulty procuring one. These are free of charge.

Food - So the very idea of all-inclusive and quality food would seem to be opposed to one another.  Again, not that case.  Most meals are eaten at buffet for shear convenience with kids.  Made to order Omelet bar, made to order Juice bar, and a self serve bloody Mary bar in the AM.  Endless fresh fruit, pancakes, french toast etc.  Lunch and dinner were very much the same.  At the restaurants it was very much the same quality.

So nowhere is perfect so here is the list of minor Issues
- Restaurants need to be better to get you in and out, and in particular most of the hostesses left something to be desired.  While the sushi place was top notch in quality, a few nights there were a number of empty tables and we were told the wait was 2 hours.  In particular one night we went to Fuego and showed up at 6pm with the family right when they opened.  It took the 15 minutes to seat us, and the meal took 2 hours.  With an 18 month old and right when the restaurant opens, this is just not acceptable.  On the opposite end though was Blue Agave.  The 2 times we ate there were were in an out in 45 minutes with a group of 13.  The staff at this particular restaurant had every down pat. 

- General Tips.
- For a week trip bring a two to three hundred in $5 bills.  For the level of service you get, these tips are earned and deserved.  I was passing them out like candy and the staff was very appreciative.
- There are 5 buildings, that are all connected.  Building 3 is the main building and while it is most convenient for access to food and the lobby, its also the loudest.  If you have young kids I would suggest staying away from building 3.  Building 1 is closest to the kids pool, building 5 is closest to the adults only pool.
- If you have kids under 5, bring UMBRELLA strollers! The resort is very large, and these were key for the wife and I.  We used them all the time and it made life far easier.  No need for anything larger, so long as you don't have a kid in a car seat.

reviews.author: Marysol L
reviews.title: AMAZING BIRTHDAY VACATION IN CANCUN (PARADISUS CANCUN ROYAL SERVICE)
reviews.text: I had an AMAZING visit to Cancun just last week (arrived on November 22nd).  I stayed in the Royal Service section of Paradisus Cancun and it was AMAZING and WELL WORTH the upgrade!!!  My suite was extremely spacious and view was captivating!!!  I want to thank my mayordomo (butler) Ivan for making my birthday vacation absolutely wonderful and memorable!!!  All of the hotel staff were exceptional; I wanted for nothing!!! There are a total of 9 restaurants to choose from and during my stay, reservations were not necessary (with the exception of Tempo (which is at an extra cost)).  Tempo was absolutely AMAZING - I had my birthday dinner there (opted for the 8-course wine pairing tasting dinner).  I also dined at Bana, Vento, Fuego, Palapa, Market Grill and Naos and the food at each place was delicious!  Drinks are premium and NOT watered down!  Live entertainment was FUN at Avenue Bar... There is a different show scheduled each night.  If you want an amazing getaway, book your stay at Paradisus Cancun today!!!!

reviews.author: KM004
reviews.title: Great Vacation at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Just returned from Paradisus Cancun.

Travelled with 4 adults and 2 kids - we had a great time!

The hotel is older but is being kept in great shape.  The rooms are comfortable - we stayed on the beach side so we had an amazing view.  That being said - the lagoon side would have great sunsets so I think you are good either way.

The buffet is huge with lots of options - the restaurants are also very good.  Bana has great atmosphere - you should definitely eat there at least once.

This is a huge resort - lots of rooms, lots of people.  We were up and at the beach everyday by 8am to make sure we could get chairs and some shade together.  The beach is noisy - music is loud, lots of activities going on and you are in Cancun - busy and noisy.  If this is not for you then I would pick a different location.

We were not part of the upgraded family service and still had a great time with great servic

reviews.author: Sistersasone
reviews.title: Amazing stay
reviews.text: We very recently stayed in the Royal Service part of the hotel and were upgraded as soon as we arrived which was a great start to an amazing holiday. The staff were exceptional, nothing was too much trouble inside and outside in the pool and beach area.....we wanted for nothing. There are plenty of restaurants to choose from with really good food, different bars and also a spa. There are vines hanging down from different levels that make for a tropical feel with coy carp and smaller fishes in a tropical area. Everywhere was kept very clean and tidy. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: 417nancym
reviews.title: Excellent Stay
reviews.text:
We had a fabulous stay at the Paradisus Cancun. The service is excellent. The beach is great at the Resort. There are lots of Palapas on the beach and we were very well attended to. We stayed Royal service and it was excellent. Our suite was large and very well appointed. The extra inculsions of Royal Service are worth it. The adults only private pool area had a great restaurant. The French Toast was amazing for breakfast. The fish options at lunch are really good as well. Overall our dining experience was good. We thought Vento was the best a la carte restaurant. 
This hotel smells amazing and the different areas have different aromas. I still think about how good it smelled.
We loved the beach and the beach service. We were spoiled here.

reviews.author: Mesja
reviews.title: Perfect!
reviews.text:
I have worked here and I have stayed as a guest.  I love the place from top to toe.  There is this ham/gruyere/cream cheese pastry puff turn over in the Deli that you will love! 

This hotel used to be Melia Cancun and now is Paradisus, a different brand from the same chain.  I love it here, the pool area is so relaxing and the view is breathtaking.  The grounds are well groomed, the foyer is impeccable and everything is nice, clean and perfect.

I loved it here! :D

reviews.author: Brian G
reviews.title: beautiful hotel with top class food and drink
reviews.text:
As said in title... its beautiful and the food and drink was amazing. 
We travelled as a couple (both 28). The hotel may be suited to older couples and families. We loved the hotel but entertainment was fancy shows at night for half hour... compared to our friends hotel were they had quiz's, games etc where the guests took part, won prizes and had great fun. Not hotels fault. We might just not be suited to the environment there. We like to get to know people and option to get lively at night. We did not get chattinh to any other guests in our week there... which is unusual for us! 

The hotel was luxury you'd expect at that price and would return for a relaxing week away again.

reviews.author: JudiWayzata
reviews.title: Family Concierge is Amazing
reviews.text:
Just got back from a week at this property.  We traveled with two other families, one with a 5 year old and one with a 19 month old.  
We were so amazed by the service, especially from our Concierge, Ramon.  We ended up with a sick baby who was running a high fever, and Ramon took such good care of us.  We also called the hotel doctor who is available 24/7.  That was such a relief to be able to have baby evaulated onsite by a doctor.
Ramon even gave us his personal number in case things worsened - which thankfully they didn't.  But what a comfort to know that such caring people are on staff at this hotel.  We also had a visit from Resi, who offered her personal phone number as well.
I haven't even mentioned the other wonderful amenities - the beach was perfection - the kiddie pool was great and where we spent a lot of our time.  It was nice having a bali bed as a central gathering spot for our families.  We would have preferred the pool was heated, but that seems to be missing at every hotel we have stayed at in Mexico. Our 5 year old loved the Kid's Zone and took part in several events.  
It was our first time at a Paradisus, but won't be our last.  A special thanks to Ramon - we will never forget your kindness!

reviews.author: floridagirl2223
reviews.title: Not a great spot for a wedding.
reviews.text:
We hosted a wedding party for 40+ in-house guests last weekend. 
We intended to have a royal service room for my husband, daughter and I, but found out that no one under 18 could stay in that tower, so we opted for what we were told was the family option of a similar service; the "Family Concierge Service". It basically entails having a cell phone that connects you directly with your butler. We thought this would help us get dinner reservations since we had a large group, but upon arrival (and after it was paid in full) we were told their restaurants no longer accepts reservations, and it's first come first served. We found the family concierge to be a waste of money. They didn't always answer, the reception was not clear and their English was difficult to understand in person and almost impossible on a staticky cell phone. They were supposed to leave cookies and milk in the room for kids (we had to call once bc they forgot) but this is not really any added luxury since the resort is all inclusive and cookies and dessert are everywhere. Our reservation was for 3 and were were told the one bedroom jr suite would accommodate, but we found out upon arrival the jr suites all only had one king bed. If we wanted 2 beds we'd have to get a cot or a double room which wasn't a jr suite which we paid for... It would be a much smaller room with only one bathroom. So we opted to stick with the one bed and cot option which was turned into my daughter sleeping with us every night bc the bed was so hard she couldn't sleep in it. Seems like they may have offered us an upgrade since we're were misled to believe it would sleep 3 (and were hosting a wedding!) but that didn't happen. 

The structure itself seems old. Lots of AC problems (ours had to be repaired during our stay) there were puddles in many of the common areas and walkways from leaking AC units.  They were very nice and punctual repairing it though. Our balcony door was corroded and wind seeped through which didn't really both us, but I could see how if could bother those who need it quiet to sleep. The curtains were thick and darkened the room well, but ours were badly mildewed on the inside. The showers were a bit of a challenge - the handheld and shower worked but the water wouldn't come directly from the faucet to draw a bath, has to use the handheld to fill the tub. Our room had plenty of space and closets were large but only 3 drawers for 3 people was insufficient. It has 2 flat screen TVs. The thing that bugged us most about the room was on the balconies there are very large planters filled with dirt - intended for flowers/plants. Some rooms did have greenery in their planters but ours did not. It was very unsightly to have big containers of dirt diminishing our beautiful view. We were in building 4, which is a nice location - away from the noisy club and centrally located. It is next to building 5, Royal Service. As I mentioned were hosting a wedding and the majority of our guests were in the Royal Service building. I think royal service may actually be worth the extra money bc they have a private pool, keyed entry into their private building, as well as butler service. This is a very large resort and the beach is amazingly beautiful. I would not recommend having a wedding here however bc it's just too big, MANY things with the wedding did not go as planned - too many to even begin to mention. My step-daughter is an event planner in Denver so she knows what she's doing.  Our experience was filled with miscommunications.  

The food was mediocre, service was hit or miss - some places were fast, some slow. We ordered burgers one day at lunch and after 45minutes they finally arrived and were awful - processed meat and under cooked. Room service for lunch was the best bet: Tuna burger, chicken ciabatta, and key lime pie were our favorites. If you like good sushi, don't go to the sushi restaurant; you'll be disappointed. The Mole was probably our best meal. My husband had grouper and I had shrimp. 

We loved playing volleyball on the beach at 11 and 3 everyday. Nice court and plenty of players made it a lot of fun.  The tennis court needs to be resurfaced, I felt it was actually more of a liability rather than a value added feature, it's peeling up and unsafe for competitive play. 

The beach is beautiful, but there are not enough chairs on the beach or pool for all guests. It was a race every morning to get a spot - really hated this!  There was a lot of seaweed and other resorts had employees raking it up, would have been nice if this resort did that also. Workout room was very nice and  well equipped, but no one under 18 allowed so this again was an inconvenience for us. 

The staff was friendly, the shows were entertaining, the atrium is filled with beautiful greenery and tropical smells.  

One of our wedding guests was a late addition and didn't get in with our "group rate", and he actually got a better price than the rest of us online. That was a complete slap in the face for me who spent 10s of thousands of dollars at the resort during the week and our guests likely brought in even more.  I suppose we were expecting too much since there were so many great trip advisor reviews. We have traveled extensively and stayed at many resorts throughout the Caribbean and Mexico, and I feel this resort was not worthy of any more than 3 stars.

reviews.author: Ngọc B
reviews.title: Great Experience/Royal Service
reviews.text: I am a CTC and I had an opportunity to stay at this resort from Nov 8 to Nov 12, 2014 to celebrate my birthday with my hubby. The entire stay was complimentary from Melia and I would like to thank them for a wonderful experience. From the resort to the beach, restaurants and bars, everything was so clean, nice and perfect. Food was so good. Royal Service was a nice way to be spoiled for a few days with private check in area, lounge  and premium drinks. I love the beach, the pool and these Bali beds. At night you can walk along the beach and see all these beautiful hotels near by. The staff here so friendly and makes you feel like you want to stay longer. Property is on a perfect location, the hotel and it's staff will wow you. Life is good when you stay at Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Alina on Tour
reviews.title: Good place for a beach vacation!
reviews.text:
We stayed in Paradisus for 14 days in a room with an ocean view. In general, we liked the following hotel and would recommend it. 
Advantages: Here your can find different restaurants with various types of cuisine where food was really good, big swimming pools and wide beach, good service and all-inclusive. The hotel looks appealing inside. Nice location (also, not far from two good shopping malls as Kukulcan Plaza and La Isla shopping village). 
Disadvantages: Some furniture in the room is old and broken, and there were all the time towels missing. Sometimes, our room was not cleaned properly. Also, when there is a high season, it is hard to find deck chairs next to the beach or pool. Therefore, book them as early as possible in the morning..

reviews.author: Tina V
reviews.title: The truth about the Paridisus Cancun
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Paridisus (Melia hotel chain) from August 22- August 29 2014. The outside of this huge resort is 5 pyramids with a purple tip on each pyramid that lights up at night. Purple seems to be the consistent colour used throughout the resort. Grounds are well cared for and beautifully manicured. Walking in the front doors was very impressive. The beautiful purple flowers in vases at the entrance, and beautiful modern decor makes this hotel grand.The vines hanging from every floor all around the entire hotel are magnificent! I can only imagine how much care goes into those plants that give the hotel a feeling of being in an exotic jungle. Even a couple of the restaurants are hidden in this vast array of plants.This hotel made me feel like I was going to a spa, by the way the staff is dressed. (The high collars and complete white uniform gives an Asian inspired look yet very comfortable feeling.) The scent walking in was extremely strong and not pleasing to all, but unforgettable. Again gives the feeling that you are in a spa. Its too bad nobody who works at the resort has no idea what the name is of that scent. The scents are different inside and out of the hotel. ( I asked many people that work there yet staff was never trained to know such information. That and staff don't know that there is a pay phone in the hotel that they are working in.) I feel that staff need to be more trained by management when asked about such small yet important details. 
 The concierge and front desk staff were nice. They do try to get you to upgrade to Royal Service but didn't push for it.  The hotel gives you a really cool bracelet to wear. Its not your typical ugly cheap bands that are bothersome. This one is a black, silky string with a brown wooden circular logo of the Paridisus. When checking in, I was bothered about the fact that they did not have my room ready. I went to eat with the kids at the buffet and still had to wait. They tried to compensate by giving my kids back packs filled with sunscreen, t-shirt, toothpaste, toothbrush, some sand toys etc. To be honest, it was a sweet gesture, but after being on an airplane with kids, you really just want to go to your room and settle in. I think they should have upgraded me to Royal service for the inconvenience. Apparently, I was told that they didn't have enough ocean view rooms ready. Finally after a few hours, my room was ready. Room was properly cleaned everyday, I had no complaints. Decor was nice not tacky. Ocean view is definitely, the way to go. Watching the sun rise every morning was one of my highlights. 
   Entertainment was fun with dancers, every night and live music just before dinner. Live music was not so good, dancers were entertaining and professional. I did not like the location of the entertainment. Located in Red Lounge. The lounge is really nice. Its more the shape of the room that was not comfortable. If your not sitting near the dancers then you can't see what is happening because its shape. Its a small and crowded space and I feel even for the entertainment they needed more space, although they did a great job making it work. Perhaps the management can work on finding or creating a more open space.
   This hotel has 10 restaurants, but you should know that Tempo is not part of the all inclusive. Also if you do not upgrade to the Royal Service, then La Palapa is off limits too. There is also a restaurant that is adults only, called La Perla. So for us it was really 7 out of 10 restaurants that were accessible. We tried all 7 restaurants and they were all good, but we really enjoyed the buffet everyday. The buffet offered us enough variety and tastes to satisfy our needs. Nice presentation and flavours. They tried to incorporate flavours from around the world to add more diversity, which I love. Kids really enjoyed it. There is nothing worse than going to a buffet where the food is the same everyday and bland in taste. 
   Pools are very nice and very big. Nice swim up bar. Again one pool was for Royal Service members. Music was played by D.J but not all day long. They should change that. The pool entertainment staff did their best to get people involved in daily activities but it was a hard and small crowd to please. Bar staff and wait staff also did a great job pleasing guests. Making sure guests were taken care of. I have some names I want to mention but I don't know who is who. Sorry guys!!! Too many spanish names and the printing is unclear. Hope I have the spelling right!! Enrique Aloudia A.K.A, Jose is the waiter who took care of us. Really nice guy. The entertainment staff I believe is Arturo, Angel and Kodrigo or Rodrigo is the entertainment staff. I may have mixed up who is who, I apologize! Nice guys who have rhythm and try to motivate all their guests to do exercise and sports.
   Beach is beautiful but waters were a little rough. If you are part of the Royal Service you can have your own butler. Save your spots on the beach and at the pool early in the morning to get shaded areas otherwise you'll be under hot beating sun all day!!! 
     TIPS for management- Train staff to know all the ins and outs of the hotel. When staff is trained well and always have an answer for guests, guests feel special and that they are well cared for. Also this hotel should either be more family friendly or more adult friendly but trying to be both isn't really satisfying. Keep up the good care and maintenance that goes into keeping this hotel looking its best.
     TIPS for travellers- Organize and book your restaurants ahead of time. Get ocean view!!! Main Building on a high floor will give you closer access to all restaurants and less walking to all restaurants and shops in the hotel. Better for kids. You can book all your extra curricular activities by walking across the street in a small little plaza. Its cheaper than booking from hotel. I highly recommend you try any of the wonderful activities that Cancun has to offer. They are all great and create wonderful memories. Buffet gets very busy after 9:30am so try to get out early but save your spots outside first. Shopping is very close to all main shopping areas, you can take transit.

reviews.author: Gina
reviews.title: Great Place To Be
reviews.text:
There's a lot we could say about this hotel and resort but I will try and condense the review
The hotel is huge five pyramids with the main one hosting the bars and restaurants and the fith one being for Royal Service guests which we were
The hotel is beautifully located and extremely clean with the majority of staff being very pleasant and there to assist if you need them to in fact the staff more than assist to make this hotel a nice place to stay
The restaurants and bars are all very good out if the fourteen nights we didn't have a bad meal and also were never refused a booking our fav was Venti however we did also pay to dine at Tempo which has a Michelin star chef and that even though not cheap was a very special night ( the wine is outrageously priced)
In terms if the Royal Service is it worth it hard to say as we never compared prices when we booked as the 'no children' appealed so much to us what I would say is this
Accommodation was excellent we had room 5605 and even though facing the lagoon and with site of a petrol station and McDonalds in the distance was excellent the service from the concierge and room service faultless however the breakfast I thought was poor unless you went to La Pallapa which is for RS guests and overlooks the ocean it is really nice to eat there but if you are going to lunch there then for me the indoor RS dining area could serve the same menu
That said they create a very tropical atmosphere in RS and the afternoon bar open from I think 2.00 to 9.00pm was excellent and again the staff who worked on it brilliant 
Now what I wasn't to sure about was the Butler Service first off you don't get a cell phone to contact him by well we didn't and we didn't see anyone else with one I wasn't too sure what it was all about really as I don't want anyone to unpack for me or do my ironing but that said he did get tickets for Coco Bongo he did book Tempo could I have done both myself yes but it just made staying there that little but special his name was Rodriquez probably spelt wrong and a charming man the role suits him
Would I recommend the hotel definitely would I recommend RS service without a doubt for two weeks of 24/7 drink and very good food we paid £3k for two and I say it was good value would it be if you didn't drink alcohol not sure 
Would I go again absolutely even though there are many places to see in the world
I hope you find this review helpful and if you have any questions don't hesitate to ask
One last thing if you are British than take Peso's for tipping as the staff rely on these and are very appreciative of them
Thanks to all at the hotel who made our stay very enjoyable

reviews.author: 228lejlam
reviews.title: 3 Year Anniversary
reviews.text: This resort was pretty much amazing! Stayed for 10 days and 9 nights. We mainly went to relax and have a good time since my husband and i didnt take a vacation since our honeymoon.
