Love the atmosphere, workers and the resort is fairly big. One thing that was a little frustrating is that there is only place to eat breakfast.. So it gets really crowded in there certain morning. Also we were rained on 2 days and the resort didn't provide any activities or other things to do around the resort. But other then that everything was fabulous! Will definitely stay again!

reviews.author: Kelvin R
reviews.title: Great holiday, great hotel!
reviews.text:
We have (my wife and I) have just got back from a 10 day stay at the Paradisus and wanted to add a few comments for the hotel staff and to anyone wanting to go.  We did upgrade to the Royal Service and it was worth every penny!

Our room was great, the food and drink fantastic - choice and quality all around plus quantity if you wanted it no problems.

Location is excellent but most of all the hotel have clearly worked hard with the staff - ever single one we came across was efficient and friendly and although they were all great I would like to single out a few in case it matters to the hotel management.......Ivan our butler, Franciso (Terrazas) and Eddie down at the pool and in the Royal Service area - all fantastic who always wanted to make sure all was well.  These guys could not do more for us - thanks!

If you are struggling to decide from a load of very good looking hotels you won't be disappointed here - there is enough for anyone.  We would return for a follow up with no hesitation!

Well done to everyone there!

Kelvin and Mandy (UK)

reviews.author: akrus
reviews.title: I love Paradisus!
reviews.text: My husband and I love this hotel.  The staff was the best part.  They all remembered our names and our drinks.  Everyone that passed by us spoke, whether to say hello or ask how we were.  We are definitely going back.  Look forward to seeing Christian, our bartender and Sophino our waiter!

reviews.author: Sherry19841105
reviews.title: Disorganized and disoriented dinner!
reviews.text:
Their trick is to make you wait between 1 - 2 hours for a group of 4. This encourages you to eat at the cheaper buffet. Even though multiple tables are available.

No concept of joining tables to seat bigger groups even though multiple are available.

Portion size is surprisingly very small - especially the entrees.

Highly inefficient wait staff.

If you get a baby sitter to enjoy a quiet dinner - make sure you have the sitter for atleast 3 - 4 hours as it takes forever to get seated and significantly long for food to arrive.

Drinks are extremely watered down and not premium quality.

reviews.author: Peggy P
reviews.title: Beautiful and stellar service
reviews.text:
Visit Oct 29 2014 
This resort is top notch. As a travel agent I have been to many luxury properties. The service is what sets it apart from others .i recommend Royal Service, you won't regret it ! Our butler Kervik and pool concierge ,Francisco made our stay there amazing . They're  attention to detail was amazing.  They we tentative beyond belief and met every need we requested. Kervik even surprised us with a romantic set up on our balcony when I mentioned we didn't need restaurant plans and were just ordering room service(also included) 
The facilities were impeccable and surroundings so beautiful. The adults only Royal Club provided a gorgeous setting and bar/food services in lobby all day! The spa was so Zen ..and soothing 
Being met upon arrival by friendly staff and given champagne before meeting our escort to Royal Service Concierge made us feel so welcomed and pampered.
The entertainment was wonderful and plenty of restaurant choices 
Thanks to everyone at resort for being so friendly and accommodating -from checkin to housekeeping to restaurant staff and beyond ... The signature greeting From every employee touched me and impressed me The staff here is amazing !
A big hello and thank you to Kervik and. Framcisco from Peggy and Keith !
I would highly recommend this resort .

reviews.author: mary h
reviews.title: Paradisus in Cancun was paradise!!!
reviews.text:
We vacationed at Paradisus Cancun the week of November 8th thru the 15th and had a fabulous time.The resort was beautiful, many restaurants to choose from and the service was excellent. I was also pleasantly surprised at how clean they keep the resort. The beach was gorgeous and it had many cabanas available for rent. We spent most of our time at the pool, which overlooks the beach and Victor, our server, was always available to provide more drinks for us. He was awesome!!
Carlos at the Avenue bar was a great guy, friendly and provided excellent service to our large group. We found ourselves going back to that bar several nights b/c the service and Carlos was so friendly.
We can't say enough about the beautiful beach and the incredible cleanliness and beauty of the resort. We will definitely go back for another visit!

reviews.author: fotograferswife
reviews.title: Club Melia at Paradisus Cancun Bad Experience....Hotel Great
reviews.text:
We just returned from a week on a timeshare exchange through RCI to the Club Melia at the Paradisus Cancun. Please note, this review will speak to our experience with the Club staff and also the hotel overall. The two experiences were vastly different.

My husband and I have been timeshare owners for years and are well aware that the check in time is normally fairly strictly adhered to so I had emailed Ivette Sanchez, the club manager, prior to our arrival to query whether there was a spot to store our luggage and a place to change as we were arriving at 7:00 a.m. and check in is at 4:00 p.m. I also asked her to make a reservation for us at Tempo Restaurant in the Paradisus for the last night of our holiday. 

We went to the club check in desk when they opened at 8:00 a.m. to get our all inclusive bracelet. The delightful lady at the desk (the only one we met associated with the club) told us that they had a lagoon view room that we would be able to check into at 10:00 a.m. or a partial ocean view that would be available at noonish. We opted for the lagoon view room and went to have some breakfast, see the resort etc. When we returned to the check in desk at 10, the lady we had been speaking with was busy with other guests so we went to the next available service agent. In this case, I use the term service loosely.  She told us that our room would not be ready until much later. We did state that we had been told to return at 10 and that our room would be ready. At this point, Maria, the supervisor got involved with the conversation and said that none of her staff would have ever told us a room could be ready at 10 as housekeeping did not start until 9:30 (strange because we saw housekeeping every morning at 8) At this point, the first person we dealt with was available and went to Maria and explained that yes, in fact, she had said the lagoon view room would be ready at 10 but had found that the partial ocean view had been vacated and so she had sent housekeeping to that room for us instead and that it should be done at 11:00. An apology for calling us liars would have been appreciated at this point from Maria but was not forthcoming.  

A half hour later we were in our room very gratefully.  We spent a lovely day on the beach and returned to our room at 4ish. Shortly after returning, we received a call from bell service asking if we would like our luggage delivered. We explained that we had received our luggage that morning. 5 minutes after that call, another guest came into our room. Needless to say, they were as surprised to be entering an already occupied room as we were to have someone coming into our room.  

After dinner, we returned to our room to find both our keys were deactivated and no, I do not store them next to anything that would demagnetise them. As the club desk was closed, a maintenance worker let us into our room. The next morning we went to the club desk to have our keys replaced, explained that someone had walked into our room and that the keys must have been deactivated at that point and were told by the person at the desk that wouldn't have happened and that we must have had the keys next to a cell phone.  She then sent us to the hotel front desk (2 buildings away) to have our keys reactivated rather than having some keys brought over for us.

This strange lack of service continued. In our one week vacation, we had a pool towel taken from our room by the night maids and it took two phone calls and one hour to have it replaced. We had our keys deactivated again later in the week. We received a bill and check out notice two days before we were to be checking out. We were promised a welcome gift of a beach bag which never came. Our dinner reservations were not made for us. And perhaps worst of all, when we shared our concerns with the club marketing people and were assured we would be contacted, it took 3 days to receive a phone call message and another two to actually connect with the club manager Ivette. 

Now, on the positive side, the room was lovely though not large. The partial kitchen was well equipped. The Jacuzzi on the deck was very nice. The toiletries were by Thierry Mugler. And, we did receive a bottle of champagne and strawberries on our last day (our anniversary) and complimentary transfer to the airport to make up for the service we received by the club desk staff. 

So much for the Club. The hotel was great. The al a carte restaurants were fabulous. We went to Vento twice-both for the food and the incredible service. Victor was our waiter the first evening. He was attentive in the extreme and made great recommendations. Thank you Victor. Mole offered great Mexican contemporary food in a wonderful environment although service was a bit rushed. Blue Agave served great tacos and pozole. And Tempo was an unforgettable experience (see separate review). The buffet was a buffet in a large all inclusive. Yes, the comments about food in the food stations being cold is absolutely correct, however there were plenty of options and they did have some really nice food. The soups were lovely, always freshly cooked meats, lots of salads etc. And for those unwilling to try some new foods, you can always get a burger or hot dog. 

The fragrance that people speak of is certainly there. Some of it I think is citronella to repel mosquitoes. The incense they burn at night around the central atrium is much too strong and conflicts with other smells.

We booked a bali bed for 5 days of our stay and it was definitely worth it. Knowing we had a spot reserved in the morning and that we would still have a place after going for lunch was worth the minimal cost. 

The hotel could benefit from providing some training to bartenders as we had the same drink made 4 different ways at 2 bars and only one of them was right. Consistency would be nice. Also, some of the restaurant supervisors would benefit from additional training-particularly Ignacio in Vento. Also, it would be nice to be able to get a bottle of wine to take to your hotel room. This is a strange policy as you can have as many glasses as you want, but not a bottle.

We would like to pass along some special thanks to Jose, Christian and Gerardo at the bali bed pool area for making our time there so enjoyable and special. Thanks as well to Gerardo at the buffet at dinner time. Victor at Vento-you made our evening one we will never forget. Thank you.

All in all a good stay and worth the $83.00 per day all inclusive fee however, not worth what the fee will be in the new year ($200/day). Dollar for dollar, if I compare experiences, I prefer the Riu chain. Although the food at the Riu is not as good, overall it is a better experience. 

Despite my overall rating, because of service received from club staff, we will not return to the Club Melia at the Paradisus and would not recommend this resort as an exchange. The hotel is very different and we would book into the hotel.

reviews.author: NerissaB451
reviews.title: After three days I have decided to leave early
reviews.text:
I should have read the hotel reviews more critically but we stayed at the Paradisus Palma Real in Punta Cana, and loved it! I really did not see a need to comb through traveler revews for this hotel - unfortunately.
The hotel itself is beautiful and humongous
The food is ok. There is decent variety 
The room is ok but nothing spectacular
The WiFi in room is good, the range is not great. Hence, it difficult to use devices in the pool area...
Definately not wowed by the service. Some of the cleaning staff actually seem BITER!
The place is overun with kids. Running everywhere! We probably should have stayed at the "adults only" location
The coffee (cappuchino) is great! 

I have had enough and we are checking out tomorrow.  We will check in at the Paradisus Playa Del Carmen - La Perla and give an update soon. Hopefully, we wont be dissapointed.

reviews.author: Jesika A
reviews.title: Paradisus is really PARADISE!
reviews.text: Such a beautiful hotel, from the moment you walk in you will be blown away! The decor is beautiful and the atmosphere is so relaxing! Food at the restaurants were very good and the beach is GORGEOUS! I would definitely recommend this hotel. You won't go wrong with this hotel! First time in Cancun and when I go back I wouldn't mind staying here!

reviews.author: Missy B
reviews.title: Relaxing and Luxurious Vacation!!
reviews.text:
This review is a little overdue. My Fiance and I stayed at Paradisus Cancun for 7 nights (11/8/14-11/15/14, We stayed in Royal service with an Ocean View room. For the minute we walked into the hotel we loved it. The hotel itself is stunning. Our Butler Ivan was very helpful and thoughtful, even giving us chocolate covered strawberries one night. He even went as far as to make some phone calls for me regarding appointments I had while we were there.  The Beach is amazing, the water is warm and clear. We received excellent service Particularly from Edier and Francisco at La Palapa, both on the beach and by the pool, we were never without a drink or food while we were there. We visited all of the restaurants while we were there and had great service and food at all of them. We also want to point out Oscar at Naos who always had a smile and even gave us drinks to go for the ride back to airport. Everyone at the Royal Service Concierge desk were exceptionally helpful, especially when it came to printing up some vouchers for our excursions. 

We were there looking at the hotel for a possible wedding venue as well while we were there and Lorena, the wedding department manager was very helpful, we got to see several weddings while we were there and will more than likely be booking this hotel for our wedding as well. I cannot express enough how friendly everyone was not just at the hotel, but everywhere we went in the Riviera Maya. There will always be people who will nit pick about things( we saw some while we were there), but this is vacation! and I highly recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Alicat80cat
reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.text:
I am in my 50's and have done over 30 trips south including  St Lucia, Turks and Caicos, Cuba, DR, Florida and Mexico - the latter about 10 times over the past 5 years always at 4+-5 star properties:  Excellence Playa Mujeres (5x), Valentin Imperial, Gran Bahia Principe Akumal.  

We were at the Paradisus Cancun in early November. 

Property:  I have avoided the cheek by jowl hotels in the Hotel Zone - glad that we didn't this time. Beach is far better than Excellence Playa Mujeres which is located near a marina and the water is not clean.  Similar to Valentin beach but less windy.   There are 5 pyramid-shaped buildings with Bldg 3 as the main one housing the restaurants, main reception etc.  It can be very noisy and even in November, there were alot of families/kids.  Noise levels are higher than other resorts as it is completely enclosed with interior atriums in the centre and hotel rooms around the circumference so it echoes.  But having the buildings enclosed is a real benefit if you are going during rainy season as there are short walkways connecting the buildings and there is no need to go outdoors for meals etc. Handicap access is somewhat restrictive.  

Royal Service: Is contained to Bldg 5/Adults Only and is very quiet.  If you want guaranteed peace and quiet, RS is a must at this resort.   When we were there, people were very quiet and respectful of others - no drunken  pool parties.  The RS section has  its own pool, beach section, concierge service.  They have a buffet with full hot breakfast, lunch and light dinners.  Coffee/tea and alcohol (top shelf) all day where you can help yourself and either dine in the atrium or bring it to your room.  

Emerald Club:  For anyone wondering what Emerald Club is - it is not with the Hotel but Air Transat.  You get a few additional perks such as direct transfer to the hotel.  

Hotel Transfer: We had Emerald Club but opted out of the "direct transfer" - it was late at night and while we would be the first be dropped off, it still meant waiting for 20 other people. Direct transfer is not private transfer.  Unless you book ahead with a shuttle service, a taxi costs about 65 USD to the Hotel Zone.  Return is always cheaper - about $35 USD.  A prebooked private transfer is about $80 USD both ways. 

Butler service is fantastic.  You are given a cell phone and can call your butler for anything you need.  Our butler was Galdino who was personable and thoughtful. He was there to greet us when we arrived and throughout the entire week he kept checking in to see how we were doing. We did tip well but he provided excellent service and we found out they work very hard and only get 1 day off a week.  As the minibar does not contain wine normally, he made sure it was always stocked.  One day we came in to a note from him and chocolate covered strawberries.    These are likely standard touches for RS customers which is impressive. 

Service/Staff:  Generally, we found staff here better than Excellence Playa Mujeres or Valentin - more willing to accommodate, faster service, better trained. Very professional but friendly. Despite what other reviews have said, we found there was NO expectation for tips and, in fact, we noticed that many in RS/Adults Only did not tip on the beach but got the same level of prompt and friendly service.  

Beach: Royal Service section is adults only and the staff do a very good job enforcing this. A number of times, non-RS families with kids or couples found their way and were asked to leave immediately.  Excellent beach service with butlers dressed head to toe in white pants/long sleeved shirts.  We tipped - about $5-10 per day depending on how much we were using them.  You can order lunch right on the beach or there is a beachside restaurants that does Mexican fare.  They will also bring you a pail of ice and bottled waters, set up your chairs for you etc. 

There are no towel games in the Adults Only section that we could see.  Unlike other resorts we have been to, there are a lot of balibeds - about 35 of them- and must be reserved 1-2 days in advance.  However, if you go to the pool concierge after 11am, there are good chances you can snag one although this might be because we were there in early November. 

Rooms:  Unlike some newer resorts such as the Excellence which are more spacious, the rooms are typical standard hotel size - rectangular with a fully separate bathroom.  While not large, they were renovated in 2012 and are modern and updated extremely well. Comfortable, nice beds with overhead reading lights, flat screen TVs,  marble bathrooms, robes/slippers, lovely bath amenities etc.   We had booked  Royal Service Lagoon View but were upgraded to an Oceanfront room thanks to our travel agent who put in a request on our behalf as it was our first time at this property.  Lagoon view rooms overlook the parking lot and main boulevard with the Lagoon on the other side of the road.  Oceanfront was amazing. So glad we were upgraded. A big THANK YOU to Lazaro, the Royal Service Manager.  This alone is incentive for us to return. 

Balconies:  We place great emphasis on private spacious balconies.  Probably one of the best in the Cancun area.  They are stacked so you don't have a full overhang from the balcony above you - open to the sky and stars.  They are also very private with full walls in between.  

Food: Okay but not the best we have had at all-inclusives. The best restaurants were Vento (tapas) and the International Buffet.  

Room Service: Excellent.  Delivered within 35 minutes every time except our checkout day when it was busier. 

WiFi:  Excellent.

Stores:  Meh.  A few tourist stores and 1 jewellry store.  In other hotels, they are open to bargaining - not this store and the quality was not great.  Better to go to Playa del Carmen or La Islay Mall which is a 3-5 minute cab ride. 

A general store on the first level/Building 3 has the basics but TripAdvisor reviewers are right- what they charge for suntan lotion is crazy.  $34??  RS has free suntan lotion available at the pool concierge but you must apply it there.  

Excursions: Aquaworld is right across the street and has a booth just outside the Market Grill by the pool.  We did a day trip snorkeling on the Mayan Reef which you reach by boat through the Lagoon.  The snorkelling is escorted and you must wear a life vest.  They provide drinks but no food on the boat. 

What can be improved?   

There is NO way to get a cash advance in either pesos or USD at the hotel.  There is only 1 ATM machine and it was broken the entire week we were there.  Very frustrating.  Galdino our butler had to drive me in a golf cart to the nearest ATM machine in a convenience store off the property.   The only reason I was getting more money was to tip staff as they were so wonderful but one shouldn't have to do that.    

Directions:  A picky point but we had challenges finding Spa, access walkway to other buildings etc which could be improved with signage.   

Summary:  Service at Paradisus Cancun is impeccable both at RS and generally.  Staff go out of their way to ensure you are taken care of.  Beach/rooms/balconies were excellent and Royal Service perks were much more than at other resorts.  I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: INdonye
reviews.title: Great Family Vacation
reviews.text:
We stayed at this resort from November 5th to 11th (husband and 2 kids aged 7 and 5) and my parents. First impressions were great. The hotel is well set back from the road with a small golf course in the front. It is made up of 4-5 pyramids that are all connected (although you can not access the Royal Service pyramid if you aren't staying in Royal Service rooms). The lobby is in the main pyramid (#3) and is large and airy and very welcoming.  We had lagoon-facing rooms on the top floor of the main pyramid (#3814 and 3815). The rooms were spacious and the beds were big enough for 2 adults and 2 kids and very comfortable. There was a nice sitting area as well and a balcony with one lounge chair. It would have been nice to have more chairs so we could all sit out. The lagoon view was actually nice - didn't regret not paying extra for the ocean-view. The bathroom had a large tub and separate toilet area - it was OK but could use some minor upgrades. There were plenty of towels for the family and housekeeping passed by every evening to see if any more were needed. They provide lots of toiletries: toothbrushes, shaving kits, make-up removal kits, loofahs etc. There was a mini fridge that was stocked daily as needed (pop, beer, water, chips and oreos). The down side of our room location was that they overlooked the main atrium, so you could hear the music/entertainment that started at around 10pm, but we slept OK, but keep that in mind if you are a light sleeper.

There are 9 restaurants to choose from (although 1 or 2 are adults only). NAOS, the international buffet served breakfast, as well as lunch and dinner. There was a huge selection of yummy food to choose from - great especially if travelling with kids. We ate there most of the time. We had amazing waiters: thank you Oscar Gamboa, Alex Para (breakfast at NAOS), Eder Alejandro and supervisor Abram! Your service was exceptional (we left tips most of the time because of this). We also ate at the Market Grill which serves a selection of salads and BBQ.
 
There are 4 pools, one with a swim-up bar. There is a kiddie pool, although it didn't have any fun features like slides. The kids club was good (at least my kids seemed to enjoy it).
The beach was amazing, huge with nice white powdery sand and almost no sea-weed. There were lots of beach loungers. There were also lots of bali beds, but you have to pay for them (I believe $50/day).
There were also lots of activities available e.g. snorkeling.
All in all, it was a great vacation and we would definitely stay here again.

reviews.author: Anthony H
reviews.title: Holiday vacation
reviews.text:
Great experience, very friendly staff, perfect place to relax and enjoy the sun.
Plenty of choices for food. The best restaurant we found was VENTO. Excellent service from our waiter Victor. Great food and wine, highly recommended. Nothing was too much trouble.
Hotel staff were very accommodating in assisting in all our needs, especially when helping with an elderly gentleman with walking issues.
Well worth a visit.

reviews.author: Jennipher B
reviews.title: Great food, great staff but lacking
reviews.text:
This is a beautiful property, great food. We are part of club media and this resort certainly did not meet the expectation we have come to expect from a club melia resort. 

The restaurants all have good food, but the hotel lacks "personality". There is nowhere for travellers to congregate and meet others at the resort. No sports bar, no lobby bars everyone seems very isolated.

Club Melia, we got no introduction to the resort, no explanation of the restaurants let alone what we were entitled to as media members. We found it to be quite unprofessional from the check in and thought our stay. We have 2 more days here, and although we will enjoy it, I do not foresee any great improvement to change my mind. 

The staff is wonderful, and most speak English but for many it is very limited. 

Shopping is a 3 km walk or a quick bus or taxi ride (about $10) 
The Expedia travel agent in the hotel, was on the phone and wouldn't even acknowledge our existence.
The one "convenience store" in the hotel will only accept credit card or pesos, we discovered that the store is rented for the hotel and not part of it but I'm sorry that store reflects on your hotel whether it is run by the hotel or not.
Feel free to email questions, I would love to hear from the hotel as well as club media

reviews.author: DJacksonVa
reviews.title: Return trip to Cancun
reviews.text:
in 2005 we bought a time share here and have not been back since 2007. We were very pleased and surprised to see all the improvements. The resort has always been beautiful, but what has really changes is the quality of the food and the service. 

As most travelers have found, the quality of food at most all-inclusive resorts is fair to poor. This was a shocking exception, the food was fresh, high quality and they had lots of variety in your options. The restaurants were all very good !

The service was superb from the time you walk into the resort, to the waiters, to even the staff bringing drinks by the pool and on the beach. A good example was Sofonia who made our time on the beach even more enjoyable as he brought a bucket with Ice with bottled waters along with a steady supply of drinks.

My wife and I were looking for a relaxing get away of doing nothing but enjoying the sun, reading, sleeping and enjoying ourselves. If you are looking for a relaxing get away, I do not know how you could have a better experience than what we had at the Paradisus Cancun.

reviews.author: Rastko K
reviews.title: Best relaxing time ever
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun offered more than we anticipated. Great a la card restaurants (7) with top food selection + the service was unbelievable!
24 hour room service which we have used only once :)
Beach is great, we always got free deck chairs and almost always a free shadow. Great Service on the beach!
If you book an all inclusive food and drinks, you won't spend any money! International drinks also free. Huge bar, night club, ... It's really a big facility which runs were smoothly and on high standards.

reviews.author: markcJ1427AD
reviews.title: nice spot. great value. nice beaches. perfect staff. decent food
reviews.text:
I pretty much summed up the trip in the title here. Great family trip. Husband, wife, and 2 yr old. Had a blast and also relaxed. The guys at the pool bar were great. I want to specially send out thanks to Gerardo and Sofriano for always making us laugh and giving us the best service. There sense of humor was unmatched.(BABYMAKER) Good people. fun times. See you guys!

Your recent guest
MARCO POLLO

reviews.author: FRANKIE M
reviews.title: GREAT VACATION.
reviews.text: Well to begin I will like to say that the hotel was magnificent very nice, fancy and sophisticated.very clean and well kept, the staff was great they were all very friendly and welcoming.the food was good but in the buffet restaurant NAOS certain foods that needed to be hot were not hot at ALL.AMAZING service at the pool bar by the bartenders, SALVADOR, SAMUEL, GERARDO, AND MIGUEL, they were so amazing the remembered us and our names through the whole stay. they were always aware of when we needed more drinks I never had to ask for a another drink unless I was changing it up they were the best...also at AVENUE BAR inside on the 1st floor bartenders CARLOS AND RANDY were also great.. will recommend this place to anyone, I had a great time for my first time in Mexico and ready to go back...

reviews.author: Richard B
reviews.title: Fantastic service and very relaxing experience!
reviews.text: We had a group for a birthday and stayed in the Royal Service area of the hotel.  It was great.  The facility is very nice, we enjoyed being on the ground floor and found it very easy to get around.  The beach is beautiful and the thatch umbrellas provide great shade.  The waiter service extends to the beach as well.  The pool and bali beds were excellent particularly if you want to stay out of the sun some of the time.  You could stay on the bali bed all day and only get up to go to the bathroom!  They bring you drinks and food and you never go long without being asked if you need something.  Michael at the pool was the best waiter ever!  With the Royal Service you get a butler who is there to take care of whatever you can come up with!  Hervik was excellent and our group put him through the paces.  He was a perfect professional even when our group got crazy after some drinks.  This was a great relaxing vacation for us.  We stayed for a week and never left the resort!

reviews.author: Castelvetrano
reviews.title: EXTRAORDINARY
reviews.text:
I stayed one night at this resort and it  was of short duration due to business. I must say that 
it's magnificent. From the moment you step inside the staff makes u feel very welcomed. I dined in the Japanese restaurant. Our waiter Pedro who looked after the 6 of us was impeccable. No request was too big. I am in the traveling business and I have stayed at many hotels and resorts. I would most definitely recommend this resort. I will  book this resort. Sincerely G. C.

reviews.author: caribtravelers
reviews.title: Great stay!!!
reviews.text: 4.5 star rating. Travel date: 11/14-11/19. Occasion: my birthday. 2nd visit to Cancun. Booked the royal suite ocean view luxury suite for my boyfriend and I. Upon arrival at the hotel, we were greeted with 2 shots of tequila to start this vacation off right, and then we were whisked away to the royal service building to officially check in along with a brief tour. We were also introduced to out butler and were given a cell phone to reach him directly at any time.  The hospitality of the staff is superb; everyone greets you with a smile and willingness to help. The royal service building is the most secluded and quiet of all the 5 buildings, you could definitely tell that it was adults only, given its exclusive access to royal service guests only. The room was spacious with a breathtaking view and included everything from extra toothbrushes, robes with slippers, to a beach bag with beach towels. We were put on the waiting list (which became available after 11am) the first 3 full days of our stay and the last 2 days had it reserved. The royal service section had its own private pool, restaurant, and alcohol/ buffet station. We ate breakfast and lunch at both the sit down restaurant in the royal service section and the buffet that was open to all guests, both were great. There were no reservations required for the specialty restaurants. We’re from NYC, so we’re used to going out late, we just showed up every night to any specialty restaurant between 9:30-10pm and were always accommodated. My favorite restaurants were Mole (surprised me with a birthday cake with candles and ‘happy birthday’ sung by the staff) and Bana (Asian fusion). Our butler was always accessible, well at least until 3pm. We decided to take off .5/star because after our stay we learned that people were posting pics of the rooms all decorated with flowers, chocolates, and chilled champagne/wine. We did not witness any special events/ touches from our butler to make our stay even more memorable especially on my birthday, sometimes we had to ask for things twice, that should have been thought about as part of the overall royal service experience. We also travelled to the mall and downtown a few times. ($1USDpp on the bus/ .50 pesos).  * Tip: Bring change for tip, the staff deserves it and change some currency into pesos, because if you’re not careful about your conversions, you will be cheated at some point. Also try the hookah at the Coco beach bar, nothing better than tequila, the beach, the stars, a bali bed, and a nice fruit flavored hookah.

reviews.author: edlainem
reviews.title: My wonderful vacation!!!
reviews.text:
All very well organized, stayed in room 3325 overlooking the lagoon. Restaurants with great food and special attention to the restaurant Toji (japanese food) with ALEJANDRO waiter who served every day very well. Are all friendly, the service totally free room at any time of the day and night. Not have much night option within the Resort, but the location is excellent (facing the Aquatur - i think so- where does the tours to Isla Mujeres etc).
I will return with my family. Super recommend

reviews.author: Hector Sánchez
reviews.title: Great All-Inclusive, yet not perfect
reviews.text:
This review is after a week long physics meeting and is divided in three parts: conference, hotel and all-inclusive. We enjoyed the hotel a lot and would like to come back, but I was concerned that there was a lack of communication between the staff that led to some awkward situations. 

Meeting
Great place to hold a meeting. Del Prado room is amazing, the internet was easy and fast and the drinks and snacks for the poster session were delicious although they ran out very fast (I blame it on us, drunkards). The coffee for the morning break was delicious and water was always available. During the sessions, the AV were top notch, and we could hear and see the speakers and their slides very clearly from anywhere in the room. My only complain is that after the coffee break, no snacks were available so if you were hungry you had to go to the buffet and lose maybe 20 to 30 minutes of very interesting talks.

Hotel
The hotel is gorgeous with an excellent attention to detail. The room was spotless, with very fine furnishing and a magnificent bathroom. The pools were great, very fun and just the right sizes. The beach is INCREDIBLE, a lifetime experience, but it can be a little bit rough, just be aware. They kind of skimp on the towels though, although there are dressing rooms around where you can restock. The lagoon facing balcony was great because it's completely private, you can be naked in there and no one will see you, which sounds odd but happens more than once when going from beach to pool to conference and back. The beds were comfortable and the towels and toiletries resupplied daily. The minibar was not resupplied daily. The check in was drawn out. The concept of a checkout pass is uneeded and idiotic, they already have my credit card information! There are a lot of sites to just crash all around the hotel. It is definitely pretier at night. Didn't use a concierge or the other services of the hotel.

All Inclusive.
First I'll say the restaurants ARE not prepared for groups of people. We were a group of 7 to 10 people that wanted to share meals and only MOLE and BANA accommodated us. In all of the other restaurants, we had to split tables since waiters wouldn't join them, which seems odd since we were going to eat there anyway. 

NAOS. It's the only restaurant which is open early so it's your only option for breakfast and early lunch. Because of this, the line for the omelettes can get ridiculous even with two stations and you kind of have to wave your way around to get your food. Service was good to great depending on who waits you, but you do get tired of the flavors here although they are not bad per se.

MARKET GRILL. We were never able to eat here, eveb after trying 3 times. First time, they couldn't accommodate 6 people, second time it turns out they could but they thought it was not included. We checked and it was so we came back, third time, waiting time was 2 hours. We didn't try a 4th time. Waiters were kind of rude through all of this, never seeming to know what was available or included. Such a shame.

BANA. Waiter captain told uf the waiting time was 1 hour for 8 people so we went and had some drinks at the relaxing lounge. An hour later we went and asked and were told to wait more. We waited 2 hours after which we were so hungry that we decided to split our group. Food here was excellent.

MOLE. The best restaurant imo. The lady told us that they could accommodate 8 people in 60min but after letting her know that we would need 2 more chairs, they told us to wait 45 more min. No biggie really we came back on time and was told that "you should have been here at x time sir". Don't be rude to me, I'm following your instructions. Food here was AMAZING, everything we had was seasoned and cooked perfectly. The waiting staff was excellent and got away with tips from guys that are not tippers. Such a good experience after the reprimand. 

BLUE AGAVE. Excellent taco place which was surprisingly authentic. Opens late into the evening, which is great after some dancing in the red lounge. Service was slow but waiters very nice.

RED LOUNGE. Very fun little dancing bar with good music although the DJ doesn't really change the mix much so by the third day you know what song comes next. Not a bad thing, but you might consider going out somewhere else. It was not hot and very clean. Had an amazing time in this bar.

COCOs. Beach side bar was fun sometimes but the service kind of slow. It has beds where you can chillax and a ton of mixes. Daiquiries, palomad, piña colada, margaritas, huracan, blue lagoon, beer and other simple mixes are available well into the night. Sometimes they have music. On my last day, bartender was rude and would not serve me even if I extended my all inclusive. Decided to go to the pool bar instead where they did serve me. We had a feeling that american and european tourists where given priority before us. I know they tip well, but we also tip even though we are not white.

POOL BAR. AMAZING! Very fast serving time and the guys there are a riot. Never was my cup dry and they had a dirty joke for everything we ordered.

POOL SIDE SNACKS. They were good and on hand.

CHECK OUT. There is a communication issue in the hotel and that is clear. Not all the staff knows what bracelet includes what and I had to give my room number a lot of times. My flight left late and I wanted to keep enjoying the place so I did a late checkout for which you can pay $10usd per hour per person, which really is a good rate. I was told on front that it extended my all included but I had to explain that many times. Could have just added another bracelet so I wouldn't be bothered every 15 minutes for my room number. Even though I enjoyed the hotel I felt kind of harassed since I had to keep explaining that I had extra time.

reviews.author: travelluver1965
reviews.title: Birthday trip 2014
reviews.text: My review is late but wanted to take a moment to rate hotel.  View from our ocean view room was great. My only complaint was that on the balcony the plants were dead and weeds growing in their place, so I would say the place needs a little bit of renovations. However what made up for that was the awesome view and cleanliness of the beach. I also would like to THANK, restaurant manager Abraham for the Awesome birthday surprise. I was treated to a small birthday cake and sang Happy Birthday by the waiters. Attention to detail like this makes up for any shortcomings like the dead vegetation.  Weather was great and I had a ball on my deep sea fishing trip.

reviews.author: ItalGrecoLon
reviews.title: Split stay : Paradisus & 'ME'
reviews.text:
Thoroughly enjoyed this resort.
We made our own flight arrangements and booked hotels seperately. 6 nights at the Paradisus and 3 nights at 'ME'. We hired a car and drove from the airport to the resort. Parking is free.
Room assigned to us straight away ( we checked in around 1300 ). Spacious, clean room. Large balcony/terrace with partial sea view.

The beach is fantastic. Clean, soft white sand and wide. Several large pools.

It could possibly be off-season for North America, since there appeared to be quite a number of domestic guests and from other Latin countries.

Staff were friendly, wait times were minimal. A very clean resort, no insects/flies. 

Unlike 'ME', I have no negative comments at all regarding the resort.
The buffet restaurant, available for breakfast, lunch and dinner had a huge selection of food to choose from, very good quality and cooked well.

I would rate the restaurants as a good average. We found the choice a little limited/same,same.
But the buffet was always a fall back.

Quality of the drinks were superb. Bartenders were polite and service levels were very good.

It's difficult to pin point the type of market the resort appeals to since there appeared to be varying age groups, some families, couples, groups of friends. So would really summise that ultimately, it has a broad appeal.

Let's not forget this is Cancun. You can relax and do nothing, you can relax and mix some culture by hiring a car or joining a tour and you can relax and party. A good quality holiday.

Wi-Fi is free in the rooms and public areas, but the quality did vary.

reviews.author: BREEZE01_12
reviews.title: One of the best
reviews.text:
The hotel consists of 5 pyramids and is quite uniqe in our experience, we were in pyramid 5. We were met by our butler Hector and he took us to our special sign desk then showed us our room and waited ouside while we used the bathroom and safety deposit facility. He then took us to the Blue Algave restaurant for our evening meal.
We have experienced butler service on cruise ships and villas but Hector proved to be something else, he was fantastic always finding ways to please us and sorting out any issues he perceived. On my wife's 60th he arranged for a cake and champagne and made it a special day with the help of others of course.
The Royal Service was limited to Pyramid 5 and had it's own bar and food most of the day. It also has it's own pool with Bali beds and La Palpa bar and eaterie. The service was fantastic. Omar and Alexander provided a Bali bed whenever possible and were very attentive and friendly. They ballooned the bed on my wifes birthday and presented her with a chocolate cake.  Nothing seemed to much trouble for them.
The waiters took turns in side the pyramid and the pool area. They were brilliantly led by Captain Alfonso who always had an amazing smile and welcome. The waiters Alfedo, Diego,Edier, Javier, Juan,Wilberth were all excellent, always on hand to provide drinks or food  at the beach or in a Bali round the pool. We were also privileged to meet Roseanna who was also very helpful and became a friend.
Naos restaurant was used by us mainly for breakfast and lunch. The choice was very varied with plenty of vegetarian options. The standout waiter here was Orlando Beilo  always very helpful and cheerful.
We tried most of the 9 retaurants in the evening, all had their good points except Market Grill. We visited Tempo one evening this is the only restaurant at additional cost, the wine can be more expensive than the food.
Our room was excellent, better than imagined, it had 2 balconies with a view of about 270 degrees. We overlooked the private golf course and the lagoon. Sunsets in the early evening were amazing.
Thanks to all the wonderfully helpful and friendly staff we had what we consider  one of best holidays ever. I thoroughly recommend Royal Service at the Paradisus, Cancun.

reviews.author: Victoria G
reviews.title: "Amazing Resort"
reviews.text: I loved everything about this hotel from the moment I walked in. Gorgeous hotel, great restaurants, amazing food, atmosphere, shows amazing, the service. Pools are clean, property well maintained. The beach area is gorgeous. Security on premises. Location of the hotel is great. Clubs(Coco Bongo and etc.), magazines (designers or Mexican bazaars) 10-15 min by car or local bus (1$). Great! Great! Great stay! I went with a toddler and ...he was bored there. I recommend this hotel more for adults.

reviews.author: BA-Tampa-FL
reviews.title: A very good value for the money, however beware of room theft
reviews.text: This place is large with lots of good restaurants. It reminded me of being on a cruise ship but on land. I really liked the EDM DJ at the beach on the weekend. We had money stolen from our room that was very hidden and concealed. I really felt paranoid afterwards that someone was going through my stuff and stealing from us. If you stay here you will have to put anything of value in the safe, including your phones, electronics, prescription pills, etc.  We met another couple that also had money stolen from them that was hidden in their room. For this reason only I am only giving 4 stars to the service category.

reviews.author: F2943DOjosephm
reviews.title: Wonderful
reviews.text: I found that the service at the pool was Excellent!! Omar took should good care of all of our needs while we where there.. and Franciso Terrozos was a wonderful waiter.. Rubin at the bar made delicouse drinks for all of us..

reviews.author: AnnieMoo27
reviews.title: Best Week Ever!
reviews.text:
I do not even know where to begin....My husband and I were married here on Tuesday November 11th, 2014. It was the most beautiful day of our lives! We came to Paradisus with our parents. Our wedding was small with only 6 of us and it was wonderful! Lourdes, the wedding coordinator was fabulous! Anything we needed, she helped us with! She was great and made the day very special! I would also like to mention how awesome the butler Leyner was!!! Leyner was our butler along with our parents and was out of this world! He was there whenever we needed him! All we had to do was make a simple call on our cell phones that we were given the first day and he came running!!! He helped us find an empty bottle of Tequila that we loved to fill with sand and bring home! It may have been a funny request, but not to Leyner! He went and got it for us like it was nothing! He was also very helpful on our wedding day letting us know that he was there to help whenever we need him! It made the day a lot easier and stress free!!! 
The Pool- The pool in the royal service area where we stayed was so great! It was beautiful and the perfect temperature! The bali beds in the royal service area were awesome and free for us any day!! 
Alexander at the pool made sure we had a bali bed everyday at 11am! Thank you!!!! 
The staff around the pool were also fabulous! They came around all day long even when you had a drink in your hand to see if you needed another! The service was great and very fast... 
I would like to thank Edier, Erick, Samuel, Javier and Alfonso in the royal service area pool! They were the best! They were so fast and kind!

Julian at Blue Agave was a great bartender! My husband loved his drinks! 

Food- Bana and Mole were our favourite restaurants!  Bana had awesome sushi and Mole had the best authentic Mexican food!

Leticia and Willberth in the Royal Service area were so kind!! Leticia worked the check in and out desks and was always fun to chat with! Willberth made my husbands espresso every morning!!!

We cannot wait to return and will soon!
Please contact me for any questions regarding this resort!

reviews.author: Helder R Matsui
reviews.title: Awesome!!!
reviews.text:
What can I say besides the other reviews? This resort is awesome!!! Stayed 1 week and I must say this is an ALL INCLUSIVE Resort with capital letters. From the variety of restaurants, to the kindness of the staff, this resort was beyond my expectations.
This resort was changed from Gran Melia to Paradisus a couple of years ago, which means it is more recommended for families, but it is also perfect for couples, since they have the Royal Service (optional) which we didn't use.
The biggest restaurant (NAOS) has different menus every day and it is perfect for my kid, since we could choose from different plates to his taste. I particularly liked the Fuego (Peruvian/Chilean) and the Blue Agave (Mexican Tacos), but all of them are very good.
My room was also excellent with Ocean View, clean and spacious.
We asked many times the Room Service, and the staff were very kind and the food was as expected.
Whenever we were enjoying the pool or the beach there was always someone asking if we needed anything, so we got spoiled.
If we can say anything negative, well, the Brazilian restaurant (Market Grill) served the meat overcooked, which for us Brazilian, is an offense. I enjoyed eating a lot of meat though. The free wifi works pretty much every where, but it is very slow, we couldn't talk over Skype. Also, the bathtub lever in my room was broken, but I have never seen a tub lever working 100% anyway.

reviews.author: JZ M
reviews.title: Looking forward to going back
reviews.text: We've been to Paradisus Cancun at least five times using a friend's timeshare and are already looking forward to going back next year.  The place is beautiful and has several pools, in addition to the wonderful beach.  However, it might not be a good option for anyone who has problems walking, because things are so spread out. All personnel are friendly and helpful.  Very comfortable bed. We've never opted for the-inclusive, but it seems that most guests do.  The breakfast buffet is amazing and, for the first time, we ordered room service for a late dinner.  Surprised that it was reasonably priced.  Buses run frequently, and it's an easy ride to nearby malls and the Negro market and a huge grocery store. Only two minor complaints:  the balcony lights go on and off automatically, so we were unable to turn them off; music too loud around the pool.

reviews.author: Klozer
reviews.title: Top Notch
reviews.text:
We really, really enjoyed our stay. It is costly, but very beautiful. Our room was amazing with views of the ocean. The food was good. The atmosphere was awesome. 
The service was not so good at the bar or in the restaurant. It was actually shocking how poor the service was, because of how nice the hotel is. It didn't seem to match. They servers moved at a snails pace.

reviews.author: NYinSconnie
reviews.title: Good, but room for improvement
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I visited Cancun Nov 1-8 and opted for Royal service based on reading prior reviews.  The royal service is absolutely worth it and we would highly recommend it.  It cleared a lot of paths for us when it came to reserving Bali beds by the pool, seating at the pool/beach and learning more about the hotel options.  Given we were on a couples trip, the adults only pool and building were the highlight.  The building and pool were both quiet and very low key, which is what we were looking for.  It was also really nice to have the coffee, snacks and top shelf liquor available at any point.  Our butler Cesar was willing to help us with anything and went the extra mile to make our stay special.  We had a wonderful time, but there were some issues.  Summary of pros and cons below:

Pros:
-Royal Service - worth it and not much of an upcharge/day
-Hotel was beautiful - the inside of the entire facility was really stunning and a pleasure to walk through
-Very clean everywhere
-Amazing beach
-Pool was great with adults only, general and kids sections
-Cirque show was impressive
-Service was generally very good
-Bars everywhere with good quality liquor

Cons:
-Food was very mediocre - even the stuff that was good was really just OK
-Seriously skip the Argentinian meat specialty restaurant - we saw this in other reviews, ignored it and regretted it 
-There is little seating for the shows, so standing and trying to see was annoying
-Something made me sick day 2, but was better a day later
-Error in billing, which was resolved after a week.  Just really annoying to have to come back, call Mexico, provide documentation (they were unwilling to even look at the charges without a copy of my credit card bill and my vacation payment voucher) and basically clean up from a vacation
-Spa was pricey and not worth it
-No hot tub - the spa had this wonderful (looking) hydrotherapy pool which was ice cold

The hotel was truly lovely, but with some of the drawbacks we would probably try another place next time for comparison.  But we were really happy with our trip and would recommend this hotel.

reviews.author: Amy H
reviews.title: Perfect Stay/ Great Service!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay at the Paradisus Cancun.  Make sure to stay on the adults only/ royal service side if you can and reserve a poolside cabana asap.  Rode was our butler and was terrific! He made sure we had everything we needed and even provided us with little extras to make our stay special. We also enjoyed attentive pool side service from Francisco as we lounged in one the cabanas.  Its a perfect trip and we will definitely be back!

reviews.author: Ana Vega
reviews.title: Overpriced and very bad service
reviews.text:
It was a big hotel with nice rooms but very bad service. The first day I got there, the concierge took around 1 hour to take my luggage to my room and I had to call receptions. It seemed as if they had forgotten about it. I went there as a business trip and when leaving, the concierge lost the bag of one of my team mates making us run late to the airport. This happened on November 7th and till this date (8 days later), it has not been recovered. The fact that the suit case was lost made our whole experience very bitter. 

Another thing we experienced was that the staff would over charge without consulting. We all agreed as a team, that we will not come back or organize a seminar again in this hotel.

reviews.author: Ben G
reviews.title: Perfect setting
reviews.text:
stayed at the Paradisus in June 2014 - first time to Mexico, and Cancun. Despite the slow and complicated check-in process, the welcome was warm. Finding the room was complicated, at first attempt it's difficult to navigate the hotel room logic, but when I did get there it was fab. Fantastic room with a view of the pool and beach. The food and beverage situation was ok, not mind blowing, but fairly decent quality and choice

Highly recommended for couples holiday, but you will be left wanting for alternative F&B outlets, all of which are a taxi ride from the hotel

Would stay again

reviews.author: drhendrix
reviews.title: Nice getaway
reviews.text: My family stayed for 3 nights in 1 bdrm family concierge room on the Melia side. We had a wonderful time. Our butler Fernanda and the rest of the family concierge staff was great. We stayed at this resort last year in punta Cana, I will say the punta Cana location is much better, but at least they were very accommodating, they gave us a Bali bed by the pool free of charge because they are free in punta Cana. The kids were also looking forward to a drink called the Paradisus that they had in PC, they hadn't heard of it in cancun but the next day, I don't know if they called PC but they had it for them. I was very pleased with the service. The food for me was just ok. The beach was gorgeous and pool was really nice too. Good vacation.

reviews.author: jaredcharlesc
reviews.title: A great weekend trip
reviews.text: The staff was helpful and friendly, The entire resort was clean and well kept, Most of the food was very well made, however I did not care for the quality of the food at the sushi bar. Have a great time!

reviews.author: Akriti M
reviews.title: Great Place to Stay!!!
reviews.text:
The Resort and its amenities were great! Good food options and great service! Sergio was at our service, by the pool and he did a fantastic job and made sure we were comfortable and was always at our service!! 10/10 for Sergio!!!

The room service was always prompt too. Used the spa, it was great too!

reviews.author: Noori B
reviews.title: MONEY STOLEN FROM ROOM- USE SAFE!
reviews.text:
The hotel, view, and location are all gorgeous! So beautiful.
Unfortunately, money ($180.00) was stolen out of our room from a friends purse the FIRST day of our stay. Room service came in the evening ( around 730pm) and we suspect they were the culprits. No other days did room service come in the evening.
When we reported the incident to Security, 3 men searched our room for 3 hours and the head of security made up a bogus story saying our friend left the room door open and had to be escorted to the room in the middle of the night because she was so drunk( which was not the case AT ALL). It was convenient for him to tell us this story AFTER the money went missing. 
USE THE SAFE AT ALL TIMES! nothing valuable should be left out. 

The food available at the resort outside by the pool was okay- but the hamburgers gave me food poisoning. Be careful with eating the meat that has been sitting out in the sun and not cooked properly. 

The bartenders called us "Borrachitas"! No bueno.

reviews.author: shannon1278
reviews.title: Thanksgiving abroad
reviews.text: We all wanted a quick getaway from our hometown in Southern Florida and found ourselves at the Melia aka Paradisus.  We all opted for the "royal" treatment and SOOOOOO glad we did!!  Screaming children and babies in strollers are not considered a vacation in our eyes.  The royal "wing" of the complex leaves all that rifraf far behind!  Between the four of us we had 3 ocean balcony rooms and all were exceptionally nice.  We smoked a respectable Cuban cigar and enjoyed lovely sunsets all without the noise of college kids/teens/ and toddlers.  Just a great place!

reviews.author: Rosie H
reviews.title: Amazing Time in an Amazing Hotel
reviews.text: The hotel is beautiful! The staff was great, food was amazing. Our favorite restaurant was Mole, very authentic tacos. Would totally go back in a heart beat. Next time I will invest in the Royal Service Rooms.

reviews.author: Cindy L
reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.text:
My 5th time visiting Cancun. I have to say this was the best resort I have stayed in. And I have stayed at Excellence Playa Mujeres, Live Aqua, Nizuc, and Gran Caribe Real, which was my least.
   But my Paradisus experience was the ultimate.
Our Private  butler, Ramon, made sure we were accommodated to the max. Especially made it a point to please my children,  10 and 2. He treated us like family and made us feel as if we were at our 2nd home. 

The hotel is very clean, very peaceful yet very alive!  At one point my daughters and I just walked around the whole Hotel just to browse the beauty of it. I don't know how many photos I took.  Just too beautiful. Restaurants are very nice and are all very unique. 

I think I found my spot for my next trip to Cancun,  for sure. 

I forgot to mention,  I had originally booked for the Hotel Great Parnasus, which was one great big mess. I couldn't wait to haul out of there asap.  The pictures were definitely not what they appeared on the Website.  Luckily we were able to switch Hotels. I hadn't heard of Paradisus, I came across it as I was browsing the Web for hotels outside of my room,(that's the only place WiFi worked) I briefly glanced at the photos and thought, "I sure hope this isn't false Advertising too." To my surprise it was everything and more! 

I highly recommend staying there. 

What I did Not find too pleasing, 
     was my Spa experience.  I booked for a massage for my daughter and i, but we were unable to use any of the amenities because they we're doing a photo shoot for their website.  All we were able to use was the steam room. I think even the waiting lounge that I saw on their website was different from the small sofa we were designated to.  But those were just minor hiccups.

reviews.author: ellen c
reviews.title: Hurricane Odile'd from CABO...
reviews.text:
AWESOME!!!!! The most relaxed vacation EVER!!!!! Food was AMAZING at every resturaunt!!!!!!
Service was beyond good!!!!!
We spend most of our time on the beach and our waiter, Miguel, took such good care of us, you'd've thought we were his only "clients'!
The rest of the week our beach waitress and new friend, LAURA, just added more sunshine to our day.  She was an absolute delight to see very day! Her smile and diligence, were out of this world!!!!!!!
Loved the nightly shows!!!
I am hoping to take my entire family to Paradisus Cancun!!!! It truly was paradise!!!!!

reviews.author: Danielle W
reviews.title: A friendcation that we will never forget!!!
reviews.text:
My friends and I (ages 29-31, men and women) booked a vacation for 8 of us.  We were at the Paradisus from Wednesday, November 5th to Tuesday, November 11th. We had a great time!  We stayed in the Royal Service pyrimid 5.  It is the only way to stay - the adult only aspect is great! The royal service is awesome -- We had 3 rooms - Lagoon views for all.  We didnt mind, since we were really in the rooms to sleep and shower.  The lower level floors have ALOT more space than the higher level floors.  2 of the rooms on the first floor had a whole extra sitting/living room area besides the bed area.   The 3rd room was on the 5th floor, and they had alot smaller space.  Since it is a pyramid, the higher rooms have less space, but a little better views. Overall it wasnt bad by any means though... the larger rooms we liked Since we were splitting rooms, we didnt feel "on-top" of each other.  We had a great time, but we did notice some pro's and cons.

Pro's:
1) The resort itself is amazing! beautiful - both pool, beach and inside areas.  The smell that many people mentioned as a negative comments below, was not an issue for any of us.  We loved it! 
2) Fransico Terrazas, our pool server for the week was AMAZING!!!!!!!!! He made the experience and unforgetable one.  He was so personal, happy and all around great guy!  Not sure what we would do without him.  He made this trip unforgetable! 
3) Mole Restaurant - Delicious!!!!!  One of the better meals we had here. 
4) Our check-in and check-out experience was great! very easy and they pamper you since you are in the royal service. 
5) The bar and food avalibility in the Royal Service
6) All the views inside the hotel and outside the hotel.  It was all awesome! 

Cons:
1) Becuase we were a group going to some of the dinners - they always wanted us to do the "group order". Which means the waiter chooses some of the things off the menu and brings it all out.  We didnt like this at all, b/c we didnt know what we were eating half the time.  For example: Blue Agave - the taco/mexican restaurant.  Since we didnt know any better the waiter brought out a bunch of different types, and since we didnt know what half of them were, we werent sure what we would like and didnt like.  We are the kind of group who likes certain things and not others - we would have prefered for each of us to order our own 3 items, rather than them choosing for us.  
2) You wait a LONG time in some of the restaurants for your food.  Market Street grill for lunch - is not worth the wait.  They do have good items, but our experience, the food took way to long. 

Food Wise:
The better restaurants:
-Mole, Vento and Fuego. These were delicous! 
-The omlettes at the buffet for breakfasts were awesome! Buffet overall was pretty good! 

Not so great restaurants:
-Blue Agave (lower end taco/quasidella/ etc).  Not great food, and for mexico, not great mexican food.
-Tempo (sushi/japaense in the middle of tower 3).  Great aumbiance - one of the prettier restaurants, but some of food was not good at all. 

Overall - we had a wonderful time, i wish we were back right now! 
thank you paradisus cancun for your hospitality - and showing us a great time in Cancun (which some of us had never been before!)

reviews.author: Diana N
reviews.title: Excellent Resort - Great Location - Beach Awesome
reviews.text:
We recently stayed at the Paradisus Cancun Royal Service Adult Only Section.
Do yourself a favor and tell your travel agent you will  pay the extra for this area if your not traveling with children , money well spent. We enjoyed our Palapa Beds poolside with food/beverage service.   This section
of hotel also has adult only pool and beachfront restaurant just for the "royal service guests" 
among many other amenties....butler service, etc.

reviews.author: James F
reviews.title: Royal Service way to go
reviews.text:
Second time for us at this hotel. 8th time in cancun.during this review I will compare it against other hotels like Live Aqua, and The Royal Cancun. Last time we stayed at this hotel it was The Grand Melia. Since the change a lot has changed. Most noticeable is the service and the food. Both have improved greatly. The hotel was overbooked on the Royal side so the upgraded us to a one bedroom suite. We were delighted until they moved us to next to a family of three kids. The next morning we complained and later that day they moved us back to the Royal tower ( adults only) 
The pool side service was good with employees like Fernando working extremely hard. We were a little disappointed that you only get a cabana two days during the stay. No reservations are needed at any of the restaurants but if you show up later in the night you may not get a seat. The buffet was good and again employes like Jose going the extra mile. ( thanks for the coconut ice cream )
This hotel isn't quiet ! They have lots of conventions and family's . Be prepared for kids in the common area. Overall a great time and can't wait to return.

reviews.author: Carrie D
reviews.title: Nice Resort Bad Food
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay. The pools were excellent. The beach was in nice condition. The staff was kind and helpful. The food options are limited to say the least, especially for lunch. I ate one freshly cooked meal during our entire stay. The rest of the food was made in bulk and left on warmers.

reviews.author: meyjo82
reviews.title: Dream Wedding and Vacation!
reviews.text:
Hello, Everyone! I just wanted to tell you about my experience at the Paradisus Cancun in beautiful Cancun, Mexico. My husband and I got married here, and I wanted to express my gratitude and amazement with the resort, the staff, and of course, the outstanding romance department at this hotel. If you're searching for potential resorts to hold your destination wedding, or just to have a special vacation, this is the place to do it! There's a reason why so many weddings are held here. These people know what they're doing! And they're so nice and professional about everything, too. I thought this review would be helpful for brides since I, myself, had also searched for reviews like the one I'm writing now! I'm going to organize this review into two parts--the wedding and the vacation. :)

1.) The Wedding:

This resort has a wedding planning department in the US that is based out of Miami, FL. Bianca was the planner who helped us with all the details before arrival at the resort. Response time was fast via email (usually one business day, and they are also easy to reach by phone), and she was incredibly helpful, polite, patient, and informative; we absolutely loved working with her. The same goes for Francis, the representative who helped us reserve the wedding block for our rooms. Laura, from Alquimia Events, helped us with our decor; she is amazing and will ensure that your wedding looks beautiful and just the way you'd like it. 
When we arrived at the resort, we met with Lorena, our on-site wedding coordinator. During our meeting, she answered all of our questions, went over all the details, times, decor, menus--basically, a run-down of all wedding details. She walked us over to the locations where our wedding and reception were to be held. She was lovely in every way and worked so hard to make everything easy for us. She was with us the entire time, was readily available, professional, made sure that everything and everyone was in the right place at the right time, and really took care of us while we were there. Esther, from the romance department, was super sweet and helpful as well. We loved working with all these wonderful people!

For music, we used companies that work with the resort. Our awesome DJ and MC, Carlos from JSAV, who provided the music for our cocktail hour and reception, as well as Pedro Sampler, who provided our instrumental music during the ceremony (the guests loved all the music throughout the event) played a big role in making our day very special! They fulfilled all of our requests and were so accommodating. 

I know that it can be a bit nerve-wracking to try to plan your dream wedding from afar, but you will definitely be in good hands at the Paradisus Cancun! Thank you, Paradisus, from the bottom of our hearts!!

2.) The Vacation

I LOVE Mexico. This was my fifth time in Mexico, third time in Cancun, and this resort is the best one I've been to. One of our guests who had been to other resorts like this one said the same thing. It's beautiful and gigantic! The service is excellent and is what sets this place apart from others! If questions or concerns do arise, they take care of them promptly and professionally. Wherever you go in the hotel, it smells like flowers (it may seem like an odd thing to mention, but this place smells awesome!!). And the beach...wow...the beach is pristine with soft, white sand (wish we were still there!). The food is good, and I have to say that I was pleasantly surprised! There are also several restaurants to choose from and so much variety (Japanese, Mediterranean, Mexican, Brazilian BBQ, a taco bar, etc).

There are two nightclubs inside the hotel, a blue and purple lounge area where they do shows on certain nights (the shows are actually entertaining!), and a red lounge where there is dancing. I've been to hotels in Mexico where there are nightclubs inside, but the music here is better, and the vibe is more fun! 

Also, this resort is kid-friendly. There is a kid's play area inside the hotel as well. 

We opted for the Royal Service, which costs more, but I'm glad that we did it. Our personal butler, Sergio, showed us to our room and made sure that all of our needs were met. He was also able to get a spare room for us to use on our wedding day! He checked on us regularly to make sure if there was anything else he could do to make us more comfortable. Again, great service!

If you go with Royal Service, be sure to read through the pamphlet they give you on everything that is offered with that service (there's quite a bit of fun extras that are included, and you don't want to accidentally miss out on anything, i.e., the two cabana bed reservations with your stay, scented pilllows from their pillow menu, access to the spa, a make-your-own cocktail station with premium liquor, etc). They'll go over all of that with you when they check you in, of course, but we were so excited about the wedding and the trip that I couldn't remember what they'd told us. :)

Regardless of what service you choose, though, you'll have a great stay here. All of our guests complimented this place over and over during our time here. We will be back for sure!! :)

reviews.author: tracydeneenh
reviews.title: Awesome experience
reviews.text: Waited on constantly. Food great. Best trip yet.room very nice and clean. Had an upgrade to ocean view which was awesome. Close to airport and downtown.  Pool and lounges great . Will definitely visit here again

reviews.author: kashcarroll
reviews.title: Perfect for those looking for peace and quiet!
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I had the Royal Service here in November, 2014 and it was exactly that! We were treated like royalty from the moment we arrived and were handed our first glass of champagne.  Every staff member devoted their attention to us anytime we were seen. Our personal butler, Rode, was accessible by a cell phone given to us by the resort at all times. He made us feel completely taken care of - it was like having a family member at the resort who knew all the ins and outs who could provide advice. For instance, on our first night we called him to ask where a restaurant was and 15 seconds later he was at our door and walked us to the restaurant. He always went the extra mile and the resort should be proud to have an employee like him. 

The Royal Service pool and beach area is quiet, but that's the way we liked it. The beach is perfect. 

All of the food we had was amazing. We said we would've been happy even if we had to have the buffet every night- it was that good. However, we enjoyed the speciality dining and were always pleased by the quality 

The only thing that could have made the stay better is if there was a theatre for the shows that the resort put on. The shows are held in a lobby with very limited seating so if you aren't there early you have to stand and likely won't be able to see. 

We will be back to the Royal Service at the Paradisus Cancun for sure!

reviews.author: Julie_wileman
reviews.title: Great Holiday
reviews.text: just returned from a week at the Paradisus and I had to write to say it was the best holiday yet... the hotel was fabulous and the staff were always polite and helpful. The food was great in the main restaurant and there was a choice of other venues should you wish a change. The beach was clean and seeing the Beach Weddings was an added bonus. Great activities for all ages and reasonably priced. We booked our transfers and activities through Jumbo Tours Ricardo was very helpful and very professional. We booked in under the Royal service, now we are considering going back again taking my daughter with us, and booking through the Family Service after the experience we have had we are looking forward to our next trip.

reviews.author: bigbob3808
reviews.title: Royal service is the way to go only 1 setback
reviews.text: based on pics you would think there is relaxing hot tubs but there are no hot tubs and water therapy pool in spa is cold that is my only complaint is no hot tubs great food, service, atmosphere, people. spa was a little pricy but we just went down the strip for way less. loved the royal service only way to go with no kids.

reviews.author: Jamie Lynn
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel
reviews.text:
I stayed at the Paradisus Cancun last week for a wedding. The facilities were great and very clean. The hotel has a nice modern décor. There are several restaurants to pick from, though I only ate at the buffet and the sushi restaurant. The sushi was very good and my favorite meal of the trip. The omelet station at the buffet was also great. 

The only real complaint I have is that there were TONS of ants in our bathroom sink/counter.

If you have a chance, be sure to go on the snorkeling trip. It was incredible!

reviews.author: Giambruno
reviews.title: Magnificent staff and accommodations
reviews.text:
I have been to many resorts in Cancun and along the coast there. This was the best of them all. 
The amenities were great, beach access perfect. Most of all the staff was all around magnificent. EVERYONE was nice and very helpful.

A special nod to the staff at Naos and the market grill. Darwin and Alejandro were our waiters, I cannot say enough about how friendly and professional they were.  Abraham Gonzalez is the manager there, and he also made sure our experiences in his area were perfect..and they were.

reviews.author: Viktoriia J
reviews.title: Mrs Jorissen
reviews.text: Great location. Great service. Gorgeous beaches. Great meal choice.  The management is very involved and helpful so is customer service personal. The interio design is  relaxing and nice.Thank them for great vacation.

reviews.author: aimhowey
reviews.title: Paradiusis ... no disappointment
reviews.text:
We visited the Pardisus Cancun on 11/3 to 11/8.  .... Hotel was immaculately clean.  We stayed in the Royal Service and had Heveric as our Butler he was great .   The bad... The lobbies are very warm and the shows are good howver they should use their convention center since people coldnt see show... Some ppl even sat on the floor.

The great.  Place is beautiful, staff freindly and hard working.  The beach and pools are phenominal.  My husband enjoyed the swim up bar staff.   The waiter on the beach was awesome and having a seperate beach for royal was gfreat.  They ushered kids off the beaches quickly.

We will definetly return.  On a side note we are picky eaters and were not fond of the the buffet... If you stay at Royal have breakfast a LaPlata everyday:)

reviews.author: J Z
reviews.title: Beautiful!!
reviews.text: I want to thank Darwin, Eligio, Alejandro and Luis for making our vacation stay a memorable one.  This was our 10 wedding anniversary and we really enjoyed it.  The hotel is beautiful and the staff went out of their way to assist us.

reviews.author: Sandra R
reviews.title: family trip a success
reviews.text:
We stayed at the Paradisus from Oct 28th-Nov4th. We booked the Family concierge and it did not disappoint. We were greeted and brought to a private room to check in especially for families. So we didn't have to wait in line! there were snacks and drinks for all of us which was great after a long flight.

Ramon was awesome...he was our personal concierge for the time we were there. He took extra care of us, left gifts in the room for the kids every night. We had some cheese and fruit treats for us as well. 

Here is a brief summary in point form
-definitely recommend booking the family concierge as it was nice to have extra special attention
-the rooms and the hotel were very clean
-the staff were all very friendly, nice and accommodating
-the food was great
-the pool area was huge and so was the beach, there was even a shallow area especially for family/kids.
-the entertainment staff did a great job during Halloween
-the nightly entertainment was great especially the Michael Jackson and circus shows at night.
