-the kids club looked promising, but when you travel n the off season like we did there generally aren't enough kids there to do the activities
-the ocean was swimmable, but a bit rough due to the time of year we were there, but the water was very clear
-probably the only areas for improvement might be the size of the room...be careful when you book the family concierge that you get a big enough room. We only had a king size bed and a pull-out couch...so it was a bit cramped for a family of four, plus the mattress on the pull-out was atrocious it was terrible you could feel the springs! So make sure to ask for extra blankets or ask for help.

reviews.author: adarsh
reviews.title: Excellent Place and Great Service
reviews.text: A great place to be with great rooms, service and food. Highly recommend this place as the service is excellent, rooms are very clean and luxurious with great views(Ocean view rooms). The staff is so nice that they catered to all needs and in all inclusive you had option to eat at 8 places so you get a variety of food and alcohol. We love this place and would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: lawhpt
reviews.title: November Vacation
reviews.text:
This was our 2nd stay at the Paradisus.  Perfecto!  Staff, food, beverage service, rooms, house keeping all were great.  The pool, pool bar, excellent.  Sofonia remembered from day to day our drink requests and always wore a smile.  We are not big indulgers, but it was all top shelve call hard stuff.  The buffet was amazing with so many choices.  The restaurants are equally good with great service and food.  Was disappointed with the restaurant Freugo .  Beware of the creation placed on a plate with artistic drizzle. The piece of steak was small, 3-4 inches and the dollop of sweet potatoes the size of a mellon ball scoop. My wife's tender loin was so tough it was uneatable.  The waiter was appraised of this at the meal's end and "sorry" was the reply.
The entertainment was first class in the evenings and was a nice end to a perfect day on Cancun's white sand that goes for miles.
Our guests were very impressed with the property and great service and want to come back next year.
Bus transportation downtown is so easy and inexpensive.  It is fun to hop on and just ride to see the city and it's many hotels.  We went to the flea market to appease the hunter/gatherers in our group.
The Paradisus had suggested the transportation company "Tropical Incentives" which we used coming and going from the hotel.  First class!  The airport has so many transportation vendors and hundreds of arriving passengers. It was so nice to look for their signature dark blue shirts an them holding a sign with your name.  Hope this is helpful.

reviews.author: Tom D
reviews.title: Family vacation details every one should know
reviews.text:
We booked a family concierge trip through bookit.com (2 adults; 2 kids (2 and 4)).  Bookit assured us that the kid's club drop off started at 1 years old.  Unfortunately when we arrived we were informed that if your child is under 5 they may play in the kids club but a parent must stay.  We wanted to have a few dinner's without kids so we used the babysitting service and she watched them play in the kids club.  It is $25/hour for 2 kids; two hour minimum.

We did the family concierge package which for the price we paid was worth it.  It has its own set of rooms where we could go consisting of play areas, top shelf liquor selection for the parents as well as a sitting area for the parents, snacks, pool table and video games.  This area was constantly staffed and kept very clean.

There were 8 or so dinner restaurants and all of them were excellent for food quality and service. There is one breakfast and lunch restaurant; the food was good but the service was average due to so many people flocking to one restaurant.

The property and our suite were well maintained and clean.

A lot of the kids activities would get changed or canceled I am assuming to the lower amount of travelers the beginning of November.  The activities they did have for the kids would get moved from by the pool to inside the kids zone, where again the age started at 5 without an accompanying parent.

We stayed in tower 1 which was quiet and close proximity to the kids pool, kids zone and playground.  The entire property was well maintained with the exception of the playground which consisted of merely a small piece with 1 slide and 1 swing.  Our Bali Bed was close to the entrance of this area and frankly rarely saw anyone go there.

The "kids pool" is a 2 ft deep pool that is good sized but has concrete loungers in it, I guess for parents.  It made me nervous having my kids jump around on them.  I didn't think it was a very good swimming option for kids... especially after seeing how cool the pirate pool was at another Paradisus property.

We got a family concierge bali bed by the pool every day.  Our younger son napped great there during the day so we didn't have to waste time in the room for naps.  Sergio and Flor offered great service and were very good at anticipating our needs.  Grace was our family concierge.  Very kind and knowledgable, it was convenient to have a property cell phone to call her with questions and to make an offset dinner reservation for us.

For the $ value we received, dedicated service, kids indoor play areas (although we had to watch them ourselves), activities, spacious beach, and entertainers this is an excellent choice and we would return.  It was evident the majority of employees were very customer service minded.

reviews.author: djr007
reviews.title: Nice but Disappointed !
reviews.text: Hotel was beautiful.staff was great. Food quality and selection was probably the worst I have had on all my Mexican Trips. Buffet was sad. Main restaurants small portions. Quality average at best. Our last night stay we went without dinner because we choose to watch a show and when we arrived at the restaurant around 9:30 they would not seat us.that was very disappointing. Definatly  not the "Royal Service" treatment we paid extra for. Alcohol quality very good. Need a "main bar" to gather at with friends.  As big as the hotel is it lacks Bar space. If your a couple traveling alone it will work for you. Larger group, not so good.

reviews.author: Phil R
reviews.title: Beautiful!
reviews.text:
My wife and I just returned from our one week stay.  The hotel and surroundings are beautiful.  The staff is also wonderful and accommodating.  We wanted to especially recognize Jesus, one of the waiters at the pool bar.  He catered to our every request and was an especially nice person.  I would definitely recommend this hotel!

Phil

reviews.author: David S
reviews.title: Halloween Treat
reviews.text:
We just returned from another relaxing vacation at the Melia Paradisus Cancun.  During our arrival we were warmly greeted by Raul and our vacation was off to a fun start. This was our first time in Royal Service and we were impressed with the amenities in this ‘hotel within a hotel’.  Our butlers, Sergio and Rodrigo, took care of our special requests and made sure a Bali bed was available.  The buffet, bar, and coffee service in the Royal Service atrium was a nice convenience, along with the same-day laundry service.  Alfonzo was always there to help.  

Paradisus has pristine beach which is beautifully maintained, but if you prefer pools we found them to be clean and refreshing.  The beach and pool staff are excellent.

This resort continues to maintain its high level of service and great food. We started each day with breakfast at Taos, the main buffet.  Jessica, the hostess, always managed to find us a nice table overlooking the ocean.  Prompt service was provided by Alejandro, and excellent eggs and omelets made to order by Julia, always with her beautiful smile!

We dined twice at the specialty restaurant Mole.  We love the authentic Mexican cuisine, the décor, and of course the mariachi playing songs on request.  The manager, Rody, takes care of every guest and makes sure that everything runs smoothly.  Sonia, the hostess, greeted us warmly and our waiter Leonardo served us a wonderful meal each time.  We want to give a special ‘shout out’ to the busboy Aaron (“Speedy”) who prepared delicious coffee and cappuccino with the fastest service we have ever seen!

We treated ourselves one night to dinner at Tempo.  The food there was excellent as always, with great service from Samuel and Carlos, the sommelier.

Special thanks to Max, the head of food service at Paradisus.  It is one of the main reasons we come back each year.

We enjoyed our stay at the Royal Service and are looking forward to returning again next year.  Gracias to the entire staff for your hospitality.

Dr. David and Johanna

reviews.author: gmack49767
reviews.title: AMAZING!
reviews.text:
My husband and I just returned from our stay at Paradisus Cancun.  The hotel is ABSOLUTELY beautiful and the staff especially Victor and Sonfonia are the BEST! The ambience is breathtaking; The food is delicious; The beach ahhh the beach simply amazing..... 
The only negative thing that I would have to say is that the hotel needs to add entertainment for those who want to stay and relax without having to do excursions.  If you are booking a vacation to Cancun and want true Paradise go to Paradisus Cancun!

reviews.author: Elly N
reviews.title: Breathtaking
reviews.text:
The most beautiful, amazing place. It was all inclusive and had the best food and great restaurants. We are going to go back again.  
The staff and service was the best. Very friendly and helpful staff. 
The spa was great as well. 
The main building is the best place to stay at since all the restaurants and bars are in the main building.

reviews.author: Stanislav_Sviridov
reviews.title: Market Grill
reviews.text: Hello everyone! Me and my wife stayed at this hotel for 2 weeks. During this time we went to have dinner to Market Grill a restaurant at the hotel literally every night! This is a meat restaurant with Brazilian way of meat served to you. You get 9 types of meat in a carousel service. The service is great and the atmosphere is romantic! And! There is this guy waiter with a name Francisco, who made every dinner fantastic! If you get lucky to have him as a waiter you don't only get excellent and super fast service, but you also get a man who can light up your night with a joke, recommendation or a story (only if you ask for it!). And I tell you, he has a very good sense of humour! Thanks to him we tried many traditional Mexican drinks like tequila+sangrita, mescal, etc. We will come again to this hotel and I do hope he is going to be still there!

reviews.author: F8486XXheatherb
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Royal Service
reviews.text: Galdino our Butler was the absolute best. The general manager,Lazaro is available and on top of everything. I can not complain one bit. Leticia ,Natalia and Mayte are perfectionist and run the private check in area with ease. Mauricio and Galdino are really the best. and everyone at pool service and the bar at the adult pool are fantastic!

reviews.author: Bill J
reviews.title: Best hotel we ever stayed in!
reviews.text:
Granted, this was our first time at an all inclusive hotel, but everything was excellent!  The hotel service, resteraunt service, elegant and comfortable rooms.  And all right on the beach!  With seven unique restaurants included inside the hotel, you don't need to travel downtown to get great food.
For those who do take the all inclusive package, please remember the waiters still depend upon tips as part of their salary.

reviews.author: Jessica B
reviews.title: Well....
reviews.text: It was great before I had about $200 cash stolen out of my room while we were at the hotel bar. Security says there is no cameras & no way for them to find out about the theft. So.... :( but overall the hotel is beautiful. The food options are abundant, the beach is picturesque, most of the employees are great help, it's big, great for events, & the entertainment is nice too. I don't like that randoms walk up to you selling stuff on the beach but that's any resort you go to. The front desk girl wouldn't apply my corporate discount to my room so that was also annoying

reviews.author: Feras E
reviews.title: A true paradise
reviews.text:
Me and my wife stayed at this resort from the 13th till 20th of October. To start, I would like to make it clear that if ever you have concerns about the weather because of Accuweather's reports, DON'T. It's nonsense. They forcasted rain and thunderstorms throughout our stay and none of it happened. It only rained late at night and by late I mean 03:00 in the morning. All day, it was sunny with a little bit of clouds here and there which is kina good so you can catch a break from all the heat and grab a bite on the beach. 
That being said, we stayed at the Royal Service tower on the 4th floor. I think the room was 5418. Julie, the concierge, was more than helpful explaining how the services work, what could be done, and what the hotel has to offer. Out butler, Galdino, was just fantastic. He literally can make anything happen during your stay. No matter what you want, the butler service at the Royal is always there and ready to help you and facilitate your stay. The room cleanliness was phenomenal. The tower itself is like it's from a beautiful dream. The ponds, trees, bonfires, live music at nights, tranquility, and best of all, the snack bar as well as the self serve liquor bar. The liquors were all premium. They had Belvedere, Black Label, Absolut, and a variety of wines, champagnes, and portos along with other high end strong liquors. It was jst out of control in awesomeness.
The restaurants had t be the best I've had in Cancun and I've been many, many times. To start, breakfast at La Palapa was like breakfast in heaven. The view over the beach as well as the quality of the food was nothing less than perfect. Once you're done, you'd head down to the provate area on the beach and enjoy a comfortable tanning bed as well as service by great servers. If you are lucky, you would have Javier. He is just fantastic. He's so nice, friendly, and fast. You don't wait for your drinks to come to you. He's always ready to help. And the quality of the drinks is great. Nothing watered down or anything. He definitely made my experience at La Palapa and on the beach outstanding every day he was there. I personally am not a huge buffet person but for lunch, your options are sort of limited to the Royal Service snack bar which has good eats, or Naos and Market Grill. The food varies every day at Naos (the buffet) so it was good. So was the quality. Mind you, you can also eat your food outside and overseeing the beach which was awesome. The dinner restaurants are the best in Cancun hands down. We went to Tempo and it was really one of the best meals I ate in my life. It is not included in the stay (Royal ornot), but if you want a good experience at a high end restaurant with great food and service, Tempo is a must. My favorite restaurant of them all was Bana though. First, the location is magical. It is center Tower 3 and the ambience is like nothing I've seen. Second, the food leaves you speechless. The sushi selection they had as well as oher Asian cuisine options were all perfect. We went three times during our stay because it was just so amazing we wanted more. To add to it, the service was ridiculous. We asked for the same server, Manuel, on all three dinners. Hands down, this guy is the best server I had in my life. One, he is extremely accommodating and respectful. Second, when we asked for some tweaks in our sushi, it was done exactly how we liked it and to perfection. Third, he is very creative. We asked him to make a drink for us that he would think would mesh well with our selection of sushi and he came back with this insane 'Manuel' drink that was like a party in our mouth. So make sure you ask him to make you a Manuel drink if you're lucky enough to have him as a server. He is seriously the highest point of our dinner services anywhere I ever ate!
The bars and nightlife are awesome. First you have your self serve bar that'll get you started before going out any which way you like. Then, there's The Avenue. They have nightly shows but what's more important is that their bartenders are generous on the liquor and make sick mixes. Then there's Red Lounge for the party, it's small and comfortable but the DJ plays great beats and the alcohol is always flowing so it's pretty awesome. 
The beach was great. The water was clean and no rocks that would cut your feet as you're going deep like I had in Riviera Maya. On the Royal Service side, they serve you food, and I am talking great meals, on the beach if you decide that you want to have a quick bite instead of going to the buffet. I personally opted for this option most of the time since the sandwiches, burgers, and snacks were awesome. Also, we had Bali beds right on the beach that should be reserved through the butler as soon as you arrive so you'd get the best ones. 
Overall, this hotel is a must. And the Royal Service extra is 110% worth it because you get soooooo much for paying a minor extra. Paradisus is definitely going to be my only Cancun stop from now on. Out of all the resorts I've tried, this one took the cake and none of its competitors came close. I definitely recommend this hotel to anyone who wants to have a great time and stay.

reviews.author: Tatiruiz
reviews.title: Great Vacation for families with younger children
reviews.text:
We just returned from a trip to Paradisus Cancun; we were a total of three families, 6 adults with children under the age of 4 including an infant.
We booked the Family Concierge Ocean View and could not have asked for a more perfect location.  Rooms were in the main pyramid on the 2nd floor, it was a little noisy during the day due to the music by the pool, however after 8:00pm all was quiet except for the wind and sound of the ocean waves. 
Upon our arrival we were escorted to the Family Concierge private lounge, there we were greeted with cool, damp towels, drinks (non-alcoholic as well as alcoholic with premium liquor, as well as juices, milk or water for the kids) and were provided with our bracelets as well as welcome back packs for the children (these contained a cap, sand toys, an amenities bag as well as a t-shirt). We were introduced to out concierge, Fernanda Alvarez,  who turned out to be AMAZING!!! We were provided with cell phones so that we could reach Fernanda at any time of day/night as well as each other, this came in handy when each family wanted to do their own thing and we were able to communicate with one another easily.
Fernanda checked-in with us at a minimum on a daily basis and ensured were doing good and were not in need of anything. She left little "surprises" in the room every night such as snack bags, milk and a cookie for the kids and even aromatherapy scents on the pillows. I can go on and on and on about what a wonderful concierge she was, always had a smile on her face and so willing to help with anything was needed. I would most definitely return to the Paradisus Cancun Family Concierge and request that Fernanda be out concierge....I miss her already!!!
The hotel itself is beautiful, a little dark inside and warm as it there appears that there is no AC in the main atrium, however it not so hot that I was uncomfortable, no one else in my party seemed to notice.
As to the food, well that was hit or miss, sometimes it was great, other times it was bad, same goes for the service. We had breakfast at Naos every morning as well as lunch, there are no other options for lunch except for the grill near the Family Concierge pool, but the food there was awful. The only good thing we had there were the chips, salsa and guacamole.
Back to Naos, the days that we did receive excellent service was thanks to Abraham, Jorge and Darwin. These guys were amazing and aimed to please...I have to apologize because there were 2 others of which I cannot remember their names and should totally receive recognition.
We had dinner at various restaurants including, Mole, Market Grill (brazilian rodizio style), Vento, and Blue Agave (my personal favorite). The two other couples that were in our party ate at Bana and Tempo. My absolute favorite restaurant was Blue Agave....this place should be open for lunch....authentic Mexican tacos, quesadillas and to-die-for margaritas. Drinks were a little week for my taste but just ask for a stronger drink and they will make it to you liking.
The hotel did not appear to be at full occupancy due to the time of year so we were always able to find loungers by the pools as well as the beach. The children's pool is large but very cold, Paradisus should consider adding temperature control to the kids' pool as it appears that at this time of year the overall temperature in the area seems to get a little cooler, making the pool waters very cold. I did not see a lot of people in the pool, possibly due to the cold water.
If you are in FC you need to ask for towels at the stand in the FC area by the children's pool. We went to the beach and asked for towels at the hut closest to the entrance to the beach off the main building, and were denied towels because we did not have the "towel card"; let me just say, if the FC area were close to the entrance to the beach, it would not be a problem, but in order to get towels I had to either walk to the FC club to get cards or to the far right extreme of the hotel, near pyramid 1 which was very far, especially with a 4 yr old, 2 1/2 year old as well as an infant in a stroller.....very inconvenient and frustrating. This issue definitely needs to be revisited.
The beach is incredible, this is my 4th visit to the area because of the amazing beaches and warmth of the Mexican people. Laura, the waitress by the beach was amazing. She was the only wait staff in the beach area serving a large number of people, but she was amazing always seemed to get everyone's orders right with a smile. Gracias Laura!
One final thing...we tried the Coco's Beach Club experience one and it was absolutely fantastic. The waiters (I'm so sorry I do not remember their names) were very attentive and ready to please and provided excellent service. However, I would not pay $100 a day for this service since we have already splurged for the FC. WiFi was great and consistent everywhere on the property except for the beach. The Kids Zone was fantastic for our children, they had a Spiderman bounce house which our older kids (4 and 2 1/2) enjoyed very much.
Overall, the majority of the employees at this hotel made the experience unbelievable. I would definitely return to  Paradisus Cancun, especially the Family Concierge.

reviews.author: triwave
reviews.title: The best time of my entire life!!!
reviews.text:
My husband and I spent one week at Paradisus for our honeymoon.  It was our first trip to Cancun - we were already planning our next one on the plane home, and I wouldn't even consider staying anywhere else than Paradisus!

The property itself is amazing - five large pyramids that are "hollow" in the middle.  The main pyramid houses check-in, many restaurants, and shops.  All of the pyramids are beautiful, with live vines that hang down from all levels like a tropical paradise.  You walk in and are immediately met with a soothing, spa-like fragrance throughout the whole hotel.  The pools, beach, and grounds are nothing short of breathtaking.

My number 1 tip would be to upgrade to the Royal Service (unless you are traveling with children - Royal Service is adults only).  Royal Service rooms are located in pyramid 5 only, with its own check-in, open self-serve bar, and food (continental breakfast in the morning, cold-cuts and breads in the afternoon).  The best part of Royal Service is that you have your own private pool area that is only for RS guests.  The first day we only stayed in this area and I thought maybe the hotel was experiencing a very slow time, as the RS area was not crowded in the least, it was so quiet and relaxing - there were many times that my husband and I were the only ones in the expansive pool!  The next day we went to the other side of the resort and I realized THAT'S where all the people were.  That side has two pools, one small and one very large with a swim-up bar.  There is much more energy on this side of the hotel, with Zumba going on by the pool in the mornings and many more activities.  It was nice to experience that side for a while and then retreat to the quiet side.  Another perk of being a Royal Service guest- you are guaranteed two days of Bali Beds by the pool (you don't have to pay extra like the other guests do).  Even on the days that you are not guaranteed a reservation, you can go on a waitlist (you must come down and check into your bed by noon or it is given to someone on the waitlist).  The waitlist was no problem for us and we ended up with a bed all 7 days of our trip!

The food and drinks were very good, although we got a little tired of the breakfast and lunch choices by the end of our 7 days.  The buffet has many choices, though.  The Royal Service pool area has its own food service (La Palapa) with light lunch choices.  We received glasses of champagne when we checked in -- it was sooo good and has turned me into a champagne drinker.  ;)  The dinner restaurants were very nice - we visited Bana (asian), Vento (Mediterranean tapas style), Blue Agave (tacos), and Market Grill (Brazilian meat style).  The only restaurant we were disappointed in was Market Grill - the servers come around with large skewers of meat and slice off pieces, and will keep coming around until you flip your card over, signalling them to stop.  We felt kind of rushed with this process, and the meat was just okay, nothing special.  Our favorite was Bana -- evidenced by the fact that we ate there 3 times!

The service at Paradisus is impeccable.  Everyone you pass says hello to you or gives you a smile.  Everyone is constantly asking if you need anything or if they can help you with anything, and they are genuine about it.  You truly feel like a king or queen.

I need to give special thanks to a few certain people who made our stay extra special - first being our butler Cesar, who was so wonderful and friendly and wanted to attend to our every need.  We are pretty easy-going people and didn't really ask him for much, but whatever we had wanted from him, he would have gone out of his way to do it.  He checked on us many times during our stay, and brought us special treats (without asking!) like a bottle of wine and chocolate covered strawberries.  THANK YOU CESAR!!  The next person I want to highlight is Pedro who works at Bana.  We ate at this restaurant three times, both for the food and to see Pedro.  He was so very friendly, hard working, and is an amazing waiter.  One night he made us an incredible dessert with coconut ice cream and anise that he lit on fire and poured it back and forth between two cups.  Thank you Pedro!!   We also enjoyed seeing Hector in the mornings, who works at the buffet (Naos).  He was super and again so friendly.  Angel who works at Blue Agave was wonderful as well.  I hope that the management reads this review and gives special recognition to Cesar, Pedro, Hector and Angel - you all helped to make our trip a memory of a lifetime!

reviews.author: mz_64
reviews.title: Excelent stay
reviews.text:
Service and food was so good, that there was no need to go outside for food.
TEMPO BY MARTIN BERASATEGUI (full price, not included in the package) is a must! Even so all of the othere restaurants were great, Tempo has to be part of your experience if you are staying in Paradisus.

reviews.author: CHARLIE H
reviews.title: 5 Nights of Relaxation
reviews.text: We just returned from our Cancun trip staying at the Paradisus in the Hotel Zone with the Royal Service.  It was completely Peace and Tranquility the entire time.  From the time we got off of the Best Day Travel van till the time we got back on we were pampered, waited on, and treated with the up most respect.  We never met or talked to any staff members without getting a smile and friendly treatment.  The food and drink in Pyramid 5 was plenty and very tasty.  The bungalows in the pool area are fantastic for resting with lots of shade.  One waiter named Francisco Terrazos in the pool area went above and beyond getting you anything you needed.  Breakfast and Lunch were the best meals for us.  The Market Grill in the evening serves Brazilian style with lots of squarer served meat choices.  As for drinks, if you could name it one of the bar tenders could blend it.  Great choice and an excellent relaxing time.  Strongly recommend the Royal Service area for your stay.

reviews.author: Paul D
reviews.title: Awesome hotel and great service
reviews.text: This was my first trip to an all inclusive, I've always been against them in the past when traveling. This property changed mine mind on all inclusives for sure. We traveled with two other couples and no kids. We spent the extra money and got the royal service which I think is worth every penny. You get your own building super quite, adult only pool with great service and a great beach out front. We also had the butler, ours was Ivan and he was amazing. It was my 30th birthday and one night I got home and our room was filled with ballons and champaign for my birthday and our last night each couples room was full of rose pedals, champaign and chocolate. It was truly an extra touch I have not seen at other hotels. The staff works extremely hard to keep the grounds clean and the hotel guest happy, they almost make you feel to lazy which is what vacation is all about. I'm a big foodie and love to cook, so I was pretty worried about the food not being very good. This place however had some great places to eat ( the taco place was my favorite, they were real street tacos and you didn't even need to leave the hotel). The lunch buffet was ok had lots of different options which was nice, the market grill was good for lunch too or you could just get lunch by the pool and not move at all. This hotel is defiantly worth staying at and I would stay here again in a heartbeat....

reviews.author: Arlpal
reviews.title: Ms
reviews.text: Excellent in every way. Special thanks to Mr.Sanchez at Cocos Beach  Bar.He treated us like royalty. Great food and drinks. As for rest of resort, staff were extremely kind and courteous. I would not recommend this resort forr elderly or handicapped.

reviews.author: Goro65
reviews.title: services
reviews.text: We stayed at Paradisus in September. Not so many guest, for as vas perfect. From arawing to living,  five nights total, we enjoyed our stay. All staff at resort was more than friendly. I must mention Alberto, room service manager, who make samething special for us, gracias Alberto.I must say that we pay bet extra for ocean room wiew, priceles, and went to visit Tulum and Playa del Carmen. Enjoyed all of it. Will be back soon.

reviews.author: Patricia3013
reviews.title: Excellent Vacation
reviews.text: Paradisus provided our family with an outstanding location to celebrate my husband's birthday.  The staff helped to make this a memorable birthday. The resort was perfect for my grandchildren who are 2 years old.  Their huge  pool was so perfect for the children.  the resort is clean and everyone of their employees are so accommodating.  There are many restaurants and the food was great for all.  We had an ocean view which was beautiful. This is also close to the airport but I never heard a plane!

reviews.author: John A
reviews.title: Very nice
reviews.text: we stayed here several years ago when it was the melia, cancun.  Giant pyramid hotel with huge atrium.  Pool and beach were fantastic and food was plentiful.  This was our first trip ever to cancun and was very nice. Not sure of new ownership but would assume it is even better now than it was

reviews.author: beerman
reviews.title: The golf course
reviews.text: This will be just a short review of the Par 3, 9 hole golf course located in the front of the Resort  which I am sure will be helpful to others. To begin with each hole is approximately 100 yards so the amount of clubs you need is minimal. I carried a pitching wedge a sand wedge and a putter. The course was in relatively good shape the greens were very true but could use a trim. There is no charge to play but I believe there is a charge to rent clubs, they give you a very large bag with a full set of irons....why??. there is no dress code, no club house , no score card and no reason to make a time, but they do have 3 sets of marker tees very close to each other. All in all we enjoyed ourselves . Each morning at 9 am we would play a round which would last about an hour or so then onward to the pool.

reviews.author: Hjremlinger
reviews.title: Everything you could ask for
reviews.text:
My second trip to this hotel and as before nothing to complain about.  The staff are friendly, kind and willing to please.  

The resort is on miles of white sand beaches with views of the Ocean to die for.   

Our room is clean, beautiful and comfortable with a large private balcony.  

I would recommend this place to anyone considering we are already booked to return in the net future.

reviews.author: ReginaGirl_8
reviews.title: Truly paradise
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful time at the Paradisus.  I would definitely recommend Royal Service, because it makes all the difference.  I would also suggest visiting during low season, as we did--we spent the entire time on our Bali bed by the pool, but availability might have been an issue if it hadn't been low season.  

Some pros and cons to help you decide if the Paradisus is a good choice for you:

Pros:

The Royal Service pool provided exactly the kind of relaxing atmosphere I was looking for--a Bali bed at a beautiful pool overlooking the ocean with full bar service.  They will also bring lunch directly to your bed, so you don't have to leave--a truly excellent idea.

The food was good overall, ranging from fine to very good.  I would suggest avoiding the sushi/Japanese restaurant, however, as the flavors were very inauthentic.

Beverage quality was excellent, probably the best I've had in Mexico.

It's located directly on Cancun's wide, soft white sand beach.  Please note that Bali beds on the beach are a paid upgrade.

Our room was spacious and comfortable, with prompt housekeeping service.  Room size varies considerably within the resort.

The resort is fairly compact and easy to navigate once you are oriented.

Cons:

Service at the pool and in restaurants could be very slow due to reduced staffing during low season.

Incense everywhere--not very good for those with asthma, allergies, or sensitivity to scents.

No air conditioning in any of the common areas made for a very hot indoor experience.

Lots of steps in odd places.  I wouldn't recommend this hotel for anyone with mobility challenges.

I'm not sure how much fun this resort would be for families with kids.  From what I could see, the kids' club looked very small and basic.

reviews.author: Louise E
reviews.title: Awesome Resort!
reviews.text: I stayed in the Royal Service building,Adults only,beautiful beach, swimming pools and loved it,butler service,champagne in my room everyday,bar in the lobby with top shelf alcohol,you can pour your own cocktail or a waiter standing by will mix it for you.It was the royal service.I stayed in the Royal service building,but was reconized in all 5 buildings and resturant by our wraistband.

reviews.author: Lucky2Bme8
reviews.title: Paradisus is not paradise
reviews.text: My wife and I just returned from Paradisus Cancun and had a really good time. The beach could not be better and if you can get a palapa on the beach it is great. The beach chairs are old and in bad repair and not very comfortable. The resort occupancy was very low and we still had problems getting chairs. They have Bali beds for $100 a day and none were ever used, I don't understand why they wouldn't lower the price and get some revenue from them.After we were able to move from a very old room in building one into a little better room in bldg. 4 we were mostly satisfied. The resort common areas were very clean and in good repair, but all the balconies had planters which looked like they had not been tended to since the buildings were built. The food in the restaurants was very poor quality with Mole being the worst and the Brazilian style Market Grill the best. The large restaurant on the beach is closed and only one bar open during the day. This was our 7th trip to Cancun and we will return, but not to the Paradisus. J.W Marriott, Fiesta Americana Grand Coral Beach and Le Blanc are all much better options.

reviews.author: martin m
reviews.title: Another trip to paradise
reviews.text:
This was our 3rd time back to Paradisus since December and we are already planning a return trip in the spring. During check in we were greeted by multiple employees who remembered us from previous trips. Alde Cepeda helped us in Royal Service during check in and is the sweetest most professional concierge we have ever had the pleasure of working with. She makes everything as smooth as possible and within minutes we were off to our favorite room "not going to mention the number so it doesn't get too popular". Our butler Sergio made sure we anything we needed from the time we arrived until the moment we checked out. 

In our opinion the main reason to upgrade to Royal Service is the adults only private beach and pool. The pool is large and not overcrowded so you can always get a nice comfy bali bed to get out of the sun and relax and maybe even take a nap. The entire staff at the pool works extremely hard and our friends Octavio, Rogello, and Francisco always made sure we had a drink or anything else we needed. We have been to many 5 stars private pools "Wynn, Atlantis" and this pool matches them them in service and style. The only problem is choosing to spend your time at the pool or the picture perfect beech.

There are also enough restaurants with enough variety to keep you from having to leave the resort for a meal. Valerie at La Palapa makes sure you start your day with a smile every morning. Sonia at Mole makes you want to come back and have dinner their every night.

Overall, if you are looking for a 5 star all inclusive in Mexico you can not do better than Paradisus. The resort is beautiful and makes sure every little detail is taken care of. It seems as no matter what you need every employee is either able to make it happen or will quickly get someone that will. It is clear the managers at this resort know what it takes to make the guest experience very enjoyable. This is a large resort that is sparkling clean and has lots to look at and enjoy, but the main reason we keep coming back is how friendly everyone that work there is.

The only reason not to come to this hotel is if you are looking for a non stop party with loud music. However, if you are looking for R&R with just enough fun mixed in, then this should be your choice.

reviews.author: Christinem7787
reviews.title: Inconsistent stay at the Paradisus
reviews.text: Overall a pleasant stay but not sure I will be returning. Had multiple issues (sometimes multiple times daily) with our room keys.  Luis was gracious and helped us but after the 5th time I think a change to reprogramming the key is in order.  Hector was awesome at the pool,  making sure our drinks were always full!  Angel and Karla were great in activities, Zumba was good as well as the aqua aerobics. Had hit and miss service at the market grill, one day my salad came after my meal by about five minutes.  Overall a pleasant stay with some room for improvement.

reviews.author: Eva A
reviews.title: Amazing People
reviews.text:
Great hotel loved the food, the beach was great, rooms were modern and clean. Reception was great, but the people were fantastic.

Enrique the beach waiter was amazing so attentive and extremely nice. He took care of us our entire trip. We barely ever had to get up and get our own drinks. He helped make it a truly relaxing vacation.

Balazar naps was super friendly and attentive.

Gerrardo and Wilberth were also friendly and amazing. Such hard work ethics.

George Castillo from Expedia was awesome.

Yeri provided absolute top notch service. Also an extremely hard worker. Same with Martin from Fuego what an amazing person! 

Luis and Jesus were awesome during breakfast. It just doesn't get nicer than these guys. 

Jesus from the Market Grill, Disenum, Miguel, Dassa, and Guillermo were the BEST.

Humberto was awesome as well as Jose and Roberto at Blue Agave and Enrique at the lunch buffet.

Loved the people!!

Hdh

reviews.author: Teresa M
reviews.title: Perfect All Inclusive resort
reviews.text:
This was the ideal beach break for us. This is a $30-35 cab or shuttle ride + 20-30 minutes from the airport on a beautiful beach. The beach is white sand, it's not overly crowded, and the water is nice and warm and crystal clear.
The hotel has a big enough pool that it's not super insanely crowded- although if you're settling in for the day, I would recommend sending someone early to save your chairs if you want shady ones, or better yet spring from a Bali Bed. Our favorite poolside drink here was a Riviera Maya- beat out the pina coladas by a lot since the pina coladas had a decidedly weird aftertaste. They will also give you good margaritas on the rocks. 
Our room was a nice size, the bed was a great night's sleep, and furnishings were good. Our main complaint was with respect to the noise. While you get a lot of families who stay here people are pretty young and we got woken up in the middle of the night the first night. The hotel is really nice ambiance- we really liked the uplighting at night + the jungle-like feel of the main pyramid.

Food: it was decent and we enjoyed the fact that room service is free! However the restaurants could use more flavor... of the vegetarian friendly restaurants we went to, Mole was the best for dinner- and the drinks here were super good! The buffet is decidedly meh-- for breakfast, be on the lookout for a juice bar, which was good. Our favorite buffet item at lunch was ceviche. A lot of times we had what I would call catered food issues... like the waffles were cold + tough, or they would run out of the most popular dessert that day. Breakfast also has a make your own bloody mary bar. 

Additionally, they also have an entertainment segment every evening at 8:30. While I'm not super into cheesy entertainment in general, we did enjoy the Michael Jackson impersonator... Other shows included acrobatics (this was pretty good), and a 70s show which we did not attend. Service is great here!

reviews.author: 172kellia
reviews.title: Anniversary Trip
reviews.text: Our Royal Service experience butler service was not what we anticipated (based on previous reviews) however the royal service amenities made it worth it all! The spa was great! Pools great! Food great!

reviews.author: AzClassytravel
reviews.title: Pool service impeccable
reviews.text: thank you to all the staff that serves the pool area at this hotel-they make vacationing here so enjoyable -special thanks to Jesus Aguayo who kept our drinks coming and the fun  rolling.   Good luck in todays contest!!

reviews.author: Pat A
reviews.title: Amazing and Friendly
reviews.text: My husband and I and my sister and bother-in-law spent a relaxing week at the Paradisus Resort Club Melia.  From the moment we arrived the staff was friendly and most accommodating.  The hotel is beautiful and as soon as you arrive the smell is amazing, like flowers!  We had a two bedroom unit with living room and kitchen.  It was very comfortable and way more space than we actually needed, but so nice.  We had the all inclusive and the food and beverages were very good.  We especially enjoyed the service of Jaime and Jaime at the NAOS Restaurant.  They were so friendly and attentive to us during our meals.  All of the restaurants were first class and the food at the Market Grill was excellent.  The pools are outstanding and the service provided was first rate!  I would definitely travel here again.

reviews.author: Salvador C
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text:
Restaurant Mole & Market Grill are excellent , most of staff members are pros
Location is important to me and Paradisus has one of a kind.hotel design is very nice , pools specially by the ROYAL SERVICE is very comfortable & cozy

reviews.author: Daniel P
reviews.title: Fantastic slice of paradise
reviews.text: Paradisus cancun was a great place to spend a week relaxing and enjoying the Caribbean sun. Great facilities and friendly staff. The restaurants offer options from buffet to gourmet to suit all tastes, we loved it. Mole restaurant especially!

reviews.author: Veronika K
reviews.title: Very nice hotel
reviews.text:
The hotel looks very chic and beautiful. I travelled with my mother and father. We had an ocean view family concierge suite, which included the butler and a pool concierge. Our  butler Ervick was very attentive to us and made us a lot of nice surprises. The pool concierge Huan also help us a lot, our Bali bed was ready daily. The room was good except the fact that the conditioner didn’t made the temperature in the room lower, so it was hard to sleep. The Gym at the hotel is rather good, the coaches are professional and attentive. The activities in the hotel were really fun,  Hector and Fabian were really good person and really nice in their activities and entreteinment.
All in all, our vacation at Paradisus Cancun was wonderful, the servise at the hotel was really great, despite several drawbacks.

reviews.author: Deena M
reviews.title: Beautiful Hotel and Beach
reviews.text: I went on a Girls trip and it was wonderful. We took the all inclusive package; it was like a cruise ship on land.  If you are looking to book this hotel do not hesitate.  I stayed from Nov 18th-22nd.  The weather was hot and sunny despite weather.com claiming clouds and rain.  The hotel is just beautiful, spacious with the palm trees and tiki huts on the ocean.  The beach is wide with powdery white sand.   The food was delicious with a lot of varieties.  The portions are small but this gives you the opportunity to try more things.  You never get bored since there are so many restaurants to choose from. We had no trouble getting reservations at any of the restaurants  but it was the low season.  Vento and Mole were our favorites; we didn't try Tempo.  We stayed in tower two which was a great location to all the restaurants and pool/beach.  The room was a little dated but it was clean and the beds were comfortable. The AC worked but the hotel itself was very warm to the point it was uncomfortable in the restaurants.  We can handle the heat but if you can't this can create an issue.  We didn't get sick on any of the  food; even drank the water in the restaurants. The service was wonderful; everyone is very friendly. When we entered our room the smell of the fragrance was overwhelming but we called the front desk and they took care of it.  We never smelled it again during our stay.  We did use bottle water for brushing our teeth in the room.  There should be more activities especially at night.  It would have been nice to have the outdoor bar open at night with music.  We did not do the Royal Service I think during the low season it is not needed.  I read a lot of the reviews before I booked and I don't agree with the negative reviews.  Everyone can find a problem to complain about but the overall experience was wonderful.

reviews.author: mexicolover131
reviews.title: ABSOLUTE PARADISE!!
reviews.text: This resort is top notch in every way. The hotel is gorgeous, the beach is stunning, the rooms are large, and the beds are very comfortable, food is delicious (even at the buffet), the decor in the hotel is serene and peaceful. Special thank you to Sandra at the buffet for all her hard work and service, Balthazar at the buffet, as well as to our favorite and best server on the beach, the one and only Luis. If you have a chance to hit up a club, I highly recommend Coco Bongo. Enjoy your stay at this amazing hotel, you will love every minute that you're there!

reviews.author: Karen M
reviews.title: Our best sisters trip ever!!
reviews.text: Our recent week at Paradisus Cancun could not have been better in any way!!  Going monday to monday proved to be an added bonus as the resort seems to really ramp up with so many more people and kids on the weekends!  Royal service provided the three of us with the utmost in luxury and amenities we have not found in other resorts of this type. Our butler Sergio was amazing and seemed to be everywhere we happened to need him, and surprised us with many extras. He  never forgot even the smallest requests and was meticulous in making sure our chilled wine was in the room each night by 5pm.  David who managed things at the pool and beach greeted us every morning and made sure we reserved the chairs or bali bed of our choice for the next day!! He checked with us during the day to make sure we were happy and had everything we needed. Francisco brought us our food and beverages all day long and we looked forward to his smiling face and happy mood!  We had the dinner at Tempo to celebrate a birthday and it was fantastic. The tasting menu left nothing out and the presentation and timing of each of the six courses was perfect.  A must do at this resort. Each of these people stood out for us during our week, but every staff person we encountered treated us as if we were special and greeted us individually whether we were in the hallways, elevators, or just going from our room to the beach. Which brings me to the beach itself,  which is spectacular. You can walk for miles in either direction and the water is crystal clear for swimming or body surfing!  In all the years Cancun has been building up, they have managed to keep the beauty of the beach unspoiled.  We will be back for our annual sisters trip again next year!!!

reviews.author: Bcardonne
reviews.title: Wonderfull!
reviews.text: Great service, beautifull hotel, delicious food. I recommend it 100% our stay was spectacular, the buffet is delucious, the margaritas ummm. Jose was great with us, everything we needed it he help us. The lounge has a beautifull design and the overall atmosphere at the hotel is great. The best service i've ever had

reviews.author: Glory L
reviews.title: Holy amazing
reviews.text: This was one of the best vacations so far. The hotel is absolutely beautiful. The lobby is amazing the rooms are very spacious the food was great and the people couldn't have been more accommodating. I will definitely visit this location again. We had the best time.

reviews.author: Sarita K
reviews.title: wonderful service.  comfortable rooms.  great food options.  all inclusive plan is excellent.
reviews.text: spa facilities had lots of non working equipment which should be fixed asap,  but the staff is professional and friendly plus offer excellent spa services.  ask for Yareli for reflexology and hot rock massages and Moises for deep tissue massage.  both are excellent.

reviews.author: fbezamon
reviews.title: Enjoying Cancun
reviews.text:
Stayed here for a week with the family (3 adults and a kid) on the Vacation Club tower.
My sister got the week from a friend, so we were unfamiliar of the Club.
We arrived to the 5th and small tower to the right, so we were away from the crowds and into a private check-in in the Club's tower. Although there was no body to help us with our bag, we thought it was the Clubs way. 
We were offered the all-inclusive plan, as it is not mandatory for Club members. We did not take it, to take advantage of the gastronomic option outside the hotel in Cancun. 
We were registered and off we went to our room to find one bed, a small sofa bed with a small Kitchenet (stove, fridge, sink with full silverware and pans) which served the purposes of having drinks, snacks and even cooking a night. There is a charge if you want the dishes done by the maid. We had a water leak all through our stay in the kitchen sink, we called several times, just to get it fixed during the night, but it would start again in the morning. The plumber said it had to be replaced by a new tap. Room #1106
We enjoyed the pool, and hotel areas the rest of our stay. Great pool and beach area. As it was raining most of the time, we could not experienced it as much, so it was a great option to have the meals outside the hotel.
During our stay we also went to swim with the dolphins and enjoyed Garrafon park in Isla Mujeres on the only day we had sun. Do not miss it!
Overall we had a nice stay, but we have had better in Cancun.
Do not miss the chocolate raisins and gummy bears at the Club's lobby.

reviews.author: denisYUL
reviews.title: Friendly Staff
reviews.text: We checked-in at 1:30pm.The process was very slow...about 30 min wait...before being told to come back after 3pm as our room was not ready. We did not get the room type we had requested and informed the check-in attendant. We were told they would find us the correct acomodation within 24hrs. We were waken up that same evening at 9:30pm to be told that our room was ready and we could move in now. Being already in bed after a long travel day, we agreed to change room the next morning. We went to the front desk the next day to exchange keys only to be told to come back after 3pm...back to square 1. Finally got the correct room late that day after 36hrs of negotiations. Otherwise this hotel is great, the staff is amazing, they are always smiling, friendly and attentive. The food is good, fresh and good variety. Our favorite restaurants were ''The Blueagave'' which serves authentic Mexican cuisine,''Mole'' for Mexican contemporary cuisine and ''Bana'' for sushis. The Beach is great, there are plenty of chairs.

reviews.author: Oliver Bothfeld
reviews.title: Great time!
reviews.text:
Stayed for 2 nights to enjoy the Cancun night life and this place delivered a great experience all the way from the begining! 

We arrived late at night and the concierge made a dinner reservation right away at Bana were we enjoyed very good sushi options. After we went to the Red Lounge to dance but even tho there was not many people (low season) the Dj was playing like a rock star! 

We got lucky that night since we foundt a turtle on the beach releasing her eggs and we saw the whole thing happening :) 

Next day at breakfast + enjoy good times at the pool and beach with a beautiful beach area catching waves with the buggie boards was simply perfect. Our room was ocean front and the beds were really comfortable! 

I was very impressed by the way the lobby and restaurants all come together with a sense of a "small jungle" ... 

Staff were very attentive and provided great service too.

reviews.author: steveh134
reviews.title: A very nice hotel
reviews.text: We spent 5 nights here the beginning of November. The Hotel and oceanfront room we had was very nice and everything was very clean. The hotel staff was very attentive. It is worthy of the 4 star rating. The only thing that we were not delighted  with was the choice of specialty restaurants. I would stay here again.

reviews.author: bigdaveNewJersey
reviews.title: Great time
reviews.text:
Paradisus Cancun is one of the best all inclusive resorts that we have vacationed at.
The resort is very large well maintained and the employees are their greatest asset. The place is always clean.
There were minor problems that the staff addressed quickly and do not need to be discussed.
We had a oceanfront room with a butler, Karla, who could not have been more helpful and made the vacation one of our favorites. If you stay at the Paradisus you would be lucky to be assigned Karla. Better hurry though because Karla said that she maybe transferring to the companies other resort in Milan, Italy. Good luck to her, she couldn't have been better. If Karla is busy or off duty you can contact one of the other concierge like Mayte, Reyes or Juan. They bend over backwards to help with anything.
Next up was Juan Queno, the pool concierge in the family area. What ever you need or what ever you want to talk about, Juan's your man. Always has a smile on and always on the move. Also in the pool area you'll find Marisol, A lovely lady that will be your waitress for the entire day. She always stopped by and asked if we needed anything.

The cons first:
The guests! This was a big problem, very arrogant to the staff without cause. The people of Cancun were the most friendly and helpful of any resort that we have stayed in. Please tip the employees!!!!!

The pros:
Everything

reviews.author: JoJo1167
reviews.title: Great Birthday Vacation!
reviews.text: Best 7-day vacation taken with my fiancé. R&R were the key reasons we booked our stay at Paradisus. From the moment we arrived, the staff was very courteous and friendly. Check in was smooth and quick. Loved that our room was ready prior to the 3pm check in. Hotel was exactly how it looks on internet. Place is absolutely beautiful (truly paradise and zen like feeling). Food in restaurants were great, especially "Mole" and "Bana". Rigoberto was our waiter at Mole and service was outstanding. It was my birthday and he surprised me with cake after dinner and sang Happy Birthday along with the other waiters. Truly unforgettable. The spa services were unbelievably the hi-light of our stay. Daniela, my masseuse was fantastic and made me feel like a million bucks after an 80 minute massage, a birthday gift from my fiancé. The sauna, steam room and therapeutic jacuzzi were out of this world. My fiancé and I truly enjoyed them all. The beach was incredible despite the water being somewhat rough, due to the rain storm we had 2 days in a row. Can't control mother nature. The ocean view from our room was breathtaking. Got to witness baby turtles hatching from eggs at the beach (amazing)! Would highly recommend the Paradisus! Hoping for us to go back next year.

reviews.author: Gerrylindo
reviews.title: Great place for families
reviews.text:
I travelled with my husband, mother and almost 5 year old. We had an ocean view family concierge suite, which included a pool concierge and butler. The pool concierge made sure that we had a Bali bed ready daily, which was next to the kids pool and provided great shade and comfort for the family. The pools were lovely, with a shallow one just for kids and separate adult ones with a swim up bar. Drinks were replenished regularly by attentive staff. 
The rooms are spacious and clean, but the balcony only had one lounger, so didn't really serve its purpose other than to lay wet clothes on. The separate toilet in the bathroom was great considering my mother was sharing with us, but the bidet directly in front of the toilet caused a slight obstacle for my 6ft plus husband. I have 2 complaints about the room, one of which was the loudness of the air conditioning, which sounded like you were sleeping next to Niagara Falls and the mosquito problem we had. We kept the balcony door closed but were bitten frequently at night. When I complained I was told it was the rainy season and to wear bug spray. I've been to cancun many times at this time of year and never had a problem at other resorts. They said they would spray the room, but this consisted of the housekeeping staff spritzing a bug spray randomly around the room, which was not effective.
Family concierge had some nice perks, a private check in and check out, cookies and milk for my little one at night and her own bathrobe and slippers. The private butler proved pretty useless and although we were given a cel phone to contact her directly we had better luck calling restaurants and housekeeping directly when we had a request. It often took 2 to 3 calls to get results and I think some of the issue was a language barrier as a lot of the staff did not speak English well and we don't speak Spanish.
The restaurants are quite varied, excellent tapas and sushi. The Peruvian, Brazilian and Mexican restaurants were average.  The buffet was very good and nicely varied and of course the staff could not do enough for you there. 
The beach is beautiful and this hotel is very pretty, with koi ponds and lots of foliage. My daughter fed the fish regularly and really enjoyed the kids club, but because she was under 5 we could not leave her with the staff. One of us had to stay with her there the whole time. The area that is lacking in this hotel is nighttime entertainment. Nothing other than a big lounge, restaurants and a nightclub after 10 pm. 2 nights there was live dancers for about 20 minutes, but otherwise there's nothing to do. 
I really enjoyed this hotel for its beauty, the friendliness of the staff, the fabulous beach, good food and drinks and how it caters to children. I probably won't return due to the loudness of the air conditioner, but if this doesn't bother you then this is a great place to go for a very enjoyable vacation for a family.

reviews.author: 675justink
reviews.title: Must Stay
reviews.text: this place was very very nice. the service and staff were excellent the moment we stepped into the hotel. The hotel was clean and worthy of the 4 diamond status. We ate at Fuego, Banna, the buffet, and Mole. Our favorite was Bana, the sushi was excellent! We were here on a 3 night getaway and it was perfect! Thank you again to all the staff who made our stay great!

reviews.author: Carolyn S
reviews.title: Amazing wk at Paradisus Cancun Royal Svce Oct27-Nov 3'13
reviews.text: We cannot say enough about our wonderful experience Oct 27-03Nov'13. Stayed in the Royal Service pavilion where everyone was so amazing, including Hector (our Butler), David + Octavio (Pool services), Nadia and all the others manning the Royal Service area.  Staff at the entire property all were so HAPPY to make us feel welcome and make sure we enjoyed our stay.  Highly recommend the Paradisus and we would definately go back.  Judy and Carolyn

reviews.author: Krista G
reviews.title: 14 day review!!
reviews.text:
My boyfriend and myself spent 14 days here.  We figured if we were going on vaca that we mine as well make it 2 weeks.  This was my first time in Cancun and his second.  I know this is a long review; however, I feel that we had so much time to experience everything that I should tell you about it.

When we first arrived we recieved a coupon book, which had a room credit, and decided to see how much it was to upgrade.  We were able to upgrade to the royal service for almost 1/4 of what it would have cost to reserve this service in advance.  It was probably the best decision we made!  We chose to stay in our original room (because it had a jacuzzi on the balcony), but pyramid 5 is the royal service pyramid which had snacks and a full bar all day. As well as sodas and coffee.  Our pyramid was #1, but they are all close together.  
Benefits of royal service: 
-Butler; personal cell phone to call butler 16hrs a day. We had Erik and Samuel for most of our stay and they were awesome.  Whenever we needed anything they were there.  If we wanted something special in our room, they would have it there whenn we wanted it.  They also made all of our dinner reservations.  They would even set up excusions if we needed.  Also, they were great to converse with.  BTW the cell phone works outside of resort as well (which came to good use after we got stuck in downtown Cancun in a rain storm!)
-Pool; cabana every day reserved if you wish. David is in charge of this and he is great!!  Personal waiter, we primarilly had Francisco who we loved!!!!!!!!!!!!!  He would even remember our drinks and have them ready if we wanted.  He also takes your lunch order and brings it right to you.  If you are at the pool before 10am and want to get going early, the bar is right there for drinks.  
-Room; pillow list to choose from, they will iron your clothes, laundry picked up and in your closet before you even get back to your room! Bath filled if you wish, bed turned down at night with chocolate, mini fridge, bottle of hard liquor in your room whenever you want.

Restaraunts:
-Noas; breakfast and lunch buffet.  Buffet dinner, which always had different choices.  There will always be something to choose from.  All the waiters are really nice as well, and they split all the tips so don't think your money is all going to one person.
-Fuego; my favorite!!!!!  My meal was the corn soup, beef tenderloin, and coffee soup.  I probably could have had that every night! Lol
-Blue Agave; went there the first night because you don't need reservations, but it was not that good.  Only went once.  Standard tacos, quesedillas etc..
-Mole; we only went here once but it was really good.  We heard from some people prior to going that we probably wouldn't like it, but from the service to the food our night was great!!
-Sushi; the sushi is good, and it is not all raw! So don't freak out lol.  The downfall...the service is sloooooooooooooooooooooooow.  Need I say more.  unless you have 2 hrs to eat dinner don't go here.  Or if you are hungry lol
-Market Grill-  Suppose to be a Brazilian steakhouse, but all it was was 3 meats walked around on a stick.  It was ok, but where I frequently go to authentic Brazilian steakhouses, we were disappointed.
-I did just want to mention that Dulce was the hotess we encourted most frequently and she was great!
-We did have resort credits for food, which allowed us to get rib eye, t-bone, lobster at no extra cost a few times.  The meat at all the restaraunts was great!

Excursions:
We booked through liberty travel who works with Olympus Tours, and they were the rudest people we encountered on our trip.  Because of their rudeness we didn't book one excursion through them!!!  Instead we went to George at Expedia, and he was the nicest.  He would tell us based on the weather if we should rearrange our activities for sunnier days or whatnot.  We cannot say enough good things about him!!  
Xplor-We did explor on our second day.  It was good, but a long day.  We got picked up at 7 and back around 630.  Ziplining galore! Enough for the year for us lol. River swimming and amphibius vehicles.  All in all a fun day.
Coco Bongo- Be careful, all inclusive means lots of alcohol!!  So much alcohol that we had to go a second time to remember our night haha.  It was worth every second though.  We tipped really good when we got there and got moved to a great spot with waiter service.  I wish we had something like here at home.  Not to mention, late night eating!  Ask the taxi drivers, they know all the places.
Jungle Tour- Wicked fun!  Right across the street, speed boat ride out to the snorkeling site.  It was my first time so I enjoyed it.  Multiple kinds of fish and you got to swim where you wanted until it was time to go back to the boats.  It was a really fun few hrs, probably our second favorite activity.
Jet skis- We booked through the hotel a place right on the beach (15 min walk) anddddd it was good.....if you like rough riding.  My boyfriend liked it more than I did (maybe the fact that I am petrified of sharks had something to do with it)
ATVs- I forget the name of the place, but it was fun.  If we did more than just atv riding we might have liked it more.  At the place there was horse back riding, camel riding, deep sea fishing, jet skis, swim with the dolphins.  It can be an all day thing if you want.  
Porto Morales- waste of time and money! This place was about 45 minutes away, and we heard it was suppose to be way better than where the jungle tour was; however we were very disapointed.  You snorkel at the same site 3 times, even though they advertise 3 separate sites.  It was very cloudy water, and the fish were about the same as the jungle tour.  Not to mention you have to stay with your "leader" which means you and the other 10 snorkelers in your boat!!  The lunch I did not like, but my boyfriend enjoyed it.
Aquarium- Los Olas mall.  ? the name.  About 10 minutes from the resort on the left.  $16 a couple things to look at and get the dolphin show is at 6pm.  Worth it for sure!  Also swim with the dolphins and you can go into the shark tank for extra $$
Chichen Itza- THE BEST EXCURSION EVERRRRRRRRRR!!!!!!  Although your day was 12hrs, it was worth it.  The ruins were great, lunch great, cenote cool, and the ride comfy.  Bring a movie to watch or music to listen to and you will be fine with the 3hr drive.  We chose the deluxe package and it was worth it.  Coronas on the bus as well as great tour guides.  One downfall is, we wish we could have spent more time at the ruins.

Overall our trip was great! I don't think there were many complaints at all.  The biggest downfall is every trip we hope is as good as this one!  One day it did rain all day, and the hotel had no activities to participate in.  We wish they had a game room or something, but room service all day one day we couldn't complain about.  The tv channels weren't bad either.  The spa services were very expensive; therefore, we opted out of those.  

We would recommend resort to anyone! And the upgrade to royal service was well worth it.  Also, there is always friendly staff around to ask any questions to!

reviews.author: Santeq629
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.text: Cant say anything bad about this place. Food, beach, pool, staff, ALL restaurants and bars were excellent. We never left, if you want wild night life you would want to take the bus and go downtown. At know time were we approached to take a timeshare presentation. I was here on RCI timeshare trade.

reviews.author: s g
reviews.title: Friend and I  Nov 2-9
reviews.text:
Traveled with a friend and we had a great time. Everything went smoothly other then rain, wind, thunder & lightning all day Sunday. The lobby is just so very pretty with 8 floors and plants hanging off every floor growing down. We ate in every restaurant and all were good. Check out the Blue Agave and you can sit at a table or the bar for Tacos and Tequlia. The tacos are to die for and out of this world. Not what you think of if you order a taco in the states ! Free WiFi even on the beach. 

Beach is nice with bar servers and at the pool as well. My only complaint would be there really is not much to do in the evening. There was 3 shows but they do them in Avenue Bar and not much space. So we stayed on the beach until almost dark then did not have to rush as we made later dinner reservations to help pass the night.  Right across the street is Aqua World where you can rent small speed boats, jet skies and etc to use in the harbor. Also a 9 holes executive course right out front. You rent clubs in the store in lobby. Bring your own balls as they want to over charge you for theirs !  

I would like to thanks the following people who went above and beyond to help make our trip wonderful .... THANK YOU = Sofonia Castaneda, Enrigue Alcudia  and Lifeguard Oscar Sanchez (Beach) Guatalupe -(Vento)  Orlando Bello, Gerardo Barrios (Naos) Gabriel Uh Mahay, Alejandro Tuz (Blue Agave) Hector (Fuego) and Barmen Jose Alberto Velez 

Please remember to tip as these folks put in many hours and help to make your stay special               Thanks Paradisus Cancun Resort :0)

reviews.author: Laura S
reviews.title: Birthday!!!
reviews.text:
What fun!! For all ages...however more adults - very few kids. I was with a group of women and we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. The dining was great, so were the drinks. The pools and beach side were fantastic, and so were the activities. The service was spot on, and so were the drinks. 

Word of caution: avoid the 30 minute tour when you arrive. Who needs a tour? Drop your bags and hit the pool! 

Very easy to get to. Very easy to get around the grounds. Not easy to leave.

reviews.author: Marlayna J
reviews.title: Celebrating 50th
reviews.text:
We are return customers that will not be returning. I have stayed at this same location 5 times, 3 of which were prior to it becoming an all inclusive hotel. This is the first time that I had a bad experience, but it was enough so that I will not return.

We just returned from Paradisus Cancun where we went to celebrate a friends 50th birthday. I hesitated to give service an average. While  our service in the restaurant, poolside, and room service was exceptional, the service at the front desk for check-out, check-in and room key issues was horrible. We arrived Thursday early afternoon and had to wait in the check-in line for 45 minutes to only be told that we had to come back at 3:00 because our room was not ready. We were told that we could go right to the front when we returned to just grab our room keys, but ended up having to wait another 45 minutes. Everyday after our room was serviced (EXCEPTIONALLY), we had to go back down to the front desk - WAIT again, for them to re-program our room keys. Check-out rain similarly. 

The bartenders, servers in the pool area and restaurant staff were as ALWAYS incredibly helpful, always attentive and deserving of tips. The front desk area needs MAJOR renovations in terms of efficiency.

reviews.author: Tracy O
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun Wedding
reviews.text:
We just returned from Paradisus Cancun where we were married! We have been to other resorts in the Cancun/Playa area and were very pleased with our experience. We generally try to stay at resorts that are outside of "resort row" and more private, but having family and friends coming for the wedding, we decided this would be the best location so people could easily explore the area. our guests ranged from "first time outside of the US" to "high end world travelers" and the feedback from all was extremely positive.
for the wedding: we worked with Lauren and Jessica to get the majority of the planning done. both are in Florida and I cant say enough about how helpful they were!! Response times were immediate, questions were answered completely and both were so friendly. We used Alquimia (in Cancun) for flowers and some of our decor. They did a great job, just be aware that the Alquimia response times are longer than I am used to (we started with Perla, she was too busy, we were then transferred to Adriana--she was great! very helpful). Jessica at Paradisus was a rockstar helping keep the communication open and moving along.
about a week before the wedding, jessica passed us along to Lorena-the on-site cordinator. this poor lady works so hard!!!  she had 5 weddings going on the same weekend as ours-you would never have known it. she treated us as if we were her only wedding for the month. friendly, hands on, confident and accomodating. I am a wedding planner in Minnesota and thought it would be difficult to hand over the control-it was a breeze, I never thought twice. It rained the evening of our wedding and Lorena and her team transitioned us to an indoor reception flawlessly. we brought the bulk of our decor down with us, they took care of everything and it looked amazing!! we did the ceremony at the gazebo and from the pictures we have seen so far, it was perfect! we used the photographer that was recommended by the resort-Sweet Caribbean Photography-Dani and Jose were so great! Dani and I hit it off immediately and she was so sweet, involved and helpful. I cannot wait to see the rest of our pictures!
the resort:
really beautiful! it is definitely spread out! 5 pyramids-we have family and friends spread all over! we easily managed by planning which pool/beach areas or which bar to join up at. 
the rooms were nice, clean, excellent a/c.
we were in Royal Service--well worth the upgrade!! having the food and bar area right outside your door is worth it. We do this upgrade to Royal Service/Preferred Club every trip and we have never regretted it. nicer rooms, quieter/nicer pool/beach areas, usually an additional restaurant option.
The staff was fabulous!! Lordes, Hector and Erik in the Royal Service were so fantastic. every bartender, housekeeper, etc were so polite, friendly, accomodating! anything we needed, ask nicely-they would bend over backwards to help. 
room tip--the higher floors have better views, but the lower floors have bigger rooms. the buildings are pyramids, so higher rooms are smaller. royal service and ocean view are totally worth it! friends of mine did the lagoon view and they stared at a McDonald's and gas station all week.
favorite restaurant was Fuego, and the shrimp and pesto pizza from the Royal Service pool bar was so good!! We hit the buffet for lunch a few times-I was expecting nasty food--it was actually quite good. The salad bar was always fresh, several 'cooked while you wait' stations, delish desserts. we heard the omlete station was awesome, we never made it over there early enough. I never had dinner there, but my picky eater nephew was obsessed with the chicken strips and mac n cheese. so good option for kids.
The main pool (outside of pyramid 3) was fun! DJ in the afternoon, swim up bar, attentive servers, best guacamole in the afternoons!!
my family did several excursions, dolphins, parasailing, snorkeling, etc and the on-site staff set them up and it was flawless.
-the beach and pools were gorgeous and kept clean. the beach waves were pretty crazy most of the time, but not so much so that you couldnt swim.
-several family members took cabs or the bus into town with no issues.

only critisicms:
-MAKE RESERVATIONS!!! the earlier in the day or week, the better. and dont try to have too many groups (6 or more) for dinner or you will be stuck with the family style and no choices from the menu. that was a little annoying-but we also used dinner time to decompress and be alone or do dinner with just a few friends at a time.
-the resort common areas are hot! the rooms, restaurants, etc are air conditioned, but the common areas and hallways got pretty steamy. 

Overall-great experience!! We had such a range of guests, 14 years old to 65 years old, single wanting to party, married, parents, fancy experienced world travelers, and 1 first time flier!! everyone is still raving about the trip and the resort. will likely stay at a Paradisus/Melia resort again in the future!

reviews.author: Tractorstant
reviews.title: Baffled by other reviews!
reviews.text: Let's get it right, I am baffled by other reviews, this place is average at utter best. Yes the staff are friendly, when they understand you ( lots of nodding and smiling, not so much compression.) We stayed in Pyramid 3 on the 6th floor, on the first night we asked to be moved. Why? the Nightclub can be heard until 2am, imagine the local station car park full of boy racers, then at 9am the drilling started for the renovation work. Unfortunately they had no other rooms available. The breakfast buffet was nice, which was good because the rest of the food was typical All Inclusive rubbish. Apart from the Royal Service, pool bar which was ok. Coffee machines did not work, neither did the bath, and if you value your clothes was them when you get home, had to skip an Eaton shirt! Oh and the sun goes down at 5.....after that, there's not a lot to do! There must be better?????

reviews.author: GINA2014
reviews.title: Peace Of Mind...
reviews.text:
Do not hesitate about choosing Paradisus Cancun...Pack your bags and go !!
