Just spent 7 days in the Royal Service section and it was all so magnificent.From the lovely "Lu-Lu" at check in, my smiley butler "Samuel" ((SAM)),the terrific servers,fantastic "Octavio" and his side kick "Rogelio" - top notch customer service from all.The rooms are great, grounds are spectacular and the inside decor is breathtaking, not the mention the wonderful pools and Bali beds.A special thank you to"David"at the pool concierge who always ensured our comfort was key.We even opted to stay at the pool daily rather than walk the few steps to the beautiful ocean..We dined at all the restaurants including the buffet and all were phenomenal...Even drank the water,no issues.If your looking for some R & R, Royal Service is a must.Do not adhere to any negative comments about Paradisus Cancun, for it is truly PARADISE.

reviews.author: Calin N
reviews.title: 5-star experience, highly recommended
reviews.text:
Spent 10 days here at the beginning of November (2013), regular prices are a little more than our usual budget but we found a very good (and early: April 2013) promotion on BookIt.com – only USD 5 more per day/person for Royal Service at the time, easy pick unless travelling with children.
The complex is impressive, and with a very good beach frontage (just look at the new hotels nearby, like Secrets the Vine, for a comparison). It’s very well organized and managed; of course we were here in low season so very high occupancy rates might put some pressure.
We asked in advance for a high floor room and early check-in – we got them but a back pain attack right before the trip (my spouse had to use a cane) made a change to a larger room on the lowest floor the best upgrade ever.
The service is amazing: had great interactions with Eric (our butler), Vanessa (concierge – also great service from Natalia and Lulu), Susana and her team at the Royal Service pool restaurant (Francisco, Rogelio, Javier, Octavio and everybody else – the cook is an unsung hero on weekends), David for the pool beds/towel service and many others.
The restaurants are all excellent (Tempo is in a league of its own, I’ll write a separate review), just be aware that at Vento “outside” and at Bana it can get hot/sticky in the evening. The lighting at Bana is very dim, the waiter is bringing you a flashlight to check the menu (so it’s not only my age). I’ve also enjoyed the Pyramid 5 lounge in the afternoons/evenings. Try Blue Agave for some different margaritas: cucumber or hibiscus, or many others.
A couple of weak points: open (indoor) spaces can’t be cooled as well as the closed ones, evening entertainment is weak (and I see no space around to be converted into a real disco or theatre), and the pools can be deep (the Royal Service one IS 1.80 metres deep in the middle, look for the dark blue floor area).
Resort credits are not free money (and one shouldn’t expect them to be) but the food credit ones can be used without additional charges or minimal ones. You may use one credit per dinner (not two for two persons), and you don’t get “change” back if more than the expense (no surprise). The lobster (9’’ to 14’’) is usually less than USD 50, the steaks are more. The surcharge menus are on a small separate list, not on the restaurant menus (it might be the same list for all restaurants). The food prices include the taxes but not the service charges: if the list says MXN 550, then it’s 500 the price, plus 50 as 10% tax – and then a 15% (out of the 500) is added as service charge. If I’m not mistaken, wine list prices do not include the tax, so expect 25% more on the bill. A USD 50 credit for spa could be used only against a USD 140 (or more) treatment (and then taxes/service charges).
The water ritual is free for Royal Service guests once per day (closed when it rains) – it’s a little dated and in a rather small area, happily most people ignored it during our stay.
If you like walking, outside the amazing beaches there are a couple of good choices (up to 3 Km / 2 miles each way) along Blvd. Kukulcan (great sidewalks): north to the Kukulcan Mall and then La Isla Mall, or south to a Maya museum and then an archeological site further away.
Great resort!

reviews.author: Robert M
reviews.title: Old Hotel, Poor Service
reviews.text:
A disappointing experience, so many problems:

1) I arrived and was promised an upgrade to a room with a Jacuzzi and ended up in an old rom that made me feel like I was at a dime store hotel. After complaining to reception they moved me into a new room which matched what I had reserved but the experience of being told you are given an upgrade and then being given a downgrade is not acceptable, even if they did put me back in the room I had reserved.

2) The restaurant reservation service is rediculous.  I arrived back at the hotel after being out and about and went to guest services to make a reservation as I had arrived at 4:55 and the reservation service shuts down at 5.  Guest services was busy and couldn't attend to me right away.  When they were able to help me at 5:01 I was told the reservation service was down and I couldn't have a reservation.

3) The restaurant service was also horrible and after one night of dining at the restaurants I couldn't bring myself to go back.  I ate at Bana which I should add was 3/4 empty at the time.  So amazing that they couldn't make reservations after 5.  It wasn't like the restaurants were hoping.  Then the food was lack luster and didnt seem fresh and on top of that the service was awful.  I was traveling alone and as such dining alone.  I expect restaurant service to be tailored to the customer.  If you are there in a group or with a significant other I can see long waits between courses, but to wait over 30 minutes for an appetizer consisting of 3 dumplings and then another 40 minutes for a main course of four sushi rolls, when I was obviously sitting alone awkwardly in an empty restaurant was an embarrassment to the hotel.  After that I could not get myself to go back.

4) I was going to use the spa services but ended up not doing so after the restaurant service and seeing the exorbitant prices.

5) The pool bar did not have many non-alcoholic options.  I do not drink alcohol and while yes all-inclusives are often taken as an excuse to get drunk and party I was paying for a more expensive all inclusive to avoid that atmosphere.  I was sadly surprised to see that pool bar staff had a very limited repertoire which was pretty non existent for non-alcoholic options.  Generally places have a few non-alcoholic mocktails and here it was bad daquiris or piña coladas.

On the good side, Ignacio on the reservation line was spectacular.  If only the rest of the experience was like dealing with reservations.

reviews.author: Marcus85204
reviews.title: Five out of Five!
reviews.text:
I love the beach, so I go to Mexico at least twice every summer. I prefer Cancun to everywhere else in Mexico, and I always choose all-inclusive resorts in the Hotel Zone. I think all-inclusive hotels are a great deal, regardless of higher airfares or the economy.
I found a good rate for the Paradisus Cancun (our group of six people stayed for 6 days / 5 nights). This was our first stay at this hotel, and we enjoyed every minute of our vacation. The level of service from management and staff was excellent.
HOTEL: The hotel appears to have been built in the 1980’s, but is still in very good condition. The staff was polite and professional. Almost every staff member I passed greeted me. The hotel was very clean, and we frequently saw employees cleaning and tending to the grounds. 
ROOMS: We had three rooms: all three were in the main building (Bldg 3), two rooms faced the lagoon; the other people in our party upgraded at the front desk to an oceanfront room. Each room had double beds, a nice flat screen TV, mini bar fridge that was stocked daily, and a digital safe.
FOOD: The food was excellent in the buffet and in the premium restaurants. We were usually able to get reservations for the premium restaurants at night, but you must call from your room to get reservations for the following night’s dinner. We particularly enjoyed the “Bana” Asian restaurant and the “Mole” Mexican restaurant. Note: When you go to the buffet or the Market Grill restaurant, you will usually have an awesome view of the ocean.
POOLS & BEACH: The pool was very nice. Plenty of lounge chairs, if you get there in the morning. The pool has a nice swim-up bar. Oddly enough, there was very little entertainment in the pool area compared to the many other Cancun hotels I have stayed at. There was some music playing in the afternoons, but I was surprised at the lack of a lively “entertainment team” like the other hotels offer. The hotel did set up an outdoor poolside buffet in the afternoons, which was very convenient.
The ocean and beach area were fine, and the sand and water were very nice. This is one of the most beautiful beaches in the Cancun hotel zone.
BARS: We usually had no trouble ordering drinks. The drinks were very good (we drank Bacardi, Captain Morgan, or Absolut). The swim-up bar was fairly busy, but we never waited more than a minute to get drinks. The drinks were always good and strong. The bartenders will usually remember what you drink. 
ENTERTAINMENT: The hotel had good evening entertainment, and shows were different each night. The entertainment didn't start until 9 PM. There was also a disco/club in the main building that was very lively each evening, and the young adults in our party enjoyed going there.
Overall, this is an excellent hotel, one of the best of the dozen or so I have stayed at in Cancun. I would HIGHLY recommend this hotel to friends.
I would also like to mention that even though many hotels here are completely "all-inclusive", I always bring $200 or more in US $1 and $5 bills for tipping the waiters and housekeeping staff. I find that I get better service and I hope makes a small difference for the people in Mexico who work hard for much less dough than we make in the US.
Note: I booked this trip through Cheap Caribbean and had great service from that company.

reviews.author: AntreasNatasa
reviews.title: Amazing!!!
reviews.text: We stayed 5 amazing days for our honeymoon trip around Mexico. Everything there was amazing. Our room was big and comfortable with beautiful ocean view.  The staff very kind and helpfull and smiling to us all the time. The room and all the hotel areas very good designed and very clean.  The food oh my god the food was very very nice.  We were all inclusive but the food was so good at the buffet with a lot of choices. We also had reservation for dinner to 3 of the other restaurants very easily and also there the food was very good. The pool area was very nice and also we had there delicious hamburgers and hotdogs. By the nights we had our drinks at the bar and also danced in the small but nice club in the hotel.  In front of the hotel there is a bus station so in 5 to 10 minutes we could go to la isla where there are a lot of shops, cafes and restaurants or downtown to Cancun. Definitely we recommend this hotel..l

reviews.author: Gregory L
reviews.title: Paradisus Cancun is "hit and miss"
reviews.text: Although the resort is beautiful and the service is friendly, this all-inclusive did not live up to the expectations everyone seems to be giving for this resort. Over 40 members of a wedding party stayed there and we had several mishaps. Appoximately 1/3 of us got stomach sickness and we believe it was related to the buffet, possibly the fruit and lettuce that was washed. Bottles of water are in the room for your coffee and brushing your teeth, but if you are not made aware on DAY ONE that the sink water is not purified, you could end up using this water for drinking purposes-especially if you automatically put your toothbrush under the faucet every morning! Also, be aware that you may have a wait time of up to 15 minutes between 11:00am and 2:00pm at the Registration desk when people are checking in. I experienced this 4 times - once when I was locked out of my room as my key no longer worked and I had to go to Guest Services (and request immediate service since they told me to go to Registration) to prevent waiting in line again. I tried to order champagne and strawberries to be delivered to the bride and groom and it was an extreme effort to get this accomplished as I was sent to various departments and individuals. I was incorrectly informed about the use of a discount coupon and had to wait 15 minutes in line one morning to correct this, only to find out at checkout I had to go through the entire process again. Luckily, I had a printout from the day before and a voice mail on my room phone supporting my position. The spa is not recommended. The bride went for a makeup appointment for one of our dinners and the stylist did not even have eyeliner! One of us tried to show the stylist how the look should be and after the bride was almost in tears, the stylist walked OUT of the salon. We reported this to management. The service at the pool side bar and in some of the restaurants was very good, but I recommend staying away from the buffet and anything that may be washed and not cooked. This was our first all-inclusive resort for some of us and we said we would NOT do it again. I guess every experience is different so I recommend you read all the reviews to get a good idea about this resort. Maybe we just had the "unlucky" experience.

reviews.author: Volkl1
reviews.title: We'll be going back!
reviews.text:
We traveled as group of 3 couples to meet at the 9th hotel we’ve visited in the Cancun/Riviera Maya area. As explained to us, Paradisus is an AAA 4 diamond brand in the Melia Resort Portfolio, and is conveniently located in the middle of the hotel zone on a beautiful stretch of beach a short 15 minute cab ride from the airport. Our check in was quick and pleasant with Efrain and two of the rooms were ready early.  Ours was not, but when I went back 2 hours later, Efrain greeted me by name. 

 Our oceanfront room was tastefully furnished, clean and comfortable with a mini bar that was serviced every day.  The view was excellent and the balconies are very private. Our one issue with a slow sink was promptly fixed.

One of the most outstanding features of the Paradisus has to be the attitude of the staff.  From the restaurants to housekeeping, everyone had the same terrific, genuine attitude that we’ve found is lacking at some other resorts.

 The hotel grounds and pool are beautiful with more than adequate chair space at the pool and beach and you don’t have to bother with the stupid towel cards at Paradisus.  We did not book Royal Service on this visit, though we will try it next visit, particularly if it’s a busier time of year. Early November is a great time of year to enjoy Cancun as it’s a slower time.

Restaurants.  We tried 4 of the restaurants for dinner and had good experiences in all of them. The general consensus was that Mole was our favorite as the food was superb. Vento for Tapas was superb as well and sampling different dishes was a treat.  If we had a particular favorite, they were happy to bring out more. Bana was great as well, though I’m not a huge sushi fan everyone else really enjoyed it. Blue Agave for tacos was relaxed and the dinner was excellent. We did the buffet at Naos for breakfast and found it to be excellent.  We enjoyed Market Grill for lunch and we also took advantage of the Naos lunch buffet.  We also ordered room service for coffee and for appetizers and found the service to be timely.

Gym.  The gym is nicely equipped with high end machines, clean and well maintained.  

Spa.  I enjoyed a great massage with a coupon, but I found the spa experience to be so-so, and I was told the hydrotherapy area was closed, even though it was obviously open.

Family Concierge.  We didn’t have any reason to use the Family Concierge, but we did visit with one well-traveled family who were enthusiastic about their Paradisus experience and I’m recommending the hotel to a friend who will be traveling with his kids.

A couple of minor negatives.  The hotel leaks like a sieve during heavy rains, though we weren’t inconvenienced at all and the staff was right on top of the cleanup.
Our room was 3455 and was above the Red Lounge and was very noisy even on the 4th floor. The music, particularly the bass, reverberates and isn’t acceptable. I would avoid building 3 with rooms in the 50’s. We probably would have been accommodated had we asked to be moved, but we were too tired and made due with just leaving the a/c fan running all of the time. There wasn’t a lot of entertainment in the evenings, though that may have had more to do with the slow time of year.

Overall, we found this to be an excellent resort, and we will almost certainly return as a group next March. For another point of view on our stay, check DKurt’s review posted earlier.

reviews.author: Wendy Alaine H
reviews.title: Dayton Couple
reviews.text: Nice resort..friendly staff (Jorge, Carlos, Alfrozo & Leonardo), good bars and great food!  Usually never eat at the buffet but it was so good, with so many choices, we couldn't resist!  Pool was a little deep (5'9") but good temperature.

reviews.author: Disneylove2
reviews.title: Wonderful Resort
reviews.text:
We had the opportunity to visit this resort the first week in November.  My husband and I travelled with my parents and our daughters, ages 7 and 8.  We had a one bedroom lagoon view in the family concierge section, with my parents in a separate room.  The family concierge was one of the highlights of our stay.  Our butler Hervik was fantastic.  He took the time to get to know us and our needs and handled any situation we put before him.  The girls enjoyed him and the surprises he left for them throughout the week.  My husband and I also enjoyed the surprises we found.  We found the family sections at the pool and beach a great place for fun for the kids and an escape from the louder crowds when capacity was high near the end of the week.  Juan, the family pool concierge, was eager to help in any way possible.  We did not use the lounge as often as I thought we might, the candy was fun for the kids, but the snacks were not really different than what could be found at the buffet.

The beach, pool area and hotel grounds were beautiful.  The public areas in the hotel smelled terrific and reminded me of a spa.  We enjoyed all of the dinner reservations we had.  The food at the buffet was pretty good, but it would be nice to see a wider variety, with more authentic Mexican, and kept warmer.  We did not find any trouble with timeshare sales.  After being asked once and declining we were not asked again.  Our daughters enjoyed the time they spent at the kids club.  They loved the inflatable slide and the planned activities.

We had a great family vacation at Paradisus and would be eager to return again.  I would certainly recommend this hotel to anyone considering it.

reviews.author: SLL240
reviews.title: Paradise at Paradisus
reviews.text:
Our group's only goal for this vacation was to relax. So we struck GOLD at the all inclusive Paradisus. We upgraded to the Royal Service - and felt like we had the place to ourselves. Our concierge Sameul seemed to always be nearby to offer assistance. Our server Francisco did his best to ensure our glasses were always full and cold regardless of whether we were outside or in the Royal Service lounge. Wine Sommelier Carlos Duarte showed us the wine room and talked about his travels around the world. As the week progressed, we saw Carlos in the various restaurants and he always came to our table to suggest the best wines for our meal. David made sure that our oceanside Bali beds were ready and waiting each morning! And Jesus was everywhere from poolside, in the buffet area and in the Royal Service building, checking to ensure that every single detail was perfect for all the guests. We had a good time with all of these wonderful people as we watched the World Series and our hometown team, the Boston Red Sox and then fielded questions from all of them the next day on the results of the previous night's game.

The rooms in our section were spacious and spotless. The service was immediate and friendly. The restaurants and buffets were wonderful.The meals at Tempo and Mole were our favorites. Carlos recommended the wine paring meal at Tempo and luckily we listened to him. This 8 course meal offered tastings of duck, fish, squid, and a variety of vegetables, sauces and heavenly wines. It was the best meal of our lives.

The beach is soft, powdered sand and clean. There are no rock or seaweed or anything to take away from the beauty of the ocean. And the crystal clear ocean is the color of blue topaz. It was breathtaking. Because the resort is on the hotel strip, it is possible to walk for a couple of miles in either direction on the beach. The surf was very rough at the beginning of the vacation due to winds, but it was very swimable at the end of the vacation. The Royal Service private pool was large and surrounded by Bali beds. It was also pretty much desserted during our stay.

As for evening entertainment..... We have been to resorts that offered some type of show or activity every night. We didn't find that here. There was a "Thriller" type of show on Halloween. There is a bar that opened at 10pm, but we only went there one night and left after 1 drink. However, we didn't feel that this took away from the vacation. After a long day on the beach and a great dinner, no one minded turning in early.

And what vacation to Mexico is complete without tequila?? We attended a tequila tasting session (with Carlos!) and learned that good quality tequila is sipped not slugged, and it is best right after a meal. He told us about the blue agava plants, the process to make tequila and how to read the labels so we know what we are buying. All of this information was probably the best souviner of our trip.

The resort is only about 15 minutes from the airport, which means your vacation starts almost as soon as you land!

We highly recommend the Paradisus for a relaxing vacation.

reviews.author: shawn and natalie
reviews.title: Stop searching!  Book this place!
reviews.text:
Here I am in my room, halfway through my vacation writing this review.  Even though it's raining out, my wife and I couldn't be happier with our choice of the resort and the Royal Service upgrade. 

Even after reading all the glowing reviews of this place (and there were many) it still managed to exceed our expectations. 

Service:  Amazing!  Upon our arrival we requested and received a room upgrade (for a minor but well worth it cost) to an Ocean view.   Since it would be a while before our room would be ready,  Lourdes (LuLu), our check clerk, did her absolute best to make us feel comfortable by providing us with a hospitality suite while we waited. 

Now on to our butler Sergio.  Anytime we had a question, he would appear.This guy is so good at anticipating our needs that we started referring to him as our ninja butler. If i was at the self serve (there are plenty of full serve bars at this resort) and was pondering what drink to make, he would offer suggestions and show me how to make it.  

The pool service was also exceptional.  The waiters were extremely attentive and friendly.

Food:  The quality and the presentation of the food here rivals that of any four star restaurant back home. Of particular note was the Mole Mexican restaurant.

Rooms:  nicely appointed and wonderful view. 

Beaches: nice sandy beach.  No aqua shoes required here. 

Hotel common areas:  beautiful. Check out the pictures posted by others.

Gym:  the equipment here is high end.  Lifefitness brand.  Again check out the pictures

The little things (royal service): scented pillows, free room service, WiFi, abundant staffing, premium alcohol (even in mini bar), in room nespresso coffee machine, Bali beds and the list goes on. 

To summarize: book this place and you will thank me for it.

reviews.author: Linda M
reviews.title: A trip of a lifetime
reviews.text: This resort was WONDERFUL the pros are so many I don't know where to start, no cons to  mention.   Royal Services is what we booked, not really knowing what to expect....all I can say is we wanted for nothing! The atmosphere, our room was on the Lagoon Side and the magnification staff made our week of vacation just wonderful. I would like to say Gracias again to the following staff members, they all went out of there way to assure that we had a great time, Lulu & Natalia from Private Concierge made sure that we were comfortable with our rooms and always had a "hola" for us when we passed their way, our butler "Samuel" greeted us with a welcome drink that was perfect! he had a great personality and smiled all the time...he checked on us throughout his very busy day to make sure we were all doing okay, he would remind us everyday with our dinner reservations, Nancy and Debbie from housekeeping made our room so comfortable we were never short of anything not even a washcloth! David David David....the pool manager...what a great guy he is wonderful at what he does he makes sure that everybody is happy, had a great smile all the time for us, everyday at 12:30ish he would come around with refreshing scented washcloths, which we looked forward to, he would refresh our towels, he would come by again around 2:00 with fruit & confirm where would be sitting the next day, speaking of the pool area, what a relaxing area, we had such great lunches served by Octavio Gonzalez and Regelio Romera they work together very well and their suggestions for lunch were perfect and pairing it with a great wine made it even special. Throughout the week you can see that ALL of the STAFF here are all professionals and very attentive. I could go on and on...I will end my comments by saying "Royal Services" at Paradisus  was everything you could possible ask for and more....from the wonderful  aroma throughout the lobby to the candlelight surroundings at evening...to the turndown service .....as I said it was a trip of a life time!

reviews.author: payitfwd123
reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: Had a quick visit to The Paradisus Cancun for a wedding ceremony. My room was ready for me when I arrived @ 3pm. Others that were attending the same wedding and had arrived earlier in the day were left waiting until their rooms were ready. If you're coming in on an early flight, try to make arrangements with the hotel for early check in or be prepared to wait. The hotel is scenic and clean in a great location mid strip. The service for my quick stay was outstanding. Unlike the one other all inclusive hotel that I have stayed in, Paradisus staff  were attentive to all my needs. I didn't get to try the restaurants (except the taco place...avg to good) since I was there for a wedding but the catered food at the wedding was excellent.

reviews.author: Leslie J
reviews.title: Hotel Stay
reviews.text: The staff was very professional and friendly.  The Resort was beautiful, and convenient.  You could get the bus just outside of the hotel to go shopping at high end stores and Walmart.  There was a Papa John's across the street from the hotel.  Also, it only cost 1.00 to get on the bus.  Make sure that you know where you are going because the bus drivers make not speak English and you could get dropped off in the middle of know where.

reviews.author: Christina H
reviews.title: Clean & friendly
reviews.text: I was very impressed by the size of the rooms, pool, and hotel space. The staff was very friendly and constantly cleaning making this the absolute cleanest hotel I have ever been to. The outdoor pools were large and also very clean. The beach was right behind them and just as easy to access. I went in an off season and enjoyed a more quiet trip to Cancun. I would come back to this hotel.

reviews.author: WoJo
reviews.title: Impressive place
reviews.text:
The hotel is an expansive structure with 5 buildings (pyramids) among them one exclusively for visitors with children, and one exclusively for Royal Services  with private concierge, butler service, private pool, buffet, etc. The place is an all inclusive resort.
The building was constructed in the late 1980's / 1990's and shows some wear and tear (that's why only 4 stars) although still impressive.  Rooms are spacious and very well equipped.  Service professional and efficient.  There are several restaurants, bars, and variety of places to relax.
PROS: the place is huge so it takes you couple of days to orient yourself. There are several restaurants ranging from white table cloth TEMPO (not included in the deal but with a discount for hotel guests) to a buffet style one open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.  There is a night club, couple of bars, and more!
There is plenty of space so that you don't feel crowded (at least that was my impression when we were there).
The rooms are really spacious and comfortable. Royal Service rooms have Nespresso machines, mini bar with soft drinks and beer replenished daily. Bathrooms are very good size and well equipped. Each room has a large terrace with lawn chairs and nice views.
At Royal Service the concierge provides guests for the duration of their stay with a cell phone that will connect you quickly with your butler, concierge, room service or other guests.  The phone will work also anywhere in the city so you can communicate with the hotel or your friends without having to use your own cell phone.
The staff is very friendly and very helpful. There is always someone available to help and get you what you may possibly need.
The pool area, the beach, the cabanas... very nice. The bar / restaurant at the pool serves good lunch menu and endless drinks (!).

CONS: wear and tear in various areas i.e. fist day of our arrival it was raining bad. The skylights and various areas of the hotel had leaks so the staff had to place towels and "wet surface" signs.  The AC in public areas does not take all the heavy humidity out of the air so it may feel damp and tropical. 
One of our rooms had defective AC - it would work for a short period of time after being fixed and switch back to blowing warm humid air until the next fix.

I would definitely come back. You definitely get good value for the money.

reviews.author: dkurt
reviews.title: Our first trip to the Paradisus
reviews.text:
This was our group of 6 first trip to the Paridisus Cancun property. This resort is located in the hotel zone directly across from Aqua World. From the airport, it is about a 15 minute cab ride.  The property is made-up of 5 pyramid-styled towers with the restaurants and bars primarily located in the central tower. This resort has an upgraded Royal Service which provides for limited access to either end of the main pool area. One end is reserved for families any other is adult oriented.  A bit more about the Royal Service later in the review.

The property is well laid out and efficient relative to access to guestrooms, restaurants, bars as well as the pool and beach. Plenty of chairs were available around the pool although we did travel during low season. The main pool area has a swim up bar and drink and food services are available around the pool during the day.  

The beach was in very good shape and offered lounge chairs both in the sun as well as under numerous thatched tables.

The staff was very friendly and helpful. Some staff members had problems with English but this usually did not apply to servers and bartenders. There was no attempt at selling timeshares which was appreciated. We have found this to be an issue at a number of other properties in Cancun.

The drinks were good and the resort offered a number of top shelf liquors available for the asking including Cuervo, Stolichnaya, Absolute, Finlandia and Jack Daniels to name a few. The restaurants all did a very nice job. Here the restaurants were a bit untraditional relative to menu and food presentation. Options included Asian, traditional Mexican, Tapas and Brazilian steakhouse style. All the restaurants did a fine job with service and quality of food. Reservations were required at some of the restaurants although again we traveled during low season and this was not an issue.  One food quirk at this resort was an under appreciation for the hamburger/cheeseburger. These items were only available at on the menu at lunch and via room service. The addition of a  “burger bar” buffet during the day would be a great option.

All guest rooms have a private balcony, and I do mean private. No other balcony is visible from your private balcony. The pyramid design of the resort allows for this option. Ours overlooked the lagoon which offered awesome sunset views. The bed was very comfortable and the flat screen TVs offered a good channel selection including all four major American TV networks. ESPN and ESPN2 were available but keep in mind the programming will be different in Mexico than the United States. We were able to watch some NCAA college and professional football games.

The bathrooms were well decorated and included a full bathtub/shower. A separate room within the bathroom included the toilet and a bidet. An in-room coffee maker was provided and room service was available 24/7. The room service was generally quick and the food was very good. A small refrigerator was included in each guest room which included selections of beer, water and soft drinks. This minibar was serviced each day.

As previously mentioned, this resort offers an upgraded “Royal Service”. This includes various personal services available to members and access to restricted areas of the main pool area on either end. The family side included a kiddie pool and numerous toys for children to play with. The adult side offered more lounging options under cabanas along with whirlpools and expanded food service around the pool. The Royal service is available for an additional fee.

Entertainment was very limited at this resort. This included around the pool during the day and also in the evening. Most resorts provide some type of show or entertainment in the evening although this was not the case at the Paridisus. The addition of a live band or a sports bar would have made the evenings even better.

In general, we were very impressed with this resort and will certainly return in the future.

reviews.author: rickcap
reviews.title: 15th Trip to Cancun
reviews.text:
Just got back from a great week in Cancun…The Paradisus located in the middle of the strip, sports a boundless beach, with an ample amount of palapas.   Formerly the Gran Melia, the Paradisus has been all inclusive for just about a year, and has transformed nicely.   I’m happy to report there were no hidden fees…Internet, Wi-Fi, the gym, and the restaurants, with the exception of Tempo, were all included in the price.

The staff was attentive and friendly.  Special kudos to Abraham for pre-assigning me a super room on the 8th floor and handling my initial dinner reservation…Valeria, Marisol, and Sofonia for taking special care of me at breakfast, lunch, and on the beach…and the staff at Mole, Mauricio, Violeta, and Rigaberto.

Dinner reservations couldn’t have been any easier. Every morning, either the concierge or a guest services host was available to book the next evenings reservation.  My favorite restaurant was Mole, a nice break from Americanized Mexican cuisine.  My only regret was to have only dined at the Rodizio once, great skewers, take extra servings of the pork.  I enjoyed both breakfast and lunch at the Market Grill.  At breakfast, try all five of the blended health drinks, at lunch dine off the menu. 

Just a few tweaks…The evenings were a bit lame, I think the addition of an activity director and staff would do nothing but improve the experience.  Not being a solid gold dancer fan or techno music enthusiast, I looked for alternate types of amusement each evening.  

Finally, golfers rent the clubs, bring your own balls.

reviews.author: Semiha N
reviews.title: Our trip to "Paradisus"
reviews.text:
This was our first time travelling to Cancun as a couple and our friend recommended Paradisus. We were so pleased. We truly enjoyed everything this hotel had to offer. The staff was amazing! We come in there and were greated with "Welcome Home". For that week it truly felt like a home. Everyday I participated in the Zumba and water aerobic classes with Angel. He was really great! Although most days I was the only one that was excited about this, we would round up more people to participate. After Zumba and water aerobics we spent most of our time near the pool bar. The guys there were super friendly and accommodating. Lunch time they would ask as if we wanted to order food. We did that for a few days, but we really liked the Buffett for lunch. If your at the pool bar expect to make some unforgettable memories. Gabriel and Salvador (bartenders outside) would do some tricks with shot glasses. Luis (Flash) will make you some really great shots!!! I can go on for hours about how great these 3 made our trip.
The Avenue Lounge upstairs was perfect for winding down the night. The guys upstairs Samuel, Juilio and Antonio offered great service, and were very attentive. Right when you sit down they are there to offer you a drink and some peanut snacks.

We had dinner at most of the restaurants. My favourite had to be Tempo. We got to use our voucher and enjoy amazing food! At night time there were 3 shows during the 7 days that we were there. So make sure to ask what nights the shows will be, do not miss them. All 3 shows were amazing.

Unlike some of the other complaints I've seen on here, we were never hassled about the time share at this hotel. We met some people that attended it and they seemed happy to have gotten a free spa service.

All in all we really had a wonderful time here and are already making plans with friends to return next year. 

Thank you to all the staff at this hotel for making our vacation unforgettable.

reviews.author: Marion W
reviews.title: Terrific destination in Cancun
reviews.text:
We,ve only been here for three days, but had to write about how impressed we,ve been so far......the weather has been quite rainy, but that hasn't been a problem.  We,ve totally enjoyed the Market Grill for lunches, and Mole and Vento, which were both terrific, for impeccable service, food presentation and quality.  We,ve travelled extensively, both to resort destinations all over North America and Europe, and on cruises on a number of cruise lines, and Paradisus, Club Melia through RCI has been wonderful.  As in previous reviews we,ve read, the staff are super.  
Thank you so much for making sure our needs are all met with care and a smile!

reviews.author: Donna H
reviews.title: great staff
reviews.text: We liked this hotel very much, very pretty, dinner reservations were easy to make, we got in to the ones we wanted with no problem. Our waitress Valeria at the Market grill was the best, friendly acommadating ,knew what we wanted before we sat down. I loved the coconut ice cream and she had one ready for me to go the day we were leaving..Enrique the bartender at the coconut bar not only served drinks he showed us a lot of tricks at the bar, a lot of fun.Fuego was one of our favorite places to eat with a great staff,Hector the capitan,Dulce the hostess and Jose our waiter.When we got to the hotel Rual Lozrne took our bags and did not stop helping us with what ever we needed through out our stay up to the last minute until we left. We are looking forward to our next trip to the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Jennifer C
reviews.title: Great Vacation
reviews.text: First time to Paradisus.  We had a great family vacation.  The family concierge is the way to go.  Everyone so helpful.  Especially, Henrich.  He is the BEST.  He goes above and beyond.  My daughter enjoyed the kid zone.  The carnitas at Blue Agava were deliciouso.  We enjoyed everything.  Juan at the family pool was super.  Room service was a plus.  We can't wait to return.

reviews.author: Tierra
reviews.title: Beautiful Resort
reviews.text:
Amazing resort with Wonderful decor...the restaurants were really good. Friendly service staff, great drinks along the beautiful majestic waters of the Caribbean. 

My husband and I arrived at the Paradisus Cancun on a Wednesday afternoon to be greeted by friendly staff and escorted to a lavish air-conditioned check in room. From there, we were headed to our room in the beautiful Royal Service Pyramid (adults only section). Our room was very spacious, clean and comfortable. It was equipped with a television, safe, mini fridge, marble floors and a large bathroom. 

Although we did not eat at all the restaurants, the ones we did experience were really good. 

The pools and beach area was very clean and had several bars, including two swim up bars. 

The only thing that would make this resort better would be more activities.

reviews.author: MariaS907
reviews.title: cancun
reviews.text: I found this hotel excellent in décor hospitality, and cleanliness. the beach was stunning crystal clear water and well maintained. The pool areas were clean, and well arranged. We found the food to be very good in all the restaurants .The Bana bar was a good focal point , the rooms were well appointed, and comfortable. One of the best aspects was the staff they were attentive and always ready to go the extra step. The location was close to the commercial areas, by bus, or taxi .Yes we will go back again.

reviews.author: Ken S
reviews.title: Week in Paradise
reviews.text:
This was our first trip to Cancun and our first All-inclusive Resort experience. The décor on the first level is stunning. We had $550.00 in Resort credit, but used none of it. Several discounts on wine (which we don't drink) and coupons for food upgrades (which we didn't find useful).Make sure you get your credits when you check in. If you've cruised before, the food is very similar. Awesome swimming pool and bar area. Our only frustration was that the representative from VacationExpress was late the first full day we were there ( you meet with them and they tell you when they will pick you up to go home). Then, when it was time to leave, the shuttle was late, too.
All in all, a wonderful place to spend our 45th anniversary.

reviews.author: Arina_Bocharova
reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: We like the service of Naos restaurant. The waiters is really good. real professionals. Especially we liked Paola and Raul. Very good waiters. We did't like the room service. It isn't good... The room was good and comfortable. Thanks for really good welcome (:

reviews.author: DrEthan725
reviews.title: It's nice enough, but there are better places for better prices
reviews.text: Overall we were very happy we stayed here. There was one BIG NEGATIVE: There is a big push when you first arrive to attend a 90 min screening for Club Melia- which isnt' a timeshare, but sort of is- and they'll give you a heavily discounted spa service for listening to the pitch. The pitch went over the 90 minutes- 2 hrs 10 minutes. When they told us it was 138K to joint the "Club" and we could finance it over 60 months at 16.9% interest we said, "no, thanks." That's when the hard push came in. It was offensive, actually.  We left annoyed but were looking forward to the massages & hydrotherapy we booked for having lost 2+ hours of vacation. Sadly, the hydrotherapy was COLD water and the massages were some of the worst we'd ever had. Not a good spa. The food was decent, though never spectacular. The facilities really need attention. It rained our first 2 days there and there were leaks ALL OVER THE HOTEL. Our room, which faced the ocean, took on water through the sliding door. I don't think it should rain indoors in a "Luxury all-inclusive resort". I also found it very 1980's to have unpotable water in the bathrooms. All of the good modern resorts have full water filtration systems. That said, the service was excellent. People were friendly and solicitous. Truly, some of the best Mexican hospitality. Would I go back?  Sure-- if I were under the gun, again.  The beach is lovely as is the pool.  But if I had time to plan it?  I'd probably go elsewhere.

reviews.author: abroto b
reviews.title: definitely not Paradise
reviews.text: first you are welcome to hotel Paradisus with sales pit, members rewards and time share! This experience was daily approached by staff to sell. This is not a all inclusive hotel since some items in menu in the restaruants are for purchased. the food is either awful or basic with a over powering after taste of poor olive oil. The drinks was water down and wine was not included must be purchased. Restaruants are not available on a daily bases including the buffet restaruants. traveling off or returning could be hazard to your health due non handrails and eight flights of steps.

reviews.author: zneh
reviews.title: Another memoriable time at Paradisus in Cancun
reviews.text: I can never get enough from this place. This is my 3rd time going and will continue to tell my friends and family about it. I went during Mexico Independence Day and had a fabulous time dancing with he mariachi and the rest of the staff/guest. Keep up the GREAT customer service. Viva Mexico!!! Viva Paradisus!!!

reviews.author: Maureen F
reviews.title: A beautiful week in "Paradisus"
reviews.text: Mexico almost never lets you down. It was a grim extended forcast before we left but the weather was beautiful! The Paradisus was gorgeous, it deserves every one of it's 4.5 "palm tree" ratings. Very clean, service with a smile, a great buffet at Naos, many restaurant choices and easy to get a reservation. We were there during a slow season so I can't say how that would be at the height of tourist season. Also very nice workout equipment. Ask for the 3rd tower, 4th floor or higher, ocean view. All restaurants, stores the Avenue bar and the Red Lounge are in here. I would definitely return to the Paradisus.

reviews.author: Fabio H
reviews.title: Wonderful vacation
reviews.text: The hotel is great..but the staff puts it over the top. Everyone was dedicated to making sure we were happy. We have no reservations about recommending this hotel to everyone we know. We were traveling as a family of 16 including children and the hotel accommodated all of our needs.

reviews.author: veneziabellaitalia
reviews.title: Relaxing under the sun
reviews.text: The purpose of this trip was to relax and that is exactly what we did during our stay.  We stayed during the last wk of October and it was obvious its low season in Cancun.  We took the Grayline shuttle offered by Orbitz and both times our drivers were very pleasant.  It was a 20 min ride and upon arrival to Paradisus we upgraded to Royal Service Ocean front room. And it was worth the additional $100 a night.  We had a butler Juan (very nice), private pools, ocean front bali beds (reserved by Juan daily), and anything we needed including confirming pickup to the airport.  Royal service also offers a breakfast spread but its small and we much rather the buffet choices at Naos. Lunch was always at La Palapa in the pool area which is also exclusive to Royal service and the service and food are excellent!  Our waiter was Octavio and he always made sure we had a drink and delicious food served while we relaxed on the bali beds.  We were very happy to tip him daily because of his exceptional service and I hope other people do the same.  Dinner we ate at Vento, delicious tapas-style; Market Grill, it was okay; Bana had good sushi; and Mole had delicious mexican/contemporary dishes.  All places had exceptional service and Juan, our butler made the reservations every night.  Royal  also gives you access to the Yhi Spa.  Services are for a fee but you can enjoy their sauna, massaging pool and different baths.  All VERY nice.  We did get an aromatherapy massage and it was just okay.  We used the gym, there are about 4 treadmills, free weights and a couple of other machines.  Its a small space but has enough machines to workout.  Also, we did celebrate our anniversary and they decorated our bed with rose petals and sent us a champagne bottle and chocolate desserts. Very nice touch that made us feel special.  There is a store in the hotel named Market, has toiletries and other things.  I forgot my mouth wash and the hotel had none to give me but that store, Market, sold a small bottle for $8!  And I found the same price on the hotel strip.  We took the bus for about $1 and a few minutes from the hotel.  They have Zara, LV, Gucci, Starbucks, MAC, etc.  However, we then took another bus, R2, into the city of Cancun - specifically the Market 28 area.  We went into a nearby supermarket and bought mouthwash for $2 and bought tequila for MUCH cheaper than the hotel area.  We never felt scared or threatened.  In fact the locals are happy to point you to the right direction.  Just beware of the people that want to be your personal tour guide.  These guys are nice but they want a tip and they get kick backs from the stores they take you into which means the store charges you more for that item.   Going back to the hotel - downfall is that at night there is no entertainment other than a wanna-be club which was empty every night.  Since we dont enjoy the club atmosphere we would have liked a show with mexican folk music.  Either way, I hope we can go back and enjoy the royal treatment again!

reviews.author: Jean L
reviews.title: Excellent!!
reviews.text: We stayed at this hotel from oct. 26 to nov. 02. 2013. It was our second trip at this hotel (but about our 10th trip to Cancun). How can we rate this hotel? Because EVERYTHING is excellent. We highly recommend this hotel. One of the bit decision of the day was to decide; where to go for dinner??? Because the quality and variety of food at the buffet restaurant NAOS is impeccable. As well as the many restaurants included in our all inclusive package. The room was clean, well decorated and well maintained. The hotel staff is always smiling and ready to serve you. The hotel interior design is a must to be seen.  For our next trip to cancun we will stay there....again.
